21dd9556-2973-4d03-b4fe-1ebb5f85929f: {n}Svelid turns pale and reaches for the crossbow she keeps hidden under the counter.{/n}
ce0e9358-7d40-4407-85e5-1c43c8229e5d: "It looks like you won't have to go looking for her after all. Come on, General. Let's give it to these scoundrels!"
04391277-cd7a-4c7d-b134-e2dc3f175d71: "Thank you for dealing with that wretch!"
d7f7ca7d-2275-4545-90cb-1d19a1dcfeac: "She's right! I was struck dumb with fear when I heard these screams outside. It was just like when they trashed our tavern in {g|Galt}Galt...{/g}" {n}The halfling pours herself a shot of something strong and gulps it down.{/n}
b4f877b9-24f0-4b49-8406-706670a64e74: "She'd better not stick her nose in here again. I won't warn her. – I'll fire my crossbow while she's still at the door!"
991eecee-8393-4698-aed5-7190025f6574: {n}Kalikke throws back her head and looks upward.{/n} "Up there! There's a tower there, on the cliff. But it will be difficult to climb such a steep slope." {n}Kalikke gives you a pensive and sad smile.{/n} "My sister and I used to climb cliffs together. She was so angry when I was faster! But she always helped me when she got ahead..."
3d0aa143-1741-4aab-bfac-5f6d966bb4a0: {n}Kalikke climbs the cliff with the dexterity of a lizard, but you go stride for stride with her, easily keeping up. Soon the top of the cliff lays before you...{/n}
2190471c-28e1-4dbc-89b1-898129c36020: {n}You begin climbing. At one point you discover that a ledge you meant to step on is not secure. You try to backtrack, but lose your balance.{/n}
437e9853-7932-4883-9b85-55c1712e1f91: {n}Luckily, Kalikke, who is climbing with the dexterity of a lizard, catches your hand just in time and helps you hold on.{/n} "Look, we're close to the top! Almost there..."
d2f48b0e-1652-49d1-981f-5ec1e16dcc23: "I've met a lot of people. Fought side by side with many of them. The best allies in the Stolen Lands are the steadfast Mivoni. They're always reliable — unlike Brevans."
9084a83b-d185-4359-be05-d2bf9cc3af4f: "Brevan families specialize in scheming and treachery. It would seem even commoners of those parts possess the same dishonest instincts as their rulers."
91912b0d-630e-477c-995b-a551bb82d27b: "Southerners are all the same. — Cowards with no pride or courage."
8780704e-b7a0-4c76-9da5-080f828dd921: "There's only one whose word you can always trust: yourself."
047e8f78-8dd6-4a7f-b898-6f0d50fada0d: "In other words, you'd prefer a sword in the chest to a dagger in the back."
78505544-62a4-4c1c-b0aa-3707ef59b9a9: "In other words, you'd prefer a sword in the chest to a dagger in the back."
321ccbb7-00f4-467d-bff6-74d24134f4b5: "I command you: leave this place immediately!"
ac3ac116-a51a-455f-a278-7ea961865728: "Silence! Please, let us speak. Tell me what brings you to my door."
a5de3aa7-dbe0-452a-a6c4-e933327082b6: "Keep this up, and you'll all regret coming here."
391a1e5a-c462-4d63-8994-3573f117676b: "Jhod, can you try to reason with them?"
0369f68a-a0bf-4df3-a9f3-ff0585b827ad: [To Remus] "You're supposed to be in a cell!"
96a6b2a8-67b3-4292-8ce4-a11b2244d8e4: "People aren't dying from some curse, it's from strange magical seeds that carry a fatal disease. We just need to find out where they're coming from, then..."
f3550983-4251-45c2-b369-9c8b2ce14275: "It's not worth arguing with them. Let them come to their own conclusions."
fbaaca86-5c9a-4eb9-8888-006e854cb597: "I refuse to get involved in this. Let them believe whatever they want."
be3147c1-4eaf-4872-9a5c-2eaf6a680f63: "I don't need to justify myself to anyone!"
d423f549-b626-47ac-9dcd-19d98de6df59: "In times like these, a ruler should be able to rely on {mf|his|her} people, but I seem to have only ill-equipped vagrants who insist on threatening me. Return to your homes, before I decide to give you a sample of what I have in store for those who dare to send a magic disease into MY lands!"
fae6864d-2325-4afb-9e8b-645237fe8a75: "I have no time for your wailing and threats — take your pleas to another."
45536a71-5e85-4d1c-b12c-023d34d2ab1d: "Please, give me more time! I won't let any disaster, natural or magical, overcome our strength! Trust in me, your rightful liege, and I WILL find a way to protect you and those you love!"
e05dec19-6474-4a9b-b9ba-2a7927f20f0a: "Not long ago, the Stolen Lands were little more than a haven for cutthroats and bandits. If the fine, upstanding citizens abandon me, who will I have left to rely on? It's you who are the true foundation of this barony — a fact I've never forgotten!"
c14a3d8a-699b-4c15-b7f4-c1f580a95a7f: "You ungrateful rabble, dare judge me, the one charged with protecting this barony? You're still here, so I must be doing something right!"
950882ec-ac37-484f-a25b-3686abd66505: "Your whining sickens me. How much longer must I put up with this farce?"
71743623-3070-47d3-b7fb-a8a3708f559e: "Lamashtu's cult is outlawed in these lands, like everywhere else. Keeping the reign of law in the Stolen Lands is my top priority, and I'll defend it to my dying breath!"
5f0ae645-6104-4643-bbce-5fce5f799730: "If you care so much about my beliefs, maybe it's time we examine YOUR altars of worship! Let me see your paragons of virtue who have the right to reproach me!"
b70f225b-2dc5-444d-a2b3-7b592219c0f7: "To think these miserable imbeciles are allowed to roam free in my lands..."
2ef2f58e-c62f-4390-8285-70cd023933f8: "I'm doing all in my power to protect this realm from the evils besieging it. I swear to you, we'll soon discover the truth and put an end to this!"
67b5ac3f-c8de-43f7-8083-f4aebb8b9363: "Put your faith in me, stand with me to overcome this ordeal, and I promise I will not let you down!"
d35adeb5-b1b5-4cdf-a88c-46b193f4fd42: "The mere thought of following Lamashtu disgusts me. I would never put the lives of those entrusted to me in such danger."
ca96f117-fd55-4d6c-8b48-2e748cba4df9: [Attack] "Enough! I'm sick of this rabble's threats."
5204e27b-5763-4cb0-aa44-3c6b5ce66a62: [Lie] "Yes, I worship Lamashtu. If you have a problem with that, why not step forward so we can discuss it face-to-face?"
7b9f74bd-4129-4195-9bb8-6eecfcca4bd3: "I don't have time for this 'revolt' nonsense. Guards, lock these mongrels up, and hang every second one of them — if any others persist, break them on the wheel. These people need to be taught to respect the law of their {mf|baron|baroness}."
9cbdd7ef-3b04-44d1-9fe7-db0b5fb0f549: "Please hear me out before you lynch me. I know you're tired and disgruntled — I am too. Day after day I and my companions seek a solution to your misfortunes. We've saved so many from this fatal disease, and if the gods have mercy, we can save even more! So please, let us do what we can — return to your homes, to your loved ones. They need you, just as I need your patience and good faith."
03ae2591-4ed7-4ebc-b12d-01a066e555a6: [To Remus] "You're supposed to be banished from my lands!"
f682f637-8df9-4c75-81df-350d76990d1a: {n}The murmuring crowd takes up almost the entire square. The murmuring turns to shouts at your arrival, and a stone flies out of the crowd and strikes the cobbles at your feet.{/n}
9355b5f1-4e74-4903-b998-871fe4b449cb: "There {mf|he|she} is! Out at last, damn {mf|his|her} eyes!"
a60b8f0b-d590-4d46-8d26-0c41467376a2: "People, please hear me!" {n}Jhod steps forward and raises his hands.{/n} "Quiet down!" {n}His voice thunders over the crowd, and the people fall silent, waiting.{/n}
5d455e7f-9b15-4bf2-8acc-d681b250a34b: "Lies! This 'ruler' is the source of all our suffering! Once we get rid of {mf|him|her}, the curse will be lifted!"
72a8243d-1e05-4510-b069-75bd0541140c: "Is that right?! You can't silence us all!"
39d67146-d801-4c22-9f34-d2398b3e6d21: {n}Suddenly, an old man dressed in rags steps from the crowd — or the crowd parts for him, it's difficult to tell. As he gets closer, you recognize him — it is the prophet, {d|Remus}Remus{/d}. His eyes fall on the crowd.{/n} "Repent, fools! This is your last chance to appease the Goddess." {n}He turns and points at you, his eyes afire.{/n} "By killing the one who dared lay claim to our Mistress's lands!"
8feaa368-41a6-42aa-88fa-a13a4921b9a2: "Curse? There is no curse, you fool! Are you so afraid that you'll take every rumor you hear as truth?"
56a355f3-9549-486d-a14e-d9909937a9c3: "Goddess sent me a {d|c21 Remus Executed}reprieve{/d}! Goddess protects those who hear her whispers! Goddess led me here to reveal the beast that destroys her kingdom and poisons her land!" {n}Remus lifts his hand and points his finger at you.{/n} "Your baron{mf||ess} will not receive the mercy {mf|he|she} is so eager to deny! {mf|He|She} laughs at omens and prophets without knowing what forces {mf|he|she} is meddling with!"
2a90f91c-7572-417c-80dd-59769ae0300b: "Can {d|c21 Remus Imprisoned}locks{/d} and latches stop the primal force? What doors can withstand Nature itself that strucks those who are guilty?" {n}Remus smiles, showing his rotten teeth.{/n} "You have no idea what forces you are trying to oppose! Repent, accept your faith and claim your reward — quick demise!"
57d39fe0-db8a-4315-8fb4-50724783c0ec: "Do you wish to know where to find safe haven in dark times? In faith, strong and pure! Pray to {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, or your own gods! Cast away the wicked, lazy thinking that brought you to this point. Only together can we purge the evil seeking to take root in our hearts!"
20ff8cf7-1ac5-4e1b-97da-74834931cf59: {n}People in the crowd look at each other uncertainly. Some close their eyes and put their hands to the holy symbols at their necks.{/n}
06cc96c0-64de-4b31-b54d-1bd40e04d948: "A disease? Why would you {d|c22 hide truth}hide{/d} that from us, keep silent as monsters tore apart our loved ones? No, you're just trying to hide the truth about your curse!"
dff80dd1-9420-4367-aab9-8ac6d27dbf70: "The {mf|baron|baroness} is telling the truth, and always has! How many of us were saved by being {d|c22 tell truth}warned{/d} of the coming disaster?"
c3b7f565-1dad-48a5-bae7-dd2b923be914: "{d|MadlaStasek}Madla Stasek{/d}! She believed these lies about a disease, too, and she went to you in hopes of finding a cure! Well, where is she, {mf|baron|baroness}? Likely buried in an unmarked grave!"
e0561aab-6719-4808-9606-246c6925daff: "Are you all mad? I myself came to the {mf|baron|baroness} for a cure! If you'd only seen the foulness they took out of me, you'd know this is not some curse!"
25557aa1-d75b-42c5-b124-1c2d3048666d: {n}The people exchange looks and nod slowly. It seems your words have calmed them somewhat.{/n}
2e47d0f8-2ac4-4cb4-b358-321570f3b406: {n}Your words are met with cold silence. The crowd gives each other dark looks and tighten their grips on their torches.{/n}
79cff526-8f4b-408f-8765-438ebf1219e1: "Enough! You don't care about us! You hole up in your castle in fear, and refuse to lift a finger while us simple folk die like animals!"
94e3949f-1198-41c9-b74b-d3e783f9150f: "{mf|He|She} won't even let us {d|c22 Refugees Capital}leave{/d}! Made us turn back — it'd be bad for business if any other rich folk heard that people were fleeing the lands like rats from a sinking ship!"
8e540a46-5335-4a3b-9769-ff83f8cdc15b: "If all you care about is your own hide, then go on, flee with your tail between your legs! My neighbors may have fled like cowards, but the {mf|baron|baroness} is still here — {mf|he|she} refuses to leave {mf|his|her} people!"
0acb18ed-a098-4caa-a7ed-fdcdc215c337: "Bah, only {d|c21 Bandits Evil}thugs{/d} in {mf|his|her} service! They're locking up roads and bridges! You want to cross? Better pay up! People are running for their lives, and {mf|he|she}'s lining {mf|his|her} pockets!"
b81948f7-44e1-407b-83cf-e256b25a751a: "You heard of the new Stag Lord yet? No? That's because the {mf|baron|baroness} took {d|c22 Fake Killed}care{/d} of him, just like the one before that! The roads are safer, thanks to {mf|him|her}!"
4dd676b1-6918-49f8-97d1-97a07ee11163: "Let an old man speak! I'll have you know I was {d|c22 GoTo Jhod}sent{/d} by the {mf|baron|baroness} {mf|himself|herself} to see this here priest of Erastil. And he cured me! So prattle all you want about some curse, but don't you spread lies about our {mf|baron|baroness}!"
21f338e6-4efb-46db-9ab8-0262673d6031: "{mf|He|She} don't give a damn about us! I know it for sure — a fellow of mine met this scoundrel for a {d|c22 Peasants Left}chat{/d} near the castle. Know what happened after that? He took his family and left for good, because it was clear {mf|His|Her} Grace cares nothing for the troubles of {mf|his|her} subjects!"
faa2da1d-7c6e-49a3-b832-a95432cd9635: "Enough, all of you! The {mf|baron|baroness} has been fighting to protect us! I've {d|c22 Peasants Stayed}talked{/d} to {mf|him|her} personally! I've seen how much {mf|he|she} cares! If we turn against each other, we're lost!"
aac7c3f8-450c-411c-82a0-5ad56313e67b: "You leave the {mf|baron|baroness} be! {mf|He|She} didn't even hesitate to help out poor folk like me!"
ff8ffe95-177d-4740-9eef-2e47383a3ccc: {n}The people before you look around at each other, nodding. You see a few peasants turn and leave quietly.{/n}
764afbbe-0d53-45f7-9972-b5905cacf6b3: {n}Angry murmuring runs through the crowd. Some shake their fists at you, others their weapons into the air.{/n}
072ff44b-52c9-4cc4-9c57-55b92540002d: "A serpent's tongue! Clear sign of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}! Did she grant you such cunning and hypocrisy in return for our lives?!"
866e3af4-fe12-442e-b22f-5753095d95bd: "It's true! {d|c22 Goblins Live}Goblins{/d} dart about everywhere, putting up their filthy totems, and without a bit of fear! But it doesn't trouble our {mf|baron|baroness} — no, they can just put up their vile idols anywhere they want and carve honest people up for their wretched gods!"
9975df34-233c-4b7e-8003-0037b9a2e7b3: "You bite your tongue! Ever since our {mf|baron|baroness} {d|c22 Goblins Killed}scattered{/d} the goblin tribe and stomped out their vile cult, there's been not a word of the vermin!"
68df9a3b-ddbc-4384-b6ef-623cf67d1307: "Did you hear about the human cult of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}? They say the {mf|baron|baroness} gave them {mf|his|her} {d|c22 Tsanna Lives}favor{/d} and panders to their every whim!"
5d3b5f81-0f2e-4ac6-abca-e0f6a5c84ac6: "Did you hear about the human cult of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}? The {mf|baron|baroness} declared {d|c22 Tsanna Exiled}war{/d} on them! Our lands are no place for wicked gods and their minions!"
5d506164-d595-4817-84a6-7c9372e25910: "Just look at {mf|him|her}! Got a goblin right at {mf|his|her} side! Has {mf|he|she} no shame, taking beasts like that into {mf|his|her} service?"
6db9bf17-2485-406f-b921-9db3f77f4b13: {n}As they listen to you, some of the people edge closer. Many nod in agreement, and those who were shouting the loudest accusations turn their eyes away.{/n}
9200e3ef-8b70-4b34-9090-44dadf51464a: {n}Angry murmuring runs through the crowd. It looks like it might erupt at any moment.{/n}
1f939a2c-706f-4ce4-84b2-a60cbbc1bdd3: {n}...which gives way to some awkward coughing and the shuffle of feet as the crowd begins to disperse. Some risk a glance at you as they go, others hide their faces as they hastily leave the square.{/n}
a1cabf2f-77c7-4c6b-870a-4df42b409f0e: {n}...and then the people begin arguing among themselves. You manage to catch bits and pieces of their conversations — some have given up on the revolt, while others demand it continue. After a while, it becomes clear the crowd has lost its fire. The people turn and leave, continuing to argue as they do.{/n}
0d44c7aa-676f-4c57-a56e-fa07569e02f9: {n}...which explodes into furious shouting.{/n} "Down with the {mf|baron|baroness}! Death to the cursed fiend!" {n}Waving clubs and torches, the crowd turns on you to attack.{/n}
4ab72ecb-c46d-473c-b82c-abc234b009c2: {n}Jhod leans in.{/n} "We've done all we can." {n} He turns to the crowd, then presses his hands together in prayer.{/n} "In the name of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, I beseech you — return to your homes, your families! You've suffered enough — do not bring more strife upon yourselves!"
e2e3ff71-429a-4048-b2cb-e1b6a0f7003e: "Would you look at that! The {mf|baron|baroness} is trying to order us around, what a surprise! Well, we're fed up with you and your orders! Get off our lands while you're still in one piece!"
c899b557-0994-4ae7-b386-33bf464299f4: {n}Your voice is drowned out by the crowd's uproar. The peasants in front raise their torches, pitchforks, and clubs as they shout at you.{/n}
9c5545bb-62ad-4674-8bd8-c5093ebd93c7: "I am Jhod Kavken, humble servant of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}. I may be {mf|His|Her} Grace's confidant, but I am also one of you, the people of this realm. The {mf|baron|baroness} is deeply concerned by your suffering, and {mf|he|she} is doing everything in {mf|his|her} power to..."
2b93fe35-097b-46e8-89e5-9d439f4e51bb: {n}The crowd is getting louder and louder. The people in front seem to be slowly edging toward you.{/n}
ec1b212a-4421-4863-b7d4-8418db73b002: "Silence! Let your ruler speak!" {n}Jhod nods at you.{/n} "Please go on, Your Grace."
4f3aa4c5-b278-448c-8b80-fb31b7a0b829: "Did you come here to hear yourselves talk? For shame! While you try to figure out why you all gathered here, at least let the {mf|baron|baroness} speak!"
6ed297d0-edd3-4f4e-9593-bcf5b9456ac0: "{g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} the merciful! Forgive them, they are caught up in their own anger! Your Grace, they don't know what they're saying!"
ce9e5933-8d6f-437f-8ef9-605e303adb08: {n}As the priest's speech comes to an end, a silence fills the air...{/n}
15d35d1b-0be9-4c13-b197-4df2d01fadc4: {n}You look around in search of Remus, the mysterious old man who managed to show up despite your best efforts to get rid of the instigator. It seems the mad preacher managed to disappear in all the commotion.{/n}
24959ec7-0742-4d5f-8af5-c05383682310: {n}For a moment, the crowd is silent. Then people start exchanging glances and whispers. Some give you looks filled with fear and hate.{/n}
161bd8ed-c003-4aae-b217-331d62e1cb29: {n}The people in the front row step back, pushing their companions backward as well. Those who meet your gaze look away quickly.{/n}
a9fce2c0-90dc-44c9-8b5f-a7ef87e1de3d: {n}The people before you exchange wary looks and back away. You notice a few peasants hastily turn and leave.{/n}
af52f80d-4e82-4e23-b8b6-be72cb3e87d3: {n}The crowd before you sways and mumbles: people look at one another, talk in a hushed tone, shake their heads and frown. It seems rebels who were screaming and jeering a minute ago alost all their confidence. Finally, one of the peasants opens his mouth.{/n}
6d6dffb9-f41a-4a43-809a-f9b9b4f01434: "You really believe this? It's pure nonsense!"
c758d2de-49d5-40d2-b50d-d990fc6f12bb: "Don't you get it? We could run the {mf|baron|baroness} through, but it wouldn't change a thing! {mf|He's|She's} of more use alive than dead!"
3b8d531f-f23c-4d1f-b2dd-523d74e54b14: "So be it, {mf|baron|baroness}, we'll let you pass. But don't forget — we're trusting you with our lives."
773609e7-d240-474a-b0c3-0914b5872096: "Find the source! Save our children from this terrible sickness!"
fbd035b7-0dce-4a48-a01b-72bb00ee2b54: "The old man's right! The {mf|baron|baroness} is cursed! If we let {mf|him|her} go now, we'll all find our graves tomorrow!"
eacdf141-08ff-47b4-98de-45301a01d939: "An if we don't let {mf|him|her} go, we'll be mangled one by one by them beasts that tear out of the sick! This goddess of yours no one's seen — what help will she be then?!"
6da83750-16d2-429d-9287-3ed9b9b237fe: "Pitiful fools! You doom yourselves by entrusting yourselves to the one who angered the great goddess!"
cf46043e-5d11-46ed-9b4f-6f2ecd0160e1: "Are you out of your mind, Your Grace?! This is inhuman!"
2fdd5ff3-9222-4c54-b598-ab14647899ff: "Jhod, the time for words is done. Guards! Didn't you hear your {mf|baron|baroness}? Carry out your orders!"
3b4b11de-87f7-4a56-a115-474b616d78a2: "I am the voice and sight of the goddess, Her loyal servant and herald of Her will! Your words are nothing against Her commands! Your orders are ashes against Her prophecies. The day is nigh when this disgusting city will be swallowed by the other world, and I cry out to all who can hear me: Repent, fools! Repent, for the reckoning of your avarice is nigh! None of you know the forces you're dealing with!"
7aec290e-a9e6-4269-b0c7-efec644547f5: "So I pick up my clothes this morning — and see some pictures embroided on it — pine trees, clouds, an owlbear fighting a troll... Spill it out, who did that?!"
3ec45b32-5ac5-42b2-9bd6-2a6998f342e9: "I confess. It was I. — I only meant to patch them up a bit… and got a little carried away."
55b59b18-63e5-4b76-ada8-48d9cdee13d3: "Your head is like an attic – so stuffed with books and trophies that there's no place left for simple compassion!"
c86abac5-4c7b-432e-94a5-da3833b5e315: "And your head is like a temple of Sarenrae – beautiful, roomy, and filled with incense and sunlight!"
d3353660-d962-4466-977b-8257b50d3b10: "Thank you for the story. We may speak more later. Farewell."
edcd64bb-6aad-4001-8c18-d8819dd2f181: "What did you do to anger Erastil?"
9f109dc2-df78-411a-a5c4-d2a6f53f7c94: "To each their own. I wanted to ask you about something else."
039844af-979a-44df-9fe7-c373f6ad08c0: "Still, you saved the village from another danger, did you not?"
33586a13-0fbb-4b78-a54d-6c1e00044ddd: "What can you tell me about your homeland, Galt?"
2463767e-7ce0-49e1-a2cb-5b1276ff9ebf: "Wait a moment — cities have their strengths as well, don't they? Civilization fosters science, trade and invention, and in that it often improves life for all of us."
6c62a5c0-c65a-45f3-ae87-56afe38cfb2e: "You should have stayed your hand and discovered the truth before you acted."
1a7c6880-b1ab-4f3f-bac3-8b2dfc5c1c97: "I don't share your opinion. My future capital will be no village, whether you like it or not. One day it will rival Absalom itself!"
735006f2-a22f-473e-8721-dffccdac0127: "Well, you do have a point. Indeed, cities can be places of evil and wrongdoing."
a8772388-6147-4002-81cd-48eb971c5e66: "Do you understand the true meaning of your visions now?"
c104855f-8c36-42b0-aae8-57714e146dc7: "I've always had respect for Erastil and his priests."
b5b50eab-f0c3-47a5-a312-5cbc625be1e4: "I've long felt that Erastil was a worthless god, and now you've made me even more certain."
126a9a5c-3ffa-431f-aba2-cfabc6bcfdbb: "What does Erastil demand of his faithful?"
f9b55dda-8384-41bd-8497-db2348f78c90: "I've heard of the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g} from a local nymph. She believes a mad druid, who served the Stag Lord, once performed his rituals there. It seems that's where the magic mist comes from."
688dc80d-7d18-45fe-a1f5-97b313b395a5: "I went to this temple of yours, but found nothing special. Just ruins, dust and desolation."
dfebbb5d-15f9-4f68-902a-1d4bb1e426c1: "Tell me about the visions that led you to the Temple of the Elk."
094e29be-36a0-42c2-8cdd-1e123bc6e856: "It seems that Tristian has already told you about our adventures in the Temple. Do you have any advice on what we might do next?"
9c9dbfa0-2329-4315-bfcc-e9d6ce255fd8: "Why do you need to find this temple?"
32ceb4f3-79cc-404d-a709-e73f52a07ead: "What role might you play in my government?"
0b05ff53-b3b8-4cf5-9291-ec212ed22acc: "How are you enjoying your duties as the High Priest?"
f35ff61e-f275-4a43-ab03-c436db3ef269: "It's hard to tell you this, but that vision that led you to the Stolen Lands..."
14ee60e4-47ff-4ce5-a8e3-d05da9493168: "I need the help of a cleric."
a9a38e2e-e3f6-4171-85ba-e9f128cce646: "I found the Temple of the Elk and killed the beasts there."
837f2e93-23c2-4b45-a50d-5d76707c3abd: "Of course." {n}Jhod nods.{/n} "The story is a long one. Few would care to listen to it all at once."
93f19adb-f375-4ee9-93b9-668feeab88c4: "Tell that to the peasant robbed of all he owns, spending his nights in the gutter, hoping to live to see the sunrise. You won't see such things in a village." {n}Jhod mournfully shakes his head.{/n}
09b3d928-cb3c-4c67-8eb2-520ba33540de: "My story… Why not. You deserve to know it. I am a priest of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, and {g|Galt}Galt{/g} is my homeland. You can imagine what it's like — following the teachings of the Stag God in a realm torn by discord and strife."
8519867d-897c-48c7-a01d-a0dc4ea04cff: "Indeed. I remind myself of this every day when I awaken, and again when I go to sleep. I, who'd admonished my fellow citizens for the chaos they spread and the transgressions they made. But then I myself…" {n}Jhod frowns.{/n}
2e5fd0ab-ed6e-4df3-bb1b-bcdf46b19434: "That's still no excuse for my actions. I was a fool. I made a grave mistake, and what's worse — in the eyes of my flock, I cast doubt over {g|Erastil}Erastil's{/g} greatness. A priest who can barely hear the voice of his god is a disgrace to his Lord and himself — and corrupts the very people he would save."
545e6efe-bd6a-4d2a-bbc7-53c3aaab2e8a: "And so I left, and traveled far, seeking myself, and a way back into the favor of the {g|Erastil}Stag God{/g}. And thus I found you, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, and thus Erastil has returned to me." {n}Jhod sighs.{/n} "For that blessing, I shall be forever grateful to you."
fb6a4e73-e87f-4395-92f7-00bf4d9b07b2: "Whatever the case, I knew that {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} was no longer pleased with me. It was… terrifying." {n}Jhod's voice wavers. Even now, one can glimpse inside him the remnants of the horror he lived through.{/n}
48a297a7-27e1-482b-95d0-80b60564295b: "For me, it is a place inhabited by the frightened and the desperate, always suspicious, watchful for trickery. All too often they are deaf to the voice of reason. They cannot grasp that chaos and lawlessness lead only to yet more chaos and lawlessness. All my life I've tried to break through to these poor people, but alas, I don't seem to have made much progress." {n}Jhod is visibly upset, and grows silent for a while.{/n}
11379c3f-8d7f-4b31-be31-f89fae8f90f4: "Led by providence, I left to gather my flock, and we surrounded the tavern. The retribution..." {n}Jhod clearly has no wish to go into detail.{/n} "The retribution was swift. However, I was tragically mistaken. The young man was no werewolf. He was a bandit, sent to spy on the village by one of the local gangs. We only found out after, when we went through his things."
b02d38e5-53ea-4670-8860-eeb3552fd563: {n}Jhod lets out a deep sigh.{/n} "Well, if you truly wish to know… I'll have to start from a long time back. Werewolves preyed upon the lands around my village. They murdered people for fun or sport, and left the corpses to rot on the roads. One night, they broke into a young woman's house and dragged her into the streets."
59caaacd-423f-4be5-8aa8-2098b36f90a5: "For some, it is a land of freedom, where power belongs to the people, not to lords or kings. For others, it's a land of never-ending revolution. — A realm surrendered to anarchy. It depends on who you ask."
b9101f15-95b1-45a3-aa3d-3f2040faccb1: "For me, I found {g|Galt}Galt{/g} a…" {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "A violent place. Crowds eager to lynch a stranger for their accent or appearance. Where a single word, uttered at the wrong time or place, can spark the people to riot and cities to burn."
66eacb4b-b1fd-488e-ae15-5d63a1862920: {n}A dark-haired man stands stooping before you. He's in his forties, but at first glance he could easily be mistaken for much older. His weary face is crisscrossed with innumerable wrinkles. His weak eyes squint at the light, and moves his lips silently as if talking to an invisible companion. He raises his head as you approach.{/n}
d68dd373-7273-4357-9fc4-0cceded24713: "Of course!" {n}Jhod's smile widens.{/n} "It would be my pleasure. {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} is one of the eldest gods of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}. His faith emerged when the first people appeared upon the land. Erastil helped our ancestors cultivate the land and hunt. Even now, his blessing lies with those who uphold the old traditions and keep to simpler ways, far from civilization and the noise of the city."
a629d301-aa36-4d9d-b36b-7d44d3b8a128: "Rebellion and suspicion are the pillars of {g|Galt}Galt{/g}. Led by {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, I tried to guide my flock to embrace tranquility and balance, and guard them from hasty judgment. — Until I fell from grace myself. Foolish, foolish old Jhod!"
b4866941-20e8-435f-9a0c-7a6d514d68f6: "One evening, a traveler came to our tavern — tattered and dirty from days on the road — like so many others roaming {g|Galt}Galt{/g}. He sat quietly in the corner of the tavern, drinking cheap ale, and in an instant I knew he was a werewolf. I felt it in my soul — it was like {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} himself had whispered it into my ear." {n}Jhod smiles, but his eyes are dead as stones.{/n}
54491498-86f2-4570-98a0-3b92323f903b: {n}Jhod looks saddened.{/n} "As you wish. Still, lend your ear to this old man's words — don't brush away the wisdom of ages past. I came here to spread the kindness of simple village life, which is often lost and forgotten in the noise of an indifferent city."
8704e1eb-ca02-4295-910c-1581095b044c: "I am glad to hear you agree. These days many are deaf to the wisdom of generations."
5f0dc9b4-8bf5-4666-9b82-9ab2f573e5e6: {n}A smile lights up Jhod's face.{/n} "I see it more clearly every day. — {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} himself led me to meet you. Your keen spirit will serve you well."
50dc0fc8-f76c-48a6-8d5b-6a89060029a0: {n}Jhod sorrowfully shakes his head.{/n} "Alas, I must truly be an inept servant, for I have failed once more to convey the wisdom of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}. I only hope that someday in the future you will allow me the chance to change your mind."
6e823bd9-18a3-4d68-a1db-1550a842c085: "I trust in their truth. These visions... they were the voice of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} himself, quiet, but clear." {n}Jhod speaks with reverent awe.{/n} "Before all this happened, I believed Erastil had turned his back to me. But now I see clearly — he has shown me divine mercy, for he has led me to you — and invited me to aid in a fellow priest's deliverance. Lady {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} and Erastil walk the paths of the gods, hand in hand, and so must their servants as well."
262606ea-a3d2-4211-8986-1ee08f788a13: "Tristian is, undoubtedly, still very young, and youth is a time of naiveté and confusion." {n}An amiable grin appears on Jhod's face.{/n} "But I see kindness and strength of spirit in him, traits indispensable to a priest. I sense that all that's transpired thus far is only the beginning, and the future promises great things for Tristian — and for you. This is why {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} led me to the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}. Day and night I pray for you, and for my young friend. May the Stag God lead you down the true path!"
446a6aae-817a-4011-9390-9a627089783e: "As you say," {n}replies Jhod, with just a hint of grumpiness in his voice.{/n}
e61428b3-6ef9-441e-b20c-211697f2956b: "My misdeeds cast a shadow over my life and service. In search of redemption, and a balm for my soul, I took to the road. I had come nearly to despair when {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} sent me a vision of the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}. I knew that very moment that the Stag God had shown me the way to redemption."
1c3337d0-1943-48bc-a453-86fd82c93ce1: "The word 'demand' does not befit the {g|Erastil}Stag God{/g}. Honesty and friendship, loving families, merry weddings and newborn children in their mothers' arms — they bring a smile to Erastil's face. He loves his people, and rewards them with fortunate hunts and plentiful harvests. But he has no temper for sloth and vanity. He never bestows gifts upon his faithful without first measuring their worthiness. We ourselves must win our daily bread. But the Stag God comes to our aid in times of need and strife."
57646987-76ae-4c50-bd8c-821f50c0e4ec: "What exactly would you like to know?"
705d76a6-ff4a-48ad-8ad9-cf12ebdbd7c9: "Greetings, good traveler! My name is Jhod Kavken, I am a cleric of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, from {g|Galt}Galt{/g}. I was led to these wild lands by the Stag God in a vision. He led me through the magic mist, and showed me the location of an ancient forsaken site, the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}. Give me a moment of your time. I would speak with you of this."
437b97c5-1f63-4895-9345-256920d23a7a: {n}Jhod looks at you with disbelief.{/n} "It's... Odd. Perhaps {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} requires my personal presence at the Temple... But I'm sure he pointed to this place for a reason. Please, check it once more, at least for my peace of mind!"
a197e409-9865-48dc-b08f-4f07eeca315f: {n}Jhod groans with indignation.{/n} "To defile the ancient shrine of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}! And with such unnatural magic! How could it be that this druid wasn't completely exhausted?"
5c959832-f7f7-4c6b-b118-3e29efd901ed: "Imagine how my mind raced, when here, in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}, I heard the voice of the Stag God once again! He gave me another chance at service, to atone for my guilt. Now I have regained hope, and that very hope is my most precious possession."
4aa61e58-446d-4ee6-b6c6-1909668b0ca3: "As you wish," {n}Jhod says with a hint of grumpiness.{/n}
8d208905-8781-460a-9018-05d32b17f9e1: "What is there to understand? The gods do not send us visions for no reason." {n}Jhod folds his arms over his chest.{/n} "We must go to the Temple. Then, I believe, we shall discover the true meaning and wisdom of {g|Erastil}Erastil's{/g} will."
36b6d771-b86f-4985-8936-4fcc54f83935: "I'm always glad to speak of the Stag God's teachings."
833c1663-341f-49a6-bf0c-39aec03dfc2b: "Oh yes!" {n}Jhod shakes his head in contemplation.{/n} "This has given me much to think about. It is another confirmation that our meeting was ordained by {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}. Your victory over the bandit leader has only strengthened me in this belief. People like the Stag Lord disgust my god. I must continue helping you as well as I can, for as long as I am able. Perhaps that's why I was granted these visions."
f59e1fe6-33e8-4a94-8603-8899e9f3efdf: "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, if there's one thing I know, it is matters of faith — whether it is my own god or some other deity. If you appoint me as High Priest, I'd be able to do much good. On the other hand, politics, or questions of trade — I know little of such things."
2b0b3f99-852a-4477-8f30-d14dad3ba652: "Oh." {n}Jhod opens his mouth to say something but then changes his mind and just waves his hand.{/n} "Everything is all well, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. I just keep forgetting what a mess it is in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}, and how troubled are the minds of its people. Sometimes I must listen to such nonsense from my visitors... {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} forgive them!"
310a14f6-2704-427a-8172-6df93be691ac: {n}Jhod shakes his head in a slow motion.{/n} "No, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. I cannot picture myself as your advisor. We disagreed too often while I was still in your service."
0007e47c-ec14-411e-a96e-7b4943a0ac59: "...was merely the trick of some wicked fey from the {g|First World}First World{/g}." {n}For a second, Jhod knits his brows, but then sighs and shakes his head.{/n} "Tristian told me already, Your Grace. Looking like a beaten puppy all the while. I cannot say that this late confession brought me much solace…"
91aa4cd4-02c1-4535-bd55-65db1618c787: {n}Jhod looks straight at you.{/n} "Damn it all! So what if {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} didn't lead me here? I didn't do all this traveling for naught. And yes, I forgave Tristian, have no doubt of that. Last thing I need is to bear a grudge against that dunce."
2acf3475-6325-4945-bfdd-4177ced57099: "Find the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}!" {n}Jhod frowns.{/n} "I've pieced together its location from what I can remember of my visions. I have a rough idea of where to look for the sanctuary — somewhere in the North Narlmarches. However, I don't possess the strength to walk this path myself. Do not reject my plea, good traveler, and I'll repay you as best I can. In these dark times, people rarely help each other without compensation, may {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} forgive us all. But I am sure my healing abilities will be useful to you."
72fa4e10-cb4e-43f7-8f76-b34fd6819170: "As far as I know, your next target looks to be the Stag Lord himself. With the Temple of the Elk cleansed of evil, the fog surrounding us should disperse to reveal the path to the brute's lair. Of course, magic so powerful is unlikely to disappear all at once. Bide your time — follow up on other concerns while you wait. I will gladly aid you on your noble quest. {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} himself foresaw our meeting." {n}Jhod bows piously.{/n}
a44b28d7-5aad-4876-9a18-fdbb2f5140ce: "{g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} be praised, you've finally returned, my good friend! Tristian told me how you helped him at the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}. Thank you for heeding my request. My heart is calm and filled with confidence that I've followed the will of my god. I would like to reward your bravery. I possess no treasure, but please, take this as a token of appreciation..."
4c387f25-bf56-465f-8185-df667eada356: "I wish only thank you! You helped Tristian at the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}. {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} teaches us to esteem those who help each other, though today such unity is sadly rare — especially here in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}." {n}Jhod shakes his head in disappointment.{/n} "I would like to reward your bravery. I possess no treasure, so let my knowledge as healer serve your good cause."
1175db10-2327-490f-955b-46494cecab6f: The baron{mf||ess} took the opportunity to learn the reason for such caution.
645338dd-564c-4de0-8506-1c96ac39d0f5: [Close] We agreed to let the guards escort us safely to Varnhold.
89dddb90-bf60-4b0f-8168-c16356cbba0f: [Close] We turned back and returned to the baron{mf||ess}'s lands.
858a032f-bee2-4209-a317-9592c71ef727: Our travels took us east. Leaving the mountain ridge behind, we came to {g|Dunsward}Dunsward{/g} — a wild land, far less populous and civilized than the barony that had grown so dear to us! It wasn't all bad, though — the roads in Dunsward were well guarded, and we soon met a well-armed patrol.
a256810f-f038-4351-a53e-8807b38eded4:
As we approached, one of them raised a hand. "Stop! Turn back! The road to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} is closed."
The second guard was in less of a hurry to drive us off. He squinted and studied our leader. "Wait... you're {name}! My respects, Your Grace! If you're here, traveling so far from your land, I have to assume you've come to visit our ruler, Maegar Varn."
abaaa9ac-b7aa-4219-b172-45cfd0809f28: "You may continue on, of course, but please allow us to accompany you to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} — for your own safety. Are you ready to continue?"
7209521c-4ff7-49df-bb16-486d4de76f71: Just as we turned toward {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}, we ran into a patrol — again. We exchanged the usual pleasantries, and they offered to accompany us to the city.
2bb4c922-7bee-46d8-9491-e6ae2e4eb5f4: "Bandits, Your Grace." One of the guards muttered. "All sorts of rabble make their way here from {g|Restov}Restov{/g} — we don't get a moment's peace. The river and roads are crawling with their lot... Until we clear them out, we thought it best to patrol the tracts and the river. But we're not here to hold you up with that — we'll be happy to accompany you on your journey to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}!"
b858d76a-dd3a-45ba-baf0-7f9be3462461: "My loyalty and duty to the good of my people is stronger than you, Eldest. You cannot take it away."
6ca797f4-84ad-4699-a86e-ba47455d07c0: "My heart has always belonged to the people, and it always will. Nothing can ever change that."
aefa7230-1522-4f38-8388-e2a32220bd4c: "There are no gods or curses that could take away my thirst for adventure."
d33fcf01-34cb-42b7-87bf-923597dbc530: "You are a creature of chaos, Eldest. You know nothing of order, and it's not within your power to destroy it."
a97c4714-4bb3-4dd7-be96-fa2bc9a987b8: "I never allowed external factors to influence my soul. And I'm not going to start."
a783bfdc-a016-4101-adfd-77f110f2408d: "Very amusing, Eldest. I'll gladly laugh at your joke. And then I'll forget all about it."
54f53569-f13c-47e8-b03c-294e2b4486ce: "I make the world live by my rules. — And there's no rule about letting you take part of my soul."
93e5ba48-6a6f-4f43-996a-64ca597d0a23: "There is no greater power than the power you have over your own soul. I have it, Eldest, and you do not."
08039520-320f-41ed-baf1-9e0fbb8a9860: "I can play with others' souls like I'm playing with dolls. Your tricks won't work on me."
2b418616-1c9b-48a7-9731-f7b7e2eaa489: "Your words are nothing more than wind. Let them fly away."
8f1b24b6-e9a6-43eb-967c-7090e8b31993: "You love to wreak havoc and play evil pranks, while I care about nothing more than the good of my people. And I know my way is right."
9a714f31-ee6a-40c6-8930-d03f6536a7de: "I get my power from the endless loyalty of my subjects. Can you make a similar boast?"
0de8323c-21fb-410f-a75d-114461d499f6: "My kingdom is strong with its warriors, so it can always protect itself. — And that means I can too — even if I were facing a deity."
2d36ec4c-5035-4727-adb4-e79d9673dbaf: "And why do you imagine I told you the truth back then, Eldest of mischief and lies? Perhaps you are the one who was fooled? One who can be fooled so easily has no power over words!"
e3f2d80a-9334-4e5b-b719-ce20603e5090: "I might not be a deity, but my kingdom is rich and prosperous. And so is my power."
1b6cfcac-274a-4bfd-a344-81cfb4a68cf8: "You talk about yourself so much. But do you have friends or allies, Eldest? I always have someone to lean on, which is why I and my land will survive any hardship."
c7d8dee2-7d47-4d92-8e35-1e9b586362c3: "Don't threaten me, self-proclaimed deity. My kingdom is a true stronghold of faith, and from it I gather my strength."
2866f6d8-6c6e-4400-a25f-08f7971e465c: "With all my knowledge of magic, with all the arcane power my country possesses, I have no fear of you, Eldest."
8ce8b64b-a1c2-45b8-a4ea-031e17d77e71: "I've put much effort into making my state strong against any chaos or threats. My kingdom is a secure stronghold. Even if I were facing a deity."
5fbb63a9-dbd2-4e78-9ebb-ed72d737fba9: "Knowledge and inspiration are as powerful as magic. My kingdom's subjects know this full well. We have what it takes to protect ourselves from your evil."
c98b3dbd-6531-467b-8ce1-0efb09005092: "What are you jokes and chaos worth? Being a ruler, I strove to know everything about everyone. That is true power!"
97b19bd8-bb51-421b-b524-6ddb21e18469: "I know enough about divinity to say that you are no deity. Don't try to scare me. You don't possess that sort of power."
6ab6f125-0c6d-45e4-b7d5-5e51e12b7cb3: "I know enough about magic and sorcery, so don't try to threaten me. All you are is the most treacherous monster I've ever had the chance to defeat."
69e1a00f-95bd-4622-accc-c32585d7b9f0: "I won't allow such evil to happen. And being what I am, I will retrieve what's been taken from me."
bd83eeaa-0574-455a-931d-dd77994e90c3: "You took not my pillar of strength, but just useful tools. But it's in my power to take them back."
b63757a2-41d3-40a9-9e24-af992068ca0a: "I am beyond your power, Eldest. Yours or anyone else's. But being what I am, I will change what you have done."
84efe103-66ce-4dc6-a883-e598efb21759: "You don't have the right to take anything from me, Eldest. But I have the right to retrieve what's been taken unfairly."
6930736c-f8ff-43b4-86e5-df1596917319: "What, is there a rule by which those like you dictate another's will? Even if there is such a rule, I'll break it. I will take back what is mine."
3614dd4e-586f-4023-99f2-ed23ad016014:
{n}The {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g} starts talking. You hear his voice not with your ears — it comes to you through the rays of light, burning and compelling.{/n}
"The time for masks is over. You risk challenging an {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g}, and I accept the challenge. You will fight not a mere embodiment, but my true essence.
This is my essence: I don't need magic, or servile monsters to destroy you. Words are enough. Yes, words.
I once told you: words spoken in the right time and place possess the power of a storm. You light-heartedly answered that you know what your power and essence are."
c1d6cd0a-7a2a-40b6-9ec4-3dbad6639d03: "… In duty and the desire to make the world a better place."
1b504b85-e606-435e-8177-6d074517553e: "… In the desire to help people whose grief touches you."
e06e8b5e-d3bd-4fdc-84ff-7f0782808181: "… In the dedication to bring order to chaos."
c877d4e8-c30b-4ef8-988c-2fdd46aa6bf2: "… In neutrality and following your way."
dbde6c8c-f381-4c1c-93d6-abe652ffa509: "… In jokes and lightness with which they are said."
0e23fe89-714d-4aeb-a61e-139fac4c4103: "… In the desire to make the world live by your rules."
15b62c89-f5c6-41d3-b6ae-23b5190e4b66: "… In the desire to play with others' lives and fates.
109b37da-03e6-4f90-8767-62fd29fb9fd2: {n}A wave of pain comes crashing down upon you, but recedes quickly. You cannot tell whether you were protected by your words, or something more — the essence of your soul. But the attack of the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} was parried.{/n}
e55b9ad3-0e6c-49d2-88bf-76d18830a776: {n}The {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g} laughs. This laughter — soft, insinuating, almost amiable — is scarier than any nightmare. It resonates with the hot metal splinter — the curse within your soul — making it stronger, slashing at your essence, and taking away something essential that nourishes your power.{/n}
2eea5c3b-b02b-4295-abf2-372e84eeef13:
"Let us continue." {n}The Eldest's voice carefully conceals his thoughts.{/n} "We both wear a crown. But what do you own? A meager patch of land, a few thousand souls? My dominion is chaos and magic, madness and deceit. Your power is nothing compared to mine. And that is why you are helpless before me. You will take my every blow as a divine punishment, as something... imminent."
{n}Yet again you have little time to answer, and this answer is the only thing that can protect you from the {g|Eldest}Eldest's{/g} next blow...{/n}
123f853a-c015-43c1-aa1a-1d93d4361605: {n}You feel strange, as if wrapped in an invisible veil that protects you from the {g|Eldest}Eldest's{/g} wrath. And its source is yet your curse. It bound you to your kingdom... but through this bond can pass not only pain and death, but power as well.{/n}
597b5f84-bd81-4ef5-985f-29ec67f99df7:
{n}The mask of the Lantern King alters for a moment. It shows reproach instead of wrath.{/n} "You would insult me with this? This?"
{n}The curse burns inside you, nearly unbearable.{/n}
1e4d3ad6-2220-462f-847e-cebf3c9562f1: {n}The rays pass through you, pierce you, ruthlessly baring your most intimate secrets, fears, and desires. Something inside of you resonates with the light of the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} — your curse. It is like the splinter of an arrow that remains in the wound, a slow weapon crawling toward your heart. As soon as the rays touch it, it begins to heat up, and then burns with intolerable pain.{/n}
663e62fb-35fb-4bc3-ba51-d20785069fed: "I'm curious what you think of me, cursed {mf|king|queen}. Do you see me as a villain, or a simple joker? In truth — well, you will never be able to conceive of the truth. Being an {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} means being one of the many strings that hold the world in place. Being an Eldest means being such a vast and self-sufficient value that one's equals become strangers and one's inferiors are... entirely insignificant. I am an Eldest. Laughter, guile, transformation — that's what I am. And being what I am, I will let you feel a modicum of my loneliness. I will take away your pillar of strength."
fd47a82c-8775-4570-9858-60d2d707e0ef: "You single-handedly survived a battle with a deity. I'm amazed. Though the battle isn't over yet..."
5db9d3d1-74ee-441b-b4c6-7d8c7603c571:
"I remember your answer. The world remembers it too — your answer, your heart, your essence. And now, cursed {mf|king|queen}, I'm taking this part of your soul — as I took away Nyrissa's ability to love. What you called your essence, is yours no more!"
{n}The words of the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} fly towards you like an arrow, ready to give new force to the curse that already torments you. You have but an instant to reply...{/n}
149f91c3-be08-4d30-b0ea-630a2e30e017: {n}The blinding light flashes away, frightened like a living creature. The blistering metal of the curse cools. It still hurts, but the pain is no longer unbearable. You stand before the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g}, as before a blazing living star. And he looks at you as if he's seeing you for the first time.{/n}
1bb43728-bf7d-4185-b8ed-3db99d9ae94d: {n}For a while the {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g} remains silent. You feel in this silence not angry bewilderment, but endless, boundless astonishment.{/n} "Good. You can play with words. Let us see if you can withstand the heat of my fire!"
f2f0c5ad-860f-4182-b07c-5f8b8f1561dc: {n}There is great power in knowledge. It wraps you in an invisible veil, and protects from the {g|Eldest}Eldest's{/g} blow. You feel his fury, but you know that it is not divine wrath, but the emotion of an ancient being — mighty, but not almighty.{/n}
3b90db83-7d44-4fd8-a19b-4069998d5e83: {n}Having lost all support, you face the deity alone. Silence hangs heavy over the ruined throne room.{/n}
776dc9ed-2069-43bd-b059-f298f2e066b7: "Why did I ever decide to come to this wilderness? I could be sitting at a nice desk, writing a new novel... Or a reference book..."
9e0fb2f1-1d08-4918-bf9d-f74e58db96be: "And local mosquitoes seem to have no idea they're drinking the blood of a famous scientist, writer, and traveler!"
ef13afd8-1d34-4f68-ae09-521650cc8751: "I don't know what I'm doing here... Let's get this over with quickly."
6d38813c-18ed-44af-84b2-7817a944df7b: {n}Ekun nods at you. His face is softer and at the same time, more resolute than usual.{/n}
ec327eed-3e87-4d56-b29c-a63c06864f28: {n}Octavia looks at Ekun, biting her lip.{/n} "My condolences..."
5de4787f-7f96-42a2-a20f-1dc33f9c126c: {n}Jubilost opens his mouth for a moment, raises his finger... But then only sighs, nodding silently to Ekun.{/n}
725e7d69-e82c-4ef6-8bee-852f2b8ec65e: {n}Tristian smiles sadly at Ekun, then speaks, his voice warm.{/n} "The darkest hours are before the sunrise. Hold on. Trust me, you will feel better."
81d30a56-1cfe-434d-af6d-8ba59cf1684b: {n}Jaethal looks around silently, her eyes avoiding Ekun.{/n}
43d1d9ce-28e7-4231-92b1-fb949ca8005f: {n}Shaking his head and sighing heavily, Ekun looks away from you.{/n}
9bbbfce7-4928-4636-9e6d-d65a9551296d: {n}The ranger's dark eyes are directed your way.{/n}"You've come. Thank you."
04e6f0a2-80be-4588-bfeb-429a99eb6a34: {n}Linzi hides her eyes, enough to conceal tears — but her voice breaks.{/n} "W-we are with you, friend."
e2c7484c-9d7a-4d42-955c-d61871f27c91: [Attack] "It was a mistake to let you live."
6908ac0b-1d6c-4c0f-9087-89be6c3ee98e: "I have to go. Have a good life here in Trobold!"
4f9a9b2c-c48e-4b17-8c86-2f81bce47444: {n}Jazon gives you an awkward bow.{/n} "Hello, human {mf|king|queen}. Jazon happy that rulers have an agreement. No more war, no one eats no one else."
f72698ba-8fcc-4d49-9f1b-8815c29bcd23: "{g|Trobold}Trobold{/g} is a mess, trash everywhere. Trolls clean up, brush up, try to be like borba- humans! Me mean try to be like humans. We have real town soon, just like yours!"
a65264ab-ab5e-492d-b948-18c742f5425b: "No! King Hargulka forbid hard! One troll brought a killed human recently, and king tore off troll's arms and legs — troll still trying grow them back! King keeps his promises!"
7e59f99e-bb0b-4175-a0c8-fc53df4e7a75: "Without Tartuk, kobolds scattered. No immortality now, eating borba forbidden... many trolls disliked and left too. If some trolls attack you, don't be mad us, they not ours! Not much of us left, but we have plenty borba around — deers, boars, sometimes lizardfolk... But never humans, no one eat humans! That true! Jazon tell no lies!"
b9c2ba05-e3cf-4f5d-ba27-4ac26591396b: "Me Jazon. Had another name before. Like other trolls, went hunting, ate borba. Then Tartuk came, talked to trolls. Explained how humans live. Jazon not as smart as Tartuk, but Jazon saw... humans live better. Jazon stop eating humans, started wash his fur and brush his fangs."
f1f184f0-1fdd-4291-acef-07146f14156e: "Other trolls said Jazon was crazy. Now other trolls wash their fur too! Good when there no war. Jazon happy."
bcbbf379-c152-41d8-8d59-cfbf487da4ec: "Other trolls said Jazon was crazy. Now they dead or fled. Jazon stayed, lives with kobolds. Good when there is peace."
dacde47d-44bc-46e1-911a-67251dd48492: "Without Hargulka, trolls scattered. Became wild, like before — they run around forest, kill borba. Jazon lives with kobolds. They are tiny, food is plenty. Tartuk tells interesting things. Jazon listens. Helps with heavy stuff. Everyone happy."
30e32a68-19b5-4b32-ac05-876bdadd261a: "{g|Trobold}Trobold{/g} is a mess, trash everywhere. Kobolds clean up, brush up, try to be like borba- humans! Me mean try to be like humans. Jazon helps them. Lifts heavy stones. We work hard. We have real town soon, just like yours!"
c247044e-2855-4628-85ec-588302d41caa: "Also, Tartuk says humans are smart because they look at magic papers. Jazon found one! Soon Jazon become smart, just like humans!" {n}The troll proudly shows off a half-torn book of children's fairy tales, thickly smeared with blood.{/n}
ddc66b74-55e9-4930-99b4-1c833b73407e: "No. Jazon decided — Jazon does as decided. Deer and boar are borba. Dwarf and human are not borba. Tartuk says, 'Good for you, Jazon, you get it right!'"
fe18d562-9135-4a17-ba10-daaaf6605fe0: "I wonder why in the vast majority of cases, brains and brawn are reciprocally proportional?"
244fe8aa-8146-4ee4-9fda-e435c5586ef3: "Pro-pro-ti-what? Oh, gnome, I feel it in my gut you just said something bad about me! Gods forbid one day I understand what you're babbling!"
214f3236-a87a-4029-806f-3d26c8ad2136: "Pitax's attack is a boon for the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}. It's the perfect opportunity to expand your territories and not be taken as an aggressor."
c54988b4-addf-44b4-a8fc-a2e48f5522ae: "How could you say that?! No government's ambitions could justify the terrors of war! Can't you see that?!"
555f59bd-40d1-42bc-a13b-f0ff2b6d8341: "Like spiders in a jar. All this fuss only lowers the veil over your mind... Like smoking, or wine."
a50d920d-2074-48c7-9dd3-367e551affbe: "Are you prepared to risk our own kingdom, just for a chance to conquer another one? There's a reason they say there's a reckless gambler in every calculating strategist!"
472a703e-2c40-4025-bafa-321e8acf5694: "Are you prepared to risk our own kingdom, just for a chance to conquer another one? There's a reason they say there's a reckless gambler in every calculating strategist!"
d8af21c8-9380-45a6-8e54-c6a9d117ce9f: "I need to go through that portal, but I have no desire to kill you. Perhaps we can come to an arrangement?"
47ce27fe-7e41-4abf-8bad-758ed596e7e4: [Attack] "You shouldn't have stood in my way."
c9d9d155-c6d4-4a3f-862b-65cbe5840cda: {n}The darkness visible behind the slits in the creature's helm is pitch black, but you still feel its gaze upon you — unwavering, probing.{/n} "Ah, the little {mf|king|queen} from the sand castle. How fares your kingdom? Is there anything left for me?"
1470056b-e283-47aa-b27f-8ece1c4a823e: "You may call me the Horned Hunter. At any ruler's court, there is a place for the likes of me. You do love hunting, don't you? But I suppose here, in the mortal world, you hunt elk or bears as game. I hound more... impressive beasts for my lady. Ancient monsters, aliens from the outer realms... and self-proclaimed {mf|king|queen}s who would think to challenge us."
d0a960b9-87ed-49ba-91dd-fda9c07231ac: "What, you came all this way without knowing whom you would be facing? The self-confidence of mortals always amazes me. It's as though you think you, not I, shall revive in the {g|First World}First World{/g} should trouble arise. I serve my lady Nyrissa, the Lady of the Thousandbreaths. And you are on the threshold of her demesne."
cef42aae-cae9-4a61-a893-2a0df63c87c6: {n}The creature tilts its head and breathes loudly, as though sniffing.{/n} "Curious. You carry with you what my lady's servants have spent ages searching the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} for. I'll have to report that. Or better yet, I could simply wait a bit and take Briar from your corpse. Do you have a preference?"
f56bb9d6-ae29-48ea-ba81-40d7ac1dcded: "An arrangement? With me?" {n}The Horned Hunter shrugs.{/n} "I wasn't going to fight you anyway. After all, I'm not the guard of this portal. As for the actual guard... well, I don't think it will be interested in making any 'arrangements' with you!"
200a88b1-b66d-4045-8bbe-2e97e25bc282: "What makes you think it is I who stands in your way? I'm the Horned Hunter, not the Guard. If you're so interested in a fight, try defeating that..."
c6fbff39-cb33-44a7-af3f-42702978a3d0: {n}...You hear it before you see it. A hoarse, wavering rumble can be heard from all around you. The sound itself moves as though it's alive, washing over you and rolling back, boring into your ears and echoing into the depths of your consciousness. And then...{/n}
ae631fa2-2582-4c17-bf3b-7d69248c7bf4: "I know it is no toy for mortals. And I know my mistress will be happy should I bring Briar to her. My mistress is difficult to please, so I value every chance."
b5da7b31-d0e3-48f0-a5d9-097678d77949: "Ah, the traitor is here, too. You were a poor servant to {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, and equally disappointing to my mistress. I'll enjoy watching you let down your third {mf|master|mistress}."
d2b31e70-558c-45fc-a224-a54078c01e15: "It is not so difficult. Nyrissa always seems to enjoy the death and destruction she causes."
25e61b34-ca41-4a72-8466-a81bc8817ad2: "What are the rules of your game?"
cbe113e8-d3a1-4995-8611-7fc435ca7f4b: [Attack] "You filthy hacks! I'll teach you a lesson!"
f3f26ddf-5810-4ddd-a868-46977d9ab7c3: "Don't. And you'd better return that scroll to whomever you 'found' it from."
f8b10af9-0860-412d-bea9-0fe2107275b2: "Let's not. Being thrown out of the tournament is the last thing we need."
710c894c-25ce-4092-a4e5-84f756474041: "Do it! I hope the scroll has something like fireball or poisonous cloud!"
1ae9abda-741d-4539-9b6d-bf3c031f1658: "Come, come, don't be shy! Witness secrets not meant for mortal eyes! An aetherial battle within a vortex of the supernatural! Bets here — place your bets!"
e4377055-5300-4db0-bee9-ec0b2c015010: "Oooh, something special indeed! I'd wager you've never seen the like! Before your eyes unfolds an epic battle between the world's greatest spellcasters — Mysteriado, the Devil Tamer of {g|Cheliax}Cheliax{/g}, versus Zynmyrgya, Magistress of the {g|Irrisen}Irrisen{/g} Witches! Who will win? Who would you bet on?"
fb204d6c-9ddd-4014-9fb3-3e295b6d3fc0: "You think this just a game? I wouldn't be so sure! The rules for you are simple enough, though — choose one of the spellcasters, and place your bet. If you guess the winner, you double your wager! If you're wrong, the gold is mine."
04d70984-dfb9-4ff3-8204-f181733e4dd4: "Bets are set — no more bets! Let the battle commence!"
9e87987f-e9c3-4d85-903e-43feaae6df98: "Oh, it's you! My apologies, but I'm afraid you're just too lucky. My pockets are empty — you won all I had! So I can't accept any more bets — though you can still enjoy the battle!"
ff4dfd23-3b6c-4311-9037-d67987f4bd79: {n}Octavia moves very close to you and, barely suppressing her laughter, whispers,{/n} "Some charlatans, huh? Can I teach them a lesson? I... 'found' an interesting scroll here. Shall we see how they like it?"
5486f320-8e2b-41b6-a172-068a3bb9cb8a: "Ugh, you're so bloodthirsty! No, it's nothing like that — just a harmless joke... Look!"
cd0df340-eea0-459e-ab2b-d861c991d118: "You're such a bore! It's a holiday, have some fun for once in your life! Come on, smile!"
3dd8cc36-aa7a-4ba8-8865-aa630dffcb1a: "The land must bear fruit and feed the people, not amuse a crowd of wealthy crooks. Allow the peasants to plow these new fields."
202cee49-1001-42f9-991c-df2b3258acd9: "I don't want any problems with the merchants. Let the peasants find themselves another field to plow."
c0759ab7-73f3-4880-99dd-7434aa59333b: "Take the oak grove. It is my gift for you."
bc45fdb1-5e57-4981-93ef-e691c6f42050: "There are more and more workers in the kingdom, and our farmers require plots of fruitful soil. The ordinary people regard you as their defender against the iniquity of the merchants. And they have come to you with a request."
658a60ce-d650-4486-be85-e74130261187: "{name}, your subjects grow countless, like a swarm of locusts. They require food, and there is not enough cropland. Hunger brings them to you. They seek your permission to plow an ancient oak grove. It is said that the wealthy use this forest for entertainment, hunting for sport. They won't like it if you take away their toy."
8643ab64-8116-4e46-a69c-9360ef0fad9e: "You are merciful. The people will never forget who granted them land for their honest labor."
9e86effc-e3b2-428d-b0a2-0317732070c9: "I wish you had given them to me. But I understand. You must think of your own pack."
5b29c3c9-8998-4e55-95c9-a19ac9d1ff3f: "The oak groves will be restricted to everyone except my pack. The children of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} will finally have a place in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} where they can be free!"
0d6102a4-17c8-4c60-b87f-20a2e4dd0d83: "But the earth must bear fruit, not serve as a playground. But I know better than to chop down old trees or give them as playthings for the idle. Grant this territory to me and my pack! My wards long for a place of their own, where they can escape persecution... and your pack may take all the rest. The children of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} will keep away from your other lands, and leave them to be safe for your pack."
441ea647-49da-4aba-b0f8-aecaa201732b: {n}Tsanna's smile is predatory.{/n} "I can hear happy laughter. It's my goddess! We shall drink blood to our heart's content. We shall glut ourselves in celebration. We will produce beautiful monsters under that canopy of trees. We shall leave to your subjects all the game and farmland around the area. Thank you, {name}! You won't be sorry."
7bc0598d-8b71-4f8b-8ffd-7d9350a7f0a4: "Your subjects wish to clear and plow some nearby oak groves, where wealthy men, both local and {g|Brevoy}Brevan{/g}, have hunted in sport for many years. The merchants won't like it, but I'm sure you can see that food for the children and the elderly is far more important than sports for the idle? Wouldn't you agree?"
2b1422e5-1326-4494-bada-4b0a0dc25ccb: "Your Highness, your protection of the rabble has borne fruit. Now the peasants are demanding a permit to level the oak grove near the capital. They want to use the land as a field to plant crops. But you see, the wealthy merchants have enjoyed hunting there for years. They won't be happy of another violation of their privileges. Take my advice. Don't turn the influential class against you."
98ded162-a0b7-4dd6-9deb-5e2a0dd1e5db: "Perfect. The forest will stay. The peasants will just have to make do with the food they have. The merchants will be grateful for this gesture."
26000a62-d98b-4bd3-a81c-2c7d0ee36cbf: {g|Military2_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "Open unrestricted recruitment. Anyone with the will for it is good enough for our army."
d4193aa5-9bff-4364-9ae9-749cc50dc83f: {g|Military2_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "Select the strongest and most skillful recruits. I need real fighters."
a5373366-ded6-432a-b6b9-7b4822711049: {g|Military2_3}[Choice effects]{/g} "Select those who have ambition. Soldiers who dream of glory and rank always serve better."
86089f4e-6a8b-4e01-9779-55b71657aeb3: {n}Kassil bows briskly, then hurries to speak.{/n} "On your orders, I have reviewed our military forces. The results are... disappointing, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. We require new recruits – and the sooner the better."
8932307d-7c72-412a-979b-45d50124e6d7: "We can introduce some restrictions, limiting how many could qualify for service. However, under these circumstances I feel they shouldn't be very stringent. Indeed, I would recommend we announce that anyone can join the army – and I'm sure that we shall find many brave men among your subjects, ready to protect their lands!"
89a1806e-95cd-4821-af51-e6458c95a212: {n}Amiri looks displeased.{/n} "Since you made me the troops' chief, listen to what I tell you: you need more people. The ones we have now are weaklings and cowards. If we don't get any good fighters, our neighbors will smash us whenever they want!"
dc83b5e7-cced-43f1-b474-0cb62899f4d1: "Just so you know... you should pick better fighters. I don't want to deal with overgrown kids who complain about every scratch! Don't take just anyone who wants it – or else we'll have barracks full of pansies. What are we going to do with pansies? We need them strong and gutsy or it's no point."
51d89530-b08c-4575-994a-12b49fe9b0d6: "You busy? No? Then I got something for you." {n}Regongar stretches his shoulders, like he's readying for a fight.{/n} "You may have killed the Stag Lord, but it's too early to kick back and relax. There's still plenty of bandits walking your lands. They still think it's their home. Let me get some more soldiers, before they cut through the ones we have and leave us with nothing."
23295680-a7bb-4a02-b716-c797a85cc9d9: {n}The half-orc squints.{/n} "You know which ones you need? Not the big dumb guys. No, you need fighters who want power. They'll serve you well. And if any should grow too bold..." {n}Regongar sneers sullenly.{/n} "I'll hang them from the trees."
384327b4-afc6-4f4a-851e-0a165aade32b: "Wonderful, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}! I will begin recruiting new soldiers immediately."
d527aa11-d73d-4cf7-908b-2c53ee3aed31: "Seriously? Your capital is already guarded by a handful of pansies, and now you want a whole army like that?! Ugh!" {n}Amiri spits on the floor and angrily turns away.{/n}
fdef484d-e341-46bf-a651-fc9f488c62e7: "Is that right? Well, you're the boss. We'll find a use for cannon fodder too." {n}Regongar shrugs nonchalantly.{/n}
c25b7b34-cd20-45b1-9563-d43cd6426428: "As you wish, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}."
dc85a6ff-94ca-4c87-82e8-38ca0224da85: "Right! Just like I say! No idea why I come to you. I could just do it all myself."
62b4154d-3493-4c5d-91d2-49d1080908b1: {n}Regongar shows his fangs.{/n} "Dumb blockheads marching around? What am I supposed to do with these idiots?!" {n}The half-orc growls in irritation and turns away.{/n}
27481182-a75a-4369-a137-012a28fb4202: {n}Kassil frowns.{/n} "Ambition is good, when there's a place for it. But an army, with its strict order and hierarchy, is hardly a place for upstarts." {n}The half-orc coughs.{/n} "I'm sorry to speak so freely."
c93f9353-a47d-48ff-91df-02096206598b: "Hmm... well, maybe something good will come from them. I understand. I'll go find some."
37f5df39-039a-4697-8b59-2ad782b64e82: {n}Regongar grins.{/n} "I like your attitude. I'll go get busy."
7f7350b8-63b1-4314-a988-f1ee5ebd2c5e: "As you wish. I will announce immediately that anyone who wishes to serve their native land shall be welcomed in its army."
70b87dda-f99a-4b0b-ae98-e10d778a6b5d: "So why did I come all the way here from the other side of the castle?! Fine, I'll recruit the ones I like. If he can get up after I punch him, then he's in." {n}Amiri cracks her fingers, ready for a brawl.{/n}

2bda1d47-2e39-4b19-b1de-8230e37e0880: "But on the other hand, I thought... How should I put it..." {n}Harrim wraps his beard around his fist.{/n} "My gift, wherever it came from... The gift to destroy, to help others create... Perhaps my god does something similar. Everything that has a beginning has an end as well. One day, {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g} will be free and destroy this world. But imagine what will happen then, after the end... Perhaps a new beginning? A new creation and a new world? Who knows? Who knows!"
54965989-5595-49d8-8111-456304172517: "Anyway... Thank you, {Name}. Without you I would have kept going in circles while resentment and hatred gnawed at me from the inside. You helped me find peace. And I swear by {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}, I won't leave your side until it's our turn to crumble to dust."
ba05d87e-8cd9-4d5e-ac26-e6498d8d887f: {n}Harrim looks at you – or rather, through you. His eyes seem to look into eternity.{/n} "Rumbling stones, clanging metal, rustling dust... You know, {Name}, in the sound of the falling fortress I heard the whisper of my god – but for once it was loud and clear. He said, he said... Oh, if only I could put the revelation into words... If only you knew what I have seen... If you could only imagine..."
8e21c8fb-0c22-44f4-97c3-c630e35b1457: {n}The priest clenches his beard in his fist. There is wisdom in his wide open eyes, like you've never seen before – and incredible depths of insanity.{/n} "All this is no coincidence, {Name}. Our meeting, our battles... Our future death. I may never be able to share all this wisdom with you, but I'll tell you one thing now: the gods themselves brought us together. From now until the end, my path lies with yours. And I shall not step away from it for as long as I live!"
f8ad6f0d-f041-46ca-9287-46344f8a6f28: {n}Harrim shrugs indifferently.{/n} "Why does it matter? This old man is pathetic and ridiculous. Just think: his pride and greed were so great that they tricked him into overcoming death... And for what? So he could keep guarding this pile of rocks? Ha, a worthy end for a true Skjegge – but there's nothing to be proud of here."
6e17f5de-0284-466e-8d25-cf73fe946cba: {n}Harrim shrugs indifferently.{/n} "Good, bad... They were driven by greed and pride. Truth be told, the two didn't differ much. Both true children of the Skjegge clan, and true followers of {g|Torag}Torag{/g}. There is nothing to be proud of here."
03cc78c5-4584-4b79-a482-8fdf2feb7b7d: {n}Harrim shrugs indifferently.{/n} "Laws and rules are even more ephemeral than we ourselves. Oblivion will not sue you, or call dust and ash as its witness. It makes no difference."
a0acd4a3-07aa-49d4-9569-021d73c95bd2: "I care not who won the fortress. What draws my mind are thoughts of my place in the world, and the true meaning of serving {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}. Destroying, creating something new from the pieces, and destroying it again... Isn't that what you're doing now here, in the Stolen Lands? You have built your kingdom upon the ashes of countless predecessors... Ponder this when you have the time."
0e2f1776-def9-47e0-afde-06cebaad3dc4: "Forget about them. It means nothing, nothing. The dead fighting over a pinch of dust – that's what they are. To give credence to their whims means standing in folly alongside them."
9c1216cc-855b-44ee-a083-69a6cd9f0f6a: "You can judge me if you want. But don't forget to judge the woodlouse and bookworm... The winds and tides that pummel down rocks... Judge time itself, for having no mercy on anyone or anything!"
c895b834-32f0-4dd6-896e-e701fcf0d832: "The fortress, the Skjegge... They are just pinches of ash, cast over the abyss. Their fate means nothing. All that matters is what I've just realized... Seen... No, I can't explain it. I can't pronounce the words of the truth, though they may be imprinted forever in my soul! But you were the one who brought me this revelation, this insight. And so long as my feeble flesh and exhausted mind still serve me, you will have my gratitude!"
e51d494b-60cd-4b11-ab11-78c75d6898e5: {n}Harrim's lips stretch into a haunting smile.{/n} "Fun? Ha ha ha, probably... The universe falls into splinters, and all things are dissolved in a whirl of dust... We can grieve or laugh aloud – and what's the difference anyway?"
ed80e7c1-ca02-4562-a53a-c77275c82664: "Forget about him. Never regret that you didn't interfere with a dead man fighting for a pinch of dust. To give credence to their whims means standing in folly alongside them."
88e8a6ff-229c-44dc-8a20-5d6d1ccc6db6: "And have you ever thought about... starting a new family? What if you find another place you could call home?"
5e1c303e-677b-4689-b019-d927bb480b02: "I've lost much. But I survived. I wouldn't survive again. I'm better off alone."
a06a6039-7948-45b3-8cb0-ad942399506d: "You lazybones, you didn't even try at all during the last battle! Are you feeling all right?"
894e3427-2b79-4a62-83d8-d8a887b1bb63: "Hey, I'm just giving you a chance to get at least one kill for yourself!"
801c27c9-ffe5-4a7d-9204-99fbf2ee64be: "I have yet to become a baron{mf||ess}, and already it seems that someone wishes to poison me..."
187c4180-ad56-411f-b5af-92cee58a8280: "Do you want to get right to business?"
38d90c76-2de8-4926-b335-da641632779a: "No need to apologize – I don't expect everyone I meet to immediately fall under my charms and entrust me with all their secrets!"
8cd5c219-978a-4501-9b17-2ee57624618d: "Apology accepted. What did you want to tell me?"
b54a642d-e9c5-42a1-a680-2001557d1ea5: "You've shown your duplicity once. I don't want to have anything further to do with you."
2cdaf194-fa54-4fa5-bc5c-90d2e499f803: "First I will listen to what you have to say, and then I will decide what to think of your repentance."
3f0d5ecc-c0a8-4865-abaf-50dcb709c47c: "It sounds tempting, but I'll need to think about it."
c7e0d56b-dfe3-48bd-ab1b-f69adb2bfe8a: "Forgive me if your promises are not reassuring. I've no wish to have anything more to do with you."
c48830f3-c83e-47e9-a160-d8e76a8673e3: "What could be better than a treasure hunt? I'm ready!"
a2ed5438-1887-4353-9cf1-80c883048c6d: {n}You see {d|Kaessi}Kaessi{/d} approaching – the tiefling you met during the battle at Jamandi Aldori's mansion. As she draws near, she places one of the cups of wine she's holding into your hand.{/n} "Will you drink with me?"
76650ab7-8033-42a9-b844-dda381d8c425: {n}Kaessi smiles and taps her cup to yours.{/n} "To beauty! It sweetens our happy days, and brings solace to our dark and sorrowful ones..."
b1cfb20c-3e29-4374-bbe3-a5f51914611f: "Oh yes!" {n}Kaessi salutes you with her cup.{/n} "There's no wine in the world that tastes as rich as victory. But still, there's nothing wrong in cheering your successes with wine."
c143bcfd-44de-4521-8865-68176ae00729: "I'd say you like to walk a straight road, and keep away from roundabouts..."
b022b341-e72f-474b-a079-4287e80a1368: "You insult me with such suspicions! Only a very foolish poisoner would offer a cup of death with their own hand – and right here, for all to see! If I wished to poison you, I'd surely do it secretly... and with grace." {n}Kaessi smiles coyly.{/n}
b7dea00a-fa06-47df-8e89-324e9f14ae34: "But jokes aside." {n}Kaessi stops smiling.{/n} "I came to... apologize. I know – the words I said in our conversation with Lady Aldori might have offended you, but this was not my intention. The lessons life has dealt me were not easy. I've learned to be wary of new acquaintances – which is why I refused to join your party. I hope you will forgive me for this weakness, and for my harsh words. And I hope you will hear me out – for I have something to tell you..."
10f1f8fc-bdd0-47d6-8ef4-148f97b622c0: "As it happens, I came across some very valuable information. What brave conqueror of these wild lands wouldn't be intrigued by news of an ancient shrine – possibly full of great treasures? A place such as this was discovered by my old friends from {g|Qadira}Qadira{/g}, and it just so happens to be located in the lands that today become rightfully yours. My friends lack the courage to enter the shrine and seek the treasure. But what will stop us? We, who know the taste of battle, and have been singed by the same fire?" {n}Kaessi stops, looking at you expectantly.{/n}
e8eed487-e138-4220-9bc8-8dd1281ec74e: {n}Kaessi bites her lip, preparing to argue, but then shakes her head.{/n} "Well, it's your decision. Farewell, {name}! May the crown on your head not become a heavy burden."
5c0a9995-13ae-4e8c-a1bc-e13d7ae15232: {n}Kaessi looks down at her cup for a moment.{/n} "How amusing. – Usually, those who don't seek affection are the very ones who receive it... Anyway, enough sweet talk. There is something important I wanted to tell you."
e28f3f1b-c786-47dd-8590-c9bde7c31122: {n}Kaessi laughs quietly, fiddling with her cup.{/n} "I'm sure you'd like to finally gain your official title and celebrate your victory. And I don't like noisy parties and ceremonies... Find me when you return to your dominion. I'll rent a house in your capital. We can discuss the details of our expedition there."
e37f1b20-d6a4-4852-bb98-4c9c6239e2f3: "Your caution is reasonable. Well, I'm going to visit the capital of your newborn barony anyway. I might rent a house. Find me there if you decide you're interested in my offer!"
9fd23bf5-23ab-4924-81af-24371aea8f80: "So long, {name}. I'll call you by your name today – because soon enough all you'll be hearing is 'Your Grace, Your Grace, Your Grace'!" {n}Saluting you with the cup, the tiefling girl steps back and disappears in the shadows between the columns.{/n}
af196a0c-5704-44ec-9bdc-df0e2d5f9eb5: "You speak strange sometimes. Mix up your words. But in a funny way. Is it magic?"
e86c695a-9332-4de5-8254-73885e6a2991: "Ha! This fellow has a taste in humor! Not like all of you!"
7171cbf1-83f1-4af7-a5bf-c6285ad356f7: "Let's get to the point. You say the bandits are going to attack again? Who are they, and when will they arrive?"
209c1053-0db2-4505-a13d-bfe38b448fce: "Oleg, I'd like to see your goods."
bf960fa1-bb2b-4f3a-9a83-442921f644ee: "You have nothing to fear. I'll help you deal with the attack."
1da99ae2-167b-408e-9c6d-35688eeb0d8a: "Tell me as much as you know. How many bandits are there? What do they want?"
83f0146e-bea3-4d41-847e-ae96ce2d9666: "They claimed they were collecting taxes. Why?"
94bc0cd1-84e0-4a58-9404-b95883e7307d: "The safety of your post may have been one of the conditions Jamandi Aldori placed on granting me barony, but she said nothing about having to listen to your whining."
15f03403-fbc1-43cd-a920-f2605648e3ef: "Can you answer a few more questions for me?"
e2da3af6-0d30-4586-9029-387a20f453fb: [Wait for attack] "I'm prepared for the attack. Get in your positions and wait."
eda6319f-bc5c-45b8-9743-7819d546decd: "Let's get back to the possible attack..."
1ef0836e-6685-424e-86c6-1b5d145e5ff9: "I'm going to look around, think on the best way to use the tar and traps."
2fddff11-b9b7-489a-9ba5-9d3115420dfc: "I saw someone run out of the trading post. Do you know who it was?"
b75ef08a-8271-487a-afd6-a29428389e76: "Alchemist's fire? We could put it by the gate, light it off with a burning arrow when those bandits are nearby."
8f4fab87-619a-4679-8db5-3840570866ab: "What can you tell me about that man who ran away from the post and came back?"
1dea6037-3003-4dda-a3c8-87363fd1b5e8: "I'll help you. I'm not really interested in your post, but I never back down from a good fight."
113eec02-32cf-497e-93c1-e67f99439a2e: "Better give the alchemist's fire to me. We can deal with bandits without it."
b6f6bea9-8130-4ee3-ba60-825c3775667d: "Alchemist's fire? Could you give it to me? I'm sure I'll find a good use for it!"
705b97da-da60-4aa4-b6b9-2e2b0ed1fa39: {n}Oleg looks at you as though he'd hoped you and the bandits would cut each other to pieces, then he grunts.{/n} "So, the rats bailed, huh? Better than nothing.
