4fa32232-1dc7-495b-a1bd-8b07117575c9: "My mother is dead, and I... feel nothing?" {n}Nortellara speaks in a quiet voice.{/n} "Perhaps my heart is made of stone, just like hers? Forgive me, {mf|king|queen}. There are words that must be said aloud."
0ffd98e7-79ef-4adb-bf9e-b50431a3989b: {n}The young elf looks at the bodies of her mother and her other relatives, shocked.{/n} "An endless circle of death... It began in {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g} and ended here. What was it all for? Now the only one left to ask — is me myself." {n}She looks at you as if she'd just awoken.{/n} "If it makes any sense at all, I'm... grateful for my salvation. I want you to know, {mf|king|queen} — from this day forth, I owe you a great debt."
e296e1b5-5339-4b40-a961-11bb47823229: "I made two mistakes with her," {n}Nortellara says as you approach.{/n} "The first time, back in {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g} — when I defended her before the court and argued that she might change. The second time, here, when I sought to kill, believing that she could never change."
876a150b-b05a-4313-a07a-0d24a8c15612: "I owe you my life, {mf|king|queen}. My life and my hopes. I pray that one day I might repay you in kind, but for now..."
87825eca-f68f-4253-8175-ce05ed2a37b9: "I wish to give you one of my mother's things. I don't think I'll ever be able to touch this again. Thank you for everything, and farewell!"
232d5cb3-108d-4d1d-92ea-a252f47fc7ec: "I like your wolf! In the mountains we like them too. A tribe near us used to breed such giant ones – ugh! They'd swallow a man alive! Horse and all!"
4f817ee2-5360-48bf-8826-c0961022d25c: [Relay your meeting with the barbarians] "There's a chance to cut our losses."
0eb65fa9-4115-4800-9d49-3f2d4069b058: "How did barbarians recruit giants into their army?"
27b204e2-5b15-4e85-9e8a-4a35a3a10746: "At least I managed to save you."
296af127-672b-410c-809c-f03fdc358e76: [Relay your meeting with the barbarians] "Not all is lost. There's still a chance to cut our losses."
22a4c845-2d12-43ab-b6ff-2f1a2569ef8d: "How did the barbarians recruit giants into their army?"
27dbd3f0-73e3-47c0-b612-15b2019792e5: {n}A half-elf woman, clad in armor, folds the spyglass she was using to watch the battlefield and shakes your hand firmly.{/n} "I knew I could {d|c41 Follow Amiri}count on you{/d}! The battle's about to begin, and I won't lie — without your reinforcements, this battle would be hard on us."
f98f283b-07eb-47aa-a70d-3e0d1d7145aa: {n}Kassil salutes you with his sword.{/n} "I'm glad to see you again! Now we'll win without a doubt!"
b3b59db0-7c71-44e5-aaba-c7badd003297: {n}Jamandi listens intently, frowns, and rubs her chin.{/n} "You tell a strange tale. Who are these Sisters? Why did the {g|Tiger Lords}Tiger Lords{/g} attack us in the first place? This sounds less like a conditional war than a bloody hecatomb. It's like the true reason behind this battle is to sacrifice as many people as possible, on both sides, in the name of some grim deity..."
37fd8207-76dc-49eb-952f-828be44d3453: "I'm glad you're an adventurer first and a ruler second, in this instance. Perhaps with the information you've obtained we'll be able to avoid a slaughter."
aea79dba-5f5a-4a1d-8733-7e55424ad357: "It couldn't be worse... Well, no, things can always get worse. But the barbarians outnumber us, and they have giants in their ranks. They've broken their force into several groups, forcing us to spread our defenses thin. I really can't guess how many of my people will see another dawn..."
96ed1478-dfff-471f-8d21-693fcf02183b: "To the best of my knowledge, {g|Numeria}Numerians{/g} adopt giants when they're young and raise them as fighters. These giants are usually quite strong but poorly organized. However, under the leadership of a capable commander, they're threefold the danger."
03ef46d3-39e5-4ec7-9f15-a8e935cb4fa5: "Cautiously. I'll draw my forces to yours and begin a slow advance against the enemy. If your contacts spoke true, they should retreat."
0ccca6b1-1a4d-4958-98ad-05ff8c0bab14: "As for you, your best option is to return to their main camp. If all went as planned, you'll find Armag's body there. If not... then bring that adventurer's instinct to the fore and improvise."
f45c6b9c-364c-4659-ab67-6cbc513fa209: "{g|Abadar}Abadar{/g} guide you! Do your best. I'd really like to see you again... In this world, I mean."
03bd5f60-88cc-4639-bea9-32a0bca9f1be: "Get going. Time is of the essence."
7f8a99e7-23e8-4b1b-8bc4-d2793f7072f2: {n}A half-elf woman, clad in broken and dented armor, sets a healing potion to her bloodied lips. Leaning on her jagged sword, she stands and looks over the battlefield, the corpses of friends and foes alike strewn across it.{/n} "Dead... Everyone is dead."
a75adfc5-c7a9-4e40-9749-3bc301183c94: {n}She turns to you, her blood-smeared face distorted with rage.{/n} "Where have you {d|c41 Follow Tristian}been{/d}?"
c9fbd72a-f29c-4411-aafc-c4ace2764aeb: {n}Jamandi shakes her head, wiping her hand across her face.{/n} "No, it doesn't matter. Don't bother answering, I've no interest in your excuses. You're late, and it's all over. My army's been destroyed, and the way to {g|Restov}Restov{/g} is unprotected. Your reinforcements won't make any difference now."
aa896bc4-6422-45e7-a688-4dbdc1ec8066: "Should I thank you for that? What good is a commander with no army? Now I'll just die a few days later attempting to defend {g|Restov}Restov{/g} proper from these barbarians. So, great. Thanks."
77715f40-1b64-4acd-a38d-0751bab67e32: {n}Jamandi throws her sword to the ground with a curse.{/n} "Do you even comprehend what this means? We were double-crossed! All this... All these deaths... All for nothing!"
d096af9a-9476-4cb9-9ca8-7239235645ba: "I'll find the ones responsible — hunt them to the ends of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} if I have to! And if it turns out the {g|House Surtova}Surtovas{/g} were behind it all — gods help them!"
346f1c84-dc96-4d27-953d-06021e15581d: "Follow through on your agreement with the barbarians. Go to their main camp — it's not far. In the meantime, I'll try to save whatever remains of my army."
8498db89-95dd-4090-8610-8c87fc9fa2be: "How do you think? The barbarians outnumbered us, and with giants at their sides. It was a slaughter. We killed many of them on the battlefield, but my army was decimated in the process."
9e9c8a8e-8528-4c27-a564-7c292d3d79cc: "How should I know? Probably picked them up as children in {g|Numeria}Numeria{/g}, and raised them to fight. Giants are dangerous enough on their own, but under the command of an experienced warlord..."
ba7e3b21-bd74-48eb-8fbb-ed5b9d4fb520: "Go. Too much blood's been shed this day — but perhaps we can still save someone."
88fbc636-7863-4a24-91a5-647c4fda07b8: "Such a tragedy... O {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, how many children became orphans today and won't see their father or mother any more... I..." {n}Tristian stops, his lips clenched and twitching.{/n}
aa85f8b5-6a5e-44f7-b9f5-89c3dcb2e89c: "Where is this neophyte who was supposed to test me?"
c0a04b32-5e41-45d9-b64e-0e17073d1efc: [Attack] "I don't need the likes of you here!"
f731a468-931b-47db-b3ef-a2a4bc247d9b: "Are you sure you want to help me? My views on the world differ from yours."
99231cb9-82bd-46bd-8a13-6d5c238f7989: "That time I didn't have to wait long! Congratulations, Your Highness – you passed this trial with flying colors!"
97b407ee-307f-494b-9206-5add2bfe5ab1: "You took your time, Your Highness! Unfortunately you didn't pass the trial."
983ff4fb-3355-4686-814d-e52b73821d31: "Now the final trial awaits you. Find my sister, Vidya the Lion. She is somewhere nearby – you need not look far."
8729135c-a745-4774-8807-7e3ab24fc123: {n}The dwarf smiles.{/n} "Standing right in front of me. Who made you run here day and night without sleep or even rest? It certainly wasn't me! You tested yourself – and with brilliant results!"
99bfdf85-aeeb-436d-a2e2-7ad2c963e6e9: {n}The dwarf smiles.{/n} "Standing right in front of me. This time you were supposed to test yourself. Could you bend your will to follow the road day and night, without sleep or even rest? Alas, you treat yourself too gently!"
701af65c-f9c8-4850-942f-5a6cfe404449: "Forgive my rudeness. It was a part of the trial. Not everyone is be able to smother their pride and suffer insults from a smug stranger!"
29eec1ad-a632-477d-8ad9-96a799a28d02: "Not too smart on your part." {n}The dwarf whispers a spell, and boundless peace and tranquility descend upon you. Unable to even reach for your weapon, you watch Puja leave.{/n}
9f3e9c04-f433-4d27-b270-859c2fb63836: "Safe journey, Your Highness. We will meet again."
2f50b9a9-f43a-4505-921d-2f320a5c52cc: "I received the name Puja from teacher Avalo. He comes from {g|Jalmeray}Jalmeray{/g}, and gives his disciples names in his native tongue. 'Puja' means 'prayer'. And 'Wolf' is an honorary title. To become a master of an order, one must walk one of the paths of wisdom – the Phoenix, the Unicorn, and so on. The Way of the Wolf is the way of humility, of foregoing pride and personal ambition. Of honest, if sometimes thankless, work for the common good."
9ab1dbff-619b-45f5-b0c9-fcbb08132b0a: "Refusing those who seek knowledge is a sin. What do you wish to know?"
d9a3b3ef-22bf-4bbd-a8ec-ea73e5856fb0: "It was founded by teacher Avalo. Very little is known of his past – only that he is from {g|Jalmeray}Jalmeray{/g}. Some say he was a criminal and fled the law... These are only rumors, but even if there is truth behind them – well, many in our order used to be villains. Changing one's sinister nature, rising from mere animal existence to goodness and order – this is the backbone of our teaching."
73af459d-04c8-4fa9-b512-7d93864fc58e: "It is difficult to translate – there just isn't a suitable word in the common language. 'The way of a hero' is close, but hero is not understood as one who spills more blood than the rest. 'The way of the righteous' perhaps, though still not very exact. If you would forgive such a bulky phrase, it's more precisely "the way of the person who makes the world a better place'."
cd82eb3c-f1f6-490f-a676-3a297b44a947: "To tell the tale... the teacher spent many years meditating in the Arthfell Forest and then showed up out of nowhere at a great temple of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, and challenged the high priestess to debates about the essence of their faith. He argued thus with many religious leaders, proving that there's a common principle behind the faiths of the different gods of good and order, a common path he called the Wise Way. Disciples came to him. But though there was nothing profane in his words, it seemed that the servants of even the most kind deities don't like it when their congregation is being taken from them." {n}The dwarf chuckles sadly.{/n}
18b4d13a-c55f-489a-a602-3d71f8d385b3: "And thus the teacher returned to the Arthfell, swearing then and there that our order would build no temples of our own. Some of his disciples stayed with him, while others went traveling, spreading his teachings. We are no secret, but don't attract too much attention either. Some tell us to leave, others listen and learn... That is all."
84112cab-126c-44b0-bb33-f168b76189fe: "The Wise Way. Our teacher discovered it after years of contemplation and meditation. Its common principles of good and order underpin the faiths of all the kind gods. If everyone followed them, the world would know no war, and all would live as one vast family. The core principle of the Wise Way is non-violence. Yes, it can be difficult at times, especially when evil rages all around. But we believe that it is only by pacifying the evil in one's own soul that we are able to defeat monsters."
809c1eb7-e8e7-4132-8266-193dcb87ac90: "We are not sure – that's why we are testing you! But be assured that even if you harbor evil and hope only to profit from us... If you manage to pass our trials, this surely means there is room in your soul for good. Many of our members were once scoundrels or worse. And each of them is now living proof that the Wise Way is open to all!"
148dab1b-fc43-411c-a00f-8ba35821167b: "We venerate many deities, but swear by none. {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}, {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, {g|Irori}Irori{/g}, {g|Iomedae}Iomedae{/g}, {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, {g|Abadar}Abadar{/g} – each a fragment of the truth. But only teacher Avalo gathered all the parts together in the teachings of the Wise Way."
15825e1d-8345-4f4b-918d-7de0ead21d4e: "As the teacher likes to say – ask and be answered."
886585a4-21ed-4fb3-92f1-636bb7b9a7cd: "Hello again, Your Highness. Congratulations! You not only passed the trial, but you performed it brilliantly! If you walked just a little bit faster, you'd have had to wait for me, not me for you! My sincerest respect!"
4c317b2f-a31a-4f50-a396-2617b8990a1d: "A wolf lives for the pack — true. A wolf is humble and not proud — not true."
ece33b70-1a14-411b-bb67-b43dd43a1b70: "I see wisdom in these words. Perhaps your teachings do not fully match with what I believe and know of the world, but there are many kind things in them."
84e19fc6-c494-478c-b1ba-0c0e340835e2: "What do you hold for the future of Varnhold?"
86b6aff7-dcb5-43ca-a192-ec76d21f26da: "The Varnling Host fought for your interests many times, but we haven't had a chance to meet in person yet."
6738dae5-a226-4c48-9a77-d1b1b856c8e0: "Work. Much difficult and dangerous work awaits us – if we are to survive."
3cb022dc-b0c4-4436-9350-f9bb7e11b5e9: "Nothing good. This is a reckless venture, and will only bring trouble to everyone involved."
f2ba914b-e585-49a7-8c1b-4b0df7839310: "I'll be frank. We are braced for the manipulations, guile and treachery of our neighbors."
c9fcb054-8c3f-4ed8-b67d-6b2a72751e78: "We'll be fine, if that is Abadar's will!"
c274230f-c1d2-435e-a13b-345f7ceb0101: "So you're the famous {Name}? I'm pleased to finally meet you in person. {d|Varn}Varn{/d} has told me much of your deeds."
0f2135f8-e470-43e1-ae52-f7e876958bb4: "I only wish I knew! We live in a wild time of great changes. The rise of new states in disputed lands will be a shock to the entire region. Of course, I have my own thoughts and plans, as everyone does... But there's only one thing I'm sure of – there will be no risk of a boring future!"
725e061e-08dc-4bdb-a2af-988bde87e223: "It's a pleasure doing business with the {g|Varnling Host}Varnling Host{/g}. –- You offer honest swords for honest gold. You do charge a fair amount, but this means I won't have to worry about someone else buying you out from under me. Alas, not many mercenary teams can boast your reputation."
6304e884-3574-4fab-a13a-5578769b5e70: "Allow me to return the question. What do you think awaits your young barony?"
108b356a-37ed-4ce6-b12e-4f3484bfb336: "Just as your commander might put it! Well, I sincerely hope your optimism pays off."
9f133651-40a4-4fb4-83da-dfa8801240c1: "You seem to have both your feet on the ground. It's good to see that {d|Varn}Varn{/d} has such people around him. He's never lacked courage, but practicalities have never been his strong suit!"
fba9fa65-68d8-4acf-8f64-316b27fe48a6: "A reckless venture perhaps, but {d|Varn}Varn{/d} has often been called a venturer. Though thanks to allies like you, he has so far managed to navigate his dangerous ordeals – and with the lives of his people intact. Yes, reclaiming the Stolen Lands is a dangerous game, but if I didn't believe in you, I wouldn't be betting on your victory!"
cc8227b6-be8f-4600-81fc-05d07769610b: "And I approve. I have no doubts in you. No matter what challenges tomorrow brings, the {g|Varnling Host}Varnling Host{/g} will surely triumph!"
96eff0c1-42b1-4ca6-ab94-fac51b88ed12: "I value your frankness. Yes, many rulers fall victim to the ambitions of their neighbors – and their own gullibility... But many more fail from an inability to make reliable alliances. You can't survive without friends – and how can you find them if you see the face of the enemy everywhere you look?"
609cbcd3-2201-47d3-8214-d5113caa98f9: "I will pray that the god of cities smiles mercifully upon you. The task before you – to build houses and plow fields where a wild wasteland stood only yesterday – this is the work of the righteous, and promises to be most profitable as well!"
ad356aac-39bf-472e-b0cf-8908eb2446bc: [Talk to the old people] "Who are you?"
67f0afb7-1b4e-45eb-8abe-e89c707b00a8: [Talk to the young man] "So who are you, and what are you doing here?"
7a3f2e38-397f-486b-98de-81e508174d9f: "I've inspected the area and I'm ready to report my findings."
411cb632-061b-46ff-a0dc-64baaa3dcdf1: "I'll go and see what I can find."
f3b803e1-f370-49a0-b40e-eed43cea204f: "I've explored the area and found nothing strange. It seems to be a regular inn."
7b3da1f1-6073-4e63-8b13-13ab16027649: {n}Three people are sitting at a table in a tense silence, an old couple and a young man. They turn to you suddenly, making little effort to conceal their dismay.{/n}
b5f0411b-de10-4b85-b64e-715429608818: "Em... No, no, not at all! Welcome, dear guests, please sit down! How can we help you? Would you like to have dinner? Or maybe a room for the night?"
dd2ca22e-5296-4732-b848-487fee0fc7f1: "Make sure not to order any meat. I heard it's... strange here."
335fdefe-466d-4509-9dc0-8ada5f0e3949: "I'm afraid we don't have any meat, only cabbage soup. And bread – but the bread is fresh!"
0a454f7b-dae4-4bfe-a7e9-7a1d18235f4e: "Well, have you looked around? Have you found anything?"
91afd4d3-4ac6-421a-9278-d6b847266642: "Yes, yes, of course! Don't worry about a thing!"
828d65f9-1484-4e4d-8fcf-18867705962e: "Then I suppose you won't mind if my people take a look around your inn? By the way, I forgot to introduce myself. Maegar Varn – the baron of these lands. I've heard rumor that guests at your inn are treated rather badly. But surely this must be idle gossip?"
5dbeb245-6824-424e-a8ce-bef011d9fe41: {n}The old man looks at the old woman, then you, and then turns his eyes back to Maegar.{/n} "Em... Yes, yes, of course! Please look around! I assure you, everything here is in order!"
58e26eaf-f28d-4873-9776-a48593100200: {n}Maegar turns to you and winks surreptitiously.{/n} "Cephal and I will remain here just in case, to keep an eye on everyone. You have a look around. And if you have any questions, I'm sure our dear hosts will be happy to answer them."
594b1824-9066-4fea-b459-37c9346dfcbb: "I am Mytko, Mytko Bragic, and this is my wife, Kalina. We came from... em... Brevoy. Wanted to move someplace new. And we opened this inn..."
c077cf1b-eec8-4837-bcb8-c54431dc57f3: "I'm Yorgesh, a simple merchant from {g|Restov}Restov{/g}. I'm on my way to {g|Galt}Galt{/g} to trade... I've been here before, and never had any problems. The beds are warm, the food is good, and the roof doesn't leak!"
70b07122-6e9a-4ac0-a772-4fac34034c7e: "Great! Let's hear what my people managed to find out!"
a2742fb5-c51d-4715-9a94-5a4701f0f21b: "Right, there are lots of passers-by here, settlers, merchants... And we thought an inn by a ford would be sure to have a regular flow of guests!"
28a628eb-251c-4aab-80d8-be9b6f2df169: "And treating our guests badly? Why, that's slander, I swear by all the gods! We... em... We value our reputation!"
39b5fafb-0d30-4d38-9bd8-4fc90f322e26: "Keep your eyes peeled – any evidence might be important!"
401c2566-c069-4eb4-8bd9-efc9b680aca9: "Really? Well then, forgive us for the intrusion, dear hosts. Thank you for your hospitality. We have to go."
1d5a305e-ca39-43ff-9a0d-d086a7891986: "I will not deny help to anyone in trouble who comes to me for aid."
e5bea311-e408-49e4-ad4b-d5241bef58ff: "I will be merciful to those who deserve it!"
178a282d-0ae1-44bc-bf14-b34bdbd45ecd: "Perhaps with benevolence. Or perhaps harshly. We'll wait and see."
0e52c3e9-c089-4edd-a6c2-343dd217cf0b: "I will destroy the unworthy, but as for those who are suffering — let them solve their own problems."
7b987daf-c414-47a9-bb43-e86f7ddf66ee: "All who abide by my laws may rely on my mercy."
4b14302b-0d32-4d56-bead-830ec3060fda: "Only if it is wise and serves our larger goals."
b3b3bef0-7c63-415e-88a9-663dfa9aba7c: "I will abide the laws which benefit my subjects and my lands."
1bf62972-bb16-4847-a156-3aed845da1d1: "This country will live under the rule of law, and those who break the law will be severely punished."
b2453135-5207-4091-a023-69a221783b76: "Laws? I don't give a fig about laws. I am the power and I am the law: if during breakfast I wish to hear innocents screaming on the rack — then I will hear it!"
9b8ab584-2b16-4dfa-8254-1fab480fba79: "I don't need outdated traditions or stupid laws! The will of the {mf|King|Queen} is above all: I know what my subjects require for their happiness and prosperity!"
fdc34898-5bcc-4f10-91e2-325d2af2f59e: "That's quite enough for today, Linzi. The people want to celebrate, not listen to my pompous babbling."
0386562c-4137-4c9a-935e-60c72c52ceae: "My loyal subjects! Today is the day when law finally comes to the Stolen Lands…"
a59814ea-9805-43eb-a546-693d8b181363: "My good subjects! My only dream is to deliver peace and safety to those who have put their trust in me — something you have so desperately needed, for so long..."
888b9c88-2496-4bd9-95a8-ca890dadc164: "Now listen to me, my subjects! From this day forth, I am your sovereign and your master. My word is a law, and my will is your command…"
4f675ae2-efa9-4e8d-ac41-3aa977645520: "Brothers and sisters! The very essence of the Stolen Lands is freedom! No longer will the powerful dominate the weak. I swear to defend your freedom to my last breath..."
f4bb7d7a-e82c-4321-9af0-922cbaf8e21c: {n}Linzi is almost jumping in excitement, clutching in her hands a scroll covered with solemn oaths.{/n} "{mf|Baron|Baroness}, what took you so long? Everybody has been waiting for you! Hurry up!"
f59a2e1f-e78f-464d-ad0c-6435f63d91ba: {n}She proudly demonstrates a parchment scroll covered with scribbles.{/n} "I've searched all the books, but I couldn't find anything that resembled a coronation protocol for the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. So I took the liberty of penning the program myself! Don't worry, I did the very best I could!" {n}Linzi clears her throat and turns to the crowd.{/n}
558d31c3-7321-40be-8913-3ae3fb5c8c73: "Citizens of the Kingdom! Ladies and gentlemen! It is with great excitement and indescribable awe that I, Linzi, official chronicler of the hero who stands beside me, hereby declare the beginning of a sacred ceremony — the coronation of the first legitimate ruler in the history of the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}! By the power of the representatives of the other royal houses, who recognize {mf|him|her} as their equal, and according to the will of the people, who accepted {mf|his|her} rule, {mf|he|she} now ascends the throne, which has been waiting empty for so long, for such a worthy ruler!"

f31332e6-a637-4d99-a340-513b04fba3f1: "Everyone makes mistakes sometimes, Tristian. But not everyone is ready to accept and try to fix their mistakes."
fa1a9eab-c403-4784-96bb-40112000800b: "You should thank {name} for not letting me do all I'm supposed to do to you by the laws of the tribe…"

e7fce12e-2a35-42ab-a61e-e128df9774e6: "The only thing I am cursed with is your presence!"
c2f65cc7-553c-46ed-8afc-b9b6eef423ac: "I wonder what feeling an undead halfling would evoke from the peasants – fear or laughter?"
688004ac-5759-4981-a2ae-1a940bc926fa: "I think disgust. But I don't feel like testing the theory."
7ed33704-ef46-4d62-9ade-85c8916ba6d0: "Greetings, Gwart. Was your riot a success?"
0bb3de13-9e47-489c-be96-5d98e85b5e3a: "Nilak, what will happen to your tribe now?"
d21e0ca2-7225-49e8-a52c-22512d074867: "Farewell, then. I'll do all I can to stop Armag. I hope you can talk some sense into your tribesmen."

d744008c-7345-424c-ab06-b76ec6974b3f: {n}He unties Amiri and Nilak. Both women rise to their feet, rubbing their numb wrists, and exchange smiles of triumph.{/n}
3500f5f2-7aa8-453b-bf3d-6aa2b7377229: {n}He unties Amiri. The barbarian rises to her feet, rubbing her numb wrists and looking down in silence.{/n}
9579f160-53eb-45c2-ae60-0418ce5a1fda: {n}Dugath greets you with a curt nod.{/n}
d981aac4-e31c-4a54-8822-44de0c962c1c: {n}With a sour expression, Amiri shows you the hilt of her broken sword.{/n} "Armag was really strong, the dirty piece of crap. But I survived, so hail {g|Gorum}Gorum{/g}, I guess. As for Armag, I'm still going to get him!"
1f94ff65-076a-493f-bc69-1e40282e65c4: {n}Without raising her eyes, Amiri silently shakes her head.{/n}
344f5754-e462-4fc7-bb61-8751790d7785: "Heh heh heh, that's {d|c31 Ashman Friendly}right{/d}! Old Dugath's not so easy to kill! I'd ask you to share a drink or two with me again, but as you can see, now's not the best time!"
2e248263-bc31-4cb1-be2b-5e17ea92c95a: {n}The old cleric nods with restraint.{/n} "So, the battle rages {d|c31 Ashman Hostile}again{/d}, and your people continue killing mine... but I owe you my life. The gods like to play cruel jokes on mortals."
8d273537-efd9-489a-a731-40c0d8fd854b: "Yes and no. Armag's still alive — mad or not, he's still one of the strongest fighters in all {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}. But that's not important right now. He abandoned his army in the middle of battle — no one here will recognize him as chieftain after that!"
ea408fa9-6a47-4e74-b97b-e6e9acfe67e3: "Not at all! There's still an entire army of our brothers and sisters back in {g|Numeria}Numeria{/g}, ready to obey his every word. I fear this will end with the {g|Tiger Lords}Tiger Lords{/g} splitting into two separate tribes."
83f6f158-e6e5-4409-9fa4-ffb13f007163: "Exactly — and you should be the one to do it, because we can't stay any longer. 4342be04-2a26-492d-aac8-273c24ea071d: "An evil spirit still haunts us. We won't survive on our own. We're going back to {g|Numeria}Numeria{/g} with Gwart and the others."

b0183634-99fb-4bbf-a1b7-f98a3a7abf1a: "Go. I'll catch up to you later," {n}Amiri says, her voice hoarse.{/n} "I must... bury Nilak. And this useless piece of scrap, too." {n}The barbarian looks to the hilt of her broken sword in her hands, then turns away.{/n} "Go. Go, I said!"
a5dc9486-9c76-4fb2-84fa-958fc0f0df92: "That's the creepy part. 96f26634-896e-4cf8-82a8-54206800288c: "Only Armag and the Sisters know! You'll have to find it on your own."
84cba1c2-ed19-4c8f-9f73-498a9dcb679f: "Amiri... thanks for saving me. {g|Desna}Desna{/g} be my witness, I didn't deserve it. After all I said..."

7e42c26b-49c3-4198-89d7-b60fd8cb01de: "I know you don't want to see our tribe anymore, but at least visit us one more time. Many things have changed. We should talk — even if it's just one last time."
0f23c23f-944d-4950-be26-6f804e9f5194: "Well, if you say so... Fine. I'll come. But if anyone tries to send me to the women's hut again, I won't be held responsible for what happens!"

75115d4a-bbab-4f1f-a9dc-34ee0142c9d8: "Oh, Amiri... How many times have I told you that disobeying orders and acting on a whim can lead to nothing good? I am glad to see you alive, though."
e6a670a4-05e3-4d84-9eda-c285fd920157: "No one to blame but yourself. No one else called your people to bring their swords to these lands."
952479d2-1729-43dd-911e-b266435d7d2a: {n}Tristian sighs heavily.{/n} "I... I feel her grief. You should not have wasted time helping me back then, {name}. Then perhaps this tragedy could have been avoided..."
7a2c8887-4544-4019-b7eb-a5f1e62ea647: {n}Amiri looks up and glares unkindly at Tristian for a moment, but she says nothing.{/n}
e8dcdf4e-fca2-4660-abc1-7026662d5d8b: "Appalling irresponsibility! Such a person cannot be trusted with an army."
4860c7ab-e530-4cd9-b7c7-688e8359b223: "You hear that? A valuable lesson for the baron{mf||ess}. If you're a hero for even an hour, whatever you do later, you'll always have companions — people who will find it easier to accuse the whole world of lying rather than admit they were wrong about you."
611c3ab6-1944-442d-b5c3-eb54c908c634: "Actually, that hodag wasn't so tough. — Though it was fat like a beached whale. But compared to giants it was just a pile of crap."
ab45432b-f441-4264-b3fa-705723122519: "I don't think we'll find many giants in these parts. But you know what — trolls are their distant relatives. You could certainly practice killing them."
6b35d739-6c2f-4e82-b803-5d5619db6d2f: "I'd love to see a real giant! But fight one? I think I'll pass!"
29bc563e-1a38-49e9-ac38-ab8d97e47f9f: "By the way, you promised me two weeks ago that you'd tell me everything about your fight with the giants! Now don't think you'll get away with changing the subject like the last time. Go on! Start talking... Amiri? Amiri?! Ugh, damn stubborn barbarians!"
1e41fceb-f8a6-4847-9d4d-deebd5ecd798: We slipped into the river, swimming up to the camp to take cover behind the boats.
c614afc6-46c2-4b30-ab70-b59a089134d2: We began our approach by picking our way through the swamp.
0ce1048e-dbae-44a3-b4b6-25b5dc05820e: We circled around to approach from the woods, seeking some game trail or other path that could lead us through the undergrowth.
8a737399-6f18-47cc-93e8-a1c2baf92e11: On reviewing the situation, our leader elected to return at a later time.
1d5ba632-01f5-42d0-a8f4-6beea6313dee: We threw the caution to the winds and approached the camp.
ec1116fd-94a0-4448-a1fa-66d813eefa1e: There was no time to waste. We burst from hiding with weapons drawn!
4a680aa2-74ac-40ea-bf29-9b232a7ab7e3: We made a rustling near the boats, hoping to lure and subdue a few sentries.
57bc349a-2e18-49ca-88f2-90bd671fe100: That's when our leader set fire to the boats, sowing chaos in the camps before we launched our attack!
ad800270-0cef-4dc2-b8e8-8da20754bf49: We made a rustling near the reeds, hoping to lure and subdue a few sentries.
ed037433-2264-401d-b8d9-5b60ffa116b9: Our travels brought us to the {g|Littletown}Littletown{/g} surroundings in pursuit of the dastardly river pirates who have preyed on innocent merchants and travelers. 4e10a3ef-5ec7-47f0-8921-21341b8bc0c9: The {g|Pitax River}Pitax River{/g} may have looked gentle, but it was fast, deep, and dangerous. The current dragged us downriver, slamming several of us into a submerged tree before we could reach calmer water. What an exhausting swim!

a8eb3911-b20e-4eeb-92f6-491450b767b8: It was exactly the plan you read about in dashing tales, but rather than fall into our trap, the sentries alerted their friends. Before we knew it, we were fighting a far larger group than we had intended!
eeb562d9-eb29-4615-9b73-aaddf59b65ed: It was exactly the plan you read about in dashing tales, and our enemies fell right into our trap! We quietly dispatched the sentries before launching our attack on the remaining pirates!
4d324f9a-b067-4e9b-8364-ebb8bdf3acce: Gravel beaches might be great for mooring boats, but they're terrible for sneaking. All the cargo in {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} can't cover the sound of you tripping over cobbles. The pirates launched a volley of arrows at our hiding place before closing in to attack!

ef2f9d8d-a582-42dd-ba31-b5eb00ecf01b: "What was your role in the camp?"
5879084c-59f4-4c7d-95df-93c38984bf61: [Attack] "Such a sad story... Sadder yet, it doesn't touch me in the least. Maybe your death will stave off my dreadful boredom?"
9f059eb2-815a-44f0-ac2f-159f8ad9e931: "I'll spare your life, but don't expect such leniency next time."
4a459ff7-6695-43c2-af37-07fffea4f4fd: [Attack] "The atrocities you committed are unforgivable. You obeyed a tyrant's will and brought death and ruin upon countless innocents. Prepare to die."
5764ecdd-1411-43c0-b692-4412fe04d87a: "Are you saying Irovetti philandered with you?"
cb9bf36c-fc86-49a2-bef8-28932cf473cf: "I give! I give. Please don't kill me!"
4ab0b28b-e0bc-44b3-aacb-80762fb71592: "I'm not interested in dying for Irovetti. Let the dirty creep get someone from his fancy thieves' guild in here, see how they like this job... or the way he gets handsy!"
fc5df76b-ab33-47cb-8ef3-7f7785115af8: "My name's Ilora Nuski, Chief of the River Razors... or what's left of us, between you and Irovetti. 4359b580-ebfb-4c97-b811-0b3c739bf7d7: "You have a good soul... and you fight like a wolf. I'm glad Irovetti will have more trouble to deal with. Maybe we'll meet again."
99df60f7-408b-4a3a-98a0-73f02d0b0f9e: "The usual — gathered information from scouts, planned out attacks, recruited and trained new members... b6887ddf-5c33-42e4-9b5d-abc4bf68be76: {n}The bandit wipes blood from her lips with the back of her hand.{/n} "I have no grudge against you. Irovetti just didn't give me a choice!"
8ddeea8d-d002-4488-bd4c-074a5dd0ca6c: "To put it mildly! He hounded me like he had a swarm of wasps in his pants. Last time I was in {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, he'd gone crazy! 59156c57-e3f1-40b1-a676-466dfb72c36b: "No, we have our own gang, good as any... Well, had. Irovetti promised the guild exclusive rights to all the orders in {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}... not that his word is worth anything."

e7038f8e-f031-46ff-86ef-ed24251da46f: "Another life saved. Another chance for a new start."
f61cf5e0-a3e6-4993-9ff9-5dba42cc2fbb: "Had no choice! The favored excuse of bandits everywhere when faced with the consequences of their sins. Do not believe her, {name}!"
674d37f2-e6e7-4a42-a79d-5c6bf73c1043: "She fought bravely, and with great skill! Maybe we shouldn't end her. If she attacks us again, then we'll have another good fight! And if not, all the better — we'll have a strong ally."

b09d02ec-ae7b-4978-8a40-8ee738009a1c: "What mysterious deaths are you talking about?"
1d220cb9-3a1d-4b30-a5ad-f91557ed09f8: "I will try to get to the bottom of this."
e55fba50-5061-4502-b5ee-8367bda4df03: "I'll leave the guards to their duty."
62715a58-2889-4f3e-834d-1d2f1023f5dc: "You're not going anywhere. Guards! Place this witch and her kin in chains!"

e6edf005-7ecb-484a-aa67-eea68e52a34e: {n}The woman eyes you solemnly, but without affront.{/n} "My son mysteriously died a week ago. His body was examined; the death appeared to be natural. But it's obvious to any reasonable person that a man in his prime can't just drop dead."
dda8b582-2c52-42ef-95e3-e931ece8b509: "Your subjects have failed to show me mercy or understanding. 653e9fd0-cefc-4903-a318-f4093b98c701: "My son was a lawyer. He promoted various interests and handled the affairs of several merchants. He could hardly practice his profession without making some enemies. However, I'm not sure I could point to anyone in particular."
6642d1e5-0286-4a57-8210-aff92b00fb95: "During a hunt, surrounded by friends. They say they found my poor son in the morning. 2dccc741-ee47-472b-a2d9-3d8e5fb7bd1d: {n}Jaronna purses her lips.{/n} "There's no containing gossip, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. Over the past few weeks, many fine ladies and gentlemen have died under mysterious circumstances."
77fa2b1d-70af-4e54-89a3-6373c5e2bd0b: "You... Filthy tyrant! I should never have sought justice from you! I curse you!"
35feeac4-2b23-41b6-8993-d7271dc5752d: "As you wish. But from now on I will put my life in the hands of more competent law enforcers than yours. Farewell, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}."
ee1d9100-2498-4cbf-add1-1308c46a5189: {n}Jaronna's expression softens.{/n} "I was hoping to see justice done after I spoke with you. Thank you, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. May {g|Abadar}Abadar{/g} be with you!"
2f118e18-c1de-43cd-bd6e-d538159b638b: "The guards declared that all cases were but mishaps. I find it quite suspicious that experienced riders fall from their horses and break their necks, or young beauties die from minor cuts they get on a promenade."
01d191f5-0706-4bd2-b05e-733e3a934806: "So, rations for lunch today? — Great! I've got dried apples!"
148a61d0-cfbb-4f6f-a711-34f6589b2c23: "Why is everyone so gloomy? So we have rations for supper, big deal. Is that really a good reason to be so sad?"
6f70a023-4cf0-44a8-97a8-f4673b9e1b8a: "Without fresh meat it's not a meal. It's just crap!"
865b1e37-3334-405c-88ff-201d74ea1abe: "Oh, times like these I miss the good old days, when a proper chef cooked for me."
ea02dd35-7332-459f-a325-d37aebf6c58b: "Good grief! Even Octavia can see how many rations we've got left. I guess that must mean you could count them on one hand."
dbec63f2-a9eb-4aa0-a096-8e043c196f40: "The light of your heart warms those around you. Traveling with you is a true pleasure!"
3049ce6e-522f-4bdb-85af-31eb27318081: "Ekun, do you really have nothing left in your soul but revenge?"
77ccd32b-c308-4c7a-b854-ad2f1d32e585: "It's enough. I don't want anything else."

c5955211-4d96-4b87-bc8f-866cd0a6a251: "'… on the battlefield, among numerous corpses of their enemies!' I'm sorry, Octavia, but I can't imagine anyone of our team old, sitting by a fire, and surrounded by great-grandchildren!"
385a0625-d8b6-45dd-8861-13d80acfa1cc: "It's Nyrissa's fault all this happened. Hers — not yours!"
59c0fefd-b3bd-4423-987b-5cc3c0853f08: "Regongar did a brave and honorable thing. Respect his choice and do not blame yourself for his death."
b57c23c7-03f7-4932-83be-0bb860d2fdc1: "I don't care what you did. What's important is you're alive and with me."
fce685c4-3edb-45ec-b87b-9198e1f8f56a: "You were forced to make a terrible choice. That's not your fault."
f52130dc-c01e-4497-9afa-846d326c40bb: "Of course not. No one can bargain with death. We all must face it along."
0aa75f11-068f-4233-8b8f-028a538624af: "Please don't cry. I'm here. The evil moment has passed."
bbf99218-9107-45dd-8e77-a8eb835753b7: "True, you are responsible. Regongar certainly didn't deserve to die like that!"
14bd65bb-a940-443e-bbbd-a4bbc163cdef: "I think you're lying, and you only wanted to save your skin."
1bfd7eab-1330-4b0a-a4a3-5adffc4c7567: "I might have been rough. I don't want to lose you."
4fa352c2-c525-4cdc-a03e-515cc33fd7fe: "I don't want to have anything more to do with you. Leave me."
0884a7cf-2ddd-4c1e-bae8-f043d0c8ec39: "Octavia would never let you die. Value her sacrifice and don't blame yourself."
e737dd79-eae9-4f22-ac44-a63d9d7e6496: "Nyrissa will pay a very, very high price for Octavia's death, I promise."

7d7b5c20-204c-4b73-9aa7-6df49497cda3: "I might have overreacted. Let's go. We face a difficult battle with Nyrissa."
2b7167c5-b865-4030-b339-3d9d14450ad5: "I'm sure of what I said. Leave me."

c69661fa-1206-4baf-a292-df81426af64b: "Yes! That's something to be proud of. What else can you boast?"
de3ba1c7-b07d-4f1e-af60-8b98b7863a94: "Old man, you must be out of your mind! I'll swear on red-hot iron if you want — there isn't another fighter like {mf|him|her} in all of {g|Numeria}Numeria{/g}! 51c4d4fe-1959-4bc4-9a93-09b480b2ebc7: "Reg, that can wait. I'd like to start with a chat, try to find out what exactly they have planned. They wouldn't just send one agent in. And wherever the cronies are hidden..."

c297d640-e58b-45ed-9e2c-35dfed0bc3cd: [To guards] "Didn't you hear me? Take her away!"

46d105d9-2fad-45e5-a911-8fd2555b6b6b: {g|Arcane10_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "I wish to improve the education and training of our priests."
722cac73-4dce-473d-a4c3-2b4666858487: {g|Arcane10_3}[Choice effects]{/g} "I command the construction of a great workshop, so we may begin manufacturing magical equipment for our army."
2df050c2-1a8a-4a6c-a761-cad7dd1d43bf: "It's been a while since I came to you like this, {name}! You must be wondering if I'm here to talk about troubles again, eh? Well, believe it or not, this time I just wanted to tell you about all the successes we've been enjoying recently."
31b98927-fca5-4d83-a864-0a26f072da95: "Greetings, Your Highness. I would like to advise you on the current state of magic affairs in the kingdom. But you can rest easy — it's only good news."
98a5f30b-4a6e-4f7d-ad86-597d2b256c83: {n}"Maegar" looks somber and triumphant.{/n} "I greet you, Your Highness. And I've something to tell you."
234e6465-3aee-4905-bb7a-7469b426ef73: "The common folk have grown to trust our magic users – in great part, I think, thanks to the ban on the... errrm, exotic magical ingredients."
5779ba95-8d91-4406-a703-9af3b7582808: "Despite my expectations, maintaining the ban on exotic magical ingredients proved highly beneficial. Your subjects have developed more trust towards magic users, and are buying more goods and services from them."
422b7b6e-ba25-43a4-888f-85f142287e35: "Somehow, maintaining the ban on exotic magical ingredients did not hamper the rapid growth of magical potential in these lands. Perhaps not least because it quieted the ever watchful and ever grumbling peasants..."
e758c380-f600-4bb9-a2f6-fd531f834860: "Wonderful! I can't wait to see what we gain in return!"
b16e4fee-190a-48eb-b0f3-a5ab70cd9224: "That wouldn't be my personal choice... but it will be quite useful."
723cee40-41ae-49cb-80cb-2b45a9d98d66: "It shall be as you say, Your Highness."
830c7df0-0260-46e4-abde-ac32e2fe03c2: "It seems appraiser was right after all. By permitting the unfettered trade of all magic ingredients, we've attracted even more commerce to our lands — and more rare specialists."
75eeb096-f811-4157-8f28-b50c9bca07f7: "We've come a long way over the years. Our kingdom now employs magic of the highest order, and does so confidently and responsibly. 3e7c082d-d28a-46e3-bdfc-de179e341973: "We've come a long way over the years. Our kingdom has become an arcane power unto itself. Knowing that they can't find better conditions anywhere else, all manner of inventors, researchers and experimenters have flocked to us."
538bc68f-4cd7-4075-b84a-45bef470a28e: "Despite my fears, the magic community took the new regulations we introduced quite well. 9fb554b3-a064-4a7a-842f-6d486ea9949b: "We refused to place new restrictions on the use of magic — and, as expected, the people made peace with the decision. Recently, our mages have even started enjoying a bit more understanding and tolerance..."
2155f7ec-7eaa-4358-b7b6-abe159336ab5: "And the time has now come to enjoy the fruits of our labor! There are three projects I can suggest. 3c53f710-6245-4126-ae04-f8aefb2a3ea1: "Lifting the ban on exotic magical ingredients proved highly beneficial to commerce, and the development of the magical arts in these lands."
8fc19d51-6724-4fd1-a46f-312cbb3f0a0d: "The magic community understood the need for the new regulations which restricted the use of magic in densely populated areas. There's every reason to believe that the reforms were a resounding success."
0d87bc0c-dea3-4280-bd5f-77517efc4ef2: "The masses still look upon mages with distrust. However, it's worth tolerating a little social tension, considering the rapid development of the magical arts in our lands."
3dc64348-25e8-4e9a-b3ec-1b4e6210159e: "All in all, we've become one of the leading arcane powers in the River Kingdoms. 96d35729-97d8-4f78-9ba3-95b036c76d7a: "All things considered, we've become one of the leading arcane powers in the River Kingdoms. 7be73cef-d24d-4b67-a41e-9c8103f1ec84: "We are now in a position to pursue something on a grander scale. I suggest to you three projects. a35ac52a-67d6-43eb-8750-c7f3f3b31b11: "It was wise to lift the ban on exotic magical ingredients. This greatly benefitted our mages and sorcerers. Now they can spend less time procuring material components, and more time in their studies... and they've still so much to learn."
68d64a7b-090c-4522-bfa1-1e285e1f05af: "Strangely, restricting the use of magic in the towns and villages only strengthened our hand. Once their self-importance was placated, they grew quiet — and stopped meddling our affairs."

979c03b4-8dc0-4d4c-831e-21d62a7b7955: "We must act quickly. We have many druids living in the local woods, but they stay neutral in any political disagreement. ebf161a7-a344-4f96-b59f-b54339ec8b03: {n}Even groveling, the terrifying creature towers over you. Its dark claws glisten like metal, but the pose doesn't seem threatening. 5bd1e99e-2471-4df2-a851-8d3b7ca9d4b5: "You are back, little guest! So? Did you meet the Wriggling Man?"
f1c24326-a8c6-4242-bf7b-23231d5e6406: "Forgive an old crone her suspicious nature. My life isn't easy, it isn't... By the way, in case you don't know yet, they call me the {d|Knurly}Knurly Witch{/d}."
6daf7401-e6c6-4122-ac6f-23b25d9cbec9: {n}The witch shakes her huge head.{/n} "A lonely old hag. afffc090-c389-43e0-bc3b-7eaae406381a: "Ah, little guest, you want the old Witch to betray her queen? You have no idea what threats she uses to make me serve her. It has been many ages, and I have never dared to raise my head..."
85004141-c78f-4fc6-8a71-33f64682a40e: "I know you {d|c61 Trent Fool}fooled{/d} my servants to take the fragment of the First Crown. Foolish timber! But then again, if I wanted smart servants, I wouldn't have chosen walking logs..."
2e959000-9dcf-4cc3-b72f-b6ce4c341c8e: {n}The witch brightens and leans forward, but then slouches again and shrugs.{/n} "The crown was valuable to me... as a sign of Nyrissa's appreciation. 8b818415-bf89-4dec-87bf-5b49945763d1: "Ah, if you lived as long as I have in {g|First World}the First World{/g}... 927885b8-609c-4286-ac11-1bf2ebeb6610: "Wonderful, wonderful! The wriggling offal is hiding somewhere on the top floor. Come back to me when you've kill him. The old witch will help you any way she can... Do you wish to ask me something else?"
d6542af8-c211-419e-a3f6-1983e628ebd6: {n}The witch flashes a cunning smile.{/n} "Did I tell you we were kind to others? No, no. We lived by our laws, in peace and harmony with each other. And strangers just had to learn to keep away from our forest!"
523cf26d-a144-4823-970f-65b9788c8ab7: "Don't believe that swarming pile of corpse eaters! He eats and drinks from Nyrissa's hand. He'll promise you anything and then deceive you. Listen to the old woman — kill him without regret, then simply take the key."
f16a816e-80d8-4571-8988-10a989c70541: "Ask away, I like talking to guests..."
a4f73245-8c74-4da0-9f09-f6a3ac75242d: "Ahhh, silly creature! You'll make a nice dinner!"
e2b3bc36-f33c-4850-8eb5-f2ab35c7faba: "I store the key to Nyrissa's Shrine in my pantry. Which, in its turn, is locked with another key. 5e0a7a8d-447f-4e2c-ba48-fd4e869087ec: "I have decided, little guest. I will give you the key if you wish. Listen to the hag — trick this wriggling offal, or better yet kill him! And then... either you beat Nyrissa, or she beats you — I'll be better off without him anyway."
81470705-7d6e-44ab-ae43-09475cf85391: "You saw for yourself! He envies me. Harms me. Wants to drive me out, make me lose Nyrissa's favor. What else would you expect from a walking pile of corpse worms?"
8eb13b5f-443e-4a1f-b3eb-0aedab82c044: "Ahhh, little guest, you handled my trap? I was hoping to get a dead body. What a pity! Nyrissa will be disappointed. Or perhaps she won't... if I bring her your head."
514b7aae-e469-4c03-86e0-8e8ce3f22b63: "I will tell you. There is a special place on the top floor — Nyrissa's Shrine. It's the heart of the House. 11a8752c-9941-4b70-a7e9-b384a378c569: "Ask away. Old rot like me enjoys talking to someone young and curious..."
48ca069c-8926-456a-8a80-50822ab958ac: "Come again, little guest! The hag enjoyed your visit..."
a1a5c8c8-5ba5-4a09-814b-b3ea1b3f60e9: "Think well — and if you decide, come to me with the Wriggling Man's key. I'll know he's dead. And the old hag will give everything to the one who killed the wriggling rot."

9b7d38fa-0d1e-42d1-ad3d-18349d60ab92: "Then ask. The old hag has no secrets from you."
30acca7f-7230-4f45-9dfd-a52c686cab58: {n}The witch is approaching.{/n} "You think I'm lying to you, little guest? But you can't know for sure? Will you let your doubts affect your decisions?"
e15c4119-bffb-4d13-8c69-4cb9a5ce7dc6: "I obey the one who is stronger. If I were five ages younger, I could try to rebel, but it's too late for me now... Poor old witch makes potions as she's told, looks after the House, takes jokes from the pile of worms, and is good for nothing else."
747f0f81-e865-4401-8af1-40281e208c95: "Ahhh, I shouldn't have wasted time on this idle talk! If you don't want to die quietly, then you'll die a noisy and painful death!"
bd6bbea0-40e2-413c-8b04-8e16e69ff2b7: "Ah, my lady hasn't shared prisoners with me for a long time. I would know if they were in my dungeon, and they are not. Look higher, farther. The House at the edge of time is larger than you know — and full of secret nooks and riddles."
8b0ac842-5f06-41dd-9ce5-79cba4c82335: "Of course, of course I lied! Did you believe my sad tales? Yes, once Nyrissa compelled me to serve her, but I enjoyed doing it. d9321312-7be7-4d1a-a4cf-9f8588946c41: {n}The Witch's eyes wander, and you watch as spite inwardly struggles with caution and selfishness. 292a64c5-d373-4dd2-bf23-6f8c16937f3f: "Ha ha ha ha. Many have threatened the Knurly Witch. Few have lived long after!"
a59bd878-a0e1-421c-89c0-b6758091a283: "I won't dare challenge the fey queen. If you need my service — take the potions I made for her. And my key to the Shrine. I hope I do not see you again!"
c304b8bb-e6da-4b98-965d-a188591bb213: "Spineless creatures avoiding quarrels. I have only contempt for those who try to make 'peace' and 'good' everywhere!"
b8a9a29f-3081-4a60-8168-6a72d35fcad1: "Ahhh, ugly creature. Believe me, he appears as disgusting to a creature like me as he does to creatures like you! 053717aa-63cd-48d0-b043-3abce8e3a955: "It's worse than disgusting. The death of such a creature must surely please {g|Pharasma}Pharasma{/g}."
657c4251-aaac-4db6-8315-e4cdab55c483: "I thought I knew what it meant to desperately run from death. This is dis-gus-ting."
b4d9e10d-c8c8-4088-a5bd-09d7971380df: "Back home we'd say, 'the thicker the armor, the longer it takes to ready the corpse for the pyre.' That's definitely true about you, Valerie!"
f7bd0bbf-e907-4d90-9c7e-c98d61863708: "But you'd be quick. We'd just sew your arms and legs back, so you're more-or-less human shaped."
b7bf5542-2017-490a-beeb-ab3d586cecfa: "How does it feel to be chieftain?"
006cac3b-39c2-4f0c-af11-fb7cf2b3613f: "Warmest greetings! You're always a welcome {d|c41 Chief Gwart}guest{/d} of the tribe."
cc420ba7-06eb-4646-a07d-55a8755b2512: "It isn't easy, I must confess. Many tribesmen claim I'm too young to lead. Every day, I have to prove to the tribe that I'm worthy of this position. But {g|Gorum}Gorum{/g} doesn't abandon me. Mark my words — soon, their doubts will disappear!"
9d333751-3ad9-4055-a4f1-5c3676097c8d: "Armag dealt us a heavy blow. We're trying to recover, restore our strength... But truth be told, it will take a long time for us to return to what we once were."
29ab8b5b-f3d6-4f1e-b6f1-436f672167c1: "I would like to personally express my gratitude for all your help."
54d9744f-5aaa-4eee-ab27-b155846b786f: "I stumbled into a most peculiar old man on my way here…"
8b01238f-f5e8-4574-888e-3a2ab46d29f6: "I just couldn't help not paying a visit, especially after your invitation."
eba5b586-056b-4d0d-8d43-35d1fd9892ea: "I see life in Varnhold is in full swing."
4392ba2e-0518-4df4-8e9f-ba95c299fd9c: "You have my respects, Maegar, but I have to leave."
4b56461a-0df2-45fa-b899-a99c214f6836: "I'm glad we see eye to eye on the issue."
de5faa48-9ac4-4239-b940-403ae805b34b: "Helping out competitors is a fool's errand."
fb66e0f3-347e-4f22-b52c-e0f2d51d41cd: [Nod at the merchant] "Taking the reins of government into your own hands?"
a5824ebf-5015-4640-8020-fa67d9d4a11d: "Let me ask you directly — who else are you allied with?"
ba7a2738-5530-445b-bc80-0de43bb75f4a: "I've just remembered a treasure hunter who was on his way to Tors of the Levenies. Have you heard of Willas Gunderson?"
67fcd2e4-3d6a-4dec-bd34-be4b40ae615e: {n}Before you is a tall, robust man. 05d87c8e-4c71-447c-84a4-00f5f64c8c84: "Whom do I see! {name}, my friend! Welcome to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}! I am Maegar Varn, I run the town here. I hope you had no trouble on the roads?"

e6986ca8-c9d6-4654-ba66-5508be047648: "Look at this from another perspective, my friend — this is a chance to survey your eastern borders and make sure you've got no one but allies here. It's better to see for yourself than to rely on my words alone, am I right?"
ad1446d8-f10e-4c1d-98ed-a62644e28a27: "Much remains to be done. What you see now is just the beginning. {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} has a shining future, just you wait! By next year we'll begin building a tract to your capital, and establish river trade with {g|Restov}Restov{/g}."
b1706ab7-8ee9-4467-861f-e25bc1850ad4: "Right now, {g|Dunsward}Dunsward{/g} is not particularly welcoming, but I aim to change that. As soon as we get a foothold here, we'll begin clearing the land of creatures, monsters and spriggans alike. The people must feel safe."
3a3ed434-6c90-4c60-b38e-144d78b758f2: "We've got enough on our hands at the moment! Although, in the future — who knows, who knows…"

dc63b689-0aa4-44d2-ab41-51597f1c2a85: "Sometimes the locals bring me curious objects — they unearth them while plowing or stumble upon them while patrolling the wilderness. If the object looks interesting, I send them to Cephal — let him separate the wheat from the chaff."
206560ae-fc39-49ea-bdec-c16707517ccf: "Is that so, baron{mf||ess}…? Well then, I'll note your opinion for the future."
37f90b78-33c8-403e-93e7-5ef6ad58f081: "Treat your neighbor as you wish to be treated yourself — am I right?"
66b2a6d2-6e49-423c-a174-e3fa27975b5a: "That's why we get along so well, my friend!"
9a651853-605b-44f4-8d75-87c246fabe4d: {n}Maegar grins.{/n} "Trying to, at least. I have to admit, conquering these lands was far easier than keeping the greedy merchants in check!"

aedeefce-933c-4b81-82a8-7c9c6c5fd9d0: "Ha, you bet! An energetic fellow, although a bit meddlesome. Luckily, he spends most of his time prowling about in search of imaginary treasure, and that keeps him occupied."
49e399a2-52d7-403b-9adb-1c37ad3c0fd4: "You sure about that? Watch yourself, because I'll be watching you!"
074995ad-8833-40d3-b5a3-f09a77914fba: {n}{d|Varn}Varn{/d} jokingly lifts his hands into the air.{/n} "Peace, peace!"
49e42582-2c55-4e98-a5cb-709581a78516: "Oh! What a fair lady has accompanied you! It's a pleasure to meet you. Such beauty is a rarity, especially in these harsh lands." {n}{d|Varn}Varn{/d} attempts to kiss Valerie's hand.{/n}

88a1877f-a67d-4cc2-bb6c-3b8e4e45c37f: "I don't want to use my goddess' name in vain, Nok-Nok. Judging by what I know about Lamashtu, you shouldn't as well."
c221a17e-4a65-4284-8d8e-036d6066f323: "The statue was ancient, and easy to break. Don't try to see hidden signs where there aren't any."
810c081d-84c3-4035-acba-63f17859eef4: [Leave] "Stop whining. Let's go, we still have a lot to do."

da11ab59-4cfe-43fb-a91f-9ddae2874fb0: {n}Harrim opens his mouth to object, but apparently can't find any good arguments. Finally, he gives up on you.{/n} "You're so blind, {name}," {n}he says, just to fill the silence, and turns away.{/n}

1f0afa6f-beea-4cd9-b779-1e326aaaf2ee: {n}You throw a glance towards Ekun, expecting him to stand up for {g|Torag}Torag{/g}, but the ranger just shrugs instead.{/n} "No sense in over-persuading," {n}he says, looking at Harrim.{/n}
540cf770-134c-4415-818a-46e9fa2391f7: "You're weak, {g|Torag}Torag{/g}. Weak and pathetic. How could you, the God of all dwarves, the Great Creator, be knocked down by some meager troll?"

090c90ea-fb73-4c58-a785-09a456e4d7ee: "No, {name}, no... You do not know of what you speak! I fear for your soul. What if your faithless words result in you spending eternity wandering the {g|Boneyard}Boneyard{/g}?"

8145ecec-ffd2-406f-a903-e349093129fa: "Here is the real question — is he ready to die? For that's what awaits him at my hands."

e50b0591-4450-4b46-92fb-3cf5d40bfeb7: "The forest is big. I'm sure you can find other trees to fell."

b84125a7-59f2-4ab2-a16b-9b04739c3648: {n}A group of hardy people with axes, most likely lumberjacks, are menacing a fragile nixie. Two lumberjacks stand before her, relaxed and disconnected. e83a8e0a-8231-468b-9869-cf4a625671ed: {n}Noticing you, the lead lumberjack grins and waves.{/n} "You, there! You seem a capable sort! Interested in some coin? Name's Corax, and we're loggers here in this forest. We could use your help in freeing our people from this gorgon's claws!"
70473841-7301-4d23-b1a8-c3b8c1424c24: "We were minding our own business, cutting trees and splitting logs, when this hag shows up out of nowhere, screeches at us, then jinxes two of ours and threatens to drown them. 3b673af6-649d-491f-a92a-296b17e18787: "Stupid jumbo! You're the ones who breed like rabbits, spreading into more and more space — we've lived here since forever! 8196ca88-3939-4a17-b8e8-5803c6955ce2: "You asked for it! Hey, you two! These jumbos want to hurt me! You wouldn't let something like that happen, would you?"
df331967-383b-49c6-b5d7-7d98e7d57139: {n}You tell the lumberjacks about a nearby grove where fine trees grow and no fey have taken up residence.{/n}
dfb079ab-3328-465b-836c-7a2b8103ce57: "Sure, there might be other spots with trees as fine as these, but how would we find them? And what if there's another fey there, too?"

5c1be8b3-9029-46c0-b4ac-c8f0ee59ebbb: "So what, then? Do we just hang ourselves and be done with it? There's all manner of beasts in the forests — we can't roll over for all of them! Instead of giving up, we should just keep on fighting till we wipe out every last one!"
23f70948-888b-4f8c-93f1-760f1d203ac3: "Oh, sure! And who's going to bring back my trees, then? They come in here, smash everything in sight, and then just leave? No deal! Fix what you broke, then maybe I'll let them go!"
dacb3351-d783-472d-becc-ff2bf8e269c9: "If you push me, I'll just retreat into the lake with these two! I can breathe underwater — you think they can, too? We could find out!"
774a717e-fc81-46e7-a9fd-d3f747b3bd27: "You humans are always like this! Destroy, destroy, destroy, and then when it's time to clean up your mess, poof! Gone. Fine, then, since you're clearly clueless, I'll tell you what to do."
4eb46f75-9e5b-4454-a55d-d911def373f8: "You think we just have piles of gold lying around to go throwing away at a magic shop? We can barely feed our families!"
3095b3c1-10a4-477f-8fa0-79b818337edc: {n}The lumberjack gives you a long, hard look.{/n} "If you say so... Your Grace. The sovereign's word is law."
4cf428c6-7f52-41c5-b6f8-add2b891864a: "What sort of ruler protects monsters over their own subjects?"
64816331-064b-4917-a6f9-552cbed4c446: "You wish! Soon as I let them go, the whole lot of them will attack! If these goons want to go home to their stupid families, they're going to have to promise to steer clear of my grove first!"
f48dbad5-2954-4fc2-bc1d-d2d06efacdb6: "All right, all right. It's not like we were dead set on this grove in the first place. If she gives us back our people, we'll leave the place in peace. On my word!"
9337ef52-8f83-4059-accc-8d8029707bfd: "There are these magic thingies that look like little feathers. The feather tokens. Throw one on the ground, anywhere, and a tree springs up. 7614ec14-5f1d-4838-842c-e50556a17c3c: {n}Melianse makes a scary face as she stretches her webbed hands out toward Corax, wiggling her fingers.{/n} "OoooOOOooo!"

f8565588-fe10-44f6-9a51-f1ef319b5bfa: {n}The situation is heating up. A battle is about to erupt.{/n}
ccd68ab3-77fd-462e-92fd-261b7d6ea732: {n}The charmed loggers look at the nixie with adoration.{/n}

63655fe4-11c8-47d9-b677-134a8eb42b64: "We should help her! No, them! Uh, I don't know. Why can't people and fey live in peace?"

a5a015a5-bab4-4e05-ad8e-2983c5a1b821: "Let's just slaughter them all and be done with it!"

30b3082d-4d95-4cf4-953e-a9beced84b42: "My friends! We had a glorious feast after the coronation, but I'd still like to propose another toast to our friend! To you, {name}! May {kingdomname} stand for a thousand years!"
d286bd16-7eb6-4fc4-b39c-16c16a1c5e77: "A whole crusade must be chasing you! No one likes the undead, especially when they're as insolent as you!"
b3f6dda1-ee5a-4f6e-bd1c-d20725cda886: "And half the Technic League is hunting you down. – But so what? I might not like you, but anyone foolish enough to pursue our party will die the instant our paths cross."

c88e2906-99da-4683-830d-2207377e619a: "Nazrielle has one day to leave my domain."
9b1eed58-fbab-4111-a815-95f3cecb617d: "I need a dagger that's invisible and deadly."
be688032-5358-4c0d-99ba-21389f405865: "I could certainly use some flexible and sturdy chainmail."
e3782bd8-f0be-41aa-9b69-32716a87f2d6: "Is there anything Nazrielle can do to make me swifter on the battlefield?"
3fdcd20f-34ec-47e8-a3b9-7075a22e08aa: "I'd like a sample of her elven metalwork."

71978651-454c-4666-b03d-58243e02245b: {n}Sartayne shrugs.{/n} "I don't know. The Mistress said I couldn't touch it. But I heard her ask Ditael to take it to you."
012f210f-8d20-4de9-b34d-a55f0a870c64: {n}The apprentice bows low and speaks as if reading a note.{/n} "On behalf of Mistress {d|Nazriel}Nazrielle{/d}, I would like to wish you eternal health and express our gratitude for your kind protection."
05a72b22-9d68-4313-992d-2fb3845577e3: "My Mistress wanted me to present you with this gift. She hopes that you would be satisfied with it."
2c790c77-ce33-436d-a83c-1a7229fd8884: {n}The elf bows low and vanishes silently.{/n}
6852341f-a484-4e2e-a6c8-d33a3c6dd477: "Oh... Oh no... This will make the Mistress very, very angry..." {n}The elf shrinks and backs away in fear.{/n}
52851a74-8f2e-4839-a160-f3851813acac: "I will give your order to the Mistress exactly as I hear it."
f336c3e8-f4fe-41b4-9643-9c1662ca1411: "Mistress Nazrielle will hear your command, word for word."
1cb064cf-9d44-43c9-bd4f-50af290c42a5: "You're quite a rarity. A dwarf rejecting Torag, a dwarf unable to forge a nail... I wouldn't be surprised to hear you don't enjoy ale!"
c83270dd-7f47-4a71-b330-7847b46464d3: "I... No, I sometimes do bend my elbow. But much less now than in my bad days, after I ran away from my home, knowing no purpose, or where I should go. If I had a stronger will, perhaps I would forgo drinking completely."
0ea55c74-f0b3-4ee6-a720-918b2e4a386f: "No need to save Oleg's post anymore! Goblins left."
9a8bbf67-4e1e-48d5-ab60-d919bf20fb68: "When you do nothing, and heroics happen themselves — is one still a Hero?" {n}Nok-Nok scratches his head, lost in thought.{/n}
9e52095c-ef4f-424a-b8b2-6c8a2eda51ce: "Very well. We'll go back and collapse this passage."
0f826592-e7c2-44db-b305-79dc21fbf0f1: "As you say, Tristian. Let's go back and collapse the passage."
55ca7d64-2cb3-44fb-a143-5f8dbcc5f276: "I will leave when I decide it's time to leave."

5144da90-0673-43c5-ac62-ab34534df3b8: "I want to examine this part of sepulcher, Tristian. There's nothing wrong with that."
10909003-1065-4ddd-a1ff-b3edee97d836: "If there's power to be had here, I shall make it serve me."

b4e0e9a7-2fd4-4c94-9f62-7cddc0054afd: "This chamber... it..." {n}Tristian looks at you, but doesn't seem to see you — his eyes, normally calm, are troubled.{/n} "It is the heart of the evil that fills this whole tomb. Everything here bears traces of the ones Vordakai worshipped."
8a39b696-9c54-483e-9ad4-ff257dd2fd42: "I beg you, let us leave this place. I don't want you to suffer Vordakai's fate — you or anyone else. The powers of darkness are strong here. They can corrupt even the strongest of hearts."
24871d17-a048-4d8a-9e5a-c01bc8ca5245: {n}Tristian steps towards you.{/n} "I rarely insist, {name}, but you must turn back!" {n}He catches himself, and his voice drops.{/n} "I beg you… please. Turn back."

f7f2a311-41fc-47c8-a8f8-a5f72d04d36c: "You know, Jubilost, I think you would make a great priest and preacher. Your sense of purpose, and your eloquence..."
d273edf7-ecd6-45aa-8633-941cd9894068: "A priest? Me? Pff! I'd die of boredom in a week, if I had to repeat the same cheerless sermons day after day! Or I'd add some new ideas, and in no time I'd be expelled from the priesthood for heresy!"
f3e6162c-5262-4a77-b4b2-d3aed7670182: "When I imagined adventures and heroes, this is not what I expected. Of course there were exciting battles... But not terrible disease... And gods, so much blood..."
38124afa-b0dc-4eea-b067-2982a5e4aed5: "Life is cruel. Kill or be killed. There is usually no time for pity."
2f3bbf52-9f23-4f4c-9e74-f3130463895a: "'Tis the sad lot of the short-lived. To tremble over half a dozen years, like a miser with a scant handful of coins."
62c53b81-0d17-44dc-aee6-ccca290fe6fc: "Trebricent, enough with your pretentious bravado. You know what will happen if you don't surrender peaceably. You have a chance to prevent bloodshed, if you'll just lay down your weapons."
674cab26-30c6-4da2-b56e-4590d247a92d: "A familiar face! Ivar, it's been a long time! How are you?"
2e2dc061-0de7-4502-a07b-109b29de1662: "You seem to be having a nice time. I'll just go — I wouldn't want to bother you."
3b371d2d-68b8-47d2-b185-f393efafe330: "Free singers and poets of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}! 79bc6a17-6d07-410f-9a67-4b40da283015: [Attack] "You should've thought twice before dragging my name through the mud... None of you leaves here alive."
ba1db34f-767f-430b-8319-7eed88fb8439: "Bards of the academy, whether you're here because you believe me a worthless {mf|king|queen} or for the money and laurels promised by Irovetti, I say you should judge me by my deeds rather than speculative rumors. {n}Finally, after emptying his glass, the half-elf notices you.{/n} "Good gods! Look, my brothers and sisters! Look who it is! Is that not {name} {mf|him|her}self? {n}Some of the dinner guests roar with laughter, while others look at you with interest, maybe even hope. Everyone stops talking and watches you.{/n}
47df5921-bea2-4625-8856-e3cbf4a2b2c4: "Ha ha ha, really? Soon as {mf||s}he noticed our merry company, the cowardly impostor decides to run away? Stow your glasses and lutes, my friends — this dastard needs to be taught a lesson!"
82a7d719-8471-4724-b0b8-60c9f76a4bd9: "{d|c22 Ivar Nice}Better{/d}, now that you're here! It's nice to see an honest face — I didn't realize just how tired I'd grown of Irovetti and his hangers-on. 3aff6c30-82d8-4f8a-b688-7591ee1694da: "Did you hear that, friends?! a11985fe-20f2-42a8-8657-d0421c7773f2: "By the gods, what am I hearing? Would you sell your own father for a fistful of pork and gravy? Your thankless heart is darker than night. cf07f3ef-19c6-4992-866c-92085410e21d: {n}The audience is confused — some exchange wary looks, while others look down, embarrassed. Yet others begin to sulk. No one dares say a word.{/n}
2cdd2a4d-0190-496a-b538-f31f4145f438: "Can't complain, {name}... I didn't {d|c22 Ivar Rude}expect{/d} to see you here. I hope no trouble comes to your kingdom."
3b870ecd-b535-4379-84aa-bf4a28f67aee: "Ha! They put a mirror before a crowned donkey, and in a fit of rage, {mf||s}he looks to break it! But you won't silence us — to arms, my friends! b984f68b-faa4-4007-933a-e5328380f710: {n}The soft murmur that began running through the hall during your speech swells into a roar.{/n} "I won't write to dictation any longer! Down with Irovetti — long live {name}!"
c3eba7f9-ebcc-4a45-a016-db407aa877a1: "Oh, Trebricent, I so want to stay and see how {name} and company pluck those peacock feathers of yours. But alas, I've other things to attend to. Say hello to your family for me!"

14df343c-ad2a-480d-8bc8-9175a23e3586: {n}Valerie is pale, and her silence could melt iron. The squeal of metal on metal indicates that she must be gripping her weapon, but she isn't rushing to draw it.{/n}

71deec55-ba7c-4343-bbc7-4a9ae0eb068d: {n}Nok-Nok, who started falling asleep and even snoring while listening to the speeches, shudders at the sound of laughter and seizes his blade.{/n} "Talk-talk-talk over? Stab time now?"

3133b9e1-6b66-4138-9619-b74b1d616357: "The legends of my people are passed from generation to generation. If someone doesn't get into a legend – then he's a weakling and there's nothing to talk about."

e9756f0b-a672-48c2-b268-0b11c5dd46c2: [Leave] "I don't have time for your questions."
5604ab3f-0432-4498-9e47-6457c94b8366: {n}The golem's head is polished so well that you see your reflection in place of its face. It asks in a lifeless mechanical voice, {/n} "What is my name?"

e3f7e946-cd70-4a5c-8814-962f7cc1952e: "Who might you recommend I meet here?"
d77a0d61-b72f-405e-87ce-80c88a5c0bcb: "I've heard few curious words — 'Bloodbrush extract'... and that you're no ordinary salesman, and your wares are far from mundane."

8471ed8e-33b5-4643-bf8a-bb794ba7ad27: "How about you stay away from that junk, all right? It kills pretty fast, and I need you alive."

7e3debfd-479a-42ba-9a3e-18949c1a14c5: "Reg, leave the poor guy alone! Let's go have some wine instead!"
a8f109c8-2e46-46e8-a13f-70cf097c78bc: {n}The gnome's yellow, bloodshot eyes scan the faces in the room nervously. Noticing you, he grabs for his sealed sheath.{/n} "What?! Who are you? fb9cb85a-610f-4aef-ba52-34bf3eb2218f: {n}The gnome looks at you, suspicion in his little yellow eyes.{/n} "You again?! I mean, what can I do for you, Your Highness?"

39afa98b-f5e4-43d1-a919-637fdc5e9ad7: "No one! Everyone! How should I know?! I'm just a simple salesman. Leave me be!"

3b66a5af-f1df-45ce-98fd-a1c4f0f83781: "You got any of that stuff on you? Just a little bit?" {n}Regongar whispers suggestively, winking to the gnome.{/n}

ce4f2372-dbaa-4132-b7c3-061fba06d2f0: "Tell me about this conflict between Sevenarches and Kyonin."

0c93c447-af8c-41ce-b934-566cea428ac0: "The elves' ancestors even built the seven arches which give the city its name. Then elves abandoned their shrines, or to put it more precisely – they fled. The druids then came to this place to make it their own. Now the Oakstewards rule there."
a538c36d-9e7e-4bad-9d5a-6f54fa30571b: "The elves claim they built seven arches for which the city is named, though the evidence of this is questionable. Anyway, the elves fled these lands, and druids of the bolder tribes claimed this land for themselves, any built a flourishing settlement."
6a02b01f-e743-4024-b748-1ce98dafeee0: "Hm... At least that way we won't be hurting anyone. But we aren't helping either..."
084648ec-943d-4089-b25e-6b61fcc8c6ca: "Very good. We won't help anyone, as we have no proof of anyone's guilt or innocence."
e4b2d833-a3d6-4713-a7b1-57b1d7140e66: "Well, we won't make any enemies this way. But we won't get useful allies either... though we might have!"
68272294-c5b9-409b-b084-fdef08a13312: "They asked us to help capture him, or at least not to hinder their search. I recommend you refuse to allow the guards onto our lands, but don't help the runaway elf either."
844a9ba5-ad5d-41c6-b7c2-3bc881e9cdb6: "The Voice of the Wind is very knowledgeable. The winds whisper many secrets to him. It is wise to befriend such useful persons. If we must give them the elf to win their favor, then I'd consider it a bargain no matter who he is or what he's done."
e297899d-a9f5-41a3-9a57-529fe0e25f84: "The elves of {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g} keep trying to return Sevenarches, though they abandoned the place many centuries ago. b2f7d54a-12a4-4bfe-a00c-c58a6ae807ca: "Now the elves of {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g} are demanding the return of Sevenarches – as the land is supposedly sacred to them! 90ee623c-ad45-4d24-966a-52f03569f891: "My companion has taken a liking to your charm. Would you sell it for, say, 50 gold coins?"
70e7953c-e4fb-4e1e-8849-1784a5c7f756: "Best wares on the river! Don't waste time asking where they're from — get these deals while they last!"
d2df9195-9b28-4607-8fec-be70d480fac2: {n}You notice Octavia's fingers reach for a sparkling charm on the vendor's belt.{/n}
140bdfa7-23ee-483e-ae9e-85f30e56cb79: {n}Octavia pouts, but she moves her hand away from the vendor's property.{/n}
7ada68aa-d24f-45e9-8b1b-42cebb27c355: {n}The vendor gladly takes the gold.{/n} "Of course, of course! As you wish. Here, please... Ah, that will suit you nicely!" {n}The vendor smiles as he gives Octavia the trinket.{/n}

5bb357fb-f42d-4d83-9bde-4e7e9db2c6c8: {n}While you pretend to check the prices of various goods, the charm quietly moves from the vendor's belt to Octavia's pocket. Octavia blows you a kiss.{/n}

339bd12c-3152-4124-a8ae-0777addff40f: "How did you get so good at reading tracks? It's like the ground talks to you! What do you look for? Is it some kind of magic?"

297c6e07-9992-4ce6-9692-3f6ac0798117: {n}Octavia greets you with an anxious, but cordial and determined look.{/n} "I can't believe this is happening to us! I didn't think I would be among the heroes from a legend, but here we are. I only hope this legend has a good ending!"

19e2b498-f484-4b9b-adc1-05d182b0d743: "Like never before. If I need to defeat a deity to save you from a curse, then I'll do it."
5a2bec73-aa7d-45e8-88ff-89b98d503c72: {n}Octavia smiles, and can't help but laugh softly.{/n} "I wanted to be firm and pretend I'm not moved at all — but of course it's not true! I'm also very happy I met you — and that you don't mind my company!"

ac1dce00-d440-490d-b8df-a488f7b89887: {n}The old man stares past you with unseeing eyes. He seems to be consumed in his thoughts. He mutters a soft melody, swaying back and forth slightly to its rhythm.{/n}
c633f8a1-8cf2-4e2a-923c-a95d77c3d050: {n}The Storyteller twitches as you approach.{/n} "Ah, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Highness}. My stories are calling for you. Have you come to answer their call?"
a8c136fd-a7bd-4f93-860f-5d6a0d7de4cb: {n}The man shudders briefly and stops singing. His mouth opens and closes a few times, bringing to mind a fish brought ashore.{/n} "Ah, who is there? Is that you, Your Grace?"
19e3555e-61b9-4e8d-b4a7-1786f1a16dbe: "I am an elf from {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}. My name... is not important. I am the Storyteller, collector of stories. I collect unknown legends of ancient times." {n}The man smiles, but it doesn't seem to be directed toward you.{/n}
900550c0-17d7-4cd8-ba1f-47b195decce7: {n}The old man smiles slightly.{/n} "It is not so hard to recognize a ruler by the way {mf|he|she} walks. No one in here steps as confidently as you, Your Grace."
df0cfcb3-fb52-4cd3-b902-82c2d5c07bba: {n}The man's voice rustles like autumn leaves.{/n} "I am a collector, not a trader. Can I be certain you will keep my stories intact in their absolute purity?" {n}The Storyteller ponders for several moments.{/n} "No, I do not think so. At least, not yet."
c48a2cd2-9b08-4871-b6d4-5c214d2cb0eb: "Long ago, I was a smith in {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}. The fire of the forge has burned out my eyes, but I am grateful for it. f9381f17-e4c5-4fe2-83a5-b63ea4c83e26: {n}The old man ponders silently for a moment.{/n} "Many peoples are long dead, their homes crumbled to dust, and their bodies turned to ash. Only legends can still tell us of their triumphs and defeats, their joys and fears. I would be so interested to hear the stories told about us after our demise..."
b7c937d4-0be0-4c22-b44e-01fd850a64c1: {n}The Storyteller doesn't answer, his unseeing eyes staring ahead blankly.{/n}
fd5adcff-98ba-4e73-b0be-6483016c1f5e: "In your travels, pay special attention to items from ancient eras. There must be an abundance of such things throughout the Stolen Lands, for these lands remember stories of the rise and fall of many kingdoms."
6576eb05-59f6-4824-9cff-c5a0fc9e2824: "These legends are the most precious valuables of this world, the last remnants of ancient tribes. d6e7231b-fd1c-4ff3-a0f5-f06cb97f39be: {n}The old man thinks for a moment, then continues.{/n} "But I can offer you a deal, Your Grace. c052af43-11e5-4160-a4f8-d4ada11342d2: "And if you find all the pieces of any ancient artifacts, I can even recall my smithing skills to unite them and restore their power."
ee6603e7-a5a8-4988-8158-8f90c71dffe9: {n}The Storyteller's eyebrows raise.{/n} "How interesting! May I, Your Grace?" {n}He gently touches the items from your pack.{/n}

faee90e8-1e83-4dea-88c5-b2db2b4a1add: {n}The Storyteller finishes his inspection.{/n} "Remember me, should you find anything noteworthy."
3de11956-b4f0-4144-8f29-6181f044c02c: {n}The Storyteller touches the pendant with {g|Torag}Torag's{/g} mark.{/n} "Oh, the symbol of Torag. The children of stone wear such pendants as protective talismans. I will gladly purchase any you have."
31bf9d78-2819-4e7a-9e51-00aeb3e45271: {n}The Storyteller's fingers caress the symbol, shaped like a tree leaf.{/n} "And what is this? I hear the voices of trees, smell the scent of fresh leaves. A dryad mark, is it not? I would be happy to purchase it from you!"
b1fb71c1-59db-4c53-9ae3-e9f01b703c86: "Oh, now here is something truly impressive! 7432fe46-f003-4c6e-bede-0b4be766e976: "Oh, now here is something truly impressive! These items once belonged to a dwarven smith, and they wish to tell us their story. I hear the booming strokes of a hammer, the sizzling sparks and roaring flame of the forge... The anvil... it sings!"
