e3e0e439-909d-4953-8ba9-3dc70799f752: "Power passed into the princess's hands without any bloodshed, but the prince has retired to his estate — to gather troops against his sister, I've no doubt. My betrayal didn't prevent the feud, it simply delayed it — he'll need just half a year, I fear, and no longer. I kneel and pray to all the kind gods. May they grant mercy, and may they keep safe the kingdom I couldn't."
678828a9-1251-4a0e-9724-18ecc2d5a43c: "There is no indication of this in the guard's memories, but I consider that to be the most likely probability."
ec361628-bb83-4a22-a606-cc7841a367fe: "They were trusted as kind guardian spirits. It would not cross anyone's mind that they might entrap the king's soul into his own crown, then defame the princess to her mother and her brother."
1348845c-8f6f-4dd3-9de1-e2f6a3e23dbd: "He traveled to the {g|Thassilonian Empire}Thassilonian Empire{/g}. He served as a guard and gave lessons in swordplay... but that's where his trail goes cold."
6809ebe3-dc09-4019-9c21-58bccc81c212: "I think he continued to question travelers for news of Rushwood to the end of his days, trying to decide if what he did that night was right. Maybe arresting the princess would have avoided the feud after all, who can say? I do not believe he ever found the answer to his questions."
9021667c-3bc6-4637-a9c4-031f4dcb8c4c: {n}The Storyteller's face distorts with pain.{/n} "Who are you? You're not the Witch, nor the worm... But you're also not the {race} who holds me here... Can you hear me? Free me from this prison, I beg you! I've suffered so long! I... I wish to rest in peace..."
fa5f0375-acec-4334-8003-053878437cf8: {n}The Storyteller rolls the bright bead in his palm.{/n} "Just glass — but so much more beautiful and valuable than some precious gems. The art of melting such glass belonged to the elves before {g|Earthfall}Earthfall{/g}. That art is now lost, along with many other mysteries... I would buy this from you, if I may."
0dcb0084-55de-45e3-8075-d369bc8b759c: "I hear an elven flute. A joyful melody is being played in the main square — and passers-by cannot help but dance! This is not my native {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}, no... This kingdom rose and fell thousands of years before. What ruined it? I think I... No, no. I cannot quite make out what these relics are saying. Please, find the rest of the five — I long to uncover their story!"
5a3c8857-9720-4294-9034-ab7cfa2a97c5: "I hear an elven flute. A joyful melody is being played in the main square — and passers-by cannot help but dance! This is not my native {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}, no... This kingdom rose and fell thousands of years before. What ruined it? I think I can hear their story... Are you ready to hear about the sad fate of Rushwood?"
393bde73-8792-4a9a-96b9-22e2d8bf29a1: {n}The Storyteller's shoulders sag as he returns the First Crown to you.{/n} "You had no need to give me this item, to be reminded of this prisoner's suffering. You are well aware of the item's story. If his tears could move you, you would have already freed him."
83aecf7f-e315-4df0-8089-ce431868fef4: {n}The Storyteller sighs heavily and shakes his head. After a moment, he continues, his voice returned to normal.{/n} "As you can likely guess, the gods did not answer his prayers. Soon, Rushwood was devoured by the fires of the royal feud... And then {g|Earthfall}Earthfall{/g} wiped even Rushwood's ruins from the face of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}."
6451d51b-b7f5-46b5-8148-91613d4eb718:
"The invisibility potion tastes bitter. My charmed spectacles are cold against my face, but they allow me to see in the dark. The darkness embraces me like warm dark velvet, as I creep slowly up the tower's spiral stair.
I am Kiny the Stubborn, thief of secrets. I was born to a family of slaves, destined to squirm at the feet of my cyclops masters. But I grabbed fate by the throat and escaped, taking with me some of my cruel master's artifacts. Since then I've traveled the world, doing what I do best."
02502bd8-5613-4107-8664-df1ce967f689: "From the tall spikes of the temples of {g|Azlant}Azlanti{/g} to the secret dungeons of {g|Thassilonian Empire}Thassilon{/g}, from huts of shamans living in reeking swamps to the shiny palaces of cyclops aristocracy. I've been everywhere, and from every quarter I collected something of great value. Scrolls and potions, artifacts, blueprints of magical devices and spell designs. All this and far more I have held in my hands. Bards tell stories of my adventures. Some claim that once the Stubborn stole an artifact right from the bedroom of the Lord of Runes. I can neither confirm nor deny these rumors."
fd9d7425-18da-4e13-928d-20930ab99963:
"But today's mission is more important and dangerous than all that came before it. I must not lose. I do not have the right to lose.
The stairway ends at an arch without a door. I look for traces of protective spells, and frown when I find none. I step across the threshold. Moonlight fills the room. Wrought iron grills on the windows cast criss-crossing patterns on the floor. Small, blossoming trees sway in their pots. Where are the protections? I take another careful step."
852db004-1ecf-4c59-b62a-48d7e1adffed: "Suddenly, two of the nearest trees reach out their branches and drop some petals. They fall in a circle. Damning the world all around, I move to escape, only to find myself trapped. The invisible wall is more secure than shackles. Caught! I sigh, and I sit down upon the floor, legs crossed. I take out a flask of strong liqueur, and a volume of frivolous poetry, awaiting the tower's owner."
44e02a5b-6bda-4223-be71-b006931e6231: {n}The Storyteller moves his lips silently, rubs his temples, then sighs, obviously baffled.{/n} "I cannot answer, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. This has never happened to me before, but some of the memories seem hidden. Let us continue. Perhaps everything will become clear as the story develops."
e4539e90-c13e-4ce2-abbb-7fd5e6c23fe5: "Because I do not steal for profit. I've no interest in gold and jewelry, only the secrets of wizardry. I do not rob simple wizards, but track down those who possess unusual artifacts or develop new spells, which they do not wish to share with the world."
61cd7ffd-05ac-4743-b4bb-057617c790d1: "I began by giving the secrets of cyclops wizards to their human slaves, but many years have passed since then, and the list of my exploits has grown long. I have learned that if someone possesses unique power or knowledge, they can easily use them to evil ends. 161a3c9e-328e-4695-87af-89e1ddb94e2d: "The master of the tower is a powerful wizard, a creator of wonderful things, and an old friend. The owner did not punish me, but instead released me, gave me food, and a roof over my head. Since then we have been in competition. – Once every five or six years, I visit my friend and try to secretly slip through all the traps in his tower. Then we pass the night speaking of my adventures, and the varying fates of the elves and the short-lived."
4da7e57b-76d3-4d5e-b813-0b961ed055d7: "Today too we sip mulled wine, and I tell him of the many wonders I've seen in my travels. That is why I sit in my tower, guarding what I've created, and what I've learned from others.'"
dea83d46-c670-4eb5-b987-077aae14db8f: "I dare not argue, and we talk about other things for a while. At last we say goodbye until the morning. 8a05c14a-b179-495c-89f4-351c3bbc3444: "The truth is that I've known all the traps in this tower for many years, and have gathered a handy set of artifacts that will help me avoid them. b86d983c-9c33-44d8-91cb-a791f19028dc:
"The plan worked. Not long after, I had already escaped the tower, taking with me one of the old elf's greatest secrets. And now I'm running, hiding, delving down and down through the tunnels of an ancient dungeon, to hide what I have stolen.
For so many years we argued about whether I'm right to tear secrets from their keepers' hands and release them into the world. And here I am, shunning the sun, crawling deep, as far as I can reach, away from the light of knowledge. – To hide a secret which must never be shared."
a5602e82-99f5-463a-b3bb-1a7782cc0b66:
"I have no one I can tell of this. There is none with whom I can share this dread knowledge and my terrifying speculations. I have no right to speak of it. The thing I took from the tower must be hidden dark away, and never see the light for thousands of years. Otherwise there will be great woe. My friend's tower is not the adamant keep he imagines it to be. I must hide his secret deep, where it will vanish without a trace. Even if it means that I myself must vanish with it.
I have little hope that you will understand why I betrayed you, my friend. Forgive me, if you can, and farewell."

0766ad8d-af8e-4891-966c-4473df3a130f: {n}You turn away to run away as quickly as possible — out of here, to another room, anywhere to be far away from this dwarf and his curse. But the darkness engulfs you, the floor trembles again. You stumble and fall, crushed to the ground by the dwarf's heavy, unfamiliar words.{/n}
ddb880df-16e8-43f0-8e49-171093f02dd6: {n}You see a pile of mutilated bodies, reaching nearly to the ceiling. The bodies used to be humans, dwarves, cows, sheep and gods-know-what-else. Some corpses look fresh, others have already started to decompose, filling the passage with a heavy, sickening stench. The trolls probably use this corner as a meat storage.{/n}
0c500938-a16c-4cd2-ad1f-3f5ef6f78381: {n}The dwarf definitely looks like he will not make it. He has lost a lot of blood, and his horrible wounds would have killed any other person long ago. The fact that he still clings to life is either a miracle, or his own unthinkable stubbornness.{/n}
d55c81b1-6bde-4440-a368-891a3bf2c5bf: {n}Your hesitation is ended by the whoosh of a falling sword. The dwarf's voice cuts off abruptly. Amiri cleans the blade of her sword with a rag and throws a discontented glance towards you.{/n} "Why did you wait? Stood there with your trap wide open... witchcraft could get in!"
9ecc38c9-60ab-48ef-9c9d-d45cbce4102d: "Poor man!" {n}Octavia wrings her hands in compassion.{/n} "I'm afraid our magic can't help him anymore. We should-" {n}She swallows a lump in her throat.{/n} "-put him out of his misery."
b5cd48a5-56e7-415c-bd84-d212fd3f2bdb: "Let us grant the gift of a quick death to this unfortunate soul, and take revenge to those monsters who made him suffer!"
158aa1b8-cf99-4e40-8b0c-a7254c20fdfc: {n}The dwarf doesn't seem to hear you.{/n} "Cyril darabosh nadzhak!" {n}he finishes, and lets out his last breath.{/n}
5cccfead-b622-4c55-bcf7-e5c6327e91ab: {n}You leave the dwarf alone, letting him meet his death in loneliness. Soon he stops moving, but you do not try to find out if he's dead, or just unconscious.{/n}
0ceec831-9e1c-4ffa-b663-31f52c4e3150: "Let's leave this miserable sufferer alone. He's on the verge of non-existence, so let him make his own last step into oblivion."
40764523-8a24-4f2b-99bd-168707a77476: {n}Ekun pulls an arrow out of the quiver.{/n} "Mercy," {n}he says, pointing towards the dying dwarf.{/n}
ac340f6b-0513-466b-9258-e6477eae199c: {n}You're ready to pass by, but suddenly you notice some weak movement near the edge of the pile. Having a closer look you understand one of the corpses is not exactly a corpse yet. A bare-chested dwarf moves his lips silently, staring blindly at the ceiling. His chest has some bite-marks, left by a huge jaw, and he has no legs — they seem to have been bitten off at the knees.{/n}
2442d17a-c07f-4318-af51-f425276537ec: {n}Your companions are as scared as you are. While you hesitate, he says{/n} "Cyril darabosh nadzhak" {n}and lets out his last breath.{/n}
e7dcc5c8-48c6-46d2-a3ca-2a779b7b5ca7: "What is that? What's happening? Stop it immediately, you villain!"
502952b7-cc70-47aa-9560-7a4d993e59a5: "I thought... you were one of them..." {n}Dwarf coughs out clots of dark blood.{/n} "I'm... the priest of {g|Torag}Torag{/g}... have been searching this ancient outpost... Found it, it seems..." {n}He tries to laugh, but instead bursts into a new fit of coughs.{/n} "Come closer..." {n}With an immense effort, he raises his hand and whispers words of blessing — so sweet and kind comparing to his prior curses.{/n}
e2d695ec-fa4f-44ed-af93-a179f5d52c34: "You've had all the fun you wanted, I hope! What are you looking at? Finish him off now, before he's done casting!"
7789e06a-d9b7-4201-9e91-afd0c509328a: {n}Your hesitation is ended with the buzz of a flying arrow. The dwarf's voice cuts out abruptly. Ekun puts down his bow and gives you a silent nod.{/n}
9009d6a4-b547-4fee-bcc9-afc3fc0d6f5b: {n}Harrim's hands clench at his beard.{/n} "The ancient dwarven tongue! The curse of {g|Torag}Torag{/g}! Oh {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}, embrace your faithful servant! We all shall die now." {n}Harrim's voice is half scared, and half excited.{/n}
e15f37b4-627b-48b9-afac-87e8b8cc2f96: {n}The dwarf dies quickly and quietly. You leave his body, hoping his soul will find peace wherever it is now.{/n}
136d2b2c-97e5-4673-8b14-27c017d0f61a: {n}As soon as your healing kicks in, the dwarf interrupts his monologue, apparently regaining awareness of his surroundings. He moves his head with an immense effort and looks you up and down.{/n} "You're… not a troll."
46b053a4-cc32-41e6-abb5-31b946ce1539: {n}Octavia thrashes around in a panic.{/n} "We should run! Or hide! Shut him up, somebody!"
b8e98f4d-196a-4130-865f-d20082c9b511: {n}Having heard {g|Torag}Torag's{/g} name, Harrim recoils.{/n} "I need no blessings from the traitor god," {n}he whispers into his beard.{/n}
df677e95-6c60-4ede-80df-367394d3fd36: {n}Your healing efforts have an effect of sorts. The dwarf seems to come halfway to life and starts talking in an unknown language.{/n} "Karadash kramr dug gadalon." {n}The light around you grows dim all of a sudden, and the floor starts to tremble, resonating with the dwarf's voice.{/n} "Uzmar cyril nadzhak!"
9358ce7c-1985-4895-9c91-19c014a25576: {n}Amiri grunts in disapproval, caressing the hilt of her sword.{/n} "It feels wrong to finish him off! He fights death itself, this battle is his."
a9c61115-b3d7-4b37-a310-aebba097af4d: {n}Ekun exhales loudly and nods.{/n} "Right choice. It's tough, but it's right."
ad1fbb51-9bfa-404d-9a99-d01f22fea5ff: {n}Tristian examines the poor fellow carefully.{/n} "Difficult." {n}The priest whispers faintly.{/n} "A single healing spell will not be enough." {n}He casts a meaningful glance at you.{/n} "But that is no reason not to try."
48e3711f-5b50-4cea-a890-3d538cb5ae33: {n}Heedless of the dwarf's words, Tristian reaches out to him and chants a healing spell.{/n}
845dcc33-8d43-4758-ac39-b4327efd98be: {n}Tristian casts a grateful glance at you and steps back to let you speak with the dwarf.{/n}
7f2fbdce-d4f2-4297-9d05-44cf656914a9: {n}Tristian looks at you softly, but still with reproach.{/n} "I wonder, would you turn from one of us with the same disregard, without so much as a quick attempt to alleviate our suffering?"
b9f96e33-90e8-44f5-8388-43687449aa99: {n}The silence that falls feels unnatural. Your own steps and hastily-muggled cough seem far-away. It has gotten darker, too... or is it just your eyes? After several long moments, the sensations fade, but you feel that the ancient dwarven curse has worked.{/n}
b5e2f07f-5162-4dda-8992-353eed2bdffd: "We could lock all the ill in one place, and the problem would soon solve itself..."
817261c6-dfca-47d0-ba74-6d2b5545b3e1: "Even such measures might not help. We've no certainty how the disease spreads — from one person to another, or in some other way."
6738df0e-c209-4d46-a924-8fdf3778d51d: "I must admit that limiting the movements of those who are sick would indeed slow the disease's spread. But it doesn't follow that we should leave them without help."
bcaa27eb-6759-4685-93e1-04a1085f9436: "That's easy for you to say. Nothing sick will happen to your stinky dead face! But what if one of us gets sick?!"
a9a826d5-c088-459d-9cd1-758593a5e3b4: "Your lips drip poison. You utter cruelties just to amuse yourself. But you do understand that this curse didn't begin with the sick, and it won't end with their deaths either."
ad438fb4-b5d2-4453-b8db-fc1571873f59: "I'm thinking about writing a series of essays about Qadira. It's such an amazing place! An oasis at the border of two civilizations, you might say."
e2d9e363-37ec-426c-9444-9a3754dedf81: "What region of Qadira would you like to write about, master Jubilost? Our land is vast and diverse, and there are as many tribes living there as there are in all the River Kingdoms."
c0bc3838-cd2d-4a6c-95cc-4424ce4e4df5: "What region of Qadira would you like to write about, master Jubilost? Our land is vast and diverse, and there are as many tribes living there as there are in all the River Kingdoms."
1296b697-12e8-4ecc-bacb-d6102eb947db: "Armor must be sturdy and heavy. The heavier, the better."
7de8f723-443b-4845-a1c2-bedfb118b30f: "And if there's a good shield to add to the armor – then you feel like a whole fortress, not just a fighter."
6374f41f-476b-4363-91f1-34d7e70c1b31: "Thank you, Fes. Your gift will be very useful."
88b4f14d-f115-4a97-bb91-13fe19fd13a0: "I don't need your veterans or their wisdom."
4cee45f1-9cd9-4392-add1-1eeeaebe20e4: "You send me cripples and old men as a sign of gratitude?!"
6d85f5cc-bda9-4cdf-b65e-cdff3d4397fc: "Agents of the Worldwound come to my lands — and they even attacked me!"
08802829-8867-4e5a-8639-9ac22ae7bc1c: "The leader of cultists who ambushed me on the road mentioned two names: Areelu and Deskari."
5b8ab69a-eb6f-4393-9f88-51bb5881efeb: "A crusading aasimar. Sounds like a life's calling."
0560f49a-a099-4d19-96ce-0fd3891915be: {n}The aasimar before you is wearing armor regaled in the colors of Mendev, and {g|Iomedae}Iomedae's{/g} symbol upon his breastplate. The visor of his helmet is up, and you remark the unusual lips and eyes of the messenger, that appear as though cast in metal. The aasimar salutes you in military style.{/n} "Greetings, {mf|Baron|Baroness|King|Queen} {name}! Allow me to introduce myself: Fes Aldragem, commander of the Mendev army. I have come here on behalf of my knightly order, with an official acknowledgement."
c604d7e5-f3f5-4b96-b5a9-08fa2a46f5b4: "Not long ago, our missionaries entered your lands to find brave men and women, ready to challenge the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g} itself. You did everything you could to reinforce the ranks of Golarion's defenders, and many of your people stood ready to serve a higher goal. Our missionaries visited many lands, and few if any have done as much as you, for our common good. You have acted nobly, {name}, and have proven yourself a loyal ally of Mendev."
dc137996-016f-4c32-81c8-8af638ff767c: "We value every soul who serves to protect {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} from the demon hordes. However, we felt we simply must thank you specially for showing such valor and nobleness. I have something for you: a few veterans from Mendev have come with me. They are ready to remain here and train your soldiers in military skills. Any country could benefit from the knowledge these worthy officers possess. They only left the battlefield to make room for soldiers stronger and younger."
092702cd-2a36-4308-a134-badc1fb5d962: {n}Fes smiles, but his eyes are tired.{/n} "Our forces need aid. Every day, new hordes of demons come to the {g|Worldwound}Worldwound{/g}, ready to rip to pieces anyone who stands in their way. This is why we value every volunteer who is ready to stand under Mendev's flag."
03a38f5a-4af5-41da-8be7-a202d52a4953: {n}Fes shakes his head.{/n} "The {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g} reaches its tentacles far and wide. We recently lost two recruitment teams who were supposed to return to Mendev with help. I'm glad you didn't suffer their fate. The {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} would be unlikely to survive such a loss."
eece4636-f935-4472-822b-72cf35c9cfd0: {n}Fes knits his brows.{/n} "Your reproach is groundless, {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}. Each of these warriors have been through everything one can face of the field. They have seen terrors enough for ten mortals. Many warlords would pay any amount for such trainers. Their experience is truly priceless."
2ab07cde-49f2-4c9d-8d5d-12965eb918bd: {n}Fes bows.{/n} "My regards. Now it is time for me to return to Mendev. I shall go with a light heart, in hopes that the alliance of our states will remain strong, no matter what our enemy plots. Farewell!"
dfb3b44a-42d1-4f49-83a5-676b5405fd2d: "Hmm. I am sorry to hear that. Nonetheless, my companions will enjoy the hospitality of the locals and remain in these lands — just in case you change your mind and decide to take advantage of their knowledge."
53e32825-b12d-406e-8490-d474da31ba05: "Those filthy names are known to everyone in Mendev. Deskari is the demon lord who stands behind the {g|Worldwound}Worldwound{/g} – one of the greatest spawns of the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g}. The vile lech Areelu Vorlesh is a corrupt witch, one of the most celebrated denizens of the Worldwound. I've heard of the atrocities she commits upon her prisoners and even her own slaves..." {n}Fes shudders.{/n} "The sooner this evil is destroyed, the better."
f25c74ce-0d1c-4fe0-8d47-e28cc4e6b03c: {n}Fes curves his metallic lips in a smile.{/n} "You could say so. Blood seethes in my veins when I anticipate a fight against the spawns of evil. I'm happy I've managed to direct my passions in the right direction."
7da914cf-8c07-44db-9ff8-23b24c336ad8: "What, are you comparing us with what you read in your book?"
01efe7dd-6bc3-4193-bd7a-39254afcd510: "It will get even better. We have many nights ahead of us."
0c49be33-78ff-4df0-9f67-be0c7b6b44d4: "Find me after I die. Wherever I am."
014a2848-1154-48cd-a5f8-305fd0a7317f: "I want you to be happy, too. And I'm not going to push you around."
721cd228-3079-4e74-81c9-92ea0f1a62dd: "Let's not think about the future. We're together. That's enough."
4cb8669a-c001-4e02-88c2-6ab8759ff47a: "Did you think once would be enough for me?"
14b53ae5-bcc4-4d0c-a72b-f249f2358edf: "We have to go. There will be time later."
52bbbaaa-eebf-4d57-ad9a-ac32b87e5da9: {n}Tristian tosses his hair from his face.{/n} "That was... amazing. I did not think..." {n}The deva cuts himself short, thinking about something.{/n}
2899fb02-a33d-4c82-a09a-528ba957215d: "What? Ah, you are talking about that... treatise!" {n}Tristian laughs.{/n} "No, I think I won't even try!"
789f891a-414e-4991-9b38-ef9c925fb57a: "And days. The whole eternity. Our little eternity." {n}Tristian stops again.{/n}
3dfe4cef-7045-4a86-884f-0f940bc7ff00: "Wait a second. Let me catch my breath. We have a whole future. Our little eternity."
455affc9-a289-4c0c-a182-c268e9afd1ff: "You emit warmth, like the sun. But, {name}... Once, wandering among worlds, I saw eternity pass, and the brightest of suns dim. And I can't but think that once... you and I will be separated."
f65e54c3-d2ce-43ae-b577-fb0c92530db1: {n}Tristian wraps his arm around your shoulders.{/n} "And while we are together... I don't know how long it will last... I want you to be happy. Tell me what you want. Your wish is my command."
ab2166ad-e4dd-413c-a3c9-ce188d629a1f: {n}Tristian thinks.{/n} "The {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} have just one queen — the one who conquered them." {n}The deva smiles.{/n} "But I will be honored to be your Prince Consort."
55f1a87f-09a2-4e54-b754-c3f31ddb6542: {n}Tristian coughs, surprised.{/n} "Forgive me, Your Highness, but your subjects will be against it — someone must rule them! Anyway, I'll do everything in my power to make the queen happy." {n}The deva leans into you and kisses your neck.{/n}
c183cabf-8b39-4211-8a21-0eae90648f21: "I see you kept my gift..." {n}Tristian strokes your hand.{/n} "As soon as this madness around is over, I'll take care of a wedding."
24b58d92-df4e-4120-b8a0-c83737d5f575: "I will take care about everything. As soon as this madness that's going on around you, is over. Until then I will be too busy protecting you."
796b653b-36ab-4652-afee-5f3647294bbe: {n}Tristian nods solemnly.{/n} "I promise. I will not leave you."
60a5784e-3d74-45d3-911f-0c157b3a2a35: {n}Tristian lowers his head sadly.{/n} "You know that's impossible. I must return... to where I must be. But I know that merciful {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} will not call me immediately after the victory over Nyrissa. You and I will have time."
b39286ba-7dfc-43d3-aaec-b6bd9a2f0da1: {n}Tristian thinks for a few moments.{/n} "I didn't think about that... but I can try. No, not just try: I will turn all the worlds to find you — wherever you are and whoever you become." {n}Tristian kisses you tenderly.{/n}
8ecccebf-1b56-44e3-98d2-d087a43f1f6e: {n}Tristian leans into you, presses his forehead against yours, and stays silent, his eyes closed.{/n}
de5e245a-6a28-4419-be16-3f75c275f21c: {n}Tristian runs his fingers along your neck and kisses your shoulder.{/n} "Of course. I overthink everything, don't I?"
cbc3a87a-99f8-4d69-932c-043ced330fc9: "You know. I have not been as sure as now, for such a long time. When I was Nyrissa's prisoner, I had no more freedom than a bird in a cage. I even doubted {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} mercy in my darkest hour. But with you... with you I'm not afraid of the future. I'm not afraid to make mistakes, because I know I will be able to fix them."
f74d41c3-b4a6-48cf-ac79-f89af9c959d1: {n}Tristian raises his head, as if hearing something.{/n} "I would like to stay alone with you for a little while. If you do not mind."
775d45e9-26b3-4ea7-99f1-70531ee6c861: {n}In response, Tristian holds you and pulls you close.{/n}
664004c3-6172-4aa1-b2b3-0d6b5bfe23e3: {n}Tristian kisses your hand and pulls away.{/n}
0cf550b0-923d-427c-9669-15a7bfa7344c: "Guy Shaseur De Lombair was a woodsman not unlike you. However, he favored dual elven curve blades instead of the bow. Beloq-Nur was his fellow Archknight, and he was an expert marksmen. It is said that he could shoot the wings off a stirge at a hundred meters..."
f0a1af8b-52cc-4223-bff8-0599c7d28550: "Minotaur shit... Even if he was that good with a bow, why not just kill the stirge?"
3e0f52af-4638-4df5-a748-9eac109d0c3b: "Tristian, do you know what your problem is? You have no ambition!"
cf317e62-2caa-43ba-8ad3-0471ba1034cd: "Is that a problem? I have Sarenrae's mercy. That's all I need."
3a928820-515d-4853-a997-17b3dab767db: "Welcome to Brineheart! Would you like to take a look at my goods?"
8b125fe5-272d-4de2-b10f-583bd8ede7a3: "Everything is excellent! Darven is a wise ruler. Trade caravans come every day, the taxes are low. — Our city thrives!"
fb80657b-37ca-4691-918c-d89efbe2c619: "We should make sure it's safe. Something dangerous may be stalking us nearby."
c1cc7c85-f883-44cd-b3a1-e3fc1fabc438: "We should look around first. Be sure the camp is secure."
520f60d5-8ebc-4514-8a04-83bfe80ebd61: "Yeah, easy for you! You got that dog following you around, barking if anything is off. Too bad it don't talk."
43dbf7fa-96d8-4ccc-9929-88c1a27b2ccb: "We'd better stay together. — If someone attacks, we might be too far away to help."
8a0fe1e4-5d90-4b26-a0fc-2f2d895c1a8c: "Oh no. We'll do like all smart adventurers do. — We'll just sit here quietly, and let the adventures come to us!"
a640fd29-43de-48bc-b1b2-72aa917d7b79: "I admit, it worries me a little too, when we camp in the open for all to see. But then I can play the lute — and the light from our campfire can be seen from afar anyway."
abfaba6b-f577-480d-a7b7-ddaa6a3a5a62: "I can go with you! I will ride your beast! Why you looking at me funny? Fine then. Now I'm not going!"
6ae1fd3a-f318-4a52-b20f-bc729cd45ca4: "It's not my concern. I've already had enough trouble because of this story."
e98a3e5a-008e-4940-8142-63e08462fa1c: "Does this situation somehow threaten me or my kingdom?"
671b483f-e350-47eb-9091-f1d750e1b009: "Fine. We'll meet with these elves if circumstances permit."
075ecdd8-6d61-488f-bffb-d74409fadbb5: "I'm not going to meddle in your affairs with the elves. This is my final decision."
e8213bdc-6e1a-44c5-b975-73110db9de24: "I bring news," {n}Jaethal reports abruptly.{/n} "Not unexpected. A sizable group of elves from {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g} has crossed the border into your kingdom. Is she studying you, or considering the larger situation?{/n} "I... suppose we should meet with them. 4f7e7afb-b91f-480f-9ad7-239b013e759f: "Is there a chance I might change your mind? I can't see any reason for you to say no. This mission is extremely important to me. We'll both win if we resolve the situation — one way or another."
1a65e653-b705-4107-afbf-a7bafa63f190: "I am ready to strike out at a moment's notice."
45af26e2-1897-4160-90e3-7eb451ccd9eb: "I doubt it. They are not official emissaries from {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}. — If they were, then their interference would look quite different. c8a150d4-fedd-4799-b401-e0bf15111c19: "As you wish… I don't dare to distract Your Highness any further."
cdb38667-7277-4f0b-93a5-788447b9be9c: "Indulge my curiosity. After you've become, ahem, undead, what changes would you notice first of all?"
a7d13432-1550-47d1-b3e8-35b62a908dfb: "First of all? Let me think... Your heart isn't beating, blood isn't running through your veins, there's no need to breathe. And insolent gnomes keep stalking you, asking tactless questions."
32884b13-bb86-48d8-bf40-d9dbfa56a57a: "I did not give you leave to construct shrines in my capital."
284f1491-7f44-4256-b7b1-ab5873941ccf: "Nok-Nok, I respect your efforts. You are free to worship Lamashtu here."
154c01f5-cefe-424f-bf39-8ad07add992d: "You broke my law, and you must make amends. Bring down the shrines."
cb4237ab-efc0-4720-8bd2-18af4495e6b8: "I don't care who builds what, I just wanted to see what this fool's work was you were on about. You may carry on."
1b3e958b-4db1-4370-bc6c-d3b74c983af6: "Either destroy these shrines now, or spend the rest of your days in my prison."
b5b2642e-80de-4c72-95f5-ddd7cad1a5d9: {n}Nok-Nok half-stumbles in, clanking and rattling from a number of fetishes adorning his body – teeth, pebbles – so much so he looks like a filthy bead curtain. 1e9667d0-6931-4bbb-9b7a-cdcaf3dd7d97: {n}A towering gate blocks your path. The pillars flanking the gate are carved from the mountain itself, and both the gate and pillar rise so high they are obscured by the mists above. The gate is sealed, but you see no lock… not even a handle.{/n}
03066bb9-95b1-4dd0-8068-a30596174c0e: The raven gives a rattling caw. "Pathetic crrreaturrre! How darrre you starre at the crrreation of yourrr masterrrs with indifference! Kneel! And prrray the ancients don't strrrrike you down!"
0e90f25a-6ce7-4457-b7fb-0fed3dba1b4a: {n}The gate seems impregnable — you can't imagine the power needed to open it, it looks like a score of battering rams would shatter against it.{/n}
4c98a9b9-0618-449e-88c0-d1d477d09c4f: {n}Massive pillars rise high up into the mist. You can barely imagine the power it would take to build this gigantic structure.{/n}
dd048152-cfa4-447d-aa54-1cc3c2e7314f: "A merrre touch of my masterrrr's power… he commands arrrrmies, slaves, servants, shapes mountains to his will…" {n}The raven makes a rattling caw.{/n} "This is a monument to his reign... and his rrreign will come again."
094ceda5-69b4-48d7-9413-168ab932738b:
{n}Many of the words are lost to time and weather, but you make out some glyphs and symbols you recognize — and from there, manage to piece together the inscription:{/n}
"IN DARKNESS, THE DOORS OPEN .
IN MURK, THE TRUTH REVEALS ITSELF.
IN GLOOM, DEATH STEPS INTO THE HALLS."
c33e72f0-9e08-439d-be39-82230182cbda: {n}The ancient inscriptions have fallen victim to time and weather. Try as you might, you cannot decipher them.{/n}
03f5cc63-c71e-4cbd-891c-9f1d127d989b: {n}The gates are covered with ancient inscriptions and disturbing depictions of worship and sacrifice... but the inscriptions are far above eye level, so much so you have to take a few steps back to see them. In the center, where the two gates meet, there is a circular protrusion — set into it are three black hooks.{/n}
05d26725-86ce-4975-bd52-ea647745e14b: {n}The raven tilts its head, affixing you with a single beady eye.{/n} "What is wrrrrit, is wrrrrit no more, for wind and time have taken their toll… yet you would need masterrrry of languages grrrreater and olderrr than yours to read what's therrre… and a farrr greaterrr mind than yourrrrs to comprrrehend it."
815b99fc-9243-411c-abfe-f9b55065871c: {n}Depicted on the gates are three cyclopes — great giants clad in ceremonial garb. They stand before an image of the gate, which is open. Each cyclops is holding aloft a lantern that looks to be a cyclops's skull.{/n}
2a03b7d6-af41-4293-809e-fee7b18a03fa: {n}Rains and winds have taken their toll on this bas-relief — all you can make out are a few vague figures, each holding something aloft, but you can't make out what the figures are or what they're carrying.{/n}
bd3cdf02-3d8b-4d4e-91e5-01dbf5d412bc: {n}The raven makes a rattling caw.{/n} "Nothing to see, nothing to see… the storms have scourrred it away… just as my masterrr shall do with you."
3a7ed81a-e5a1-416b-8460-7fb35d2e3372: {n}Clouds of smoke billow from the lit incense burners, streaming out through the cyclops' eye sockets... You quickly realize the smoke isn't rising — it's encircling you, engulfing you, until all around you is darkness...{/n}
283cdbee-d97e-4d4d-bd30-3e1350b097db: {n}You step down, and once again stand in the gate's shadow.{/n}
d7fc55bc-71cb-4212-8a80-ad15d838908d: {n}Your initial idea — that some ancient lock lay in the center of the gate — proves wrong. The "gate" is sealed, a solid wall with neither lock nor latch nor keyhole. Perhaps the gate was not meant to be opened — it was meant to seal something inside.{/n}
89eb9a6d-91b7-4fe0-bc50-4591419b28f1: {n}The gate seems built for giants and their kin, but yet three small hooks are set in a circular protrusion in the gate, five feet off the ground. If this gate was meant for giants, it is odd they set the hooks so low. Peering closer, you see the hooks bear traces of soot — and ash.{/n}
e309a46a-ac5e-47f6-a743-79a54d86e4b9: {n}You step back to take in the whole structure once again.{/n}
b4f7644d-cd5a-414d-b98d-417b41ec89ce: {n}This pillar stands on the windward side, so it is more weathered than the rest of the gate. You can faintly make out the remains of inscriptions that once used to cover the pillar — but they are so faded by wind and the elements as to be unreadable.{/n}
e158b7fb-44ba-44a5-96ab-b2cd0fb7d88b: {n}Time and weather have failed to destroy the bas-relief that rises from the foot of this pillar and winds its way up into the mist. The pillar is covered with intricate geometric patterns, images of lotuses and other flowers, mysterious figures performing strange rituals — the attention to detail is amazing, you'd need hours to examine every image.{/n}
7405c095-e2f0-40e2-96c8-47af4a801c90: {n}The stone flies in an arc, hits the gate and thuds on the ground. You wait several moments in awkward silence, but nothing happens.{/n}
e9a3b6c2-07eb-4cad-9fdf-738c76868512: {n}Your shout echoes repeatedly off the mountains and the gate. As the last echo fades, there is a moment of silence, then from the valley comes a strange sound, a mixture or howling and cawing that echoes sharply off the rock walls.{/n}
d92ffa0c-95f9-4eab-9dd4-6da716866a13: {n}The raven tilts its head forward, its tiny black eyes drilling into you.{/n} "{name}. I'll remember your name, {race}."
e8258aa1-9577-44ec-b467-428a6b486f8c: "The cyclopes believed that the soul leaves the body through the eye socket... The incense smoke is supposed to symbolize the souls departing to the afterlife."
e458cc7a-77a5-4df8-bee0-7cc0f1bcdd70: "Oh, I don't like this place.. I feel like I did in Qadira, during our raids on daemon worshipers. It's a very similar atmosphere."
1158a8b4-8208-4375-8be0-07f4737ee2e4: "I can't stop thinking about what we learned from Evindra the nereid. She and the Defaced Sisters loved and trusted the one who deceived them."
6bdb9dd8-3fa6-45cb-8a03-fd8af5f9dfb4: "Nyrissa has her charm. But she's pure evil, a destructive force of nature made flesh."

c28be583-c29f-4f5e-9b26-64ff9f028734: "Fine, why not. But it won't replace my practice. For me, the most important asset in battle is discipline, self-control and iron will."
8f6f52b9-8c25-4a7c-81e3-3638cbe84a45: "I thought super-clever professors like you don't even take a shit without a crowd of armed guards. Forget about an expedition to the Stolen Lands!"

65ae87ae-8c8e-440f-a97a-840464d729b6: "Looks like we don't have a choice, then. We'll wait and prepare for the next attack."

51cc6acf-3e44-4a86-a650-d59e10127fd5: "Don't be so hard on yourself, Tristian! Even knowing when to get ready is an important thing to know! I don't know how we'd handle these attacks if they happened without warning."

2ebb1ccd-9dd0-44b5-821c-479eb68a9d80: "I don't have anything useful to add. The locals are either oblivious to the curse's origins, or they're too scared to talk. I'd be better off reading ancient books on curses..."

34d32a77-f81e-4bf2-8d0b-223a1d584f3c: {n}The girl looks eagerly at you.{/n} "Of course, I know the {d|Varrask}name{/d}. He is the criminal I'm after! What do you know of him?"

ceb4761c-5a82-4f67-ba54-2c0a099ac71c: "I am the Lastwall inquisitor, {g|Iomedae}Iomedae's{/g} servant. I'm looking for a dangerous criminal. His trail leads to the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. 1b0e4ba3-0b97-4dbb-b7c9-90e7eca45cdc: {n}An aura of death magic hangs about the well — the aura runs strong and deep, emanating from the bottom of the well itself.{/n}
87377d7e-7807-4f9b-acde-4752415a623c: {n}A flurry of whispers erupts beneath the lid — and for a moment, you feel faint, but you take a breath and focus, blocking out the whispers. Your momentary disorientation subsides.{/n}
bdb2a59e-006a-488c-9876-090df2488c61: {n}The whispers beneath the lid rise to piercing shrieks, each one like a knife twisting into your skull. Covering your ears, you recoil from the well.{/n}
380182e7-a89d-4945-8414-cb7945910f1f: {n}As you pry open the lid, it splinters away and a foul stench burst forth. You feel a vicious, evil presence rushing towards you...{/n}

59dd6cc2-f9e5-4462-95af-7391cb504545: "I feel anguish and crushing despair. Whatever destroyed this village is somehow connected to this well."
e7dc3bab-003f-4fc4-85e2-4c53f1bca73b: "Too bad you've never been to Numeria. They'd beat your arrogance out of you quickly!"
7ce781c5-b884-4e02-8d21-bafbf964c98e: "You are wrong here, darling. I've been to Numeria more than once, and had a great time, discussing with their men of science the nuances of politics, culture, and many other things – which you know as much about as a pig knows about cakes."
a5f17b8c-bec9-48c5-b040-45839726b402: "I see such audacity and nobility in your desire to save your people from Bleaching, master Jubilost. I must say, I admire you."
89620617-282c-4ee7-b640-bca33f3e0ad0: "Ahem, ahem, hmmm — you make me blush, young lady. Truth be told, I've never shied away from ambitious tasks. So long as I draw breath, I'll keep looking for a solution!"
1facf564-44fc-4d2a-8dff-cad51ed3bd0e: "Where is the real tomb of the cyclopes ruler?"
1b2289f4-9395-49cb-924c-b8905562d93f: "I don't think she was lying to us, but she might not have been telling us the whole story."
536cca11-d34d-4311-bdef-e32bc14688df: "She said she's cursed. What if we fall under her curse?"
dd4b00ef-9026-42cc-ba96-c1bf5855b9d2: "We won't. I won't believe anyone or anything in this cursed dungeon!"
0b5365e4-9d02-43d9-a50a-049c6c850c5a: "I'm more concerned about this Horned Hunter. Sounds like a creature of divine power, and a nasty sense of humor!"
c0eb3882-f141-45ba-8f5c-13eefd36ebec: {n}The ghostly figure of a short, dark-skinned woman in a rich robe appears before you.{/n} "People?! In the name of Nethys, are you really living people? Or is this just another evil joke? Don't be silent, now – answer me! I order you! I beg you!"
c583a235-c791-4ff9-b9ff-a3eaad82e80f: "We are people, ghost. And who are you? And what right do you have to give us orders?"
a3229ebd-5278-469b-9de4-cbbe6eac28ca: "I am Marcida Vittari, the mistress of this castle... The mistress... Ha ha ha!" {n}The woman laughs uncontrollably. d45fa40c-9d43-4816-b5c3-3bbfe464ee93: "Assume I believe that you aren't another illusion, but a living person, imprisoned here and in need of our help. How much can you pay for it?"
37a502f0-afc1-484d-9348-a335e49587c6: "I swear this is no deceit! I don't know what I can give you. My castle is open for plundering... Oh, but I am locked in my laboratory! f2f875b8-0cad-4262-a047-cdf7b19fb56e: "Hmm-m-m... I am intrigued. But first you must answer some questions. Starting with – what is this place? And what is really going on here?!"
209cb7ea-cd73-4234-abe4-5b29df1f7079: "Anything, just GET ME OUT OF HERE!!" {n}The voice of the sorceress rises into a scream.{/n}
9b6c4d99-d1a2-4bfb-bf52-e0db1c7e46fb: "Hm. I'll tell you what, Marcida. We may or may not be able to help you. What exactly do you want from us?"
9e34be0c-d198-4ede-a40a-2dd68075fa41: "Somewhere in the castle there's my Gemstone of Unseen Paths – a magic key to the portal that leads to my dungeon. You will find the portal in a secret room next to the library. I beg you, don't abandon me here! Set me free or kill me – anything is better than an eternity here..." {n}The sobbing voice of the sorceress fades away, and the projection vanishes into thin air.{/n}
1542f7c0-e166-49bc-bef1-cdd194167ca6: "I don't know. The centaurs believe that it's here, but as you've learned, that's just an evil joke. 07755ed9-7740-46a5-952a-8a9a6a8aca33: "It was once a Taldan fortress, an outpost of a great empire. Then it became my shelter – a quiet home for a wizard, far away from the intrusions of lower creatures... Now it is ruled by the fey and other monsters. I heard they call it Lostlarn Keep."
67338808-8542-4f8f-89d6-feee033b6621: "I was once known as Marcida, the Master of Portals. There was no better specialist in conjuration magic in all of Taldor! 885f3471-125a-464f-af61-fe1e2d5cef6b: "My own conceit was my ruin. I summoned a force I could not control, and I discovered my powerlessness too late! I was a master of the school of Conjuration. 76686bbd-91b3-4cc4-a9e9-8d6226bd4acb: "I've come here with the glorious research army of great Taldor. This fortress was built as an outpost for future conquests, but these plans never came to pass. 72143949-cd93-42b5-85eb-1a9ea377d0b0: "You came here in search of a cyclops tomb? Alas, you've been deceived. Monsters have created illusions here for ages, playing with the naive centaurs... Why, you ask? Why?!" {n}The sorceress shakes her head, there are tears in her eyes.{/n}
8710af62-a19f-43a9-81fe-f50c0d103e0b: "But now... Now I am just a toy in the hands of a monster from the fey world. – Deceived, cursed, and doomed to eternal misery!"
04a1e5ed-0827-4cb0-84d4-f9d9109c62d6: "But one day, someone whose true nature I'd never known answered my call. A powerful creature from the fey world, he calls himself the Horned Hunter. d2cb5468-fdbd-43ba-b85d-d4ab72eb1520: "Oh yes, he gave me my own world... A tiny plane, the size of my laboratory! He gave me subjects – monsters who torment me day and night! 73e161a5-e350-4f8d-bd46-53f8dfcea7ed: "It's a joke! A joke, you see?! All these horrors, all this suffering – it's all just so they can laugh at mortals. Ha ha ha ha!!!" {n}Marcida's hysterical laughter turns into sobs.{/n}
edbfd83a-92ce-41c6-9b49-47e66475742d: "What do you say? Should we take the risk and try to help her, or do you think we're being played again?"
c3f1373e-6a26-42c6-99a2-b0a32f5e4c0a: "Good thinking! It's best not to mess around with curses."
28d4c57a-ee86-46e5-be24-e2f822af7c8d: "Perhaps not divine... But it's true about the sense of humor. Even if Marcida herself is being honest with us, she may yet be unwitting bait in his trap!"
52207252-6866-40cf-adac-e358aa0d6b93: "Yes, exactly! I sensed the same thing."
caea307a-8947-4d21-8b9d-73ee19eabe9d: "I suppose it wouldn't hurt to try helping her... But we must keep our eyes open or we'll end up just like her – or worse!"
9282ac1e-282b-4c6a-801f-9ebafc7a3df4: "Most reasonable. Well then, we will leave Marcida Vittari alone with her library and collection of precious magical items. And if we change our minds, we'd best be extremely careful. One should watch for tricks from every direction in this place!"

e86926dc-63e5-4c62-a0f3-76475e839d7b: "No, not like this. I shouldn't have stayed. But now it's too late to leave."
6b8aa1a0-5880-4afc-838e-087af6fdb5f4: "I'm looking for a cultist of a dark goddess. Can you help me?"
ec47a3ee-f89a-41d1-8dfa-a97bfc050856: "Olika, why are there blood-stained undergarments in your room? Where is that from?"
6bb0036f-940d-4fe3-aa25-68ce8880aad7: "Are you planning to stay in Gralton?"
985a87c9-95d7-4c9d-8dfc-049ad4dd7eeb: "Do you know anyone in this hall?"
cac60995-02d6-4a41-98f4-65b73a656116: "You see this couple at the table? They are nobles from Restov. They claim you were the last one who'd come to the hall."
a6d2de1b-fb48-4098-8c5b-b713a2bd58cd: "Do you know who came to the lodge last?"

3be3a559-332a-4a57-8e92-aa6f798977c2: "I need a key to your room."
a835d93e-a182-4fef-80e5-11317e802684: {n}A young woman stands before you, wearing a plain dress and a hooded cloak. Her belly is swollen — she is pregnant, and her time is near.{/n}
822cb11a-d6ef-44c7-806f-8348a3976305: {n}The woman manages a bow. {/n} "I've heard other people calling you {mf|baron|baroness}, Your Grace. It's an honor to be in your presence. I am Olika."
bddb44c9-9ead-4ab9-80ed-3e612f5e7deb: "Your Grace! It's an honor!" {n}The woman bows, then stares at you with shining eyes.{/n} "I thought I'd never be able to thank you in person for your kindness, but gods were kind to me."
d0c3ef5f-f4e7-4fd9-b008-6b8aff289942: {n}She touches a turquoise brooch pinned to her dress — the brooch is familiar to you. {/n} "You made it possible that the last gift from my husband had found its way home. There's not enough words in the world for how grateful I am."
a7453bb9-cae5-41ad-8166-502c24e316d2: "Do you want to ask about something else?" {n}Olika gives you a faint smile.{/n}
aa36dc73-8233-4e6c-a205-42f488613ba4: "I've got a sister in Gralton. Gods bless her — she's agreed to give me a shelter in her house. So I went there — there was nowhere else to go."
1b6b4439-98ef-4d36-9c3a-4bc083e55fd3: "From {g|Galt}Galt{/g}, Your Grace. I'm from a tiny village near the tract — guess no one here ever heard about this place."
76c0cbd9-80c3-4a69-8277-df37a95ab516: {n}Olika hesitates.{/n} "I don't know yet." {n}She answers.{/n} "But if things turn out well… why not?"
9a631b5f-4219-4352-b41d-3f6863db407c: {n}Olika pales.{/n} "Cultists? That's… that's horrible! But… how can I help you?"
6cc7b300-6e4c-4697-805e-11798c9b70ca: {n}Olika shrugs.{/n} "I've little coin, Your Grace… So I have to beg traders on the road to ride in their carts. I spend nights anywhere I have to. This place is at least warm and dry."
90990657-1f43-4130-8982-79740d294db8: {n}Olika takes a step back, her eyes wide with fear.{/n} "I… I'll explain..."
8e4d1d6e-e318-4430-a225-f1a167e5f20f: {n}Olika gives you perplexed look.{/n} "But that's not true! It's not!" {n}Her voice trembles.{/n} "Dumra… the hostess… she... she was the last one! I remember her coming through the kitchen!"
0877785c-9007-4d25-9162-9d663d0af11f: "I'm taking what rest I can after a long day on the road, Your Grace. I'm a widow..." {n}Olika stops short.{/n} "I've barely had two seasons to mourn my husband, and he left me with child. And in difficult times like these..."
ea718c09-6a79-401a-8055-f0a9a3f69b75: {n}Olika shakes her head slowly.{/n} "No… I don't think so..."
2f5e3681-9f83-470f-8a45-1564bd24c016: "First time I've seen these people was when I'd stepped over the threshold of this lodge."
f2c9e399-0ccf-4738-a2c4-45b1d95f6d5a: {n}Olika frowns.{/n} "I heard a noise from the kitchen… It was like something fell on the floor. And then this grumpy old lady, Dumra, came out."
a7d28cb0-1aa1-4829-b106-92264fe9fa3a: {n}Olika gives you several hasty nods. It seems the talk of cultists has frightened her.{/n}
67d2f28f-f23d-4cfb-ad05-fb699bda1423: {n}The woman lowers her head and rests her hands against her belly.{/n} "I… I'm expecting a baby… But… because of the journey... or of all the worries... something must have gone wrong. It hurts..." {n}Olika closes her eyes tightly.{/n} "And I bleed."
2e29e810-751b-4fb9-8ccc-3be8170c233e: {n}Olika starts sobbing.{/n} "I tried! I tried to find out what's wrong! To heal myself! To appease the gods! The priest of {g|Pharasma}Pharasma{/g} told me he couldn't help — the goddess rejected my child, said it would be born dead!"
9abfde57-2a76-4da2-932d-8a4a54fcf8a7: {n}You recall the location of {g|Galt}Galt{/g} and Gralton. As far as you know, {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} lay aside from the places Olika had named.{/n}
536740f9-69d0-443b-8c0c-e76873a8b82f: {n}Olika straightens the folds of her dress and puts her hands over her belly.{/n}
5cfb7d42-b76d-43b9-9fc2-0ba66e2ef140: {n}Olika hesitates, then takes a key out from her cloak and hands it to you without a word.{/n}
14c10155-7ed4-4264-8dff-65111b469340: "But I can't... can't just accept it. I can't give up. This child... my husband's child... all I have left of him..." {n}Olika hides her face behind her hands and starts to weep. You realize you'll get nothing more from her at the moment.{/n}
3b605629-8770-4b6f-8989-d3fefec66ecf: {n}A memory of Olika's letter emerges from the depths of your mind. She mentioned her son in that letter, but now there is no child by her mother. It's odd that Olika, who's been planning to stay at Gralton, didn't bring her son with her. {/n}
7031a77b-2e6b-4964-9e49-7ab32e7e8ab2: "You must have forgotten already, but… it was you who discovered my {d|Leksen}husband's{/d} body. A trader, died on one of his trips. You found a brooch and a letter on his body, and had it sent to me."

5fbd0da9-3ab8-447f-8688-2e4bd871dfb4: "You were chosen by Abraxas himself. The signs showed us the way. Your deeds are proof to any with eyes to see: here is the one who knows no boundaries! Here is the vessel worthy of the forbidden knowledge possessed by the blackest and cruelest of demons. Tales of your glory has reached Abraxas — and he led us here to prepare the ritual and await your coming."
9c91b04c-99b0-4abe-97c4-8a88ff50bbb2: {n}The elf lowers his head.{/n} "You joke with us, the Named. We are the hand of Abraxas, Master of the Final Incantation and keeper of forbidden knowledge. We are the ones who shall led the way for the Named, who will embody the wisdom of our lord."
a48939f1-5672-4b04-92ef-5775df2958ee: "The great lord of the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g}, more ancient than the world itself. Witness to history, he discovered mysteries long buried under the ashes of ages. His mind stores forbidden knowledge which he is ready to share with his chosen ones – those who have no fear of his gift. And he has chosen you, the Named."
e27b7652-619b-4335-8eda-274a1e62e73e: "For such is the will of our lord." {n}The elf sighs, as if gathering his strength.{/n} "We mustn't waste time: we have prepared for your arrival, o the Named. We are ready. Are you?"
9bf626f0-8b15-4732-9c40-059b9e1bef98: {n}The elf looks up, his voice is trembling with anticipation.{/n} "Then step into the magic circle, the Named, and accept your fate!"
08119cdf-7d8d-4ee2-8d1a-9e29bc7b3bd1: "There's no soul blacker than yours in all of Avistan. You came here following the trail of innocent blood. You are ready to accept the gift of Abraxas. As soon as we begin reading the spell, step into the circle — and your mind will become a vessel of power unknown to all of Golarion! Abraxas himself will share his wisdom with you and bestow upon you knowledge other mortals can only dream of!"
39b261d1-b8ea-41c2-9b41-012059c31a24: {n}The elf hisses through his teeth.{/n} "False prophet! We will wash away this insult with your blood!"
d3a7561d-881d-4b73-bcc0-1dcb971d3999: {n}The light in your eyes dims, and your mind is filled with a horrendous torrent of noise, which threatens to crack your skull open from the inside. You try to move, but your body refuses to obey. You are bound by another's will. Through the excruciating pain that pulses in your temples, you sense a strange, dark presence.{/n}
494bb54f-266b-4d06-867b-633716c75967: "You cannot just turn away from your fate, the Named. Accept your fate – or pay for your deception with blood!"
9c81bdd2-fcee-4605-995d-348c164a063a: {n}The deafening noise begins to fade, and the pain in your temples diminishes. You catch echoes of strange thoughts and knowledge in languages you do not speak, too complex and strange for you to comprehend. At last you feel the farewell touch of the evil being that only a moment ago fully possessed you. The strange mind, having bestowed its gift upon you, leaves you with his final message.{/n}
744c2b6d-bc62-4393-ba06-26cf8178fee6: "Nok-Nok has won, beaten your false king. Hail Nok-Nok!"
e6458a3e-a667-4f5f-a46f-7b58fe2d2b9b: "Raise your weapons to Nok-Nok, you beasts – he's your new master now!"
e37cab1e-edec-4ee1-a85b-73cd25d4ba87: "Hold on – maybe the disappearance of the 'King' will drive them all away."
0ef9e9b4-ff31-4e76-aa81-6a26e6577155: [Attack] "We can't let them scatter! Strike now while they're surprised!"
03fdbdf2-8851-48d7-af73-6122fa40e92e: [Gesture at surrounding crowd] "You did it, Nok-Nok. You wanted to be a Hero – here you are."
e3ed6aec-4a68-45b0-8f94-d4e6e3e493e2: "Nok-Nok, just stand still and enjoy this."
866e9d05-a70f-4adc-bd5f-b0fe8040bb46: {n}Nok-Nok is picking himself up, but it's clear he has no idea what to do next, oblivious to the potential threats waking up around him, still rubbing his face to brush off the blood and ash... and he's starting to glance around, distractedly looking for his teeth.{/n}
988b0a19-8953-4b3b-9d86-219da32e7ab8:
{n}The surrounding creatures jump at your words, including Nok-Nok – he then watches as the eyes turn to him.
Then, one at first, then more, the goblins begin to strike the butt of their weapons against the ground… slowly, then faster and faster, doing two quick strikes, a pause, and two strikes again.{/n}
f7ba37af-ebc3-4352-8089-62ca225358c2: {n}The creatures, at the defeat of their King, file away slowly, melting back into the trees, until it's only you and Nok-Nok again. It's time to go.{/n}
aa427f96-8665-426e-818b-39a870b5e0d2: "Stab time! But need talk to you later. Need... something."
9813c8b1-aaf9-4388-a021-80a03bcd31b4: {n}Even Munguk, puzzled, begins to join in, pounding the butt of his club unsteadily into the ground, then smiling, he pounds the club faster and faster... he must be really drunk or was really under the barghest's spell. Or arguably both.{/n}
53d24c04-237a-4909-9d5f-0595a59e1daa: {n}Nok-Nok looks enthralled. He does quarter-turns, looking at all the goblins worshipping him, his jaw agape. You notice he's still a bit unsteady, and swaying slightly.{/n}
34350cdd-89dd-422b-b5db-abb39b8f25c3:
{n}Nok-Nok, as dizzy as he is, listens to you – he stops turning, and plants his feet firmly to prevent himself from collapsing, accidentally striking a heroic pose by doing so.
The drumming of spears continues, and he puffs up proudly – while you hope it doesn't go to his head, you silently remind yourself that it wouldn't stay there long anyway.{/n}
b95b021f-0e42-4949-898d-1e92ea4010f3: "Dead! You're dead, you wretch! Ha ha ha, finally!" {n}Regongar kicks Janush's corpse, laughing happily.{/n}
7230f69a-8ba9-40a1-8727-5f4bd6936f61: "You know, I thought I would be happy, but... for some reason, I don't feel anything. Nothing at all. Well, he's dead now. Serves him right."
107a4e09-a44e-4209-8c6d-dd02d6af8b6f: "You just haven't gotten into it. Get a good, close look at his face. Remember how he'd send us to be whipped? Smirking all the while? Of course you do! Come on, give him a kick in the teeth!"
0535c200-8b59-4a77-a703-5499168b9c4e: {n}Octavia kicks the dead man's face with no enthusiasm. Then again, and a smile appears on her face. Soon Octavia and Regongar are both kicking the dead body repeatedly, roaring with laughter all the while.{/n}
3c388255-1214-49b5-92a8-70f4f2115a93: "Ha ha ha! Oh, Reg... You were right. I feel so much better now... It was all worth it!"
0e90b4ce-6216-4765-8887-e5fb0e5063d0: "Why would the Swordlords care about Varnhold?"
5c583cd8-3ed0-4a4d-bd52-1418336d463c: "And why should I drop everything and rush to help the Swordlords? I suppose that question would be better addressed to Lady Aldori. Prepare the letter and send it immediately — I won't let some Restovic upstarts tell me what to do, as if I were some servant."
c1e36225-c8ea-4c04-9e44-8aba96abe0b9: "Varnhold isn't far off. We should find out what happened there before the same fate befalls us too."
ac33eb90-36eb-4ffe-93b5-b160a0a1383d: "What do you think has happened to Varnhold?"
65e191f8-2457-4d15-b9a7-51cf2638a57d: "Maybe Varn simply decided to stop dealing with Restov?"
ba81152e-4e23-4162-bb75-c72e94849776: "Your Grace, we have urgent news from Jamandi Aldori! The Swordlord is asking for aid with an unusual problem. Here is {g|JamandiVarnholdTrouble}her letter{/g} — please read it when you have a moment."
fa358e07-0270-4a56-9c19-79ab6ef93c6c: "Greetings, Your Grace. I have {g|JamandiVarnholdTrouble}an urgent message{/g} from Jamandi Aldori. It seems the {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g} have — again — proved their inability to rule their subjects. See for yourself — here's the message from Jamandi."
eb650d79-dfaf-4e67-9a01-52913623ec2b: "I bring tidings in good measure — and bad. As for the good, it seems the {g|Restov}Restov{/g} Swordlord Jamandi Aldori honors us with her attention. She jotted you {g|JamandiVarnholdTrouble}a nice little letter{/g}. The bad tidings? She wants us to prove ourselves worthy of such recognition."
cbf082d5-5904-4f05-a7c2-da36b9de314d: "She writes that a while ago she stopped receiving reports from {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} — a neighboring barony, established by the Swordlords' protege, {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d}. But it is not only letters that stopped coming — trade caravans, couriers, all traffic from Varnhold has ceased. It is as if the barony has disappeared."
467267f9-a9cc-48fa-b99b-bd525d3f9a63: "Jamandi Aldori expects your help with this matter, for she knows of your good relations with Maegar. She asks you to go to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} and find out why they have fallen silent."
29a3068a-0ef9-4987-930c-c27f0f1db46f: "Jamandi Aldori seeks allies with anyone who has proven to be trustworthy — even if only a little. Considering that {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} is the closest thing to an outpost on the east edge of the {g|River Kingdoms}River Kingdoms{/g}, it's also useful to her in keeping an eye on {g|Dunsward}Dunsward{/g} and the surrounding area."
9fb0140e-fe28-4af1-95ac-eb24740ae454: "I appreciate your determination in solving diplomatic issues — though, in my opinion, you may wish to massage your wording somewhat. I'll send the letter to {g|Restov}Restov{/g} immediately."
70b2889d-85a3-4be2-bcbc-57615119cbd7: "This barony is much alike your own. It was also established by a mercenary, {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d}. He got his title at the same event you did."
b682fa72-3ce2-4238-87ea-f5a3d36da83f: "Then it's time to gather a party and head to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}, Your Grace."
ebc3a856-8dee-48da-98cb-f40b757e8df0: "{d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d} is third or fourth son in the family, so he couldn't claim his father's inheritance. Looks like he hoped to establish a settlement of his own and gain wealth and prosperity that way."
dd930a13-1afb-400a-a998-7bf86456601f: "Hmmm... a riot? A rebellion? But if that were the case, there would be refugees. Whatever happened there, it must have been sudden indeed — perhaps a bandit attack, barbarians, a plague… whatever it was, no one outside {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} seems to know what happened."
5ac54445-2088-4991-be8f-97f70f6f1c5b: "Judging by Aldori's letter, the silence doesn't seem voluntary. Otherwise at least one person would have reached a neighbor and spoken about what had happened there."
a767dd3d-2943-4c82-831b-4950d52b1a78: "You really know how to talk to those insolent {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g}! I'll just go ahead and add some lines of my own to your letter."
ca272084-50b1-4c54-8391-41a6d0feb38a: "How dare you, {mf|baron|baroness}?! You owe much to Lady Jamandi, yet you repay her with insults? Fine, I'll compose the letter, though I'll use milder expressions — as for you, you should go and solve the mystery of {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}!"
50f2f9c7-d0c1-43b5-a7b0-4cee012c9523: "Lady Aldori asks you to head to {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g} at once — it's a barony led by {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d}, a brave soul who carved out the settlement from the wilderness. Until recently he eagerly... and frequently... relayed to the {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g} his many successes, but then the letters suddenly ceased. As you may expect, this is a matter of some concern!"
c1af8cd6-e9f1-41eb-8b71-55d020a49d26: "Remember that annoying {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d}, who couldn't stop pestering you? Seems like he grew tired of Aldori's leash, so he stopped answering the {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g}' letters. But Varn alone wouldn't raise so much concern — according to the letter, the settlement itself seems to have vanished!"
ba09d197-18e2-4552-97fa-b7169d3b30b5: "Bless us, oh goddess. Give us wings, and your blight shall soar. Give us power, and all shall fulfill your will..."
2ac6d3bd-93c1-4e6d-9834-b9a36d65b2cf: "I eat and drink to the glory of Lady Despair. I take from life, to give to death. I take from the poor, to feed the sated..."
73136bc8-8717-4771-90b4-72cd8e49e4b6: "Ugh... By the gods... Ahem, friends, I'm not hungry at all today! Who wants my share?"
9220f200-823e-4c2a-acd0-1f946fec561a: "Oh. And I thought that after that giant centipede dissection nothing would ever ruin my appetite again..."
e4883763-3ad8-4276-ba01-08dd500a02bf: "Oh, it's bad luck to keep company with the dead. And having one of those in a party..."
fa2c988a-1388-46f3-a3e5-3f1b4b7786f8: "Chomp chomp chomp... What? She-dead wasn't eating hers anyway!"
16cd397c-4cd2-4ad0-afdb-64bdea4f9b1d: "Linzi said it was you who discovered that the throne was missing."
0a40ebd7-ed9c-4680-b6b9-f1ca59a18fae: "I don't remember hiring a guard captain... or any guards, for that matter."
d2b2ed83-80dd-4b35-80f9-b98bc6ef2fe3: "I like to learn something about those who serve me."
1463ee2c-8c04-4353-b4d4-a2078588ba4a: "Hyland, do the guards have everything they need?"
90f4112a-a83c-4e5f-9e03-1a4871dda403: "I have to go. Have a quiet shift!"
254e0462-a9ae-42a6-bc42-f3414702c3a4: "How did your folks feel about the Irovetti story?"
b0778a7d-310a-43a1-b9eb-c0a2d75256e9: {n}The captain of the guard nods to you.{/n} "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}."
b5178659-f1da-40f6-b59f-be2389284596: {n}The captain grows gloomy.{/n} "Yes, Your Highness." {n}He keeps silence for a moment, and continues, obviously embarrassed.{/n} "Actually, Your Highness... Please don't think me a fool or a drunkard..."
4858e7f0-7927-452c-9cf9-44490b0c9f63: "As I walked to the throne room... at first I thought it was a vision, and didn't think much of it. Well, I thought I saw your throne in the corridor. And it was... running away."
48decaed-013e-4656-a3da-18fac027215e: "Not by itself, of course! I just couldn't see who was carrying it. Perhaps someone really tiny had got underneath it. And my — how they and ran! It seemed the throne turned the corner by itself. But the sight was strange beyond belief, so I thought I was simply too tired and had started seeing things. A moment later, when I discovered it was really missing, I rushed after it — but it had vanished into thin air. Maybe it was... you know... magic?"
683234e5-0aaf-4a21-954f-62c3dd2be5d9: "I came here from {g|Restov}Restov{/g} with a dozen of my best guards, by order of Lady Jamandi Aldori, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. I hired the rest from among the locals."
d1378e47-650e-4b16-a34c-6f7646c38cf9: "Of course, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. I have been a guard all my life — I started a snot-nosed runt in the night watch. {g|Restov}Restov{/g} is famous for its fencing schools. Young people from all the {g|River Kingdoms}River Kingdoms{/g} come to study there. It seems every other person has a sword... and every third thinks they know how to use it better than all the rest! A misspoken word or drunken fight can quickly lead to a stabbing rampage. That's why there are so many guards in the city — and they don't accept just anyone. Lady Jamandi took note of my achievements and marked me for advancement. That's why I'm here."
b529174a-db63-4078-ad03-e11ac541b45e: "There are sufficient munitions and supplies, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. The salary is fair: we've enough to buy toys for the kids and a jug of beer when the shift is done. Of course, the town is growing — it would be nice to expand the ranks... but we can manage that ourselves."
277f83e2-5877-42db-b08d-5baa655fd538: "Don't you worry, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}! We are now the subjects of the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}. We've sworn to serve you faithfully and loyally, and you can count on us! Besides, we draw our salary from your chests..."
71631c79-bb29-4edb-9c48-aff5051d053f: {n}The captain looks at the female guard, raising his brow, then sighs and looks at you.{/n} "Of course. Every one of us is ready to die to protecting {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}... but there's still some work to be done when it comes to discipline. You know that dwarven author… Baldric Zebras? Garlic Tundras? The name escapes me... My boneheads use to read his books about guard's duty right on guard duty. I'll have to teach them lesson or two!"
5566f1a6-e5b3-40fa-8903-b373c106bc25: "Hyland, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. Captain of the city guard."
1ce92aaf-5ba5-4e60-8ef5-f28f792643c9: {n}A young dwarf girl salutes you awkwardly.{/n} "Delia, assistant to the captain. Happy to serve {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}!"
5c53f3d9-70c8-405e-8693-959c69efe8be: {n}You see a stout man, suited in well-worn armor. His face is framed with silvery stubble, and his fleshy nose is red and pock-marked. He radiates perfect calm. As you approach, he bows — respectfully and with dignity.{/n}
8807efa0-af18-4bbb-a3fb-eba238006ca5: "As for Delia, I found her on the street. About a decade ago. I remember vividly — a tiny dwarf girl sitting on the temple steps. Dirty face, barefoot, feeding a piece of bread to a stray cat. I saw her and my heart missed a beat..." {n}The captain looks away.{/n} "Where she's from, who left her alone and why — only {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} knows. As she grew, I tried to send her to learn a craft — but who can talk sense into a dwarf?! She wanted to be a guard, and that's that. So now I'm teaching her myself. Lucky she has a head on her shoulders, and a fair bit of strength."
9161ff52-6a1b-47ac-a9f8-addf7eb6e23c: "Oh, uncle, when are you going to change that old armor! The magic beasts crumpled it so badly, it makes me cry to look at it!"
3b6d574e-a967-4fd2-a140-3a253d9202c4: "Oh, you still have a lot to learn. If only you knew how many times it saved my life in that battle..." {n}Hyland turns to you.{/n} "Greetings, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}."
0f20d64d-2f6a-49ef-bfee-ceaaa2956b14: "How's one supposed to feel? He was a crook and a trickster, and everyone knew it. He got what he deserved, and it's all for the good — for {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, and for all their neighbors. Everyone sleeps better now."
8dd9b10e-0e2b-4bb4-8c90-3913707370d1: "We didn't believe for a moment all the dirty rumors he spread about you!"
36883b46-29b3-4a4e-af83-8bbd92cc5cf0: "...why don't you explain why you're staring at me like that?"
e10cdf79-47a7-4109-98a6-e1b20a7e7a86: "You say we could be useful to each other?"
eccad14b-a27e-4c50-9d4d-1680fb982ada: [Attack] "Your words will not save you, monster!"
be6690b8-483c-4340-b7d0-65087430b374: "What do you know of the war between the kobolds and mites?"
ec82adcf-497a-4df0-b010-ecc95e0f9f9b: "No, I am not interested in this."
6e3f3852-ee6c-4ccf-9379-d067348e7d94: "If you're hungry, then hunt. I see no point in interfering with the natural order of things."
02e639d5-db4a-4ed4-a795-3c2508a4c47f: {n}The beast before you is unusually large, and its eyes, especially angry. Its menacing grin might almost be taken for a smirk.{/n}
1ec68b4d-dcc3-443e-86fe-21ec537c44a5: "Greetings, traveler. Before you draw your weapon, I wish to say I see no reason for feuding between us. We might even be of some use to each other."
a65fdf95-9b7b-468c-b46a-effd2acf293d: "Only that my pack enjoys it."{n} The worg snorts and licks his lips.{/n} "Of course, I only eat fresh meat..."
e63b8fc6-ed57-41d7-ab94-157c72e1fa3a: "You may call me Grarrukh. I've lived here far longer than the rulers of those foolish tribes... I have seen much, and eaten many."
5cb48717-bbd6-49d0-bfa0-cbda59482bfc: "Bring me someone delicious. Three or four bodies will be enough. And I, as a sign of gratitude, will tell you where an old traveler buried his chest."
f2af6a36-e538-4470-8871-5c9fc16438e2: {n}Grinning, the worg looks straight at you.{/n}"Deal! I'll await your return."
b57e30b2-df56-417a-8e7b-01730b15dd8e: "Well, as you wish. But consider my offer... You may yet think of something."
ecce3fa6-b467-4846-8b86-fefc2c57605e: "Truth be told, I should thank you — finally, a decent meal! It is a pleasure to deal with you. The chest is buried under a lonely tree to the west."
69cb6dcb-0fe0-43ae-85fb-7fbf730c2f69: "Wait, why is this wolf talking? Is it magical or something?"
ce7cbf68-aa38-443f-8f63-e4ff387a69cf: "I am no wolf, female. I am a worg. Surprising you could live to your age without learning the difference. Well, it's never too late to teach a lesson to an insolent two-legged morsel..." {n}The beast slowly licks its teeth.{/n}"
6cef158e-3321-44c7-a79b-ab94b0d04290: "Who are you calling a morsel, you pelt?" {n}Amiri glares at the beast, her hand on her sword.{/n}"
5ca65717-a50f-4c04-a71f-8c4d4b9c21f8: "A very old, lean and flavorless traveler." {n}The warg grins, almost smiling.{/n}
8152332e-8e90-4e85-b985-8cf0b53b8cee: "Right! We're not going to start a chat with every stray mutt we come across!"
d7026a31-6137-4242-b39b-bc7846ac34c7: "How could you agree to such a monstrous deal?" {n}Tristian shakes his head slowly.{/n}
6b295333-9676-444a-b81a-20f02ab3b450: "This creature is filled with irredeemable evil. Sarenrae, guide my blade!"
1c1bb045-9bed-4183-92fa-97265f2d271c: "We cannot leave such dangerous animals to live in our future lands. Slay the beast!"
8f020338-c5b8-4177-957f-46d600093594: "Auch, a bruise. But the ear is still here at least."
10f6a323-6228-4096-81dc-aa824ba2cd95: "I know that I just waste my words… but didn't you think of entering combat with less abandon? You almost got your hand cut off in the last fight!"
82625f2a-075e-40e0-9aa9-b61761990742: "Let me see to your wound. And don't tear off the dressing, please. And don't hang dead mice on it either."
e86b35d0-ef19-49de-9264-1f0071a73bb7: "We are running short of supplies. I hope there are people in this party ready to hunt — or ready to go without food until we replenish our stocks."
72de3822-7f29-4555-beff-ea0ffa4e127f: "Our supplies are running low. Either we find a way to replenish our provisions, or we'll have to tighten our belts."
0aa030a0-7325-4010-aac6-4446cdea5fa3: "Oh, I can do without food for a long time! Sometimes no one fed us slaves for several days in a row!"
710aa70c-de7d-4ae8-bb8b-2c3008f5ba27: "It's no fun with no chow. We should bring more next time."
f0ac124d-261d-4bb4-b48c-b39911bb659e: "The food will come. By the hunt or by trade."
3d0e87c1-624a-416f-8dbc-6d73d0fb5d54: "The general speaks the truth. A few more days, and we'll be drinking pine bark soup."
972b34ac-8134-4139-89f7-3b34c4eaf927: "Guards! Take her. Send her head to Irovetti as our reply!"
35e1dbb5-36ee-4056-838b-6672e387c349: {n}The emblem of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} glistens on the messenger's chest. She stands proudly and speaks her words bold and clear:{/n} "Your Highness, {Name} the First! I have a message for you from Irovetti, King of Pitax."
b55cb268-3e6a-47d9-9900-ae48eb707e6b: {n}Your guards disarm the screaming messenger and drag her away.{/n}

1ff41f3a-1af3-48be-94ea-b9e31f2b83ef: "Just imagine, Tristian, how many new opportunities this would bring. Your youth would never fade. You'd never need sleep nor rest. All your time could be devoted to saving innocent lives and praying to Sarenrae."

957f7c7a-c7df-41b3-a8ab-49e218fd1edd: "And yet Valerie observed all the rules. She came when Fredero called her. She accepted the challenge. Will none of this be taken into consideration?"

3a3746b7-ce1d-4316-9f37-e57d6ae600a5: [Whisper to Valerie] "Don't let him make you angry. It's what he wants!"
d12b0d0b-64e1-4ef9-bcf2-3c067c73a46e: "Valerie defeated Fredero in a duel and slew him on my orders. Leave her be!"
b6d4ba9b-21d0-4033-ac70-ff3aaed976ce: [Lie] "We don't know anyone named Fredero Sinnet."

404e57f1-6377-407c-9e40-d9f1957d95d4: [Whisper to Eveld] "If I were you, I wouldn't accuse the one who serves the {mf|Baron|Baroness|King|Queen} of the Stolen Lands. Anything could happen in these parts."

60fa1133-f159-4560-8f96-db0346138ada: [Lie] "We don't know anyone named Fredero Sinnet."
c2595028-f209-4d6d-929a-eb7bae4f5f96: "{g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} divine trial has commenced! May she be merciful to the lost and confused. It is time to listen to all sides, and decide what fate awaits Valerie."
e37ec26b-2491-4ed0-9ae2-ee8fbed67385: "Today, under the vaulting of the Temple of Prisms, we, followers of the goddess, will give you, Valerie, a chance to redeem yourself in the eyes of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}, and..."
68ddb3a0-8577-48bd-ba26-851e86e10954: "Enough, Laryen. Everybody present knows she doesn't deserve redemption. She lost the right to forgiveness on the day she rejected {g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} grace!"
ff5ccd7c-bbad-4d3c-8508-1a84f97513c7: {n}Fredero Sinnet clears his throat to attract everyone's attention.{/n} "I didn't come here to stand silent like an idol. 2f0f6292-32e8-4bf5-9653-886415d2aa43: "I didn't leave the order to look for lost paladins. If {g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} followers think it's my job to keep an eye on all her henchmen, they're deeply mistaken!"
2a33dff4-a53b-4c7e-9fe9-07c252aeecca: {n}Valerie looks down. She tries to say something, but can't force out a single word.{/n}
3173e2b4-82a9-4c1b-bfc8-dc7db827e941: {n}Valerie scoffs.{/n} "I don't care about you, let alone respect you! I just wanted to teach you a lesson and make you leave me alone!"
a24fa118-ea56-45ae-8433-7bba9d5b9504: "I never wanted to insult anyone. All I wanted – all I dreamed of – was to choose my own way!"
106688b2-33a6-458d-b636-446edc88f5da: {n}Valerie clenches her fists.{/n} "Yes! The paladin challenged me. Why am I to save him from the consequences of his own actions? I did what I thought was right, not what a goddess – who I don't even care about – might want me to!"
1c4eb462-c5e6-490f-829b-e257fb4d4760: "There's truth in the {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}'s words. You can hardly blame Valerie for losing her temper, after being stripped of her beauty so cruelly."
e8544544-2f4a-472c-baa2-eebeba3a74eb: "Of course! You can't ignore a person's deeds, even when their words are bitter!"
4b3e212b-16b7-4666-8979-41c72050ef1d: "Honest words. Believe me, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}, none of those present have any illusions about Valerie!"
5d096130-f2d4-4362-b6eb-1ecbd5c874bb: "Enough about Fredero. We don't have that much time, and Valerie gives us much to consider. According to her masters at the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g}, she's always been noble and merciful."
8adf9d7e-ab09-4532-9c30-a555d5951a03: "Really? Rumors from {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} tell otherwise! Valerie {d|c0 Let People Burn}abandoned{/d} innocent people to die in the fiery inferno at Jamandi Aldori's house! And why? Simply because she was ordered to!"
b6797dd7-9395-4d1c-9050-494ae1f85940: "Stories about the valor she showed in {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} spread far beyond its borders. How many did this fearless warrior {d|c0 Saved People}save{/d} from the fire at Jamandi Aldori's house? They and many others owe their lives to her."
ff88e36a-2009-4069-a018-524d77b3ea9c: {n}Valerie talks quickly, her face blushing.{/n} "I didn't have time to look about! To appraise the situation! That attack... The murderers..."
3a0e0791-7689-48b4-b60a-8fb5f25872df: {n}Valerie opens her mouth but then sighs and lowers her head without saying anything.{/n}
c5f1ba5a-ad4d-4057-9092-973898ba7202: {n}Valerie throws a lock of hair from her face pensively, but then her lips form an angry sneer.{/n} "Right. There's no comparing such dramatically different numbers."
c5a68396-4b36-4afd-a530-361312a4b3db: "Jamandi Aldori herself was in danger! How could I risk the life of a Swordlord?!"
aa7f2104-7b8f-42e4-9b53-b1976cbd0d6d: "I remember it well. The one I was able to save from the flames. The others..." {n}Valerie stops.{/n} "I'm sorry."
3b460d53-f65e-4ca3-8ed3-fefe40edc851: "Oh, don't ascribe mercy to my actions – and don't drag your {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} into this! I obeyed an order – that's all!"
5b60e698-f1ba-4e44-9819-d3eb5585dcbd: "I only did what I had to. No more and no less."
a176a2a9-63a6-4190-b824-4f5c2196acda: "Enough! I'm tired of this endless babble. I shall prove that Valerie is a capricious and dishonorable woman who has twisted her life to pursue a single goal: to harm everything that is precious to {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}!"
14823637-884e-441b-9196-7ab2ad2a44e7: "I have a reliable witness who can confirm my statement. I present – Sir Eveld!
7740fec9-499d-4649-a3bc-33f63b25612e: {n}Eveld pushes his chest out and pulls his chin up.{/n} "This lady insulted me in front of my audience – for no reason at all! Arrested me with brutal force! 628635a2-bd20-4113-a745-bbef11b6bce2: {n}Eveld rocks on his heels pensively.{/n} "Well, Sir Hegend, actually Valerie did express her {d|Valerie Support Eveld}apologies{/d} for all the inconvenience she caused. Who would I be if I started digging up the past?"
62567604-a2a5-423d-b21e-8078d1c622f5: {n}Laryen raises a brow and looks at Eveld over his glasses.{/n} "Oh? Was this man's art meant to do harm?"
3588dbba-5997-4ec7-9f41-1b09249ae7b8: {n}Eveld waves off the notion.{/n} "Impertinent. Art is meant to arouse minds, not beget violence!"
1355715c-0bc3-4cbf-92cf-b8980cc301d2: {n}Valerie allows herself a shadow of a smile.{/n} "Very true. But if I hadn't apologized, he might have died of sorrow."
d7f909db-0735-4c2e-8da0-6c7b3045c2c9: {n}Valerie casts a tired look at you.{/n}
ef9bed19-f835-48f3-b4d1-fbd0256e5fd4: {n}Valerie raises her head and takes a deep breath – as if awakening from a deep sleep. She looks at the temple's decorations and raises her hand.{/n} "I've stood here listening to your arguments for long enough. Now it's my turn to speak."
c07aa46f-cd71-460f-92dd-fc5eb990f74a: "For several months, the {g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} followers made my life a torture. Why? Because I refused to obey someone else's will. 9f8082e9-416e-40f3-b040-b7ddb68d787c: "My departure from the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g} was not an insult to {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} or her followers.
