5afc871c-c21b-4aaa-a768-26365b138c15: "Cyclopes... A great empire, great power, so many lives. Now, all gone — and all that remains are tombs and graves. I see the hand of Groetus in this."
bd465fa2-d38b-42db-b5a9-8115bf9f36f1: "They must have been weaklings, so they all died out. If you want to survive, you must fight no matter what."
56b98f0f-abd5-4597-90b3-a9440722293a: "But here we are, long after they're gone. Life, and the struggle for good — this will always return and prevail in the end."
5429591d-45bd-4bd8-b3c8-c7bf3abe1157: "They grew callous, overwhelmed by their darkest passions — and died. Thus is the fate of all who sink into insanity and evil."
113d5062-4964-41bc-b902-644fba92fcc8: "What's so great about some dead meat? Goblins are great! — You can kill us all you want. We will sneak, hide and survive!"
79d386c5-d724-41e2-89ce-0a8d604dd588: [Try to shove Ekun closer to Elina] "Ekun, my friend, could you crowd me so..."
6469c5fc-a043-4db0-9bf1-38fdc8b24238: "And now I'd like to play something special for you. I haven't composed anything for a while, but this is a special occasion..." {n}Striking a theatrical pose, Linzi begins to play.{/n}
23a58d3f-d8ba-46da-9be5-de75e1451811: {n}Ekun quietly takes a place next to you.{/n}
a250275f-62bb-403d-bc5d-eb998befffa3: {n}Music starts flowing. Linzi's performance isn't perfect, but it is deep and emotional. One cadence follows another, and music echoes among the trees...{/n}
6f1f372b-6f6f-402f-a1a6-6a03a491683c: {n}Suddenly you notice that Ekun is standing much closer than you thought. You realize he's slowly moving closer to you, fidgeting from foot to foot and trying not to look at anyone...{/n}
201a534c-7138-4e22-a391-151b39622591: {n}...at the same time Elina is trying to lean closer and closer to Ekun, trying to touch his shoulder! Noticing your look, she gives you a sharp look.{/n}
e177ee49-8b8a-4f1d-ba33-4d011247b76b: {n}Turning red as a beet, Ekun whispers an apology and moves towards Elina. She grabs Ekun by the arm, looking at you gratefully.{/n}
ec1c2bfb-12cc-4ef4-9250-3fb15ce39236: {n}Finally Linzi strikes the final chord, and the sound fades. Pleased with her performance, Linzi receives well-deserved applause.{/n}
2f15a9cf-fab4-462a-9bae-4b6951e44cea: "My friends, let's raise our glasses! Let's celebrate our adventures — and that we have others to share them with! Also let's thank Elina for a generous feast — the evening was wonderful!"
a1691da0-3238-481d-b5e4-305626a66dfb: {n}You take a step, and Ekun does the same. Elina pouts and looks away.{/n}
ee8d0076-847a-438c-901e-f8373d0d66bf: "I can't believe our adventure finally begins! I'm so happy to be here! And I do hope we will become trusted companions... and perhaps even true friends!"
7a687633-4e3b-42ac-a79a-7c523760801a: "Oh, yes, certainly. Could you pass the salt?"
d2547011-ad46-4eab-af14-f158b2fa8654: "Ha ha ha, that's the spirit! Well I for one am glad to be here too. Maybe this truly is the beginning of something wonderful!"
dccb0b0d-2bae-41e6-b511-7e0fac7787ad: "Such sad, deserted lands. Lawlessness always leads to desolation and emptiness."
3ff3050f-de0a-48f1-9de7-ce1dbd4f1ed5: "I wouldn't know. Galt is no more orderly — but it's nowhere near as desolate."
7bd9ec2e-7ac2-4889-b082-5d23d59e0b24: "Trust me, law and order can be twisted into the service of evil, and spawn even more cruelty and suffering."
6258f05a-1f97-423d-bf6e-bb17dbfae4f1: "Law and freedom balance each other like two ends of the scales. Both can lead to evil, unless tempered with compassion."
67a3a806-5fbf-4890-a2fa-5c2dc30d20db: "Why does every noble who so much as glances at me deem it necessary to compose embarrassing odes to me? Why not give me a new pair of boots, for instance?"
1c6aa633-e217-418e-92c6-4ef384f5a795: "You obviously mean something more personal, but I do agree! One can accept odes from a poor joyful bard, but a noble should give precious gifts, or one doubts their generosity."
8cf43caf-b39f-41cc-b303-9fa708502e17: "Don't you have some other pressing business to attend? Perhaps Jamandi's quest — the search for the Stag Lord?"
86c1cce9-731c-4dfd-891f-e0fc27415502: "Get to the point, Tartuccio. I know you're looking for an artifact — and you're planning to use it against me."
ecf60ac0-c26d-4d54-9943-146f359137ba: [Attack] "A barony cannot have two lords. You'll just have to... disappear!"
4d330d43-9582-4f82-ab9b-0fe7e21e7426: "Linzi, don't you think it's the perfect time to throw away that silly draft and start a real book? You already have a great protagonist — me!"
be32b49c-2193-4c0f-b2f3-dee4eace0192: "Valerie, I would say you and your sword can find greater glory than in service to Tartuccio. He summoned you to fight the Stag Lord's bandits, but now uses you for more questionable dealings."
83bdc846-9661-4224-ac57-31017b5cbb83: "Jaethal, isn't Tartuccio's arrogance long past what you can suffer? I can find far better use for a companion such as you."
07ec2903-74f7-4b1f-ab73-046028907ad3: "Harrim, I would be happy to see you among my companions. Your faith does not oblige you to follow fools and liars like Tartuccio."
2ddcec51-b57d-4388-89df-b3089c4379ab: {n}A gnome in gaudy purple garb seizes your attention. Of course — the scoundrel Tartuccio, who you know from your time in {g|Restov}Restov{/g}. The vile gnome is standing on a small hill, expressing his discontentment in every way he can muster.{/n}
4042d6d2-53b8-455f-bc95-e2a8c5c5e4dd: "Let me guess — you're still dawdling?" {n}Tartuccio scoffs at his underlings, unimpressed.{/n} "Should I make some tea in the meantime? Bake a pie, perhaps? Plant a small garden and harvest some cherries? Perhaps you'd be more comfortable wearing fools' caps and colored trousers? Then at least I'd be able to sell tickets. Come one, come all! Feast your eyes upon — "The Slowest and Most Ridiculous Buffoons on {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}!"
8b6acd5d-d8a6-424b-b714-c50d52ab815c: "Why hurry? The same end awaits us all."
88f5c781-d80c-4362-ab97-ca5cfaebc8cc: "Sir Tartuccio, I may serve you, but I am no one's slave. We do what we can, but it is no simple feat to find an unknown object in a vast dungeon."
18b7c280-7340-4252-a398-61b570c92a5b: "Achoo! Digging through a dusty dungeon, searching for I-don't-know-what. And all this frowning! Scold, scold, scold. This is not how I imagined adventures with the future baron! What am I ever going write my book about? How we labored to open a chest filled with dust?"
d13b8eb8-55da-427a-9503-8ea65bcb6ced: {n}Jaethal stares Tartuccio down.{/n} "Hold your tongue, gnome. I can hardly tell your twaddle from the buzzing of a fly."
c42bccb4-6460-4b01-a8e0-d0adafa5de39: "Quickly now. If we don't find that artifact soon, someone else might seize it. Someone... who's standing over there watching you right now, you fools!" {n}Tartuccio turns his angry gaze upon you. He nods to his guards to draw their weapons.{/n}
a186cbc4-35b5-4aff-9775-e172d277ffd3: "I might ask you the very same! Aren't you supposed to be searching the local forest for some bandit boss in a horned hat?"
63a4c88e-a918-4d3b-92d3-ffc6202b8678: "Looks like someone's grown fond of an imaginary crown... Over here, you fools — front and center! Cover my retreat!"
3efe3c4c-4e15-42cd-b203-5e7dee7867d9: {n}The gnome grins.{/n} "What ever did I do to deserve someone like you?! Here, you fools, drop your shovels — we're leaving! The rest of you — cover my retreat!"
21632622-182b-44f9-8565-5ab983f2f4da: {n}The little bard jumps for joy.{/n} "Yes! I shall overturn a new leaf! And on that leaf I shall pen a wonderful, thrilling story — of the victory of the future baron{mf||ess}! And the bitter defeat of {mf|his|her} malevolent, flatulent rival!" {n}Linzi sticks her tongue out at Tartuccio.{/n}
b489eae1-d5cd-47b1-bec2-c410b318b96b: {n}Linzi frowns.{/n} "Why do you say my story is silly?! You haven't even read it. Ach, a critic is born every minute. Why should I help you anyway?"
d0875d09-14aa-4831-a97e-1da2319c2210: {n}Valerie folds her arms across her chest.{/n} "You're right. Tartuccio has deceived us. A warrior who bows to a lie, who humiliates herself — there is no glory in this. I shall aid this scoundrel no more."
509d6d36-b017-40c0-a6d2-46cfc52bd6d3: {n}Valerie looks unconvinced.{/n} "There is truth in what you say, but a warrior cannot leave her commander on the easy words of a stranger."
ca496de5-b2d1-433d-ab84-b25e587866a4: {n}The elf looks at you for a brief moment, then nods silently. She draws her weapon and eyes Tartuccio coldly.{/n}
5b37cc1e-27b5-4a91-984f-b2d4f8b0c8fd: {n}The elf allows herself a faint smile, unkind and frightening.{/n} "Flattery cannot buy me, {race}."
1ea936c2-6fd0-4645-b07f-40b2bca8c475: {n}Harrim strokes his beard, brooding.{/n} "There is as much vanity in your words, as in the words of all who have not seen the wisdom of {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}. Yet you seem a worthier leader than the arrogant Tartuccio. Perhaps in serving you I shall open your eyes to the teachings of my faith."
367bf794-a4b0-41cd-ab5f-0ecc134cb42d: {n}Harrim pensively twists the strands of his beard between his fingers.{/n} "Side with you? I cannot say if there be sense in that. I am satisfied in serving Tartuccio, as much as anyone else. {g|Groetus}Groetus's{/g} peace awaits us all, in the end."
4b2e078b-36ea-4f5a-8175-51da668cbc1b: "I see my magnificent rival will stop at nothing, even at stealing the servants of {mf|his|her} enemy. Let us see if your fools are even more useless than mine! Draw your swords! And cover my retreat!"
9277c41e-ac11-44bf-96c6-e4f4eeedd688: "Still, why do you want to kill this monster? You passed this test back when you were with your tribe, didn't you?"
2a0e9282-a790-44bb-b9d8-40ecb2d16424: "Newcomer? You wanted to prove you're good enough to join my group?"
e0ded3b6-ac51-4b5c-b760-547f52ab8df0: "Ta vinh dự khi ngươi xem ta là một phần của bộ tộc mới của ngươi. Ngươi là một chiến binh mạnh mẽ và quả cảm."
a88df496-4a38-443d-9673-0a566b5f2b33: "Are you... embarrassed? I didn't think you were capable of that."
494c2343-56bc-4909-9cb7-9e148d28c288: "I don't like this whole 'tribe' idea. I only helped you. You owe me nothing."
7add6b9c-f2cf-4e5e-9733-4f4d034fb6f1: {n}Thở dốc, Amiri đứng trên xác con quái vật ngã gục.{/n} "Nói gì nào? Thấy ta hành động chứ? Ta suýt chặt phăng đầu nó rồi!"
633741ba-31d6-4a9b-8288-6356517e98af: "That's it! Trial done! Now no one dares say Amiri is weak!" {n}She grins and thrusts her chest out.{/n}
8e0e702f-70ad-4427-8fcb-2ab7a613589b: {n}Amiri snorts, and examines herself closely. After a few moments, she grunts.{/n} "Scratches."
f0619244-1c9b-468f-ab45-2f90e0498188: {n}Amiri's face reddens.{/n} "Well, yeah. True." {n}She scrapes the floor with her boot.{/n} "I'm in your tribe now. Kind of." {n}Her voice trails off, then falls silent.{/n}
88dae3e4-5406-4a63-80bb-f7e1776facb1: "You know what? If we meet another monster like this — I'll kill it too. Not for a test, just... Just that nobody would ever dare say Amiri isn't a warrior!"
1e8eca37-58d0-4c41-a1b4-143a04b04699: {n}Amiri's face reddens.{/n} "Well, not just pups must pass this test. If a man is newcomer to a tribe, he must bring a monster's hide. Proves he's not weak..." {n}Her voice trails off, then falls silent.{/n}
c9cf56df-a140-4289-b90f-80299d4b5b49: "Just don't start this... that..." {n}Amiri stops, trying to choose the right words.{/n} "Don't talk me about honor and valor. I know already!" {n} She frowns and turns away.{/n} "Still, I owe you thanks. You have a true chief's heart."
df0383a3-9d36-4ba3-a8b2-f218c802d7ed: {n}Amiri growls low in her throat.{/n} "I don't get embarrassed! I'm a warrior!" {n}She grunts.{/n} "Still, I owe you thanks. You have a true chief's heart."
11c35103-cbe8-48f0-b9a5-6e8871c76342: "What you know?" {n}Amiri shakes her head.{/n} "I don't waste time listen to you!" {n}She turns away and studies the area.{/n}
bd111f7f-7f3f-4747-a1c7-22728b4c5ba7: "You are a valiant warrior. Were there truly fools who doubted your strength?"
a6c5a3cb-4c3c-4881-bfef-19eddd23d11c: "Some did, you know... I spit on them! No one'll dare bark at me now!"
edf45357-88eb-48f0-8d8f-663b92608fd4: "Yes! A real epic battle, just like the sagas! I won't even have to embellish it for the book!"
21277170-c102-4912-8bf8-50b52b7d4022: "Barga no speak like borba yet," {n}the second troll says, stepping forward.{/n} "Barga new, came a day before." {n}He bends down and carefully touches the kobold's hand.{/n}
55008f67-3847-4622-877d-a87e0bbb84d6: {n}The bravest of the kobolds steps forward.{/n} "Garasssuk! Tartuk, ssshakasss. {g|Trobold}Trobold{/g}?"
9fd080e3-48ef-4a8c-90b5-0f836ad08a42: {n}You see the same kobold shaman you recently met at the forest path. It looks like he and at least half of his band managed to reach the troll lair.{/n}
95f6cc62-36af-44ed-943a-36c9c0222832: {n}You see a group of kobolds gathered before the troll lair entrance. They seem hesitant to proceed. It's typically hard to make out differences between kobolds, but this group seems familiar. This seems to be the same group you recently met at the forest path, though it looks like many of kobolds didn't make it this far.{/n}
90275997-cd74-4ca5-ba69-befcac2618c3: {n}The troll frowns and scratches his head. He doesn't seem to understand the kobolds or have any idea what they want from him.{/n}
dcab4e5d-308c-44bb-8623-d72187e52d3a: {n}You see a group of kobolds gathered before the troll lair entrance. They seem hesitant to proceed. It's typically hard to make out differences between kobolds, but this group seems familiar. This seems to be the same group you recently met at the forest path.{/n}
fc6dbe56-a00b-44a6-a40b-f20bbd10cac9: "Garasssuk! Greetingsss!" {n}The kobold extends his hand and stares at one of the troll guards.{/n}
3af9fa32-04db-4869-abdc-86899ba2c8c6: {n}You see the same kobold shaman you recently met at the forest path. It looks like he and his band managed to reach the troll lair.{/n}
6cdda2cf-03b6-4407-8608-8ee9b5727432: "Kobold can go {g|Trobold}Trobold{/g}! Home!" {n}the troll announces, letting the kobolds enter.{/n}
fed666ac-6c0a-438b-b63d-792a6e023728: {n}You see a group of kobolds gathered around two trolls, who seem to be guarding the entrance to the troll lair. The kobolds seem hesitant, but the bravest of the gang — he seems to be their shaman — steps forward.{/n}
3af6b82a-a97b-4ff6-87b9-29745524f13a: "Drop everything you've looted and get out of my city. If I see you again, I'll execute you myself."
f402f8a4-e357-43f9-b80e-e2e885880d3b: "You have a choice: either I execute you here and now, or you voluntarily submit yourselves to the captain of the guard and follow his every command."
1aca1e5c-16b5-422c-96b6-1d1831079568: "Ha ha ha, I've never seen such clumsy thieves! Look, I'll cut you some slack — I'm going to close my eyes and count to three, and when I open them, you'll be long gone."
d3b6dcb7-032d-4418-b312-6e7ea2f5a9a8: "Give me all the gold you've gathered and I'll pretend I never saw you."
4999a59e-e275-43d0-b957-48ed60cc67ab: [Attack] "I'll post your heads above the city gates as a lesson to everyone else."
3773ec82-2b8e-4a48-8ebd-90f65942c346: [Leave] "If the owners really valued their possessions, they'd have protected them better. I have more important matters to attend to."
e8e8d28b-c692-456b-92c1-40be22fd302d: {n}While the fierce battle rages, these people aren't fighting or fleeing. Rather, they've entered one of the ruined buildings and seem to be filling their sacks with whatever goods have been left behind. Noticing you, one of the marauders turns pale and drops his bag.{/n} "Gah! Damn..."
af3b624c-6926-41ef-a1ce-3174801cd926: "We're, uhhh... Well... Don't s'pose you'd believe we're pickin' up lost goods to return to their owners, would you?"
15469203-e3cf-4c0c-b056-68e82a1adbf4: {n}Looking back and forth between themselves, the pale-faced marauders eventually nod, drop their bags, and make their way to the captain of the guard under your watchful eye.{/n}
673fccee-8323-494c-9b1b-c9661476e82d: "Yes, Your Grace... Thank you for your mercy. You'll never hear from us again, I swear it!"
17c11948-caf6-4373-8efd-4603d23a7997: "Thank you, Your Grace! Your land, your right... and here's your share!" {n}The marauders hand over a pouch of gold before picking up their bags and hastily leaving.{/n}
f0f5883e-d99e-4196-8bde-6294c7c6bbc3: {n}The marauders quickly pick up their bags and disappear.{/n}
865c30dd-6454-45e2-b7ff-14c40fcf1837: "Such filth!"{n} – Kanerah almost sings the words.{/n} "After our victory, they should be publicly executed in the main square. But since we're a little busy to deal with criminals, I suggest we just kill them right here. We must get rid of these parasites!"
6705b458-3b23-43ce-9305-0d84fff56d71: "Reg, I need some inspiration. Strike a heroic pose!"
e590b73d-eee7-4013-9423-9e40330a6061: "A pose you say? Ha ha ha... I like poses. The ones I like would inspire you for something quite different, though..."
6ce3a18d-e4f7-447c-b8bf-9af353781d0b: "I would recognize that armor anywhere. What is a hellknight doing in my lands?"
b2b4de44-0cdf-4cb1-9454-5dd28c3ebacf: [Attack the peasants] "You broke the law by attacking this knight. The sentence is death!"
7eaf255f-c1bd-4160-b098-a7148d5e15ff: [Attack the hellknight] "Fellows, let's show this hellknight how we handle his filth in the Stolen Lands!"
76d36ec3-e8a2-4e5e-af95-62ec67187776: "I have no wish to interfere. Deal with this yourself."
c37b0fd3-5cda-44e5-b94a-af2b0d39e9db: {n}One of the peasants, who is armed with a weapon, jumps up in alarm as you approach.{/n} "{mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}!"
b475b258-1071-4f87-b1bd-cf40eb62f82b: {n}You look upon knight in pitch black armor, a monstrous snarling snout emblazoned on his breastplate. He doesn't turn to you — all his attention is taken by multiple adversaries. Nonetheless, you hear a muffled voice from under the visor.{/n} "Praise {g|Asmodeus}Asmodeus{/g}! {mf|Baron|Baroness|King|Queen} {name}, I presume? My regards. Please accept my apologies for not greeting you as the etiquette requires. I'm a little... busy."
56d98985-bdf8-4bc2-81f0-db61049c0452: {n}Another peasant takes a moment to quickly wipe the sweat from his forehead.{/n} "You're just in time! Look... Look who we've caught here! Look at the disgusting creature. He isn't afraid of anything!"
762ec3db-3825-43a3-a2dd-ff32eea47c3b: {n}You hear a chuckle from under the visor.{/n} "I intended to come directly to your court, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. Unfortunately, I was detained."
760158cd-ae7c-459c-962e-8cf06a6571f2: "These degenerates have never before set foot in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. — But there, this devil's spawn was walking right in the middle of the road. And we became so angry..."
de45db32-bdc0-485a-944c-5e7658a4d665: "Right, we figured we could gang up on him... But you could help, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}! We're shedding blood for your lands, after all!"
3fdd0bed-7004-4941-8f48-07fa3c2c99b3: "This is a {g|Hellknights}hellknight{/g}! These wretches have dealings with devils!"
c607a30f-29cc-4882-8165-987e57c20eb2: "Well... you know... they trample everyone whose lands they visit! Wherever there's one, there will soon be a hundred – in a blink of an eye! They crawl like locusts, with their executions and their laws!"
a5cc1e82-4789-48f0-8858-e1abfcdceb92: {n}The {g|Hellknights}hellknight{/g} laughs dryly.{/n} "Of course. Savages like these fear laws even more than fire or sword. Listen, {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}, isn't it time to put this bandit trash in its place? You are too soft for such a savage land as this."
21815e5e-f8d3-493e-b5fa-8fcc25b65f52: "Kayse Berro, maralictor of the {g|Order of the Nail}Order of the Nail{/g} of {g|Hellknights}hellknights{/g}." {n}The warrior pauses.{/n} "I hail from {g|Varisia}Varisia{/g}, if {mf|Your Grace| Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness} cares to know. I've come under direct orders of the paralictor, in order to hold negotiations."
cad5fcf1-8b3c-4582-934e-b8a0a7ca0c2e: {n}The {g|Hellknights}hellknight{/g} clenches his weapon.{/n} "Not the fairest trial, but it's acceptable. Please allow me to help, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. Weeding is our job."
95c8bb05-d479-4338-a504-3f6e6c6fd3b3: "So... so you're just going to stand there and watch us die?!"
a4c726bb-d53e-4c08-8745-e02ba19c46d8: "Let's beat {mf|him|her} up for abandoning {mf|his|her} subjects when they're in trouble!"
9b71d3f2-bb09-4a08-9398-cf7a963a9c12: "Yeah, right, keep listening to him! These scoundrels mean to conquer us. That's why they're nosing about! That's why!"
48521687-74af-493d-bfc8-dd37cf2a5312: {n}The {g|Hellknights}hellknight{/g} seems to not hear his adversaries.{/n} "I ran into some unexpectedly aggressive local fauna. Luckily, I was prepared for such a turn of events. The {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} are said to be full of surprises."
5b140f55-8f34-4e90-9826-e5229acacadd: "There's no need for the charade. – Your sister told me the truth."
2d5e23eb-b8c9-45d9-9ec4-2771212f376a: "It's nice to see you again... Kanerah."
ad84c012-5fd2-46f9-842d-717eb80340d0: "I guess I'm a {mf|baron|baroness|King|Queen} of many talents."
bfc68ab0-cd66-44f5-b30c-9a2916edaa63: "Your sister asked me to find an artifact..."
08c853d8-4ac8-49cb-8704-40113d853956: "Enough talk. I'm here to win the Taldan treasure and the artifact."
0a77198b-980f-4887-abdd-29604cfac8db: "Let's fight it! We'll easily defeat it."
b1358025-3660-489e-891f-b60ca98a7eb2: "Let's try to slip past it and take the Disk and the other valuables."
7573e349-1326-44c0-a64c-facc8d371feb: "We freed the water elementals, who seem friendly. They will help us defeat the gargoyle."

7705fb42-14cb-48de-8499-51466c659191: "The Disk of the Eclipse! That must be it! But how do we..." {n}The girl freezes midsentence, her eyes wide open. And then...{/n}

eed68cf5-7391-432c-b8b1-a1fa7709d653: "Have no sympathy for traitors, Linzi. Especially those who wear the white robes of the righteous."

d567dc99-94d0-4c3c-b321-cf6427639d2d: [Sigh] "Give your knife to me. Will sharpen it."

0597818d-bfc9-48c8-a461-0d290b14e067: {n}Virish rises to his feet.{/n} "Weird day, when dryskin save one of tribe. Weird, but maybe not last for tribe? Maybe not time for Ashshas-ta-ha take all?"
efa94838-77fb-47c6-aa40-076481121978: {n}The lizardfolk's wound closes as he stares at you, astounded.{/n} "You no take Virish? You... dryskin? Friend?"
23580b0d-c061-4526-98ea-e464d7b504f6: {n}On the floor of the hut, lying among eggshells, an old lizardfolk is pressing his hand against a festering wound. Raising his head with great effort, he stares at you.{/n} "Dryskin? No, I see truth... Ashshas-ta-ha... I been waiting for you, yes..."
76286cad-e67d-404d-8a17-9aaaf6326010: "Ashshas-ta-ha... Death... You have many-many faces… You can come as animal, as wind, as dryskin... come and take all, everything, yes..."
a68ced0f-69ad-44af-8670-9e29f700fc5b: "Virish of Longtail tribe... Once was clutch father... Now no eggs, and soon no tribe... So who Virish now? You tell me, Ashshas-ta-ha..."
e75a03db-736f-447d-8e76-66a111b5f853: "Great Ancestor go crazy, tell of famine come soon, children starve, so we must eat eggs like every time famine come... But where is famine? Many animals, many mushrooms everywhere! We could breed many children, could raise many warriors, yes!"
4a49869b-0573-47a8-826d-49863c46ab07: "Virish ready... Take Virish now, Ashshas-ta-ha... Take all..."
e4621f09-0bb8-4609-a3c3-6246968342a2: "Virish try save eggs, try stop tribe from eating them. Great Ancestor get angry, put spell on Virish. Then Chieftain Vesket poke Virish with spear... I lie and watch Longtails eat our own eggs..."
6d3ecc75-266b-4d2c-b120-0dff9aea02ff: "Now no eggs left, no children left — where tribe get new warriors from? Soon Virish die, and then tribe die, yes..."
1152d252-43b6-4013-91ff-44456b2fdd83: {n}The lizardfolk stares at you from the floor without a word, pressing his hand against a festering wound.{/n}
873cfc9d-e595-40ac-867a-fd8f276a098d: {n}The lizardfolk is still weak, but his life is out of danger.{/n} "Thank you, dryskin..."
afe6f033-2ff7-42ab-b649-20f445e7e2ad: "Virish from Longtail tribe, clutch father. When we have no eggs, we have no children — tribe die out. But if ancestors help, we get new eggs, we get new children!"
123a515d-3c4c-4926-bddf-856d673f8505: "What now? We lay new eggs, no? Virish know not. Maybe tribe survive, if ancestors help."
668e3be2-fb88-445a-9bae-bcc844ac3f46: "Ashshas-ta-ha. Thought you are Death. Virish lie here, wait for death come and take all tribe, yes... Virish wrong. Now, Virish think maybe tribe live on!"
ddb8a01a-9142-4832-be0f-1194e39e656c: {n}The old cleric lies on the ground, staring up into the low gray sky. Crimson blood from numerous wounds stains the dry barren soil around him.{/n} "Come closer..." {n}he whispers.{/n} "I need to tell you something."
b2fc8406-1f22-4129-9bbc-7309a9a6764e: {n}Dugath casts a gloomy glance over the battlefield, the bodies of his brethren strewn across it.{/n} "They died meaningless deaths... I hope you realize, Baron{mf||ess} — when next we meet, we'll be sworn enemies."
93afbfcd-4ece-47ff-867f-0e6494339dc6: {n}Having passed the bloody bodies of his men, Dugath stops near the corpse of the Sister.{/n} "They died meaningless deaths... 87cc1023-2ccd-4244-944e-11511a42355b: "I know where to find what the Sisters were looking for. It's in the {g|Valley of the Dead}Valley of the Dead{/g}. An unholy, cursed place, that is... I didn't want to lead my people there. Now... it doesn't matter anymore..."
4fc6bbc9-47e5-47b1-8601-b9f83ec673ef: "I'll tell you how to get there. That thing the Sisters were searching the tombs for... it opens the entrance. Go there... and die there..."
17e0c157-e917-4ee1-9a4d-839adc04ae9e: "We have nothing more to do here. We'll leave. But let me tell you why we came here in the first place. These incense burners from the tombs are keys to the entrance."
043a31eb-7c99-4b30-b76c-e8e4e3e1fdad: "That place is called the {g|Valley of the Dead}Valley of the Dead{/g}, and for good reason. It's an unholy land, a cursed land. If there's something capable of devouring a whole city around here, that's where you'll want to start looking for it."
74dd3053-bf43-4a24-8b24-358f89e2c2fb: {n}The barbarian pulls the hood off the dead Sister's head and frowns. Right, she wasn't human at all — she was fey! This is who our chieftain was listening to."
f994c64b-22d7-41ad-8926-1a09a706fdb3: "I wouldn't want to give unwanted advice, but I don't think we should let the barbarian go. He told you in all honesty that he has dark plans for you and your lands. He deserves honesty in return – an honest death."
c4e58f15-a2e7-435a-95d9-497b67b4cfb5: "I'd like to make a toast. A toast to {name}, our leader and patron. May you enjoy all life's brightest pleasures in your many years to come."
22c168e5-6168-473b-814c-b14334a0f84b: "And may the weaklings and the rabble envy you, as they always do their superiors."
23c38e41-a30e-45ab-9178-164f7afbad9b: {g|Loyalty2_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "We shall hold a fair for the common people. I want them to know that I hold them closest to my heart."
a93ba3b0-2a2b-436d-8fe2-a3690952498e: {g|Loyalty2_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "We will hold a luxurious dinner party for the merchants. The support of our wealthiest citizens is essential."
e1a9c0a2-43ba-4752-8b8c-58ea14dc894b: {g|Loyalty2_3}[Choice effects]{/g} [Gain 20 BP] "I don't care to arrange anything. We can do without festivities and feasts."
c78cbe74-f1f2-43bf-a327-0cd62a9cc1a5: "Make up your own mind. – I don't care who we pander to."
2f1aacbe-4423-42bf-b7ec-e54b740d6f14: {n}Tristian lowers his head.{/n} "Greetings, {mf|baron|baroness|King|Queen}. I am sorry to take you away from your other affairs, but your people need you."
45d92e61-62e9-4902-97b2-dd3370c22ea2: {n}Shandra bows briskly.{/n} "{mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}, please spare me a moment of your time. The people are suspicious of their new {mf|baron|baroness|King|Queen}. But I know how to solve this problem."
004bf7d9-ed9d-4f98-9718-7088e6c57407: "When the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} were freed from the Stag Lord, the people sighed in relief. But many are still confused by their swift change of fortune. Truth be told, they simply don't know what to think of their new {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}, nor what to expect of you. Will you be a fair ruler for all, or only for those of wealth and status?"
df9717d6-afb0-4237-8336-84c5d5809314: "Let us reassure your people – show them where your favor truly rests. Perhaps a small celebration would help to win them over. Of course, you could spend the same amount on a luxurious dinner for the wealthiest of your barony, but I recommend organizing a fair for the common people – the ones upon whose shoulders your power truly resides!"
5a7a3466-5c42-4e1c-872b-a12e1c88bed3: {n}Shandra holds out a piece of paper.{/n} "I took the liberty of composing a list of the wealthiest and most influential merchants in the region. All that is required of you is to hold an lavish dinner, to show them how generously their support is rewarded. This would draw heavily from the treasury, but I'm sure they will appreciate the gesture, and your noble attention."
adb26afc-cfed-4f90-9451-09738016a750: {n}Shandra ponders for a moment.{/n} "Of course you could use the dinner money instead to entertain your peasants, but I wouldn't recommend it. The whims of the crowd change with the wind. They will forget your generosity after the first bad harvest."
0592d3ed-6568-45d4-ab27-db198b78b204: {n}Tristian smiles warmly.{/n} "We will hold a common celebration, where everyone will be welcome – including the poor and downtrodden. This is the greatest gift a ruler can give to {mf|his|her} people!"
9ec95746-0394-4d1b-89bc-421f65896d67: "Cheap populism has never done anyone any good. You'll throw your money to the wind without achieving anything. But it's your decision, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}."
db427da0-31e6-4071-910a-57d45b5b5251: {n}Tristian keeps silent for a few moments. He is choosing his words very carefully.{/n} "It saddens me to see money that could feed the hungry and bring joy to the suffering, will instead be spent on a feast for the wealthy. But if that is your decision, I cannot change it."
2331c117-bc42-44be-9344-30aeac8dae45: "An impeccable choice, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. I shall make the necessary arrangements."
00600bf0-70e7-4d7b-8c3f-07084554eace: "But..." {n}Tristian interrupts himself and sighs.{/n} "As you wish, {name}. As you wish."
0ce44a72-385c-443e-9340-8c941322cc7e: {n}Shandra raises her puzzled eyebrow.{/n} "Are you afraid of the extra expense? You shouldn't be. But if this is your decision, so be it."
19891867-c242-48f1-9b5a-8469d7b0ed18: {n}Tristian's face darkens at your words, but he hides it, lowering his head.{/n} "Then I shall commence preparations for the folk fair."
dca10855-3ad1-43cd-8f72-24ef18ea2825: {n}Shandra looks through her list.{/n} "I will send out invitations to the merchants today."
c9aec0f4-4d81-47bb-864a-5064eb07c46b: "{name}, I'm offering you guidance on leading your pack, so I will share my wisdom. You have won this land by right of strength. But your new pack doesn't know you. Are you kind or vengeful? Should they seek your favor, or flee in terror? Something tells me that the one who killed the Stag Lord might become even more fearsome."
a83eb7d2-7a65-431d-91bd-b48ea8aa7580: {n}You hear a rustling sound from under Tsanna' clothes, but she ends it with a swift, impatient slap on her hip.{/n} "Show your pack that you bring peace and prosperity. Give them food. A feast is the surest way to loyalty. And make no distinction between the wealthy and the poor."
8a99a4c3-2e5d-4f39-bf9a-a516f7d75e8a: {n}A rat's grey face peeps out of Tsanna's sleeve.{/n} "Very well. The people will enjoy a royal feast, and my rats will sup upon their leftovers and scraps."
932a160a-34b1-4dbd-a2f8-b5f987a51642: "This is wrong, {name}. You tease your pack by feeding the well-fed in front of the hungry. If you mock the hungry brutes long enough, they'll come to you at night to gnaw upon your bones. Is that not right, my children?" {n}Two little grey faces emerge from Tsanna's sleeves.{/n}
f1b108ef-331c-4765-98ae-7343cc2a7cf8: "It is your right. If you wish to be a strict leader, such gestures are beneath you."
d7be6198-9732-4439-a790-d0abb0b07b7e: "I will succor your pack. Your subjects shall be fed and happy, and the traders well entertained." {n}You see a rat's nose peek out from under Tsanna's hair.{/n}
1acc7466-980a-4424-aee9-f525b7b91d75: "I know that your wealthy merchants seem the most powerful within your pack. It may feel right to throw a feast for them and leave others to fight over scraps. But beware of spoiling them before they prove their loyalty." {n}You hear the rustling once again, and the folds of Tsanna's clothes shift and ripple.{/n}
b52e3137-2049-4380-9f9b-f21ae7db130f: "I admire your optimism. Even when the situation seems desperate, your smile never leaves your face!"
d69aaddc-9cb6-4bba-a2f4-74c9a1c7ffdd: "Do you know how many desperate situations Reg and I survived in Numeria? And we're all right – we got out of all of them! We'll handle whatever comes."
ccebf94c-173f-4270-a54c-b9efb1317787: "I'm someone you'd better treat with more respect!"
4eea26a2-0fcb-493b-8dc3-d7dbec22530c: "Perhaps it's time to finish the grimoire?"
06ceb0e8-36ea-4961-98f8-98f5ae9d224e: "Why do you stay here? Are you hiding from someone?"
dcd51e80-c8e0-400c-8282-7f1ea2fd4c28: "Have you ever been to the First World?"
84efecd8-b7a1-47d4-aff2-fd7b365b35f7: "How did you wind up in Katapesh?"
f074f8e9-3f08-4ba5-8cd3-4cd115c02a38: "What did you do in the North?"
85837014-33d5-41ab-abf2-7a0b79c98e24: "That won't do. Give me the book immediately!"
c75fcdff-e721-4050-a636-1a69d5365942: "It's important to be able to accept closure. Perhaps it's time to put a period on it?"
bef393e7-f21c-4b05-bcd7-4003d897e54d: "Maybe I can help you finish the book?"
260ea8f0-efab-49c0-88ac-091d263d6ef0: "But there are more important things to discuss..."
a320a9c0-7579-4755-becf-46179ebaaee8: "I'm in need of a wise adviser. Would you like to work for me?"
7050eacd-7c8f-490a-8419-bb18f565e400: "I'd like to learn more about you."
e1f2f577-fa3b-4ec1-b2b6-875f5daa391f: [Attack] "No more excuses. I'm taking the book."
fb5485c0-c60c-4b3c-9f29-070c4c66df11: {n}A large and broad man turns to you, trying to smooth his thick, tousled hair. His deep voice could have belonged to a giant.{/n} "Hey, who are you?!"
1ff209ed-fe14-43cb-90b7-c0dd33b61e4e: {n}For a moment the man stares at you blankly, then smiles and heaves a sigh of relief.{/n} "Oh yes, Captain Martyn! By all means, welcome to the dwelling of Blakemoor the Wizard."
41fb2d40-242b-4c16-b5e8-6b96eb1e1af7: {n}The man heaves a heavy sigh.{/n} "Ugh, another fan. You fans are the bane of my existence. And of course you're here seeking stories of the legendary Blakemoor the Wizard."
001b380e-c4cb-4b69-8c52-51ca3c053297: "So, someone important has come to visit good old Blakemoor? Well, I shall be a most gracious host!"
2d43c203-06d8-4b91-8bd1-53e198f4fec5: "Ta có thể giúp gì cho ngươi?"
214781d2-b227-4559-82fa-48c1eb20ce3c: "Only from my numerous fans. My enemies are terrified of me, even the mighty devils! Once, thanks to a certain vile entity, I ended up in {g|Hell}Hell{/g}. Took the wrong portal... Long story short, I found myself in Hell – and it was open season on my head! The devil Siroket was chasing me. And all I had to fight her off was a sack of low-quality tobacco, the Flute of the Hundred Sea Winds, a deaf-mute kobold servant, and the sulfur which laid in such abundance all around. But that's more than enough to trick some clueless devils!"
dd20e246-525e-4f64-9ca8-ec87eaef987b: {n}Blakemoor stares at the scattered pages with ill-concealed yearning.{/n} "The book is almost finished. It's a phenomenal piece of work. All it needs is a couple of alterations. Everything must be perfect."
14ffd2a6-5fbb-4b58-9299-ab85c6a15378: "Ha, where should I start? I am Blakemoor the Wizard. I've seen many things and been to many places – from the northern {g|Realm of the Mammoth Lords}Realm of the Mammoth Lords{/g} to hot {g|Katapesh}Katapesh{/g}, and even to more exotic places, such as the {g|First World}First World{/g}."
5a9e15bf-8cff-4c79-87fa-3379b9b83c64: "I got into the {g|First World}First World{/g} by chance. But in spite of that, it was easy for me to find a job there. I was soon substitute rector at a rather remarkable academy, which was located on the back of an elephant with three eyes and numerous tusks. Actually, the elephant had served as the former rector, before he caught a rare elephantine disease. I moved on once he recovered."
84522e05-8ae3-4cdb-9caa-2de05709a4a0: "I wound up in {g|Katapesh}Katapesh{/g} by pure chance. I was planning to sail further, but seasickness had overtaken me. Katapesh is an amazing place, but I had little chance to enjoy it. In the heat of an argument, my then-sweetheart decided to teach me a lesson, so she drugged me and sold me to a traveling nightmare circus. There I earned my keep as a sword-swallower – and the crowd was just crazy about me! And it wasn't such a hard a job to learn."
a8214da8-18d2-4c36-9b3a-fcc0502b6148: "While taking part in an expedition, quite contrary to my intentions, I found myself hunted by some barbarians. While trying to escape, I climbed up into the mountains – so high that the barbarians had to abandon their quarry to the mercy of icy winds and avalanches. So I plodded across the highlands until I spotted a little light in the darkness. It turned out to be a tavern, where a celebration was underway. The highlanders weren't too happy to welcome an intruder, but they agreed to give me shelter if I beat them in a challenge."
f3b1d04e-78a5-41fa-98f5-eddeab26a93a: "My doors are always open to you!"
bd10de89-19a3-44fa-b93c-3d2a5c03aa1b: {n}Blakemoor hands you the book and turns away, bitterly offended and grumbling.{/n} "Oh, just take it. What should I care? Ruffians. Breaking in, making threats…"
2c089692-1640-40e8-b04d-7df0bd5b61b4: {n}Blakemoor puts his fists on his hips.{/n} "Are you mad? I have to tell you to behave, here in my own dwelling?!"
dbcc0165-8522-4161-8347-66469fe2fb42: {n}Blakemoor opens his mouth to argue, but then just sighs and waves his hand.{/n} "Yes, you're right. Perfection is always impossible..."
251ce361-463b-4a70-bc33-95a5741647be: {n}Blakemoor's tone grows aloof.{/n} "Art cannot tolerate half-measures. You've much to learn before you're capable of discussing serious matters among artists."
34658dd8-afd9-4262-9d95-0456f0599aed: {n}The light of hope flashes in Blakemoor's eyes.{/n} "An excellent idea! Let's try!"
2645a63c-6e1d-43e3-a348-b1aee7594a83: {n}Blakemoor scoffs.{/n} "Well, of course, here's foolish me sitting and wracking my mind day and night! But here you come – a renowned author, no less! For you it's just a piece of cake! You'll finish everything in five minutes!" {n}Blakemoor frowns, offended.{/n} "You shouldn't underestimate me."
6aa819d9-235d-49eb-9693-5eed3f579c4c: "Don't worry, I won't let you down! Come back in a week – my door will always be open!"
cab767bf-1724-44ba-9e91-b371592f96c2: "The Prestigious gave me transport after one encounter. Once time I woke up in the middle of the night and went to look for... the head, I think they call it. So, I went down into the bilge – and suddenly came face to face with eleven banshees – screaming ghosts! They were preparing to devour my soul, when I stopped them and offered to indulge them with conversation prior to the bloodbath. You won't believe it, but they proved to be most pleasant characters to converse with!"
ee0e82d8-33cc-46a9-bf03-b6e08d9d822e: {n}A note of resentment rings in Blakemoor's voice.{/n} "Yes… Very well."
b0b35069-fe2b-4757-aba7-6a5033ef9b8f: "That was unexpected! But we managed! That was Siroket, by the way. – The same devil I met in {g|Hell}Hell{/g}! Did you see that face? Ha ha! That was one tough lady! Thank you for your help, and please give this grimoire to Captain Martyn."
68f81eb8-6342-42c3-bb20-5a8d956ac6eb: {n}After many hours, you and Blakemoor stare at your creation. The Grimoire. Finished. Perfect.{/n}
5661c3ed-b9b1-4e4a-a4c5-34f70e24695a: "Ha! I've been an advisor once already, and I don't want to do it again. I once served one of the merfolk kings. My service went on quite successfully, until I got into an affair with the princess, the king's daughter. Though her virtue was guarded day and night, and anyone who dared approach stood under threat of execution, my feelings overtook me, and we managed to run away together. But on the third day they caught up with us – the whole merfolk army. My death was imminent, but of course I had a brilliant solution in hand."
dbfea095-4398-44f5-9a94-27d197c32160: "After the merfolk soldiers captured us, I entertained myself with card tricks. The merfolk were mesmerized by my talents and demanded that I teach them. So, I suggested a wager. We'd play cards. If I lost, I had to teach them my card tricks before they executed me. But for the next three days I couldn't lose. I won all their money, armor, weapons, their dolphin mounts, their funny bone things they like to put in their ears, and even their Flute of the Hundred Sea Winds, which used to belong to their general."
61556b8b-d23b-48cc-bb59-9b3f59dc8eba: "After three days I'd become quite rich. Then the general ordered his fighters to execute me with their bare hands. But at just that moment my princess arrived! All this time she'd been looking for a way for us to escape, and she'd finally found something. It was a pirate ship! We climbed aboard, I blew the Flute of the Hundred Winds, and our sails nearly burst, taking us away. Unfortunately, things didn't work out between me and the princess. She turned out to be quite... unpleasant company. But she discovered some new talents, and now she's a successful circus fortune-teller!"
011ba903-d0c7-4af9-a731-bd127e64d9f1: "I noticed a sturdy fellow with a simple face, wrapped in a cloak, so I picked him to be my rival. The competition – gluttony. The savage snatched my backpack, turned it inside out and started to cram all my equipment into his mouth. In a short moment, the greedy highlander had swallowed all my stuff, the backpack too – and gobbled down my axe for dessert. The barbarians were already making bets how long I would last out in the cold. Then I tore the mammoth's skull from the wall, broke off its tusk, and rushed for the huge barrel of beer that comprised the entire wall."
9ba754d3-1887-419b-8399-3d19d43a066d: "I kicked out the cork put the tusk under the rushing stream of beer. I filled it up like a drinking horn, and started to gulp. My memories of the next hours are hazy. I vaguely remember the highlanders being extremely angry at me for drinking all their beer. I remember how they started to turn into great beasts – and my rival became a wolf with blazing eyes. He charged me, but I caught him by his ears, shoved the mammoth's tusk in his mouth like a bit, and tied my mustache to both ends, to form reigns."
f527d131-27be-4871-8e1e-595587aea413: "Enraged, the wolf rushed out into the night – with me firmly planted on his back. We ran through the blizzard, and the vile dog whined in anger and humiliation. In the morning he stopped running and fell, exhausted. I looked around and realized there was not a single snowflake around. In the wild race, we'd crossed the borders of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} and entered an amazing place, the ancestor of all other worlds. I took pity on the wolf and let him go. He ran away at once. As for me, many adventures and exploits still lay ahead."
7f7446a7-db1b-411e-8076-88d5da807652: "Once, all of them were elven virgins, captured and enslaved by an evil slave-trading necromancer. The necromancer eventually perished, but the tormented souls of his tortured captives were bound to his ship's figurehead. Later, The Prestigious took this figurehead as a trophy. I felt pity for the banshees and decided to help them."
72682e39-d16e-4726-8d27-1188ea31e9ac: "I called upon one of the numerous sailors' deities of death, and amid the storm he brought, I performed a sad song, written by myself, hoping to touch his dead heart. And it's worth noting that none of the snoring pirates even woke up! The weeping deity set the banshees free, and they all turned into glowing ghostly maidens. To this day, they sing in a world-famous choir, taking the guise of simple mortals."
08833fb1-e844-4038-8cc8-631460b3d414: "Though it made things a bit more complicated that I had to use real combat swords. I traveled with the circus until I got a chance to escape. A well-known captain, the Hurricane King, came to see one of our performances. He accused me of being a fake, and challenged me to swallow his magnificent rapier, a weapon he cherished more than life itself."
36b36bc0-2216-454f-81ae-6aadede4a305: "As the audience applauded, I performed the trick. It ended with my spectacular disappearance in a cloud of smoke. When the reprobate came to his senses and hurried to find me and his cherished rapier, I'd already sold it to an unscrupulous vendor and was heading north, to flee his revenge. That's why I try to stay away from the southern lands."
226f1478-9dc6-4f7f-abaf-9d6c16cabf48: "Chronomistress Shyka always carefully avoided meeting herself, and she'd been jumping all over the timeline, like the water strider across the surface of the pond – because the Lantern King was assuming her form to trick her. After I revealed the game, I earned his unwanted attention, and it was time I left the {g|First World}First World{/g} for good. As a gesture of thanks, {g|Shyka}Shyka{/g} opened a portal for me, but after I stepped in it, I saw that Shyka's appearance had changed, and in her place stood the {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g}! It was not {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} on the other side of that portal, but a far more dangerous place."
0ac7c420-17ec-4fd3-93bf-9eb1f09be819: "Seeking new purpose, I wound up at the Sinmarket, where I made a bargain – and came away with a fair amount of dangerous curiosity, and on top of that, a sack of tobacco, generously mixed with dirty thoughts, four to one. A horrible mixture to smoke. But my purchases didn't make me happy. Soon after, my curiosity, together with a swarm of my good friends – the squirrels – helped me discover that one of the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g}, the {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g}, was playing a dirty trick on another Elder, {g|Shyka}Shyka{/g}, by assuming her form and visiting her."
60157470-30b2-4a50-ae0f-9865d3e39377: "When Siroket came for me, I used my gloomiest voice to recite a spell in a language I'd only just invented. On my signal, the kobold ignited the tobacco, the whole sack of it, and clouds of stinky smoke filled the air. I pretended to go into a fit. That was the second sign, and kobold started to play his flute. Have you ever heard a deaf-mute kobold play the flute? The winds have truly gone wild. The final hurricane is descending – the end of all times! And the squirrels, my loyal friends – the squirrels start screeching in different voices, from their hiding places behind the rocks. The overall effect was terrifying, I must admit."
9c3eae2a-2483-4545-b55b-0edae9f81d69: "As for me, I spun a bit of magic, to make the clouds of smoke look like the devil lord. With a booming voice, the illusory figure praised me for my efforts and 'gave me another task' – to create a grimoire, which would act as a gateway for devils into my world. Then the winds subsided, and the smoke cleared out. After that, Siroket didn't dare to lay a finger on me, fearing my 'Master's' revenge. Devils are extremely stupid, after all."
f79e1e0b-d321-4f58-9f8c-e04af84c1175: {n}The man interrupts you with a gesture.{/n} "Now, just a moment. I don't believe in coincidence. As you're already my guest, let's at least get to know each other. My name is Blakemoor."
9f7861ff-4df9-42c1-b5ec-63e71c9e4bd9: "This humble dwelling is my workshop. It's where I'm creating my masterpiece – the scienmajistik grimoire, a calligraphic work of art. The client who ordered it is my good friend, Captain Martyn... Oh, he must be getting so impatient by now. I'm so far behind schedule. I just want the grimoire to be perfect, you see?"
29aaaae1-8630-4318-a4c4-979b39762a63: {n}Blakemoor's voice trembles.{/n} "But if you could come back in a week, the book should be ready by then… I have almost no doubt about it."
80759cfd-5a59-413e-afd8-bdb082c88b32: {n}As Jubilost listens to the story, he opens his mouth to interrupt, but then he closes it as he realizes the futility of the attempt. When Blakemoor finishes, the gnome just sighs.{/n} "{g|Desna}Desna{/g} help me sort out this mess! Half the story seems to be made of reliable facts, while the other half sounds like unmitigated bullshit! Even in relation to the {g|First World}First World{/g}, which is already insane by nature!"
505db21f-7ad3-42a8-bbb1-352f1d866029: {n}Amiri listens to the story with suspicion, but in the end, she roars with laughter.{/n} "So that's who drank all the beer in that tavern! Our tribe liked to stay there, but there was that one time they had no beer and a mammoth's tusk was broken. But the thing about the werewolf owners... that's a lie. They're not werewolves — I should know!" {n}Amiri looks back at you hesitantly, as though seeking support.{/n}
f8bcd6d6-c521-4b3a-8a0d-31b389c61363: {n}Harrim shakes his head, almost admiringly.{/n} "Please allow me to visit you on occasion, honorable Blakemoor. I have never met a more stunning example of wasted words, madness, and pride incarnate. I must see the day these things bring you to a sad end."
d9aad5e9-09b5-444e-84a5-f9a41bb0613b: "With great pleasure, honored dwarf! And do remind me to tell you of my meeting with {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}. I have to admit, I was almost charmed by him — who'd have thought the god of the End Times would have such an excellent sense of humor!"
026e4d6b-7bb8-4533-808b-cf5fbf36e8f6: {n}Kalikke listens closely to Blakemoor's story, her eyes wide open, then claps her hands.{/n} "What a story! So what is this 'Sinmarket' – and could you really buy a curiosity there? And your squirrel friends — are they magical, talking squirrels? Are they fluffy and nice? Oh wise and honorable Blakemoor, forgive me if I'm bothering you, but could you please, please tell us more of your adventures?"
8aa5df30-077a-4776-aaee-1939173587a7: "How about this: you pretend you didn't notice anyone, and I'll spare your lives."
2b3bb1b7-9938-40f1-b5aa-d30f270f5e44: "How dare you! I'm an honored guest of His Highness, and he invited me here!"
db8a8807-24a5-44aa-92bb-4019733e9f2a: "Well, looks like I've been caught... But wouldn't you prefer to spend your time counting this thousand gold I have, rather than rush off to turn me in?"
dc739cc6-ed35-4478-8b07-42285991eea8: [Attack] "You should have looked the other way."
776e45fd-3383-4792-bed8-ce8cdf46e8a6: "I'm aware. He's the one who invited me."
c349bd6a-ccda-4c18-b459-e8107b69e386: "Back off peacefully, or I'll make you do so."
7302bf2b-0360-4292-bca2-41dadbf05513: "Perhaps a thousand gold will persuade you to let me in?"
db43e3d5-9024-4872-a0fc-9dc6c2fa88c8: "I think I must be lost. I'll just be going."
1a689de6-24bb-4068-a1f4-3e20cfe39a10: "Hey! You can't be here! This is High Highness King Irovetti's camp!"
842bdbdc-40db-4cc8-9b9f-fc6e6cb17b30: "Hey, who's crawling around there? Stand still, hands in the air!"
e08b0ee7-e926-47b8-a3bc-6ff73cf05bab: "What's this, a bribe? Not a chance. Thieves! Raise the alarm!"
f9bb1d3c-9d8d-4507-b9d6-d0cb3ce318b0: "Is that a threat?! Raise the alarm!"
6b98fa42-edd5-4ea7-8c44-2fe43ade1427: "Don't try to confuse us! We'll hand you over to the king and let him decide what to do with you!"
50a1b60c-1d33-4f76-8efc-9c4df3e8e8eb: "We're not supposed to allow anyone in! If the king commands it, we will, but at this point you could be a thief for all we know!"
c6c7e3a5-504a-4846-94fc-94a421062569: "These barbarians make marvelous characters... All we need is some savage with a high sense of honor!"
e18fa403-6e5d-41b2-8c6a-8455c5975b0d: "Do you ever talk about anything besides your book? Life is so much bigger than art can ever portray. People are so much more complicated than any sketch conveys..."
53e24667-0afe-432c-a2fe-56641944b334: "Trust me, you don't want to know them better..."
49f4e921-8cb0-41ad-be33-9d21292b9d5a: "Take me for example! You see every day how honorable I can be. And you hear every night how savage, ha, ha, ha!"
a7ea89ee-7b82-4a74-b69e-903d62b05ad5: "We've met in a tomb, in Dunsward."
c4db007a-9d52-4b10-bcc6-615369d484a0: "So, I was one of her toys from the beginning?"
0f5d9c23-1360-467d-9e2a-2b96a94233fb: "Is there a way to free you?"
dc4343e9-9050-49f5-a982-6c0e1d07fd83: "I'll take your blessing. Thank you. Your sacrifice will not be forgotten."
580451f7-18e4-4cb3-a687-6485948d71ad: "You don't have to sacrifice your life for me."
7f1f8e40-84f3-40ab-95b7-87d7bab1f4ed: "I've a better idea. Use this spell on yourself. It is a faint hope, but a hope nevertheless. A day shall come when her curse dissolves, then you will be free."
c508e0a7-6036-4969-b50a-b4ded91c0edc: "Why won't you target this spell against the one who enslaved you?"
916901d9-c7c8-4b44-9df6-ec92744cc95b: "This stone is a powerful weapon, you'd better give it to me. If it comes with your finger, so be it."
2b14e8af-11e9-49a6-84eb-2fd5bc848baf: {n}A slim figure clad in grey cloak is nestled in the shadows. Through the holes in the veil that covers her face, eyes stare out at you — sharp green, like emeralds.{/n} "You have found this place... I knew you'd come. I was afraid to meet you here, yet still hoped you would come."
f25e6c92-33c1-487c-92be-fb0f10a75c56: "Yes. {d|c31 Good Sister}Your words{/d} made me remember who I once used to be. They gave me hope — no matter how false, no matter how short-lasting — that once I would be able to free myself from the service."
fc893446-9dc7-4949-bcb8-c343382ccc0b: "Ask away. But you should know: the one I serve has put a spell on me. If I try to play against her, I will die. There are some questions, answering which will kill me faster than I finish talking."
dfbbbf1f-7076-46f0-8965-198aa381a79f: "Wait! Before you leave, I'd like to help you. The spell, I am bounded with, won't spare my life... But my death will be my only independent decision in many ages. Please, take my blessing."
5208cfc4-d71c-4d63-9850-2e6de7d7d616: "Let me help you. Trust me, the life I live now isn't something worth any regrets."
52a0c0fa-6130-4dff-8729-efddcffaae52: "I can only guess on what she has planned. And... I'm not even sure she has a plan at all. Maybe it is simply some game that lasts for thousands of years, the rules beyond my comprehension. Or perhaps she does what she does to amuse herself, a distraction from her own pain."
8f99937b-2b0f-4a5c-a928-5d53a2c6e401: "Century after century, she does the same thing. First, she finds within her lands something she calls an 'empire'. It may be a village led by strong chieftain, or outlaws that terrorizes the roads, or even caves of trolls and kobolds... any center of authority in these lawless lands."
2c0c5269-90de-4283-aa8e-0d04d0960416: "She helps this new 'empire' flourish... only so she might destroy it. Lies, violence, magic, blades of her new favorites — this is her arsenal she uses to destroy dreams, hopes, and the very lives of those she formerly nurtured and protected."
b1e1fdd9-0097-45d7-bd81-08b5deb402e5: "Yes. You've defeated the Stag Lord, Tartuk and Hargulka, dealt with Vordakai… Now the time has come for her to destroy you as well."
498f2eac-e4c3-4cbb-851c-8fc29f0ac5ea: "Our name must be the only piece of truth among all our lies. We really are sisters — the nymphs from the {g|First World}First World{/g}, bounded by blood with the one, who turned the ties of our blood into shackles. We truly are defaced — when she shared her curse with us, she deprived us of our freedom, our names, and our beauty."
05f0bf43-4c0f-4d09-85ad-0f1cc27fd3de: "I doubt that. To do it, I'd need a mage stronger than she — or a cleric, who would be able to ask their deity for a true miracle. My shackles are solid. I'll be free from the curse only the day when she herself is freed."
4fbfe8f8-3933-4d0a-ba68-d89ebf14ac18: "Once she was our sister... the most powerful, the most beautiful of the nymphs of the {g|First World}First World{/g}. Then she was cursed and banished — I know not why. We followed her into exile, hoping to give comfort... but she changed. As cheerful, wise, and gentle she had been back home, she became arrogant, wicked, and cruel in these mortal lands. You can see for yourself what she's done to us — but it is not the worst thing she has done, believe my words."
9439cab1-f5cc-46e8-a5af-af0c3656e61a: {n}The Sister raises her hand and starts to cast a spell. With every word her voice becomes weaker, her fingers tremble, but she persists. After the last word of the spell is spoken, the Sister collapses, dead.{/n}
8198443f-04ae-4506-b068-df019b76ef50: "I am glad I can do something for you."
0493be28-13bb-4fa6-9158-c2696982dbda: "He's like us — our stepbrother in misery. You must know already he's not a regular man. He is a child of Higher Planes, {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} deva, who fell into my sister's trap and was forced to serve her. His task was to aid your ascension — and your fall. But his will was strong enough to fight her commands."
779b08c0-5afd-4dbf-ac1a-e59e07c01372: "I beg you to forgive his betrayal. There is no hope left for me, but he… everything is not lost for him. Not yet."
6e10b962-f56f-4168-833b-91623590fd92: "All I know she eagerly shares it with the others. A canopy of curses looms over the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} — a web so dense, that sometimes a single careless word, spoken in anger is enough to tap into its energies."
4be4a411-abe3-4ffa-ada1-a4debf1cff83: {n}A weak sigh comes from under the veil.{/n} "My life is over now. Do you really think that the one I serve hasn't learned of my betrayal? If she didn't want us to meet, this encounter wouldn't have happened. The only freedom that remains is the freedom to choose my own death. I do not wish to die by her hand, and I won't do what she's sent me to do."
28999e71-c325-4cdd-9849-07527065fb60: {n}The Sister raises her hand. Instead of a fingernail, a bright tourmaline lies embedded in her finger tip, encrusted with caked blood.{/n} "This stone holds a powerful spell of Imprisonment. A touch, a single secret word — and you'll disappear underground, outside time, trapped forever between life and death. But I'd rather die than curse you so."
f8005a27-b84a-4e29-b519-632caa73b8bd: "But… By the {g|Green Mother}Green Mother{/g}, you're right! She won't find me underground. Thousands of years shall pass before her curse dissolves. It may never happen. But still... It's hope. Thank you. And — farewell."
a053699c-16a2-45ff-be30-14f4ca83618c: {n}After giving you one last emerald glance, the Sister shuts her eyes, whispers the secret word and presses the jewel against her chest. For a moment she is still, then disappears into the ground without a trace.{/n}
21823498-1e1c-4111-8ce5-9c98fdc2a890: "I thought about that. But… this is all just idle dreams. She'll know my intentions long before I build up my courage, and she'll kill me before I come anywhere near her."
ea4a6c91-f1ce-4ebf-9091-dfe4e289e1a0: {n}The Sister recoils from you, putting her mutilated finger with the glinting stone forward. She whispers hoarsely,{/n} "Do not disappoint me."
9d49dcef-72b2-48e2-89e0-8b6109bee352: "Burial in the depths as the only way to escape a trap... Truly an amazing finale. I am pleased to have been witness to the act. Perhaps one day I could turn such a spell on myself in reverse, leave the world without fuss..."
02971497-5c0c-426b-9f67-0065570a9046: "Sorry, no. A little lying or caving in to a higher power could be forgiven, but stabbing your friends in the back? Not a chance!"
5824c5ca-ea23-4ad1-ba36-a3326a0d9d5f: "Tristian has a good heart! I don't believe for a moment that he seriously wanted to harm us!"
223d0048-0920-4f3a-8519-580ede68b656: "If Tristian was an honest spy, serving for money or ideals, I could forgive him. He fooled us honestly, did his job — he's a good spy! But the righteous asshole tried to play himself off as being good and pure, then just turned on us when some witch told him to — then he even 'rebels' against her! Ugh."
49df0701-b4db-40bd-9e8c-b1d2b808ff75: {n}A strong magic aura surrounds the woman's figure. It seems that the spell that caused it belongs to the abjuration school of magic, and its creator is a much more powerful spellcaster than the Defaced Sister herself.{/n}
348c4754-ceb1-4ee1-bbf2-b6841e0c147b: "Greetings. Well, my darlings. You've broken your divine patron's second condition, just as I foretold."
f61f298e-ac76-428b-a2ab-6648ac6a9b46: "So you knew what was going to happen to us at the House at the Edge of Time?"
524b7bca-e59a-40e6-9224-fd96cf9831b6: "I surmised. I led you by the hand through all your adventures in the Stolen Lands. I brought you to the Disk of the Eclipse. I made sure you arrived at just the right place, where the magic of the First World would rid you of the divine curse you've suffered, so you may reunite. Aren't progenitors supposed to look after their offspring? And I am a very caring ancestor!"
c0d69af0-a377-421b-a9bd-dded39f495ff: "And now, if you'll excuse me, Your Highness. It was a pleasure dealing with you, but there are greater forces than you at work here, and it's time they resolve their differences!"
d2d08843-aef2-4c07-b4c4-c8423c1259dc: "And now, if you'll excuse me." {n}You hear undisguised mockery in the devil's voice.{/n} "I'll leave you to your destroyed kingdom, and the insane fey lord who has seized it!"

76988180-c7e9-4b60-92dd-58b3adaf144b: {n}The smile drops from Tristian's face.{/n} "What? No! Oh, it doesn't matter. Anyway, they're yours now."
126bd140-9584-4f40-a4d3-e83bde7ec6cc: {n}Tristian laughs back.{/n} "All right! A friend in need is a friend indeed — in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} we'll have many chances to check if that's true!"
80ec36d0-da83-49b9-bf3c-9aaf5e843250: "Every time I turn away, I feel your eyes boring a hole in my back. Is there something wrong?"
292e2ec4-89a7-4809-84b9-353b340a39b5: "No, it's fine. I just don't understand you, young man. And when Jubilost Narthropple doesn't understand something, he tries to get to the bottom of it. And he succeeds!"
a08e2684-803b-4dcc-beab-2746403e787e: "Well, I don't look forward to reuniting with eternal emptiness just yet."
2dd3cfca-ae02-4424-ae83-2a692a2821bf: "You just overreact. Perhaps the fortress ceased to be necessary, and the dwarves just left? How can we know?"
be3a81fd-cb21-4cc9-9c20-192143c5f0fc: {n}He turns his gaze to you.{/n} "Now you see, {name}. This once-proud fortress has fallen, all her inhabitants long gone. Death and oblivion wait for every person at the end of their path. Soon you and I will reunite with the eternal emptiness too."
3de4742c-a96a-468b-8870-6d7d6faac6be: {n}Harrim sighs.{/n} "Your ignorance changes nothing. You won't miss the end of the path anyway. My aim is to make you ready for that. This is the will of {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}."
934459de-b593-4b19-b420-1d9aaa11b725: {n}Harrim grimaces with displeasure.{/n} "If you put forth such an argument, you must know little about the dwarves. We are the most stubborn creatures in the world. Dwarves would never abandon a fortress without a proper fight." {n}He raises his eyes and stares at the broken statue near the gates.{/n} "Oh the cradle of sorrow, here we go..."
cd84cb0e-9045-4c60-96ff-ac859228ec4d: "It's worse than I thought." {n}Harrim pulls his beard, his eyes are full of suffering.{/n} "Dwarves, where are you now? Why did you leave this fortress and let it be defiled by monsters? Perhaps you were killed? And no one survived to tell your families about your fate."
c7cbd7b0-6b56-4d62-95ab-782b9f543998: "I was looking for you. I need your help in the capital."
3bec1f10-c9d8-4df5-ae8a-615cfe6f641b: {n}Shaking off his false image, Vordakai towers above even the other cyclopes that surround him. As you approach, he casually gestures toward you.{/n} "{name}. Why are you here?"
d943310e-9b82-406e-97f5-a19a55b4158e: {n}Vordakai brushes drops of blood from his garment.{/n} "The final line has been drawn. I am ready to return to your city. It's time to get rid of those who claimed my... your land."
fdab61ec-af24-4ea4-ae1c-8fcb36fa8bde: {n}The lich turns his head, and you can feel the gaze of his empty socket looking right through you.{/n} "An invasion from another world, isn't it? I've heard about this before, but have never seen it personally. I still need this world, so I will help you deal with this trouble."
ec26349b-9268-4215-bab0-a05c22afbbb3: {n}Vordakai turns his head toward the river.{/n} "But only after you help me. I want to make mincemeat of this sad excuse for a baron whose {d|c31 Vordakai Hired}image{/d} I assume at your court."
7b984575-5d2d-41dd-8c40-9d58bb7d923d: {n}The skin on Vordakai's face tightens, as though he's trying to sneer, but his features remain still.{/n} "I'm completing what I started on the day of my awakening."
79cb75ec-b612-4ea7-a7cd-93e1ef70b6cc: "When the turmoil began, I went away — where once the cities of my people were towering. Where a great empire will one day be restored. Where there is no place for a nest of thieves and bandits. I summoned ancient warriors and lay siege on {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}. All that is left is to break the fort's defense."
295d6c0a-fc90-46d5-af2a-f580b68d3f3e: "This nobody, {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d} and his henchmen. Or rather, not they but fakes born by strange magic who consider themselves true mortals. Doesn't matter, I will destroy all of them, once and for all."
2d6d8f8e-6306-4384-a069-eaf96d536fc5: "Let's go, my servants! Trample our enemies!"
24a557dd-e554-4d82-85e2-a02025595585: "Ughhh, I didn't like that masked witch. Who are these Defaced Sisters, anyway? Why would fierce warriors crawl through dungeons on their say, instead of fighting and hunting?"
622c7f0f-e47f-4994-a2b6-c54ad25e2fd5: "I've never heard of them before either. Perhaps they're some new religious order? It is indeed strange that the barbarians would obey them."
6f8e938a-91c9-42c9-a74a-98f1a64aa5a0: "She gave the feeling of something... familiar to me. Grief, and darkness."
c62fed90-8340-4b26-902b-a41504eddb3a: "One thing is sure. They did not tell us all they know."
7fe4b891-fe37-48d1-b1a2-bc4c27762525: "I feel the Defaced Sisters share some terrible grief. What could make these women reject their names and their faces?"
227891cf-2b4c-46e0-b089-c544644f712d: "I feel the Defaced Sisters share some terrible grief. What could make these women reject their names and their faces?"
c2c11066-1e1e-498b-9764-3bd9ca938cfe: "I wonder, is it the constant cold that makes northern barbarian brains work so slowly? – Or is it that the tribes are so secluded that they've become incestuous?"
76d73439-53b1-4437-af15-fd3e02aa777d: "I wonder too. Our old ones start drooling around ninety. But you elves live for hundreds of years. How much idiocy do you save up in your heads over the ages?"
38338c8e-bc7a-4455-8e0f-153217be30dc: "Get to work on this special gift of yours."
d259b0ab-30a4-4c71-a154-d801c99d65ab: "I'd like you to make something specific for me."
992e1283-ef5e-4337-90be-a3285c594941: "Show off your leatherworking skills — make a magical item for me.''
a34d280a-aced-42a4-bd95-e5923c5d455b: "On second thought, you can decide for yourself."
82678b52-a62b-47e3-af6d-c5c24e4c4944: "I like this idea. I'll see whether I can make it happen."
3fe18222-4334-4ae2-ae9f-529d032e094b: "Why don't you simply come and serve as my guards?"
feb52faf-cab2-4e54-b4ae-12662c83dc54: "I do not require your services any longer."
f8a4ed8b-fff2-40a9-bf25-635d57cdf895: "Remind me, who are you and what are you working on?"
1db321f4-0c4a-4d42-9b12-b7b46e41d4eb: {n}Before you is a boyish half-elf. Her tight-fitting leather outfit is full of patches, and a large, mean-looking blade rests on her hip. I am here to represent our community, to present you with a token of our loyalty, and to humbly beg your help."
69a74a15-7498-42f4-babb-b4b4c39b79a1: {n}{d|Tirval}Tirval{/d} greets you with a half-bow.{/n} "{mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}, please, accept this new gift."
cd55176e-2af7-4323-96ed-1f64b7da5cc7: {n}With a bow, the half-elf hands you something wrapped in a piece of cloth. — It is a set of leather armor.{/n} "This is my finest creation, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}.
