35a40f09-5d36-4a3f-b20c-2ae5922c5382: "And that is not all, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}! The Varnhold militia is proud to report that the region has been freed from bandits, and order has been restored. We hit 'em so hard, they flew all the way to Mendev! The people know it's all thanks to you. If you hadn't helped us to gather the militia, the damn crooks would still be robbing and butchering us."
64c693d8-ed9a-45da-a6d7-d157af923ccf: {n}Tirval proudly hands over her gift and continues in a steady tone.{/n} "We ask you to let Varnhold assemble a militia of her own. Many of the locals are eager to keep watch and defend their homes with weapons in hand — especially so after the… well, you understand."
fc81731a-ef6e-44e5-af9d-3b507d0de00b: "We owe you a lot. And I would like to make something special for you. Not long ago, I shot something down in the forest… I'm not even sure how to describe it. It was like a dragon, only smaller. I've never seen a beast so fierce! Its hide is a thing of beauty. And that's what I'll use for your gift. It will make the best leather armor you've ever seen, let alone owned. Just say the word, and I'll start working on it."
0924b122-3a1e-410d-b202-0a3046883a8d: {n}The half-elf looks worried as she rubs the tattoo on her neck.{/n} "I'm sorry for everything that happened in Varnhold that day. It all seems quiet there now. In any case, me and my people shall hold our word: we'll fight to the end for our homes and our loved ones."
8f2bfc6a-edfe-4627-add8-192ff477bf45: "I shall work like never before! Trust me, you will not be disappointed!"
5a6a7100-c2bb-4346-b5fa-50daf2c8d2f8: {n}Tirval smiles and nods.{/n} "You're welcome. I hope it serves you well."
54a43edc-a21c-4563-9efe-52d5d8569340: "You have my complete attention. What is it that you require?"
b17b2558-0239-44ca-b537-fcf1a0bf522a: "Right. Something light, but still sturdy, and make sure it doesn't creak. No problem, I've got everything I need."
a3e3deda-b7d4-4b00-a40b-a7ab598f6af3: "He-he, you'll love what I come up with, I promise. When it comes to leather, I'm the best around."
b8742652-1764-4b67-ac8e-ed60587f89b4: "As you wish. I'll do my best."
89651714-0c20-431a-bc07-84107d0fdbce: "{mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness} took care to send guards to Varnhold, and I am grateful for that. However, the townsfolk would sleep better knowing that you've let us take the protection of our children and elders into our own hands. I understand that this would require an investment from you, but we will not remain in your debt for long. If there is a workshop where I can work leather, I'd be more than happy to make all manner of things for you — I used to make a living as a tanner back in Daggermark."
2e983036-18df-4b07-9653-63e99e9bc994: "Thank you, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}! I hope to hear from you soon."
ddd95575-50e7-452b-8d22-6a57268a59c6: "Ah…. I see. Well, you are in your rights." {n}The half-elf makes a sloppy bow and turns away.{/n}
ffa30d22-7d62-4245-9e6f-decd035f06ec: {n}The half-elf hesitates.{/n} "You see… Right now, we're close to the people. If we put on a uniform, well, they'll accuse us of selling out to the authorities. And we wouldn't want that, would we?"
4ef12ccf-7983-4985-8ec7-ddd83c70e774: {n}The half-elf livens up.{/n} "Oh yes – I'm a master leatherworker, after all! Armor, boots — I make it all. I just can't find a proper place to practice my craft. If you help me with that, I can work for you. But only if you satisfy my request and help us organize a militia!"
ad2d616e-e8ee-4dd6-91ed-b2056de8fc96: {n}Tirval speaks with pride in her voice.{/n} "Thank you for supporting our militia. We bought the best equipment, and we've already begun with drills. As it happens, at the meeting I was elected captain. It must mean they trust me. Your soldiers are training my people as we speak. If you hadn't stepped in to help, none of this would have happened."
dd35825c-1a99-4e9c-ae29-11a6b21ac747: {n}Tirval purses her lips and remains silent for a few moments. She then harrumphs, bow, and without a word, turns and walks away.{/n}
8f06a0da-d61d-4bda-b23d-7e4f711be32b: "I'm Tirval, leatherworker – and the leader of Varnhold's militia! I can handle any leather work, foot to finger, and I can enchant them as well. I'm especially good at leather armor. One day I'll make something very special for you – leather like steel, but light as a feather. You'll be able to move like it was nothing at all."
2ac913bc-aabd-4d8b-bd5d-e097e8ef96d8: {g|Loyalty7_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "Let the merchants know that their efforts are not required. If they touch any vessels that isn't theirs, we will have to resort to force."
15e0b3f3-8c1e-49c9-afd7-a2f504d9634e: {g|Loyalty7_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "Let the merchants and their mercenaries do as they will."
97d0a969-545d-4686-99ed-7b40711b977e: {g|Loyalty7_3}[Choice effects]{/g} "Tell the guards stay away from the dispute. The stronger will have the right to trading on the river."
b9d9f5c2-697c-4209-a5ab-d92b06688e17: "{name}, a situation has developed. We must decide if we shall follow the letter of the law, or do what my heart tells me is right."
259f8f67-ff5d-49c4-80b6-c966318a88c3: "{name}, I require your judgment on a sensitive matter. The vessels of river travellers have entered your frontiers. They sell cheap goods for nearly nothing, and of course, they pay no taxes."
fbb33542-4839-40a8-91db-d58bacf83d73: "Thank you, {name}. The law doesn't always grant protection to those in need."
3cbe139b-0865-4e1e-9a22-017f25e4b222: "I will forbid this insanity. Let the merchants trade with those who can afford luxuries. Meanwhile, leave the poor in peace, to buy what they can afford from the traveler vessels."
237c1851-e858-4032-a644-644e4b736c60: "Travelers' merchant vessels roam the rivers of the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. They sell low-priced goods, and bypass the official fees. They sell nothing special, of course. Cheap clothes, utensils, simple tools. These are life-savers for our peasants, who can afford little else. However, the merchants are unhappy with the current situation. They wish to fund a boat squad to hunt down and sink the travelers' boats."
f54d2a4e-bf7e-4403-92b9-f4f20a0bd343: "The merchants are allegedly enforcing the laws, and fighting against the sales of stolen property. But in fact they're only greedy to control the small percentage of goods that the travellers live on. It's up to you to decide what we should do. I'm sure you can see why this troubles me. We must interfere and prevent this injustice!"
2fd1a609-ea51-4897-b118-a94c920255ef: "But your moneybags merchants hate competition. They're assembling a squad of boats to hunt down the travellers, sink their boats, and drive them from your lands. It's simple greed that drives them, but they are on the right track."
e614daf5-74e5-4e60-956c-ce467fc3de03: "My suggestion is to stay out of this. The river travellers are a hardy, teeming people, much like termites. They please {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, and we shouldn't trouble them unless we must. If the merchants decide to strike at them, we should order the guard not to interfere. The waters will run red with blood, and the river people will call upon their relatives from the neighboring lands, and together they'll show the traders what they're made of. Those who are strong will remain, to seek their fortune in our lands. And we will profit no matter the outcome."
5629670b-5dd0-43d1-b639-f24d8f2df5f7: "Your Highness, there's something that requires your immediate attention. As you probably know, there are travellers, humble merchant tribes of mixed origins, sailing up and down the river, selling essentials to our peasants. They pay no taxes, and answer to no authority. The merchants have decided to put an end to their lawlessness. They're assembling a squad of boats to send those travellers packing."
72297121-5019-42cf-86a3-d6344bdd373d: "It's a good start, although I expect we'll have certain issues with these new enforcers. It's an abuse of justice to some extent. I suggest you legalize their actions before they arouse civil unrest. After all, it's your law that they're upholding."
49686e3c-fa44-4923-80de-610e8e2c7cc3: "Yes, let the stronger win. If the merchants cannot protect their interests, let ones who are smarter and more skilled do the work instead. If the travellers are ousted, then their spirit and their flesh were too weak. They would have died either way. In either case, our pack stays strong, and the weak are culled."
443a3dc7-36a7-4f38-b480-3a6748b16f8d: "Let the merchants give those petty thieves the boot. It's time we make it clear that {kingdomname} is {kingdomname}, not the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}! It's civilized now. There's an order to things!"
aa996afd-f1d2-4f24-b166-242d18a49dfb: {n}You are making your way through the goblin camp — a dirty, hastily-erected "settlement" built of trash and mortared with what smells like goblin waste. You catch sight of the silvery glimmer of water ahead — then suddenly notice a squad of armed goblins moving towards the water as well, shouting and prodding at a few scared peasants in front of them.{/n}
366cc1e3-3f90-43ff-ba8c-d561becca0dc: {n}Seemingly unaware of you, the goblins push the prisoners to the water's edge. One of the guards knocks the nearest captive, a decrepit old man, off his feet, and he falls to his knees with a moan. The goblin throws a filthy bent ladle in front of the man and points at the water.{/n} "Drink! Fast!" {n}The old man picks the ladle with shaking hands, then stops, quivering with fear.{/n}
09d4a301-bc4e-426f-ad44-6b6fbbcc1a16: {n}A hail of curses and blows fall upon the shaking old man. Cringing, the man finally does as ordered — he scoops water from the river and drinks it hastily. The other goblins, following their leader's example, drive the other prisoners to the water's edge beside the old man.{/n} "Drink-drink-drink! All drink!" {n}After this, it falls silent... the undersized guards hover over the prisoners, occasionally lifting one of the prisoner's chins with a spear until the victim not only drinks — but to ensure he swallows as well.{/n}
e6fad4f5-f0ae-4e99-86fa-1bb1ac12dea1: {n}Once each prisoner has drunk the water, the goblins stand the captives up and lead them away, deeper into the camp. Only the damp ground reminds you of what you have witnessed here.{/n}
ee371d0a-31f4-4779-bb79-9c63ea9cb0cd: {n}Hearing your approach, the goblins whirl, see you, and start shrieking — whether fear or battle cries, you cannot tell. In the heat of the moment, one of them drops his spear, another steps on the foot of the goblin next to him, and so it goes, causing a ripple of chaos to pass through their ranks. The old man, startled by the noise, drops the ladle into the water — and then, in the confusion, staggers to his feet and breaks into a run. The other prisoners follow, leaving the hapless guards howling in anger.{/n}
2299c457-57d5-4377-905d-fa20787d5781: {n}Hearing your approach, the goblins whirl, see you, and start shrieking — whether fear or battle cries, you cannot tell. In the heat of the moment, one of them drops his spear, another steps on the foot of the goblin next to him, and so it goes, causing a ripple of chaos to pass through their ranks. The kneeling prisoners, startled, quickly see an opportunity and spring to their feet, scattering in all directions.{/n}
2b9f4e8b-a84a-4842-a3a2-da2b933b518e: "What are you waiting for?! We have to save them!"
a02b300a-d43b-40d9-bfc1-3d3d68aca520: "Do not rush to interfere. As much as we may pity these poor souls, we must understand what is going on to save countless others."
0c886871-ccbf-4924-8bf5-8bddb6d25559: {n}Without a word, Ekun frowns and pulls an arrow from his quiver.{/n}
b7e32a4c-4abe-4231-a726-24e70b4f10f1: "I cannot just watch — we have to do something, I beg you!"
66150f1c-fcfd-45f9-92c3-337af413a90d: "May {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} keep us, for our deed is good!"
2f8979f8-7a93-4783-a032-3a41bff93f61: "I hope she didn't ruin the day for you."
a426150d-78a2-41f1-806c-1657993bbb6f: "Don't mention it. Well, I won't bother you anymore..."
67e2ae6f-97a9-4c82-876d-c36aa5b957c7: "It's better than standing quiet, doing nothing."
2f7a8279-4f48-448f-a764-3de0f09cb944: "I didn't know Ntavi became a priestess. She changed a lot..." {n}Ekun frowns and wipes his brow.{/n} "Thanks for the help."
690d2be9-a948-4171-b18a-5668a62e9f01: "This wasn't needed. But we couldn't stop it." {n}Ekun winces.{/n} "Come talk to me in a few days. I need to speak to you."
6cc279a8-e7d9-4779-87e3-342d65951bd3: {n}Ekun looks away, feigning indifference.{/n} "Come talk to me in a few days. I need to speak to you."
84803ac7-2c27-4658-8771-05aa6617f3c1: "Come talk to me in a few days. I need to speak to you."
73dbd96e-9876-4abe-b6e1-bb3a85096435: "Who are these Embeth Travelers, and what would they ask for their help?"
b3867ae2-5b30-40c2-b299-22525d7f6f3e: "Whom will we invite for the hunt?"
51948bea-edaf-40de-9dad-d7b0873949e1: "Aldori from Mivon? I thought Swordlords were from Brevoy."
ff8f232c-3292-4fd0-99ca-833e9c6ca4e5: "How would you describe the relations between Mivon and Pitax?"
87f73019-de5c-4caf-b59f-29ec5f8d22f2: "We don't need external help. This is our issue to deal with."
db00829b-c18b-4423-9d47-2a9ba72db556: "I beg pardon for the intrusion, Your Grace, but I'm afraid I have bad news. Magic beasts are attacking people across the country. No one know where they come from, but if the situation continues to develop as it has, it may pose a serious problem."
ca695afd-816f-4c41-ba40-d42d43097e75: "Fortunately, there is good news as well. The {g|Embeth Travelers}Embeth Travelers{/g} have offered their help to fight the monsters. I expect this would be a good opportunity to invite some guests from neighboring countries to join the hunt. Would you mind that?"
226d4b47-5506-4860-9ed4-9bd80fef87bb: "Your Grace, we've received troubling reports. Magic creatures are attacking your subjects at an increasingly alarming rate. No one knows where they come from, but if we don't nip this in the bud, it could become a real disaster."
d784b351-020d-4c10-b667-202d4b62a8a5: "Has anyone told you the bad news? No? I guess I have that honor. We have a new problem: an invasion of wild and hungry magic creatures. There have already been casualties, and if we dally, there'll be more. We have to find the hellhole they're crawling out of and seal it. Otherwise, you risk becoming a ruler with no subjects, I'm afraid."
b4133f0d-5d35-482e-819d-85d41a80a2ab: "{g|Embeth Travelers}Embeth Travelers{/g} have offered their assistance after learning of the problem. We could invite some guests from neighboring countries and turn the hunt into a diplomatic affair. What do you think?"
853e9089-4056-4344-9593-b2aa2624b530: "The bright side is we've got an unexpected ally. {g|Embeth Travelers}Embeth Travelers{/g} have offered to help us thin the monsters' ranks. I suggest combining business with pleasure and inviting some guests from neighboring countries to participate in our little hunt. How does that sound?"
d8c597a3-233a-40f4-8e48-a2d15e4d2ef1: "Embeth Forest is south of your domain. It's a dangerous place, swarming with wicked fey and other magical creatures. {g|Embeth Travelers}Embeth Travelers{/g} are renowned for their mastery of eliminating such threats. They don't ask for much — compensation for traveling expenses, and the right to keep any trophies they hunt down. This seems a fair price to me."
d70167fc-f57e-417c-a30e-b90831b20ca6: "We need to establish connections with our closest neighbors: {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} and {g|Mivon}Mivon{/g}. I'll invite someone from King Irovetti's inner circle, as well as some Aldori {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g} from Mivon."
175ff5f4-63bb-4a7e-a4bd-f4b3e81998ab: "He would most likely reply with a polite refusal. Once he stepped foot on your lands, he'd find himself at your mercy. Irovetti is a treacherous old fox, and he'd expect nothing but similar treachery from others."
62221700-9c90-412f-ba73-649adfe58736: "Typical for the {g|River Kingdoms}River Kingdoms{/g}. They have an armed-to-the-teeth truce, with regular skirmishes along the border. b3e4e6c7-5b93-49dd-8e51-5e4555c3dffb: [Pages through the spellbook] "Anyone have a suggestion which spells I should prepare for tomorrow?"
c3888dc2-37fa-4d99-9825-614b24f38001: "If you are interested in my opinion, you should choose the spells yourself. 'Tis unlikely that someone else knows better than you."
b9315c6b-142e-4462-aca1-b0d9659b07e0: "Something to fry our enemies' asses! Or freeze 'em. Or both!"
4f96ec71-22c6-443c-a8b8-dbd4d7cd9a6f: "You page through your book with such determination. You chase your powers so. But it's all for nothing. In the end you'll be left alone with the silence of eternity."

6645fbe6-536a-49c4-91e1-6db9584a42e5: "Spells you can get from a book are like powers borrowed from a crafty moneylender."
1a3c7bb7-ef21-4159-9b1d-3ad6cf566bd6: "Spells you can get from a book are like powers borrowed from a crafty moneylender."
2c5c841e-7bf6-4f9a-9ba1-37e72e773bad: "Now that there are fewer of us, it's so... cold. So empty. I don't want to talk."
d035b45b-a47b-4b09-97cf-387e9dcc20ed: "I don't know how I'll write today. I don't want to write about death at all!"
72e80cbb-c170-433c-9817-0854db2b6414: "The dead live on in stories of the living. And if you have nothing good to say about the dead... they don't deserve us missing them!"
35cd6e12-abc2-45be-9912-a2361dd42864: "Patience. It's hard to get used to it... but it's easier if you don't talk about it."
3a30d5d3-9d1e-4309-9e5a-28bea405cd67: "Don't force yourself to speak, if you've nothing to say. Let us instead just sit in silence."
3de67f58-93e7-414a-9e0f-282cb2c33bbb: "'I fear I'm going to cry.' Just brush it off, child... the same lot awaits you all."
aaa84cca-1fb9-4d7e-b0be-afa876b77ef5: "Regongar, tell me, you and Octavia are so different... What keeps you together?"
f6924abc-a68e-4cad-900e-29d6407e4c18: "Ask what doesn't! We've been together since we were kids – in chains. And now that we're free, we're together in battle!"
d4563fca-1b3c-4115-b0f2-a0c1e1d1df81: "Wait, I thought I killed you already..."
85ee8f8a-592f-43e8-93a4-304ea9930c4d: [Attack] "I won't let you keep tormenting my city!"
dd17f085-7b34-4850-ae45-ba4c42e6fabd: "Get out of my way, and I won't hurt you."
92113693-70f8-4122-85ae-865397133857: {n}An old{/n} {d|Nugrah}druid{/d} {n}stands there, swaying a little and mumbling to himself. He looks up at you — and you don't see any gleam of intelligence in his eyes.{/n} "You! Why did you disobey me? You didn't die! Have you forgotten the rules?"
2e354700-5771-4e5c-8a7f-a02b02ffd254: {n}Sparks of sense appear in the old man's dim eyes.{/n} "Yes, yes, you {d|c11 Nugrah killed}did{/d}! But not me. I'm just a shadow of the one you slew."
0b074a53-abc2-4b42-9de6-c7b235c974fe: {n}Sparks of sense appear in the old man's dim eyes.{/n} "You don't remember, no, you don't... 11c02a08-a600-4e1f-8600-26015c08a5bb: {n}The old man laughs madly.{/n} "You speak when I say. You do as I say. Disobedience leads to punishment!"
432c5854-2bb0-4663-98ba-ae5adc8230ad: "I often catch you looking at me sideways with fear in your eyes. You do not want me as a companion?"
370de6a7-360c-49f6-b17f-20232899c5fa: "No, Harrim, how can you say that!? Your faith frightens me, that's true. But I still like you personally. You're not arrogant — unlike many other clerics — and you have a peculiar view of the world. Traveling with you is always interesting."
671024fa-3a13-49bc-8aca-ff99aa7cb54d: "You are disappointed in Shelyn, as I am in Torag. Listen closely – maybe you, too, will hear a barely audible whisper... Perhaps Groetus will speak to you too?"
e88c2f2e-6bad-4df3-ba21-4abae80c893b: "No one is talking to me, Harrim. And if I start hearing whispers, it means I have problems with my head, not with my faith!"
bd72a601-8c66-492f-a2ca-3f31c249df51: "Remember those books from Maestro Janush's study? We'd hoped to find something about our past in them..."
e8381aed-7e37-4238-b52a-ddcf77774c35: "Well... we did. And I'm kind of sorry we looked."
0e85d26f-2005-4489-8c14-b08c17824105: "We actually found something, but it's... a sensitive conversation. We'll wait for you in the palace garden, near the viewing point."
68ae1d3f-617a-44bb-8f7a-65aabab49525: "Get lost, Nyrissa. We have nothing to talk about."
40e859a6-d94f-4602-b5fa-932f517e10d9: "You're trying to say that you love me?"
6eaec577-8e29-4c61-a666-727ec4290352: "That's enough. You're my enemy. I don't care about your feelings."
a0e6c8e4-c5f9-46b8-804b-9793ee57347b: "What if I'm ready to sacrifice the kingdom for you? Take it, it's yours. Let the grain fall into the cup."
ebe0eaf7-f2e9-45cb-aa85-b3391d2fe415: "I am sorry that everything turned out like this. I care about you, but I can't let you destroy my kingdom."
c7644727-8d36-40f4-a135-94485d5b506b: "You've broken into my dream. Now it's my turn to enter yours," {n}Nyrissa says in lieu of a greeting. You feel the air trembling around you, like in the short moment of still calmness preceding the storm.{/n}
f358b6ca-4693-404d-8bac-b1cb6732ed53: "I've come to say goodbye. If we meet again, it will be a meeting of sworn enemies on the battlefield."
dc7542b8-65cd-4f44-a7f3-2442e5bf4fa7: "How sad, the fate of daring souls..." {n}The nymph speaks in a singsong voice.{/n} "There are paths that cannot be strayed from, and words that best remain unspoken. e95354e1-68bc-4e4b-b619-0862db059f99: "I cannot love," {n}says Nyrissa in a cold and even tone.{/n} "The very essence was ripped from my soul and lost. But when I speak with you, when I watch you facing unthinkable threats, the hole in my soul bleeds, and hurts more than ever."
00917bc3-6c3d-488e-91d3-7fa8172ee660: "Do you remember the first time we met? 88bca6f6-6f8d-4e46-acac-a532852a3c21: "I know. Long ago, I refused to back down when the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} sent the beast to destroy me and my realm. 60cddb3c-56d7-4602-884a-4f3f0e7aaf60: "Oh, could I ever expect some other answer? You have every right to say so."
5a1ade48-14dc-4e7b-b739-de6ee057121c: {n}Nyrissa gives you a harsh smile.{/n} "Thank you, my hound. I feel I am finally rid of all doubt, and all of that excruciating, debilitating weakness. Farewell!"

41885d98-8ee2-4b57-94ea-290b6246fa92: "It doesn't seem right... What if some of the guards are wounded? We need to help them!"
09233713-cde1-4878-81ed-78d615087493: "Linzi, are you sure you're really a bard? It must be hard, being deaf in both ears! You were told to help Jamandi! Was there a big word in there you didn't understand?"
79f02d51-5588-42c6-a014-48fd6a6ea199: {n}Kesten points to the burning building.{/n} "You'll have to run through the fire. We've almost put it out at the entrance, so your main concern should be to not inhale any smoke. Hold your breath and take the first right, then head straight down the hallway!"
8f9aa37d-e57a-436b-be5f-e9ee8ad9418a: "What are you waiting for? Get to Lady Jamandi in the banquet hall! Now!"

06e0f4de-729f-4349-bbe9-10113341e837: "Fire doesn't frighten me – thanks to {g|Hell}Hell's{/g} blood running in my veins. I'll go ahead and wait for you on the other side. Catch up!" {n}The tiefling girl starts off and dashes through fire.{/n}
7c657196-9018-40a2-a1fd-ebba5c94f0cf: "Considering Lady Jamandi's fame, I'm not surprised that a whole pack of assassins were unleashed on her – including a giant. But what's at stake? What could anyone hope to gain?" {n}The tiefling squints, obviously curious and thinking quickly.{/n}
7216bda7-79d6-4e97-b496-f7f9d2e42943: {n}The girl casts a coy look at Kesten and remarks sweetly,{/n} "If I were a rich and influential lady like Jamandi, I'd also get myself a... manly captain of the guard. Or two."
5ae13589-579d-46c2-825e-7f096a0b0273: "It seems your goblin ally and his tribe have been industrious – they are erecting statues to {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, the Mother of Beasts right outside the capital. Do... they do this with your leave?"
56c9a53f-2181-4329-9487-a4caaafc0f0c: "It seems your goblin friend and his allies have been industrious in their latest blasphemy – they are erecting statues to {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, the Mother of Beasts right outside the capital. e5ed2b32-755f-4790-81e4-7c67d3b95eec: "Your jokes are quite amusing. If you die, I'll have to bring you back. Not in your entirety – just the head. Everything below your clever little head is quite useless anyway."
0f467234-8c11-4918-aafd-595430edfb18: {n}You approach a massive totem of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} that is surrounded by goblins. 6277b24e-a615-49c6-8b8a-ad0f1556c4ad: {n}The shaman emerges from behind the backs of his tribe members — a goblin you already know, covered in tattoos and bedangled with amulets. The other goblins pick up the melody and give way to the shaman, who is walking towards the totem.{/n}
a0d0e5ab-9f64-4371-bcee-9e9eb3c3233b: {n}At the sound of your attack the goblins around the totem spring up to their feet and grab their weapons. 90000ccf-4dbb-4742-8bd5-1ce900ffd8d8: {n}As he approaches the prisoners, the shaman gives a short order. 44c0b87f-dfa9-49c7-ae85-a16fc5132907: {n} The strange procedure takes place again and again — the shaman doesn't stop until he is sure that every prisoner has gotten his swill. At last, having brought the ritual to its conclusion, the shaman turns around to face the crowd — and notices you!{/n}

"LONGSHANKS! SMASH-SMASH-SMASH-SMASH-SMASH!"
{n}The piercing shriek startles the goblins around the totem; screaming and shouting, they dart towards their weapons. Before you have time to react, the shaman disappears in the goblin crowd — which, in turn, attacks you!{/n}
7260165b-9f2a-4112-bfad-bca92acf4877: "What are you waiting for? We've got to save them!"

c9816bd0-a9c2-4259-a56d-ff86378daaa5: "You want some advice, Jubilost? Keep away from the Technic League. Those creeps don't care about your research. For them, you're a... Specimen – that's it!"

ecbf616d-e207-442e-ab44-3be6678183ad: "You shoot well. But bow is a weapon for cowards, not Heroes."

23b6b3f9-5eb2-40c6-b907-d723c5245072: "Stop this immediately! I didn't give you my permission to beat my subjects!"
6f89c9c6-82cb-46b7-9eba-ce9487827068: "Do your job. I won't get in your way."
81231a94-7528-423e-89dd-13c218ffaaae: "Where did you meet {d|Darven}Darven{/d}?! Speak, or I'll skin you alive!"
c6da1e60-20fc-40ac-8eae-a978f4c9e741: "I don't know! I don't know anything, I swear! I've never heard that name before! Please don't beat me anymore!"

961a8b6a-8a99-4a30-8627-2c8dd2eb6eea: "One way or another, I'll soon find out everything I need."
41e03346-6c4a-4702-8a92-4f1dd1107eb2: "Who might you recommend I meet here?"
ba7a6594-3b6c-4585-8c00-d846122c10c6: "I myself give prayer to Calistria. Please, might I have your blessing?"
5d67e3bd-6091-4075-bb9b-7cea7df46895: "Calistria is the goddess of revenge... I'm sure many mention Irovetti in their prayers to her, and probably not with the kindest words?"
f569e823-e6c4-4477-8f98-d7bda26dd7b9: "Oh, a new face at the celebration! I'm pleased to meet you. Drey Yarnes, High Priest of {g|Calistria}Calistria{/g}, at your disposal."
671951e3-c18a-47d9-bc60-f469ecddcd23: "There are many prominent people here, as usual. My first recommendation would be Maestro {d|Annamede}Annamede{/d}. Many would give their lives to exchange words with her. She's {g|Pitax}Pitax's{/g} best singer — and the finest of its women!"
8a4bd3ec-549c-4503-9106-fa57f037fd05: "Of course! She's been the patron goddess of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} since its founding. The goddess likes our joyful town — and its citizens love her in return. 38734129-8227-4e2a-94fe-5f4415394652: "May the grace of the goddess always be with you!"
83a0ee1c-d03b-408b-9a20-0f1531864c99: "The king himself, though... 9d7d1bc7-cd6f-4bed-89b6-cf7e95d34b61: "You see, the goddess patronizes bodily love... but only that given voluntarily. d99af245-fe50-4820-bf22-0bc98e35ebf2: {n}The priest ceremoniously places his hand on your head.{/n} "May our {g|Calistria}lady{/g} help you, if she's so inclined!"
0c7aa47a-a7b1-45b7-8b3f-f77b69840c53: "Is that so? Well, I won't try to convert you. In the end, it's only you who'll suffer for your disbelief, not the gods."

10503ced-ad10-4a71-819b-aa24f89cc1e6: {n}Regongar bares his fangs in a grin.{/n} "Hail the {g|Calistria}Unquenchable Fire{/g}!"
8110b7ba-f1cf-4573-b9ef-bb2b64d4f8ab: "You are well versed in matters both spiritual and political. 3f4b4510-0fc1-4db2-be4e-67786212aca0: "People are so busy with pointless worldly vanity... They'd be better off spending their short lives accepting the end with dignity!"
c71dbce3-50ab-4f60-8271-18489c56a88d: [laughs] "I think, most honorable Harrim, that your dreams of death are like a child, dreaming of becoming an adult and having candy before dinner. Sweet, silly hopes — that pass with time."

f27acd15-f61f-4c8d-afa6-80066260590b: "Yes… you anticipated my test. Of course. Well done."
2dbc7a3e-f899-4027-9fa8-7b3bb8967a39: "Not yet. Stay here while I figure out the next... more confining... challenge."
7c3d1f05-0f45-48c5-9a34-e96a5c9b110e: [Attack] "I'm tire of your antics, creature. I'll silence you now."

f28f259c-380e-4c33-97c4-cded02f7c890: "But Nok-Nok knows better, be slipping out of cage when little countless times!" {n}He holds up a long link of chain, then dumps it on the ground where it lies like a black iron snake.{/n} "Training done!" {n}He pauses.{/n} "Am I Hero now?"
b13112f0-cf8a-4fa6-a16d-015e1590efdc: {n}From out of nowhere, Nok-Nok is standing before you, looking slightly confused. When he sees you, he grins, his eyes gleaming in delight.{/n}
671c5803-a983-46da-a413-d08d43a9b738: "You start Nok-Nok's {d|Nok Executed}training{/d} early! Very clever, Nok-Nok almost thinking longshanks try to kill him. But Nok-Nok know better!" {n}He raps his head twice, winces, then his slow smile returns.{/n}
2676018c-7e61-4b73-b979-1dee3c23a693: {n}Nok-Nok pulls down the collar of his ragged vest, revealing huge bruises on his neck – and then removes his cap, showing his head, which looks to have a few more lumps than before.{/n} "Neck tough."
78017726-7252-4ab2-be2a-3628a07bf915: "Also, when guard not looking, loosen axe head – axe fall off, guard hit me in head with handle, but Nok-Nok head too tough for that... guard so surprised, Nok-Nok bite him in leg, then grab teeth with keys..." {n}He pauses, thinking, rubbing his head.{/n} "No... keys. With teeth."
2b4b75b2-da13-4332-b9af-caadd6bad2be: {n}He smiles again.{/n} "Guard chase, hit Nok-Nok a few times in head, but can't follow in sewer. Now Nok-Nok free again. Am I Hero now?"
0e5190cc-6338-4458-a2bf-b9e7ad064b1d: "I Hero now! Hero better than... all other heroes!" {n}He doesn't seem to hear you.{/n}
e66bf31f-cd4f-4392-b17f-a3c5e73dc865: [Search for way to unlock the door]
d1594b93-0717-4569-ad02-dbed973f28da: {n}A massive stone door blocks the entrance. It has no knobs, buttons, or other signs as to how to unlock it. However, a thick patch of moss has been scraped off the door's hinges, hinting that it's been opened recently.{/n}
9f3f6519-4e62-4d0c-b9fb-53e944141dcf: {n}You barely scratch the door. You may as well have tried forcing your way through the rock face around it.{/n}
ca2e8dbf-b838-4d8c-b724-1c84427f2d61: {n}You can't find any physical mechanisms. It seems the door must be opened through some magical means.{/n}
0d070fd8-888a-43b7-921c-304fb1e070b0: {n}The door radiates a faint transmutation aura.{/n}
fb11a876-b386-495d-90be-3bfd44708a3a: {n}Without a sound, the door slides to the side, revealing the passage beyond.{/n}
5ff04a0e-e2e8-49b5-882f-9cdf82c5d85f: "When we were slaves of the Technic League, they taught us that kobolds are descended from dragons. I still don't know whether or not it's true."
bbc4ebc5-50bf-4f9d-a08a-7b11405ceac5: "I can't imagine that something as magnificent and menacing as a dragon could spawn something so small and ridiculous as a kobold!"
b6ff4e08-cf92-474d-b922-c5d7aee2771e: "It's true. Even today, kobolds still speak Draconic. I was once even going to write a monograph about them... until some social climber from Absalom beat me to it, blast him."
370f9d6a-22d9-4451-9b15-b21b76e7bb67: "A life devoid of higher goals leads only to the degeneration of the spirit. — In their case, both the spirit and the body."
7f6f1163-2ca8-4ff3-9cfb-ca4533d34453: "Who knows... But wait! What if it's the other way around, and dragons are descended from kobolds?"
40c25f2e-f9b0-47b4-9e06-7611221bc1b8: "Who knows... But wait! What if it's the other way around, and dragons are descended from kobolds?"
d65d827f-6ef9-4dc1-94ac-3d0f3f3e1488: "How do you like living in the capital?"
3d4c4f55-9980-436f-bf04-711ccc994eed: "What of your experiments? Have you abandoned your scientific studies?"
3151a80d-fe5f-462e-a04d-a83489459ae0: "I bet it feels good to crawl out of nowhere and find yourself amidst civilized people."
12b25c67-cc01-4601-8c2b-eaecabef7276: "Perhaps you'd like to take another position?"
7e433e26-c98f-4ea9-82dd-a49f7993917c: "How well are you handling your responsibilities?"
e57ca477-2c83-430d-bc55-2017a2dc8199: {n}Bartholomew has changed a great deal since you last saw him. Now he wears a new fancy jacket with shiny buttons, and boots made of soft leather. His moustache and sideburns are waxed and perfectly trimmed.{/n}
418eb428-ca10-43b8-94b1-8365cb4bdde1: {n}Bartholomew gives you a low bow.{/n} "Greetings, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! To what do I owe the pleasure?"
9e97ebee-6cc9-4a18-b383-c495d68808f7: "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! I'm glad you've found time to honor me with your attention. How may I serve you?"
000efeba-23ac-4540-b052-6569aa4f5a61: {n}An expression of disgust briefly appears on Bartholomew's face.{/n} "Not all of the people I deal with are pleasant and polite. But I'm not complaining, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}."
00789460-f261-4eb5-b377-41e332b34bfe: {n}Bartholomew squints his eyes dreamily.{/n} "You wish to know if I like to spend my days counting the treasures of your country, and doing my best to multiply them? I most certainly do, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}!"
64efe510-50d1-4ef2-9f9b-9a3037c6ae01: "Everything is excellent, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! Behind these thick walls — and far from the dirt, bad weather and bandits, I can finally stop worrying about the traps around my house and dedicate myself to something truly important — honing my mind, solving problems of state for the sake of your prosperity!"
59988038-a28b-411e-9475-bfb66f394b8c: "I must say, it won't be an easy task for your lands to achieve a good reputation among your neighbors. It will take some time before the stench of banditry is washed from the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. But I'm sure your wisdom and insight will lead us overcome these problems in the near future!"
15a19952-57c8-42b0-a506-60874172b659: "Only temporarily, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. I couldn't reject the offer to serve such an important person as yourself, but it would have been unwise to drag my entire laboratory to the capital. My tools and instruments shall remain hidden in boxes for a while, until such time as I may take leave my duties here and return to my research."
6a3cd18f-98da-4fc3-b90c-21bc0e723015: {n}Bartholomew frowns for a moment.{/n} "Perhaps you're right, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}... but, frankly speaking, sometimes I miss my hut and the quietness that surrounded it. I suppose deep inside I remain a regular scholar, who prefers scientific research to high society. I only beg you not to take this confession for a complaint! I remain loyal to you and to my vow to serve your country."
1bfb39fe-d2f6-47fd-9f42-dda0feee09ef: "I must admit, a great many have shown interest in your treasure chests. Your other advisors come to the treasury time and again — always with some issue or other. Soldier salaries, palace candles... But don't you worry about all that — without my knowledge and permission, not a single coin leaves the treasury." {n}Bartholomew rubs his palms together.{/n}
81bfaede-ceee-4148-b048-d183ebe30cf4: "To be sincere, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, diplomacy has always fascinated me. Perhaps you might consider whether my talents would be more useful to you in this sphere?"
a789720e-ab33-4690-b6c6-ee4cf1f3401c: "I excel in money matters… Which is to say, I can make money multiply rather than disappear. So I suppose I might serve well as a treasurer."
dccecfc6-2ed1-49f4-9e05-19aadf38de7c: "Oh no, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, I'm perfectly content with my lot."
1988daa6-2691-440c-a1a6-8679eeeddee5: We decided to follow the path and explore the mysterious island.
5b2483a5-a37b-4a20-ac34-080b05b8101e: After a brief discussion, we turned back — this island and its mysteries could wait.
c51e584e-7e15-4d91-bb66-3dbc61013f6a: {name} decided to break through the fog and try to catch up to everyone.
9a3fe597-a82e-449f-b1f1-1453d11bd7b3: Moving forward in such conditions was too dangerous — {name} decided to stay put and call out to {mf|his|her} friends to stay where they were.
c4f151b0-bf04-43ef-b39a-1a5c0b6cd090: "But look at the bag — it's covered in mud, like me, but this impostor is completely clean! {mf|He|She} pushed me down in the fog and stole my bag!"
4bc8a6be-012b-4fcf-9efc-cd95bc5bc294: ...nothing! Instead, {mf||s}he jumped over the fire and attacked {mf|his|her} adversary with {mf|his|her} fists alone!
a7dcbbf5-1b2f-49cc-903c-cb5f97da20cd: "I can tell you exactly how many meals we carried with us, down to the last pack of hardtack. Can {mf||s}he do the same?"
c4ea4730-8287-4752-b252-126b3b3d9bc3: "Seize this impostor immediately. I'll personally execute anyone who disobeys me."
b574c74b-f8b4-43ac-bf6a-364a60f2e693: "Why not tie us both up and interrogate us? You'll soon discover which of us is the doppelganger that way."
cf0a0e1c-82eb-46d6-8fa9-f893088f9978: Reaching the wooded isle, we stopped to look around. The locals living around the lake fully believed the place was cursed — day and night, colored lights supposedly appeared around the island, and some brave souls would even watch them fly over the water. The local legends said that anyone who saw those lights would definitely disappear — if not that night, then within the month for sure...
2af442b4-3689-47f8-ae07-0fc48270eac1: We didn't see any lights at all, though — the island seemed forlorn and completely uninteresting. Silent, gloomy pines loomed over the gray, rocky shore. A narrow path disappeared into the woods.
e5a5806b-b474-41db-a281-2e9d0ed3a7f7: Whoever made the path clearly didn't use it often — we could barely make it out among the ferns. We had to walk single file along the path as branches from the crowded bushes grabbed at our sleeves and backpack straps, only to hit the next person in line once we'd passed. The forest grew taller and thicker, and ever darker.
2582650a-c241-4531-8121-bd3d805f5a78:
The air suddenly grew intensely humid as clouds of milky white, incredibly thick fog flowed up from the ground! And believe me, dear reader, when I say "incredibly thick," we're not talking like how an innkeeper might talk up his soup — it became impossible to see past our own noses, and it was like our ears had been stuffed with cotton! The air itself became so dense it was like walking through water! We had to navigate by touch, and we could move only half as fast as we'd been going.
{name}, who'd been walking last, was forced to stop. With great difficulty, {mf||s}he could barely make out the muffled and worried voices of {mf|his|her} friends ahead. Something had to be done — but what?
2bf7a0c6-10b7-4e3e-b3bd-cb80aca1c3a0: {name} continued forward through the fog, but progress became more difficult with each step! {mf|He|She} felt a sudden movement of air to the left before {mf||s}he flew forward, having been pushed hard in the back!
e01b060d-7e80-4480-9eae-dfa667c29415: But our brave leader's dexterity didn't fail {mf|him|her}! {name} kept {mf|his|her} feet and turned sharply, managing to spot a shadow disappearing into the fog!
22a0f7d0-7fd6-4474-9c0f-831dee5839b2: {name} continued forward through the fog, but progress became more difficult with each step! {mf|He|She} felt a sudden movement of air to the left before {mf||s}he flew forward, having been pushed hard in the back!
c93f254e-6e3b-4382-8551-be28ccd77009: No matter how loud {mf||s}he screamed, {name}'s voice couldn't penetrate the thick blanket of fog. {mf|His|Her} companions' voices grew fainter and fainter, until they died out entirely. {name} felt the sharp realization that {mf||s}he was completely alone.
9be435a6-4886-4a5a-bbb6-ae64c9fa489e: The fog finally began to clear, and soon there was no trace of it. {name} looked back, and {mf|his|her} friends were nowhere to be seen. But up ahead, {mf||s}he could just make out a blinking, welcoming light!
3f734f81-c03f-4b3f-a176-dcb8b333d3f9:
As {name} approached the light source, it quickly became clear that the light was a bonfire! Soon, {name} entered a brightly lit clearing and saw... all of us!
But why, then, did no one jump up to greet {mf|him|her}, or give a welcoming yell, or a hug, or even offer a cup of hot tea? Why had everyone frozen in their seats, spoons lifted in the air? Why the deathly silence?
cbe7b4dd-72e7-4729-b76a-35e2c37e9d5e: Imagine {name}'s surprise when {mf||s}he finally saw why {mf|his|her} appearance had caused such a strange reaction — it seemed {mf||s}he hadn't been missing at all! {mf|He|She}'d been sitting with us all by the fire, watching {mf|his|her} exact copy emerge from the forest!
f017d075-9ce0-421c-a795-5e0fa2c8ef37: Yes, dear reader, just imagine it! Two copies of the {mf|king|queen} met in the clearing, seemingly identical! But which of the two was real? The {mf|king|queen} sitting by the fire said...
36f43d1f-c229-4a0c-9e04-e8b3b0d03934:
The mask dropped, and we saw a short, pale man with blond hair and parrot-like wings with bright feathers!
We all went after him together, but {name} held onto him most tightly — {mf|his|her} hands gripped the joker's wing in an iron grip.
Then an ear-piercing whistle sounded from all around us, and stones began raining on us from above! The impostor was aided by his winged kin, who grabbed him by the hands and began pulling him up. We didn't give up, but in the end, we were overpowered. There were just too many, dear reader — they quickly reclaimed our prisoner from us. Soaring into the air and shaking their fists at us, they flew off.
We sat a long time around the fire, laughing and chatting about how {name} cleverly dispelled the illusion. And when morning came, as we looked around at the rainbow-colored feathers left behind by our uninvited guests, I noticed one of them had lost a valuable bracelet in the fight! We'd ended up with a trophy, at least.
2584e053-611b-416d-8ee0-bf7b2b2b335e: "How can there be any doubt? I'm the real {mf|king|queen}, of course! Look, I've got my bag with all my things!"
2ff25a5f-c8bf-4035-909a-5fa70264981a: "How can there be any doubt? I'm the real {mf|king|queen}, of course! Devils know who just walked out of the forest, and you're ready to believe them over me? So much for good friends!"
4301496c-c05f-43b5-9dec-93d21cc0a047:
Credit where credit is due, {name} fought like a raging lion, and it was no easy task to catch and immobilize {mf|him|her}.
Then we heard a sharp whistle followed by wild, deafening laughter. Stopping in the middle of the fight, we looked around and gasped — dozens of fey flew around us! Pale, blond-haired creatures with rainbow-colored wings, like those of an exotic parrot! The person sitting by the fire dropped {mf|his|her} mask, and in the place of the false {mf|king|queen} was another one of those jokers! Grabbing the bag with all our food, he soared into the air.
"Farewell, sirs and ladies! And thank you for a wonderful performance — my friends and I haven't laughed like that in quite a while!"
The fey vanished into the air, and the rest of the fairies followed suit. Needless to say, it was at least a week before any of us could look our leader in the eye again...
3fc04b95-f210-41e8-8434-8b076e598f5e: And what did the {mf|king|queen} who walked out of the forest answer?
acf9e4fc-cf3c-4dfe-9a89-7a942a34b2ee:
How should I put this, dear reader? Either the {name} who walked out of the forest seemed newer to us, or maybe the tone of {mf|his|her} voice lacked its usual confidence... but in the end, the words of the {mf|king|queen} who emerged from the forest just didn't convince us.
All together, we went after {mf|him|her}, yelling all the while, "Onward! Tie up the doppelganger!"
7c5050d1-e9c9-4748-8f1b-b637007232a6:
A deafening silence hung in the air. One could hear the thoughts churning through our brains...
And then the {name} sitting by the fire laughed in a strange voice. {mf|He|She} stood up and... began rising into the air?!
f638947b-202f-415c-9f07-a19ab50c0287: How deftly {name} jumped over the bonfire! Before we knew it, {mf|his|her} fist had connected with the face of the other {name}, and their face began to morph before our eyes!
b3f7d0e3-8aa2-4c3a-88e9-b3c7b84f7bdd: But the {mf|king|queen}'s deft jump wasn't deft enough — {mf||s}he stumbled and fell right into the open fire! Cursing and rolling to the side, {mf||s}he started to get up as our entire crew converged on {mf|him|her}!
43ddf278-7d4d-4c88-8957-9ec559ef233c: Failing to keep {mf|his|her} balance, {name} fell into the sticky mud. At that moment, {mf||s}he just barely spotted a pair of pale hands reach out, grab {mf|his|her} bag, and disappear back into the fog!
81b86d63-11d6-43c1-a6ee-8aab8fb90abd: "Your Grace!" {n}Kesten's face looks worried and fearful.{/n} "Your Grace, ill news from the {g|Narlmarches}Narlmarches{/g} — again!"
7f94bb2d-608b-47b5-bb46-dc03f48c90f0: "There were already many trolls there, but now people are afraid to leave their houses! The wilds are said to be swarming with them. The hunters were the first ones to notice, then came the merchants delivering packages and food to the outskirts of the barony. Now there are more and more reports of trolls attacking villages".
4da1e86f-57be-460d-9bb7-60f6d9943b73: "At first, I took the reports for gossip. Thought it was just the fear talking. But a local group of merchants recently reported that most of the trolls seem to be lurking around the house of one Bartholomew Delgado — an odd mage living out in the wilds all by himself. They're saying there are so many trolls out there, nobody can reach Bartholomew for fear of the beasts!"
0f0c60d0-dca0-4bc1-9d70-2443b0c65910: {n}Kesten's face goes dark.{/n} "Those trolls are up to something, and this strange Bartholomew fellow is clearly tangled up in it somehow. If the wizard's gotten some idea in his head to conspire with the trolls, we should make the first move and hit them with a preemptive strike. However, if the trolls are coming FOR him rather than TO him..." {n}Kesten sighs.{/n} "It would be an enormous help if you could pay a visit to Bartholomew and figure out what's going on. I recommend haste — if nothing is done soon, there may be a grisly fate in store for your subjects!"
fa2cb339-41ec-494c-b557-5415e4731e29: "Local merchants reported lots of trolls lurking around the house where Bartholomew Delgado lived — you know, that suspicious wizard you... Well, no need to bring that back up. Anyway, I sent some reliable people there. They searched his house and found a torture chamber in the basement, with a troll tied to a rack. The poor beast died of hunger. Seems that's how the wizard amused himself..." {n}Kesten shakes his head grimly.{/n}
80ded5c5-d2ee-4cfd-8cd6-fc048f6b1380: "We're used to trolls lurking in deep marshes and forests. There were a surprising amount of them around Bartholomew's house, and now we know why... They pillage, plunder, and drag away cattle and people alike. Survivors say they seem to be taking all the loot in the same direction, somewhere around here — that must be where their lair is!" {n}Kesten makes a mark on your map.{/n}
378fa973-8bb2-448f-913e-f847c5d21951: "Svetlana and Oleg are a fine couple. Though sometimes I feel he mistakes her for a child..."
41694d5e-f032-4e12-b028-5376842e2287: "Ha. He's simply protecting what's most important to him."
efb3a7fd-f4b9-4d97-b9de-62de416eb4f7: "They also have a fine trading post, though a bit neglected of recent. By my calculations, it will be a part of our {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom} — if we win, that is..."
465a42ef-47f8-40dd-baa0-7f446e11fe00: "You're right. And men like him are more common than you think."
7bb02702-5d88-443c-a516-a14c3ff5a9bc: "Greet, word, word, big words, ask, extra words, extra words… ZZzzz-hngGGggh-Ppbhww-ZZzzz… all asleep, but still extra words!"
8f8008b7-1bf4-4d0c-a22d-c8eb9fdb58d9: "If you think this pitiful impersonation will hurt my feelings… hey! Stop doing that! I don't act like this!"
5cdd813f-9f6a-42cb-aebb-9e455574750e: "Isn't it folly, trying to recover the gnomes' lost immortality? Nothing is eternal. Is there truly a difference in the face of the oblivion – to live for ten years or a million? The whole First World will come to an end at some point..."
2f5ae50e-ea51-47af-aaf0-a9490fa5b490: "I don't know about the end of the world, but your nagging is certainly endless. This makes you somewhat of a living phenomenon."
58b1d478-f550-43e1-9eb1-5b01f71952fd: "Can I help you in any way?"
300f7cf6-5013-406d-b89a-899801d96489: [Give fangberries] "Are these the berries you were looking for?"
a1b8659b-4b4c-47c7-a6b9-893b7d1562ed: "Why do you need fangberries and moon radishes, Bokken?"
f074f3aa-0858-479e-b9c6-476641675d1d: "What was it you wanted me to do, again?"
ffc3eee9-1d2d-4f77-9b70-7c429013c5b2: "Would you buy more fangberries and moon radishes if I brought them?"
3ab2f647-a9c9-43a0-a267-16f0363c21cc: "What do you use these fangberries for?"
ec4464da-a34a-4f45-8d47-2baba8aba6c3: [Give moon radishes] "Does this look like the radish you were looking for?"
cd4a1a41-0a1b-4c7d-b4db-e918033ca2dd: "Bokken, how would you like to become my court alchemist?"
87fedee9-c19c-485c-b6ce-c3c4ef87a0c6: "Is this the book you wanted me to find?"
1a66617b-0606-420c-aee2-412a1b134813: "Here's the second volume of that book set."
ab082988-edba-45c9-bd33-64b0ad19c3fe: "'Of Transmutations and Bodily Poisons,' volume three. Here you are, Bokken."
d8e3c7bb-63e4-479b-98ef-a4d9d131e992: "You're not working on any dangerous new potions, I hope?"
19a61d41-624d-4065-8372-f51d6ccb6c18: {n}Bokken frowns as he ostentatiously examines the nearest wall, hands in his sleeves. Without turning to you, the old man finally says in a dull voice,{/n} "You want some potions?"
c9956023-c77f-4420-8e47-92a9355091be: {n}Bokken glances at you, suddenly interested.{/n} "Well, since you're asking... There's a cave nearby. I'd be real grateful if you gathered a basket of them and brought them back. Just be quick, if you do — they spoil quickly."
48fb7f70-8234-4c9b-befa-c86c446837c1: "It's not a huge deal, really. I'd do it myself, if I were younger. But if you're willing, I'll pay you — three potions for the berries, and a purse full of coins for the radishes!"
78b51319-efb5-46e5-b8dc-6bb528c2d63c: {n}The old man crosses his arms, clearly annoyed.{/n} "Whatever."
57790949-171b-408b-9ab1-3c84006251a3: {n}Bokken glances at you hopefully.{/n} "Just watch out, all right? Don't end up someone's lunch."
eff0c013-2d7f-496f-ad5d-d74b2fcb328b: "You want to know, huh? Well, I'll gladly tell you after you bring some to me."
4ee1fede-5c12-48ac-a4f4-0e7b986f0742: {n}After a quick glance at the basket, Bokken grabs a fistful of berries and shoves them into his mouth. A smile of delight brightens his face.{/n} "Ahhh, fangberries! So fresh! You've been good to an old man. Thank you! Here, take these potions. If you need more, feel free to return — I'll even give you a discount."
a46e5fb9-71cc-4985-8aeb-9ec605a5a83c: "There's a cave filled with spiders. Red berries I call fangberries grow inside. I'd like you to gather a basket full of them and bring them to me as quickly as you can, so they don't go sour."
ba5640c5-4905-4d74-81db-d5b627faf540: {n}Bokken impatiently grabs the basket from you, but his face falls after he examines the berries.{/n} "Damn it all! 9d94aa75-5616-40ee-b549-0d0ba3a3eb92: "The citizens of Pitax seem to love Irovetti."
929bac61-42fa-48b8-b217-8ac40d819a37: "Who might you recommend I meet here?"

4c479e2b-7114-42e9-9676-7b0786bce341: "I'm the head of the Liacenza family and master of what remains of the Iron Fox Trade House. Before Irovetti took the crown, it would have been my family receiving you at our house. Alas, we're simply guests at his celebration, now."

21fc1361-8067-428a-8e39-0f108c335c4e: "I'd do better to tell you whom you should avoid. There's a gloomy, sickly looking gnome wandering about — Kharne Vereel, chief of the so-called thieves' guild. He's Irovetti's primary business partner, and they understand the word 'business' quite broadly."
d9e10d7b-771c-4e47-9091-34da169ec50b: "It was an honor speaking with you, Your Highness."

3a48477b-3577-4f78-ae97-55b77a66224b:
"And Irovetti's pleased as punch about it — the more time the citizens spend in 'altered states,' the fewer questions they ask.

21736b34-82c1-4ebd-8ec9-9a6f668c2ec6: "Take the gold, supply poison to his subjects. Irovetti's soul is black. Black and venomous."
08819638-08b8-402c-adf5-3db73394b074: "Pitax's high society is a notorious snake pit. Not that it's much different from any other high society in the world…"
908753f5-f79c-42cd-9fa2-0c5eabfa281d: "So this bright celebration is designed to veil the despair of the king's victims? How naive I was, when I praised its merriment! You have my sympathies, honorable Gasperre. I'd lose my mind if someone took my kin hostage."
2bfa3cbc-9f26-418e-8d65-b148b45b89c2: "If you want my opinion, commander, I think we should hear them out."
b7fcd48a-1291-4770-a796-933707b2ddb0: [Draw your weapon] "We are not bandit scumbags like you, and make no deals with your kind!"
4e020e50-1645-48a6-9db3-6cb69232082e: "Just to get this straight, some person or creature fried your gang until they sizzled, and now you want our help to get the better of them?"
ed5265f9-c2c2-4860-90e0-574e05adaf23: "Why should we share the loot with this rabble? Let's kill them, and then the dragon."
93855df2-fb46-4791-a206-b8e00d74b6fa: "Under other circumstances I wouldn't listen to these thugs, but a dragon is far too dangerous. We should unite with them even if only to protect our lands."
80ed4d53-05ec-4dc3-9001-09d4a9038ffe: "We can't abandon our principles, no matter what is at stake. No deals with bandits."
15d61092-32f3-42e9-a06d-22eb8a7029c7: "One should never reject a favorable offer. No matter who makes it."
74d24ae1-2733-4367-9f42-bbd02cfc4a3f: "I like it when bandits come out on their own, and literally ask to be regaled with a sword."
ff9ec7b0-0d55-445e-9e2e-e11da40a4c14: "We don't need to fight. After all, Yan has come to us to talk openly. Let him take his people from the barony and go his own way."

4da5ef46-5a94-4e54-85ca-773b32b8b157: {n}The gang appears excellently armed and equipped. However, the bandits have obviously just come from a fight. Most are scratched and wounded, their clothes torn – and what's more interesting, several have burns left by fire or electricity.{/n}

6142bfe4-c0f4-40b6-af24-56196a71ee17: "In the name of Asmodeus, will we ever be done sorting out the tavern riffraff, who are ready to cross swords over every imagined insult?!"
646df65e-4c3f-48e1-b62b-1215baec39ff: "Under normal circumstances, I would reproach you for insubordination, General. But right now I don't feel the need. To arms!"
a809647b-2172-4796-a725-c27808bd5988: "What a pity. Fine, let's see if you're as good in a fight as they say!"
3575a51c-bfd2-48af-b847-7516f9adf246: {n}Maegar laughs softly.{/n} "General, don't swallow him whole right away. Leave a few pieces for the rest of us!"
6694f1fd-5786-49ff-ac86-9aa236d37dff: {n}Maegar makes a wry face but nods.{/n} "So what did you want to tell me?"
df9e0aaa-4665-46cc-9a76-6f812793b8aa: "You have good eyes, General. I wonder if they see the potential benefits of such an arrangement, or can't you see past my singed pride?"
8104ca46-d89f-426d-b8ed-15ace715d909: "I'll tell you the whole story. b8a50715-1f93-4914-9e3b-2fa82156d0a5: "This is an urgent matter, Sir Varn. You have a bloody dragon in your barony. Wounded, but still most deadly. I promise you, afterwards we will leave your lands and do our work somewhere far, far away."
bce6453e-dc01-4f73-a52b-ad8b09442b8f: {n}As the bandit sets out his ideas, Maegar grows darker and darker. There's little doubt – he's preparing to order an attack, and put the gang down here and now.{/n}
bcd45365-fcfa-4316-9791-e4f7f171aa6a: {n}Cephal watches the leader's face closely, and draws himself together – undoubtedly preparing for a bitter dispute, but it would be unseemly to argue in front of the thugs. The sharp words will have to wait until the action is done.{/n}
e0c7d001-6222-401d-bc3f-9053d7616953: {n}Cephal starts to rub his hands together, apparently preparing for a fight.{/n}
1f1086c2-434a-4c26-8814-1d9d4d5d431d: "Listen to your General, Baron, if you don't want to listen to me." {n}The wizard speaks softly.{/n}
ad01b0cf-e272-4531-a11f-bdf25d8b011c: "Captain Varn has spent most of his life fighting bandits and murderers. I wouldn't want Baron Varn to commence his rule with an ill-fated partnership with them. 93dff829-31f0-46a7-aa7d-33483dc3fe15: {n}The bandit salutes.{/n} "The beast lies to the southwest. We will be waiting for you nearby. Come join the fun!"
fd63e5eb-f36c-4f49-bbf5-2bc33d96589f: {n}A tense silence hangs in the air. Maegar doesn't speak, either pondering his thoughts, or awaiting a reaction from you and Cephal.{/n}
74798770-67f5-43a2-80fc-d9ceb3da7539: {n}Maegar fakes a friendly smirk.{/n} "Sir Pale Yan, I'm sure this rehearsed speech is very impressive, but I'm afraid it comes a little late. f71643d1-49f2-4a6f-af22-199bd0b76272: {n}Maegar frowns.{/n} "So what, we just let them rob people, even on somebody else's lands?"
65d0ebd2-b258-45c5-a940-9601b64321fb: "What do you care what happens beyond your borders? Take care of your subjects, don't take extra risks just to play at being magnanimous."
ad436ef1-0796-4311-8878-2d91e6cdfaa1: "I'm surprised. You and the General present a united front! Fine, I will heed your advice. Do you hear, Sir Pale Yan? Gather your rabble and get out of my lands. If I see you again within the lands my barony, there will be no time for talk!"

3f30e29c-81fb-4b5a-9c91-53763ec29a33: [Give the bird to Nyrissa] "This is the final link in Shyka's riddle."
c2d3724f-bf23-45fa-b705-59d453aa9fe8: "Is it even possible? To defeat an Eldest in battle?"

9e15e212-8063-42c4-87b3-fc95d9cca9e7: "Tell me, what are you going to do?"
7b5d01db-c179-4cc5-b10c-2aecc5e64096: "All right. There must be a quiet nook here somewhere."
06930b9a-6dc7-4067-8825-2daff72e03da: "Not now. I'll return to you later."
5248802b-7f62-4505-9079-d63fb4141962: "Be sure. After everything we've been through, nothing is going to stop us."
d201b704-ccc1-403a-b174-3ba752a6d598: "I see no point in guessing. We will fight, come what may."
fc73aa99-0be0-4244-ad42-921413faabe1: "Of course. I'm ready to share an hour with you — or the whole of eternity."
1aac98a6-65b3-4383-8d26-11b6893b9acb: "It's not a good time. We need to concentrate on other things."
6e9d8161-6474-44ce-a411-49cf2de38939: {n}Nyrissa shivers as if she's cold.{/n} "Forgive me for leaving you there, in the city. I was afraid the {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g} would take me by force. When I've finally begun to discover the thread you pointed me towards — how to fight the curse..."
6a2e8696-26b8-4a1c-a48f-359aae493ca2: "A bird... I recognize it. The songbirds of the Thousandbreaths were once famous throughout the entire {g|First World}First World{/g}. b3d5a06f-6e7f-4f3b-9212-8b28d0b900e6: "Well, children. Did you like this little journey? The poisoned pond becomes clear and sparkling, and bones turn into a songbird. We look to the past to see the future."
514fdbc8-429e-4365-a141-529d24b0a848: "But let us not waste time. You've planned something very daring — to turn his curse against our self-confident brother, the {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g}. f6dd0b96-903c-4438-af16-9901e947cb8c:

8a8e9d31-f07d-4777-b070-7e04a3571a0d: "No one is invincible, children. I know it sounds a bit too simple. Defeat a god, then curse him while he's baffled about how you managed to do it! 97071ee9-8d6f-4d92-bc3a-25adc4172a13: "Most importantly, don't develop a taste for it. Besting one {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} is enough for a lifetime."
b285fa9b-b70a-4156-97ad-822d023ea9b5: "We near our purpose. I want to believe all this wasn't in vain..."
9bdea605-0a44-495a-b5b1-98aa7f24f311: "I feel the bond between us and the {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g}, like it's a real thing. He thinks it's harness and reins for misbehaving horses. 1fde67d8-6371-40f0-a799-146a463b5a31: {n}Nyrissa looks thoughtful, and a little sad.{/n} "Our mission here is over. But before we go on... I'd like to talk in private. Will you spare some time for me?"
1bebca93-49ed-4565-adab-a30fbc119042: {n}You transport to a quiet meadow. Nyrissa stands quietly for a while, staring off into the distance and gathering her thoughts.{/n} "The words of the {g|Eldest}Eldest{/g} may seem whimsical or even senseless, but I think I understood them. c0fe91d3-5921-44d4-b4e0-bc748a8d927b: {n}The nymph finally turns around and looks you in the eye.{/n} "Over the ages that passed since the curse was placed upon my shoulders, I've almost forgotten how it feels — to fear for someone other than myself. Will we survive what the future holds? Will we survive it together?"
103c9b98-1c39-4584-bc3d-cda714b52159: {n}Nyrissa nods, to your words or her own thoughts.{/n} "Then let's not wait for tomorrow. Let us seize the moment — the final hour before the storm. Let's share it together, and everything that awaits us."
fed177e9-5bcf-4a54-a0f5-2afd8df8bc87: {n}Nyrissa exhales.{/n} "As you wish. Then look for me at the camp near the capital. I'll await you there and prepare for the coming battle."
3a9ff3e1-243d-4919-8f88-b295d5ddeae5:

89f36fa4-a2cf-44e8-b709-c0083465d2a0: "We need to talk to them, all three of them, and do whatever they require, to secure their aid. I'm asking you to do it. I wish to stay in this place for a while... to remember the hour of my curse. But if need be, I will send my visions to you."
3183a6d5-570d-4526-a339-8d97f6e17860: {n}The nymph nods and sinks into thought.{/n}
c3930aeb-0790-482e-b200-e79441e81259: "A crime has taken place nearby. The one responsible may be hiding in this house. Have you seen anything suspicious?"
99a0fbae-b183-4d4c-b5c6-17be3660d39e: "Do you prefer snares? Or a bow?"
0634ee2c-610b-48f6-b595-02309cfece02: "What kind of prey do you hunt?"
683abec5-ddba-4556-93c2-aced5fe00f32: "An odd place to rest for the night."
18d9463b-03d5-4de2-9370-da9f3851a3a8: "The woman in the kitchen — your cook?"
37226632-27d7-4682-b388-44d702136eab: "Do you know the hostess of this lodge?"
aa2c0689-34e9-4870-928e-db0e2b9b791a: "Do you recall who came to the lodge in the last hour or so?"
65f2b976-31a0-4fba-8915-adff1fec171a: "I've been to your room. I found no hunting weapons there."
c45c3644-ba00-4482-950a-df0415bf7182: "I need a key to your room."
c922698a-3e25-443a-bd4b-502d6263ccd2: "A legalist? So you are a judge?"
8781c986-c42a-4821-9b89-e3ea9c831dc2: "Oh, yes! Of course, Kabron Tedrim! I've heard about you and your famous legal cases!"
69dbf164-6c72-424c-ae53-d50335874dee: "Well, with a difficult job like yours it's impossible to get by without some divine support. Whom do you address your prayers to?"
aa3c4aea-4639-4728-baeb-36ed2b6ff79b: "You've recognized me at once. Do I know you?"
3dc7634d-d80d-44dd-ba4a-49d094625b8e: "Well, I hope you enjoy your hunting. Let's change the topic."
89c7bde1-2f9f-4b19-8f02-b77f0a86169c: {n}A bearded, middle-aged man stands before you. He wears a massive gold chain on his neck. The woman beside him gives a polite smile and a nod as you approach.{/n}

dbc63bc7-d699-43b0-8206-b0942105645d: "You see, erm..." {n}Kabron clears his throat.{/n} "I've heard the wildlife here are excellent sport. So I decided to see for myself — sort truth from rumor, you understand. Fortunately, my fair wife was in favor of the trip — so here we are."

a958cd2d-d7d8-4230-9661-125a51b81d5b: "Why, {mf|baron|baroness}!" {n}Una gives a false smile.{/n} "We adore this… charming dwelling!" {n}She glances around the dim hall — her smile remains, but you notice she raises an eyebrow at her surroundings, as if in judgment.{/n}

f5ba4cc8-edb2-4605-97b4-9c73337b9d27: {n}Una coughs delicately.{/n} "My constitution demands a... unique diet." {n}She studies you closely.{/n} "A private matter, if you don't mind."
2ab9d84f-3387-42a9-82b4-e285689fa16c: {n}The Tedrims exchange glances.{/n} "I'm afraid, Your Grace," {n}Kabron looks downcast.{/n} "We won't be able to help you."
94ba292c-2c26-4463-bd98-317f714a3160: {n}Despite Una's cool expression, you notice a bead of sweat running down her temple. As she spots your glance, her lips tighten. {/n}

ac6d1d98-9e67-44e9-9710-08ad07013e7d: {n}Kabron raises an eyebrow.{/n} "I doubt it, Your Grace, My legal cases are not so famous to be known outside {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}."

bf2b9cb8-5682-4c87-a361-8f270421a528: "Linzi thinks you're concerned about the scar."
1b5b0d68-fa83-4857-9858-b745fb252647: "You've simply run out of patience. That sometimes happens when you're surrounded by idiots."
eb8ecafe-0a2d-4a77-9643-214c0c9ef24b: "You've always said that beauty isn't really important. Are you changing your views now?"

9aa060bc-205c-4235-a148-0ef4e54bb6e6: "If that's the case, then we'll just have to deal with them personally."

5b5ff3bc-8144-4399-b8e7-7b552901d829: "I don't care what excuses you come up with. Get a handle on yourself, or you're going back to Brevoy."
65f372c0-de5c-4e33-bb1d-d6a92c2cd6af: "I'm tired of your theatrics. Pull yourself together and stop wasting my time."
425a707f-9514-4bc5-9336-ab4437d01b9a: "It's a pity we couldn't get rid of the scar."
6aaa2ac7-4a06-4fcf-9b81-1a45d9698de4: "About what happened at the Temple of Prisms..."
93ac76d1-54e7-4914-a148-33518c5d0438: "I'm glad this saga is finished. Let's see what else needs to be done..."
98f33b6a-8dff-4df7-84b1-2774135cf8ee: "The next time someone come to claim you, I'll just slit their throat. You serve only me, don't forget it."
e003f2d4-23be-415a-aa92-4ffe7b6b89a8: "Together we can overcome any obstacle – I'm sure of that!"
68f768a4-6f42-4d9a-aa8c-c5be3bbcce5a: "Why is it you never just talk to me? I have to pry everything out of you!"
89d42816-23ef-4be5-b70d-09b35bcd6694: "I'd like to spend some time alone with you."
884cebb5-08d2-4d20-9e6d-4d6e759bc241: "About us... Let's go back to how things were when we met."
24ed7f23-70d1-4c0c-ba26-c2229ff35eec: "So you're an atheist? You don't worship any deity?"
99d3fbde-0ae6-41c3-bebf-440ddf6d4af3: "Greetings." {n}Valerie sighs.{/n} "Everything is well, I hope? I'm ready for new orders."
7ba5db30-c8f6-414e-96ba-36b68b7efebf: "I'm aware of that," {n}Valerie sighs.{/n} "But I'm sure you understand that I am what I am. That's how I was brought up – first by my parents, and then by my mentors in the Order."
05dc8991-9272-4f2d-a61c-016db8154143: "Besides, I was born to a noble family." {n}Valerie raises her chin proudly.{/n} "So I rather enjoy the idea that my manner of speech differs a bit from the common language of the peasantry. 7f8916a3-92ab-46fe-a5c0-77bac1829525: {n}Valerie rolls her eyes.{/n} "Sadly, you're right to suppose that. de4a1474-319a-4174-be58-c4fc8697d051: "Oh, and don't forget about the village oafs. They understand the concept of nobility perfectly well. c1e73ac0-62a1-4639-a001-6faa0687596f: "What do you mean, 'why'?" {n}Valerie looks at you in bewilderment.{/n} "I follow your orders. I've joined your campaign because I have faith in you. I believe your intentions to be noble, though things may not always turn out as you've planned."

4605a82d-1fbd-403e-8b4d-0aec32feac2c: "What exactly would you like to know? I was born to a noble family, though I didn't remain long on the family estate. My father sent me to the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g}, but I left once I realized that it didn't match my principles."
332cedf8-97df-4114-9fff-90bc6909a63c: "I was born in {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}, but in fact I've never seen much of the country. I spent my childhood on a remote estate, owned by my noble family. My father is a respectable philanthropist and benefactor of the Church of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}. He's also a renowned private collector and a great admirer of the arts."
0ef9682f-a8b0-4410-9874-8e19c55c24ca: "My mother saw to my education personally. From my early years I learned good manners – how to behave at the dinner-table, and the proper form of words for every occasion. I also learned the difference between true nobles and lowborn upstarts, and I learned how to treat each of them properly."
3ed720d8-8ac5-4763-8f2f-409ecc965435: "Our home was always under the protection of several paladins of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}. My father has donated a handsome sum to their Order. One of them, a man of venerable age with a grey beard, once let me touch his shining armor. I still remember the admiration I felt when I touched the cold, polished steel." {n}Valerie smiles.{/n} "Of all the memories of my childhood, that one is somehow the warmest one."
1967ba9d-2e46-4836-8ce2-c64a63486b17: "Ah, as you can imagine, from my first days I was surrounded by crowds of servants and nannies who never stopped praising my heavenly beauty. The paladins of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} who used to visit our house echoed these praises."
e7415baf-7790-4593-8494-90a1b03421d9: "In the end, general consensus overwhelmed my father's better judgment. When I turned six, I was brought to the Church of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}, and told that this would be my new home."
1dd595b4-61b0-4cce-ba12-22758a256c31: "Don't pity me though, I beg of you. Many who hear this story immediately assume that my parents were cruel and had no love for their child." {n}Valerie's eyes become stern.{/n} "My parents had respect for me. They taught me something that has supported me all of my life. – A sense of self-esteem."
4600854b-f3ba-4be4-94ec-45c6a67d3e50: "Besides, they didn't abandon me. Once every six months, they would come and visit me at the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g}. We had some tea and then had an hour to walk around the garden. Then they would take their leave, as etiquette demanded."
b95882d2-8ebc-4fd6-976e-14669a7c656e: "A variety of things. Some of them appealed to me, others I simply couldn't accept. I enjoyed the physical activities and swordsmanship. But the arts, calligraphy, painting, poetry – and so many other ways to waste one's time."
4aa9631a-3350-4b5b-b532-e5b2a7e5d986: {n}Valerie sighs.{/n} "I guess that deep in my heart I always knew I'd never be a true paladin of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}. Wielding a sword always felt more natural to me than handling a paintbrush."
71fc2b1a-f44e-415d-9004-1b555733eac5: "Because of my heavenly beauty." {n}Valerie winces in contempt.{/n} "According to {g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} laws, all art is sacred – whatever form it takes. Severe punishment awaits those who dare harm a painting, sculpture or poem, no matter how worthless the drivel might be."
a74a3610-b38a-4f84-829c-da0ee4983311: "My looks always attracted unwanted attention from the pilgrims and acolytes at the temple. I received my first poem, dedicated to me, when I was nine. The author was some wealthy geezer." {n}Valerie's lips thin in contempt.{/n} "And that was only the beginning."
531c6cb0-9892-447e-87e9-d8f5704ff2c6: "Sculptures. Pictures. Poems. I was drowning in them. My admirers mobbed me, and I had to respectfully accept all their... garbage. The clerics of the temple were magnanimous, for my suitors made generous offerings to the Church. But once... one time I just snapped."
dbbfd0b6-e1e7-496b-971b-72eef260309d: {n}Barely suppressed anger glitters across Valerie's eyes.{/n} "Some wealthy idiot has dedicated an extremely untalented poem to me, and he had the nerve to read it right to my face, holding my sleeve. The hour was late, and I was on my way to get some rest after a boring lesson on rhymes. I lost control and tore the poem apart, right in front of him." {n}Valerie raises her head proudly.{/n} "The paladins wanted to impose some punishment upon me, I don't remember which one exactly. They wanted me to repent. Instead I just gathered my things and left."
3fae7521-db17-49e9-b693-3d5124ca85fd: "I set off for {g|Restov}Restov{/g}." {n}Valerie shrugs.{/n} "I wanted to get as far away as possible from {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} and the destiny everyone seemed so ready to force upon me. Besides, the school of swordsmanship in Restov has quite a decent reputation. Honestly, I was hoping for an opportunity to learn from the famous Aldori masters."
2133fcb3-9690-47d0-8a5b-9cc15e26b31f: "Eventually it became clear that their technique wasn't a good fit for me. They teach to avoid impact, whereas I prefer to raise my shield."
84b3bb85-bc29-4c08-a9fb-7fae0366b02e: "But my abilities and skills, which I'd learned at the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g}, were enough to make the {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g} take an interest in me. They offered me a chance to join the mercenaries who served the Swordlords, and I accepted."
1f4f9495-30b6-4cb9-85be-c44a6cc7c1b4: "It's beyond my power to change that. But I've never given a potential admirer any reason to start a conversation with me. But it doesn't stop them! After leaving the Order, I took a dagger and cut off the long hair they used to praise. Well, now I get letters praising the beauty of my eyes."
68f8f9de-0d1d-4a0d-aadd-fb1aa1ed7e5d: "It was because of my appearance that I ended up in the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g}, though I never wanted to be a paladin. It was because of my beauty that an infinite number of suitors have pursued me, all of them confusing simple politeness with hints of affection." {n}Valerie clenches her fists.{/n} "But do you know what I really want?!"
e986ec0a-6b21-44be-95f1-6ce9ae66c602: "I want people to stop treating me like a piece of art! I want them to notice that I'm a person, that I'm capable of something more than smiling for paintings, where I sit wearing a lacy satin dress, holding a basket of peaches in my lap! Is that too much to ask?!" {n}The last question comes out in a shout, though Valerie doesn't seem to realize it.{/n}
f8988cc5-ebc1-496e-bdfb-05760d299ef7: "I am... truly happy that you understand me. Thank you!" {n}Valerie smiles at you gratefully, and the smile is full of a warmth that you never expected from someone as stern as Valerie. You suddenly realize that you're smiling back at her.{/n}
f15d1f41-2c48-4cb2-8eb7-8fa4d2e0a24b: "You're talking just like my mentor at the Order used to!" {n}But then Valerie regains her self control and hides her contempt behind her polite mask.{/n}
3a813b1c-b3f6-422d-a466-e3d11e3eb5dd: {n}Valerie breathes heavily for a moment, gasping awkwardly. As the meaning of your words finally become clear to her, she regains control over herself.{/n} "I humbly beg your pardon," {n}she says calmly.{/n} "That will never happen again."
9d8264ac-3288-424f-93da-0fa633dcac81: {n}Valerie gives you a stony look.{/n} "I sincerely hope your words carry nothing more than mere politeness."
64c7c0fe-b6d3-437a-9f9d-a7c29cf9cf4a: "That is good." {n}Valerie nods.{/n} "In that case I thank you for the compliment, and would ask that you never bring up the subject again."
b54e9435-2a6e-4b50-b5a5-930e7ebf3cc6: {n}Valerie folds her arms across her chest.{/n} "With all due respect, I ask that you never bring this up again. If, of course, you value my company and our friendship."
215e38c2-a82a-4203-8002-3c89ba8b30f8: "So you like me, but won't seek my favor? Well, that's something new." {n}Valerie raises her eyebrow and smiles, but this smile expresses amusement, not her usual cold arrogance.{/n}
b5b2dd44-4737-4338-a878-7bbf9a17bdeb: {n}Valerie folds her arms across her chest.{/n} "In that case, I must confess: even if I were to enter a courtship, I'd prefer a relationship with a man. I beg your pardon if I've disappointed you."
71db8fd5-122e-45cc-92fd-6c7b6448d9fc: "{g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} is a goddess of love, beauty, and art. Her paladins are something like armored artists — that's how they like to think of themselves at least. "
3b6d537c-7f2b-4f80-825a-c0f26a082f22: {n}Valerie tries to contain her feelings, but her inner contempt bursts forth.{/n} "They are fanatical defenders of worthless, inartistic paintings and meaningless opuses, if you care to know my opinion."
40802a51-2cf1-4209-98e0-14e31f82e9d5: "She's been trying to ruin my life." {n}Valerie snorts.{/n} "{g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} — the goddess of everything useless that ever existed in this life. 83f21529-fc20-4950-b919-b9092eb03ff8: "And I beg you to restrain yourself from offering your own opinion. Trust me, I've heard everything you can tell me — more than once. 6492f527-adf0-4d19-b947-b6a7dbbb5271: "I couldn't agree more! If I can be frank, all this talk about {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} makes me want to spit. But my noble upbringing prevents me from performing such an undignified act."
3c8e4a2d-46f0-402c-b75e-4185a96b9a5e: "Ah, that. I used to... embroider. And I still do from time to time." {n}A treacherous blush covers Valerie's cheeks.{/n} "It's nothing, I assure you. Just a simple task to keep my hands busy and keep the gloomy thoughts at bay. Nothing special."
ebd7d490-031a-4035-8e50-f87f582fee68: "Is that what you think?" {n}Valerie curves an eyebrow, mocking amazement.{/n} "Many share that delusion. I was deluded too, for a while."
8b91edad-74c7-4369-976c-b7a34b1af603: "Now I consider all works of art useless. People create this garbage because they have nothing better to do. abcce4be-227f-48ad-be63-d777fa38c32c: "They wander around, seeking the next pile of garbage. And when they find it, they call it an immortal piece of art, and admire it until they're blue in the face."
5959dd58-7e70-480a-aba8-7a28473e4438: "You might not believe this, but the paladins of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g} aren't allowed to slay their enemies if they beg for mercy. Can you guess why? So a paladin overpowers her enemy in battle, then inspires him to create a masterpiece." {n}Valerie's face reflects extreme disgust.{/n} "It might sound hilarious if it weren't true."
249bec90-599d-4874-9ce9-6bc20b9e83b4: "Plus, all of {g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} followers are obliged to practice some sort of art in his or her free time.
