6e6ac7f0-b609-4a5d-8e69-0792dd2db4a1: "I am... truly happy that you understand me. Thank you!" {n}Valerie smiles at you gratefully, and the smile is full of a warmth that you never expected from someone as stern as Valerie. You suddenly realize that you're smiling back at her.{/n}
73c0d4e0-6fd2-4ebd-a464-99a53a967312: {n}Valerie is silent for a couple of moments.{/n} "Is this decision final?"
6e442aac-50e5-465f-86e0-818d4defbd06: "In that case I would ask you to avoid such ridiculous jokes in the future. I invest a lot in our friendship and my service to your cause, and I am troubled by the fact that you neglect my goodwill."
28cef034-5c77-48b1-bad1-bc875417c11a: {n}Valerie sighs but keeps her face calm.{/n} "I can't help but notice that this is quite unexpected. It's a shame, really. I hope you won't regret this in the future. Now forgive me, I must ready my leave."
37c789e0-61fc-419b-a7ec-25636b2a977a: {n}Valerie looks at you unblinking, and you see her eyes darken with an anger she can barely contain.{/n} "Really? May I take a look at this letter?"

1e083582-6da4-4d74-8e70-327634de5c01: "Looks like he never came to terms with me leaving, since he found me even here. But the nerve! 'The mistake of leaving our ranks'! 4cc61e8e-5803-413a-8980-3ef70fdc7b3b: "Enough. We must put an end to this. If paladins of the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g} require another refusal, they shall get it! 2e4163ca-dfd7-4145-8542-97e8734fc916: {n}Valerie shakes her head.{/n} "We can't. Fredero Sinnet may be in the wrong, but that's no reason to show myself – and you – as uncultured barbarians. 0e9b1ebf-0661-40fe-86dd-f248efea64e4: "No! If you respect my honor and value my loyalty, please refrain from such hasty actions. I will go to the trading post with you. I will meet Sinnet, give him my final refusal, and the matter will be settled. Enough about that."
e4f400af-af6e-400d-ba90-a7d86da8afa3: {n}Valerie waves off your words – with more haste than prudence.{/n} "Please don't worry about such trifles. I will visit a priest or an alchemist when time permits. As for how I feel..."
4d8245ce-9803-4f4e-8ace-b0f7892f2a26: {n}Valerie smiles sourly.{/n} "It's my pride that suffered most. It seems I must devote more time to training. I will keep this in mind in the future, and not let you down again."
2ce41f1e-b575-472e-94b6-0f92decad459: {n}Valerie raises her chin up.{/n} "I admit, I expected no other outcome from this duel. As I've always said, {g|Shelyn}Shelyn's{/g} paladins are pompous dolts, capable of little else beyond admiring useless garbage and pining after poetry."
e77551ed-0b17-43b0-ae39-73af06c427fe: {n}Valerie is silent for a few moments. a7b3ea0e-7e2c-4338-9ada-9dc97f9bb676: "I should thank you, {name}. It's important to me that you were at my side. Now I'm sure that I'm finally free from the Order of the {g|Shelyn}Eternal Rose{/g}, and ready to devote all my time and efforts to our mission."
fed60cd5-f606-41b4-a728-30fad909e0ee: {n}Valerie knits her eyebrows for a moment, but the girl quickly restores her usual calm expression.{/n} "Your order is law. Fredero will just have to accept silence for an answer."
6828a124-2db3-4fdc-baf4-e8a00476f6f5: {n}Valerie rolls her eyes.{/n} "If it's about that bard again, I've apologized to him already! As you demanded!"
e4a5989f-c129-49ef-a00f-8ba36a39b562: "The Storyteller... What business of his if I have anything left from the Order? 70881bf2-4415-4a31-8736-19efc861dbcf: "Who else could it have been about?! That scribbler used to never leave me alone – dogged my heels asking questions whenever I appeared on the street, and now..." {n}Valerie stops angrily and looks away.{/n}

141ef8c9-0d98-4c21-89b4-591ac8d57e07: "Now the chieftain is dead! Who will be chief now? Will he even listen to me? Or will he be like you, letting his fists decide everything. Will this be the end of our tribe?"
aab48e85-66b9-488f-a939-25ad96d9588c: "I have no doubt about that! And she didn't think about anything else, except her reasons!"
efcda375-0457-47f3-9d0a-7fdf5d20a0d4: "Congratulations, Amiri, now you're just like a real man from the Six Bears! You only think about yourself. You use your fists whether you need to or not. And then you leave it to the women to sort out your mess!"
2f80627f-0aaa-4b40-b9df-15f66c434e14: "Everyone is strategists and tacticians! So smart it makes me sick! Only Amiri is the stupid one, right?"
dbf000b4-f15c-4024-b501-3ddff473e3d7: "So, that's how you talk now, huh? You want me to tell you why I smashed this old mushroom's face? And why I fled? I'll tell you! Listen now, you wanted it! The war party I went with... You think we went to fight the giants? I thought that too! I was so happy. I was fool! We did not go there to kill giants, Nilak. We went there to kill — me!"
d12c6455-eaff-4dbf-8a01-e2d86abc4004: "They thought giants would eat me up, and they won't have to get their hands dirty. But I came back! Alive — and with this sword. I thought no one would dare to say that Amiri wasn't a real fighter. But they just laughed into my face and said that if the giants didn't kill me, the frost would. Then they left me alone in the wilderness, without food or tent. And when I understood why... When I saw what this hunt was for... It was then, for the first in my life, I felt real rage. Yes, Nilak, don't you turn away now! Look in my eyes! I killed them all! With this sword! I'm not a thief, Nilak. I'm much worse. I'm a kinslayer. And you know what? — I don't care! They deserved it! Our whole damned tribe can go to the dragon's maw!"
55604610-8d50-453f-964a-e17217c95f04: "Do I deserve to die? Should I go to dragon's maw, too?"
f68b5005-3f20-405d-9deb-612cdc07bf3d: "No, you… This wasn't what I meant… You're not like them!"
6af34b19-9fdf-4b79-83b3-fad03ef96f64: "I am a part of this tribe, Amiri. If you don't want to help me save it… You'd better leave. I'll manage without you. I'll ask the {g|Tiger Lords}Tiger Lords{/g} for help."
27678688-8b98-4bf7-8fec-5fdf475eee57: {n}Amiri spits on the ground, then grabs your hand in her iron grip and drags you away without saying another word.{/n}
85efd666-384a-4086-a506-97469b10614d: {n}Regongar chuckles.{/n} "Good for you — serves them right! When I get to my tribe — I'll mix their hash even better!"
09180db1-974f-4a77-be63-818a8a8628d6: "All the news in the whole region must pass through this inn. What rumors have you heard?"
ad1fca8b-7994-4ff6-b446-7dd38bb500ca: "Where are you from? What land, which family?"
c2bc6e37-bd95-490a-994d-2880cc2ca294: "Why did you decide to become an innkeeper?"
585ea945-2743-438c-9fec-83e9bdbc19e6: "Where does the inn's name come from?"
be60c7ec-6d50-4593-ac12-0f31252dca7d: "Please tell me what other news you've heard. Your stories are so interesting — and useful."
5c11257d-f8b1-47b6-a315-562947baa55b: "I am curious what the people are talking about."
1ac98d70-88d6-481e-bcdb-6fdbd1a9232e: "Elina, do you have anything to tell me?"
661ff737-e6a4-4e21-9871-557f04dc380e: "Thank you, Elina. We will discuss it another time."
0b4277d5-475c-43c6-8f35-b6cd2eb7456d: "What did you want to ask me, Elina?"
a36d41c9-0852-4caf-87e9-46bb539c602e: "A fine idea! I will try to get you such an egg."
54d5bf53-014e-41d1-a5eb-3a2f305c188e: "Please remind me what you'd asked me for..."
07777903-ad69-456c-a420-8e64d6305bd4: "I have more serious things to do than gather groceries for your kitchen."
4cac95cb-4295-452d-8794-621025a13021: "Elina, I have a giant bird's egg. I thought you might be interested."
f35b60bc-1455-4763-9cf0-0f002a24ea1b: "I heard there's been a number of thefts in town. Do you know anything about it?"
62751d99-b2e4-4afc-bb44-99a54547b78c: "During the celebration in the forest, you kept staring at Ekun, giving him a certain look..."
680ff81c-d12b-4d92-802f-a47661c7d7e6: "Elina, I need to find a rare book. Do you know where in the city I should look?"
babbe9f9-79f2-462f-8d19-fb9232c73415: {n}Behind the inn's bar stands a young woman with curly red hair, a round face and rosy cheeks. She gives you a friendly smile, fixing her cap.{/n} "It's so nice of you to stop by, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! I'm Elina, the innkeeper."
776cdfc2-425c-42d3-8302-c6f4d476a468: {n}Elina makes a curtsy, like a lady in waiting.{/n} "Welcome, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}!"
afeedb60-8539-410b-919a-60c2ea060d6b: "I'd be happy to, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! I love to talk, especially about myself!"
6b7132ae-6b7f-4f90-bd27-c81517ed3f8c: "An old man came through, an odd-looking fellow. Talked about some goddess that was going to come and sweep away the city, as I sweep bread crumbs from the table. He spoke of other, beautiful things, something about magic, forests, forces of nature, but he made it sound scary! We should make a toast and pray to {g|Cayden Cailean}Cayden{/g} — may he protect us from this evil Goddess."
d7a76fd9-21d4-4afd-b446-d7b824ee9bd2: "Lately everyone's been talking about the tower at the {g|Candlemere}Candlemere{/g}. They say lights were dancing around it like a busy cook's stove. Everyone who saw it says different things. Some witnessed a dragon, and some, glowing hamsters crawling from the lake! They're probably all lying, but the place is definitely spooky. And mysterious."
a231057d-0d23-4a13-9512-0f24273099ad: "The whole town is talking about that Stefano — a lord from {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}! It seems there isn't a single man who this arrogant fool hasn't annoyed. He came here too! Mitty, the kitchen boy, admitted to me that he spat in his soup. I usually come down like a load of bricks for such things, but this time I couldn't even give him a scolding."
aedec6f9-5e54-43ad-b1d8-cf906c65b4f8: "Nothing new, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. People talk of the harvest, the weather, and their pretty, well-knit children."
f722e9a9-c15d-44d0-9e0f-f33f92b28f94: "I wouldn't want to court disaster, baron{mf||ess}, but the people are talking about you... Someone said you're cursed, like it's your fate to call down all the troubles that were supposed to hit the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} over the next hundred years. You know how it can be — some people just attract bad things all at once, right? Like the fellow who stumbles over a barrel of fish, steps in a fire, knocks over a wasp nest, and runs blind into a bull field. That's how people are talking about you! Only you're a baron{mf||ess}, so the trouble you get into is more serious..."
53eeea58-fc24-4fc5-bbbb-aeade8cb95c6: "The best fish gets brought in from {g|Lake Silverstep}Silverstep Lake{/g}. But there's been trouble out there. They saw a strange boat on the lake, and the bandits are fooling around again."
26d1e9d5-1fa5-4c7d-b963-6b6bdbd0ab27: "Nothing new, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. Almost every day we're crying over another victim of the monsters. It seems there's no end in sight!"
e25fbed2-374d-4a91-85c1-a8611669e72f: "I heard from a neighbor, who heard from her child's godmother, who heard from... oh dear, listen to me rattling on. Anyhow, there are rumors of a {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} priestess in our lands. Those priestesses are dreadful frightening, but women sometimes go to them, if they cannot conceive or carry a child. Don't get me wrong, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, no one from our town would do that, but they're happy to talk about it. They'll be talking for days about what kind of children a Lamashtu ritual can bring — with three rat tails, or three cat eyes!"
b90032dc-1a0f-436b-998e-51bc1465c0c6: "Oh, stop, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! You know the news around here: nothing strange is happening, we're rebuilding the city, getting back on our feet. Oh, and we've changed the name of the inn, did you see?"
72bcdebb-b76a-4867-9522-0939ae4d806c: "Everything seems calm, it's just that... There was a hunter from {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}, used to come in every week — don't know, if he fancies me or our groom... But now he stopped showing up. Matter of fact, there's been no news at all from Varnhold lately. Most peculiar."
61eeec02-774a-44d7-9dab-1fe102776b63: "Travelers coming in from {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}, have run across groups of barbarians a few times. They're quite some ways from their own lands!"
918f5a1e-f183-44ab-ac23-994962a5011d: "Absolutely nothing new. I'll tell you this month's topic of debate... What color is the best one for fences."
f0cb861f-3b9e-4eef-866c-2c82b2fd3b6f: "Again that tower on the {g|Candlemere}Candlemere{/g}, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! A fishermen saw monsters on the island. {g|Cayden Cailean}Cayden{/g} forbid they're meddling with us again. You know, there are bad people, and there are bad places — and nastiness just keeps sticking right to them!"
a6eea2a4-c9ae-4edf-911c-037c1fff3db2: "Refugees are coming in from around {g|Restov}Restov{/g}! Poor things... They say there's a whole horde of barbarians attacking them! The people of the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} used to be the unfortunates. And now they are running to us — for your protection, baron{mf||ess}!"
f94f54a4-5c63-4b60-8801-a86ff2fb8426: "They say Annamede Belavarah is here on a tour of the barony. She's a famous bard, who they call no less than {g|Pitax}Pitax'{/g} Pride! I'm dying to hear her — though truth be told, King Irovetti's subjects are more like foxes than people."
6fe8c695-82a5-4cbe-a766-0414edff5de7: "No other news, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. The people are recounting your past victories for the hundredth time, out of sheer boredom."
c06ef3bb-ca48-4a2b-beac-cb4fb395a49d: "Our local flower man has been happy as a prince, since Lady Valerie appeared in our city. His business wasn't going so good, but now not a day passes without some unlucky admirer buying a basket of roses or a bouquet of lilies."
db861a78-fb63-46d3-8cb6-b8328bdfc828: "It's enough to make a cat laugh, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. A little bird told me that a few young lasses pretended to be sick, just to visit the clinic of Jhod and Tristian. And it's all on account of your {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} priest being so handsome!"
f19cb973-1e87-4cae-914d-331f44a21d02: "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, I'm telling you, soon they'll be banning Sir Jubilost from all the neighborhood taverns. The inns and pubs too! Whenever he comes in, he starts shouting that we aren't cooking right, and he knows the right way, and he even has a book about it. Oh, something tells me Sir Jubilost can't tell one end of a ladle from the other — yet there he is, writing cookbooks!"
6474641a-eaf3-4e3c-be97-504e3852273e: "There's a new saying in the barony. 'Wherever Sir Harrim walks, rye won't sprout and milk will sour.'"
0040f672-e994-4541-8625-40a40739ffbd: "After seeing your warriors, the local folks came up with a new saying. They used to say 'wide as a road' or 'wide as a river', but now they say 'wide as Amiri's sword'!"
7ed215fe-ee95-4bee-a9ea-ae67e6d66954: "One villager named her newborn daughter 'Octavia' after your companion. She says lady Octavia is kind, and she wants her daughter to grow up like that too! That'd be fine, but her neighbor called her cat 'Octavia' too. She says that when she saw the way that beast's eye were blazing, it reminded her of the lady magess!"
d0f545ab-34e0-42ff-8441-69d6baec7fc8: "A local hunter came up to me, pointed at the wolf that walks beside that silent friend of yours, and asked me whether I wanted a coat made from its hide. I told him I'd tear out his beard and make nests for my hens, if he so much as touches that wolfy! I can't believe someone could harm such a smart and friendly animal! Stupid and shameless."
7d0fa95e-c3c5-4169-88e7-03a225765c20: "I hail from the {g|River Kingdoms}River Kingdoms{/g} — Artume, to be precise. I'm from a farming family, like just about everybody from around there. There's more fertile land and pasture there than anywhere in the River Kingdoms, except for maybe Sevenarches. The folks who grow crops and tend cattle are well respected there. But at the same time they live in constant danger — there's too many bad people, too lazy to work all day, but don't mind taking other people's things."
5253f68a-328f-4dab-828f-73c2c1e34a23: "I was bored! Please don't get me wrong, I was fine at father's farm, and I've got nothing but respect for farmers' work. But in our back country you could go half a year without seeing one new face. No news, nothing happening... I've dreamed of working at an inn since I was a child. That's the kind of place where there's always lots of guests and stories!"
05952f9b-9472-450e-8c0e-9fa7f1368094: "Oh, don't ask, it's too funny! I kept thinking about what name to pick... choosing just the right one... but not one to waste time, I drew a beer mug on the door — I figured folks would just see it and come on in. So the locals got used to calling the place 'The Beer Mug Inn' — so the name stuck."
057c72b8-c7ee-481d-b7f8-0cf528f3600e: "A month wouldn't be long enough to tell it all, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! Each kingdom is a special place all its own. Elves live in one of them. Another one, half of the country belongs to the Murderers' Guild, and the other half gives them their orders — they say they even get locals' discounts! There's just one thing that unites us all, like a strong thread keeps a quilt together. It's the Six River Freedoms."
2068c9ee-55b3-4466-a0fd-23eb398f6a1a: "Yes. The First Freedom — 'Say What you Will, I Live Free.' It doesn't mean you won't get beaten up for what you say, though! The Second Freedom — well, if you can call it a freedom! — 'Oathbreakers Die.' Those who break oaths get killed just like that. So people prefer not making any oaths at all."
d2365303-822c-46a3-a66f-712786f39dc7: "The Third Freedom — 'Walk Any Road, Float Any River.' Once the ruler of Heibarr decided to build a gate across the river and collect a fee from each passing boat. Well, there's no more Heibarr. The Fourth Freedom is even worse than the second one — 'Courts Are for Kings'. Whatever a king says, goes — well, as long as he doesn't say to build a gate across a river..."
5a4ac252-f2dd-4a9a-8e5c-8028d77590ac: "Now for the Fifth. 'Slavery Is an Abomination'. Nothing to explain there. Runaway slaves from all over come to us for a reason. And the Sixth: 'You Have What You Hold'. It means that theft is a much worse crime than robbery, if you catch my drift. You can honestly beat a robber and keep what's yours, but a thief acts on the quiet. Shame on him — that's just disrespectful!"
56362faa-7393-47cd-a348-28406ef3b815: "Almost no news. We're explaining to travelers and guests from the farthest settlements that we're not a barony any more, but a kingdom! Every chance I get, I let it drop that {mf|His|Her} Highness visits my inn from time to time."
8cfb92b1-5dc4-45c2-a8e3-3f08ad0e8535: "Oh, I was right when I said that {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} is full of shameless foxes dressed like people! Lately there's so many folks from Pitax — more than mosquitoes in the spring. And they're sticking their noses in everywhere."
936cc322-aa95-4085-9c65-9af7cda06d4f: "It's probably you who can tell us the news. Our regulars keep talking about the Rushlight Tournament! I really wanted to go, but I don't have anyone to look after the inn. Your Highness, maybe we could have something like it in our own capital?"
4fabb081-b668-4113-ac37-ed605db8e65f: "Nothing but trouble and sorrow. Those {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} snakes keep talking, and folks either listen to them or get scared and start grumbling. They even started claiming Pitax beer tastes better, and they cook better eggs and crispy bacon. Well, I'd serve our eggs and bacon to the gods themselves!"
bb899832-8fcd-44be-87ba-f27229a12a8d: "Come back soon, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! No one can treat you better than me."
2a63c7c2-a30e-48dd-a177-0478444926c3: "What's there to talk about, Your Highness? Trouble, trouble everywhere. Monsters, natural disasters, monsters again... Seems like the end times have come. But if someone can save us, it's you. Here's some advice — take a closer look at your companions. In times like these, between the epochs, people always have to make choices. Sometimes it's tough, and sometimes it works out just right."
fb214fac-1dc3-4ad2-b815-22d84b555a19: {n}Elina seems to be brooding. She tugs at the seam of her apron and looks at you with uncertainty.{/n} "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! I wouldn't want to bother you, but if you have a spare moment, I'd like to ask you something..."
03ff8f59-f6dd-4e4e-8a3e-d01185c235a8: "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, the city is getting rebuilt after the Bloom. But the people survived such terror! I know almost all of them, and I see in their eyes what that nightmare did to them. And I thought..." {n}Elina sighs.{/n} "I thought we should cheer them up somehow! I can make a special treat for everyone. But I can't do it alone."
fea87aec-249b-49e4-acd5-23b710a75eff: "I know there's a Roc that lives on {g|Talon Peak}Talon Peak{/g}. But it is a dangerous place. I offered a reward, but none of the hunters I know will risk going there. But I know you could handle it, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}..." {n}Elina raises her eyes timidly.{/n} "I know it's no task for a {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}, but there's no one else to ask..."
f4eef6c5-6ff8-46d7-b09e-08b8db130b74: "To get an egg from the roc, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. The roc lives on {g|Talon Peak}Talon Peak{/g}, and that bird is scary — big and angry!"
643de159-a498-4271-a668-0b39d92e9fe0: {n}Elina is glowing.{/n} "Thank you so much! I am sure you can handle it easily!"
38bc29ae-bc58-4e46-8086-ae400438a6df: {n}Elina throws up her hands.{/n} "This is a roc's egg! Our family has an ancient recipe for how to cook it! It's amazing that you brought it, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. Let me give you something in return. No, don't you argue! Merchants will pay a lot for these eggs, and you must have taken a risk in getting it!"
d04d9a3f-f9b2-4d0d-8fce-79c9e3088a14: {n}Elina throws up her hands.{/n} "You've no idea how thankful I am, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! All my life I've dreamed of cooking one of these eggs, and the timing couldn't be better!"
a316912d-5302-4629-9217-0daad45881a9: "People say different things, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. One says he turned away for a moment, and someone stole the ham from his table! Another one is missing his sausages. A third one says someone locked all his hens in the attic, and ate all their eggs — raw! So far I haven't noticed anything missing around here. Knock on wood. Knock-knock..."
a281c110-5440-410e-8779-bbc6e76474c7: "Every local resident is very, very concerned about one thing. Will lady Linzi mention them in her book?! I'd settle for just one line... although a page would be better!"
b01aecca-8d89-4cf1-a61b-75a286ae540e: "The thing is, I have a very special family recipe, which I'm sure the locals would love. It's... now don't laugh! ... it's an omelette. Made from a Roc's egg. This bird is not really a bird, but a huge monster that lays eggs very rarely. They're considered a royal treat, only a few people in all the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} have ever tried one. If we treat the people to this delicacy, the whole neighborhood will be buzzing about it for months! And what could be better medicine for their fear and sorrow, than something fresh to boast about?"
ee1b223b-d7c4-4d7d-9e9b-7be4515e1b10: "Of course I heard about it, Your Highness! Many houses have been robbed. And here's what's strange — no picked locks, no broken windows. How do the scoundrels get inside, hunh?"
b312e179-44a6-4cab-989a-4d505fc47b65: "Those thieves are real masters of getting into other people's houses — and they steal whatever they find. At one house they stole the silverware, and at another one they left the money, but took the children's toys. Strange thieves!"
828d85db-3d6c-4d32-98ae-b16d60139bcd: {n}After a brief moment of confusion, Elina answers easily,{/n} "Of course I did. Ekun's a handsome man! And he's hardworking, he's got no bad habits, he's got friends in high places... and his gaze is so mysterious! And he's so quiet... If you could only imagine, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|HIghness|Highness}!"
24a80089-7631-44b6-bccb-694ab1151b17: "You've probably asked the vendors, haven't you? If not, then do that, and if you have... um... Oh – I know who you should ask! Talk to Verdel, the blacksmith. He's quite a reader. Can't live a day without a book."
8033f168-6a84-45bb-a154-de510019d8ca: "I realize you don't like me, Regongar. But don't forget, we share in the common cause!"
75f6bfcd-7d51-4b1e-9979-eb4dc2e53858: "Someone is sharing in it, while someone else is cowering in the bushes. What, goody-goody, are you afraid of getting blood on your little hands?"
98d6b213-e75b-4b64-bce2-250c82eee5ab: "{name}, {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen} and rightful ruler of this realm. And you are?"
1c4aeb4b-89eb-48c1-9837-603b87738a41: "I dealt with the Stag Lord myself. You're just an impostor, and a miserable one at that."
0d5fcb74-e708-4ce3-9ea0-089ccf3f24d4: "You tried to take some of my lands for your own. What do you have to say in your defense?"
d483a566-be7b-487b-9cd2-29b421c181f1: "How would you like to keep collecting money, only as servants rather than bandits? You would have to share your revenue, though — seven parts to the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}, three to your gang."
a4006a21-7697-48d0-9092-8c0c38055d72: [Attack] "Here's a thought. Since I already killed one Stag Lord, what's to keep me from killing another?"
4dac7d0c-6485-4b7f-b7c5-c60863a085db: "All right, Stag Boy, you're going to take that ridiculous thing off your head, leave this tent, and do everything you can to ensure I never hear from you or your gang again. Everything you've collected so far will be returned to the people."
bfc24b83-caba-47c2-acce-32ddf6bc1163: "You'll hang in the main square as a warning to any other outlaws who might dare to cross my path. The money you've collected will serve better in the treasury."
42d040e9-3609-4644-85e8-a754f146089b: "No one blocks travel in the Stolen Lands, not even to charge a toll — haven't you heard of the River Freedoms? Get your people and get out. The bridge will be open to all."
f164f3d2-7193-411c-b2a0-5da024a5a2ea: {n}The infamous Stag Lord looks to be a portly man somewhere in his forties. His armor is at least a size too small for his bulk, and the ill-fitting helmet on his head is adorned with antlers that vaguely resemble those seen on the head of the previous Stag Lord, now deceased.{/n}
6cdcf005-7975-4c8b-bdce-fdb3b8508f20: {n}The impostor shrinks from your gaze.{/n} "What do you want?"
bb974e71-9fc5-4e17-aeba-841c46c00faf: "Who dares stumble into my headquarters without so much as a knock or a bow?! Who the hell do you think you are?"
ca2b4c02-88d5-497f-972e-02f7143fd98c: "{mf|Baron|Baroness|King|Queen}, you say? Heh, you made a huge mistake coming here, then. For I am the Stag Lord, hero to the people and enemy of any bureaucrats who would dare call the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} their own!"
a278e3e2-8d39-405b-a594-9089761616f2: {n}It may be hard to see his face under his ridiculous helmet, but it's easy to see the bandit leader deflate upon hearing your words.{/n} "I... No! It is I who is the Stag Lord! You... killed an impostor!" {n}The gang leader's voice quavers as he speaks.{/n}
74066c2c-f7f1-4289-aebb-ca5b1d95c396: "Insolent fool! All of the surrounding lands are the property of the Stag Lord and his daredevils!"

b13cf9df-e394-4eb1-99d4-38b945d9433a: {n}Valerie pauses.{/n} "Of course you know that {g|Razmiran}Razmiran{/g} is an unusual kingdom. Many are suspicious of its self-proclaimed god ruler, and its aggressive ambitions... But I won't give you any advice on this matter. Please make your own decision."

2076218d-fe84-45f2-bbb1-68ecb862c4db: {n}Bartholomew closes his eyes wearily.{/n} "As you wish..."

07c08244-8907-4580-87b9-605f542c5835: "He's a quirky fellow. He took over a kingdom, and persuaded all the locals that he's a living god! He installed his henchmen in all the key positions, and now rules as he pleases, oppressing the population!"

e90f2c50-beb3-481f-ab36-d3f4e9c5de87: {n}Moskoni smiles contentedly.{/n} "This is slander, Your Highness. My King is famous for his wisdom and fairness. – How could he have woven such a plot?! It is beyond belief!"

3aced0f2-4e9d-4b9b-8f6f-f4ffe3ba5278: "Sometimes I admire you when I watch you fight. It's like you embody the uncontrolled power of chaos, leading the world to its imminent end. Some die from the fire or storm, while others from Regongar's hand..."
130ef4b1-a6bc-4128-b48f-07d8d4ed404c: "Ha ha, you got it! Yeah, man, I am what I am!'
aa9787b5-211f-4b44-b502-fcb11e246ce3: "What do you think, Harrim – if we're all meant to die, how will it happen?"
efec75d7-1f5b-417b-8537-42f44c9a1467: "I don't know, I'm not a prophet. I simply follow the will of Groetus. Whatever end is prepared for me, I only hope to face it with dignity."

528e4d90-ee7a-4af8-a7ed-619f065930a3: "Vordakai summoned me. I am here at his request."

e4cf05d0-ac1b-4ec7-a47b-73581f80dc45: "Oh, you must be careful, Linzi! I understand why you'd want to get a better look, but you really must stay back..."

c290354b-2df7-4034-8b9c-59cbd5c81921: "Whoa, that's one thing I wasn't ready for. But listen up, you old piece of shit! Do you take us for brainless idiots, here? You think we got through all your training and didn't learn the most important lessons?" {n}He looks at Octavia.{/n}
e6692c28-392b-44b9-be34-4c7c7658502f: "Lesson one: never trust Maestro Janush in anything. Lesson two: hate Maestro Janush with all your heart... Enough talk, old teacher. We're here to pass our final exam!"

c690192a-1c82-413f-9df2-9a9788db8031: {n}Valerie's eyes turn icy. She puts her hand on her weapon, looking at Octavia and Regongar silently, waiting for their answer.{/n}
164a05fe-a8d6-46a2-b9a7-12652472859c: "That female back at the barbarian camp... strange. Smells funny. Walks funny. As if broken."
b4ebe6c6-b740-4b79-91e0-e49ffc1111f2: "I... well, it's a strange to say, but I agree. When I stood next to her I got goosebumps all over!"
a08b3df7-e644-4be5-a2ae-e12e405f4d87: "I didn't like that witch either. I don't care what she smells like, but I don't trust those who hide their faces."
e411e7c4-947a-4857-8b30-3a36770ad28f: "Broken. Hmmm... that's an interesting notion from a degenerate pet like you. I wonder how close to the truth that is..."
dfd0e229-102b-47ce-aa07-a0b2c4226ced: "As expected, the Kellids know nothing about strategy and maneuvers. However, one can't deny they possess a certain... resourcefulness and tactical ingenuity."
555bd0d7-31a0-4788-bde5-5bb7c0dbbea3: "Don't be fooled. They are counting on their opponent taking them for idiots. Underestimating them is a mistake you only do once."
96a44034-7d37-4cea-88d6-f5e32cb1b382: "It's all about resolution and improvisation. You've got something to learn from them here, ha ha."
474a9d4d-43a0-44ab-b8a8-531b855849e1: "Easy, easy. We can always fight later. Let's talk first."
64184de5-ed48-4f8a-9cc9-056e62e33cd2: [Attack] "There's too many of you here. And I only need one…"
fe47b5fa-9b2e-431e-aea3-dddfdee55bd7: "An alchemist I know is working on a new potion, and the decoction has to be tested. Does any of you wish to risk your life in the name of science?"
817c4083-408d-49ca-b9fd-18de5dd2e2aa: "The ruler of these lands wishes to show that all who inhabit them are like children to {mf|him|her}! In {mf|his|her} grace, {mf|he|she} gifts you with this rare, noble drink!"
3e752286-7fa8-47aa-980d-9d8f38a09d40: "As a matter of fact, nothing. I guess I should get going."
e471a8a9-5fd8-4913-be2f-c4a4713c0447: "What do you know. I was just looking for a couple of lab rats. Do I have a volunteer?"
10b105b4-ad9f-45d1-91af-567d76c172d0: [Pour the potion into the wererat's mouth] "Here, take a sip of this first…"
927ddc97-e884-41f6-84fd-f08fc970699c: {n}Hunched, gray figures turn to face you as you approach. Yellow fangs show from grinning muzzles, and clawed paws reach for weapons.{/n}
2252fdaa-b2c5-4e76-9c2c-72efdc571d3d: {n}The wererats freeze in intense anticipation, ready to pounce on you at any moment. Finally, you hear a hoarse, cracked voice.{/n}
b832f219-1aab-414d-9dc6-ee356d5d669b: {n}The raspy laughter of half a dozen throats resounds over the small clearing.{/n}
a3c27314-78ff-4b8d-bd00-724a03026c5b: "Move one finger – an' we'll cut your bald hide to scraps. Whatcha need?"
09eebfe4-1e74-4e3f-9b37-a4ffc3da7e6d: "What, you lookin' to test this stuff on us? Of course – why try it out on people when you've got monsters! Not like anyone's going to miss 'em, right?" {n}Tiny rat eyes glisten with an evil glow.{/n} "Arrogant bastards… Tear 'em apart, boys!"
7cf3b4c7-44ae-49c2-8d6f-f6ed37bbcf1e: {n}The pack leader's snout twists with hatred.{/n} "Die, baldskin!"
29b1afa5-29e5-428c-be4a-727b0b653182: {n}The wererats exchange glances, clearly surprised. One of them approaches you and takes the potion. However, as soon as his clawed fist clenches the bottle's neck, he rips out the cork and greedily raises it to his mouth! f53f3f00-2bbc-4aeb-aaac-1d0869a8812f: {n}The pack leader bares his teeth in a sinister grim.{/n} "Not so fast, you pup…"
f1fa4dbb-bc0f-4978-9f62-a567b5a22088: "That idiot. How predictable." {n}The leader shifts his animal eyes towards you.{/n} "They've killed one of ours. Get 'em, boys."

f82e9daa-0f1a-4435-a01d-6e60b1acee5a: "What else can you tell me about the Stag Lord?"
0e6bf794-21ec-4c2e-9c5a-e3f4745b86a3: "Tell me about the Stag Lord's gang, and any other bandits operating in the area."
0ba09a7b-ce62-462c-80a1-596ca1de7702: "The Stag Lord's gone. We found his fortress and sent the villain to oblivion."
1b511061-be33-48ed-8de9-a90ded3dd1d3: "Restov awaits — I plan to set off right away."
16bfb718-5b48-42d0-8017-76a40cb7e304: "I still have some unfinished business here."

9d95fc88-6e2e-4c02-9467-33f680f82f75: "Tuskgutter is dead! You could mount his head on the wall as a trophy!"
786b9150-d4c6-4c17-a345-d106883a908a: "How are things going in the trading post?"
3b35cb28-7704-4342-9b79-7491c52a75db: "Remind me: what is the problem with Tuskgutter?"

8d59c7bc-eb91-42db-b2c8-e4545ff5eca3: "A fine day to you! What brings you by?"
2cc4ddca-455e-4b98-8cff-042d9f449dd9: "That's quite a task you've set yourself on. b39178dc-312a-4f42-ad3a-cd25fd42d17f: "Not much. Not like I've sat down and shared a cup of wine with the man, you know? I wrote to {g|Restov}Restov{/g}, tried to warn them that the Stag Lord wasn't some typical gang leader, but they didn't listen. The rumors about him are horrible. He'll kill a person if they so much as disagree with him. He never reveals his face. Those who've seen him up close report the same thing — ugly scars cover every inch of his skin not covered by his clothes."
a85673ff-9e4b-49b4-a3ff-c93061173bec: "The other gangs, if they're still here, try their best to keep a low profile. As for the Stag Lord's men... He's fierce in a fight, but from what I hear, he isn't cruel by nature. The other two are Dovan and Auchs — they're usually seen together. Auchs is a mountain of a man with the mind of a five-year-old — albeit a mean and bloodthirsty one. He's quite the fan of torture and bloody executions. Dovan, though, that one's a snake in a man's body. I hope to never meet him in the flesh — the rumors about him are more than enough for me!"
190f456f-0944-4240-956b-fdc4be368f10: "The Stag Lord's past is a mystery. He just... arrived one day. He was immediately a power to be reckoned with. I guess the most surprising thing about him is that he has as many followers who admire him as he has minions who obey him out of fear. He's got some inner strength in him — or maybe an inner madness. There are many who seem to follow him BECAUSE of that madness, like it was some kind of virtue."
013744ac-248b-4b52-9eac-02bbeba67624: {n}Oleg looks at you with respect bordering on admiration.{/n} "And good riddance! 96d30fb4-76a3-45b4-94a6-fbcd6d45fb98: "I just... dislike the noise," {n}Oleg answers reluctantly.{/n} "I'm from {g|Restov}Restov{/g}. Cities are... complicated. c0026810-f911-43b7-a725-bfe481c2f44a: {n}Oleg looks at the bloodstained boar's head with respect, touching its tusk with his finger to test how sharp it is.{/n} "That's one heck of a beast! 35b38f82-82b1-4b76-bae4-eae2ba81d149: "Jhod mentioned that he needed to speak with you. You should see him before you leave."
041ffaa0-5137-406c-9097-7caf93045166: "Just be sure you see Kesten before you go — he was eager to discuss something with you."
8324e996-8a29-46f0-a438-9603000b5673: "In the meantime, I'll gather some supplies for your journey. Come back when you're ready."
58f7cbf2-7add-4a8c-ae95-5d837e6a3d5b: "The fog seems to be thinning, but we should wait until it burns off completely. In the meantime, I'll gather some supplies for your journey to make sure you can enjoy your trip back to {g|Restov}Restov{/g}!"

c20f2dbf-7715-41ec-b620-4bf862526a84: "It is a giant boar. A terrible beast — he has killed many hunters, and maimed many more. Old Benzen has lost his leg to Tuskgutter, so he has put up a bounty for the animal's head!"

5021d149-9e73-4fd9-92ca-6e25299b204f: "When you die, I will miss you, Linzi. Maybe I should make an undead of you?"
25c48b3a-905c-47d8-b00e-4e4c9be39185: "Jaethal, did Harrim bite you or something? I'm not going to die. And I don't feel the slightest desire to become undead."

35d0e50e-da7e-4954-95c2-9a3d83e20eaf: "It's good we can rest while our friends watch the camp."

b5cd3bb6-2cd1-484b-939d-9169a6548453: "You asked, I answered! When you pry into others' lives, don't be surprised if you find something that will keep you up at night, ha, ha!"

500bde71-c3e8-4694-bae2-7f6f9de1b3bf: "I don't know whether I could have survived by sheer stubbornness, if it weren't for Octavia. I probably couldn't have. I would have just given up and died. Second, there are sudden and inexplicable monster attacks being reported all throughout your lands! And third, there are people out sowing dissent with rumors and songs, even handing out pamphlets mocking your failure to fix things — and encouraging the citizens to pledge fealty to Irovetti instead!"
9a173f92-4261-4292-b7aa-a2b37c3aea0f: "Who else could it be?! Bandit attacks are increasing along our border with {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, and the bards spouting negative propaganda against you are singing the praises of Irovetti at the same time! Hell, he even invited you to the Rushlight tournament for the sole purpose of mocking you! Who else would backstab their opponents in such a low, conniving way? This is just like him! That nasty, slimy, fatheaded prick! If he were here right now..." {n}Linzi clutches the air, as though gripping the throat of an invisible enemy.{/n}
48ef4560-d1c6-489b-9d19-264ab1a6edbc: "Yes and no. The bards handing out pamphlets and singing slander about you have been seen in city streets, but none have been caught. Obviously someplace in {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} is training these people and printing up their pamphlets... and judging by the style and quality of the texts, someone from Pitax's {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy of Grand Arts{/g} was tasked with this mudslinging. I'd recognize their style of verse from a mile away. If I were you, that's where I'd start looking for agitators."
ae0ecdb0-1060-48fa-86f6-482a39ffd1e7: "Not yet. But I'm sure the agents he hired will have something we can use! It's a good idea, though — expose Irovetti, show the whole world the dirty game he's playing... It would definitely help us. When you deal with his spies, be sure to keep your eyes open!"
1793d462-0ba9-4c3f-977e-0e9c8d856e35: "What did you think, that you'd become {mf|king|queen} and just get to feast every day, enjoying the fawning of your lords and ladies in waiting, and holding tournaments? You sit on the throne — you could be so kind as to rule!"
d10f48cb-6a0d-4f8d-b552-b2f0b02ba414: "Nonsense?! Do you have any idea what's happening?!"
94e3102b-5f43-470e-b58b-847de8b2a8d7: "Our governors are panicking! They've had to use all the funds we budgeted them from the treasury on preventing riots and mass hysteria. Several provinces have already refused to attempt gathering taxes from the people, claiming that just trying would be tantamount to suicide!"
f8a469d3-ba8e-4de5-b653-9cb5f3cf9dab: "Thing is, they may be dressed like bandits, but they're behaving completely differently. Bandits wouldn't decimate the peasant population, burn their fields, and poison their wells — then there wouldn't be anyone to extort next time! Much more profitable to just shake them down every once in a while. That's why local thugs tend to be well known. But nobody recognizes these new ones! And all that's left behind after their raids are corpses and scorched fields. It's gotten to the point that 'our' bandits are fighting these 'outsiders.' Some of the villages are even gathering weapons and supplies to help 'our' bandits, because they at least let them live... but they're still losing."
e8fa2c7b-5856-4047-9f99-9d5a7c80afa0: "The reports are controversial — they talk about things you wouldn't even hear in fairy tales. Educated wyverns, trolls wearing armor, even undetectable goblin ghosts! But all the testimonies agree on one thing: they emerge in small groups literally from nowhere — in the middle of a field, in the center of a city square, on fortress parapets... One inn reported monsters rushing into the common hall from bedrooms and storerooms. And in a temple nearby, the monsters fell down on the heads of the praying congregation, breaking through the roof with a wild roar!"
0d3bc894-305a-4fdb-b5a3-b0f2f347514b: "At first, no one thought these isolated events could be part of some conspiracy... even now, it's likely few have figured it out. But these events have all developed too quickly, and in what seems like a concerted effort — as though someone were pulling the strings from behind a curtain. And there's more than enough evidence tying these strings to {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}!"
d005e599-cd67-478f-9b56-94c02b3f07ae: "We don't have much time. There may be no troops marching against us, but more of our regions are under attack each day. We may not have catapults firing on the walls of our capital, but there's no doubt we're under siege. There are no battlefronts and no battalions, but there are plenty of victims. We've been attacked — without reason, and without declaration of war. We have only one option..."
a6c9e915-03d5-460d-9888-37eaf84a6b64: "...to kick Irovetti's ass and show everyone in the {g|River Kingdoms}River Kingdoms{/g} just who's the master around here!"
841d251d-fa47-49aa-aee0-af8f5b41bdb5: "Just a few hours ago, a messenger showed up at the castle with a missive offering the services of a group of rangers who specialize in investigating mysterious cases similar to these. For a 'small fee,' they're ready to 'facilitate establishing the nature of these inexplicable events'... I suppose we should take them up on it. I have no idea how else we'd go about finding the source of these attacks!"
7c810898-47a8-4d41-984f-710f867eeca8: "Hurry, {name}. Your {d|c51 Rushlight Fail}performance{/d} at the Rushlight tournament... well, frankly, you'd have been better off not going at all. The people are laughing at you — you've completely lost their trust. The seeds of Irovetti's propaganda will be falling on fertile soil."
2f20e979-0faa-44b6-ac75-ee4a6fe4df6e: "Fortunately, the situation could be worse. Your decisive victory in the Rushlight tournament really bolstered the people's {d|c51 Rushlight Cool}faith{/d} in you and your abilities. It's funny how such nonsense can affect people's minds more than real feats and atrocities do. But this works out in our favor — thanks to that victory, we'll have a little more time to deal with whatever vile acts that madman from {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} throws at us..."
dabdf574-3e27-43e0-a2cb-67affe537c0d: "One more thing, {name}. Your performance in the Rushlight tournament was... {d|c51 Rushlight Neutral}not the best{/d}. But at least you participated — if not for that, I think it would've been even easier for Irovetti to confuse people and undermine your authority as he tries to push our kingdom into the Abyss. Don't let your guard down, though — we're looking at a matter of months, at best."
ac02b658-422a-4e4f-8ee4-62e93e5149c3: {n}Linzi's eyes flare.{/n} "Sometimes I don't know why I even bother coming to you at all!"
c4100fed-d63f-47f8-9804-212f4cba2314: {n}Linzi's laughter rings across the room.{/n} "Ha ha! You dummy! This is no time for jokes!"
8ac2ba98-ba70-422e-808b-a59edfc27142: "I don't want to be a downer, but... the fate of the kingdom really is in your hands here, {name}. I'm afraid to think what might happen if we don't get control of the situation in the next few months..."
2822b65b-0e7e-451c-a491-9dc7f01af221: "Hurry, {name}. Your refusal to participate in the Rushlight tournament really hurt your reputation with the populace. They think you were too scared to accept Irovetti's challenge."
4ed46375-2076-4d42-b922-f2897b15db34: {g|Military8_1}[Choice effects]{/g} [Pay 3 BP each week] "I trust Alkenstar's engineers. Have them supply us with their weapons."
8ff586fa-ef4e-4c97-890a-843b0616b558: {g|Military8_2}[Choice effects]{/g} [Pay 3 BP each week] "I am impressed with Arcanamirium's power. I'd like its graduates to train our mages."
371709b5-de80-4c5c-b894-f4762df1a0de: {g|Military8_3}[Choice effects]{/g} [Pay 3 BP each week] "May Kurgess bless our warriors with strength and agility."
37147943-ccae-456e-a5c2-7e6d6c1028d8: "You understand our army's needs better than I do. You can make your own decision."
1768cfa2-59af-4600-ba25-56c5b6551c2e: "Who should I make the deal with?"
9e8f7ebc-486b-42d7-9ba8-c5b3eecc41ec: "Tước hiệu của ngài rất khác thường."
280535f6-f557-45d2-9cce-93b94341d267: "Ngươi có gì để cống hiến cho quân của ta?"
4ecb0802-8c9d-4cbd-a1ca-10d643299fac: "Cái Arcanamirium này nổi tiếng vì điều gì vậy?"
7f8ce472-8734-4191-8c2a-aa86721c7374: "Kể ta nghe về quê hương của ngươi. Nó ở đâu? Ở lãnh địa của chúng ta hiếm khi nghe về nó."
af23ce33-f83f-4335-9354-29306d77eb1f: "Kể ta nghe về vũ khí giắt lưng của ngươi."
cc0db3ab-0128-4179-8e0e-88f43a006b5b: "What makes you think I'd prefer your odd toys over time-honored magic?"
6a410807-4623-4986-9511-338d8d281cd1: "What exactly do you have to offer?"
426f573c-71e6-419b-b060-7d343216ea3e: "Ngươi giúp gì được cho quân đội của ta?"
5b03271e-ead8-4515-9efa-6224d379df90: "Kể ta nghe về vị thần của ngươi."
a230555d-fa37-4035-b3a5-7d48227a2b7e: "You... look outlandish. Where have you come from?"
91f16048-695b-4f6c-8698-571159dfefed: {n}Regongar grins contentedly.{/n} "I have an idea I'd like to share with you. I'm sure it's occurred to you that we are now in control? We're the power everyone answers to – and not only in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. We demand respect. And those worthy of respect are worthy of doing business with. Profitable business."
cf93adef-39e7-4590-aa28-7c084dd05aa0: {n}Amiri smiles in satisfaction.{/n} "It looks like word of our heroic feats made it all across {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}. Merchants and shamans are always chasing great warriors, trying to sell them their best sword. So they can proudly announce it on every corner!"
a3ce2236-8273-4b2d-bfb7-89811ec06420: "Anyway, three representatives of... dealers in life and death have requested an audience with you. All three are willing to support our army. Talk to them and decide which of them we want to sign a contract with. However, we can't hire all three. Each of them wants to be your main weapons supplier. If I were you, I'd consider the Arcanamirium."
2e5e6ccb-695d-4b2f-bc80-811a69e4fca1: "Three great clans want to offer support for our troops. There was more before I got rid of the swindlers and the small fish. We should choose the best one and seal the deal. But only one. We have to refuse the others to command their respect. All three want to talk to you. Talk them all you want, but look closest at..." {n}Amiri gives you an 'inconspicuous' wink.{/n}"... the Kurgess guy, I say."
89435183-cae8-43c0-9cd4-f5931dedc62e: "You think their tricky devices will bring you victory? Well, you obviously know better than me..."
904dead5-3bc8-4652-a11b-3f198b5fb3da: "You can get a decent education in Arcanamirium. They don't just teach the books, but also how to use your legs and hold a weapon. The result is a well-rounded warrior."
7677f593-bc8b-4d7a-9c93-fc6be7485e43: "If even half of our soldiers were like Wodga, we'd break every enemy spine on the battlefield."
65f18971-d924-406d-9532-fd345d73838b: "Did that jock impress you? Ah, what am I saying?! I liked him too." {n}Regongar smirks.{/n}
d91ce54b-cf0a-4a1e-89bf-71a7cb110c9f: "Alkenstar's weapons are impressive, but relying too heavily on their power may weaken our troops in other ways. You know what I think about magic and mages. But if all our soldiers looked like that Kurgess priest, the war might not happen at all! The enemy would flee on sight!"
23e6d3c2-7902-441d-b531-63d46f244a2f: "With the mages, of course. Have you seen them fight? Now that's what I call a massacre! Fireballs hurtling, ice crunching! Swoosh! Bang! They can rip a soul right out of a body and use it as a bomb! Kaboom! Bony shrapnel flying everywhere! Blood in everyone's eyes! And then they jump into the shadows, spread out, and sneak behind the enemy's lines to finish the survivors. They surround them, cover them with a force field, and create a little explosion on the inside. And don't forget the roaring flame! All that's left is ashes and footprints on the scorched earth..."
607d40e3-6f36-4d92-b64a-22b157240420: "They'll be waiting for your decision, chief."
4b76f8bb-f85c-4927-8e3d-1807eecec06c: "You should think fast. What if an enemy assault takes us by surprise, and we've got no reinforcements, hunh?"
76f913bf-78dd-4e02-b1ac-568b3ff444bb: {n}Một người phụ nữ trung niên vạm vỡ trong bộ trang phục xám thực dụng cúi chào ngươi. Qua vô số sợi dây và dây buộc trên cổ, ngươi có thể đoán bà đang đeo khá nhiều bùa hộ mệnh dưới áo choàng. Tóc bà ngắn và cắt sát.{/n}
895dc59f-cb51-437d-aef6-37ae3fab2d3c: {n}Đốc công đầu tiên của Lữ Đoàn Đũa Phép, Raquillata, lịch sự gật đầu và khẽ chạm hai gót giày vào nhau.{/n}
a5030eb0-377b-4acd-87db-38c244e71685: "Đốc Công Trưởng Raquillata, sẵn sàng phục vụ, thưa Điện Hạ. Đến để đàm phán thay mặt Lữ Đoàn Đũa Phép, những người tốt nghiệp Arcanamirium!"
b9424b94-01ca-44a0-a0d3-ad4b5cc814da: "Chúng tôi không phải lý thuyết gia hay giáo sư, thưa Điện Hạ. Chúng tôi là những người thực hành bí thuật, chuyên gia chiến đấu, và lính tiền tuyến. Chúng tôi sẵn lòng chia sẻ kiến thức với các pháp sư quân đội của ngài."
3ada023d-fcf6-4e6e-972c-645ba5143963: "Kinh nghiệm của chúng tôi. Ngài đang thuê Lữ Đoàn Đũa Phép, một đội pháp sư độc lập, không chỉ làm lính mà còn làm cố vấn và huấn luyện viên cho các binh sĩ khác. Mỗi chúng tôi không chỉ có phép thuật mà còn dày dạn kinh nghiệm chiến đấu. Quan trọng hơn, chúng tôi biết khi nào và làm sao để dùng nó."
47e55c26-b0db-4448-bb0a-2bddfe3e1aeb: "Đó là học viện bí thuật lâu đời nhất, lớn nhất, và danh giá nhất ở {g|Absalom}Absalom{/g}. Nó rất có ảnh hưởng. Học trò từ khắp thế giới đến để tinh thông nghệ thuật phép thuật. Mà này, trường miễn học phí đấy."
51a4087f-979d-4a94-b01c-ac26a78462eb: "Họ dạy cả phép thuật lẫn kỹ năng thực tế, cả hai chắc chắn đều hữu ích cho pháp sư chiến đấu. Chẳng hạn, nếu ngươi đã học cách triệu hồi quái vật nổi điên, thì học cách chạy nhanh cũng là ý hay."{n}Một nụ cười thoáng nhẹ trên gương mặt Raquillata.{/n}
c3300fae-cd34-4706-b896-bd8451e0d0f4: "Mỗi thành viên trong lữ đoàn của chúng tôi đều tốt nghiệp Arcanamirium. Mỗi người đều có kinh nghiệm chiến đấu và khao khát xây dựng sự nghiệp lính đánh thuê. Chúng tôi đã chuẩn bị nhận lệnh của ngài kể từ khi gia nhập Lữ Đoàn Đũa Phép."
f326537b-d6a2-4d32-a6d2-1085d7660779: {n}The halfling standing before you wears fine black cashmere. He has a couple of strange-looking palm-sized crossbows in his waistband. His expensive attire does nothing to disguise the scars on his face and hands, or his sturdy posture. Your guest seems more accustomed to sitting in the saddle and wearing traveling clothes, rather than visiting palaces wearing expensive attire.{/n}
0cd5d147-4bc6-4d0e-889b-76cf246053ed: "Greetings, Your Highness. I am Captain Romelo. I represent the Smoky Dawn Arms Factory in the Grand Duchy of Alkenstar. Our enterprise is prepared to provide your army with the finest weapons ever made."
f8cfa9d8-f068-4961-9057-54bdcca2decb: "Alkenstar ở tận nửa vòng trái đất. Ngươi thấy đấy, phép thuật... ta diễn đạt thế nào nhỉ... Nó không hoạt động ở vùng đất chúng tôi. Đừng hỏi ta tại sao. Đó là câu hỏi dành cho các nhà nghiên cứu và sử gia. Nhưng người Alkenstar bình thường chúng tôi đã biến phiền toái này thành lợi ích lớn lao."
a2d86a63-6288-4e76-afdb-1d11a1c633a4: {n}Romelo xoa cằm.{/n} "Chúng tôi từ bỏ phép thuật vì khoa học. Không nước nào sánh được với Alkenstar về những kỳ tích công nghệ! Chúng tôi không chỉ sống sót. Chúng tôi sống rất tốt ở đây, nơi một pháp sư không bao giờ chịu nổi. Và chúng tôi sẵn lòng chia sẻ phát hiện của mình với bất cứ ai trả giá hợp lý."
eee991f7-06f5-4190-a3fa-c27c3a7875e2: {n}The captain grins and pats his crossbows.{/n} "So, you'd like to know how they're operated? What gears bring these small death machines to life? How can they rain bolts down upon the enemy without ever recharging? It's a secret. We make our living from other people's ignorance of how our weapons work. Nevertheless, I will tell you a secret about these two crossbows of mine."
c21b7eda-cba9-42cc-ae8c-6a1561968b3c: "The left one is for normal work. I use it to kill bandits and thieves spying on our secrets. It's loaded with ordinary bolts. The right one is for special occasions. Each of its bolts bears the name of a rascal who wronged me or my family. When the right one is empty, my travels on {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} will end, and I will return to Alkenstar and find myself something else to do."
3af080e7-b3d2-4bef-bf2e-54b4f8d0382f: "Because you're smart, Your Highness. Firstly, our 'toys' are way safer, and their failure is far less dangerous than magic cast awry. Secondly, anyone with an eye and two hands can use our weapons. That makes things a bit simpler for you, doesn't it?"
7d8c5d98-e2e5-4dfe-87c8-59cc261519da: "I'm sure we'll have a most productive association, Your Highness."
d3bddc80-c1e5-4c27-9577-bd9c9847f874: {n}The captain's voice grows serious.{/n} "We will provide your soldiers with our weapon, teach them how to use it, and make sure the weapons are working. Believe me, each bolt shot by our crossbows will cost the enemy an equal amount in gold."
28808d5e-d234-4b07-b8eb-21bce1ba558e: "I should make clear from the beginning, we're not selling the technology. Your engineers won't be permitted to repair the weapons; they're to be handled exclusively by our specialists. However, if you're interested in any of our non-weapons technologies, our craftsmen will gladly train yours!"
1bbdbdf3-517f-4333-a7bd-686704f69ead: {n}Một gã người lùn cao lớn và vạm vỡ khác thường với cái đầu cạo trọc cúi chào ngươi. Bất kể thời tiết, đôi chân hắn để trần, và hắn khoác một chiếc áo ghi-lê giản dị trên thân mình trần trụi.{/n}
500b3fee-b0e9-4c25-8b5c-3223174ed39e: "Này – đấu vật tay đi, hả? Ồ không, ta chỉ đùa thôi. Ta biết Điện Hạ bận tối mặt. Có gì ta giúp được không?"
6681c6ea-d9b1-4210-9ea1-325a56221693: {n}Giọng nói hùng hồn nhưng dễ chịu của ông vang khắp đại sảnh.{/n} "Kính chào, thưa Điện Hạ. Ta là Wodga, thầy tu của vị thần vinh quang Kurgess! Ta tin rằng không phải ngẫu nhiên mà con đường đưa ta và đồng đội đến vùng đất của ngài."
cd646306-8cfb-4c82-8b60-ecbc3a9362ef: "Binh lính của ngài... dũng cảm, nhưng yếu. Theo ý chí của Kurgess, chúng tôi sẽ chấn chỉnh đám quân thảm hại của ngài. Các thầy tu của ta biết cách tăng sức mạnh cho binh lính bằng phép thuật, cho họ sức mạnh và tốc độ của một con thú hùng mạnh. Và nếu điều đó không bảo vệ được họ, lời cầu nguyện của chúng tôi sẽ chữa lành cho chiến binh của ngài và phục hồi họ về trạng thái chiến đấu hoàn hảo."
9f7f67bf-d024-4c33-837b-902bd7fe266a: "Kurgess là một dân làng {g|Taldor}Taldan{/g} với vóc dáng phi thường! Ông đi khắp các thị trấn, ghé thăm các hội chợ thương mại, tham gia mọi cuộc thi và màn trình diễn, và luôn chiến thắng. Chuyện ai cũng ghen tị là điều tự nhiên thôi."
f86d63d7-7e53-4df1-bd31-7e04a0642363: "Đối thủ của ông đã giăng bẫy ông trong một cuộc thi. Ông chết, hiến mạng mình để bảo vệ những người tham gia khác, nhưng vinh quang của ông sống mãi ngay cả sau khi ông qua đời. Ít phàm nhân được xem là xứng đáng gia nhập hàng ngũ thần thánh, và Kurgess là một trong số đó!"
007544c6-74dd-4c82-ae24-0223e2228a55: "Giáo hội của chúng tôi còn non trẻ, và chúng tôi chưa có một hệ thống cấp bậc ổn định. Chúng tôi lang thang từ thị trấn này sang thị trấn khác, chữa lành cho người bệnh, dìu dắt kẻ yếu đuối và đau ốm, dạy họ cách khai thác sức mạnh của chính mình, truyền cảm hứng cho những ai có thể vươn ra ngoài giới hạn bản thân. Chúng tôi không xây đền thờ, vì chúng tôi tin rằng cơ thể mình chính là đền thờ. Một túp lều giữa cánh đồng, đó là tất cả những gì chúng tôi cần."
a42d2e31-2291-4f82-98fa-2adb040d34bf: "Kurgess ghê tởm khi người ta tự làm tàn phế bản thân, nên chúng ta từ bỏ rượu và các loại thuốc gây mê. Ta sẽ cấm những thứ này trong binh lính của ngài. df36c369-8e78-4bcd-bf5e-e5103e7cac10: {n}Nok-Nok hesitates for a moment, then presents an open palm – then taps it with a finger... you suddenly realized he just did what seems to be the goblinoid version of "trade." 466ad216-3bc1-4625-94ef-c4a27a0e6760:
{n}Munguk seems oblivious to the kick, but glances down at Nok-Nok, who is now holding his foot and leaping about, and suddenly, a smile slowly cracks Munguk's stained face – it's like watching clay crack.
Then, he starts chortling as Nok-Nok's eyes water.{/n}
d46a900b-54e9-4a8a-9596-ecac098cdb90: {n}Nok-Nok finally stops hopping about and takes a step back, glaring furiously at Munguk.{/n}
e20f0a3d-4a0c-4c5b-b32b-c4a43e6a855c: {n}Seeing the goblin become still, the once-smiling hill giant begins to grumble angrily, his eyebrows drawing together.{/n}
7a11dc65-50f8-4e53-b702-b942c49dd418: {n}Nok-Nok looks confused at your order, then without thinking, kicks Munguk again, and emits a new set of howls.{/n}
1e7d8c87-74bc-40df-8d03-2665ddfb4e47: {n}At this, the giant gives a delighted, booming laugh, spittle flying from his splintered teeth. One gob flies, almost slowly, twisting in flight, to land directly onto Nok-Nok's head with a heavy SPAT, forming a phlegmy cap that drips down his face.{/n}
370f4ba9-0ab5-4919-8ea2-7b7c924b5839: {n}The other goblins, once paralyzed by drink and fear, suddenly begin to laugh as well, pointing at Nok-Nok, until the entire building is filled with laughter.{/n}
500da806-d485-4f71-aa2f-dc935deac84f: {n}Nok-Nok's ears droop at the ridicule, but then he finally manages a half-hearted chuckle, until he's laughing as well... and the hill giant doesn't seem as angry anymore, it seems he's forgotten his hunger in the light of this amusement.{/n}
888812ea-a00f-41cd-ac9f-becaadf70837: {n}Nok-Nok looks doubtful, but shrugs. Squaring his chest, he tries to give a booming, rumbling command, then stomps his feet and nods outside.{/n}
64dba91d-0c36-4664-bb3b-913e03699e3d: {n}The hill giants glances in that direction, then turns back to Nok-Nok, confused, then points at his belly… then points at Nok-Nok.{/n}
b3a00e63-a7fc-4d10-9ec3-5609dbd64e85: {n}Nok-Nok shakes his head frantically, then risks a quick glance at you.{/n} "Munguk not want to go. Food is here. Now he think me not a Hero, but food, too."
061092bf-84fa-4713-b860-6832baf674c3: {n}Nok-Nok thinks hard for a moment, one ear twitching... then brightens. He gives a series of rumbling grunts, very quick in succession, then spreads his hands out wide – and then spreads them high, standing on his tiptoes. After that, he settles back on his heels, and pats himself on the belly with a "mmmm" sound… which doesn't need translation.{/n}
578abbb5-f74d-49b6-9ae3-2e9409246eda: {n}Nok-Nok nods. 4b972dee-09c8-45fd-8c2c-bcb6c5676c6c: {n}Munguk absorbs this dully, then glances at the goblins. He gives a short, dismissive grunt, then glances back at Nok-Nok and shrugs... then to your surprise, he lumbers out, club over his shoulder.{/n}

dbb1869f-79fe-4806-a6b0-e63a315ca919: {n}Nok-Nok loses some of his puffed-up-ness, his ears drooping.{/n} "I not counsel well? But... Hero good at chasing off giant means Nok-Nok good Hero... right?"
f8cd44d6-f2eb-4720-8123-7376a9c94c8f: {n}Despondent, Nok-Nok thinks hard, his thinking ear twitching again, but he seems to be chewing over your words.{/n}
068578e7-2989-4a14-9b89-e409a7cfc524: {n}Ignoring him, pile of goblins are all watching you as they sober up.{/n}
ae5666c2-717f-4725-9184-a6aed45b1e3f: {n}To your surprise, Munguk looks sad – his eyebrows collapse and he gives a low grunt. 9ce9a13b-3e54-4a88-bb01-a15547941299: {n}Nok-Nok nods, listening, then translates – you think.{/n} "Munguk not happy. He not hungry, just lonely. bdcac279-aee4-4f6d-bf48-0f2bf3d20180: "Ah, ha, HAH." {n}Amiri snarls sarcastically... as she does, Munguk looks up at her, and his face brightens.{/n} "No! 99f5d054-0a81-4dad-a61d-f49d9bcbfb11: "Ha. You put an animal higher than yourself. You think almost as little of yourself as I do..."

9f3e5acd-d3e3-4eb2-8edd-f3558b11f571: "It's not strange at all! I write for myself and for other people – and not for those bloated toads at the Academy! People like my stories – and I couldn't ask for more!"

aef96cbe-ae50-4fb8-bd6a-2d33927e0b73: "On the day that he betrays you, you will speak otherwise."

3a2e1107-244a-4feb-8e67-7f8af99951d1: Our story started at the mansion of an Aldori Swordlord. Drawn by the promise of a most dangerous task and a commensurately huge reward, heroes of all stripes gathered here...

0fb702b7-9152-4636-b485-4f0970b70bb0: "All I'm dreaming of is a bath, hot spiced tea, and the sound of rain outside the window. And sweets... Oh, sorry for not properly appreciating your embarrassing little delusions."
3f637188-2b88-464f-9c65-829abfbdd3a5: "Oh, what is it I hear, a bruised ego? It must be so hard for you, mighty Regongar, to walk beside someone with no interest in your charms…"
13110bd7-6c00-4c4a-af65-f774325fc09d: "Now that I freed you, can you rest in peace?"

0691cbc3-c8ef-4dc9-87ec-001671763f77: {n}You see the translucent form of an old man in dirty work clothes. His gray hair is tousled, and his eyes wander madly. 7d258d47-7376-4f86-8f03-89c1c83b82d0: "Who am I? Who am I? How can you not know me? Shame! Shame and disgrace! b5bea535-de07-4b1f-be4c-5e3d80f25b06:

721636a2-2ae3-471c-b2f5-d2d8da30b0d4: "But do you know who would be worthy of living here? Well, not living exactly, but... it doesn't matter, doesn't matter! I mean me, of course! b23d9da1-66b6-4eaf-b969-f431b76d7441: {n}With a nod of farewell, Gwart disappears into the depths of the tomb.{/n}

08990a6f-76dd-4e71-b62a-669c4d558910: {n}A dark-haired, dark-skinned {g|Varisia}Varisian{/g} stands before you, wearing an expensive but rather road-worn doublet, a leather belt, and dusty baggy pants.
