744b4424-7282-4d18-aeb2-f22d697e572b: {n}Octavia laughs out loud. For a moment, something more than just friendliness flashes across her eyes.{/n} "Oh, you are so sweet!"
19528729-fc7a-49ec-b1ba-be11d00ca412: "Forget about fighting for a moment! We all need a break, especially you!"
1702ec40-2097-4089-89c2-023d1dc7f410: [Attack] "Fools! You fell for my trap, and now you'll die!"
928a6afb-c7e2-44c1-a648-4544b3e49b5a: "You seem to be comfortable. Not interested in hunting monsters?"
1e4a975c-f5f8-49f4-bb13-d54770511e37: [Abandon the hunt and relax] "I suppose the monsters aren't going anywhere. I'll take the largest goblet you'll give me, if you please."
d1ab20db-f44a-4023-bc72-b1e9a1d9bf4c: [Leave] "Enjoy yourself! I have to get back to hunting."
0c716df6-d2fc-457b-a752-2cc2846d071f: "Your music is beautiful. You must have been blessed by Shelyn herself!"
80adbfce-1e5c-440e-9b8b-1605cdcbebbe: {n}Up the hill, there's a burning bonfire. Beside it, a tablecloth's been spread on the ground, with various delicacies on it. 67bc71f4-d643-4611-b4f2-20127f82ceff: "Excellent! The sun is warm, the wine is rich, and the company is good. I couldn't dream of a better hunt!"
44d85c78-411e-4b34-b5bc-713d9ff05fc0: "Why should we? We're happy where we are! Please, have a seat! Can I pour you some wine? {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} wines are the finest around!"
cb26af54-3ec4-45a9-b680-e60cdaa17f3a: "His Highness is healthy and vigorous! He sends you his regards. Some urgent matters of state prevented him from attending this fine event, but he does hope to meet with you personally in the near future."
538b2b71-7d90-4d35-97a0-17fd474cf361: {n}The bard fills a goblet to the brim with fragrant wine and offers it to you.{/n} "To good relations between neighbors!"
a7faed6a-8ecd-40e4-9460-90bd22c4dc51: "A good hunt to you!" {n}The bard flashes you a charming smile and begins playing her lute again.{/n}
70149ce0-23bc-481c-9525-d4d61451b4e4: {n}The {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} wine deserves all its praise and more — it's almost as sweet as Annamede's voice. 3f28ceea-0cb8-4f8d-abcf-0b739eb3a710: "Your Grace! Come. Sit with us! Treat yourself!"
c30f6bec-d299-41a2-8708-42916f966021: "Now this is my kind of hunt! Gods only know how long it's been since I've had the chance to spend some leisure time in polite company. Pass me the peaches, if you would."
45698d06-8324-440e-8214-dbbd19d5db69: "What a surprise! If it isn't the estimable Jubilost Narthropple himself! Your books are a blessing. Please, be so kind as to honor us with your company and tell us of your adventures!"
ef5a87d0-1a3c-43a1-93ef-347a9586f16e: "Ah, I can hardly believe my eyes! How could such a beautiful flower bloom in these wild lands?" {n}Annamede feasts her eyes upon Valerie, who steps back with a scowl.{/n} "Please, sweetheart, sit here with me. Let us enjoy your company."
5b9228ef-b20a-418f-9686-61a379c7b7ba: "Lady Belavarah! You probably don't remember me... We... I... You taught us poetics at the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy{/g}, and I must say... 834438e0-0c52-41d0-95a8-85d3bd45fb38: {n}Valerie glares angrily at Annamede, then turns away to stand guard at a distance, her sword at the ready. She meaningfully looks around for enemies with exaggerated diligence.{/n}
bfddb419-1db0-4f0c-a4c8-0a89a72ff0d7: "People dying of a magical disease, monsters roaming the country, but here you are — drinking and having fun, as though forgetting it may be the last day of your lives... But that is human nature, I suppose, is it not?"
f90567d3-f4c7-4ea7-a712-83e0c1c9d6c3: "Ah, {g|Shelyn}Shelyn{/g}, Shelyn... The Eternal Rose brings inspiration to many — but not to me! For that, I turn to {g|Calistria}Calistria{/g} — that's why my music promises not boring beauty, but true ecstasy!"
d0eb6ded-a656-42f0-b5a9-1f7f215b4074: "You seem a reasonable man, so you must understand — the times of lawlessness and chaos in the Stolen Lands are about to pass. Lay down your arms, surrender, and confess your crimes. A just sentence is far better than an undignified death."
1aa80568-52a7-4e4c-9dc6-e7e48ae254fa: "Help me get rid of the Stag Lord. You'll gain a new chance at life and a reliable ally."
a21eff59-02a3-4792-b2bd-6c50d39df083: "Since I first met you, I've wondered why a man like you would serve the Stag Lord. You don't have to serve him, to die for him. We could be allies, Akiros."
3a988018-8729-458f-8054-51ab93d8b06f: "Leave the Stag Lord and get out. I won't follow you."
b4cc9bb6-8520-4737-9cb2-368a4da3d1db: "This isn't the first time you've tried to speak reasonably with me, Akiros. Now I'm returning the favor — this is your chance to keep your life."
e06945f0-c0a6-4b53-a9ff-47419a313839: "I heard your voice tremble when you spoke Erastil's name. Why is a kind god's servant working with bandits?"
20bd5128-c3b4-4eea-8898-b85798158eca: "We have company!" {n}A tall, broad-shouldered man with prematurely graying hair stares at you, but he doesn't attack.{/n} "You must be the {g|Restov}Restovic{/g} envoy I've heard so much about. Otherwise, let's just get this over with." {n}Akiros raises his sword, watching you carefully.{/n}
af8206d1-2cb7-4988-9b28-a75c8fe2734f: "Why does this not {d|c11 Meet Akiros}surprise{/d} me?" {n}Akiros stares at you, but he doesn't attack.{/n} "I don't suppose I could just ask you to leave the fort in peace, in the name of Erastil or whatever deity you swear by?"
ae5ab7b7-98f0-4ffd-ad51-c3a5966dabe8: "Akiros Insmort, the Stag Lord's right hand. So, are we going to stand here exchanging pleasantries, or will you go back behind the wall? Or better yet, back to {g|Restov}Restov{/g}?"
e0f02d27-4238-4198-8559-86d35daa2a35: "My little chat must have given you more food for thought than I'd expected! It's true, I'm not much satisfied with my current position. An alliance, huh? Fine. If you start a fight with the Stag Lord, I'll be there to help."
7cc0172a-2372-44c8-b342-ccec1763858d: "If you knew me better, you wouldn't want me as your ally. I'm afraid I fit in a little too well with the Stag Lord. Sorry, but one of us will have to die here."
84d22d56-aefc-427b-9d7a-5410334ac9f2: {n}Akiros squints.{/n} "So... that's it? You're letting me go? Well, I certainly don't fancy dying for the Stag Lord. Farewell!"
5718e35c-13dc-4e17-a5ec-ee4e85d7753c: "How noble. I would have agreed, but I don't really think it'll be that hard for me to get rid of you."
5df6e842-4646-4678-87b5-18feac3bf242: "You have no idea what you're talking about. d0d71c6e-9e31-4fa5-a9fb-6cb7b99937aa: "I'm glad to see that my good manners served me well. Farewell. I hope you live to see the end of the day — perhaps you'll actually be able to bring some change to these lands."
1be62171-d9ed-4b00-a2fd-e12aad381a6a: "I'm sorry, but that just won't do. I offered you the chance to leave in peace, but it seems we'll have to fight."
aa497708-5546-4762-946a-217ae97d71b2: {n}Akiros gives you a hard stare.{/n} "An alliance, huh? Well... if my 'leader' weren't so fast to drown himself in wine, I probably wouldn't listen, but... 8d6e70b3-49b0-4cef-bc23-2fef4c825c02: "I like your confidence, but I'm afraid I must disappoint you — I don't just make alliances with anyone who offers."
7bba64e8-b07b-4e04-abf4-4fb5a8d9d6bb: "Wait... Did you just lure the Stag Lord's right hand over to your side? Nice work!"
ce8628c2-13f4-4dac-b15e-efa4b8c67d19: "Ha! That's what I like about you. Just look at him — such a tough guy before he met you, and now he's running with his tail between his legs like some kind of whipped mutt!"

417ebd5d-119b-4a50-8356-95541768b525: "I hope I won't regret this decision."
c2c1fbf4-88cc-4a17-9c0f-9f64e9dd649c: {n}Akiros looks at the fort one last time, then turns away, never to see it again.{/n}
048c138e-ea78-47a2-ba9d-cff7921201c4: "Perhaps you'll succeed in bringing law to these lands after all. Maybe even with your persuasion skills!" {n}Akiros nods, a bitter smirk across his face.{/n} "Farewell!"
5235eb48-c5c0-4eba-abd3-99b5a0b81aee: "You set a hardened criminal upon the path of law. The blood of a real ruler truly runs in your veins!"
6ef3a494-507b-4ff6-a860-3a3dac539f73: {n}Akiros looks away.{/n} "A servant of... It's been a long, long time... Many years, and many atrocities ago."
c2119c3c-a093-4761-b000-f7e5722c9d0f: {n}After a moment of silence, the man resolutely looks you in the eye.{/n} "Tell you what... e3d67fa3-f0e3-4a49-8dab-220634b68858: [Pat Irovetti on the back] "I'm happy to finally meet you!"
6dc0a65a-a17e-499f-9717-1d4b10716384: "Hey there, Irovetti. We've only just met — are you already checking where you want to stick your dagger?"
11e40a3b-d320-41d0-a7b5-167eb9014538: "She is beautiful, isn't she? I wouldn't have anyone else beside me!"
b24ff6c3-871b-4fe2-a1a0-8060841e2e5e: "You are the epitome of hospitality, aren't you? But not too long ago your spy nearly killed me! You do remember the one named Tartuccio?"
8323ad7b-3ced-4079-8d52-85ae28c74116: {n}King Irovetti greets you personally. The bulky Kellid is broad shouldered and looks to be somewhere around fifty years of age. 6cd72c1a-631f-41b8-9da8-660b5acf4523: "Well, my crown-bearing {mf|brother|sister}, welcome to my home! Stuff yourself, drink, be my guest! You've proven yourself in combat, as well as affairs of state — let's see how you do at having fun."

53fe62da-d60d-45b4-8c99-3aff0fe31001: "It's no good for kings and queens to stay in our palaces all the time. We need to meet, be friends with one another... It's all about keeping up neighborly relations, you know?"
74096039-aa20-4ac7-86e4-d21436d26eec: "So here's the plan. First — the fisher's triathlon. Then a boasting contest, and in the evening — the best part — a drunken melee. And after the melee, I'll announce the winner, and then we'll have a festive banquet and a fireworks show. Ha ha, just joking, just a joke!"
dca75f8e-09ce-44df-93ec-308858594df3: "Oh, and one more thing — I'll have to seal your sheath. This is a peaceful celebration, after all, and bullies will be kicked out immediately. 0bb8abe8-cac2-40cb-9d0f-fc625d9e24cf: "Well, I have to go. If you need anything, talk to Nunzio Arpaia. He's my master of ceremonies, so he's responsible for organizing this mess. Have fun!"
c1727201-00d2-4e69-8ba8-84bccea683c8: {n}Noticing Valerie, Irovetti leers and gives her a raunchy smile.{/n} "Although I wouldn't mind baring my sword for such a luxurious sheath!"
ebe86489-8ce0-4de5-b6c2-a1ff91167902: {n}Valerie glances at you, alarmed and disappointed, then glares at Irovetti with silent, undisguised contempt.{/n}
ba2ba58d-af35-423d-8e73-9087f10fb047: "Aah, of course! Such a pretty flower has already been picked, hasn't it? Who knows, who knows, who will enjoy these plump buds in the future..."
a99c6bdb-dc50-4a58-84b9-dd98456cb085: "I assure you, Your Highness, it will not be you." {n}Valerie folds her arms across her chest and lifts her chin. You notice her move closer to you ever so slightly.{/n}

77580fd8-436e-4c18-b6ea-49e517eb3e36: "Forgive me for interfering into a conversation between illustrious persons. I just meant to inquire — how is my death sentence in absentia? When I inquired about it the last time, you still couldn't determine on the type of execution, honorable sir."

9c591421-ff0b-405e-9ae4-ab49155fcc28: "What a gloomy, dull place this Rushlight tournament is... How can you not fall into despondence when you see all this ridiculous brightness, pride, vanity?"
c5d0351b-da97-480e-82ec-7088b64e18fd: "Tartuccio? The short, purple fellow? Ah, you're bearing a grudge about something that happened years ago! 4aa7e398-3893-4454-a1a6-ea5e438a4818: "{mf|Brother|Sister}? What? Why? Ah, it the crown? Hmm... His better."
d351c9be-f368-4169-846a-47aaf0fc2742: "I feel like a child in a sweet shop. Entertainment! Shopping! New trade connections – and the smell of intrigue in the air! Mmm…"
1bbb0c3e-5ddc-4234-9b66-6b3ee29ce6eb: "This place is amazing! Bright tents, music, people smiling and laughing… After all our grim adventures, I've longed for such a holiday with friends!"
02e0dc15-491e-4946-a88d-5641d9cde5a5: "As sovereign of these lands, I demand you give me that monster's head."
c2fbfcf4-4460-462d-9c23-f698578e1f80: [Attack] "I'll be taking that monster's head... and yours as well!"
1bfa9a9d-8bfe-438f-b39a-9757bac0d64d: "The way you've handled it was amazing. Great job!"
ed9f0ff2-184f-4c9f-8ca8-e8cdaddc06e7: "You're good warriors. Gorum smiled when he saw how you dispatched that monster!"
6379ea3a-00e0-4209-b0b5-cf8172851b72: {n}The hunter lifts the wyvern's severed head in triumph.{/n} "You see that? Bang, down, it's done! Now that's how we deal with these beasts back in Embeth Forest!"
6c19b7d3-49dc-43c3-8f46-d4afb0c9b28d: "Hells no! That's not how this works. You may be lord, master, and almighty on your lands, but this is the hunt, and a deal's a deal: anything we kill is our trophy!"
764ad83a-fb03-4bef-807e-12eaddb161c5: {n}The hunter hides the wyvern's severed head in a bag, then spits and glares at you.{/n} "What's wrong with you? How 'bout you stop getting in our way and just mind your own hunt? That beast's almost fled — how 'bout you give it a whistle!"
2f3b7f85-b371-495e-887c-06a57249a860: "Thanks for the kind words! Yeah, unfortunately, we're used to it. Our homeland gives us no slack: every week there's another hungry beast to deal with!"
9f3e5c1a-7b51-49a4-8c50-609290808d56: "Is it like this everywhere? Is there no place left in the world where people can live without fear?"
b40cb4fd-dd2b-46b2-845c-4233ba096bf4: "You'd better just give it to us while we're asking nicely..."
018c20af-07a1-4fff-ada8-5966532861bf: "Don't try to scare us, boy! We've faced horrors you haven't even seen in your worst nightmares!"
95e5d1fc-b59a-41fa-91f8-7389b8f8021a: "They are right. These are the terms you agreed to."
27f729af-1520-4d1b-8391-3ac9c9894487: "You haven't seen anything unless you've been up north! You seen a mammoth? It's the size of a mountain! Hair like forests! Tusks so long, each one could impale a whole tribe!"
14d0d35d-1b70-4ffa-967d-b68cbbe5e1d8: "Yes, we know what a mammoth is. Sure, we don't have those here — but trust me, we've had our share of monsters."
a64021c8-29d7-429f-90ef-8ab45a5b55ed: "Now that's something becoming of a baron{mf||ess}! What's yours is now ours, losers!"
79bb6c26-40b5-42a7-8314-1363f7092469: "I dare not disobey Your Grace's orders... but still, this is mean and despicable."
a6f3ae85-d681-44d4-b520-8c64cfd24c2d: "We kill all kinds of monsters — flying ones, crawling ones... You think we can't dispatch a few two-legged ones?"
721286fc-2cc9-435c-80f5-6eb247c17af2: "No offense, Your Grace, but {g|Gorum}Gorum's{/g} not exactly our kind of deity. He wants his worshipers to fight as much as possible, while our goal is to help keep actual fighting to a minimum!"
ed709f64-ff69-46fb-94f3-2efec2b2a8ec: "Why didn't you send word in advance?"
8245eff0-70dd-40a3-af35-9c66292e1fee: "Where will we find Eobald and his students?"
b30d24df-fde0-4fd9-8023-589876af0ae8: "Get out. I don't care about you, or your teacher!"

3c4bb60c-c3df-4a51-8977-a3e573b13b0f: {n}Linzi opens her mouth, about to say something harsh, but she realizes the gravity of Alondi's words and interrupts herself.{/n} "You... What do you mean? Professor Eobald is in trouble? {Name}, we have to help!"

6d8b3318-454f-4de3-8654-9240a39ff453: "Irovetti has spies everywhere. If our teacher had tried to contact you, we wouldn't have made it out of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} at all."

fddd35c0-9ffc-4458-b6dd-43d7394f2bc4: "Please don't let Irovetti get Professor Eobald! He's a shining beacon, you'll see!"
5e098d8a-bbea-435d-91be-4edeeafda0c4: {n}Sniffling, Linzi runs out of the throne room.{/n}
5e4b208d-f7b1-425f-b941-39f93f85dc59: "Thank you, Your Grace! You won't regret it! I'll hurry back to the tree."
18a5e5dc-bf18-41a4-9c39-e1eee0b79f51: "I can't believe Irovetti actually kicked out Professor Eobald... Well, it's his loss! We'll save him! Just don't go without me — I miss my old teacher terribly!"

2a6e78a6-050a-480d-a510-147dd89cf3af: "Hay lắm! Ta hy vọng giờ ngươi sẽ bay về với nữ thần của mình, và thôi làm phiền ta với cái bộ mặt ngốc nghếch hớn hở đó, gã trai có cánh."
800fecdd-262f-463b-bc5f-a581a997350a: {n}Tristian freezes and the golden veil that envelops him begins to vibrate.{/n} "Yes, {name}. Yes. But not now."
99e5aabb-6281-4f4c-9a12-e6377f11480b: "Are those your traps in the forest?"
b7ead97b-a36f-4107-b974-b0e9ce9f581f: "Bartholomew, have you ever considered using your talents in service to the public?"
893c8ac1-60a5-424c-9ff0-2912b39b1eaa: "I would like to count you among my advisors in the capital."
c182775c-db9a-4263-903a-931895963d1b: "Your Highness! It's such a pleasure to see you here! To what do I owe this honor? Please let me introduce myself: I'm Bartholomew Delgado, an independent scholar of esoteric science — and your humble servant. How may I be of assistance?"
7d399601-a8bc-45f7-86de-971c5f733bae: {n}The laboratory feels emptier than before. The wizard is packing his books, vials, manacles, and needles — carefully wrapping them in cloth before placing them into crates.{/n}
7757df48-cb92-4cf0-aa23-b250dc2f887c: {n}Bartholomew greets you with a deep bow.{/n} "Welcome, Your Highness! It's always a pleasure to welcome you into my humble abode!"
d343bbb9-7838-4fa6-be15-834800c84b7c: "Oh, a little bit of everything... But I'm especially interested in the local fauna. This realm is a home to the most peculiar creatures — with the most interesting qualities!"
27d36937-0b2d-4e91-be55-f053b6bf8aa5: "Yes, they're mine. This wilderness is a savage place, what with all the bandits and monsters poking about... I'm infinitely grateful for all your efforts to protect your subjects' peaceful slumber. But even now a hermit such as myself must take some measures to protect his humble hut from intruders."
74f98579-0a32-4825-aa4c-ae2a1d21c1cb: "Hmm... I should say my accounting skills are quite remarkable. — In fact, science requires very careful record-keeping and attention to detail. 1326343f-05b3-4a61-a4f8-f31d4a6c3f74: {n} Bartholomew's eyes flash. {/n} "What an unexpected and pleasant news, Your Grace! 2d99b7b0-24ff-4ece-8933-faf1a4d8d381: {n}Bartholomew's wide smile doesn't contain the slightest trace of sincerity.{/n} "I've already taken that role, and, to be honest, I'm convinced that my advice only distracted you. I really think you need another person to fill in this position."
30e8535a-16e1-486d-9615-c9630244c106: "My spells must be replenished. I feel uncomfortable without them."
9b0cbafc-038a-4ea7-a43f-7aa99f8c68c0: "It was a hard day. My spells must be restored, so we're prepared for tomorrow."
30f6d70a-093e-4c3e-b09a-d0eb72e4fec6: "At least you can always rely on your weapons if magic fails you… If the same thing happens to me, all I can do is hide behind my companions!"
40aac418-8828-417c-bb1d-c52e65efb986: "You'd better sharpen your blade, instead of wasting time on that crap!"
6215573e-db37-4af5-b0b6-a7a6adf0331d: "You're rather well-stocked — your weapons, your magic, and your wolf. It's no wonder you sometimes forget to replenish your spells."
1051e287-cebf-4523-a15f-2934317b6b6d: "Oh, oh, can I play with wolfy while you're busy? He's so sweet — such a fluffy head, and that soft fur! I just love it when you summon him!"
efff3920-6e1e-48f4-951d-d77016d76e9a: "I don't want to get involved in all this."
f922b077-8885-48b3-a4a6-50f4df10dff6: "Fine. As soon as the opportunity arises, we'll visit the Valley of the Dead."
639b72c1-d6ab-4b7d-875a-9a9261ee7543: "I will not help you in this."
58ff0b39-2f87-4576-a164-9db62bffa968: {n}Jaethal crosses the throne room, her gait determined and confident. I expected him to seek shelter somewhere far from your lands, but no — he was spotted not far away."
6f36cf3e-7e14-4fd6-8b41-e16765c05512: "Not far from the {g|Valley of the Dead}Valley of the Dead{/g}. What a fitting place for a Pharasmite, desperately trying to rid this world of the undead. 49898c89-395c-42a9-8225-b5e61fd32d1d: "How could this be, after all he's done to fool you and drag you into his schemes?" {n}Jaethal can't hide her disappointment.{/n} "Very well, as you wish. But this is a short-sighted decision. Very short-sighted."
865070d3-5a85-49d4-a155-c7e8d84ab71d: "To track down the half-blood, I had to deal with a whole range of scum — thieves, vagabonds, grave-robbers. Excerpts from "Serving Your Hunger", the sacred text of {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa's{/g} followers."
45f44f4e-86fc-40d4-9296-4c17ed40159c: "I've examined the stolen papers closely, and now I believe that their owner is a high-ranking priestess of {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa{/g}. Then, when he comes for her... well, the servants of any deity should be able to stand up for their faith, is it not so?"
685346aa-134e-4928-b98f-a888635b60a5: "Thank you. I want to say — this... this is important to me. I've grown tired of drowning in silence, hearing never a word from my goddess. f4a20982-c61b-4b0b-8ef8-a3886413900a: "Most honorable Jubilost, do you mind letting me see your maps? Yesterday I looked over your shoulder in passing, and I noticed a place for a possible new caravan route!"
2a876ceb-fa16-4ab6-a75c-1402b173c657: "Ahem, ahem, of course, take them! Finally someone with eyes to see!"
67421303-96d7-43a5-8173-a39cf3fd87a0: "We're looking for a criminal who may have fled this way. Have you seen anyone suspicious?"
46ecd708-5741-4a03-9705-6164a36ff2f8: "What can you tell me about your masters?"
e98c2280-9410-4c29-b3fe-6d65a0e9a326: "All right, that's enough about the Tedrims."
7b83ceeb-4aa0-445f-a970-5ddc8fea7b44: "The hostess of the lodge doesn't mind you cooking at her kitchen?"
71ccf633-0bb3-4967-99b7-8975c889e8e9: "I've heard there was a commotion here in the kitchen."
5aeb6d86-7219-487d-a55c-2f237a000237: "It must be difficult to please nobles like the Tedrims. I imagine they ask for something new for each day's meal?"
c6b3f377-e1b6-4f1c-bd5b-83876d3975b0: "All right, I won't trouble you any longer."
56576520-e04e-4e6a-943a-fae41b621b06: "I need the key to your room."
e2ef4db5-5175-4415-99e4-18976a988410: "Has anyone come into the kitchen recently?"
c33363f2-0729-4fb6-a5dd-2817e922fefc: "You! You and your minions unleashed a blight across my lands! Because of you monsters overrun the barony, and honest people fear to leave their homes!"
6d0d30ad-49fb-4c37-a65d-c6127bff5904: "Tell me who you are. Quick now."
fd867cc4-5bb8-4fcb-80e7-e814e6c291af: "Tell me about the cult of Lamashtu."
24c1226f-d7d8-4531-83d3-8445bc1f60eb: "What kind of rituals were you performing at the shrine?"
747e3dac-baf4-4fb9-88ba-c9b45ae193d4: "Where are the rest of Lamashtu cultists hiding?"
d10922d9-cb81-4a29-9b5d-0f48975d21a9: "Have you allied with goblins and other creatures in the area?"
20968fff-7cff-4b80-9992-38b36b4ee3eb: "All these people in the lodge — are they here because of you?"
c1886307-7484-4866-80d6-205702f0fc55: "The couple from Restov — did they come to meet you?"
a12f90c6-699c-4958-9a6c-c831b7356508: "Is the lodge hostess involved in all this?"
95ff44f5-718f-4a65-baae-a27fa65277ad: "Kesten! I have an order for you!"
5553f67d-5b74-45db-ae10-ef07dafa6116: "Arrest everyone except for the lodge hostess. I want them executed by morning."
e478d04b-a482-4d83-9d07-3bd70b98a54f: "Send these people home. The priestess of Lamashtu must be executed."
8d5d84c9-a30e-4d49-afff-22a1c7d387b8: "These people are innocent — let them leave. As for the priestess, she's banished from these lands forever. See to it she's removed from the barony at once."
69265d0b-51b1-4b8f-bc55-d71e77ffc38a: "I forgive all these people — even the priestess. Let them go."
64d540b8-705b-44bb-ba51-37d28cb529ea: "Fine, Olika. The priestess will perform her ritual for you, then Kesten will follow my orders. Servant of Lamashtu, are you ready to help this woman?"
9e8786c3-0abb-4b11-9dc5-e81da278d710: "No, Olika. There is no place in my lands for such rituals. Kesten! Execute my order!"
15b73ddf-01a0-4b22-ac3f-508b4a3f600f: "No, hold a moment. I want to ask the priestess something else."
ff5f404d-4370-45cc-84cb-b3f137f4c361: "It disgusts me to listen to this."
6173392b-fe98-4e35-9e4c-32e65b021fb0: "The more I hear about Lamashtu, the more I favor this goddess. What else can you share with me?"
9b822fb7-457f-4cfb-af72-0c65b75bc6f4: "I'm not impressed by your attempts to wound my pride."
a5016dc1-6b98-4c4b-8af3-f9dd89d83858: "I have nothing against Lamashtu and her flock. Priestess, you are free to go."
961efbd0-219c-44d4-8975-c9e3e3c4fb28: {n}The kitchen servant is busy, grinding herbs within a mortar. She's wearing a dress, soiled with dark stains, and her hair is knotted in a bun with a few stray hairs poking free.{/n}
c0ab3d56-3948-4ce6-9049-479cf0f6b227: {n}The kitchen servant looks at you askew and keeps on grinding the herbs in the mortar.{/n}
333dbe4e-ebdd-413a-8c49-cc989ffa3d2c: "Name's Tsanna, I cook for Tedrims, nobles from {g|Restov}Restov{/g}." {n}She wipes her hands with her apron.{/n} "What will it be?"
5ad73477-a396-4b8b-8e5e-a63fe896e45c: {n}She throws a glance at the stove. {/n} "That there's for tomorrow." {n}She hesitates.{/n} "Tomorrow's mid-day meal, it is."
6e4da2f9-88e8-4f1b-aa72-71fec1def409: {n}Tsanna frowns.{/n} "No quicker road to trouble — talking about masters, that is." {n}She glances at your clothes and sighs.{/n} "How would you like it if your servants were all a-gossip about you?"
3b6f7e8d-48a8-43ef-84ea-557ff80d09a9: "None of my business. Might be they have things to do, but I wouldn't know it -I mend, I cook, and I serve when, where needed."
e598f5a7-0bfa-40c1-90cf-25045a5b7d36: "What can be seen here, you say?" {n}Tsanna snorts.{/n} "Ask Dumra, she runs the house, she does."
af9346a2-1cf5-448d-87b3-b0d0266adaec: "As if she came here often herself!" {n}She throws up her hands.{/n} "Filth piled in corners, the floor sandal-deep in dirt… had to work my fingers to bones to clean the kitchen before I could start a proper meal in this…" She curls her lip. "...this cowshed."
0bbe6dd1-d843-4d49-ae76-1870b6f2a3e6: "Wha?" {n}She looks at you, confused for a moment, then brightens.{/n} "Ah! You meaning the pots. I knocked some off the stove. Haven't had time to hang them back up — that witch Dumra stormed here at once, all thundercloud-like! Howling as if I'd broken her finest crystal!"
611ff9f8-1a8b-422b-ab5b-f42cd9fd17ec: {n}She waves her hand and turns back to tend the stew boiling at the stove.{/n}
c31c03e9-4d4a-4366-9622-9ab9c5b9a39c: {n}You take the lid off the pan. Some brew boils inside. It looks strange and smells odd. You lean over, smell the stew...{/n}
60e54365-771d-41b0-9352-30987ddd6588: {n}…and immediately flinch: the acrid stink of vinegar feels like a punch in the face, besides you can smell some strange spice, which would be appropriate in a dessert, but not in a first course for dinner.{/n}
0071c3ca-8b20-40f1-8fd5-af370d790c78: {n}Tsanna thinks about it. {/n} "Yes." {n}She hesitates, then nods.{/n} "That's it, I s'ppose."
8f24c2c0-1d39-4440-ad6b-bc4f137099e9: "Room?" {n}She raises an eyebrow.{/n} "I don't have a room 'cept here in the kitchen. Bed's a bench. Still — warm enough, though."
2f9f85b3-d552-475c-bafb-60c4fef4dfa9: "They pay regular, not stingy with their coin. They don't yell — much. So I count myself fortunate, I do."
36d0542c-758e-4dff-8fa3-bd01e474216b: "Only Dumra came." {n}She frowns.{/n} "No doubt checking to see I'm not palming the silver. As if there's anything worth stealing here, so there's not."
26e9a37c-da9e-498c-ba02-d726216496b2: "Stop! Stop! I surrender! I surrender!" {n}The priestess of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} holds her hands over her bleeding wounds, moaning in pain.{/n}
d2713fd2-a90d-4e2f-8cd4-18d8f3ffb3ed: {n}The priestess of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} shakes her head and tries to close her wounds, moaning.{/n} "That's nonsense! I've heard the stories about what's happening in your barony, {race}, but I have nothing to do with this!"
db63bbee-a211-4f97-9cec-f9e3f54acad4: "The Great Mother rules the monsters of this world. But if you had truly earned her wrath, your lands would be drowning in blood! No, {mf|baron|baroness}, you must look elsewhere to place blame — {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} and her followers have nothing to do with your troubles."
f6c1adea-6c80-4ee8-b3de-077f3a88f108: "I am the priestess of the cult of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, The Great Mother, The Ancestress of Monsters." {n}The priestess struggles to raise her chin, her voice a hiss. {/n} "I'm not from these lands. I came because of the pleas of your people, who seek the mercy of my goddess."
1db604b1-1268-46cf-8f09-dcb32c0be7d3: "I came to these lands in secret and hid my identity from everyone except for those initiated in the mysteries of {g|Lamashtu}Great Mother{/g}. Even the hostess of this lodge had no idea who I was! And those looking for divine benefaction, found me on their own — and there are more than the followers of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} would believe!"
84c65fce-9e2b-4473-a2d9-8108129cfe3f: "We are numerous and we are strong. The tribe of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} followers grows every day… breeds… and spreads over the lands of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} in search for places to create new packs."
7be2f6c4-9ad7-46e6-b226-af894edf2fd3: "We prayed to {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}. We asked for new offsprings in the pack. 4b53cbe0-aab4-4277-99cc-1512575df1d9: {n}The woman's face turns to stone.{/n} "You cannot make me betray the children of Great Mother. Torture me if you like — {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} will grant me the strength to endure any pain you inflict upon me."
c815a232-adea-4778-a2a6-c3022b0f6a05: "No. We have the same mistress, but our paths to faith are different."
edc1769d-da98-422e-881f-b06f20db0d31: "I held no illusions you could grasp the wisdom of my goddess."
1b7fa172-80fa-44be-8e8e-92c85e6a3637: {n}The priestess shakes her head.{/n} "They were searching for the blessing of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}. Other gods have denied them and they had to ask Mother of Monsters for her benefaction."
17f0b9b7-3c2e-402d-80f5-68d9d20563bc: {n}The priestess of Lamashtu looks at Dumra in disgust.{/n} "This thoughtless thing? 0d36a52e-ffe2-468f-9b94-032950cedd35: {n}The priestess glares at you, hatred and contempt in her eyes.{/n}
2ee92fbb-97cd-4b34-9598-77aef52ec22d: "Olika, Olika, Olika… She's a poor girl clinging to the unborn life in her womb. The seed of her husband was too weak — Olika's child is doomed to perish before coming to this world."
d64f2519-ab5e-441a-9828-7c386fcfdd41: "Yes. Several years ago the lawyer defended a necromancer in a court in his native city — and he won the trial. Since then all Tedrim's attempts to conceive a child were doomed to fail — {g|Pharasma}Pharasma{/g} didn't want to prolong the bloodline of a man who protected those who raise the dead. Una has more brains than her spineless mate, so she'd sought the support of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}. 68a05cb6-4057-4780-9157-3fe1bddc8415: {n}Kesten hesitates.{/n} "Your Grace... I realize these people are guilty and must be punished. But I will not harm a pregnant woman. She will be sent home." {n}Kesten's face hardens.{/n} "That is the only resolution to this matter."
0e7e05e3-e3c9-456c-91d2-42a1048cfbd1: "Your Grace! Wait!" {n}You can barely hear Olika's words through her sobs.{/n} "Let me ask you! No, let me beg you! Allow the priestess to perform one last ritual! Let her save my child! I have no other hope except for Tsanna!"
484b28aa-de0d-473a-9aa5-ebe854eca496: {n}Kesten looks at you as if you're mad.{/n} "Let them go? All of them?! But..." {n}He hesitates for a moment, then seems to remember his place and nods calmly. {/n} "As you command, Your Grace."
510541fd-5774-443e-9813-1368dc3ed5db: {n}She raises the hem of her skirt and starts to wipe away the blood from her legs. Her right leg is covered with sores, oozing pus and yellow ichor.{/n}
ef5b9561-1062-4181-aed5-38c569dfb522: {n}The cultist of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} looks at you with unblinking eyes.{/n}
ca3b8bf0-ebb0-4576-948d-ee96ab17110b: {n}Kesten throws a tired look over the lodge and rubs his chin.{/n} "That's all." {n}He looks around the lodge.{/n} "We'll deal with these people as you've ordered. I suppose it'll be a relief to Dumra to get rid of such troubling guests."
e3bc00d5-604d-4e7e-8de9-67516c124507: "I thank you, Your Grace, for your help and for your wisdom. A pity we didn't discover the true reason behind the blight, but at least we have one less mystery on our hands. Have a safe journey, {mf|My Baron|My Baroness}!"
6e1ceb47-3990-4fb1-8109-f29c02759bd8: {n}The woman doesn't appear to notice you as she makes her way to the stove — you notice she's limping badly on her right leg. Before you can speak, she turns, sees you, and freezes.{/n}
5f5d5ac8-b82b-4405-a6b6-a7f97b4921ea: {n}Hearing your footsteps, the woman raises her head and looks at you.{/n} "Need something, do you?"
68de4b16-f3d4-41d8-b015-a9ad10ef3728: "Narrow-minded creatures, living by stupid human laws."
6e43d7c3-7900-414e-bd6d-326da2486454: {n}The priestess chuckles.{/n} "Of course, {mf|baron|baroness}. Let us sit here like friends and have a heart-to-heart!"
86ed23fe-462b-4938-967d-1a9379e5f6c5: {n}The priestess says nothing, her eyes filled with contempt.{/n}
ead8bc02-2988-497b-8a50-d593c58d5ac0: {n}The priestess spits at your feet. {/n} "Then {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} will enjoy the suffering of this woman to the full!" {n}Shocked, Olika steps aside and hides her face in her hands.{/n}
ae853709-5b7f-4dcb-94b6-f2b388e464d0: "You may think of me whatever you like, but I have a duty to my pack. I'll help Olika, and the child will be born as a symbol of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu's{/g} grace!"
8b440bbe-8592-4e3a-a449-c45e1d12c689: "Only if you'll change my death sentence to banishment. Let me go — in return, I'll help Olika, then after that will leave these lands forever!"
87d59ccb-368b-4373-9f64-44f0adbf9de1: "Aren't you a merry bunch!" {n}Octavia giggles, waving her finger tauntingly at the priestess.{/n} "But you know, {g|Calistria}Calistria's{/g} faithful have a lot of fun, too — just without the risk of growing a pair of tentacles in the process!"
ad65265b-7ffe-4bd2-a21b-aaff941a893a: "Don't you dare compare your frivolous goddess to ours, who's as old as the world itself! Your orgies are little more than entertainment for bored townsfolk. Ours are full of primordial wisdom!"
724a24d2-0f83-49fe-b821-f3948169dc3d: {n}Valerie winces.{/n} "Could we please skip the theological debate over which cult has better orgies?"
dd7d0680-fec6-4143-ac89-82c615778cd9: "Are you sure about that?" {n}The half-orc bares his fangs in a grin. Sparks dance along his fingers.{/n}
5239dc52-9c1f-4656-a912-24017fb8ffc3: "The culprit has confessed her crimes. It's time to announce the verdict!"
b45725c5-f146-4357-a7a9-616b1e4dc017: {n}Tsanna blinks and sweeps her eyes over you as if just noticing your presence.{/n} "Well then... It seems I shall serve the Great Mother in these lands a little longer. If you wish to speak or ask for something, come to the Shrine of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} — that is where you'll find me."

6a46ecad-d97a-4969-b492-c2cead8bd402: "Hey, Amiri! Why don't we go to a fashionable dress shop once we get to the city. I promise, we'll make a real beauty out of you!"
d8dda2ef-7ece-4faa-9b76-d38d7471ced8: "What? You want me to pull on a dress? Maybe I should start brushing my teeth too?"
a449c58c-0e41-4ef4-8412-b9ea844a3015: "Heh, Octavia, my Octavia... You said we'd get out and live! And you were right – we got out, and we're living!"
63c1def0-16e6-4310-8fa7-a77269c6ae4f: "I don't care to waste my time on this."
ccbf92e8-33ca-47d4-b266-abb4e8a28b04: "Let him speak, Jaethal. Anger will not help us learn the truth."
c4b8b56d-cdf4-4909-b98e-ef8ae2fb720e: "Jaethal, listen to reason. If Enneo was involved in your death, he wouldn't be openly offering your dagger for sale."
94905eec-ce1d-4b7a-a43e-c9087eea5982: "We will investigate this matter further. Let's start by checking Enneo's story, and seek out this unfortunate boar."
72a7baeb-dc84-4654-b746-c40004dcf199: "Where exactly did you find this carcass and dagger?"
e80ddcdb-590d-464c-9216-127938040bb9: "Enneo, you face serious accusations. Are you sure you can say nothing more in your defense?"
bd3fbcc1-daf3-4e5c-98e2-c625c43f67d0: {n}Enneo, a half-elf merchant who recently appeared in the capital, falls to the floor in front of you. Jaethal stands beside him, looking quite unlike her normal self. Usually cold and stiff, the face of the undead elf now burns with rage. Despite his nearness to his furious undead captor, Enneo looks concerned but unafraid.{/n} "If you allow me to speak, I can explain everything."
59f69e25-42de-4f0a-881b-53bcdf262dd3: "Was it poison? Magic? Illness? Whatever stole my life away, it left no trace. I thought this mystery would haunt me forever. But then I entered the shop of this half-blood... Seeking some reminder of {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}... and what did I discover there? My very own dagger!" {n} Jaethal shows you an elven-crafted dagger with a chipped blade and empty sockets, where once gemstones adorned the handle.{/n} "This dagger disappeared the same night I was taken by death. How could this half-blood have obtained it?!"
f089ac47-f94f-434b-9977-63a40155ef3e: "I hope you can, half-blood, otherwise..." {n}Jaethal hisses and turns to you.{/n} "Have I told you the sad story of my death? I stopped to rest, or perhaps I lost consciousness... When I came to my senses, I heard the call of my goddess, returning me from the dead."
eeb6677e-fd8a-4ab4-83a1-b5af331fc266: "That is why..." {n}Jaethal pauses.{/n} "Respecting your authority, I have brought this pathetic huckster here, rather than getting the truth out of him by my own methods..."
99ee69dc-ce51-4617-9c5b-1c7a1a11cac8: {n}The half-elf rises to his feet and sighs, putting his clothes in order.{/n} "Thank you for allowing me to speak, Your Grace. The story is not very exciting, certainly not as exciting as my tale of the drunken regatta within the Eye of Abendego! ... Yesterday, north of the city, I stumbled upon a dead boar. There was no one around, but the dagger was protruding from the miserable beast's neck. I don't know why the owner would have left it in the carcass. Perhaps the beast escaped from the hunter, taking along the weapon that had injured it? So I... inadvertently decided to keep the item I'd found, thanking my luck — and never suspecting the price I'd pay for it."
0ac97fd4-85ed-4d16-b989-787ce57df8b8: "You are very attentive to the troubles and needs of your faithful companions." {n}You detect poisonous notes in Jaethal's voice, but she restrains herself quickly.{/n} "Very well, let's not distract the {mf|baron|baroness}, half-blood. Let's go and talk somewhere alone!"
95b50a23-2c47-4da8-ad55-4534ca9a41a0: {n}Your words set Jaethal on her heels. She frowns, but calms down.{/n} "Perhaps that's logical. This one would have to be a useless fool to do such a thing, and useless fools do not easily survive the road. Still, his story should be verified. It must be. And in any case, the dagger may lead... to my killer."
45dd3a50-28f6-4980-8ad2-13860000293f: "In the vicinity of the Old Sycamore. Of course I'm sure you know where that tree grows. I found the boar to the west of the Sycamore, in the direction of the {g|Thorn River}Thorn River{/g}."
eac52667-c759-43e7-b6ee-a35432353c7b: {n}Jaethal bows gracefully.{/n} "I am... grateful. It's important to me. And you, half-blood, should pray for our success. If you are lying, I shall find a surer way to get the truth from you!"
804e654e-35de-4b4a-a13b-64336c62802c: "I would be glad if I could, but alas." {n}The bright yellow-green eyes of the half-elf are calm.{/n} "The dead boar is my only witness. But I believe in your justice, {mf|baron|baroness}. I have faith that you will investigate my story and sort everything out."
5e156dba-c6a2-46a6-aac0-1ceca7c7c212: "I'm fairly certain that the old man who helped us to destroy the Flower knew something of the gnomes' migration from the First World. I still can't believe he refused to give me any answers!"
ba06e12c-ed53-49ed-b78c-ca368d4aa144: "We visited another world, learned an unbelievable secret, won an unprecedented victory and brought peace to our lands. Yet still all you care about is gnomes! Gnomes! Gnomes! Gnomes!"
a5fc13ea-0ab0-404f-ab68-07bd4c25a86b: "You've seen people torn apart by monsters, from the inside out — and your reaction is to wallow in self-pity?!"
b6201f7b-7922-4ba7-be25-60907fe06538: "Searching for knowledge is as vain and futile as accumulating worldly goods."
19ed3993-d4dc-4744-a95e-0202ab448fc2: "You think you're a hero? I think you're a common villain... And not the most dangerous I've dispatched."
3c5680d1-55e6-4bbc-9971-001aeca8d0d5: "Irovetti, what are you babbling on about? What hero, what villain? You're dead! You're not really here!"
f49c6103-617d-4832-bc5b-1f7ca8c1f6ca: "I don't have time for your nonsense. Ready your weapon!"
cb912064-23da-4e46-9bfb-cb67ba445982: "There you are. Of course. After all, you couldn't miss it. A mimic cannot exist without a model, nor a villain without a hero. You don't have your own journey, or your own story, for you are merely a chapter in my epic. Without me you simply do not exist!"
d5051933-1ded-4055-b24f-b73a6e119712: "Do you remember when we last met you said you'd rule my lands..." {n}Irovetti says in a mocking voice,{/n} "'for the good of your subjects, wisely and fairly'? b752dbf2-d835-47db-aaaf-a9c24c77a9dd: "Do you remember – when we last met, you said you'd return {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} to its citizens? It sounded so noble! But in the end my possessions are returned to me – both Pitax and the toady fairy! Your governor is now my foot-rest. And as for you – it's time you go to oblivion, where you belong!"
27644773-56d6-43ce-900b-a3c2dfc47ba6: "Do you remember when we last met? Remember how you threatened to consign all memory of me to oblivion? How daring you were, how arrogant – and how stupid! {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} is mine once more. The toady fairy serves me again. Your governor is my foot-rest. And you – what poetic irony! You've once again come here, for me to send you to oblivion where you belong!"
bfaadfc3-bf46-4355-bced-7b60613bef8a: "Do you remember when we last met? Remember how you promised to make things so rough for my subjects that they would remember me as a benefactor? You shouldn't have said this, for the one great law of this world is the law of poetic irony! Now their benefactor has returned, and your subjects curse you. The toady fairy serves me again. 8c09e14d-8425-4e59-b37f-d4af59b40501: "And what do you think Irovetti is? A sack of skin filled with bones and guts, that once decorated this room so beautifully? Of course not! Irovetti is a legend! And the legend has returned, in all his glory!"
5c9fc703-93ec-4a7b-8f25-5208f8fb292c: "Everyone thinks they are the hero of their own story, and all the others but a crowd. But do you know what makes us different? Your story is a poor joke that's gone on for far too long. Mine is a legend for the ages!"
dddb190d-5295-401e-b052-2f0ce16a5811: "Really. Why do I waste words on someone who will never understand?"
ce300bb6-4ea7-4d94-9f9a-37aff7067aaf: "Look around! I am everything I was, and all that I could be! All the legends composed about me. My glory was too great to fit into one body. Here is Irovetti – wise ruler, Irovetti – invincible warrior, Irovetti – cunning trickster, Irovetti – sacred champion of Calistria... And who are you? No one and nothing. A minor prop I will use to demonstrate my grandeur to the audience!"
dc2509c2-a6a2-49d6-ac82-846882654826: "Well, let us begin! It's time for you to become a part of my history!"
3720a1fe-c8c3-4de8-aa3b-2254e7cafb62: {n}'Maegar' stares at you without blinking, his face like stone.{/n} "You've kept me waiting. In so doing, you disrespect me. And…" {n}Vordakai gives a disgusted hiss.{/n} "I can feel this flesh slowly dying even as I wait."
ae6e556b-2d51-446f-a15e-2c95100eb7f3: {n}Vordakai's eyes snap open.{/n} "So you decided to set them free." {n}He frowns.{/n} "Wasteful — your kind breeds quickly, their numbers would have been restored in short order."
129c616a-92e9-4e14-9921-99751c7de503: {n}Vordakai's eyes slowly open.{/n} "So you've decided to keep the jars for your own needs." {n}He nods.{/n} "Wise. My work on capturing these souls is far more valuable than the lives within."
2b6da160-0eed-4f4e-b643-8dbcbf7555eb: "I shall be your honored guest." {n}Vordakai's face twists — in what might be a grin, but you're not sure.{/n} "There, I will study your habits, your books, absorb all I need... but do not fear, you and your barony shall remain untouched." {n}He stares at you for a moment.{/n} "For now. 3a978ca5-15ac-416a-8625-733d1fd7c8d7: "Foul. Where are they...?"
1069b12a-ce78-4623-b5bf-e1e052b3a457: "As for me, I shall assume the role of this..." {n}He raises his hands, and his face curls with contempt.{/n} "...this '{d|Varn}Maegar{/d},' the upstart ruler of {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}." {n}He turns to lock eyes with you, and his voice grows colder, sharper.{/n} "But know that my ambition is greater than one settlement — I'll be with you, in your citadel, as befits my station."
9fddac59-0263-4d64-bcdb-5f00d6fac398: "Tell me about your past. Where did you grow up, what kind of childhood did you have?"
26b24cac-0f28-45ec-9157-a02bb2c6bc10: "It's all in my autobiography. Look it up in the library. It's in the 'Jubilost' section."
b801a771-2417-496d-b192-2ef044922343: "I heard that somewhere, in other lands, there live kobolds with golden scales."
8a1c31a7-ea09-4193-9c8b-b769cadf56fe: "Gold, blue, red... who cares? They are all the same: little gutless beasts!"
72324406-757d-4468-b3fb-8ec71c0644fa: "Golden kobolds? Could they be distant relatives of golden dragons? What do you think?"
f5abf655-e342-41ca-a376-74045ce141e8: "You know, just because you heard it in a song... you know... You can't trust all the bards, Ekun. Some of us get carried away and just say whatever sounds good. But of course I myself always mind what I write!"
cf012b5f-1ffe-4403-a994-fbc24da1e2f9: "The miracles they recount in distant lands... The farther the land is, the more amazing its wonders!"
bec518a4-2222-4c14-8683-2810629c105a: "The miracles they recount in distant lands... The farther the land is, the more amazing its wonders!"
3d71aad8-781b-4319-a53e-33fd12039e77: "I was careless. — And those jackals made me pay for it. But we made them pay more dearly!"
79aaf8d9-c175-4dad-8eff-643545cb3b16: "You call that 'carelessness'? I call it 'outright foolishness!'"
c17140fe-7a1d-49ee-855b-265025c44414: "Heh, I wish I was born in a noble family. Servants to lick my boots and bring me breakfast in bed. Not like in my tribe. They wake you up with a kick, and hustle you to cook for them – the stinking goats!"
985c7d02-d0e7-4b20-8b96-82a72d8c603a: "I bet your time among nobility would be even shorter than mine. You'd jump up the moment you were trying on your third dress, or drinking tea with your auntie. You'd trash the place and run into the forest!"
16e6dec6-878c-4bc6-90d0-4baf5d3daa32: "You are like Linzee. Also stick your nose in a book. Still better than halfshank."
8141c4e7-1448-4031-989c-b5434ebbbdb6: "Hey! Don't talk of Linzi like that! Can't stay quiet about her… you are not in love with her, are you?"
8b2fec88-1077-4519-90d0-76093df4b27a: "But then who would take revenge? I'll take revenge for as long as I live."
4a92509e-2530-40ec-a782-6ae3569277b4: "You don't look well. Go get some rest."
67eb06cb-0d58-46fa-b3ea-1d5be4f482a4: "Get out of here immediately! I can't afford to have you infecting our guests!"
940e6fa6-c084-436e-9218-c73074562329: "How about we play a prank on our guests? I want you to sneeze on those pompous Aldori over there!"
dfc2469d-2e7f-4ce1-af0f-86754359621a: {n}The servant doesn't look well — his eyes are bloodshot and his cheeks are flushed. As soon as he notices your attention, he straightens himself and gives you a strained smile.{/n}
5b6557cb-ffa0-49a0-906d-be39f4a3c200: "Oh, it's nothing, Your Grace! Just a bit of a cold I caught on the way here, that's all. It'll pass soon, don't worry!"
b41bffc1-4315-4c7f-8f1b-0b223b06dbe4: "My thanks, Your Grace! You're too kind."
21806289-6ae5-4720-b523-3635dce9a87b: "Of course, Your Grace! I'm so sorry! I'll leave immediately!"
5bef5c6b-f699-4344-9d45-a64c4c2ee6e1: {n}The servant forces a smile.{/n} "As you wish, Your Grace. I'll do my best!"
712014c4-18fb-4023-8cff-c9937a824719: "Are you sure? You look quite unwell."
f2fada72-8bd1-4b06-8811-60d97753871b: "Worry not, sir. Just pray for me, and I'll weather it. We're hardy folk here, you know!"
67990f4c-ce61-4e04-8f0b-142def25805b: "Yes... Even here, at a celebration of life, there is someone to remind us all of the inevitable..."
dd1ef2f0-e1d9-4853-aaa0-1ea7cbd6b2f1: "Heh heh, I'd love to see the looks on their faces! I hope the poor fellow gets well soon, though."
48ffbf7c-95e3-4ca1-a750-81bb0d820d2d: "Our kingdom and our very lives are hanging by a thread. Let's postpone the wedding until the victory!"
ad446af1-7743-4184-a6c8-ca90a436da55: "I have no idea what I'd do without you."
5f97d5f6-f763-4536-8ff6-38a5305280d4: "It's not difficult to perform a miracle if you have somebody to do it for!"
0d21cd6c-1e3d-43e0-8ea4-372ac9670072: "I love you, but I don't want a wedding. There's no ritual that could make us closer than we already are."
efc9655e-28aa-4556-9b7d-90513557012e: {n}Tonight Octavia and Regongar are especially passionate. When everything is over, the three of you lay there for a while, holding each other and panting, unable to let go.{/n}
f4b2b620-22d3-4278-81ec-bc4af3c825b3: "It's a miracle we're together. Everything was against us, but here we are. Alive... And even happy!"
239de4bd-8e0c-4fc7-ab99-3cf3954a61a0: "{Name} is a miracle. Who else could gather such a team of pariahs, exiles and outcasts? And not just gather, but give each of them a new home and another chance?"
eefa1e1b-a679-494d-a09e-d6de4842d1f3: "That's so true. Listen..." {n}A wild sparkle lights up Octavia's eyes.{/n} "I'm going to say something, just don't laugh. Let's... get married! All three of us! {Name}, you're the {mf|King|Queen} — who's going to stop you?"
618bc16f-6dbf-4d20-8999-18920b1f347f: "Are you serious? You've always been against all that sort of..." {n}Regongar waves his hand.{/n} "What about your freedom?"
1a346344-6eca-4ad9-bf89-89e6024cb189: {n}Octavia shrugs.{/n} "Maybe I've grown up a little. Or maybe I just learned to tell the difference between dangerous strangers threatening my freedom, and the people I love. I've said a lot of harsh things to both of you. I was afraid of everything in the world, even you. But now I'm not. Now I realize that we can only really be free when we're together."
c7bb8c7a-947c-4d67-8e99-c9226fd8b2e7: "Deal! Now we have another reason to win no matter what it takes!"
2fb81737-57c6-40ce-889f-3fe17c4fd0ae: "You're right. A ritual won't change anything. We're together — and that can never be changed."
3f67dd3c-ce30-4f7a-85c2-ce12f009b146: "Yes. Now there's only one thing left to do — face the powers of this world and another, and tear them all to pieces. People, monsters, fey, gods — doesn't matter. Everyone who wants to take away our future. And then…"
855c3c1b-5280-4366-b509-a667997c0340: {n}The half-orc smiles.{/n} "Then there will be just the three of us."
99b44167-8859-4591-90da-9818cd6f8d3d: "So we really met for a reason. The gods aren't good for much, of course, but sometimes they send gifts... Like the three of us to each other."
32e36fe6-9a9c-4109-94f5-0890a9fb3f4b: "That's true. Fugitives and outcasts like us should love each other and do miracles for one another. Who else would do anything for us?"
211d10e3-f727-4e6a-b165-76455745fdc3: {n}Near Armag's tent, Amiri spots a familiar figure clad in a gray cloak. The Sister stands over Nilak, who's bound and helpless. A dagger gleams faintly in the Sister's hand.{/n}
9215a6e4-f153-4a46-bb9b-8cb1f6949eb1: {n}A dense red fog clouds Amiri's eyes as a roar of anger bursts from her chest. Her body rushes forward, seemingly of its own accord. Her head is empty but for a single ringing thought — kill. Kill. KILL!{/n}
ad2d623f-5164-47f2-af33-925c220d431a: {n}Dugath sits nearby — with his hands and legs tied up and his mouth gagged, he stares at the witch with eyes full of hate.{/n}
ca624a83-a4d8-42ab-949b-73c5ae0a6a0a: [Attack] "You look like you're at death's door. Let me give you a little push."
bd56668d-51f5-44d6-84a9-8c2a679eb116: "I won't distract you from your woes."
06c5ad8e-9aa1-4cca-9d25-5799a9b8d909: {n}An elderly half-orc looks at you without any friendliness. 2897e0d7-3905-41dd-b614-2c02f1a2dbb6: {n}The half-orc harrumphs brashly in response, but his eyes seem disappointed.{/n}
31556871-e14c-47ae-933d-143af7fe9e4d: "What happened... It was a calamity! I was going about my business, and then I fell ill. Cut down by a fever. I'd been burning up for three weeks. Took everything I had as payment – even my precious work tools, the last of my treasures!"
b565b401-691f-4af2-8040-ac99f22020e2: "I'm useless like this. What good am I to anyone? But if I got my tools back I'd be quite all right! I used to make such weapons and armor – they sold faster than I could make them. But without my tools I'm useless. If you tried to use a regular hammer to forge like I do, you'd just ruin a good thing. I'd bend the tongs, and wouldn't make anything worth putting my name to. That trickster got everything I need!"
f5618bf3-f531-4e33-8aec-e577fe154fc4: {n}Varrask looks at you with eyes full of despair and clenches his huge fists.{/n} "Old Varrask is listening. What are we going to talk about?"
34571bdd-ecbd-4dbf-89ec-c1c9b746481d: {n}The half-orc touches the tools tenderly, as if he can't believe his eyes, and then clutches them as tightly as he can.{/n} "Can I have them back? Really? 29274436-1889-4d4d-9c31-4b83335e74d9: "Varrask. Varrask the Wildfist, they call me. I was once an armor and weapons maker. I'm more of a corpse than a master now. Some evil people took everything from me. My family, my house, my craft... Even took my tools. Everything."
6bae574a-4068-4313-9dd6-4ab4d0d0f470: {n}The half-orc pierces you with his angry eyes.{/n} "Listen, I can tell you got money... maybe you need an armorer? If you help me, I'll serve you. I'll make formidable weapons for you! Ones that just beg for enemy blood! But first I need my tools back."
4b5bbf21-9819-4260-bb95-46de3bcebdd9: "I helped you. What about the reward?"
a46165ce-2da5-4514-9f42-f63ca2c6bc46: "I'll take you down if you pay me."
3995bb7e-dd44-4938-9247-01bc8301d72b: [Collapse the tower] "Why should I help you down? I'd prefer to watch you fly!"
c1428fe3-1263-47ea-8346-9fb7e425f489: "Ha-ha, that's spectacular! I'll leave everything as it is, I don't want to ruin such a beauty!"
0a49d144-f503-4fcd-ba0c-bee7942f116f: "Wait a bit, I have to think about it."
c9256816-d0f3-43cf-8ec7-96337b399f3b: "I'll give you a chance to think it all over and to give me the right answer. Where. Is. My. Money?"
5cb1b579-be9a-4ed0-a716-c6b73721e090: "Where can I find the fey who did this?"
e4fda6d4-d0c8-4948-885c-c176bfcd3cf9: "So how did they call this tower, Tamrath?"
a4c7f022-caa3-49ea-9971-10b82d666544: {n}A stout middle-aged man is fighting to keep his balance on top of the creaking tower. He's terrified and sweat is running down his face, so much so it's soaked his shirt through.{/n} "For the sake of all gods, take me down before I break my neck!"
358187a4-0adb-4f0d-88b0-9065e58520e7: "I'm Tamrath, a paint vendor! I'll be happy to tell you the story of my life after you help me down!"
2cbc861c-af46-4faf-ae3e-d2ff02fc4d30: "Damned fey and their pranks, that's what happened! They sprang from the woods, hexed my horse and cart, killed my coachman, stole my paints, then put me up here…"
311b998a-93ad-402e-a0ae-03be8c9a214c: "Garland just couldn't stop rearing, he was so scared. And Avim couldn't take it anymore... he loved Garland so much." {n}The vendor is silent for a moment, his face pained.{/n} "Avim, oh Avim, we've been through so much together…"

d97dee85-3f9d-4782-890b-03df1736a304: {n}Kanerah bites her lip, then nods.{/n} "The Herald is right. Whatever you may think, I can't accept that my patron and my only sister would use me as living bait. I still have nightmares about the soul eater – about how it killed me the first time. 7a051ebc-cf87-49fd-ac37-6434af972f74: {n}Kalikke takes a deep breath.{/n} "You are right, wise Herald. I cannot forget my friends. Naiho, Tevi and Elki... 53ab4b64-af36-44c2-a813-c9d1778e8097: "Really? And how do you intend to stop me, when even the god's Herald confirms the right of my claims. – And even the one you would protect refuses your patronage?"
153b5e3e-fb9a-45c2-a49e-514dd56317ec: "I wanted to change your fate. But I guess I couldn't. There is nothing for me to do here... and maybe I shouldn't have interfered in the first place."
1dec50ab-7062-4af7-80d2-f5ee489f7968: {n}A storm troubles Kalikke's eyes.{/n} "You want me to become colder and more calculating? I guess it's time for me to grow up..."
71a87f21-ee2d-4aed-b7a7-917025cb7218: "Do you really think mere words can make me forget the deaths of my friends? I have kept quiet about my grief for too long..."
85c6b741-ffdf-4758-9c3f-047b79275651: {n}Kanerah looks at her sister and back at you with almost childish despair.{/n} "You're really serious, aren't you?"
4b52d5d5-3f17-42a9-922a-ae6560074a70: {n}Kanerah makes a wry face.{/n} "Go to Hell and take your condescension with you!"
228c35ac-3e02-465d-84cd-dcc954562300: "It's amazing you didn't suggest that I'd happily feed myself to the soul eater! Anyway, that's almost exactly what I'm going to do. Auferon, I am yours. I will join you in Hell. This is my decision."
e5e5b776-1818-4e45-8324-f174828cb684: "So what am I supposed to do? I'm not allowed to bear a grudge? Ha! Fine, fine, Kanerah is evil and heartless, and Kanerah will try to be better. Satisfied?"
6f6332b7-0a8c-4809-b98c-5ff66916590b: "...Grow up and understand how the world really works. I can see it now – this place is no different than Hell. Evil and deviousness rule here as well. 724df508-bb45-4d75-9d65-22501d4beef5: "I must accept this bitter world as it is, and not as I've imagined it to be in my dreams. Very well – you convinced me. I will try to change for you. Perhaps my heart will hurt less this way..."
34d270b6-b32d-439a-9640-4521ea5413b0: "No! That's not how I wanted things... I thought you'd understand... and then..."
d66564e6-0d80-48d1-9a0b-466027051c10: {n}The Forefather holds his prey tightly by her hand, then looks at her sister.{/n} "This is called 'accountability', you foolish child. d11ff1f3-e986-4c3c-a046-78c017d05ea6: "This chapter ends in sadness... But I will not stand against a decision made freely. You have given me so many new thoughts, so many ideas. It's enough for an age or two of contemplation."
12dc6822-63bc-4b24-a5ff-59ba40316775: {n}He looks at you.{/n} "Sooner or later, the kingdom of Asmodeus will collect your souls as well. But for now – farewell!"
4e7199d5-27ce-4f26-9ccf-71a0edb81ac2: {n}You sense a note of approval or even respect in the Arcanotheign's otherworldly voice.{/n} "This universe is built so intricately... ee7face0-1bae-4e8c-a3ca-42b0e1a4dcde: "More amazing still is that my lord and creator momentarily turned his gaze upon you. Nethys does not speak to his followers directly, nor reward their efforts or punish their negligence. But there is nothing to prevent me from presenting you with a token of thanks, for the insights into human nature which you have given me. 1490d02a-6ed9-430c-8a07-3a4edea15d3e: "Thank you, Herald. For this gift and for the new chance we've received."
4f76ae61-06c9-4f5d-a36e-16947a9fcd42: "It's not enough to receive a gift. What matters is how you use it... But nonetheless – thank you!"
4abbdd58-6a6b-4cf5-9516-2fbeac2079bf: "You gave me a chance to end this story for my own benefit. Now that the Herald has ceased her meddling..."
668d9328-68f3-49f9-9f8c-5fb466412a58: "I too will excuse myself. Many interesting things are happening here. I would stay and watch, but I do not wish to interfere any longer. All that happens next is your story and yours alone. Farewell!"
bf6bb465-da78-4804-a170-8efebbdc1a1b: "But you're already having so much fun here, and I have no wish to interfere. Farewell!"
94e8c54c-057e-4c4c-8fa4-888fc1ae1197: "I doubt your kingdom will exist for much longer, so there is no sense in my return. Farewell!"
556fda24-3444-4336-a672-b64805dc1158: {n}Kanerah folds her arms on her chest.{/n} "It is as I expected. My sister and you are two peas in a pod. But you know what? I'm not mad at you."
3d9700db-5678-411f-b840-7cd02ead04ad: {n}Kalikke listens to you silently, nods, then turns to the Forefather and says abruptly,{/n} "Take me, devil."
f6f18e27-7482-4a6d-8cc1-97e0f89b1762: "Everyone must choose their own friends and patrons. I simply don't belong in this friendly gang. A good thing I've received an alternative proposal... Forefather, I'm ready to go with you. Of course, we must discuss the terms of our new contract in detail..."
704c8de2-44bd-4384-9566-900f0ad3ff74: "No! You silly goat! What's got into your head?"
9354c026-129c-490d-9d8a-180ec3ac7ecc: "I just want to get this over with. You are good here, Kanerah. You and {name} have found a common purpose. But I don't belong here, as everyone can see. As for you... be happy, sister."
86a33d0a-35a1-4b27-90e3-bf0ca40b043a: "And on that splendid note, if you'll excuse me. – This miserable piece of land will soon fall anyway!"
bebc1a3c-3595-4175-a7a1-f393059cc633: "However, you and {name} made me happy... first there, at the barrens with the soul eater. And now here, dashing the illusions of poor Kalikke so ruthlessly. How can I leave such a delicious act of indifference and evil without granting you a suitable reward? Accept this gift. And farewell – for now..."
9a020cee-b3a5-41bd-ab39-a8c680388aeb: "Strange, why do I feel so lost? There is nothing else for me to do here. My help led to nothing good... and it's folly to hope it might."
becfb0b7-bd07-46ef-8016-86237d20823c: "I can't believe it, {name}! You managed to force some reason into my silly sister's head!"
1ebb6a9e-c84f-4d09-914e-c355af40de75: "How presumptuous. But it only means that I'll get not one, but an entire bouquet of souls..."
66afecb4-6eb2-494a-90d0-804b428afe0c: "There's nothing else for me to do here. What did my help lead to? This does not seem like balance and peace... Perhaps I should not have interfered in the business of mortals..."
8f076e38-05c6-4f0f-8d73-23d396025ff9: "...Anyway, why don't I go there? The Forefather's company obviously suits me better than yours!"
5c7ccf14-32b8-423d-8dc2-0a4948568af0: {n}Kalikke turns her pale face to the devil.{/n} "Take me, Forefather. I don't belong here any more."
54afb73f-dd97-42d1-9db9-2ff2f807ef0c: "Such moving unanimity." {n}The devil can barely conceal the venom in his voice.{/n} "It appears that I should not even consider reclaiming my stolen property. Surely I shouldn't argue with the Herald of the most unpredictable god... And so, if you will excuse me..."
bb8a7184-1a8d-418e-aa2f-36a2507c303c: "Better you should consider whether you'll have anything to offer in return. Considering the state of your kingdom, I am very much doubtful."
1c476e92-2e12-45f2-bfb9-06502c8b7e33: "That's not a wise decision... but fine! Forgive me, great-grandfather, but our dealings are done."
5e263d14-8c2e-4c12-9c40-ae463e360100: "Yes. We are together now, and there is no longer anything you can do to harm us!"
2ccf547b-3053-45dd-b7fe-efaa8cb41572: {n}The Arcanotheign tilts her head, as if curious.{/n} "You are an interesting creature, {name}. You venerate the god of magic without wielding it yourself."
c672a328-cc1d-4c68-bf65-43437c646049: "Learning new things is priceless. I understand you all too well. Good luck to you in your journey!"
66f0c5f4-ccb7-4045-9fac-d265000e300d: "You don't wield the power yourself, but you help others develop it? This is most worthy. To increase magical knowledge in any way is our goal and our reward."
0b22fc1a-e7f9-4d44-a943-fd0024d75d09: "My lord and creator pays no heed to the prayers of those who are not bestowed with magic. You know you will enjoy no profit from this faith, yet still you choose it by your heart's bidding. Interesting. I enjoy contemplating such intricacies..."
62e5b836-8af7-4b40-bdfc-77174c6751f8: "Nothing would please me more!" {n}You hear honest joy in the Arcanotheign's voice.{/n} "But it is time we must finish what we have gathered here for. How else could you have seen such magic phenomena? Where else could you truly test your knowledge and power?"
255409f8-e10b-4148-aa9c-6e4297dd61f7: "It's too late, you fool. And do you know what? We'll be better off apart. I'm sure I will find a place for myself in Hell. And you will stay here, saving silly outcasts who stumble into trouble, and write your poems and live as you like..."
b81e667b-8f79-4a90-b2cb-5354084e13cd: "I don't think so," {n}the tiefling says harshly.{/n}
21c08440-c2eb-401e-b8e7-64a2285e084c: "Nor do I. Allow them to part now, before there's even greater trouble."
d7700908-d16e-4a56-8efb-5a193d6a12cc: {n}Kanerah hugs her sobbing sister.{/n} "Don't cry, you silly goat. This has been a long time coming. And it ended the only way it could."
0f9265c3-f944-4fc5-9bc6-c1f9401cb6a2: "It's so hard to understand you mortals... or perhaps you simply don't understand yourself? Soon enough you will sigh in relief, Kalikke. ab998a0a-e9e4-42c8-982a-ed34fe63eb87: "Don't try to stop me, {name}. It's too late – besides, you made this decision when you fed the Sweet Teeth to the soul eater."
86b1bbd1-5521-4fc1-a7aa-f79ec7b1e042: "You and your silly impulses again! Don't... don't sacrifice yourself, Kalikke!"
24cac968-f4b6-461e-afb5-2814422051b3: "She does what her nature tells her to do. As do you all. Alas, now I see – a god can reconcile internal opposites. But mortal souls cannot withstand such strain..."
444b1429-1a60-4176-95fc-8f96c3beaafc: {n}Kalikke takes a step, touches her sister's cheek for a moment, warmly and wistfully, then turns to the devil.{/n} "I'm ready."
ada531cd-0c5d-400b-99ed-e0ad590596c1: "Such a moving scene. I'm sorry to leave you here, Kanerah, on this piece of land soon to be devoured by chaos, already nearly consumed by the First World. ab6d91e9-318d-4c2e-96ef-1184e6f751f1: "No – never! You can't just give her away!"
ed385098-ce4d-4f7f-a397-05ca810afaab: "Wonderful. A claimant to my property removed themselves from the argument. But strange as it may be, I'm not going to remove myself. And I guess I'm going to get an entire bouquet of souls instead of just one..."
945dd470-a993-430d-9fdc-e334ee109571: "Come on, you silly goat. You can't defeat the Forefather, and the Lantern King is drawing near. The kingdom is all but destroyed – there's trouble everywhere... Don't worry, I'll be right at home in Hell!" {n}Kanerah chuckles boldly.{/n}
e63d7112-9573-4015-8753-46c269d9f204: "It will be better this way, sister. It will be better. You cannot defeat the Forefather in battle, and the Arcanotheign no longer protects us. The people of this kingdom and {name} must not be made to suffer because of us. Let Hell take me..."
6db12d4b-236e-440b-8dc7-22b43b0bddbc: "I must say – those who stay in this wasteland to be torn apart by the First World, I do not fancy their chances. Let us go now, child. Many interesting things await..."
0e372245-f2ea-48ef-8571-7592b1ec4574: "There's no way out, and everyone is unhappy. I couldn't have imagined a better ending myself. Let us go now, child. Hell awaits!"
728ad46b-8779-42fd-9c03-82d081b65df5: "Oh, I don't mind sparing the world of this scumbag. But why did you only decide to do it now, {name}? After letting him kill my friends, being a part of this..."
e64ea9e9-5512-400d-b87a-a4805397643b: "I see you like leaping into battle without much thinking. It's a pity neither you or Kalikke think your actions through, risking those who don't deserve it!"
7dbc2255-a1b9-4d3f-ada7-88d65923f32e: "No more tears! As if it was better to feed me to the soul eater!"
f23a5c65-027a-432c-9136-5138439f777d: "Kanerah, please, enough. You survived the fight with the soul eater, everything ended well. And now it will too!"
00c429ac-6649-48e5-92ac-00c953f79836: "Kalikke is just whining, like usual! She'll cry for a while, but the tears will dry. Stop manipulating her, Forefather."
1e55fa08-c1d7-4b7f-a896-0ec16f965660: "Hell no! Kanerah will understand that we did everything right, if you would just stop manipulating her, you devil!"
d9c203f8-7269-46f8-bad4-33aca9d99141: ...to the greenish portal leading to Lamashtu's shrine.
be02a6fc-b2a4-4da9-91c8-f960abbd8f28: ...to the bluish portal leading to Varnhold.
4650f99d-3b00-4f74-8583-4e2bcdcf730e: ...to the shining portal leading to Oleg's Trading Post.
607d02f0-0851-4204-b763-dbd66ca7bd76: ...to the purplish portal leading to the depths of Trobold.
6a9662ed-1447-4897-b212-bc693c2b4bea: ...to the silver portal leading to Irovetti's palace in the heart of Pitax.
6d5922f9-1616-45be-ac95-7752a385db04: ...to the reddish portal leading to the Rostland borderlands.
a773a62e-325e-410f-afcd-ffeab1248aa2: ...to the golden portal leading back to the capital.
2fa24881-93de-4de8-bbee-f077275cfe39: ...to the whitish portal leading to the Everblooming Flower Cradle.
a93b375f-426a-4db0-8cfd-898b1bc6ce9e: ...away from the portals of the First World.
efc7f16a-6c00-46d7-8226-bbc117136242: … to the black and white portal leading to Sorrowflow.
5d0bb833-d5ea-4364-9cf7-39fa57ea2b42: Traveling through a kingdom that's been half "swallowed" by the {g|First World}First World{/g} is a dangerous, unpredictable affair, but our hero{mf||ine} didn't have much choice — {mf||s}he had to save {mf|his|her} lands (or at least what was left of them!) as quickly as possible. 4042e92a-ae0a-408a-a98d-33f79247b568: Summoning all {mf|his|her} courage, {name} took a daring step...
6409b39f-5694-4311-9cf2-62e56780b2f8: Sadly, the vicious {g|LanternKing}Lantern King{/g}'s curse placed a heavy burden on our leader's shoulders. And yet, even barely standing, {name} wouldn't abandon {mf|his|her} duty!
224b608e-e02f-429c-be10-e175b0be1de5: After defeating several enemies, our leader felt a surge of energy — the curse was growing weaker! If we could manage to help a few more allies out of trouble, maybe it would be possible to eliminate the curse entirely!

a6451be4-aa69-4bd8-b32d-175970ce8db5: The journey to the capital was uneventful — well, as uneventful as possible when you're traveling through the {g|First World}First World{/g}! Luckily avoiding encounters with otherworldly monsters or becoming lost along treacherous paths in another reality, {name} found a suitable portal and was soon standing at the entrance to the capital!
609a1c21-2c97-46c8-a878-f66283ed0d7a: [Attack] "Verdict? I only wanted one thing: to lure you all to one place! Now you're all going to die!"
705cecc6-8a6e-4a81-8ea8-14a7080a508b: {n}The masters of the Suramgamin Order silently watch you approach. Beside the four masters you know, you see a fifth – a nondescript halfling woman in a modest robe.{/n}
704719bc-88bc-4e76-834e-5c18be0aa3b7: "Your Highness, we meet again. Allow me to introduce to you the fifth master whose test you faced. Daksha the Chameleon watched you from afar, and has drawn her own conclusions about how you approached our tests."
8407738b-6a6a-472c-a2f3-e845991fd7a5: "We are ready to announce our verdict. Are you ready to hear it?"
15ce1444-a56e-4b06-adf5-f5e2d1d6ea7b: "All right. I have tested {mf|His|Her} Highness and I testify: {mf|he|she} is worthy."
244dd9a2-23ee-4237-b2e7-a90845d2acdd: "All right. I have tested {mf|His|Her} Highness and I testify: {mf|he|she} is not worthy."
957da980-f0a7-447c-b6b9-60bd1a4fc38d: "The majority of masters agree. Your Highness, we find you worthy of our aid, and would offer you the title of Protector of the Wise Way. Will you accept it?"
8cbda03d-394c-4f17-aeb3-1a00713599e4: "Alas, Your Highness. We cannot trust you. The risk is too great that you wouldn't be able to use our gifts, and would only harm yourself and others."
b8b9b6c1-491b-4cbd-9ccc-487d195dae62: "What devious guile... We were ready for this, Your Highness. If that is your will – we shall leave your lands and bother you no further. But first allow us to say: you spoke to us, listened to our sermons and passed our trials. The seed of good may yet sprout in your soul. If ever you step away from evil and set foot upon the Wise Way – we shall accept you with open arms."
6743c16e-6a15-48a7-8202-fba3fb827be7: {n}The masters of the Suramgamin Order leave solemnly.{/n}
a847c3b2-de9e-44aa-a3c0-4c5ed32a94cc: "Such unanimity is rare among us. Your Highness, we find you worthy of our aid, and would grant you the title of Protector of the Wise Way. Will you accept it?"
e39a9362-f87c-4a8d-8d7d-f2564320756b: "Nevertheless, please allow me to present you with one gift – the word of truth. We have long meditated, seeking knowledge of the power that opens portals. Here is what was revealed to us. The one you've been fighting since the day you set foot in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}, she is not only the fountain of evil, but its greatest victim. As she prepares to sting you with her dagger, a sword hangs above her head, in the hands of another. It is in your power to save her – if you would brave the wrath of those who could make even her tremble."
bc8fc168-15ff-421f-8f95-c8c339baee70: "Lo and behold: you managed to deceive us all. Five masters found you worthy – yet all this time you harbored guile in your soul! Thank you, Your Highness. This is a valuable lesson for each of us. Allow us to thank you for it."
9303497f-b7c9-4e4b-ac60-7afebe53e166: "Accept our second gift as well. Alas, this world is full of evil and hatred, and you shall have to engage in battle and shed blood more than once. With an easy heart we present you this item that will guard your life."
e047b86b-627e-4dc7-8f81-5978b7b0df68: "And now it is time for us to depart your lands. Goodbye, Your Highness, and may your way be always wise."
eec9e064-e036-4a10-9c15-a4c73e785bf5: "We present this to the traces of good that live on in your soul. To that part of you, which your evil side hides behind like a mask. May this item guard your life in battle, and in time free your good side from the fetters of evil."
d88f8e70-97c8-4690-bebd-60ee4154e3d2: "Regarding your evil side – the one that still reigns in your soul, as you yourself reign your lands... We present to it this item – as disfigured as itself. Think upon this gift, and remember: so long as you live, hope is not lost. If ever you decide to reject evil and accept truth – you know where to find us."
4b8d4349-76f6-45fc-bfae-7af0299d6901: "And now farewell. No matter what crooked path you walk, I pray that one day you shall set foot on the Wise Way."
8b416140-e86c-4e6c-943d-e2c327688b05: "Lo and behold: you nearly managed to deceive all of us. We tested you and found you worthy – yet all this time you harbored guile in your soul! Thank you, Your Highness. This is a valuable lesson for all of us. Allow us to thank you for it."
df52ab9f-87e8-4525-9f96-a2abce021daa: "Of course. Show me any order or organization that would not be happy to take a real king or queen into their fold."
02b9ad50-352a-444c-a454-7503691d06f1: "Listen, Octavia. Where you're from, do they also treat women like garbage?"
71771c4b-5cce-465b-821c-67c423c759d6: "I don't remember my home too well. But in Numeria where I grew up, they treated everyone like dirt, men and women alike. I don't even know which one's worse."
53454141-f3e9-40fa-b21f-4c80e552e15d: "The crushing defeat of the bandit king and his countless forces! A mighty troll empire invading the kobolds. Disease. Conquering half of the world — and now this... I won't even have to make anything up!"
3bb5a3bc-380a-4263-91db-948ee4f52865: "I will never understand how danger and death make for entertainment."
5c69addb-eb64-4bec-ba56-16c62c1b2e51: "Romantic maximalism and vulgar hyperbole are stock and trade of amateurs and graphomaniacs. Oh, who am I talking to... no one here even understands these words..."
fd1c3a3c-f634-4bc3-8b9d-2927298f2399: "Sometimes even I can scarcely believe that so many exciting things can happen to the same people in such a short time! Imagine the readers of your book..."
8e3813fa-f27d-4088-b243-714122fc7715: "Better just make up. Don't write about us. Me ever."
2fe87cb1-c6ab-4251-b306-b1560a6f68c4: "Làm thêm một lần nữa ngay bây giờ nhé?"

c550f73c-8738-43d3-920d-65968aa8d2c0: "They are armed and prepared to shed blood. You call this a petty squabble? If so, when do you suggest we intervene? When the corpse pile numbers one hundred? Or should we wait for a hundred more?"

e62b3c2d-945b-418a-a412-321d48b272f7: "I can't believe a hedonist like you doesn't have some other joys in life besides battle."
e4d09a76-87e8-4348-9006-3eac73a49cbe: "You know, it hurts me to hear this. What does war have to do with anything? First of all you're my friend and lover."
1cabd57f-66b9-4518-9f5a-ac8a5a3bc7d2: "You think we'll have nothing to do without war? For a start we'll stay in bed for a month! Then maybe we'll think of something!"
8fd97339-d6b4-4832-8c5c-7939f5762a5c: "If you keep asking dumb questions, maybe I'll start thinking about it."
2826ff92-ebef-40e8-8e38-08a980daf958: "I love you. And I'll never leave you."
2e17ddd4-8cb0-43dc-baab-f0ec75ab03b2: "If any more bad thoughts bother you at night, wake me up right away. I'll... help you get rid of them!"
173a4710-afcb-4b8f-a962-f5b142b95bc8: "If you keep acting like an idiot, maybe I will."
c60a28a3-226b-483a-b9a9-32b6a715bd66: "You're one of my best warriors. You really think there will come a time when there's no work for you?"
b24caffa-c90f-42ca-83c8-4d40dc91d616: "Listen, I wanted to ask you... Imagine: all this constant hacking and slashing ends. Cyclopes, barbarians, our neighbors... We defeat all of them. Imagine, right?

0d4b6be2-1bb5-4d55-8d29-d45f8a08e20b: "Ha ha hmm... That's the problem. If I did whatever I wanted to do, I'd be dead already. From drinking, from brawling in taverns, or just out of stupidity. I'm still alive just because you need my sword for your war."
8061adee-9ed6-434e-85ea-7c334a3a0c3a: {n}The half-orc looks you in the eye.{/n} "And without war... Why would you need me, hunh?"
5d34a261-f093-4b6f-b3e5-dddea05409d8: "Ha ha ha, right, that's you in a nutshell! But don't dodge the question. Say you conquered all of Avistan... No, the whole of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}!
