f219f195-f951-48cc-87e7-a467d5294f2d: "Pleasures come in different kinds. Some have no place in peaceful life. Take me, for example... I kept dreaming of the freedom to do whatever I want. I wanted to go with you and fight your war. And now that war is the only thing I have left."
a5d0e647-2519-44e7-988d-4dc75eadbbe6: "It's not about joys! If all I wanted was pleasure, I'd buy a cartload of Numerian shit. Life would be short, but very pleasant."
f0e3851f-7c7d-4add-96e4-aea586ac8d0c: "My life isn't worth spit. I've got no need for myself, you know? I'm alive because you need me. For fighting. And without that — what is there?"
f1932a3f-f4dc-4b8e-af3a-9ea8c4123b5d: {n}Regongar roars with laughter. You see relief in his eyes.{/n} "Ha ha ha... You're right. I guess I put my foot in it."
ceeec2ae-9f22-4719-bacc-3b3b9e0af5ac: {n}Regongar sighs with relief.{/n} "I'm sorry. I'm being stupid."
df213665-e970-49bd-83f2-d0a5764896d7: "I need to sleep more and think less. My head is filled with such bad thoughts lately... Last night I managed to convince myself three times that you don't need me and you're about to dump me."
a84376fc-9c6f-4b23-baf5-11f0cde11f68: {n}Closing his eyes, the half-orc clings to you with his whole body. He whispers,{/n} "I know. I know. Forgive this idiot. I love you too."
f72161f9-3711-4047-a66b-eca9fbf2f739: {n}Laughing provocatively, the half-orc clings to you with his whole body. He whispers,{/n} "Definitely. Forgive me for saying all this rubbish. I love you."
0acb69cd-3368-4409-a086-b7c840c1e303: {n}The half-orc's face turns to stone.{/n} "I'm sorry. I'm sorry, this won't happen again." {n}He sighs and turns away.{/n}
5ff33667-91c0-4f7f-8fa5-65f3c2aee403: {n}Regongar looks away with a wry expression.{/n} "Yeah, all right… Fine, forget it. I'm an idiot and I'm asking dumb questions."
701ff238-9c92-4648-9329-6cf03e93c857: "Will you show me that move? The one you used to slice that creep in half? Hey, what you grinning at? You just dare to make another joke about your tent!"
6e68c04d-33c5-4d37-bddb-436ae86ef487: "Ha ha ha! You're reading my mind! All right, I'll show you, no problem!"
1af20381-423a-4201-b88f-eb3619f079f8: "So, how does it feel to be chieftain?"
9c999688-6052-45cc-83f7-264f83598574: "How do you manage the ghost in your sword?"
1a43687a-fdd7-402f-bc49-5ff37aaeb7d2: "{g|Tiger Lords}Tiger Lords{/g}! Look who it is! A {d|c41 Chief Armag}friend{/d} to Armag, a friend to the whole tribe! A friend who's always welcome here!"
de13817e-93df-4c3d-a970-eac45638718e: {n}Armag's wandering eyes stop on your face for a moment, and he firmly shakes your hand.{/n} "{d|c41 Chief Armag}Greetings{/d}, {mf|brother|sister}."
d2c42335-ea5a-4717-a14a-0a07e0df6df9: "Armag failed his brothers and sisters, but they took him in again. Armag would rather die than betray their trust again. And they know it."
23f41e4c-54e7-4ae5-8676-5fd792ed674e: "It fills Armag's days with doubts and his nights with nightmares. Each day is a battle, when it is around. It is Armag's curse, but it also gives Armag the strength to win. The dead man will never prevail again."
800fd0a5-7fd8-4d8a-a7da-498a5c95047f: "The tigers are licking their wounds. Much time will pass before the tribe can regain its former power and glory. But that day will come!"
1d727245-8886-4982-b2fe-df1151ac5870: "You fight like others, share trophies with everyone, eat a lot! You are just like proper she-goblin!"
c2ad1ccd-5145-4536-a527-3f7aa5e1625a: "You bet! I'm not some Brevic damsel to whimper and play dress-up! Wait... did you just call me a goblin?!"
2e3f1f88-54e1-4d2c-b864-8f5125632ed1: {g|Population5_5}[Choice effects]{/g} "We need money and that means business. I'm willing to make a deal."
ed65a745-1e5b-49b3-9233-2dbb255cac65: {g|Population5_6}[Choice effects]{/g} "We're not Brevoy's dump. Let them find another place to put their trash."
cc4516b4-4983-45ac-8bf3-2f5ea4b287bf: "{name}! We have a big fish here today – a noble from {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}. His clothes are worth hundreds of gold coins, and his eyes are shifty. He has a business offer to make. He wants to open a leatherworking shop in our domain, to tan skins."
9d0a7fa6-b81c-4f0c-8e4e-5f1da7637bc3: "{name}, a nobleman from {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} has arrived. He requests your approval to open a small business. He desires to open a few leatherworking shops in your domain, to tan skins."

He desires to relocate them to your lands, and share the profit with you."
a0495541-d71d-4211-b682-273b0d97cf82: "I'll give the orders to begin construction. I'll also reinforce the patrols, in case there's any unrest. It's time your subjects learn how to work for an honest living, even if it means a nasty smell."
8252a06a-c66b-476f-98d9-f78ff49e269d: {n}Lander winks and smiles delicately.{/n} "Excellent. After all, nobody ever died of a nasty odor. I assume."
87402d3f-d27a-4e64-9a5b-9f63d2818e10: {n}Octavia's eyes glow.{/n} "Perfect! We didn't save these lands to just turn them into a dump! Free from alchemical fumes, our people will live here happily and give birth to healthy children."
fd1cc35a-80b8-4f70-814b-26ebd24c47ca: {n}Valerie nods solemnly.{/n} "I'll give the order to prepare a location for the tanneries. The guards will deal with any loudmouths who complain about the smell."
c1868be6-1e94-4505-bbb0-455979d92d67: "A fine choice, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. You can count on me. I'll immediately have people sent out to determine the best location for the tanneries. We certainly wouldn't want their..." {n}{g|House Lebeda}Lebeda{/g} frowns gently.{/n} "... odor... clouding the air we breathe here at the palace."
95e02c0c-4ff3-4bed-9ad3-756fdef6cefc: "These tanneries smell like a kobold's backside. This industry requires the use of alchemical components, which are carried by the wind and cause nasty diseases. We mustn't make a deal with this little man. Better to send him away – and quickly. That will teach the other moneybags a lesson too. Just because you're stuffed with gold, that doesn't mean you're allowed to do whatever you want."
f41ef8ff-7a2c-459b-ad0c-7bfb7471c7bb: "This alchemical enterprise would make an unpleasant neighbor. The people of {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} will happily pay to move these tanneries away from their homes. But you have the right to make whatever decision you consider best for the country."
b7d634cc-12b3-48f7-9cc8-79db25101102: "These tanneries stink. The alchemical waste is hazardous, unless you're a Kobold of course. 7787103c-809a-4ed9-b2e4-f721f3346983: "Who or what exactly am I talking to?"
630c3c24-78de-4c46-98c7-d0565e10edbf: [Use magic to make the spirit visible and attack] "I don't negotiate with monsters!"
d31c4fa8-6532-4aa1-916a-a68019e138d8: "Maybe we can strike some other deal?"
cdd91a80-a0b2-43dd-909c-97fe9f6c4f91: "Don't be afraid, Tig. We'll get you out of here. Your mother loves you and is waiting for your return."
d71be466-8c9d-43b5-8e18-232975e1e681: "Who are you? A ghost? Evil spirit? I need to know who I'm dealing with."
7f97ea9a-51fc-4ce9-b9b2-49b61ca536eb: "And what influential personage would that be? If you mean a god, I don't know of any gods in the world matching that description."
398d1715-0ce2-4728-b749-b17815ebaf13: "Now, now, shame on you! You burst into my village, kill all my lizards... Such barbarism!"
83f3abbf-35b5-499a-988b-4734f1888e7b: {n}A young boy stands in the middle of the hut. He's pale, and his eyes are wide and frantic, but when he opens his mouth, a much older voice emerges, confident and derisive.{/n}
522d8164-969d-4b12-bff4-1ccbded5a86e: "Kneel before your Great Ancestor, mortals! Or I'll punish yooouuu!" {n}The child bursts into spooky laughter.{/n} "All right, enough games."
a7365c1f-4bc0-4a65-8d48-81cb24f70448: "I understand you're here to take the boy?"
e4bc79c2-1903-43ef-949e-e28d8c4e4aa4: "You can call me the Count Shimmerglow — 'Your Excellency' to my friends. I own this village, and all these foolish lizards. You wouldn't want to get on my bad side."
a049d2b9-d703-4db7-a378-fe4ff3b034fe: "Enjoying myself. These gullible lizards obey my every word! And I do my best to make their lives a living hell so I can feed on their fear, pain, and shame — all the most delectable emotions!"
934091a0-5bd4-44af-a92f-8815d7ee5a15: "Before you arrived, I was enjoying myself, feeding on the pain and terror of these naïve lizards. 327a949b-9113-48cf-89e6-7b571c0e3a16: "The deep, primal terror of these barbarians makes for a heavy and satisfying meal, but there's no spice to it — it's too plain. 1eb148e8-9c7e-4d97-b332-b879893467f2: "How rude! First you raze my village, and now you try to take my last sweet morsel of nourishment? Such times we live in... Well, all right. I suppose we can make a deal."
02dd27d6-05ab-46dc-9e4f-9f784264e02f: "Are you this rude to everyone you visit? All right, you want me to set the boy free? It's negotiable. You'll need to provide me something of value in return, of course."
4915a0dd-77a3-4e9f-8b42-2a478dc73acc: "The boy was just a whim. I don't mind parting with him so long as you provide me something more valuable in return... say, an old lizardfolk? 1c67695b-0ee5-4b06-aaa1-b457f919a681: {n}The boy laughs again, the same unnatural laugh.{/n} "Frankly, I wasn't planning to part with the boy without some additional offering from you, but your speech before the chieftain was beyond expectation! 5d7775cf-6352-4bed-ab59-caa40e97d451: "You really are an unpleasant guest, you know? I suppose there's still a chance to settle this peacefully."
babc69cc-0275-4983-9aa3-cc276fbdc2c0: "I've grown tired of the old lizard and his rattle. His songs drain the fear from the tribe. However, I can sense that he fears me as well! Mmm, yes, that sounds tasty. I'll take great joy in feeding off his final fear!"
c0c6128f-58e5-459c-b748-a28411df2fb2: "No, no, no. You want to haggle, try the marketplace. My terms are nonnegotiable. If you want the child, bring me the old rattler."
5bc3826e-d6e4-4110-9adb-fd9a4d0e9967: "Ah, and here's the old lizard now. Vesket? Do kill him for me, please."
45f33b28-b877-45b8-ab6e-8957b1e5d3d7: "Stop that!" {n}The voice coming from the boy's mouth is tinged with irritation, but the boy's eyes soften with relief and gratitude.{/n}
236cab58-3870-45df-a414-71fe18801a4e: "Excellent, excellent. Well, a deal is a deal — the boy is yours!" {n}The boy gasps, and his eyes fill with tears. The old rattler falls to his knees, trembling, and begins to moan.{/n}
8a5b687e-bed7-478d-bc36-e0d7a6807607: "Thanks to you, he's the last lizard here, and I need to eat before I leave this area. My choices are limited: the old lizard, or the boy. 4794d1d4-e701-4582-bb5a-954e62130c43: "A pleasure doing business with you. The child is yours." {n}The boy takes a deep, convulsive breath, almost like he'd been drowning and finally made it back to shore. His eyes fill with tears.{/n} "I want to go home..." {n}he says as he begins sobbing.{/n}
0a4b86b9-0249-4a41-8e36-34aaac20f37b: "Oh, yes, what could I be? A mystery! A secret! A delightful charade! Hahaha! It's enough for you to know I'm not the last one at the court of a particularly important and influential person!"
d3a25d0d-d8c9-4f12-b875-137439916d62: {n}It's hard to detect what it is you're speaking with. A ghost? Demon? Fey? Maybe something even more exotic. 0f13d9bf-861d-4ed1-bf35-66a47cf37a4e: "But... Great Ancestor... It not seem right to..."
f9400c92-94b8-43b6-b09a-beff220871a5: "You question your Great Ancestor? Perhaps I chose the wrong time to come back and guide the tribe back to glory. 23450c32-f036-4edc-8856-0bf9f68da2a6: "Farewell! Fear not, heh, you can leave through the door safely. I've instructed my lizards to treat you as an honored guest!"
3b1ac782-e529-4672-9da7-a5d8deca6e7c: "Vesket! Your Great Ancestor has need of you! Hurry!"
a19d642c-9a42-49ac-a6ad-6fe580ff0133: "What makes you think my patron is of YOUR world? What would you, a mortal waste of flesh, know of the {g|First World}First World{/g} and its gods? You shouldn't even speak its name above a respectful whisper!"

dceb7419-02b9-4349-828c-791119c73638: {n}Nyrissa laughs.{/n} "My wild cat — so angry, so hungry for knowledge. I've never thought you'd give up so easily. But you are too late. 34e7a7ca-c202-49d6-acf0-131b099f6ef8:
"You are lying, as you always have..." {n}Says the wizard, but his voice shows doubt. He turns to the mirror, for some a long moment you seem to meet his stare.

6a7c350f-f051-4429-9fc0-21370f3ac9f4: {n}Nyrissa gets up from her place and approaches slowly. 76a79473-404a-442d-befe-b9b6813a34e6: {n}The vision fades. A moment later there's the original reflection of the wizard returns.{/n} "Dead! I'm dead! Why won't the House let go of me? As if the story isn't over yet. Find the final mirror, I beg you!"
fad0d0b1-319e-426e-b625-99f7bbaecc89: "If I oppose Irovetti, will you support me?"
52eca8aa-23e1-4f36-a79e-03a958ab8e86: [Attack] "You are Irovetti's servant, and that makes you my enemy!"
3d093d5b-a0bd-46e8-9612-42b68736dde9: "There you are. Well, what kind of performance are we to expect today? The capitulation of {mf|King|Queen} {Name} in face of the luminous Irovetti? Or... Something else?"
f542eb6e-964d-4e1a-adde-bc62905cd13e: "I am Drey Yarnes, High Priest of {g|Calistria}Calistria{/g}, the patron of this city. I also command the temple guard."
9aad19b5-f3ee-4e31-aeba-0cc778e6f072: "Why? Irovetti prays to {g|Calistria}Calistria{/g} himself, and donates generously to the temple. With him in charge, the city has become much more cheerful than it used to be. Why would I wish to see him deposed?"
8b747bb1-3639-4433-9df8-f9e7391a2e73: "No, that's no reason to rebel. Think about it — why should I incite a riot?"
d3d92963-2f7e-4f18-8d5b-fcbe4730cbf7: "The {g|Calistria}Savored Sting{/g} allows much, but what he's doing is unacceptable. I'm ashamed of accepting money tainted by his dirty crimes. I shall wash my hands in his blood!"
c6091307-02e9-4b71-8071-aeafc50e1556: "I'm afraid you have nothing to offer me, Your Highness. If you oppose Irovetti, I will protect him. Now you'd better leave — there are spies everywhere."
617e1411-95b6-4992-8586-2d0ca5b711cb: "Go now, and carry out your plan. We shouldn't be seen together — there are spies everywhere!"
5361cca1-e5db-46f9-bacf-e931b78fff6c: "Go, Your Highness. Today, the fates of many hang in the balance."
58b29d96-7534-4309-bd14-da7dfd339862: "Don't say another word. There are spies everywhere. Your fate awaits you on the palace steps. — Go now and face it!"
08ce71df-9a6b-459b-a4ba-ecf1e6b8380d: "Hello, Your Highness. May the goddess smile upon you."
8c43a2e1-f56b-40f8-bf62-c566fd907ea2: "Not much has changed for the temple. Whoever may rule {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, the city has but one divine patron — and everyone seeks her grace!"

19cbc9ce-08ea-4f60-9f46-a224661cb4f2: "I know. You were screaming in your sleep. If I could drag your nightmares outside and punch them in the face..."
0fb5c1fa-c7f7-4fda-8511-8919b5c22495: {n}Your advisor has arrived to report about the recent Arcane developments in your {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}.{/n}
185f57b9-9eca-4032-b7c7-45320e25ab23: "Ha! Why is it so quiet? Aren't we going to toast and drink in the name of our chief?"
9af4ee17-35a7-405c-bc89-c4c457e98985: "A birthday is a good day, {name}! Time to count all the great fights you had this year, all the beasts and monsters you've killed! I wish you one thing: may you never see a day when you turn around and there's nothing exciting to remember!"
89cc84b7-d4e2-40ef-8a03-f3fc95109a2c: "As we walk in light, we shall not forget those lost in darkness."
035ee949-75bb-4a12-a1ab-78ac4545bfb3: "I pray for peace, and an easy path for the fallen."
b5b71fbd-947e-4aa5-a02e-ef02b907593f: "Speak slowly, I'm writing it down. I shall cite your prayers in my essay on the cult of Sarenrae."
d8962f24-fc0a-4f45-8df4-d40f5e142c30: "Let us remember the fallen with dignity! Our sorrow, and our pride in them, shall live on in our hearts."
b408368b-d13a-4fe9-bc3d-5f26bec17d3d: "Your words heap sadness upon my soul, but relieve it as well."

Unfortunately, our wealth has been depleted by a series of reckless ventures — like the one my brother is partaking in right now. 0efb6559-b432-4fb5-8c2f-e4c35645f651: "Mathian Hanvaki was known for his bravery and recklessness. When our family was dealing with some financial difficulties, his best idea was to leave his family estate, his wife, and his children in the care of his brother and go off treasure hunting with a group of... daredevils of the same kind, let's say. No one has seen him since. Unfortunately, stories like this aren't unusual in our family. Stories about the exploits of my great-grandfather have become legends, the bards praised his courage... Too bad no one wrote any songs about his widow and everything the poor woman had to endure."
4a5a72a9-5aff-4177-b866-c27cd48a275d: "Is that so... My poor father won't be able to cope with such a loss... What have you done, Brother! And for what?" {n}After reading the letter, Edrist sighs bitterly and shakes his head in dismay.{/n} "So, that's how it all started. My brother found our great-grandfather's letter in the family archives, and he decided to follow his example... And most unfortunately, he did."
30a8be46-3736-42e2-aa81-796082b1233d: {n}Edrist grabs the letter eagerly and starts reading it line by line, faded though it is with time.{/n} "A tomb of cyclopes! Looks like you shed light on one of the secrets of our family. The bones you found were the remains of my great-grandfather, Mathian Hanvaki."
30fa1272-d66c-46ef-880c-d9b594e19629: "No! No, wait! I beg you…"{n}Ignoring his shouts, the guards drag Edrist away.{/n}
70b46d4e-cb0e-41e7-a8a6-9078683cb954: "We don't know where he is or whether he's still alive. Our poor father is losing his head in grief. Please, help us to learn something about the fate of my brother, and you'll gain an eternally loyal ally."
4348d8d0-b962-45e1-8aec-127289cdaeb9: "This means I'm the heir of the title now... But this doesn't give me the tiniest trifle of joy, believe me. Well. I'll have to stay in your capital for a while. If during your travels you happen find yourself in this ill-fated tomb, do me a favor and tell me what two Hanvaki daredevils died for."
0b7075a3-8381-4b8f-ba05-3e6bf4a7e2b3: "Well, the picture's perfectly clear now. Oh, if only this ill-conceived letter had been lost to time, if my poor brother hadn't found it and been infected with this deadly craving for adventure! Well, Your Grace... Today I'll leave for Gralton — the city in which, from this day on, you will have a loyal friend and ally."
64542711-f880-4cdb-9b4b-ccf7d0073f76: "All I can do is pray my brother has been spared the same fate. I beg you to find him!"
a114229c-bd74-4ba6-aa48-2eb80fbdfb8b: {n}Edrist gives you a bow and leaves the room.{/n}
24699496-ab88-48af-9562-115a908ab280: "I look forward for any news you may find."
a44bc63b-2700-45df-b07a-196b2e7e5bf8: "Is that so... Do you have any proof of his death that I could present to our father?"
7eac6e88-25b7-42ac-a316-57d8d03f217b: "They say pets look like their owners. I always thought this statement was ridiculous until I met you, Ekun – and your wolf. It's as sullen as you!"
cc6dc308-da4e-41d7-9c05-7bbee75ce38e: "You should have a rattlesnake. Noisy and venomous."
0cd20122-ef32-4195-98c0-5911e6f5ed88: [Gently throw a little pebble at the window]
e3f8ef28-d3b0-4cbf-9a65-30702a9b2542: [Detect Magic] "Let's see if there's any enchantments on this gate…"
24192f3d-1352-4d16-9fee-3eb365319f8e: [Detect Magic] "That scarecrow looks like it might be trouble…"
a5caa02f-0b1a-44ed-91d8-bb2a25412ca9: {n}The pebble hits the window with a KLAK. After several moments, the door creaks open and an old woman with a tangle of grey hair and greenish skin steps out — her eyebrows and ears taper to sharp points. {/n}"Who's causing all this mischief?" {n}The woman scans the porch with a baleful eye, and her gaze locks on the pebble.{/n} "Throwing rocks now?! What, you think that bell hanging there is just for show?!"
89377628-a03b-4756-8343-0533272bf35a: "What in everlasting damnation…?!" {n}After a few moments, the door creaks open and an old woman with a tangle of grey hair and greenish skin steps out.{/n}
61f584a0-51c5-4c1c-99fe-1264c7aa9f6e: {n}No matter how loud you shout, no one answers.{/n}
d50fbd9a-8cf5-44ad-b49c-7e6219782a87: {n}Your aim is true, but you've put too much strength in your throw — the window shatters! You hear shrill curses from inside the house.{/n}
8f8f7e9a-59dd-4d19-8e0c-1440fb0bb81b: {n}This house differs from the others — it's the only one that looks habitable. A low, almost-defeated fence rings it, smoke rises from the chimney, and you can smell what could be a stew — heavily spiced. Even glass windows, adorned with drapes, are intact. A small, dented brass bell hangs near the front gate, and a well-swept path leads from the gate to the door of the house. Along the side of the house lies a garden — vegetables, it seems — and in the middle of the garden, you see a scarecrow with black stones for eyes and a wicked grin stitched on its burlap face.{/n}
9d7ef7d7-74e9-4b3d-9ef5-96a35be4fa07: {n}The gate and the bell bear a simple enchantment that alerts the caster — presumably the owner of the house — about uninvited guests.{/n}
3220ad5c-4f6d-4787-ba4e-60769c379c60: {n}The scarecrow's aura is strong, almost like a lightning flash to your senses. It is not a bundle of sticks and rags — it's a dangerous ward to protect the home from trespassers.{/n}
3df4351f-6a81-45eb-b816-6f0f1c4fafd4: {n}As you snap the gate, you hear a slow creak and the snapping of tree branches — the scarecrow has stepped from its pole! Its stitched grin splits, revealing a wicked row of teeth.{/n}
cd4f2820-daeb-4eef-985e-df67e3323230: "Ha ha ha! Great throw! That smashed it to pieces! Nice!"
a9625e3b-6dcd-4009-abd2-02e958e42e3f: "Jubilost, I don't get it – how are you still alive? You're so small – and you always piss everyone off!"
53c777c4-5fc3-4e63-a7c0-67449f3b770b: "Ah! It's my strategic planning skills! There's always someone big and dumb beside me, who is more convenient to aim at!"
5a39af36-a446-46fc-8bd6-43336321bf2f: "It's because you're so hard on yourself. Try to rest sometimes. You don't have to practice every spare minute."
35a35bd3-867b-40c4-907f-fcba8fa1c564: {n}Your advisor has arrived to report about the recent Relations developments in your {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}.{/n}
a090cc9f-e547-4156-8e09-b4a113aa4d95: "I'm here to help. Whoever is attacking you, they're as good as dead."
ccf41e81-95fb-47b4-93d6-d2f662b67847: "It's time for soldiers to return to the capital, their place is on the front lines."
6160de28-c7e2-45bd-954e-a6555266c903: "Oleg, how are you holding up? Staying brave?"
5b5c9bfe-80f1-4020-a72b-de2db087a920: "Your Highness!" {n}Kesten looks mortally tired, but his usually gloomy face is bright with joy.{/n} "I knew you would return. And right on time too!"
95d399f3-7880-4370-a307-e2392ff97fa0: "Your Highness, at last!" {n}Jhod is obviously glad to see you, but assumes a stern look.{/n} "They're running wild here without you! I tried to talk sense into them, but it's exhausting! Some scatter, others try to act like heroes. There's no order at all!"
a5b71847-af64-4a1c-9546-4e4fdc16b695: "Everything is worse that it might seem, Your Highness." {n}A gloomy Oleg joins the conversation.{/n} "Bandits are preparing to raid us! Just like the good old times — to hell with them! If only they were ordinary bandits — but no, it's evil spirits coming from the mist, and then fading away like mist when you kill them. There hasn't been a single day without an attack."
e566435e-f01e-41ba-a6d8-3571a6ab3bbe: {n}Oleg catches his breath.{/n} "I guess we've fought them off. Your Highness, the fight seems to have done you good. Forgive my frankness, but when you got here you were looking like the grave. But now you seem all right."
e7adea41-ac82-4916-9f04-22090a8c04c0: {n}You do feel a surge of energy. Your curse hurts you and your followers more, the more trouble haunts your kingdom. You've lessened its power by restoring peace at the {g|Oleg's Trading Post}trading post{/g} and environs.{/n}
59a215d7-59b1-4fa9-abcc-1b817c005de5: "We won't have to wait. — There they are! All right, Your Highness. Together we'll burn the tails off these vermin!"
8282bee1-3654-4819-b8b1-0924a1bd9f25: "Without a doubt! Speaking of which, there they are, Your Highness. It's all right, it's not the first time we've faced wrongdoers!"
9828f84e-6670-4632-bc2a-5b2477a4a346: "To the capital it is, then. I'll keep an eye on these simpletons. They'll get there safe and sound!"
269328af-5b76-40a6-b25b-20146c45aaf8: "Will do, Your Highness! I'll get your guard there safe and sound. We'll stand ready for your orders."
8aaaee8a-d1b9-49aa-a41a-69eb87f2b407: "We must, Your Highness! Looks like there aren't any more of those bottom-feeding bandits in the area. If one wanders in here, I'll handle it myself. When you squish rats and roaches, you need to destroy their nests, not run after separate beasts."
996ff0e2-42f6-43e4-8978-17f924606949: "Right!" {n}Jhod remarks grumpily, but his eyes are shining with joy.{/n} "I'm so exhausted from trying to talk sense into these simpletons while you were gone. Some of them just scatter, others try to act like heroes. There's no order at all!"
cfddb634-5050-4532-a40c-d882f716e1d1: {n}The exhausted defenders of the {g|Oleg's Trading Post}trading post{/g} shout with relief, recognizing you.{/n}
639afde0-d071-45c3-9bc7-4fcd74e3d05d: "Your tribe is holding a human child. I came to take him back."
6769a808-38c0-41c4-a9dc-21e5d812f3de: "I came for a peaceful negotiation, one chieftain to another. Your tribe is holding a human child — I'm ready to pay for his return. I'd like to solve this without resorting to violence."
dab01f81-51e2-44d5-99ab-f85815a26d4d: "I've come to take our child back. Will you release him of your own free will, or will I have to cut you down?"
dd56db92-a314-4164-b82e-f6c07ecbc18a: "You and your tribe don't seem happy. Are you certain this Stishchak is really your Great Ancestor and not some evil spirit pretending to be him?"
b8dd029d-90ec-40f0-bdb8-503dc76f6ac9: "Why did your tribe's rattler flee the village?"
ec2048aa-0900-4e6f-9cbf-d47ce54d310c: [Leave] "I'm not here to fight. I'll leave."
33a63442-af49-45f0-9195-f8d18f0c4e9f: [Leave] "I'll go to the Spirit Hut and talk to this Great Ancestor of yours."
71caa76e-a487-469e-82d6-e78cf9c2fe4d: [Attack] "I'd hoped to settle this peacefully, but..."
f4ce9500-5f14-45b9-97d0-ba6345dfcb4e: "Listen here, Chieftain. I will cut off your hands, legs, and tail — and then I'll do it to the rest of your tribe. When I'm done, I'll burn this village to the ground with you still inside, and then I'll salt the earth so nothing will grow here for the next hundred years."
dff06576-2560-496d-88f8-9d291b851922: "You're unfit to be chieftain. The 'Great Ancestor' you've placed your trust in is a monster. You're leading your tribe to ruin — let go of your pride, and let me help you save your tribe before it's too late."
e8556974-2dd3-4646-8e63-a178c0987d63: {n}A sturdy lizardfolk is waiting for you in the hut. He's a head taller than the rest of his tribe, and his well-muscled body is covered in scars, displaying the experience of countless battles.{/n}
43e02bcc-1655-41ce-80ac-75d0a5f1a940: {n}It isn't easy to read the lizardfolk's body language, but his shallow breathing and jerky movements are consistent with deep exhaustion. It's possible the chieftain hasn't gotten a good night's sleep in a long while.{/n}
ab4e62da-44b2-4f69-ba8d-528db6f4eb53: "What's that? Warmblood? Why you come? Vesket not call for you! Why you here? Tell, quick!"
6952f81e-5045-4d1a-a547-fce0de60280e: {n}The chieftain hisses loudly.{/n} "You can't take warmblood youngling! Great Stishchak claimed youngling for himself! You not anger Stishchak!"
a97fb82c-06cf-4740-baef-14dcc4bf533f: "I Chieftain Vesket, king of Longtail Tribe! Warmblood not know me? Fine! Soon, all know Vesket! Great Ancestor foretells I soon do great deeds!"
53664178-f8ee-41ff-aaf9-bbf2bd967360: "Longtails the greatest tribe! When world hatched from egg, Longtails first to step here! The rest appeared later, from eggshell and dirt!"
086819b3-1600-4eab-ade3-39129c2738e4: "Oh, Stishchak is great! Too bad old Kagar not here — he sing songs about him! Know this, warmblood: Stishchak hero among heroes! Earth under our feet — Stishchak fish from the water and put on steady foundation! Moon rolling over skies — Stishchak throw it there!"
251e4ef6-20a7-42b1-a052-7c5de2682885: {n}The chieftain clenches his teeth and glares for a moment, silent, then lowers his head.{/n} "You are wrong about the Great Ancestor, but... Chieftain Vesket submits. The youngling is in Spirit Hut, with the Great Ancestor. If Great Ancestor let you, take him and leave."
75707cfb-3a11-4327-923a-1d647124dcdb: {n}Vesket can't hide the trembling in his knees.{/n} "Youngling in Spirit Hut," {n}he says in a hoarse voice.{/n} "If Great Ancestor let you, take him and leave."
460a6f21-a32a-4f0d-bab4-26e77f195240: {n}The chieftain frowns.{/n} "Warmblood youngling in Spirit Hut with Great Ancestor. Vesket can't give him away — not Vesket's to give. Go, talk to Great Ancestor yourself. If you lucky, he give you youngling. If not, I no help."
e02355c9-6129-4ccb-ac32-37dcac975fed: "Can't. Stishchak took warmblood youngling for himself. Can't give him away, can't trade him."
138f1fd4-d064-4c03-a93e-73e635fcf834: {n}Chieftain Vesket locks eyes with you for a long time, then looks away.{/n} "Warmblood want scare me? Ha! Longtails eat a dozen warmbloods for lunch! Take lousy youngling — Vesket not need him! He is in Spirit Hut. Take him and leave at once, before Vesket become angry and change mind, yes!"
839bf929-1aee-453c-a8ce-ae3a18fd893d: {n}The chieftain is silent for a long while.{/n} "Old Kagar used to tell that too. True, tribe scared. Could Chieftain Vesket be so wrong?"
0e34f1d4-3e11-4552-835c-7fd798726c27: {n}The chieftain's voice rises to a shout as he lashes the ground with his tail.{/n} "Lies! Lies! You not slander Great Ancestor!"
9550bb83-9e37-42e1-8c84-feabdd4b3712: "Old Kagar... lose mind, yes. Afraid of everyone. Tell if he stay, we kill and eat him. Happens with old folks. Too bad, too bad. Kagar once know much, sing ancient songs, teach whole tribe."
55cdfa71-d225-4878-92c6-9ecb3290557e: "All woods, all swamps, all rivers — ours, yes! Longtail Empire own whole world, from mountain roots to moon and stars!"
09f6497d-9c65-4add-8ed8-abb9b0ce7e9b: "Now, with great Stishchak back, Longtails be respected again, yes! Soon, soon!"
943ff5d5-8612-48ce-ab8d-582c088fa4b2: {n}The chieftain shakes his head.{/n} "Vesket knows not who believe. Maybe Vesket go crazy. Go to Spirit Hut, talk Stishchak. Learn truth yourself."
72a44715-0d3d-48d9-b793-30cfda9ba026: "Long ago, it was... Now Longtail tribe's enemies strong. Live all over. But Stishchak spirit come back! Tribe wage war on Thickskins, win easy! Joy, celebration! Now, Longtails get fame again, like old days!"
637440ed-ed09-4e88-937d-51a9de4e0737: "What else warmblood want? Go Spirit Hut. Talk Stishchak there!"
043addf1-c249-4a14-8bd6-1edf9569817b: {n}Chieftain Vesket bares his teeth.{/n} "Warmblood threaten? Longtail tribe not bow to force! Get your weapon and fight now, or leave forever!"
9c9f4670-d8f0-4e0a-96a7-a44caa5ae2d4: "Child stays in village. Chieftain's word stronger than rock! Leave, warmblood — I not want see you anymore."
da586fac-a9b6-4609-8410-bee21dd62200: "It is amusing how eager some of the short-lived are to serve the dead."
f638d786-5779-48ba-95a7-2d50c9098d23: {n}Jubilost quickly writes something down in his notebook.{/n} "World hatching from an egg... Longtail Empire... Mountain roots... Fascinating!"
ac94482c-2d3b-4585-b6ab-cf2c35b9dc89: "At last! I'm sick and tired of all their hissing! My hands have been itching to punch that scaly mug!"
cb178001-d423-4d1e-a791-b8ca58b6f59f: "Look how brave he is, {Name}. The big chief isn't the least bit afraid of us!" {n}The half-orc inhales deeply.{/n} "Why do I smell shit?"
5f27d448-2252-4638-9f97-6feca6420b88: {n}The lizardfolk grinds his teeth.{/n} "Chief Vesket is busy. No time for talk. You want child — go take child!"
ffda2c9b-0043-4c09-bf70-733ad67fed55: "And no come back!" {n}Lizardfolk guards lead you out through the gates.{/n}
2edb8903-d9e4-40c1-a2af-6ecb20481a8f: {n}Amiri kneels before the Nilak's body. Covering her face with her trembling hands, she lets loose a wrenching scream.{/n}
4ce460c4-d268-4a03-b478-7ad4169e404f: {n}Amiri kneels before Akaia's body and reaches down to close his eyes. {/n} "Rest in peace, you old piece of crap. After all, you were a real chieftain, at least at the end."
09ed9b33-78eb-469a-ad5f-2a4259fbf2c0: {n}Amiri rises to her feet. She touches her smooth skin through the hole in her bloody clothes, then grips the hilt of her sword.{/n} "Huh. Still alive, ain't I?"
e15b52d3-b85a-48f7-951c-cb515ef80f26: {n}With a final, indistinct cry, the ghostly giant dissolves into the air. Amiri utters a victorious shout, and then falls into laughter.{/n}
7b7c78c3-d552-4071-a145-3b9a2d3d6934: {n}The barbarian looks at her fellow tribesmen.{/n} "She gave her life for you, worms! The first worthy chieftain in the history of your lousy tribe. If you waste her sacrifice, I'll come back and chop off all of your empty heads!"
5b1079a6-7c00-489a-b19e-24cfe82fac83: {n}She walks toward you on unsteady legs.{/n} "You could stop her! But you didn't! Come, 'chief.' We have nothing more to do here."
0e9da45c-7221-4b73-80fd-3719be14faf0: {n}Approaching you, she grins crookedly.{/n} "Well, chief, now I'm done with the Six Bears. All my debts are paid. Now you are my tribe. I go where you go."
a45c07fd-a8a8-4c35-a262-f16f43bebe13: {n}Turning to the men of the Six Bears tribe, she raises her bloody fist over her head.{/n} "You see? This is how me and my chief smash freaks and scum! If his brother come, he gets the same! We fear nobody ever!"
afab330e-3e7d-4be5-af5d-4eecd428ab09: {n}Amiri approaches you, grinning wild and triumphant.{/n} "Well, chief, where to next? To the {g|First World}First World{/g}? Or right into the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g}? Together we can smash anyone and anywhere!"
cb37b4d6-2ed9-4896-b6f9-21250534bf2b: {n}She turns to her former tribesmen.{/n} "I paid all my debts. Live — and obey Nilak."
c0ef63b7-cd0d-49ce-8371-14765d7ee4b9: {n}The barbarian approaches you, a triumphant grin spreading slowly across her face.{/n} "Well, chief, we won! Where to next? To the {g|First World}First World{/g}? Or right into the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g}? Together we can smash anyone and anywhere!"
def2c092-5c6c-4427-9415-0f2563153525: "How do you keep all this in your heart? How could you be so cruel?"
a4c74d7b-0fac-4290-a8cd-357f4ae6c47f: "Cruel? Don't confuse me with monsters and maniacs, girl. I don't enjoy the suffering of others. I don't maim and kill for fun. I just know what I want, and I don't care about the rest."
50badd46-09a1-4700-8ed0-e816c7dfb88c: "Damn it! It's like I never left the tribe. How far do I have to go before I'm not running into Kellids on every hill?!"
0a598b5a-0916-46f8-866f-7720bf96139a: "The past is an enchanted place. Those who run from it, run in circles. Those who would leave it behind, flee into it as it chases them."
c65a17cd-0709-46bf-b52b-9d938bbd3414: "The more you think about it, the more confused you get. Why don't you have a drink and get some sleep. And when someone reminds you of something you'd rather forget, twist their heads off. Let them run from you, ha ha..."
ec47fdaf-3d85-4870-94cf-53bfaa434714: "I tried to escape my past for a time, but I couldn't take a single step away. Until I realized no actual walking was necessary."
bc10e8d6-63e8-4599-8e3a-d34078df3595: "You wouldn't meet any in Kelesh. But I don't think you'd like my tribe any better than your own."
24b51f7c-f3ef-4968-8eb2-d6aeb393d4b7: "You wouldn't meet any in Kelesh. But I don't think you'd like my tribe any better than your own."
8e8b4933-eb84-40a8-8c80-10aebab82dcd: "I'm dying to know how I come out in your book..."
057538c9-ff68-47b1-9c52-de65b35771c2: "You know... You're so mysterious! And controversial! It's almost like I'm writing two different characters, not one."
56a0b45e-fcbb-43f0-9f9f-08a360007c79: "I've looked through your Essays On Spices... Who is this Guisa Nordequanni and why is her name on the cover next to yours?"
7d7d7076-0fc6-4eac-9412-a1767050c1e0: "Because some judges are corrupt scoundrels who know nothing about copyright! Co-author indeed! She scarcely sharpened my quills!"
ffbcc824-adc7-41f6-a1e2-8b611650767e: "Maegar is right. We must claim our rights at once, or we'll never climb out from under Restov's boot."
1ca39bb0-de2b-42eb-a5f3-4379f6208050: "Cephal is right. We must be cautious, or we'll lose Varnhold as quickly as we won it."
4afc38e6-f97a-4d91-b72b-7b8a16c4f973: "I don't understand why you dislike Jamandi Aldori. She's a fine person, and there's nothing wrong in being her ally – in word or in deed."
1e836070-4ed6-4044-901d-afc729aaa9ee: "Let's stay a little longer. I'd like to talk to the other guests."
118b2826-72fe-4909-b1d9-63b31d37c108: {n}As the guests linger and entertain themselves, one hero of the occasion stands aside. {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d} – the leader of Varnling Host, your direct commander, and henceforth, the undisputed Baron of Varnhold. He's busying himself with one of his favorite pastimes. He's trying very hard not to yell, but he's ferociously arguing about something with the party's co-founder, a wizard named {d|Cephal}Cephal Lorentus{/d} – Varn's oldest companion, and his most uncompromising opponent.{/n}
dee96a30-251d-45b7-92ea-f7a79e821982: "But {d|Varn}Varn{/d}, my dear friend, would you please be so kind as to explain, what, devil take you, you've been doing?! I financed this venture with my own personal funds, not to mention all the effort and time I've invested. And pray tell, what was it all for? For you to assemble the fruits of our labors and pitch the whole lot down the privy?"
67c1ec1f-6477-45cb-a690-87c3933e6482: "Fruits?! I've been busy guarding these fruits from Brevoy's incessant fruit moths! But I'm a baron now. We finally have our own land. – For the first time in our lives, we're independent! No one can tell us what to do! And you want to destroy everything we've achieved by inviting spies into our house? 164ceebe-b2c2-453f-93d7-b0da66944e9c: "O {g|Asmodeus}Asmodeus{/g}! Please give me the patience to withstand this nonsense – or take my soul already! {d|Varn}Varn{/d}, what are you saying? 802c8fb9-da88-4425-8d1c-16c04bab9982: {n}As he approaches, a mean, sly smile appears on his face — clearly practiced and prepared in advance.{/n} "Ah, the ruler of this 'barony.' I'm flattered by your attention. Sir Stefano Moskoni of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, at your service." {n}The man performs a derisive bow.{/n}
c0fd6eaf-446d-4010-acaf-000910f5ff73: "Oh, I'll be on my way, don't you worry. If I were to stay any longer, I fear I might pick up fleas, or lice, or whatever else passes for subjects in this place. Take care! No need to see me off."
153a0759-e7f1-49c8-a948-4762d34e3d55: "Two — your economy is a shambles. You have to personally resolve an issue of tax collection from some lowly inn — and it seems your treasury even depends upon this handful of coins."
dc7b5367-18c3-4d21-bab6-2c41b75b0054: {n}The man before you reeks of vanity. His black hair is curled, styled, and generously waxed, from the hair atop his head to the points of his moustache. 7c4cb2c2-3bb0-40fa-8187-19f6a4d1e4fc: {n}Sir Stefano, furious, starts to speak.{/n} "My king will not stand for-"
c40ea05f-88cd-4fee-91bd-309d92be4eb8: "I was just traveling back home to glorious {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} after paying a visit to {g|Restov}Restov{/g} — all in service to King Castruccio Irovetti. b6a2c7b2-ed78-4b4d-9992-d52e0d5835cc: "Wha-" {n}Sir Stefano pauses mid rant.{/n} "My... tragic fate?"
85dd57d8-26d9-44ff-8037-9cf87986cb37: {n}Sir Stefano stares at you and snorts.{/n} "You know, the initial goal of my visit was to take measure of your so-called 'barony,' to see if you had anything of value to offer to {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}. And do you know what I found?"
5f597d01-e84b-40b6-a22a-f7c15c7f127a: "And three — your culture is... well, nonexistent, really. What do you even have? No art galleries. No universities." {n}Sir Stefano waves his hand dismissively.{/n} "Your capital may as well be a cowshed, with you a donkey sitting atop a heap of hay."
2d8ca749-aee2-4bfe-9534-50f7b8f0f258: "If anything ever changes here, it'll be the number of dung flies — and that will only grow. Ah, well, I shan't continue this slaughter — no use battling someone who can't even fight back. All the best!" {n}Sir Stefano performs a mocking bow.{/n}
ef8f577c-9104-4786-929f-0ee30a313aab: "Indeed, what was I thinking? What value could there be in speaking to someone who can barely understand the words of an educated noble? I've learned what I wished to know — I bid you farewell."

a3f3b751-b8f3-4213-8159-49c8685e038e: "In the name of Asmodeus, our lord, I welcome you!"
f680531a-f6f1-454c-aee9-1b0b64e3d2e1: "Right! Now there are devils roaming about my capital..."
3a5f9ee8-6b5c-4612-88f2-6882f05ea43f: [Attack] "I know too well what talking to devils leads to."
1b4bd13f-b6f3-4b3f-8aeb-449fca7f46d5: "Fine, speak. But don't think you can trick me."
05d3274a-9802-48c8-924f-1edd051455bd: "What is your interest in Kanerah and Kalikke?"
f5ed3d6b-09e8-49f7-940b-d40e3c8f86b9: "Thanks for the warning, now get out."
9b343886-5f2a-449f-8c10-754a309c81f6: "What's so special about this soul eater? I've killed worse beasts before."
a9709b73-0e89-4113-98ec-7c0feab98cfb: "Fine. I will come to the agreed place."
e47cbbdf-ba60-4266-8ff5-9ed5fd082bd0: [Attack] "You didn't give me any reason not to kill you."
23f098d8-763a-4674-b109-03c98d73442e: "I decline your proposal. This audience is over."
d2771069-861f-49e7-86fa-9da1e45476ba: {n}A dismal silence hangs in the hall, as the figure of a new visitor appears at the door. He's taller than anyone else present, and seems to be made of subtle folds and sharp angles, from his metal mask to his scarlet cape. And he literally reeks of evil – cold, calculating, unrelenting...{/n}
f76637b0-d7bd-4521-8e0e-1e9aee116de1: "Greetings to the ruler of this land," {n} an expressive male voice carries across the hall. The visitor bows politely.{/n} "I've come from afar to discuss a matter of considerable importance, and I hope for a... civilized conversation. Let me introduce myself. I am called the Forefather, and I serve the illustrious Queen Mahathallah. I am a devil."
fc9693ab-c1ba-4b3f-a819-b14d38c2ecdc: {n}The devil doesn't move, paying no attention to the guards' bared swords.{/n} "I wish to warn you against an unforgivable mistake. 4a6fc499-4099-43b3-ac67-0a2dabd003cb: "You have the courage to disregard reason for principles. Will you also have the courage to take responsibility, when innocent blood flows because of what you've done?"
ac0fc0ee-83de-4fce-af2c-561f0fd9fd1e: {n}The devil lowers his head.{/n} "Very well. I've always believed that order and civility make it possible, even for those whose moral views are as different as yours and mine, to reach agreement. And this is why I am here, paying you an official visit."
2b9f3cdb-0790-4aa6-8f28-69652b6e401a: "In the name of order that will someday triumph, I accept your greeting. May your rule be prosperous!"
11f443ec-dec2-474b-a02b-b54f58299546: {n}The devil makes a few gestures and says something indistinguishable. Both he and you seem to be enclosed in an invisible ring. – The outside world shines through dimly, its sounds are barely audible.{/n} "A modest precaution. Others should not hear what I have to say. I have news of someone you know, young Kanerah and Kalikke. One of them is in great danger – and they both share a single fate. They must have told you by now of the soul eater who killed Kanerah. I should imagine that by disclosing their secret and true names to you, the poor children deprived Kanerah of protection from this deadly foe. The soul eater has picked up her scent, and will soon be here. You will need my help to deal with it."
baedb557-2552-4a5c-a9ef-a92c525a785d: "My interest in these lost children is special. I would even say – familial... It's my blood that runs in their veins. A long, long time ago, I gave a night of passion to a young follower of Mahathallah's cult. Her soul has writhed in agony in the flames of Hell for many ages, and yet I still feel a vague joy when I see the offspring of our alliance walking the sunlit lands of Qadira. I am their Forefather – and not only by name..."
0f845333-96e6-4a50-8588-cfd4d1c292f2: "How can you be sure of that? 26b72855-d567-4a90-b938-c1cc44bda928: "I came simply to pay my regards to a lawful ruler. It is my manner to conduct myself in this way."
d002af99-2c27-4f3a-a741-eb1b48bac6c1: "I can lure the soul eater to appear at the right time and place. I even know a way to be rid of it once and for all, without any fuss. 0f848402-f443-48ed-a5ba-ae53c6e61215: "This soul eater is more ancient, and far stronger and more evil than any others like it. It knows Kanerah's name, and will follow her relentlessly. fe64f749-c472-432d-aac1-e36f5a050921: {n}The devil makes another half-bow.{/n} "I enjoy dealing with reasonable and civilized mortals. So long!"
e41dc035-e9a1-4bbc-833f-8f2a0f0e373e: {n}The devil bows again.{/n} "Do not refuse my help, if you care about the girls' lives. For now – farewell. I must excuse myself."

And to top that off, he's apparently the best of friends with some trolls." {n}Jubilost frowns.{/n} "It's your choice, of course, but it seems to me that our best option would be to force this gang to disperse."
caeb0dda-a6e4-4f3e-a100-52e0ccd0a221: {n}The kobolds quickly gather and leave into the woods.{/n}
9497c3b2-6f08-4936-a158-38b8cac765bc: {n}Over several minutes, you manage to piece together that these kobolds are looking for their "king," Tartuk, who's lost somewhere. After several minutes beyond that, you deduce that this Tartuk somehow managed to befriend some trolls.{/n}
18985622-55d8-47c0-a8c8-8ba6dcc02080: {n}The old kobold continues to extend his hand as he stares at you.{/n}
51e25cb1-4b34-4e63-8321-8a36a7c34360: "Nooo! What are you doing? They're so cute! Just leave them alone; they've done nothing to you!"
5f193d3a-314b-4d74-b754-2bca67976dfc: {n}Jubilost frowns and folds his hands.{/n} "You would do well to watch these yobbos," {n}he mutters, teeth clenched.{/n} "They'll try to steal your cart as soon as you turn your back. That's just the way they are."
31f1a4dc-6857-4765-82b7-9a46951d19a7: "King," {n}the old kobold answers.{/n} "Tartuk, trollsss, kobold. Love."
b1a5c84e-00d7-49b5-a5af-0116b198bd46: {n}The old kobold seems to have said his piece, so he just continues to stare at you with cold, still eyes.{/n}
8bd9cc5e-b84c-4b62-9f66-f68652cb4608: "Aww, it seems he's in love with you!"
fbef368c-f688-421e-9b96-08e7aa677b75: {n}You shake the old kobold's hand. It's slimy and cold. He continues to stare, his eyes still, yellow, and emotionless.{/n}
01fd9faa-a4f5-4cab-98f3-0d18f9cb3db4: {n}Seeing you fail to understand the old kobold, Octavia touches your shoulder to attract your attention.{/n}
c39cf444-02a5-4a12-bf8b-e63eededac6c: {n}Unable to judge the expression on his snout, you can't tell if the old kobold is upset by your statement. After you answer, he turns away from you as if you ceased to exist.{/n}
80a218e9-9a21-4b11-88f2-85ca0d5796f9: "Awww, they're so cute!" {n}Octavia exclaims, clasping her hands together.{/n} "May I keep one?"
74e53449-d30d-4341-ac48-65a63752e201: "I think I understand what they're trying to say. It seems their king, Tartuk, is lost somewhere, and they're looking for him. But it sounds like he's become friends with trolls now, so I'm not sure it would be wise to help them..."
bfd73870-06b4-4a1e-a899-1d6b3ef34d39: {n}Seeing that you're unable to understand the old kobold, Jubilost exhales noisily.{/n}
2b28a172-13dd-46d6-b4b4-7e240ab71d80: {n}One kobold emerges from the swarming crowd. His scales are a touch lighter than those of his companions. Upon closer inspection, he seems to be extremely old. His skin is dry and lifeless, and he clearly lost some of his scales long ago.{/n}
a050e8e2-56ef-4876-bc57-d73a3844ad2d: {n}There's something curious about this kobold. He seems to be calm, confident, and... wise?{/n}
9862c46d-babf-4362-8f91-a58a7c7ef993: {n}No matter how hard you try, you can't glean anything useful from the old kobold's gibberish.{/n}
e01f4635-ee81-4eb0-af24-35410c7c4db8: {n}The old kobold continues to stare. After you answer, he turns away from you as if you ceased to exist.{/n}
bf74840b-036c-4805-a12e-430c74f360e8: {n}The kobold seems to not understand a single word you're saying, but reacts to the word 'Sootscale'.{/n} "Sssootssscale. Bad. Not friend!"
9a41fa90-7a31-450d-b6f5-3133528c4b68: {n}You see a gang of kobolds resting around a campfire. When they finally notice you, they jump up and start scuttling around, making a mess, and bumping into each other, all the while muttering something in their hissing language.{/n}
68ad5fb6-d696-4f9c-88cd-9ccf11d8e281: {n}Linzi bursts into your room. She looks scared. Her face is smeared with soot, and she holds a weapon in her hands.{/n} "Help! Help!"
2f88f3ef-0e4b-44f7-9c71-21887419db41: "The mansion's under attack! We need to help!"
16374bf6-1309-4519-8363-c6093948e050: "Some villains broke in and started killing everyone! I barely made it! Hurry, we have to help the guards fight off the attackers, or we'll all be cut down one by one!"
e237c711-f9ed-4a03-bc98-ca4432804913: {n}As if to lend credence to Linzi's words, a scream echoes from the hallway.{/n}
6dd87dad-54da-430e-9a64-0e1e053aecdc: "No time for jokes! The mansion's under attack!"
16534075-6402-4ff4-bf52-ebc96969f846: "You can't stay here! The mansion's under attack!"
85d31aa1-3010-4b62-97fd-66e1a06a3f88: {g|Arcane6_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "From this day forth, the creation of undead, no matter the intent, is forbidden, and shall be punished by law."
e2b78062-5a8d-4f4e-8bf8-9642281541cb: {g|Arcane6_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "My decision stands. Any subject who has received a necromancer's license may carry on with their work as before."
5cb00e2f-a31a-40d3-bc5b-d6d902f152e8: "I trust in your vision. Act as you deem fit."
b18df751-cdac-4452-8214-6268c80d1a6e: {g|Arcane6_3}[Choice effects]{/g} "He has my permission. Let's see if his golems are as good as he claims."
9b84d1ba-622a-4438-843b-ad5c0709180e: {g|Arcane6_4}[Choice effects]{/g} "We shall not employ his services."
4f36abe5-2533-4512-9f22-43a442635da7: "You may resolve this issue as you see fit."
498fe3d6-d6b3-4148-8a25-fc22de82bb39: {n}Octavia looks worried.{/n} "Our dalliances with necromancy have not gone unnoticed, {name}. 4e39b90a-12fa-4491-a7dc-ce5a585ebf26: "A delegation of pharasmites has entered the capital, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. Her priests and her faithful demand that we ban necromancy across your lands and put an end to this blasphemy."
fbd03dae-be8d-44c8-80c7-ce1629fee9fc: {n}Today, as always, "Maegar" is clearly not in high spirits...{/n} "This world is replete with meddlesome idiots. I am plagued by pharasmites. 514b3ba8-cd1b-4a44-b285-635bc2bf9540: "I think we should listen to the priests. Raising undead is an evil, violent act. It cuts away and corrupts a fragment of the departed soul. We never should have allowed this dark craft in our lands… and it is high time we put things right!"
6bdb30d1-81ac-4ecf-8eb3-9233589723e7: "I believe that we should agree to their request. This is only because the availability of cheap undead slaves has led to the impoverishment of living laborers. But worse, in order to create an undead minion, a mage must cut away a miniscule fragment of from the departed soul, and corrupt it with negative energy. They then plant this seed back into the dead body. Nothing can justify such depravity."
b275c7f5-a0c4-4483-91cf-f8f82a50a60b: "Their incessant wailing makes my teeth hurt. The imbeciles must learn their place – and we must put an end to their complaints once and for all. Need I remind you that necromancy is the only path that leads to true power?"
c81b5d75-c009-4d8f-a48c-d34c96affffc: {n}Octavia gives a sigh of relief.{/n} "A decision that should have been made long ago!"
5b9bd582-43e1-44e0-89f1-5cfdb9710c84: "Very good. In that case, raising the undead shall become illegal."
65968046-6d63-4527-af19-86f1d276aa46: {n}The Storyteller nods.{/n} "I shall inform {g|Pharasma}Pharasma's{/g} faithful that they may rest easy."
7387283c-a188-43f4-8bd9-0b8d05004609: "Splendid. I shall decline the pharasmites' complaint, may they find themselves in their goddess' cold embrace as swiftly as possible."
c4a2fe7a-31f6-44f4-8744-640e0df7733c: "An amazingly impudent fellow, {name}! I have been approached by a wizard from Nex, who has learned to create golems from piles of literal junk: splinters of wood, rusty nails, broken furniture… He asks your permission to set up shop in the capital and start selling these junk golems. In return, he promises to provide us with a few of his finer creations. Now, you may find this surprising... but I am convinced that we must reject his proposal."
479eda8f-bd2b-429a-b07d-12777665bf2e: "A most interesting proposition, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. A wizard from Nex has offered to create a number of golems for us, using only the rubbish that litters the capital's streets."
b4fe1d97-070f-40ea-83a6-9cf06926a6dc: "We've received a curious offer. Some upstart from Nex has mastered the art of creating golems. Even more, he assembles their bodies out of whatever junk he can find. – A simple rubbish heap is typically enough. We could use a few workers who don't ask any questions."
7dbb13b9-aaee-4d0e-9a6f-5c949734c41e: "I believe we should take him up on his offer. Golems are perfectly well suited for guard duty, as well as hard physical labor. de4dc303-5bf2-4f14-af3e-68b4cebd1e2d: "I shall instruct the mage to begin."
86d9cb9f-2ae2-44c6-aa85-c1cb44820872: "Perfect. It will be my pleasure to get rid of this crook."
70462223-e45b-4407-a766-c0de914fff50: "In that case the mage shall begin immediately."
07e458ae-8d65-4736-b9f8-ed448710aeea: "Moreover, the bumbling fool somehow stumbled upon a way to eradicate the main flaw of many types of golems – the chance that the construct might go berserk. However, this Nexian shyster has found a way to strengthen the magical restraints that hold them captive."
1ba34dfd-cd02-4b51-ab49-70526f57528a: "Do you know how golems are created? A mage must ensnare a living spirit from one of the elemental planes – most typically, an earth elemental – and bind it to the construct. This means that golems are no better than slaves – after all, elemental spirits are living, sentient beings. The mage even brags that his golems 'never go out of control' – as if total domination of a spirit makes the whole thing any less cruel!"
2d044726-5d7d-43fb-a90f-76a4f2025e3f: "After assembling the body out of various junk, he binds to it an elemental spirit, which lends the construct a semblance of life. In some golems, this enslaved spirit may go out of control and become berserk. However, the mage assured me that he has been able to completely eradicate this flaw. All he needs now is your permission – and access to our rubbish heaps."
05543b19-197c-46f6-acc9-7a179732f32d: [Attack] "I've heard all I need to hear — and you've said all you need to say."
60f4bf77-bb38-43b2-bed3-3fda03fe792c: "Why did they want to kill you?"
18da1a53-38e8-43a5-8d85-574db10ae230: "What makes you think you are the Seer of Lamashtu?"
6d3b606e-ae78-41e5-96c2-27d8ffded755: "What do you know about the incursion of enchanted beasts?"
4bc8164f-3031-40c8-948c-2ce91634b1c4: [Let Nok-Nok join the party] "Why not? Join us."
18a37926-4a1f-49bd-9533-8aec868ba509: [Leave Nok-Nok in the village] "Maybe some other time… far, far from now."
8d225b07-097b-41de-a264-91a026d7d8d3: "What should I do with your kin?"
8a1a95be-fb4f-4dae-82aa-aa85a75691ab: "I've killed your people. Aren't you scared of me?"
b0e6901a-41fd-4524-bc57-1d554a7992b2: {n}The goblin, tied to the pole, has seen better days — he's covered in filth, and a wide variety of burns, bruises, claw marks — even a bite mark or two. b3aa3642-17cb-4249-9751-84dbc5773d08: "Greet and meet, heroes! Seen, how I dealt with them? They were like — 'we be smashing you'… and I snarl back — 'no, I be smashing YOU!' And the beast was — 'RrrrRRGH!' And bite! And bite again! Ha-ha! That's it!"
41fb862f-ed3a-42f2-9742-75152addf0dd: "I be the ear of Lamashtu!" {n}The goblin grins widely, then falters.{/n} "No, not that... I be... the see-er of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, that's who I be! 72578b04-3561-4301-9163-0e9414b8a4b4: "Ah! It be because of that halfhead shaman, bees bite his back! He be crazy — something get in his way, he be snarling and poking people with fork." {n}He huffs, then grumbles and shivers, as if trying to dodge invisible pokes and prodding in his memories.{/n}
104ef6db-bbfb-4b56-a880-0edf17b2947b: "I had dream." {n}The goblin leans in as far as he can, nodding, the cords creaking as he does so.{/n} "Lama hold Nok-Nok in her big white arms, rock me, let me suckle her skulls, pet my head, and sing... 55411191-e42a-4a0c-8a54-b3d909c15437: "Beasts?" {n}The goblin frowns, then shakes his head.{/n} "Lama, {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} be their mother, like all beasts, but she not birth them out this way, no way! 6420d173-9001-4e7e-83a2-458c8659afd5: "See for yourself! Heroes needs muscle, right? Also need brain for plans. Someone with pretty face to charm everyone. And needs leader, heart of the group." {n}He nods, finishing his case.{/n} "I can do all of that!"
3f3c388d-30ae-4e10-9279-7f34bf26e303: "Wait! How can you do without me? You die fast than you say 'die'! And with me coming along you won't die! 2568e270-2a65-4d2e-bc22-63bca314e52c: "Aie! AIE! Stop killing me! {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, shatshank's killing me, spill blood, kill shatshank instead!"
018476ec-293c-4a71-a79b-a37fa1d70e53: {n}The goblin casts an angry glance towards the other goblins, huddling behind the statue of {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} and hisses in disgust.{/n} "They deserve a nok across heads, all of them! 85370887-bfa9-4bf2-84ee-0fd22a88566a: "Not at all! Good riddance! They shouldn't try to hurt me!" {n}The goblin lowers his voice.{/n} "Just step quiet-careful now. 5069a7a4-4b5c-4a29-aa21-de134c4c0f4b: "An evil little throat-cutter, and an arsonist to boot! That's exactly what our company needs. Please, {name}! We can't reject this cutie!"
622b9853-9ca5-4d65-a8ef-ab827b2e8b6d: "I know goblins are evil, but this one looks so lonely…"
0164a721-d9bc-4eac-a9e9-635f17052846: "Why don't we convert the old prison into a guard headquarters. We could name it after Kesten."
0e2a9d0f-e9c7-4ff3-a997-e6c0e1914403: "We don't have the resources right now, Jhod. It's going to take all we have to finish rebuilding the capital."
883c59f2-f991-4041-9948-c6e061468f50: "Kesten's death was his own fault. I won't spend our limited resources glorifying such a failure."
e5a38f2d-7a43-445e-85a1-c8f438f14e21: {n}Jhod's sorrow is plain on his face.{/n} "Your Grace, if I may? I just need a moment of your time." {n}He takes a deep breath.{/n} "I feel it only proper to honor the fallen."

9e2bb32d-ef29-448a-a1d6-bf89367fd9cd: "In our darkest hour, he stood at the head of the militia and spared the barony from popular unrest. a033c6ea-f3ca-40e6-bf7c-def59edce55e: "Now, with the capital finally returning to a semblance of normalcy, I think we should consider commemorating Kesten. I think the people would appreciate knowing that we don't forget those who fight alongside us."
0a3e84b5-c796-44df-8e5a-a6b2011dbc74: "A brilliant idea, Your Grace. Kesten would have been proud to know his example will inspire new generations of the barony's defenders."
0d42ec0d-796a-4e93-aef5-02d113d4aca0: {n}Jhod bows.{/n} "Thank you. I will personally attend to all matters related to this decision you've made."
d557cd14-2b5d-4b1d-9410-bf80d51076c3: {n}Jhod is silent for a moment, then sighs.{/n} "There's truth to what you say, Your Grace. We must think of the barony, not just our lost associates."
b791b4b7-a348-4c21-966d-b92793b23b29: "You ungrateful... That 'failure' didn't hesitate to give is life defending you and this barony of yours!" {n}Jhod shakes his head, his face red.{/n} "I... have to go. I'm sorry to take your time."
2abaa8a3-1ff9-42e6-bdc2-fb6912f834e7: "I'll return to my regular duties, then. Thank you for your time." {n}Jhod bows and turn to leave.{/n}
8735d38f-a0ee-4629-a86a-0ecc2fe83fd8: "Today was hard... But I'm alive – and that means hope still lives."
b1c52064-9dab-4529-8607-af4b9e6870a2: "I could heal you, but you keep shunning me and looking at me sideways."
2c97f2b0-48d9-40d0-955b-3c68a1a74865: "Poor thing! How can I help? I could sit beside you and sigh compassionately."
cc335c13-cfd2-421a-8aad-cf50292ba380: "I agree to make a deal with you."
e8978726-e321-4752-801e-270fddd2c86e: "I take no interest either in you or your weapons."
ea655478-3ded-4970-8a95-12b0088c959d: {n}A stunning elven lady turns to you. Her hair is immaculate, and her eyes are deep water. Her beauty is like a bird of prey. She is also heavily armed. As she sees you, her superior air fades, leaving a charming smile on her face.{/n}
3f1971ea-76e1-410b-bbee-f220877497a9: {n}The elven lady nods politely.{/n} "Will you help me? I promise, this deal won't make you sorry."
d8845799-b5de-419d-b8e4-c037caf53347: "Of course. Return to me immediately, if you decide to sign the contract."
32cd2611-77d5-4276-a9ee-9633611475c3: "An artist, one of a kind. I create weapons. Not just pointy iron sticks, but real weapons." {n}Nazrielle raises her eyebrows meaningfully.{/n} "Alas, not every domain appreciates high quality – and expensive – blades. I hope you'll be a generous {mf|patron|patroness} and an appreciative {mf|connoisseur|connoisseuse}!"
30110097-5dab-4fcf-93bd-2e360ac9bc42: "I hope to start serving you in exchange for your protection. You see, my creations are not to everyone's liking. In the lands where I come from, demand for artful blades is low. The heavier and cheaper ones are better for peasants. I had to swallow my pride and do such work merely to survive."
b86236db-3a5d-4920-bb6a-58a8a449efd8: {n}Nazrielle's eyes shine with excitement. She hands you a pen and paper.{/n} "Thank you! Sign here, please... and here. Done! All right! As soon as I'm settled, I'll send one of my people to deliver your order."
5583570d-ecf9-42e9-b3b2-10391e7f9e95: "How fortunate! {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}, allow me to introduce myself. I am Nazrielle the weaponsmith. As soon as I found out you were here, I dispatched one of my apprentices, but of course the bonehead failed his mission. Would you like to hear an offer that would be to our mutual benefit?"
eda4b5d6-1b1d-4a54-9828-866c156c5cf4: "I know that serving you will allow me to earn true recognition! I'm offering you a contract. You will provide me a workplace and all the necessary resources, and I shall fill your arsenal with perfect instruments of death. c2d13065-38b5-45d6-aa7e-e688ed24857a: {n}The elven lady bites her lip.{/n} "That's a shame. Well, I'll be on my way – to a place where my talents will be truly appreciated!"
e462565b-38fa-4c34-914c-41dd738cbc51: "All you need to do is sign the contract and place your first order." {n}The elven woman shows you a leather case with a prepared contract.{/n} "Do we have a deal?"
913336b4-95c6-4e83-830d-3827671abb5f: {g|Loyalty3_1}[Choice effects]{/g} [Gain 30 BP] "Arrest that shifty merchant immediately! He'll answer for selling stolen goods, even if it happened before my time."
c4a9c903-898e-4f57-8fa1-0a014afc9e69: "I'd prefer to forget about this minor matter."
72526c2a-8e3f-4f22-ae04-800b65764c74: "Why don't you make your own decision?"
8e75654f-451d-4a04-b20f-4f37d6fbcddc: {g|Loyalty3_3}[Choice effects]{/g} "I will issue an order for free pardons. Let the peasants keep out their countrymen's business."
2c9b059c-4f7d-4d1f-93d4-533111c54e30: {g|Loyalty3_4}[Choice effects]{/g} "Turn him over to the people. Let them do with him whatever they wish."
23870f4c-2023-4a04-a0ea-a7a36af0d2a6: {n}There is a look of determination on Tristian's face.{/n} "I bring bad news from your subjects. Today one of our citizens stopped me in the street, and asked me to tell you something of import." {n}Tristian ponders a while, as if he doesn't dare continue.{/n}
dfafe088-0ab4-44ab-a19b-e1887503d513: "{mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. A woman approached me on the street and asked me to tell you of, as she put it, a 'great injustice' in the capital."
10b6cace-fc21-4a2b-8108-7ffbd87046a5: "You see... one of the traders, who today sells imported specialties in the capital, has not always led an honest life. Under the Stag Lord, he helped the bandits sell stolen goods – for a percentage, of course. 9a17c072-0175-401e-a652-328b8fffb833: "I never rush to judgment. But you must at least arrest this merchant, to question him and give him a chance to repent. 2472ba6a-2e1e-452a-b5aa-86cf097271bb: "It appears that one of the merchants doing business in the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom} has been keeping silent about his previous ties to the Stag Lord and his bandits. The merchant was away on the day you defeated the Stag Lord, and since then he's kept a low profile. The informant who brought this matter to our attention asks that you to give this trader his due."
f11f466c-3952-4d46-9a16-8ffd85254354: "I fear the people will continue to demand punishment for any who were able to profit during the times of trouble. Don't give these squealers any more reason to stir up trouble, or you'll never hear the end of it."
f8e5de58-92b4-4d6c-8771-ccbb83bd92b0: "I shall order that this merchant be detained. Of course we will fully investigate all these rumors and get to the truth before we judge him."
f2028319-b147-4b51-9451-01063cb81d80: {n}You see Shandra purse her mouth for a moment.{/n} "I won't lie to you, saying I understand your decision. In this situation I would act quite differently. However, you are certainly in your own right."
e60e1979-9c55-47fb-a769-51eeefe2a457: {n}Tristian looks away.{/n} "I can't agree with this decision... but I understand your reasons." {n}The priest says no more, and falls deeply into thought.{/n}
994155cd-3cb4-41cf-ba8e-befbc8192a61: "Hmm. If you think that will be enough..."
cfcfc659-5c4c-4f4f-9a99-a4c2f4c5c91f: {n}Tristian sighs.{/n} "I will handle this. To do so, I will need to detain this merchant and speak with him. I'll see to it personally."
150a5967-4073-447e-aa20-7cb5d9285883: "Then I shall draft the general pardon. I am sure this will make all our lives more peaceful."
722e0fb7-7101-4e04-ae64-dc90823aa45b: "A wonderful decision, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. I shall prepare the order for you."
65fb0122-b7af-4afa-bec4-05f1b68a62d6: "{name}, my confidants tell me of a wicked person in the capital. Under the Stag Lord's reign, he trafficked in the bandits' stolen goods, but today he wears the mask of a decent man. But we know his hands are stained with blood from his ill-gotten gold."
1a93d7bb-7732-4593-8ee9-10697ea4a45a: "Oh, you deprive yourself of a pleasure... It's a genuine delight to look into the eyes of a man, chased down by a pack."
465d7460-efcf-4d57-a1d3-6f6a598dcece: "Your pack will never forget. If you fail to exercise your authority, then someday someone will seize it for themselves. That will be the consequence of your mistake."
b519d0e1-c4d9-44de-8793-9dfa2987cb03: "I'll put out the word you no longer take an interest in this merchant's life or well-being. Then we'll find the perfect spot to watch the chase!"
04a6009d-9d13-4159-b9dc-4d3749dfef5a: "The people who were robbed by his cohorts surely know all about him. And surely, they want revenge. I expect he's not the only one in the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}. Whatever we subject him to, the same will happen to all the others who laid down with the bandits."
d0182a60-b258-4129-b6ed-f3ea70032e69: "What would you like to do with him? Grant him your protection? Send him to prison? 649525e7-6a85-420a-b04d-d3ce5acfd587: "I am clearly addressing someone important, but I don't believe we've met."
1c6ef1a3-36ff-40a3-b91b-bb08db170be5: "Perhaps Pitax would benefit from somebody who has a history of vanquishing bandits."
f5d5a7bd-edd3-4b56-921c-7a6ab6cccbe7: "I overheard you talking about stolen shipments. Is there a problem?"
c3ef61cd-ca30-403a-8a71-11360fd1f958: {n}Several concerned dockworkers crowd around a finely dressed half-elf, who listens to the workers with imperious dignity.{/n}
0c431f2c-86ea-47c5-ae4b-42e2f33ea975: {n}A bright sash cuts across this man's chest, identifying him as a magistrate of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}. 6dad5a62-8879-499c-a921-97fe73b6d18b: "It's as we've been tellin' you, judge. This is the third shipment in two months they've stolen from us."
fbbc8b39-9846-4824-9e81-418ec38a5b5f: "Can't keep that up — doesn't matter how good the last year's business been. No cargo means no pay, and no pay means no new shipments!"
0ab69819-b56b-48e9-871c-f259cbe28b1d: "We asked you about the thefts before, and there's nothing changed. Where's the king's justice, your honor?"
9244b3a0-a127-4362-b25c-384fd0d841ad: {n}The half-elf patiently motions for silence. {/n}"It is true that pirates have taken root along the {g|Pitax River}Pitax River{/g} and attacked several shipments heading upriver. The king has-" {n}he pauses, noticing you for the first time. He adjusts his posture to stand taller and straightens his sash of office before continuing. {/n}"King Irovetti shall address the problem soon, however he will hear no formal complaints until after the {g|Rushlight river}Rushlight{/g} Tournament. If anyone has further questions or concerns, I am at your disposal."{n} The gathered workers grumble and disperse, barely mollified by this response.{/n}
81239369-2f0c-4581-ae71-2405b8cc4ad9: {n}The half-elf motions to his sash.{/n} "I am the honorable Walsh Celvoway, a magistrate of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, judge of the people's concerns, and executor of the king's justice."
354934fb-6c58-4f6f-b13d-d6c811bd40c1: "Ah yes, that."{n} He sets his teeth into a practiced smile, though his teeth briefly grind together.{/n} "An outbreak of river piracy has caused some consternation among the citizens. Simply avoid or exercise caution near {g|Littletown}Littletown{/g} in the meantime."
810e9bfc-19d3-4140-94c4-1d0d9ca227ca: "Let us be clear," {n}declares the magistrate, narrowing his eyes with disdain.{/n} "{g|Pitax}Pitax's{/g} armed forces are entirely capable of handling these criminals. 31e271d7-1858-4c86-aba0-fe765955d6c1: "How can he be so deaf to the people's woes? And he calls himself a judge?"
088bc61f-b6be-480f-8a92-c1e2421acd7b: "Ah, a fellow judge. I'm sure this is the most sincere, kindhearted, charitable person you could find around here." {n}Jaethal smirks.{/n}
a5e68bf8-4336-4a37-9e2d-7975ef06fc2f: "I knew a judge once. She spent nights butchering her own kin, then went on to become a zombie. This guy seems fine by comparison!"
b981499b-69cc-43fa-90e1-fd575b64ecc9: "I can understand his reluctance to allow foreigners to meddle in his kingdom's affairs. What I cannot understand is such blatant negligence of justice and the safety of his subjects."
5699c578-c840-4e5d-9d92-11194db8e5f5: "Animating the dead? I had no idea you could do that."
92ee7e11-9d45-4cb8-a8b0-937727418d74: "Jaethal, what are you going to do with this poor girl?"
c0eb1894-7610-41a3-8921-bdc9d788513b: "I've made a decision. The girl should not die. Being undead is better than being dead."
14d6d6a3-c925-48ac-b119-0992e2dca69e: "I've made a decision. You should allow the poor girl to die, Jaethal. This is her wish, plus — for some, eternity might not be a gift."
b170e17a-adfc-41a4-a350-84bb5208967e: "Who was this wanderer who claimed that Jaethal was chasing you?"
10fac4de-205e-42d5-a7e0-9be28dd136b0: "I'm sure that someone laid a false track straight to the elven camp, and convinced the elves that we were hunting them. Everything points to this."
6dd3ee4a-011a-4bb7-88c4-499e5346aea2: "I've heard enough of this story. Let us go."
c46cec36-bca3-41e7-a7ad-5df394025f02: "If Enneo really deceived both us and these elves, forcing us to shed innocent blood, then he must be made to pay."
8d3be171-d127-4ac1-8eaf-2ea0116cafa8: "I do not know who to believe in this story. Did the merchant deceive us, or is this girl lying?"
66734627-1501-47bc-a666-60d01be50645: "I respect cunning and intrigue. But anyone who tries to use them against me will deeply regret it."
399ea524-e2c9-4b6d-8628-5e68e676cebf: "We cannot be sure of anything. Let's go to the capital and talk to Enneo again."
14eb733f-28c9-407d-b909-9d3b9c25c1a6: "The elves deserved to die. Their naivety and stupidity alone are good enough reasons to kill them."
d147a4fe-c439-4991-bee7-5a0ecff38ed4: {n}Jaethal freezes in front of the dead elven girl. 0b2cf0a7-4744-4367-aca5-debeb04c1685: {n}With a blank look in her eyes, Jaethal passes her hand above the girl's body. The feeling of an oppressive force, cold and painful, becomes nearly physical. Jaethal looks at her in amazement, as if she surprised by what she has done.{/n}
d788aafb-c1ea-4cb3-8ea5-58b715065bda: "I... sense the touch of my goddess." {n}Jaethal stares at the elven girl.{/n} "So that's it... I knew that I hadn't fully mastered the powers granted me, and here's the proof. A new side to my gift."
ce852ab9-49b6-4665-b7bc-9632c69ef92f: "I never knew of this side of my power. Something has awakened in me... the ability to share {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa's{/g} gift." {n}Jaethal studies her newly created undead with the look of a sculptor contemplating her creation. Withering under this stare, the undead girl begins to tremble.{/n}
501ace5a-eda9-4ada-aa44-60b5c3e1f5cb: "The same 'foul witchcraft' that brought me back to life. And I prefer to call it a 'divine gift'." {n}Jaethal looks at the elven girl as if admiring well-crafted work.{/n}
239fcef2-5d6c-4a8e-87e8-938b18bfdcfd: "What have you done to me?! What is this?!"
9b449df3-373e-4576-b7c8-3f5f3ad6a42c: "I saved you from oblivion — you and all your beauty, foolish child. Now you bear {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa's{/g} gift, just as I. You are 'undead' — if you prefer the word used by uncomprehending narrow minds."
ea84349b-bb19-408c-8491-556108d85329: "No... no... e19316aa-d4e0-4c7d-8c98-5173732885a0: "I will not harm her... and I will not let her harm herself. She is frightened, and does not understand the gift she just received. ceccb90b-414e-4f82-a5c2-2da613bf5d28: {n}The wide eyes of the elven girl are filled with confusion.{/n} "We only meant to protect ourselves! fd3ea22a-84ef-4e9e-8843-bfa8b546b81f: "No one can be forced into happiness, Jaethal," {n}Tristian says passionately.{/n} "Especially with such a 'gift'. {name}, please — end this poor soul's torment. Let her die as she wishes!"
23447d6a-eeb6-4df0-8a8a-a2c234d2e971: "I hope, Jaethal, that you feel sorry for the senseless death of this unfortunate girl, and wish to help her in your way. — And you're not just entertaining yourself, as you usually do."
83b569ef-e174-4da7-9a45-d0647c29534b: "We knew him as Wanderer, but it's only a nickname. I do not know what his true name is. He is a half-elf. Please! I don't know anything else. Release me. Every moment in this lifeless body drives me mad."
93b6405c-1cba-4cee-84b6-5553f675d250: {n}With a sharp, awkward movement, like a hinged doll, the elf bends her neck and rests her head on her shoulder, silently looking at you with wide, empty eyes.{/n}
5cf60d9a-75db-46ed-b460-73e663ba2090: {n}Jaethal frowns.{/n} "I cannot disobey my patron and master of these lands. However, I hope that you will not make a habit of disposing of valuable resources like that. Such waste is bad for both the ruler and {mf|his|her} subjects."
6c00f33d-93bc-44e6-b196-62379d01d43e: "Can't believe I say it, but I agree with the corpsy one. Everyone can fall down and die. You don't need no bravery or brains for that. d71643c2-131a-4aa7-815c-08313f015e21: "Why would someone prolong the senseless agony of being, when one can be finished with it once and for all? I do not like this." {n}Harrim shakes his head in condemnation.{/n}
f2157ef8-05d9-42c2-8deb-93f0bf6a0daf: "Wonderful. I shall send her to the capital and find some useful tasks for her."
baefef50-9c1c-4d48-afc6-fcbf94027969: "And we know who did this, do we not? A sudden appearance, a dagger, a false trail... The {d|Enneo}half-blood{/d} will have many questions to answer. a366b1b1-af98-4d05-80b6-d2aa50f332e7: "You do not even want to know what really happened? Well, I already have some ideas about it. And someone — namely, the damned {d|Enneo}half-blood{/d} — will have many questions to answer on our return to the capital."
1d1df0f4-6a33-4e3c-a5e6-6a5d64c9a0eb: "So far, it all points to one thing — the {d|Enneo}half-blood{/d} lied to us. And he did not merely lie. It was he who killed me in the wastelands. 9eb5ad99-0b97-4765-b10b-e5b8cad2df2e: "You see, now we both have something to ask the half-blood about. This will be amusing. Let us hurry to the capital!"
46cbc3d2-b68e-4569-8a25-0424e9bf79bb: "True. Let's hurry to the capital. I'm looking forward to seeing… my killer."
c8df7f6b-b4c9-4aed-a55a-f70aa445c3c6: "Certainly. Let's have a little chat." {n}Jaethal seems stony calm and indifferent, but this indifference is more frightening than anger. {/n}"Let us hurry!"
7efdf56d-4b53-4742-8f12-c3b99c8eafde: "You may be right. Still, I always feel sorry when youth and beauty are wasted. But let's hurry to the capital! We have much to discuss with the half-blood."

45c39cbe-0a1d-4486-97f5-fe2181488377: "What were you looking for here? Why did you need all this?"
640f556b-f16d-4ac9-9012-302fdb7342ac: [Attack] "Enough. We will fight to settle our dispute."
4684de77-e0ef-4d3b-853e-7b7abd1325c2: "I don't think we need to fight. Let's resolve this peacefully."
5d986976-2e87-41b7-84ea-0e6b1b51fdbc: "I know you are a Pitaxian spy."

16705d39-6b90-4f7e-9c12-d9fd41a080c2: "Don't take me for an idiot, I am not going to tell you anything. Even despite the fact I am going to kill you. By the way, did you know I am going to kill you?"
d8903fb9-dad1-499f-b54b-74c84d996a72: "We do, dimwit, we really do. You know too much. And truth be told, I am simply tired of you!"
4ccc02bd-3c60-49e1-8d05-0ed65dbfb8f3: "And this is the person I nearly made the hero of my book? Ew!"
d06b8a4d-87c1-4971-a7c7-6870ec30cc10: "Without a doubt, vice does have its advantages. However, in the end it always — you hear me, always! — gets what it rightfully deserves!"
5b884e10-cbc8-4b8b-8787-3436cfcf360c: "But you don't know my mission. And won't ever know, because I will never tell you. Even for the pleasure of seeing your discouraged face."
521f68c5-4cd6-463a-a5d1-d2050b97e0e4: "I've received your letter, Kesten, and came as soon as I could."
e173be6e-4dc2-4dc9-b86a-791222c7f701: "I must leave now. Wait for me here."
e647ff86-1773-45a3-853e-133f49618c9f: "I'm ready, Kesten. Let's get those cultists".
1d565619-1beb-4657-8042-0b31465150ff: {n}Seeing you, Kesten nods. Under his coat you notice a suit of armor, a sword hangs at his belt — the guard is ready to fight. {/n}

92a006ce-466b-4199-903f-c33f4e5fdcd8: "Thank you, Your Grace. I've decided you'd like to see this place with your own eyes"
