5c8be6b7-f295-4c31-b66a-35c9cab3edfc: "The day is right, and the time is coming. All we have to do now is wait until the cultists gather to their coven. I hope you're ready to fight."

2e23efc1-662c-4a1c-846c-99a9a571525e: {n}Kesten frowns.{/n} "Not much, Your Grace, but I've heard some things. 15d41aff-3f61-4281-9cdc-4b170e47122e: {n}Nok-Nok stomps around angrily.{/n} "Is place to worship and praise, and what we? We mess around! {g|Lamashtu}Mother of Beasts{/g} will be pissed!"

9187a206-87e0-457f-88dc-4b2ca1831484: {g|Relations2_3}[Choice effects]{/g} "I agree with your proposal. Set the fines as you see fit."
8eae5eb4-0192-4054-8873-7e9acd360668: "You can deal with this without me."
d7c0ea61-b00d-436f-a6c9-e5907a669bbd: "This will only take a moment! Really, it's nothing. But I do need your advice!"

54ea34ca-8a9e-46ff-94d8-d8b8a954e61a: "Chúng ta đã quét sạch một hang troll gần đây, bằng cách nào đó chúng kháng được lửa. Ta muốn chắc rằng những con mới với cùng khả năng kháng đó sẽ không xuất hiện. Ngươi có tình cờ biết gì về chuyện này không?"
154ef7c7-7311-44cb-8860-6715a3db7007: "Ngươi đi trước đi. Chúng ta cần chuẩn bị cho trận chiến trước đã."
dca35f2f-91fc-47f7-9fc9-25cab1a7e80c: "Do you know anything about the local trolls who are resistant to fire?"
c8d339bb-e739-42cf-9428-2f28af06d895: "You seem to be an educated man. What are you doing in these woods?"
3076f029-b4de-44f5-a412-0d1ae700a468: "Mấy cái bẫy trong rừng — của ngươi à?"
3e6cb00c-39fa-48fd-971e-1e748a30f385: "Con troll đá trong khu rừng gần đây — có thật không?"
aaef9153-d96f-4450-9dfc-bac9066e3695: "Còn bọn cướp địa phương thì sao? Chúng có quấy rầy ngươi ở đây không?"
7064d55c-5716-4418-8169-f58499887e04: "Đôi khi ngay cả những kẻ biết đọc cũng sa vào bẫy của ngươi. Chẳng hạn một lái buôn tên Waine."
de2783cf-5172-44ed-9281-9845777ff14b: "Một câu hỏi về mấy cái bẫy..."
2f7ae2fc-2e61-4f59-84a0-242e5e4225a9: "Ngươi đã thực hiện lệnh của ta chưa?"
d8e07fec-3090-408e-b6b0-76690f928f29: "Nghiên cứu của ngươi thế nào rồi?"
42d2b699-e019-4c37-ad67-1e601f4decb3: "Thôi, chúc ngươi may mắn với công việc."
a3719dfd-1cc8-4020-895b-75766a733c4b: "Thí nghiệm của ngươi không an toàn — dừng ngay lập tức. Và giết con troll đi."
cf61470c-db57-4756-bb18-50eb4a81d428: "Ta chưa từng nghe chuyện nào như thế! Ta hy vọng không con thú nào sống sót, nếu không ta sẽ phải xem lại phòng tuyến của mình..." {n}Bartholomew lập tức im bặt, cau mày, và nhắm mắt lại.{/n}
0d26cb76-4e33-4ff5-90ba-b3d06c7910b6: {n}Bartholomew đón ngươi bằng một ánh nhìn dài, ủ rũ.{/n} "Chào ngày tốt lành... thưa {mf|Nam tước|Nữ Nam tước}."
587faf63-e8fa-49f9-b197-c98673ea7bad: "I've never heard anything like it! If this is true, I'll have to revise my defenses..." {n}Bartholomew suddenly goes silent, frowns, and closes his eyes.{/n}
e1291386-31f3-4574-80dc-c8e59679d552: "Your Grace, I'm afraid we must intermit that conversation for now. A moment ago, a troll was caught in one of my fire traps... and it was unharmed. I suggest that a chance to explore its corpse would better equip me to answer your questions."
13709b2c-099e-4642-b975-a9e6b19490b4: "My liege, I humbly request your protection. Please, follow me."
3cf69df6-47e6-49fb-ab54-36e45c3cc8d7: "Mau lên nếu có thể. Nó ở phía tây nơi đây, không xa. Ngươi không thể lạc chỗ đó được."
4685a877-f3f4-4850-a2a6-e9e06c3a5c36: "Ta chỉ là một nhà nghiên cứu khiêm nhường trong lĩnh vực khoa học bí truyền, và ta chọn nơi này để làm việc trong yên bình, tránh xa sự ồn ào của thành phố. Khi môi trường tĩnh lặng và không khí trong lành, mực cứ như van nài được đặt lên giấy!"
a57e2a43-98dc-4807-9e48-c4d540d87ddb: "Ta chỉ là một kẻ hầu khiêm nhường của {mf|Nam tước|Nữ Nam tước} của mình," {n}gã phù thủy đáp lạnh lùng.{/n}
6c4bf65d-2744-47de-9671-9cb11b601915: {n}Octavia bật cười.{/n} "Và chẳng có hàng xóm thô lỗ nào than phiền về tiếng nổ, khói, hay những tiếng thét rùng rợn!"
618bf2d4-0a5b-41a8-8dbd-158a45c252a2: {n}Octavia trừng mắt nhìn gã phù thủy.{/n} "Nhà nghiên cứu…? Đồ tra tấn thì có!"
4f3dd887-a6f7-4e46-b10c-99751a65b673: {n}Bartholomew nở nụ cười chua chát.{/n} "Ừ, cái đó cũng quý giá ngang vậy."
4b60189e-a735-4c8b-bfa7-a5bf6dda036c: {n}Bartholomew vờ như không nghe thấy lời nhận xét.{/n}
9b119752-d430-4a92-aaca-3f96b5c9465c: "Đúng, của ta đấy. Ngươi thấy đấy, dù ta vui khi đón khách, ta thích những kẻ có khả năng nói năng mạch lạc hơn. Ta chẳng hứng thú cũng chẳng muốn phí thời gian đánh đuổi mọi con quái vật mò tới chỗ ở của mình. Nhưng ta có để một lối đi an toàn cho những ai biết đọc. Ta thậm chí còn dựng một tấm biển. Hẳn ngươi đã thấy nó."
9e37cbff-eed3-4f06-89be-e8001ee33d34: "Ta nghi ngờ mình có thể kể cho ngươi điều gì thú vị," {n}Bartholomew lầm bầm mà không nhìn vào mắt ngươi.{/n}
00ce24ed-94e6-44a7-9e5c-1b54b18782ce: {n}Amiri cau mày.{/n} "Thì đã sao nếu có người không biết đọc?"
c96c2ddb-5ad3-4627-894c-d56a7ab82f41: {n}Bartholomew nhún vai.{/n} "Biết chữ là một trong những thành tựu quan trọng nhất của nhân loại! Tin ta đi, những cái bẫy của ta còn chẳng đáng là gì so với những hiểm nguy tồi tệ nhất đe dọa bất kỳ ai chọn ở lại trong bóng tối ngu dốt. Dù vậy, ta nghĩ nếu có dịp gặp một họa sĩ ở đây, ta có thể nhờ họ thêm một bức tranh vào biển cảnh báo của ta."
ee4789b7-3a05-4e50-b655-bc65dba4c667: "I'm always happy to help those who seek knowledge."
e6123f84-ed7e-465b-8844-742bf1b63267: "Ồ, đúng vậy. Thực ra ta khá tự hào về con đó. Ngươi thấy đấy, troll hiếm khi bỏ mạng trong bẫy. Nếu chúng thoát được một cái, sự ranh ma của loài thú thường giúp chúng tránh được các bẫy khác. Nhưng con troll đá đó bị mắc bẫy ngay trước bình minh, nên nó không có cách nào tránh được bình minh. Giờ nó cứ đứng đó, như một kiểu vật trưng bày... Vừa hữu ích cho nghiên cứu của ta, vừa là vật canh chừng những vị khách không mời."
df70cee4-06f9-4fa2-9e0e-fea77f3f64ed: "Chúng từng thử một lần. Giờ chúng cố hết sức tránh xa. Chúng chỉ xuất hiện khi không còn lựa chọn nào khác, và ngay cả khi đó chúng cũng chỉ lịch sự nhờ ta phù phép cho tên của chúng."
df33dc2d-186a-4c1a-ac61-447ce2eac718: "Và ngươi vui vẻ giúp chúng sao?!"
dc07cd08-c6b4-4ac4-bc8d-2e84c651b59d: "Just because someone asks me to do something doesn't mean I actually do it," {n}Bartholomew says with a shrug.{/n} "Though to be honest, in these parts, you can't really tell a local bandit from a peaceful hunter based on looks alone."
64a921fa-717a-4088-b9b3-807983afcdd2: "Ôi, Waine... Thành thật mà nói, ta tự hỏi trong đầu hắn nghĩ gì mà cứ thế lao vào rừng, dù biết rõ hiểm nguy. Hiển nhiên, nếu ngươi không cứu hắn, ta đã... chỉ muộn hơn một chút thôi. Sau khi hắn học được bài học của mình."
1f0e15dc-9ba6-4332-bd77-33de84e365e7: "Vô cùng đáng tiếc, kỹ năng biết đọc đơn thuần không phản ánh năng lực tư duy phản biện. Waine đã ghé qua vài lần và được cảnh báo về những cái bẫy nhiều lần. Ta thương gã, nhưng số phận của gã là lỗi của chính gã, ngươi không nghĩ vậy sao? Cũng như thể có ai đó giật một bình axit từ bàn của ta và nhấp một ngụm; ta khó mà chịu trách nhiệm cho nỗi đau thể xác của họ, đúng không nào?"
ae9ed537-e3c8-4f04-a12d-8ed258fd2528: {n}Bartholomew gật đầu, sẵn sàng thỏa mãn sự tò mò của ngươi.{/n}
2b19e91e-a87d-4be4-8bae-9120800455b8: "Vâng, thưa Đức Ngài," {n}Bartholomew lầm bầm.{/n} "Ta đã thả con thú vào rừng. Nếu ngài gặp nó, cho ta gửi lời hỏi thăm."
fdc642c6-4afa-4892-9d3b-a25cc086be55: "Vâng, thưa Đức Ngài," {n}Bartholomew lầm bầm.{/n} "Ngài đã tận mắt thấy nó. Ít ra ta đã thu được vài dữ liệu hữu ích từ cái xác. Hy vọng ngài hài lòng."
3f175e5d-71f2-4a72-8bc4-59176fbfa919: {n}Octavia mỉm cười với Bartholomew, vừa đủ để không thành đắc thắng.{/n}
459f10fe-5892-4cb1-8ddc-ea019d0f0970: {n}Octavia ném về phía ngươi một ánh nhìn lạnh lẽo.{/n}
e32f2312-5508-4724-b4b4-a50094b3b345: "Ta không nói dối, vẫn còn nhiều việc phải làm — nhiều năm nghiên cứu. Đó chẳng phải việc nhỏ với ta và với... trợ lý của ta. Dù vậy, phải sẵn sàng hy sinh vì tri thức!"
15d5db5f-3368-4f43-bf3f-a6e7e278c528: {n}Mắt Bartholomew mở to — rồi nheo lại.{/n} "Ta không dám phản đối… thưa Đức Ngài."
f6097839-ed49-45c8-b0a3-ef3d1386705a: [Pay 23 gold] "I'd like to spend the night here."
5efd67d4-ab22-43d6-b39e-7762ffd1fb0e: {n}An elderly barbarian waves his hand, inviting you to come closer.{/n} "Welcome, honored guest! Would you like to buy or sell anything?"
c56060b0-24e1-4989-bd99-cfd73814589d: "Name's Dug. Was a hell of a fighter when I was younger, but truth, those years pass before you know it. The health, too." {n}The barbarian raises his hand, and you can see he only has two fingers left.{/n} "So now my job is equipment and provisions, along with a bit of trading from time to time."
d3f7eb0f-c87a-4236-8770-832e56567077: {n}The aged barbarian gives you a hospitable nod.{/n}
8e7cb6b1-99d7-42db-86fc-4db680696669: "Haven't sacrificed anything to Mother in a long time. Need to find someone. Someone… special."
9333d380-a0da-421a-b8a7-2a37aede11f6: "If Linzee disappears everyone notices. Shame. Would make great sacrifice."
7decdaa3-0af2-4a6e-b050-42e8406b49f9: "I think Kanerah is very angry with you..."
17908102-d687-4538-bd3b-4cbd671639cc: "Will you continue to serve me despite the death of the Sweet Teeth?"
2dd20d50-0637-4437-a39a-436ff46dc238: "I need to talk to your sister."
3d00e59a-d104-4c0f-bc38-ba7f5f33ec5c: "Did you understand what the Forefather was trying to achieve?"
03fd7da1-77c9-4445-853b-26bd8d21193c: "You seem unhappy that Kalikke and I decided to summon you to save the Sweet Teeth."
147c2a32-b797-482f-a572-6b68804f749f: "I'm surprised you and Kalikke didn't get into a fight..."
31a0ff83-0524-4d8c-9e89-07be2c81c174: "I think your sister is in despair. You hurt her feelings."
942eb70b-0bf4-4de6-9d12-7d80c6c20889: "Did you understand what the Forefather was trying to achieve?"
05af2603-c960-4b45-b903-f4d82f1a0a05: "Are you upset that I didn't let you summon Kanerah, and we barely saved the Sweet Teeth?"
5cf4357b-c0fe-49c4-9d6f-2653f3a0931b: "I need to talk to your sister."
0140cfdb-52b8-4091-b270-20a3d2a1294a: {n}Kalikke gives you a grateful smile touched with sadness.{/n} "It's been a difficult time for me. Thank you for asking..."
66932e35-7c9a-4328-92ad-235a1b249101: "You have the right to answers. Ask."
2e37e1b0-5723-43eb-bbf2-142679fdcc3e: "Is that some kind of wicked joke? Don't ask empty questions."
b0b42af9-6c47-4db6-b399-83644aa682b7: "Amazing, isn't it? Yes, I'm quite all right... for someone who was used as bait for an evil monster from Abaddon..."
4195c765-9ff7-481d-8da4-381a8fa90fbb: "I'm surprised. Between everything that's going on in your lands, you find interest in such a trifle as a devil's plots and the family troubles of two lowly tieflings..."
f6da8cf1-0da3-488b-adf8-0b49822894c1: "You saw and heard everything. Back then, my heart was like a pot, boiling with scalding poison. I shouldn't be angry at my sister, I know... but I'm so tired. And it seems the nightmare we endured in Qadira has returned to us. Whatever we do, we keep hurting each other."
dc414a5c-ce99-4b32-b0ac-7fe6891d5253: "I... understand why you made this decision. It would be unfair to my sister to use her as bait for the monster. But I can't even think of letting the Forefather feed the Sweet Teeth to that beast. We tried to help everyone without making any sacrifices or putting anyone's life above the others. Something in me rises against this decision, but the more I think about it, the more I see the wisdom in it."
7b1e9b33-f6c2-401a-8908-70ff7a74b078: "You are my benefactor and patron. My debt to you has not yet been paid." {n}You hear respect in Kalikke's voice, but also detachment.{/n}
e8bfd847-4a62-403d-9cfa-f1150988aaeb: "Oh yes – he couldn't help explaining everything in great detail. The patronage that Nethys gave us weighs heavily on him. But despite all his might, the Forefather believes in rules. He imagines that if he forces us to break the deity's conditions, Nethys will turn away from us. Perhaps he's right. But – in spite of everything – I'm grateful for the taste of freedom I've received. I've had enough of pretending. I want to bear my true name, and not have to lie about everything all the time."
5f8c2164-e73a-42ad-a113-d9ec9852134f: "Of course. I'm sorry I can't talk to her myself. – I wish we could discuss everything in real life, not on the pages of a diary..."
fda3c610-dab2-4730-9b39-4bc8e8b9cb1e: "Like songs with missing verses... whatever you do, they'll never sound the same..."{n} Kalikke's voice becomes a whisper.{/n}
7d8e1770-2a28-487e-b92e-0e9a69503471: "I'd say I'm perfectly fine! Like I've started a new life, ha, ha! But seriously, I do feel better, now that the soul eater is no longer a threat..."
77cb1a32-10c7-4f22-9d52-74b3ad49b20e: "He explained everything – with his devilish dedication to details. He considers his offspring 'a valuable investment', and me – well, I'm his property, and my death didn't annul the contract! But I suspect he has another motive..."
7ce8f106-d01b-4ed6-98c2-82a4b61b3b8f: "You know, deimaviggas like the Forefather live for one thing: twisting the souls of believers in other deities, and bringing them under the reign of Asmodeus. Hell does not forgive mistakes, and the Forefather was well regarded there. But his 'valuable investments' slipped his grasp, to be rescued by another deity... That must be unbearable for him, and he will do anything it takes to take us back – or me, at least..."
d35daa83-8c01-4481-9b73-7e338130c21f: "I'm afraid all we can do is wait. The devil promised it's not yet the end, and that he'll make us break Nethys's other condition. I wish I knew how he's going to do that... because it means Kanerah and I will meet again..." {n}Kalikke swings her tail nervously.{/n}
a5f91879-b93a-4b70-97d2-4c065dd4be7a: "I'd say we should figure out how to stop the Forefather from carrying out his plan. He's stronger than you or I – it's only Nethys's power that keeps him at bay – for now. Only someone with a death wish would stand against a deity, or his herald. But for now, all we can do is wait..."
069c1ed9-eebf-4f8e-94d1-b8a298503617: {n}Kanerah sighs.{/n} "Of course! But cheer her up, would you? She must be all worked up, and she's been through so much..."
55bae4fc-2c4d-4509-a8d2-55c6bf3123eb: {n}Kanerah wrinkles her nose.{/n} "You are my patron. You have the right to give orders, and decide how to fight your battles. But the same is not true of my sister! She risked my life a second time, and that's not something I take lightly! Let me remind you – the first time I died, it was because of her virtuous trickery. I died alone, desperate, with a clear understanding of what was happening, and what fate awaited me." {n}Kanerah's face grows dark, and her tail thrashes the floor.{/n}
57fca5f0-df15-4389-8368-b33c42bb1982: "We can't, thanks to Nethys. It was a wise decision, dividing us with a time-plane wall! But seriously – the Forefather is as devious as they come... He found a way to trick us both. But everything turned out all right in the end... I suppose."
66edda4e-4ff9-4cbc-8aa4-6f73c219e0f7: "But I didn't do anything! However, were I the one to make this choice... I admit I feel a little sorry for the foolish Sweet Teeth, but I died once before, and I don't want to do it again. And Kalikke might, for once, have put her sister above that riffraff."
2d9fe662-0979-4036-b2c7-8b5de557578c: [Give the bully 500 gold] "Here. For the damage."
0c9717dd-0fda-4d8a-b2af-ff3230f99535: "Best not anger me. I've put away more people and monsters than you have bottles over the course of your waste of a life. Get out of here while you still can."
d9d74422-6c36-4739-8867-9ec007723374: [Knock the bully out with a stealthy blow]
0ed0003a-125a-425e-bedf-8d1e2b341f7e: "Why, is that Annamede Belavarah herself over there? And it looks like she's calling you!"
77fa966a-9f63-46b0-be13-a6d2f94335f0: {n}A young man staggers toward you, his expensive doublet wet with wine. As he passes, he brushes shoulders with you and starts yelling, his breath rank with alcohol.{/n} "Watch yourself! Who do you think you are, you pig?! You tramped on my foot and ruined my doublet, hic! I'm gonna... I demand satisfaction!"
08c4bdc6-942d-4623-ad11-0586e2deb173: "What? Forgive you? Hic! You bump me, ruin my doublet, and I'm supposed to just forgive you? Who's gonna clean this, huh? It's expensive! And you slopped wine all over it!"
810ce875-0eb2-47f2-9375-20e3cd2430e0: "Well, then, all right. Fine! You got off easy, though!" {n}The young man takes the money and leaves.{/n}
d542f978-359c-44ea-bc95-8f7fed1a404b: "I... Uh... Sorry, sorry. Think I — hic! — confused you for someone else... Sorry. My mistake. These things happen..." {n}Mumbling apologies, the bully disappears.{/n}
6b4cdf71-ecab-488d-965d-39c3796b4ad3: "Wait, you're threatening me? Ha ha! I'm... I'll... Single-handed, too! Come on, then, draw your weapon! I... I d-demand satisf- hic!"
8678ff55-e18f-4660-b2bf-236bfb9e2995: {n}No one notices as you drive a swift blow to the bully's solar plexus. It simply seems as though he swayed and leaned on you, after which you graciously helped him step away to lie down in the shade.{/n}
163f4564-01f9-44df-a53e-458451c8fd33: {n}After a swift blow to the solar plexus, the drunkard falls to the ground — but you immediately hear someone scream from behind you, calling for the guards.{/n}
60384690-8380-4751-9fd5-0d87eca4b560: "What? Really? Where? Oh... how do I look? Quickly, now! I'm all right? Phew, good. Annamede, my joy! I'll be right there!"
399b867b-3ee8-4723-b8de-d976453d1873: "Don't you smooth talk me, hic! I... You ruined my doublet! You jerk!"

e539cb32-14b7-42d7-8b09-4c5b87ff3e42: {n}The tiefling seems surprised.{/n} "Someone was here before us? Found the treasures and the artifact, but didn't take them? So strange... Well, we aren't going to use the Disk right now anyway, are we? We'll just take it to the capital and examine it there."

2d792b4c-609d-46ca-965e-d4d6fcb8287d: "Of course, the spiral comet is a symbol of Pharasma. Long ago, my goddess managed to break free from the grip of the {g|Pharasma}Lady of Graves{/g}. He's already tried to kill me twice."
ac7dbc71-3ac1-4a5b-9fd2-63ac28cd288b: "You can count on me. I'll hunt that half-blood even beyond death, if needed."
61532203-b0cf-43a4-91de-b5c110250f65: "I think in this case we are dealing with a solitary fanatic. Why kill us by the hands of some elven youths? In any case, your caution is understandable. I had thought I was doing enough to conceal my nature from the public. But It seems I must do more."
7143de7d-9c95-4d28-b3ae-53365d6b33d9: "Perhaps he's both fanatic and fool. He struck me down like a coward in the wastelands — only to see me rise again with renewed strength. 7fb31654-6e1b-4449-b13f-aa550b8ce450: "It's unsafe to set up camp in the open like this."
fcefb538-ec45-4559-b47d-996a8afcafb8: "Being this careless could cost us dearly."
982bcadc-fab0-4328-adfb-e52d23fa75fb: "Stop your whining, cleric. If someone jumps us, I'll save your hide!"
70848791-b3ae-47e1-a2f2-05138a7d3e59: "Each careless step taken is one step closer to Groetus. Surely you understand that everyone shall rest in his embrace in the end, no matter how carefully they try to delay the final moment?"
a16045d7-9a3c-41cc-9088-10f5f7675d36: "You are right. The art of camouflage has been developed over many centuries. It's unwise to neglect it!"
da4d4892-e48b-4eca-93a6-53e737806f7b: "You complain as though you'll be the one slicing up the monsters if they attack us, ha, ha, ha."
763de124-2700-4ca1-be16-c5c5cc64c018: "Jamandi, just what kind of game are you playing? I think I have the right to know."
1e79d58a-91e8-4835-afae-35d60cd03172: "What do I need to know about the history of Brevoy?"
25f53530-a1cf-417a-b476-bbd8abe548e3: "What do I need to know about the current political atmosphere?"
68f19f06-d5d7-43a5-90e9-51a3774f84cd: "What role do I play in your plans?"
dd0f515f-dba6-430e-bded-a64b419650ee: "If Natala is already here, why did she let you grant me the title?"
3cad9707-1437-47dc-9092-20078f419946: "Do you already know about my encounter with Tartuccio?"
ff036eb2-0b48-4ac1-87f1-5f4153735e48: "Thank you. I'm going to speak with the guests."
eae9f8ca-f8b7-41bc-bf63-efa4bf87687e: "What part does Restov play in this game?"
587b9ca7-3b8c-420e-9966-31e5fb1ba818: "Don't the Swordlords have any other foreign allies capable of playing this role?"
9251a461-d32a-41ed-9878-98d4f3e9d8cf: "May Abadar help us bring civilization to this savage land."
8c34ae97-60b9-4b0b-b7c2-5334a7a3f5e4: "Good work. Nice to see I haven't lost my intuition for people. Not many would have managed to set out to {g|Stolen Lands}the Stolen Lands{/g} and return with the Stag Lord's head, but I knew you could handle it."
8879c2ee-c832-43da-adc2-6fdbe89fdb34: "But matters of state can wait. For now, enjoy this feast in your honor. All the city leaders are here. It's a great opportunity to make some useful connections."
7015d7e5-b59c-4d53-a950-7b326c74ec17: "Speaking of connections, let me introduce you to Kassil Aldori. He's my adopted son and apprentice. He's a trustworthy man — I'd like to send him with you as an envoy."
12cea0f0-5358-4a75-aab7-b40a84706309: {n}Kassil, a young half-orc with impeccable poise, performs a textbook-perfect bow.{/n}
d5b977f3-7037-41c7-9749-ca878b1702b3: "Yes, you certainly have that right. But tell me, how well do you know {g|Brevoy}Brevoy's{/g} history, or the current political atmosphere? It won't be an easy explanation."
63114bf1-f763-4f58-92e1-36fe31de8f1d: "Don't think I'm trying to impose a nanny or a spy on you! We're neighbors now. 2ca3a29c-5f6e-43c8-90cd-f18b890cd1f0: "I hope you have a better understanding of what's at stake."
f02e7b16-842c-4b5b-9b95-1a63b8b93aa9: "Of course. Kesten gave me a full report. You dealt with the scoundrel perfectly. It would be naive to think that none of your neighbors will try to stick their hands in your affairs — especially that sly fox Irovetti!"
70bd1bf6-2799-491b-a09e-5aa29cbea9ce: "What's now called {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} was originally two different countries — {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g} and {g|Issia}Issia{/g}. Two hundred years ago, they were stuck in constant squabbles. Then {g|Choral}Choral the Conqueror{/g} showed up and united the two states into one. Such diplomatic tricks are easy to manage when you have dragons at your disposal."
b0020387-cec0-4345-aecb-3c6cf07ff4cb: "The so-called noble Houses of {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} — mainly {g|House Surtova}Surtova{/g}, {g|House Orlovsky}Orlovsky{/g}, and {g|House Lebeda}Lebeda{/g} — once ruled over {g|Issia}Issia{/g}. We, {g|Swordlords}the Aldori{/g}, ruled {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g}. {g|House Rogarvia}The Royal House Rogarvia{/g}, founded by {g|Choral}Choral the Conqueror{/g}, forced us into obedience. But two hundred years isn't long enough to make peace with such a troubled history — even two thousand years wouldn't be enough for us to accept Issian rule! Brevoy is a country held together by a thread, and that thread grows ever weaker."
01390472-3831-47c9-a9ea-a48e03e63d27: "We — {g|Swordlords}the Aldori{/g} and the Great noble Houses — spent two hundred years under the rule of invaders, {g|House Rogarvia}the Royal House Rogarvia{/g}. We plotted, we schemed, we stabbed each other in the back, but open confrontation was out of the question. But a few years ago, House Rogarvia... disappeared. No one knows how or why, but one day, their manors were just... empty. And the force that held {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} together, that kept us from a bloody feud... ceased to be."
49fafe22-eac5-4eb4-bd71-b437046b7c67: "{g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} is currently ruled by {g|House Surtova}the House Surtova{/g} — the former kings of {g|Issia}Issia{/g}. But their power pales in comparison to that of {g|House Rogarvia}House Rogarvia{/g}, when they were here. So now, Surtova and {g|Swordlords}Aldori{/g} stand facing each other, staring each other in the eye, waiting for the other to draw their sword. It's an untenable situation. No one wants a civil war that would drown Brevoy in blood... but peace between us is also out of the question."
9d92ebd7-5eea-4003-a7ae-094d6a2dc85b: "{g|Rostland}Rostland{/g} wants to regain its independence — and we will regain it. The power the {g|Issia}Issians{/g} hold over us is humiliating and costly. And the {g|House Surtova}Surtovas{/g} won't give us our freedom without a fight — that is, unless there's some external power that can force everyone to sit down and talk... Do you see where this is going?"
18bd13b5-dfcf-41ac-8ff6-0b93d7c2b82e: "{g|Stolen Lands}The Stolen Lands{/g} are disputed territory. {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} can't appropriate them without raising protests from each of the neighboring states. However, if some brave people were to found independent states on that land, it would be another matter entirely. My hope is that you and your future neighbors — Baron Hannis Drelev and Captain {d|Varn}Maegar Varn{/d} — will become our allies. But even your neutrality would introduce a powerful counterbalance to the aggression of the Noble Houses. Maybe, with your help, the inevitable division of Brevoy can occur without too much pain."
13284d30-47ef-4e26-9e27-a165d77cbe8e: "Actually, she could still intervene and disrupt the proceedings. But she's a {g|House Surtova}Surtova{/g} — their games are always complex and multilayered. Let's consider how she could do so."
d8f63b4d-797b-4756-8911-c7699173c570: "Maybe she understands that {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g} will inevitably separate, and she doesn't want a war. In that case, new states in {g|Stolen Lands}the Stolen Lands{/g} give the {g|Issia}Issians{/g} a reason to sit down and talk without losing face. But that's an optimistic view, and truth be told, it doesn't quite match up with what we've come to expect from the {g|House Surtova}Surtovas{/g}."
c7e0078d-63eb-459a-b8e8-a77bc4dfb18b: "The more likely scenario is that Natala wants to win you over to her side. If war breaks out and at least one of you stabs us in the back, {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g} will be surrounded by enemies. That might be enough to bring about our downfall... A piece of friendly advice: don't do business with {g|House Surtova}Surtovas{/g}, no matter what promises they make you. Any deal with the Noble Houses is a deal with devils."
baf1cfc5-c906-4768-85d2-790700767027: "How should I know? We're in the middle of a big game — and today you move from being merely a piece on the board to being one of the players."
170ec63c-5adf-469a-9eae-4e571fd5434e: "Enjoy your evening! When you're ready for the official part, come to me."
1feaddab-468e-41e8-aee0-e73e768c0f65: "{g|Restov}Restov{/g} is a free city, proud of its independence from everyone, including the {g|Swordlords}Aldori Swordlords{/g}. But when it comes to {g|Rostland}Rostland's{/g} liberation, our goals align. This whole plan is our joint creation with Lord Mayor Ioseph Sellemius."
22d77c96-8497-41e0-8e09-a4f1edc744c9: "You have pulled it off even {d|c11 Fast}faster{/d} than I expected. Very good: we were short of time, and these months you've won for us proved very useful. Lord Mayor Sellemius especially appreciated it, and asked me to give you this little token of gratitude."
1f92b807-7c17-4010-80b2-262b6555a2a2: "We hope to get some help from the Mivoni Aldori — the descendants of the {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g} who have fled from {g|Choral}Choral's{/g} rage to build a new nation in the south. But the {g|Issia}Issians{/g} know this well, and are doing everything they can to deny us this help. I won't go into details, but, if my intelligence is correct, if a civil war starts in {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}, {g|Mivon}Mivon{/g} will be too occupied with its own inner troubles to interfere."
075bdc94-f881-4b76-9d30-d8a916ba1dff: {n}Jamandi nods.{/n} "I will pray to the God of Walls and Ditches that he never leave your side. Though you can definitely expect more support from me than just thoughts and prayers!"
d39f9046-f604-4d0e-8f99-a7b1227ecc69: "You're right. Octavia and I are very close."
31f40081-b2c6-4763-9d2f-c4f6e4a5314f: "You're right. Regongar and I are very close."
36414940-32a7-43bb-9658-590e2d7ae1ac: "There's no place in my heart for anyone but you."
53270260-7cd1-4fbf-91cc-b435c51503c0: "I couldn't help but notice you have quite a... close relationship with someone from our entourage. I feel it's... let's say obscene, considering everything we've said between us." {n}Valerie looks at you, folding her arms across her chest.{/n}
d516f8e8-dbd9-4425-a520-eef662bbe798: {n}A thin smile appears on Valerie's face.{/n} "Oh, just that? In that case I won't keep you from having fun."
64ed8e4e-8937-45c7-9ce8-0260bed721bc: {n}Valerie grows pensive.{/n} "I'm sorry you decided to inform me about it only after I raised this question." {n}Valerie turns away.{/n}
f9cb63b8-ab4c-4f6e-9cae-c74a2b723b7c: {n}Valerie tilts her head.{/n} "Are you sure? I think you should clarify the situation with those who... who are close to you. And make sure everyone knows where things stand."
04f85809-5a5f-4f36-a4a6-34a4bb7aca3a: "Envoy Aldori is a curious type. I never expected to see a half-orc among the Swordlords."
0c6196a0-1dc9-469e-a38f-4c853e05a6c5: "A noble and brave heart makes for a true knight, not a person's ancestry. And Sir Kassil possesses those virtues without a doubt."
3cdddea2-9f86-4b78-9ce3-03a0e69dcb99: "He was able to change a destiny that was written upon him by his very birth. He was able to find his own way. This is admirable."
5997aeda-5003-4109-8ced-f95a38956daa: "Kassil is a sweetheart. But he should smile more often — then he'd be priceless!"
1df6c539-d902-4e87-8fa3-d8758310a237: "Wait a bit. I have to do something first."
9e6bc3f7-96eb-4950-be3d-9b07defc1422: {n}While you enter the capital, Regongar pulls you close and whispers,{/n} "I want you. Right now — or I'm gonna die."
e2571495-ab55-47c4-b998-966ea9ba5863: "Ha ha, that would be nice. Too bad your subjects wouldn't understand."
b306262e-0204-47d4-a8e8-0fef85fde2d0: {n}Holding you by the arm tenderly, Regongar almost runs with you to the palace.{/n}
7700064d-3673-4c87-8e1d-8214452cad99: "This is more important. Seriously — don't argue! It's the most important thing in the world."
fe4568ec-e9a8-4ca9-ba4d-307efd5f4b49: "What good are shrines if we already have pubs and taverns?"
b8916e65-f03c-4e5f-be52-fb8933cdd470: "Why do you propose this to me?"
6526539b-84c4-4e76-aba0-59fd01406719: "I've no wish to waste money on such nonsense."
9f7b95c5-bd9a-42b8-8ef0-a96ae1e6db8e: "Building shrines is a fine idea! Of course I will help you!"
b3fe176a-2855-4308-bd5e-f1f4e7486a87: "I will help to build these shrines, but only if those they welcome will abide by my laws."
273b428f-ebee-4ee0-89c6-3e19699d3a14: "I've no wish to interfere in Desna's matters. I'm sorry but I will not help you."
b5cfb1ed-02dd-423a-a8cf-9debec35a25b: {n}A middle-aged halfling woman in tattered traveling clothes bows before you.{/n} "Greetings, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}! Thank you for agreeing to see and hear me out!"
c552cc25-9022-477f-8608-ea9d4a6816ac: "My name is Jase. I am a priestess of {g|Desna}Desna{/g}, goddess of travelers and luck, who accompanies us on our journeys. The fame of your lands has called me to your door – with a request."
f227e370-a3d8-470a-8553-5437ee87305e: {n}Jase folds her arms across her chest.{/n} "{g|Desna}Desna{/g} protects those who spend their night out in the open. Please help me and my associates create shelters for such travelers – roadside shrines to the goddess! cd8820bb-18a3-48ef-a616-5851ee5d344d: {n}Jase shakes her head.{/n} "And what if the seeker has no coin? Or the owner refused him entry because he had no means to wash? No, a shrine of {g|Desna}Desna{/g} is more than just a hotel. It's a place where every tramp is welcome, for the mistress of the shrine makes no distinction between rich and poor!"
d5b5631f-9aa8-4eae-94d9-ccd02e8a1dc3: "Making a shrine is easy, of course. — We'll build an altar, pull out some stumps, clear the area — and we're done! But the unseen presence of {g|Desna}Desna{/g} will remain, protecting every corner of your lands. None will dare attack anyone sleeping in the shade of such a shrine!"
5d1cf309-a437-482e-80c4-049370bcc80f: {n}Jase looks at you in surprise.{/n} "Because everyone in these lands knows you are a good {mf|baron|baroness|King|Queen}! 0369c7ef-d8b3-4dd8-bf70-f5bd41ab28dc: {n}Jase can't help but clap her hands joyfully.{/n} "I knew it! I knew you would agree! May {g|Desna}Desna{/g} keep you and your loved ones safe!"
f2392473-4751-49e3-9915-b2400875af03: "My companions and I will await your news. When you are ready, we'll begin right away. You'll have shrines in all every corner of your state!"
472038df-0298-4cfe-9392-12e1837cd026: {n}Jase nods seriously.{/n} "The road tempts all kinds of travelers. But are a few lost sheep reason to deny care and protection to everyone? I do share your hope that evil-doers will steer clear of these lands."
a200d12f-3b42-401f-a2d7-6e93b91371e7: {n}Jase sighs.{/n} "Well then I won't waste any more of your time, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. Farewell!"
a749755c-2ee9-4553-a812-c1e29f028c4e: "From far away, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. There was once a time that I, like my ancestors, served a noble family in {g|Cheliax}Cheliax{/g}. d3588200-556c-4b7b-b6bb-30b9b74ff19b: "We have nothing to talk about. We hold nothing in common. You see no value in life — while I am intoxicated by it."
8b5fedbc-a33c-447f-ad06-8259df7b20a8: "Amazing. However miserable your being is, you still cling to it. You think you are a free spirit, but you are merely a slave, cherishing her chains for fear of true freedom."
c0e1cd4b-11f4-41d5-b4db-38d96ddafe08: "Jaethal and the Rivers of Blood... Jaethal and the Broken Hearts... No... She prefers ripping them out over breaking them...
ff03d559-9b92-4cac-8772-8792f295d0a2: "If you must mention me in your scribbles, would you care to replace my name? I've no wish to be associated with cheap novels."
d191b613-90bc-4a04-bb4b-a886de6f0f6b: "If we may, I would like to return once more to that forsaken fortress. To walk below its arches... to feel the tranquility of its halls and arcades... to listen to the silence..."
a6e3805b-ec29-492f-9f8a-c642693b1e4a: "Do as you wish, but you can do it without me. Dirt, ruins... Ughhh!"
8b6b24b1-9787-4675-9f2c-072d41c58fea: "I find your notions of tranquility and silence rather strange. For me, I'm content with the calmness of my tent."
31f577c5-c027-44c4-b7b7-4e2b52ad958a: "It might do you good. Such places seem to lift the gloom from your brow..."
dd555e32-c525-423b-8392-7b23050880c5: "I'm not going to pass your stupid trials. Get out of my kingdom!"
2c8b8ed5-bdcb-4c94-a5e7-13d9333018bd: [Attack] "How about you tell me – are you ready to die?"
b71c7b32-3b1e-474f-90a1-d3852888787c: "And how do you imagine I'm going to face a whole swarm of monsters without killing any of them?"
8317fc40-b480-41a3-b848-b43882bda813: "Wait a bit. I wish to prepare."
2e44e5df-3d5b-48e8-9fd5-c98c3f0badfb: {n}A man in a ceremonial robe stands near the temple, surrounded by monsters lying still like little sheep. He greets you with a deep bow. His voice is soft, almost a whisper.{/n} "Your H-Highness. Are you r-ready for the trial?"
afb72517-3d61-43e0-af50-9dce95c963c0: "I am. Every hour. But not b-by your h-hand." {n}Visaka casts a spell and boundless peace and tranquility descend upon you. Unable to even reach for your weapon, you watch Visaka leave with the monsters.{/n}
82f2c26c-3ec9-4167-a414-c1b0b8092ba7: "V-Visaka the Unicorn from the Suramgamin Order."
501be070-0f7d-4309-9bdc-399443e38361: "These c-creatures are lost. I will send them home, to the {g|First World}F-First World{/g}. But f-f-first you will have to show you are capable of holding them back without shedding any blood."
c4f8187f-0340-4a59-8a40-4c91f09b723a: "I shall lift the s-spell and commence the r-ritual. While I open the portal, you must defend yourself. But you must not kill. If a single one of these creatures dies, you will not p-pass this trial."
1c141168-0452-479f-bf5f-5c06ae16a7f8: "It's up to you. Such is the nature of your trial."
690ed7f8-2d86-4ced-afa8-aa408d61b6a8: "What will you do if I let you live?"
bc4879b7-fad7-4080-ac40-c8b9a49b8b85: "Wait! Before you die, I need to ask you something..."
d3a6ff4f-a892-4ce5-bc32-8d45fbe7e691: "That's a coward's death! You whine and complain that you're not Armag, that you have no destiny — you should be thankful! 75524c40-9e40-4859-ba81-bad2591742cf: "Do it. You may not be the real Armag, but you can still have a heroic death."
5efd8ad2-d60a-407e-a711-c0f5cacd7463: "I want to ask you something else..."
5bb0ba71-cd4f-4767-b047-e398ed68e78c: "You're free. Go, make your own destiny."
0a7f56f4-552f-439e-a847-fa9403debf4a: {n}The exhausted barbarian falls to one knee, the blood seeping from his wounds falling to stain the floor. He doesn't look at you. His gaze wanders around the room until it stops on the bodies of his tribesmen.{/n}
c55e48ae-81ab-4096-b700-a33ed29ddbdf: {n}You raise your hand and deal the final blow.{/n}
413357f7-8202-477a-a423-17c3306ae014: {n}With great difficulty, the barbarian regains his feet. His bloodshot eyes dart about nervously, studying you from head to toe.{/n}
e16b0773-37f3-4b34-9b5d-9ba670f05826: "Armag, the great chieftain of the past, was buried here. Armag, the great chieftain of the present, was born again. That's what the eight mothers told Armag. They lied. They were lying all along!"
7fa8a06b-fff9-4d36-95a5-4e5668b8d054: "Armag took the sword and spoke to Armag's soul. The sword said Armag was not Armag, but just an impudent brat! Ancient Armag's rage blazed like a torch in the night! All that was hidden was unveiled at once — everything! Armag is just a toy for eight witches! But no more. Armag's life is over, but at least he dies free from all the lies!"
c508eada-3b1b-42b9-a52b-7c3dc0be80c9: {n}The barbarian stares at the bloodstained sword in his hand, raising the shining blade to see his own reflection in its surface. His voice grows dull and hoarse.{/n} "Ancient Armag, great chieftain of the past... Invincible hero, {g|Gorum}Gorum's{/g} champion... He served only Gorum. Not his people, no — only Gorum. When he killed, it was not to feed his people, not to gain glory, not for wealth, not for power... No, it was the other way around. He fed his people to make them better killers."
14283f3d-80f3-4b4b-be9f-506a417f3834: "The blade was thirsty. It quenched its thirst on the blood of Armag's fellow tribesmen. Ancient Armag was a great warrior, that much is true. But he was a bad chieftain. He would send his people to their deaths for no good reason. Armag wasn't a hero. Armag was a kinslayer."
460b1615-cdd5-4e09-a1d1-b450ccff88f2: "The eight mothers used to say that today's Armag is a great chieftain, just like ancient Armag. He would defeat anyone he wanted as soon as he could find his soul. They said all he needed to do was find the tomb, then he could conquer {g|Restov}Restov{/g} — conquer all of {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}. Just find the tomb... But did ancient Armag need some stupid tomb? No! He just fought and won! If Armag was really Armag, he would be bound to win!"
9063ee4c-3f67-4555-84f5-de380111ff18: "But this Armag is not that Armag. He led his people into a trap. Realized too late that he won't be able to take {g|Restov}Restov{/g}. And that's when the eight mothers told him they had found the tomb. Armag entered the tomb to become stronger, to save his people, to bring them glory and riches! But all he found was death. Ancient Armag and present Armag have that in common."
1923c97d-8733-4753-82ad-34a0756a995c: {n}The barbarian presses the tip of the sword against his broad chest.{/n} "Nothing. This sword is cursed. It {d|c41 Tomb Late}controls{/d} the hand that wields it. If Armag is freed, he'll kill again, just as in the past. Not for glory, not for riches — just killing for the sake of killing. This cannot be. Armag must be buried in Armag's tomb."
84fd5e88-b944-42d4-be87-7776125ec5b4: {n}The barbarian lowers his sword. His eyes avoid you, wandering around the room until they rest on the bodies scattered on the floor.{/n}
987eab08-7aa0-4f2c-a470-c54d7448fc84: {n}Armag nods to you, plunges the blade deep into his chest, and silently falls to the floor.{/n}
f1d5c613-d192-49d0-9a49-7a823d527743: "The one holding Armag's life in {mf|his|her} hands didn't take it. This cannot be forgotten! Let us fraternize! Become sworn brother{mf|s| and sister}!" {n}Armag draws Ovinrbaane's edge across his palm, then extends his bleeding hand to you.{/n}
c77f9d0c-715e-41ab-84d2-e149a3cafb6b: {n}The barbarian lowers his hand.{/n} "Friends, then. Should we meet again, Armag will not forget."
11044955-cd0c-4745-8dec-460e7ec819a9: {n}You run your palm along the blade of the ancient sword and shake Armag's hand. For the first time, he looks directly into your eyes.{/n} "Brother{mf|s| and sister}."
7c0c2db2-2a35-4312-a4ff-cccbb336dc94: {n}Armag sheathes Ovinrbaane and leaves the tomb.{/n}
60d6211f-158a-42d3-99a6-1f268ef7d39a: "The eight mothers fed Armag, raised him, taught him everything he knows. Since he was born, Armag knew no other family and no other tribe. They told Armag of his great past and his even greater future... And every word was a lie. Armag was just their trained dog! He jumped when told, growled, tore their enemies to pieces... He had no idea for what or why he was fighting!"
57fa3cce-a1ec-4026-b64a-8b707c2f8321: "One more thing... Once, Armag heard them talk about another Sister. The one they all serve. When he asked, they lied, said there was no ninth Sister, that Armag had misheard them. He should have understood then that they weren't to be trusted. Those who lie once are not to be believed twice!"
e6266336-c889-409b-831c-8c65ce1a2fc1: "Be merciful to the enemy, even as cruel as this savage. Stop his suffering — here and now."
b240c5b9-03ee-48f1-b66e-f0f741548477: "That's it." {n}Valerie sighs and her shoulders relax.{/n}
a7138153-d181-42de-8dc4-4f330376e6c8: {n}The chieftain of the {g|Tiger Lords}Tiger Lords{/g} silently falls to the floor beside the bodies of his tribesmen, joining the corpses of those he'd slain.{/n}
b789ab6b-0b9b-4537-b831-bcf1430e2afd: "We always only achieve death. Even presumed success in mortal matters is actually just one more step toward the grave."
60f93076-3ca4-4b83-ae68-de4e0d091aef: "So much blood was shed in vain, and yet compassion for this person stirred in my heart. A bitter lot — treason of those you thought were your family."
2a13d7d9-d642-4733-b63c-3cd1a9c8681d: {n}Amiri spits glumly.{/n} "This ancient Armag was a scum, if what you say is true. And some just love to venerate some dead wretch!"
7bdcf790-2f35-4ed4-aae5-541e176ed847: "Oh, I think I shed a tear from my left eye! It's all emotions! Such a beautiful finale of the story, I can't wait to write it down!"
0c373463-03ca-43f3-9f33-1beced1a04b1: "Turning an enemy into a friend and giving him hope... I believe {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} herself smiled at your deeds today, {name}".
9adfffb7-499a-4384-9e8d-4f9377723bd8: "A lie is what Nyrissa and her servants live. And I was part of that lie..." {n}Tristian's voice holds a bitter note.{/n}
663667ef-221f-464e-92ec-c33932b42811: "The grave of the first Armag will accept the body of the second. I see a special dispensation in this. They were both devoured by anger, but now both are dust and peace."
c0fa0d24-8509-485b-a47e-c63bc5c29f65: "Do you know where your shaman Tartuk is?"
175ba9e3-93fa-4f3a-8fc2-57786e257da6: "Friendsss! Chief wait! Many trapsss. Follow me!"
ebf12428-0200-4724-9e90-ce74b6d637f9: "Don't know! Asssk Chief! Chief know all!"
3f8b6398-c46d-4a73-80b7-dc17bd59cb27: "Mine!" {n}The kobold is obviously proud of his knowledge.{/n} "Humansss make, then leave. Kobold come, live, work. Was mite passsage, no more. Mite thief! Mite ambushhh attack, we break passsage, lose big chessst, goodsss. Can't go deep. Ssscary. Angry mite bug, wild bug live down there."
35b94aa1-9480-444a-8111-e35292be9bc0: "You know, Harrim… I don't think your Groetus cares about his congregation. What's the point in worshipping him?"
62de4d11-b084-4fbb-a662-2670761a6ffa: "And what's the point in venerating the other gods? All they promise their followers is empty fuss. Pleasure, war, magic... For his part, Groetus teaches us to accept the inevitable with dignity."
29b5a77e-8014-482d-af51-303def1b23a7: "What can you tell me of Sarenrae?"
753e838d-f885-430c-82fa-3cbb919be8c9: "Tell me about this battle you mentioned. What was the act of valor of Sarenrae?"
4216f7e1-8b4e-4a63-bec7-e35ab10e9a75: "What are your duties as a follower of Sarenrae?"
a2ed08cb-bd8e-4db7-b1d6-2404751116c3: "I do not agree. There are crimes that cannot go unpunished."
7c351b16-4d31-4529-8c24-e8d621baf60b: "There is good in everyone — one just has to look deep enough. Even those who feel lost, or broken — or unrepentant have light in their souls, and it's possible to help them see it."
d27f9814-5eb8-46f4-bb45-d3aa21e4ace6: "I like this idea, even though following through with it demands a lot of spiritual strength."
af073c99-2af5-47c8-ba2e-63ff209f5dfe: "An abstract theory — and little to do with real life."
fc0712f8-a894-4991-b99f-36b501279f32: "You make it sound like the followers of Sarenrae will try to find good even in a bandit with a knife to their throat."
6fb63e16-962f-4ec1-8a50-c73f7eb52d5f: "Why did Jhod see you in his premonition?"
65b9f449-ba41-4df2-992a-3de4db09796f: "You have spent much time here. What do you think the future holds for these lands?"
a098dbe5-6e41-4a69-9012-9595c151796f: "Doesn't being outside the temple make you uncomfortable?"
449748b0-e932-402b-85ff-ead8e965abc6: "Never before have I met a person so noble in spirit. Sarenrae's blessing was upon me the day you came to my aid."
8899164e-fea7-4bcf-9844-abb1054cf526: "Do you know where you're going next?"
eba8bb01-20e5-40fe-8b89-804b8d5eb039: "To the contrary — I hope you will stay with me for as long as you can. The thought of you leaving... is not a welcome one."
5defc4fa-bdc6-48f0-8593-7bdbb107d650: "I didn't mean to alarm you, that was not my intent."
2582e90e-69ab-4e72-8e01-ea387732b498: "Of course not! You are my comrade in arms. I trust you completely."
76735c88-c4c2-4ef5-9306-e4681d7dac20: "What are the temples of Sarenrae like?"
64780526-3fac-4981-ae9a-5778773928bc: "That is all I wanted to know about this."
c7ea6058-5295-4c89-9add-b4f097b2eda4: "Forgive me, but from your manner and appearance you don't strike me as a Keleshite."
56d9e022-ff9e-4af1-a1c5-f3b27570e54c: "You've mentioned Gormuz… What happened to it?"
7b0d9a0a-1711-4209-b64b-4592655a6556: "The more I hear, the more it seems your Sarenrae isn't worth a damn."
1487293f-8746-46b8-9f95-52d23433a162: "Forgive me, I overreacted. I have nothing against your faith."
3bf249d8-3d77-41a2-b84f-14cf25c74570: "Compassion, mercy… all this wailing in the name of good is sickening."
ce2de0f6-cb3a-4a48-904d-a2806b6ae8db: "Your religion is foreign to me, Tristian. Perhaps I shouldn't have put it the way I did, but Sarenrae's ways are much different than my own."
559f6f6c-92b5-41d2-ad76-c2a77b369882: "Leave. I don't want to ever see you again."
9512fb55-5faa-4bd3-b6c4-fbf6af42cc0b: "I'd like to hear about the history of your faith."
f4e53f97-ae43-46ff-97bf-b7caded61136: "Enough. I want to ask about something else."
34cfa9bf-6ab9-4697-9695-2b60d19e86ff: "I'd like to ask about something else."
9629e715-589c-45b2-91fd-8e0b933f68ae: "Have wars ever been waged in Sarenrae's name?"
43250c45-4fa5-40fa-bc26-ff522d90061b: "Tell me about the Pit of Gormuz."
c732f904-17ba-440c-9fd6-b4d38f054cd7: "I've seen your shining wings on several occasions…"
047dd7da-2b53-4fda-ac7c-8f22d3f1f09c: "Why didn't you tell me who you were right away?"
d078faa1-148e-4657-b459-5e9eb1acd0ce: "How do entities like you come into this world?"
4be9e861-dce5-46ad-9cb6-c3ab43e2d946: "What did Nyrissa do to make you serve her?"
f509c96f-f2ff-4140-814c-ffcba450a283: "Do you know what she's looking for? Why does she make all these plots and schemes?"
a4e7997a-1ad0-4c0b-8007-c215cb2869ec: "Did you like to travel amongst the worlds?"
df46a516-082b-405e-a240-cc21ae8e8039: "Will you be able to restore your eyesight once?"
f26d367b-e8d7-4bec-85d1-87b4d5c3929c: "All this Nyrissa story… How did she capture you?"
f9209278-8174-402b-b251-024e56a83227: "Have you ever seen Sarenrae by your own eyes?"
aa5fda94-a871-4b8c-ad0f-1aab2c468fb6: "How do you get by without your eyesight?"
ffb8db67-d37e-4d88-8663-54ba6306510c: "You mentioned Nyrissa sending a vision to Jhod."
61a5b3fd-e554-41ea-838c-04f266dd1dec: "Are you ready to go to the meeting of the Kingdom of the Cleansed?"
b25e6ec2-777f-43b2-a285-beea0f5a3d2b: "Have you heard anything about the Kingdom of the Cleansed or the First Faithful?"
e91db75e-f250-4d8f-8023-73ccd03239e3: "Don't you regret your decision? Sarenrae was ready to forgive you..."
aca713db-f17a-4828-b63c-bd6a4a43def0: "I'm glad you stayed with us. We will need all the help we can get to fight Nyrissa."
f6e56458-033c-42ec-883f-c586d92f1afd: "I want to be alone with you."
d2de5fe4-44d6-4ae9-b79e-1f96e6691f0d: "Don't argue. I don't want to be with you any more."
feda2156-3576-4887-bd0e-a49e69507fd6: "You called yourself the Chosen of Sarenrae. What did you mean by that?"
bb4e3265-74d7-4d1c-882f-715b14d4e7c7: "So, what happened to you calling yourself the Chosen of Sarenrae?"
71c9c3ba-08be-4ea8-b7a4-53de0e53da94: {n}Tristian gives you a friendly nod.{/n} "How may I help you, {name}?"
658fa847-5da1-42fc-a9a5-2ba410455931: "About myself? I wouldn't know where to begin." {n}Tristian pauses for a moment in thought.{/n} "You know my name, my faith — I follow {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, and I have traveled from the {g|Kelesh}Padishah Empire of Kelesh{/g} to here… what else do you want to know?"
101ce1be-effb-45a1-9159-39343b4a851f: "I've heard rumors — they say these lands are cursed, and the curses are growing stronger… as if something is granting them power. I could not ignore such rumors."
97eeac43-5af1-43ff-b27e-121415a1b7de: "{g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} is the goddess of temperance and patience. Solarflame goddess teaches us compassion for the weary and mercy to those who go astray. What would you like to know of her?"
0a093778-8382-4d67-bd98-710604583aa0: "My goddess strives to see the best, even in the dark gods — she never abandons the hope of their redemption. The priests of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} follow her teachings — akin to the Healing Light herself, who emanates warmth and heeds the call of those in need, we aid the suffering in body and spirit throughout {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}."
3c6e84bc-26fc-41fe-8e2a-1e2f9fa4f9b9: "Her greatest moment of glory is her battle against the monstrous {g|Rovagug}Rovagug{/g}, who threatened to destroy {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}. {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} delivered the strike that staggered the horrendous creature and allowed her allies to shackle it. Once the Rough Beast was captured, the goddess split the earth, and the gods threw the behemoth into the depths. Once it was done, the goddess sealed the pit, and commanded her faithful to stay away from the scar that was left in the land."
72bf1409-9521-40e9-85db-1b5b5ce53500: "These are difficult questions you ask, {name}, questions wise men have debated for centuries. Does a being that has been tainted by evil to its very roots, that rejects its own salvation, still deserve compassion? Can those compelled to do evil by others still seek forgiveness? There is no easy answers on these issues among {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} followers."
c43236a7-7531-4464-bcb4-2ac1ceeb4da1: {n}Suddenly, Tristian's face lights up.{/n} "However, you've already chosen your side in this eternal debate. Your actions show that any creature, no matter how twisted or how far astray, can be led to enlightenment. It is in your lands that a settlement has sprouted to give shelter to those that used to leave nothing but destruction in their wake!"
5d3fe3bd-ec46-44c9-9a0d-61cb9d51f4f9: "As for me… I believe that every soul carries the potential for goodness within. No matter the crime, the guilty may find forgiveness if they repent and cast off the evil that led to the deed. I believe this with all my heart, {name}."
44013915-0b8f-41b2-90ee-8fde186177f5: {n}Tristian gives a perplexed laugh.{/n} "Well, I wouldn't force anyone against their will… although, if it served a good purpose…" {n}Tristian falls silent contemplating the issue, but almost immediately he shakes his head.{/n} "No, I am not ready to make such a decision yet."
5aaa509b-1b52-4b2b-914b-6763f4a63d61: {n}Tristian folds his arms.{/n} "What is of greater importance — a living soul or the laws of nations? One's salvation or observance of rules? Know that I hold you in high esteem, but it is difficult for me to agree with you on this issue."
3a482dd1-5e98-4d37-bacb-b2e2a1f7591b: "It does, yet I think you are equal to the task, {name}. No, I am certain of it. And one needn't worship {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} to practice mercy — all are capable of it."
530c027c-21d3-4cd3-93b4-85dd33b4d3f9: {n}Tristian smiles faintly.{/n} "I cannot argue with this, and nevertheless… I'll keep to my opinion."
e8eccb8c-33b3-4126-a66f-d09282bc3f4a: {n}Tristian's shoulders sag, and he averts his eyes.{/n} "It is a pity our views are so different. I hope it will not stand in the way of our shared goals."
b5e26500-f134-4d55-b9d8-50eda2e3c218: "If you ever wish to know more about the goddess, just ask."
7f1d471e-eda6-4048-8d0a-18195472a359: "Do not mistake compassion for weakness, {name}. One hand of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} is shrouded in healing light — the other holds a scimitar. Following their goddess, the priests learn to wield this weapon starting in childhood — and they do not hesitate to use it if a dispute cannot be settled peacefully."
6f6e197d-b39f-4292-b61c-e1eb0cc3ae6a: "The priests of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} are willing to help anyone, no matter the faith of the one in need. Each plea must be heard. Every misfortune deserves compassion — be it a peasant seeking a blessing for the harvest, or a murderer seeking repentance the night before their execution."
5c04414c-f684-4e9f-a13f-7e2214b0a0fd: "Sometimes the mercy of {g|Sarenrae}solarflame goddess{/g} is the last thing that can save one's soul from ruin. We have no right to withhold it from the truly repentant."
3e60ee7d-cf33-4ebf-b650-72dcf0754cc7: {n}Tristian falls silent for a few moments.{/n} "Alas, mortal beings are imperfect. Not even the most faithful among us can always follow their deity's commandments, even when such commandments are meant to save the world and their followers. I, for one, pray the goddess is never again as furious as she was with {g|Gormuz}Gormuz{/g}."
bd2ca3a8-7a87-41eb-93ae-2645f2b644dd: "{g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} preaches mercy. Yet her compassion is not infinite. We give a second chance to all who ask. But if they reject it, if they persist in their sins, they will face the goddess's retribution."
dd6b3f6b-6ec5-4b79-a23b-b47b223556e6: {n}Tristian cocks his head to the side in wonder.{/n} "Do you not see? Every word uttered in the heat of an argument turns into a prophecy here, just waiting to fulfill itself. And if it were only for the people — the land itself is seething with curses so ancient their origins are impossible to trace!"
0d080f95-1145-4138-bf69-6be204f1b0b3: "Take the abandoned temple of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} where we met. What happened to it? What force compelled the priests to leave such a magnificent temple behind to the whims of nature? Will we ever know?"
91205a8a-d294-4fe5-9b67-639a1c71717c: "{g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} sees all the good gods and goddesses as her allies. Many have fought alongside the goddess against the menace of {g|Rovagug}Rovagug{/g}, {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} among them."
6580126d-dec5-4885-bf71-c6781992530e: "By offering my prayer to {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, I let her know of my misfortune in the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g}. The merciful goddess did not ignore my plea — but whom could have she asked for aid than {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, whose faith is strong in these lands?"
9fee62bf-804d-466c-986c-4bc6e66385a9: "I myself was nearly slain by beasts. Fortunately, you came along, following Jhod, and saved me. I owe you a great debt."
31a0c192-9a2b-4b4d-b780-f3618b76ced3: {n}Tristian laughs heartily.{/n} "When you look at it that way, then yes! But please, do not think that I came all the way from {g|Kelesh}Kelesh{/g} because of mere curiosity. I was wandering long before that. It is a custom of our faith — the farther our paths take us, the more people we may help."
4f134527-6995-4698-b93c-7dd93f37ee28: "{g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} had sent Jhod a sign, and you came just in time to rescue me." {n}Tristian sighs.{/n} "To tell the truth, I was certain my journey was at an end, and those creatures were to be the death of me."
93e10003-388c-4e6e-9cac-31db377057ca: "These are cruel lands. As I came here, I bore witness to much pain and suffering, but I have seen equal kindness among those seeking to protect themselves and their loved ones. The people of the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} are resolute and true to themselves — I admire their strength."
c3a69695-c404-414a-98e9-92b3cbff5a0f: {n}Tristian shakes his head.{/n} "There are many ways to honor one's gods, {name}. It is true shrines play a role in the lives of many of the faithful, but even more find other ways to serve {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}."
d939d092-e2e3-4dff-b5af-042b3565b3ec:
"{g|Sarenrae}The Healing Light{/g} values good deeds above all else. I cannot stand by and watch evil claim others."
{n}Tristian thinks for a moment, then raises an eyebrow.{/n} "Perhaps that is another reason why I chose to go on my pilgrimage, leaving behind the temples of {g|Kelesh}Kelesh{/g}."
b8c58700-11f2-49ab-8b69-fe2cb5a04ee7: {n}Tristian touches his chest.{/n} "My faith is in my heart and in my hands. Millions honor {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} in her temples, and my soul is filled with joy when I think of their devotion to the goddess. Nevertheless, my path is a different one."
50f40f36-9289-4891-a6a4-aee2d8ef198b:
{n}The priest frowns and shakes his head.{/n}
"I cannot, {name}. If my presence troubles you, so be it — I shall surrender my place in your party to another. But I insist on staying and continuing my research with Jhod. Something wicked is stirring in these lands, and it is my duty to find out what it is."
99099a2f-9eb2-419b-b2f6-727141001261: {n}Tristian nods, his eyes light up.{/n} "Oh, yes! No library and no archive, however large, would have ever allowed me to learn as much of the world as I have in my journeys! It was only outside the temple walls I realized every living being is a world unto themselves, a world where many contradictions and passions coexist!"
37d998e6-80de-48fb-89a4-0bde0b009757: "Each realm leaves its mark on the lives that live there. Only by visiting it, by breathing the same air, walking on the same soil, can you understand its people — what drives them, what frightens them, their dreams, and how they honor their gods."
6d4d8a0a-90a1-4bc2-b9e1-36b5ff41f946: "No, my thoughts were far from it, for my mission here is not yet done." {n}Tristian stares at you in surprise.{/n} "Why do you ask? Do you wish me to leave your lands?"
df027b47-f14d-4303-8dfa-f9c3cf1fc5fa: {n}Tristian's face lights up.{/n} "Thank you. I am pleased I could be of assistance."
dd651a60-8317-47f5-9a4b-682436bc084b: {n}Tristian takes a step back.{/n} "But why? What have I done to earn your mistrust?" {n}He stops, then nods, as if ashamed.{/n} "Do not answer. Whatever I have done — forgive me, I can only hope that I work harder on your behalf and prove myself an ally."
050015c6-ae66-4955-939a-29c83091d4e1: {n}Tristian shakes his head reproachfully, but with a smile.{/n} "You enjoy watching others' reactions, don't you? In this regard, we are alike, although I do not choose such sly ways to achieve this."
40138469-568e-45d0-b289-df39e915b923: "Many worship solarflame goddess in her temples. Some make the pilgrimage to the {g|The Everlight Oasis}Everlight Oasis{/g}. But even those who do not serve the goddess directly rarely shun the festivities dedicated to her — the Sunwrought Festival, for one."
a3b44745-c9fb-40bb-a81e-f70977ebd7fc: "{g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} shrines are often open to the sky and to the goddess' life-bringing sunlight. Her light fills the temple, enshrouds the parish in warmth, and grants its blessing to all in need. In {g|Kelesh}Kelesh{/g}, crowds gather during the services so that all may feel the blessing of the goddess!"
8e953e6c-0e05-441a-be3d-a95b5830a556: "I have never been there, but the stories say it is a wondrous place, sacred to {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} faithful. The Oasis is located in {g|Zelshabbar}Zelshabbar{/g}, which lies in {g|Casmaron}Casmaron{/g}. Pilgrims from throughout {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} travel there, seeking the goddess's blessing."
2df65dd7-315b-4e47-bc36-d31d4f94bff4: "The most ingenious devices are constructed by some of the faithful to please the goddess. I have seen a temple of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} which housed a complicated array of mirrors — all to direct the light of the sun to the altar!"
f6f19f53-d782-4dc9-8317-e0af2ee0a527: "According to legend, the waters of the {g|The Everlight Oasis}Everlight Oasis{/g} are imbued with healing properties, and anyone who bathes in them shall be cured of any ailment." {n}Tristian smiles in thought.{/n} "Just imagine — a place where people from all around the world come to gather to worship. What stories they must share!"
d1d30dd1-095c-46e9-ae40-d414e7c43461: "The Sunwrought Festival takes place on the day of the summer solstice, when the prayers of her flock can reach {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} the easiest. On this day, {g|Kelesh}Kelesh{/g} blooms with color — in each corner of the {g|Kelesh}Padishah Empire{/g}, the people praise their goddess by dancing and singing, setting off fireworks and flying kites! I hope, this beautiful custom shall one day reach your lands as well, {name}!"
6f701191-27d2-46f1-8d47-6ff278d62290: "I hope I have satisfied your curiosity."
fb6948f1-b9f2-4dfa-8dbc-9449366b4dec: {n}Tristian sighs.{/n} "Alas, yes. Terrible battles were once fought between the followers of {g|Nethys}Nethys{/g}, {g|Norgorber}Norgorber{/g}, and {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} in the lands now known as {g|Rahadoum}Rahadoum{/g}. To my shame, I must admit that this conflict was started by my brothers and sisters — they came to a foreign land to make way for the goddess's light with sword and fire."
e85cf965-18bc-4237-a3da-45bfbb5927d7: {n}Tristian sighs.{/n} "An error of faith. Perhaps a lesson. But it speaks of the danger when one listens to mortal words and one stops listening to their faith."
06822fd8-3062-4251-a1a2-734a377bbf3d: "Sarenrae forbade her followers from coming near the place of {g|Rovagug}Rovagug's{/g} imprisonment. But some of her priesthood misread her will and began to preach of a sacred place, where the mightiest of temples dedicated to the goddess were to be constructed. The people listened to these sermons and went forth to the lands touched by {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} scimitar. On the scar that sealed the well, they founded {g|Gormuz}Gormuz{/g}, a holy city that was to become the greatest monument to Sarenrae. Unsurprisingly, after the city was built, faithful from all {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} traveled there to worship."
935264ef-c7be-4178-a7ce-0660d4368eab:
"{g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} sent omens and visions, urging her followers to leave this dangerous place filled with the dark will of the shackled {g|Rovagug}Rovagug{/g}. But in their pride, the people misinterpreted or ignored her signs altogether, for they had already come under Rovagug's influence. Finally, the goddess sent her herald to the city, but the fanatics killed him."
"Realizing the people had turned from her, the enraged goddess smote {g|Gormuz}Gormuz{/g}, razing it from the face of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} with a single strike of her scimitar." {n}Tristian shakes his head.{/n} "Today, it is called {g|Pit of Gormuz}the Pit of Gormuz{/g}, a well of pain and suffering."
bf82bd26-66f7-432f-9e9b-86eb740caed8: {n}Tristian smiles softly.{/n} "You have nothing to apologize for. Truly, I have received my name and appearance from my parents, who had come to {g|Kelesh}Kelesh{/g} from afar. I never knew them, for the fate had separated us when I was young. So I grew up in Kelesh, raised by the followers of Sarenrae."
274339ca-6613-417c-a2c3-7effad03ccac: "My home is where my heart is — within the temples of the great goddess, among the wise and generous men that took upon themselves the care of a child that was so unlike them. I learned mercy and patience at an early age — and it is these virtues that have made me the man I am today."
bea8c74f-e2d7-4661-b0ba-88e5d6642f89: {n}Tristian lowers his head.{/n} "Forgive me if my stories have bored you. I am not accustomed to speaking about myself and, in truth, take little enjoyment in it."
62f287f5-3b0e-4341-9a14-2bbdc22799a7: "Truly? The goddess does not demand of you, nor anyone — she only seeks to help. Why do you dismiss her?"
ed8a5958-968a-4e0b-9f21-3c152b18b50b: {n}Tristian sighs with relief.{/n} "We are all different. One needn't share the other's faith to be a loyal ally." {n}He nods and gives a warm smile.{/n}
8e2c7ab5-8252-48da-b292-1a00ae7e9cfa: {n}Tristian's voice drops, almost to a monotone.{/n} "We are all different. Allies needn't share the other's faith." {n}He nods once, the turns away.{/n}
7763aa6a-56f4-4e8c-99f5-8fb7206d26d9: "We are all different. Allies needn't share faith, as long as they stand together." {n}He nods again, quickly, and gives a faint smile.{/n}
3c856161-9c02-419a-89f2-dafeca83dbfe:
{n}Tristian blindly gazes past you into the distance for several moments. When he speaks again, his voice is quiet, reflective, as if echoing his thoughts.{/n} "Undeserving of mercy... would even {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} herself find the compassion to..."
{n}Tristian shudders, as if awakening from a trance.{/n} "Forgive me, I... your words — they are not easy ones to reconcile, and even priests such as I... we debate them to this day. What is the point at which a soul is irredeemable — or is it a failing of the priest themselves?"
7cb05e33-0a2d-441b-ae85-ccc971c264d4: {n}Tristian falls silent and looks around himself worriedly, as if he can't believe what he had just said.{/n} "Forgive me for my rash words. But this mission is important to me."
095c3e46-1189-40bd-be8f-b3ddbf5be69e: "There is much to tell — but I'm afraid I would miss the mark, and I fear I would bore you. Is there something specific you wished to know?"
df0d0562-605c-4987-b045-8fdbd2dadbfb: "Solarflame goddess is the light of salvation — even to those who have been forsaken by the other gods. She teaches us mercy and forgiveness — for as long as they may be useful to a soul's salvation."
05405c09-fad9-4d2a-ac26-f391547181ec: "{g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} is one of {g|Golarion}Golarion's{/g} eldest deities. Once, she was an angel that had gathered the armies of her celestial allies behind her. The battle in which she showed her valor decided the fate of a whole world — and, in her victory, she was rewarded with divinity."
f17d9a2e-344d-42a0-ad61-645698bcc42e: "In the sacred texts, {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} is shown as a beautiful bronze-skinned maiden, her hair dancing flame." {n}Tristian smiles slightly.{/n} "But her appearance is not what matters, it is the grace she brings with her touch — healing and salvation."
335d3f9b-cead-49fd-924b-6fde6cf8b6a5: "Of course. What else would you like to know?"
b2ba774a-6a13-40e3-be24-ae2ecc5f7b69: "That calamity became known as the Oath Wars — a catastrophe that led the inheritors of {g|Rahadoum}Rahadoum{/g} to deny all gods, banning all faiths from their lands. Alas, the mortal vessel is imperfect, and even a pure faith may be distorted by blind ambition..." {n}Tristian goes silent for a moment.{/n} "And great suffering may occur in its name."
399a6f1a-ea46-4ed8-938d-be90a75c4b39: "Alas, I do not know yet what powers the curses that flourish in this land. But I swear I will not leave until we have the answer and the means to cleanse them. You must forgive me for not swearing on {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} name, but as of late I have troubled the goddess too much as it is — and it would better serve her through action, not prayer."
fb4d877c-3f43-4d89-821c-21e8e6b7c3c9: {n}Tristian smiles awkwardly.{/n} "You speak as if sharing your heart's affection. If… if I am dear to you as a comrade in arms, then I too value our friendship. If there is more to it, however…" {n}Tristian goes silent, shaking his head sadly.{/n}
d8892d72-7e86-440c-b3f7-acdf89cd39c6:
{n}Tristian nods, smiling.{/n} "I, too, would not welcome the thought of leaving you. I…"
{n}Tristian pauses, then gives a rueful smile, shaking his head.{/n} "My apologies, I don't know what came over me! I simply wanted to say I won't leave you until you ask me to. And still... I hope... I hope that won't happen." {n}Tristian stops, his face red.{/n}
6a74e451-fcd1-4ca2-a2a7-5044f61f4e7d: {n}Tristian smiles uneasily.{/n} "Thank you for your kind words. However, I am confused — where I am from such compliments are not given to friends, but rather… to ones who are closer than that." {n}Tristian raises his eyes to look at you.{/n} "I hope that this is not what you meant. I would hate to disappoint you and lose you as a friend."
99498d11-4078-466d-9072-43d4549df65d: {n}Tristian blushes.{/n} "Th-thanks, {name}. I… Your words fill my heart with joy. To be honest, I have never met a woman quite like you…" {n}He breaks off mid-sentence and bites his lip bitterly.{/n} "Forgive me my hasty words. Anyway..." {n}Tristian sighs, as if trying to gather up his will.{/n} "I am pleased to share your company."
80c831c7-172d-4269-9858-ebe35c6a0a33: {n}Tristian shakes his head.{/n} "It's a great crevasse in eastern {g|Casmaron}Casmaron{/g}. The lands surrounding it are dead, soaked in poison. {g|Pit of Gormuz}The Pit of Gormuz{/g} seems bottomless… until someone dares to gaze into its depths. All who have dared tell of a strange, distant glow — a glow that followed them in their dreams ever since."
007ac61a-1b88-4969-87d1-abb205a3a69c: "Throughout all of history, {g|Pit of Gormuz}the Pit of Gormuz{/g} has spawned… creatures. Hideous beasts of overwhelming power and driven by only a single desire — to destroy everything they see. Some were defeated — such as the nightmarish Ulunat, whose carapace to this day towers above the capital of {g|Osirion}Osirion{/g}. Others... proved too strong to be defeated by mortal hands." {n}Tristian frowns.{/n} "The most terrible of them all was the Tarrasque, the Armageddon Engine, who to this day lies dormant deep beneath {g|Avistan}Avistan{/g}."
2d93a30d-cc28-413d-9ad1-cfebb0de76fe: "Alas, I also had a hand in making lives of these people yet more miserable. I hope I'll be able to heal the wounds I unwillingly inflicted to those families." {n}Tristian lowers his head, hiding his blind eyes from you.{/n}
e00040c3-40c7-4802-ac45-5de8371abcfd: {n}The cleric folds his hands on his chest in a pleading gesture.{/n} "I realize I have wronged you. I know It won't be easy to earn your forgiveness. But I beg you: please, let me stay! I won't be any trouble to you — just give me a chance to prove how deeply I repent!"
2eaf23ec-35d1-4505-b421-5889c9366708: {n}Tristian's face turns grayish, light seems to leave his blind eyes.{/n} "Indeed, earthly mercy is not boundless. So be it. Farewell, {name}".
4774d8c0-9201-4488-b2c9-46654e4c5aea: "I thank you, {name}. I swear by {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}, you won't regret your decision."
adb0d248-6a52-4ef8-bd31-87cc8d73d589: "Well. As I've already mentioned, I'm movanic deva, a servant of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}. Of course, now I don't look much like an immortal being..." {n}Tristian raises his hands only to drop them a moment later.{/n} "But once I used to travel amongst the realms, searching for those who needed my help."
1f1dd708-8d41-4475-8ba0-c2c0e02c37b4: {n}Tristian raises his head, as he hears your footsteps.{/n} "{name}? I wanted to speak with you."
fd021af5-5a7f-40f5-883a-f30dbf212340: "On my way here, I had enough time to think. So, I've been thinking about you and me. About the words we once exchanged. It feels almost like a joke now... who knows, maybe you really were just joking back then. A lot has changed since then."
f7e59ed8-ba54-4b02-88f3-efa994b8e76d: "Anyway... I would like to preserve our friendship. We've been putting it to a test way too often to endanger it once again. Another disappointment can be fatal to it." {n}Tristian utters a heavy sigh.{/n} "We shouldn't cross the borders from now on. I hope you'll understand that my intentions are pure and won't feel offended."
3413614f-af4a-422e-8875-29127835e1c2: "I've been traveling amongst the worlds when I noticed something strange. How should I describe it... it was like something had pierced time and matter, leaving a slight trace. I should have turned back and told my brethren about my discovery... but I was sure I was able to find a reason of this strange phenomenon by myself, so I decided to go for it alone."
04acc042-2f36-4334-a13b-fe38c2ba9ce2: "My overconfidence and my foolishness are to blame for that. Once I believed I deserved much more than {g|Sarenrae}solarflame goddess{/g} assigned to me... and eventually I paid a price for my pride."
c412a338-be77-4daf-8eed-e3342dfbe645: "The trace led me to {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}, to the {g|Temple of the Elk}Temple of the Elk{/g} — and right into Nyrissa's hands. She proved to be much stronger than I, and defeated me in a heartbeat. Before I had time to realize what was happening, she put me into magic slumber, filled with nightmares and visions."
a7da6096-1531-4e04-a642-48cbc2e191c7: {n}Tristian hesitates.{/n} "She… she threatened she'd destroy my immortality and deprive me of my divine powers once and for all. I didn't dare to confront her; it was in her power to kill me — and then I'd go to {g|Pharasma}Pharasma{/g} instead of my Goddess!"
b3c9ffcb-b2c4-4476-a5a7-16a9b01f94d0: "Of course, it all proved to be a lie…. But you should understand me: when I awoke from my slumber, I already was trapped in a mortal body, and this crazy fey bragged her power over me, and threatened me with eternal damnation!"
fd9f63b6-ad3d-4295-a47d-f9bbf8acf7a3: "Nyrissa demanded unconditional submission. I couldn't… didn't dare to confront her and put my divine sparkle at stake: a single step in wrong direction — and Nyrissa would destroy the very essence of me!"
b5bf0911-65c1-47b9-bf0a-d837fa0ea380: "She forbade me to uncover my true identity and made me do what she wanted me to: to help her create that flower, to plant it... but she never forbade me to help you fight the Bloom. This is a weak excuse, but I did all I could to make sure my deeds won't do as much harm as she expected."
53319a89-28d5-4cc3-9043-20ed40f82042: "Alas, no. Nyrissa trusts no one, she is reluctant to share her plans even with her Sisters. You'll have to expose her plots and schemes by yourself."
cdbdffce-9d63-42cc-b21b-0454b4f7570b: "Indeed. I would wish to leave it all behind — once and for all."
b553873c-6795-4a03-b1ef-21442ccb2bc9: "Devas, you mean? The same way as the servants of other deities do: our masters create us, give us our shape and vest us with our missions."
2fa9b92f-bec6-4f09-ab4c-c33d2a7cbecd: "As for me, I was reborn from the soul of a great mortal hero. My conscience is deprived of memories of the past life — but looks like mortal pride still resides within my heart. It was the reason why I've lost my freedom and my power."
2490808b-8428-43df-82f9-82b13b896f33: {n}A slight smile emerges on Tristian's face.{/n} "A gift of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}. A key to freedom. A symbol of our closeness to our Goddess. With my wings I could travel between worlds and to find those who asked for help. This is our sacred duty: to heed the prayers of mortals in every corner of the Universe."
d0a408b0-8223-4f55-a8e1-7a012ec368b8: "I was too stupid to value that gift. My heart craved for opportunity to prove myself, the chance to show {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} I was capable of more, than what I was created for. And once the whole Universe laid on my palm. Once..."
3456bda0-cdc9-467d-9d25-b0ef8a9c48fa: {n}Tristian falls silent. You wait for a while, but seems like deva isn't going to continue. He winces and turns away.{/n}
b326d36a-82e8-4824-8d63-c8af1cfa4b74: "No. I sacrificed my eyesight to destroy the Oculus of {g|Abaddon}Abaddon{/g}. Of all the mess I've done recently it was the only righteous and proper thing.
