d0634a53-fd65-46b2-b98a-6358760d2f26: "What do you want to talk about?"
c463f6be-77c6-4aa6-a6e6-fbc5654e769d: {n}Warm smile lights Tristian's face.{/n} "I came to his world in the palms of my Goddess. My breath is just an echo of her breathing life into me, my powers are just a grain of her everlasting light. Yes, {name}, I've seen {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} by my own eyes, and she was more beautiful than anything else ever seen in this Universe."
7085c563-a458-412a-8a9b-52f4aa52b644: "Despite my mortal body, I am still not just an ordinary man. I'm not sure I can explain it accurately..." {n}Tristian ponders over it for a while.{/n} "The light has left my eyes forever, but my soul is filled with the shining of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}. My heart will lead me from now on."
62f3a551-0ee9-4651-b914-70d932af8e7b: "Please, don't treat me differently because of my blindness. I won't be a burden to you, I promise."
01bcbc97-55ac-490b-8716-6ec17473ef45: {n}Tristian hesitates for a while, then gently takes your hand into his palms.{/n} "But I was young and naive back then. I didn't know yet, that warmth of living being can outshine divine light."
c873e8cc-b4fc-48ad-95b2-976eac63e6a7: {n}The priest shakes his head.{/n} "I have to refuse, {name}. Something wicked is stirring in your lands. I must find out what is the reason. Jhod gave his life to this cause — it is my duty to carry on!"
156a162c-836e-4258-bff7-20dbadce53c6: {n}Tristian touches his face.{/n} "It is so. Her goal was to orchestrate our meeting. And she knew nothing better but to deceive a faithful servant of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} with a hope of forgiveness. Tricks and frauds are her specialty indeed."
5672bdd4-0fcf-4a02-a9f6-7296dfac2973: "The magical fog was her doing as well. She wanted you to go where she needed you to be. Wanted to gain your trust, fill your mind with lies, set you up for the fight with the Stag Lord... She fooled us all, playing our feelings of faith and duty… and I played my part in this heinous act."
144386e5-62ed-4cd1-ba8f-fd787a132be5: {n}Tristian greets you with a nod.{/n} "Thank you for coming. Unfortunately I have bad news."
0605c9a7-40e0-4643-96d9-fc9dba8bdf98: "I managed to find a couple of cultists from the Kingdom of the Cleansed. The poor fellows were scared to death, but I comforted them, and promised not to speak their names. Anyway, they left the capital, fearing your wrath."
e64b63cd-cfda-4d2e-b9c0-a170728db716: "None of them saw the First Faithful after that fateful meeting. The scoundrel vanished into thin air, and with him, all meetings, sacraments, and talk of the Goddess. It looks like the peculiar power of curses in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} is not in fact connected to these lunatics."
1e54cfb4-b0ba-435d-807c-adf3c57245c4: "Anyway, we managed to get their barkers off the streets, and yesterday's fanatics have returned home, to their families and honest work. Thank you for your help, {name}". {n}Tristian wears a beaming smile.{/n} "I will not leave you of my own accord, until I repay you for your kindness."
833f7b0d-ec9d-47ca-9f30-e99cb81a5627: "Any time. Just let me know when you gather your party."
cdd81f58-004d-4598-a5cf-046b5fa2516a: {n}Tristian frowns.{/n} "Not yet. I don't know whether to be glad about it or not. The priest may be regrouping — in which case it may be all the more difficult to defeat him."
594cea86-3966-4605-8054-b2b8f5bbd8e2: {n}Tristian smiles faintly with just the corners of his lips.{/n} "No, I don't. bb12be56-024c-425f-a2e0-00d1319749ac: {n}Tristian smiles brightly.{/n} "It is the will of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}. I was torn from her blissful radiance for so long. I shall never contradict her again."
77f154cd-addb-4915-aacc-d176d49360ad: {n}Tristian nods.{/n} "Hello, {name}. Do you wish to know what happened there, at the altar of the Cleansed? I'd like to tell you, but I don't really know how to describe it."
9ba425e6-6957-469f-b474-78242039d860: {n}The deva moves his shoulders, as if stretching unseen wings behind his back.{/n} "One way or another... I walk in {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} light once more. 04aac262-4f93-4d11-a8e0-1be51fdeaa86: {n}Tristian closes his eyes.{/n} "She has given me a special power — a gift worthy of her messenger in the material world. I think this power will be useful to us, when we confront Nyrissa in the final battle."
fa127ce0-a4fc-4b38-a15c-33d745584cc2: {n}Tristian smiles, almost humbly.{/n} "When... when my master touched me with her divine radiance... I felt her love. And pride. She feels I've learned much, living among the dwellers of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}."
0e025ea3-dbbc-4d2b-b22b-38ba23e31918: "None of this would be possible were it not for you. I owe you my life and my salvation." {n}Tristian pauses.{/n} "I once told you that I'll stay by your side until I repay you for your kindness. Now I promise you, I won't back down until Nyrissa is finished."
f983493c-0831-4ed7-b291-ca96d72ae65a: {n}Tristian nods.{/n} "And {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} knows this. That is why she entrusted me with this mission. 15f71ea1-b203-469f-8571-f00557041010: {n}Seeing you, Tristian smiles a bright smile.{/n} "How good it is to see you!"
1bbaadaf-e6f1-4f3d-a2db-a47c345cef5b: {n}Tristian looks at you carefully.{/n} "How can I help, {name}?"
c14da27e-3d02-4f40-a184-c873ef240d52: "Your steps sound special. I always know it's you."
3e8d98bb-e41a-4b2c-a051-f22b655ffa2c: {n}Tristian holds your hand and kisses it.{/n} "Yes, my love?"
19893d71-bbec-430d-821b-e5f638b0894b: {n}The smile that Tristian greets you with is sad around the edges.{/n} "Can you imagine, I just found out about you and... I hadn't noticed anything for such a long time!"

b0deb949-5ab9-4cd7-bd31-daa7d46cde18: "Burn it all! The tyrant's dead, to the Hells with his legacy!"

1906ef49-f539-4846-a495-e9729d581f44: {n}The troublemaker tries to escape but is swiftly captured and handed over to the guards. The remaining crowd quickly scatters.{/n}

2ebb316e-bfd5-40c9-91a2-7c469b4fb543: {n}The crowd roars, a mix of rallying cries, curses toward Irovetti, and praise for you. Stones, then torches begin flying toward the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy's{/g} windows, and smoke begins to billow over the building.{/n}
3f671212-86ad-443c-8125-33db5dfa71eb: "Maybe you should have! That Alondi was an asshole, and he got what he deserved. And you won! They're looking at you like their leader. And you didn't even raise a sword for it — a quill was enough!"

80ba287e-7531-47a3-a34f-43f0d29f9e82: "Yeah, that's right! I wanted to be a fighter, and I did! And what did you want to be? A rotten fish with bulgy eyes? Well, congratulations!"

f37cd06a-0d4a-4f47-a3b2-f4a27cdae498: "Why do you think I need any help?"
a2069ddb-f702-42e8-b483-efcd50f7afb1: {n}This dark-skinned, wily halfling is quite different from his kin who you've met in the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. He's constantly looking around, even beneath his feet, and rubbing his palms together as if the action is about to commence.{/n}
3657c0bb-c071-402b-9ed3-bfc838d1f8ab: {n}The halfling dares to look up at you — and you see servile admiration in his eyes.{/n} "{mf|Your Illustrious Grace|Your Illustrious Grace|Your Resplendent Highness|Your Resplendent Highness}, what... what an honor to meet you in person!"

52fb9322-c6a0-4197-b640-dfaf52d5789b: {n}The halfling drops to his knees and prostrates himself before you.{/n} "I beg you, just a moment of your time! Give this poor soul a chance to perform a sacred duty, which I owe to my brothers in faith!"
29d0d056-f870-4990-baf6-7eeacb2e5170: "The messengers of Abraxas informed us that a ruler of a faraway land had become the keeper of knowledge, bestowed upon {mf|him|her} by the Master of the Final Incantation himself. cd798b32-6417-484d-ac7a-5ea0bc351180: {n}Ekun gives a short nod, his face a picture of decisiveness and resolve.{/n}
ee4dd942-0109-4f7e-95cf-22497dbdbc6d: "My advice — strengthen the guard in the settlements along the border, and fortified our position there. Then the barbarians will have to come to us... and they'll be easily dealt with."
1af70592-de73-48e0-9e44-4c06841fed6f: "Yuk! Pshaw! Nasty! Why does Tavia eat this? Smells of flowers! Faugh!"
be2ada0c-905e-4fd9-af26-d13a40593fb1: "Oh no! That's my lipstick! From Absalom no less, made with rose oil! And you stole it… from me? No, I don't want it back, you can keep it."
111f8e86-9f25-4cf2-baca-b3233e61566c: "You had it tough, enslaved by the Technic League. Tell me, didn't you ever think about putting an end to all the suffering?"
8f752e2c-ce0d-48d4-a479-a6812466ab7c: "You mean cut my throat? Pff! That's for weaklings. Hell no, I prefer cutting other people's throats!"
cba5242c-9b04-4550-8b5f-44130f34e2dc: "You pray to your goddess with such devotion… But you never accused me of apostasy, like other priests. I appreciate that."
a11493f6-f797-4ed9-bb0a-1ae597aa5377: "There's nothing to be ashamed of. It's better you leave, than to stay and lie to yourself and your deity."
007f0cdb-c17e-45ac-bc81-5b9d6153e705: "So, you rule Restov? And what about the Aldori?"
0fde8e4c-5bab-434d-805d-a4022d2a05b6: "I would be happy to accept your offer."
000181e8-be6d-444e-a74e-56f1415c8ac1: "Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept it."
a990926b-a591-4708-80c8-6c2d12de7329: "I'll probably accept your offer in the end. I'll need resources for construction, after all."
9f5fd22f-4511-48c8-b769-e1ee0ed652bb: "What kind of 'events' were you talking about?"
46504ec6-a25e-4cd0-a478-c7917bb16175: {n}An older {d|Sellemius}man{/d} with full sideburns looks at you with interest through a golden eyeglass.{/n} "Well, now, if it isn't the hero of the festivities, the protege of our dear Jamandi!"
ee92332d-236b-4aa5-bd0f-520b296858c9: "You pulled this all off quite cleverly! I confess, I wasn't convinced your enterprise would succeed — I even bet a bottle of my best {g|Pitax}Pitaxian{/g} wine against you! But I'm happy to admit I was wrong. The Aldori have always been adept at finding new talent!"
cee72367-aefe-48fa-aa4a-a36b0db8d840: "So it would seem. I am {d|Sellemius}Ioseph Sellemius{/d}, Lord Mayor of {g|Restov}Restov{/g} — I rule this town and the adjacent lands. As your northern neighbor, I hope we can look forward to a long and fruitful friendship!"
79c71e5d-1287-483e-b955-01b4982144f4: "Ah, {g|Brevoy}Brevoy's{/g} politics seem complex and incomprehensible to many. Here, in this part of {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g}, the spirit of northern freedom still lives. We are loyal to the throne, of course — may the gods prolong the life of {g|King Noleski Surtova}His Highness{/g} — but here, far from the dominions of the great houses, we have our own way of life... It is especially important now, after the certain events that I probably don't need to name."
03905a63-c625-45cf-a934-4a8ff818ae49: "The Aldori {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g} used to rule {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g}. They're still the largest landowners and main military force in the region. But it's not for nothing that {g|Restov}Restov{/g} is called a free city. We're proud to choose the Lord Mayor from among the citizens, considered not by their lineage, but by their own merits."
175913af-0db1-47e1-a0db-9d62bdb72c05: "I don't want to boast, but things have been going well in recent years. Trade prospers, the population grows, and the citizens are happy! Although recently — especially after the disappearance of {g|House Rogarvia}House Rogarvia{/g} — more and more troublemakers have been appearing, and people are talking about the most shocking things... But those sorts of rumors aren't worthy of your attention."
d1f69876-49d6-4bf2-bfa3-dd2b06d8fb83: "Please wait a moment... Your young barony will need resources to establish itself, and from what I've been told, you're somewhat in need of financial assistance. I could organize and supply everything you need for the construction, and spread out the cost on extremely favorable terms."
ab12905e-a45f-4106-9eb1-0b8c2894caae: "The feeling is mutual, I assure you. I look forward to hearing more of your dazzling successes soon!"
060881d5-b6b5-40c0-861d-86c133e12081: "Then it's a deal! I'll get everything in order right away and schedule a delivery immediately!"
5f761b92-14f4-4b84-b4ba-99e1e8ed40af: "It's your choice, of course. I just figured I'd mention it."
0bbce35c-e932-4fb2-9486-3e0941ee0ac0: {n}Mayor Sellemius gives you a patronizing smile.{/n} "Why, an aspiring politician needs to be well-informed! I'm talking, of course, about the disappearance of {g|House Rogarvia}the ruling house Rogarvia{/g}. Can you imagine it? Old man {g|Choral}Choral{/g} conquered our land two centuries ago. It would be a shameless lie to say that nobody wished his royal house could just disappear into thin air. But once that exact thing happened — turned out, nobody was ready for it!"
6ad94881-46f7-4a2f-8012-22e51f6fa8d9: "Poof! All over the country, every member of the royal house disappeared without a trace! Nobody knows what happened. It is a mystery... But a mystery pregnant with opportunity for everyone!"
54331699-a49d-417c-8faa-754b0c92766f: "I could immediately procure, let's say... five hundred cartloads of building supplies. I'm sure that would give you a good start. In exchange, I would ask a small favor: until you repay the debt in full, you simply assume the obligation of contracting building services through {g|Restov}Restov{/g}'s builders guild. Do we have a deal?"
41763e56-6dd7-4617-be2b-fcdb58f287f6: Trolls who didn't fear fire? That sounded terrible. And dangerous. And terribly dangerous! If we couldn't rein them in, our young barony would be eaten up in a snap!
118a8405-4e5e-4bcb-a149-4becffa1ec9b: {g|Relations9_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "Send messengers to announce that all those unwilling to become a slave to Razmir must unite."
e006f6f8-b9e6-4fb6-a0a2-e2060ae0b71a: {g|Relations9_2}[Choice effects]{/g} [Gain 250 BP] "We aren't meddling in the domestic affairs of other countries."
4bc8b8e6-38d0-45fe-8de5-c28b090c3511: "I want to know more about this political conflict."
eaea8140-8b0e-434d-a620-1007f767be52: "The Outlaw Council wants to know our opinion on Razmiran's current behavior. They're continuing to expand their borders, slowly extending their territory on all sides. Tymon has already mobilized their army, and Lambreth is recruiting volunteers from among the Black Eagles. But alone, they can never match the might of Razmiran. – We must bring them together in stable union if we wish to curb Razmir's ambitions."
8dea8db0-8774-4ae1-a550-d14e918ce05e: "The Outlaw Council is willing to hear us out. Razmir is pushing back his neighbors in the East, and Tymon has mobilized his forces. Lambreth is bolstering the Black Eagles with volunteers. But their forces are scattered and divided. Only in a stable union would they be strong enough to oppose Razmir."
dc238532-151f-4c21-960f-98c62fa36615: "The Outlaw Council wishes to hear your opinion. Razmir is testing his eastern border once again, and Tymon's ruler has started recruiting mercenaries to oppose Razmir. Lambreth has mobilized the Black Eagles. Alas, these forces stand divided, where they should be united in common cause. Only a stable union can stand up to Razmiran."
8bc3b952-7dd3-400d-863c-e142ba956d6b: "Perfect! We shall call upon the River Kingdoms to stand together to face Razmir's threat. I'm sure this open confrontation of tyranny will only add to your fame."
965cd568-1eae-4388-9609-782e3ab7bf79: "We're calling upon the River Kingdoms to unite and face Razmir. His appetite is too immense to imagine that we are not likewise consumed. As for the common people, they will adore your commitment to striking down tyranny."
e46f3d03-c8de-4925-b53c-56f60b6459d3: "Well, Tymon and Lambreth are Razmiran's immediate neighbors to the East. Tymon's founder was Maldar Tymon, a renowned Taldan hero. By long tradition, it is a city of warriors, arena fighters, and gladiatorial champions. The Arena of Aroden is there, along with numerous military schools. Razmiran has a predictably difficult time of dealing with Tymon's army – especially when they're supported by Gorum's priests."
b04e4eda-9b6a-44f6-a29a-b1e3628d6731: "Tymon and Lambreth are Razmir's preferred prey, though both countries are hard nuts to crack. Tymon was founded by Maldar Tymon, a great warrior and a hero of Taldan. The state will send entire armies of gladiators and highly-trained soldiers to fight under his banners."
9b4fb079-d717-4781-9364-de305d28e26d: "It's obvious that Tymon and Lambreth will soon fall to Razmir. Tymon is a foolish state of gladiators, whose favorite sport is to slay one another in the giant Arena of Aroden. Their fighting ability is unquestioned, but they lack any political skill. Champion Ullorth Ungin, Tymon's ruler, begs the Outlaw Council in Daggermark to help him defend against Razmir every year."
16ab42f8-e96b-4798-a337-9d13cd13d50d: "Very cunning. Only two monarchs of the River Kingdoms can see the future of this land – Your Highness and Razmir. The others are destined to rot. We won't derail our relations with Razmir – not yet. It is more strategic to wait... and claim everything that he cannot claim himself."
0ce9bdb6-731b-4a4a-93d2-35edaea66f2e: "Kyonin and the other countries will listen to us if we vote for the River Kingdoms to unite against Razmiran. However, Razmir has made a generous offer in exchange for our silence. Besides, his future is far brighter than those minor monarchs. I think we should side with him."
442196f4-e168-44bf-948f-11afa64d2c79: "Sevenarches and other countries will listen to us, if we vote for the River Kingdoms to unite against Razmiran. However, Razmir has made a generous offer in exchange for our silence. Besides, his future is far brighter than those minor monarchs. I think we should side with him."
99856a83-516a-47a6-a852-ea09cf43c420: "Kyonin is prepared to follow us, and many others will join them. But on the other hand, Razmiran would generously reward our friendship. But to be honest, I think it's time Razmir be taught a lesson. Should we call upon the River Kingdoms to unite?"
b41e807e-856e-46b9-9067-9e3c525d2d13: "Sevenarches is prepared to follow us, along with many other countries, but Razmiran has promised to reward our friendship generously. Still, if you ask me, it's time to teach Razmir a lesson. Should we call upon the River Kingdoms to unite?"
87408b31-cd3d-4eef-baf1-3e46f06426b4: "The Sevenarches trust us to act as we think best, as do many of the smaller kingdoms. Razmir, for his part, has offered to generously reward our silence. But we must call upon the River Kingdoms to unite. The Razmiran expansion must be stopped!"
d72038cd-3ec9-4524-b95c-13a204d84f98: "Kyonin trusts us, as do many other states. Razmiran has offered to reward our silence generously, but I think in good faith we must call upon the River Kingdoms to unite. This Razmiran expansion must be stopped!"
79053136-91a1-4f4e-9b08-0d6015a59ac9: "Every year, champion Ullorth Ungin, Tymon's current ruler, asks the Outlaw Council to help him fight off Razmir's aggression. The Outlaw Council consists of the rulers each River Kingdom, and they hold court every year in Daggermark. Unfortunately, not many of them are receptive to Ungin's pleas. Even Kamdyn Arnefax is not his ally, though they have a shared enemy in Razmiran."
a4dd7a27-9327-46d1-a805-378b5ed6b65c: "Arnefax governs Lambreth, a small state that was formed through the union of three rival merchant families, who feared annexation by their neighbors. Razmiran's shameless land-grabbing is nothing new to them. – It was Razimir's invasion that elevated Arnefax from a mere general to the Dictator of Lambreth. The Black Eagles, his private knights, impose order in the country and ensure that his will is carried out. They are feared even among the people of Lambreth, but they excel at protecting the country and the citizens against invaders."
15da01ab-48fc-48ef-823b-b722a347dbdb: "The state of Lambreth was established by three merchant families who feared annexation from their power-hungry neighbor. Razmir's aggression elevated general Kamdyn Arnefax to the throne, which he occupies as a genuine dictator. His personal knights, the Black Eagles, are feared throughout Lambreth, though they maintain order and protect the country against constant Razmiran incursions."
8d0272b4-6c8f-4966-b613-95c543391313: "Despite this opposition, Razmir stands strong. Every year, champion Ullorth Ungin, Tymon's ruler, asks the Outlaw Council in Daggermark to help him defend against Razmir. Hardly anyone listens to him. What else would you expect from a union of River Kingdom monarchs, half of whom were once bandit chieftains themselves?"
9b73e8e3-eb22-4ff9-8551-9788a9949801: "Not even neighboring Lambreth comes to his aid, though both face the same enemy. The state of Lambreth was established by three merchant families, under constant threat of annexation by their neighbors. This annexation was exactly what eventually came to pass, though not by Razmir. Instead, Lambreth was seized by general Kamdyn Arnefax, commander of the Black Eagles. This grim dictator is no better than Razmir, if you ask me. His knights are known for dispensing justice after hours – as judge, jury, and executioner."
41b5c13d-76f5-4a18-b78a-af8e0f6007eb: "Clearly, the Outlaw Council has no wish to help those who are too weak to stand up for themselves. The Council consists of the rulers of all the River Kingdoms, and none of them have any desire to upset Razmir. There are plenty of fools among these minor lords, and none of them know the first thing about politics. Luckily, we're nothing like them!"
268d3418-0a9a-4c15-9490-6f9b487e4371: "You're sweet, Amiri. I'm sure you have a kind heart. If only you learned to control your passions..."
a3a95011-4959-4a76-a76b-5c5adbac5137: "A barbarian without passions is like without... hmm... – without guts, that's it! If I lose my rage, who will fight for you while you babble your prayers, hunh?"
3095258a-8a6b-44c6-bbf0-d25cd8575dd5: "Who are you and what is this place?"
0c5c5b77-b5a5-4835-8fa8-4f36bdb79be7: "How can we get out of here?"
5818c455-4c53-4b3e-996f-e59f1b6525ab: "I've seen something odd here. A vision of a woman — and many others — in the mist — they appeared before me, then vanished."
adaf6cc6-1851-4389-8499-7c74e768abc2: "Monsters are emerging from seed-portals into my lands. What do you know about it?"
48b43281-6d87-4f6f-bf71-6da959ab100d: "Let's stop talking about that for now."
4ce40077-08ec-4834-b88c-feafa9b82377: "Troubling events brought me here. Maybe you know something about what's happening."
ac761661-310e-4db7-9f72-2cc05074a842: "Could you tell me the story of the Goddess again? The short version."
9d669030-fa0b-43b2-8462-54d32389e9e1: {n}The gnome looks old, worn, and is covered in a layer of dust, as if he has sat here for some time without moving. His back is hunched, and as you approach, he tilts his head up to you, giving an odd half-smile.{/n} "Come, child! Come closer, don't be scared! The sound of your footsteps reminded me of..." {n}The gnome dips his head and goes silent, although his lips remain moving — as if he is speaking silently to himself.{/n}
551e4dec-c5fc-4b7d-8194-8aea56bbf90d: "This is the beginning that was before all other beginnings. The echo born before sound. This is the mark on the margins of sacred text, made by gods when they got bored. This is the world, but unlike all other worlds."
14d5e138-a545-4783-a3ad-bf419f9ac484: "Dear sir, I've got one thousand one hundred and twenty-seven questions for you. Approximately." {n}Jubilost coughs and straightens, as if trying to project an air of authority.{/n} "Do me the courtesy of answering at least one! Do you know why gnomes left the {g|First World}First World{/g}?"
09bb8132-9458-47cf-bbad-f3d5b36efd0a: "I'm just an old man, a remnant of the past in a world that cares as little for time as you care about the air you breathe." {n}The gnome covers his eyes and starts rocking back and forth.{/n} "So many things lost... so many people left...and still I'm here, here..." {n}His voice drops to a whisper, but he continues to rock back and forth.{/n}
9761de1e-4bd2-4109-b5b3-e8b0e9881c59: "Monsters? No, no... they are just creatures, frightened, as you and I would be so far from home. They've lived here with me for time countless, and were my only friends before the Bloom tore the world. It's not their fault! Seal the Bloom and they will trouble your world no longer!
1974852c-9aad-41d9-8ca5-4703db3cf162: "The Goddess once passed here. The proud one, the bitter one, the one who fell so far, yet never has fallen to her knees. Her steps still echo — taste the silence, the salt in the air is her tears. And when you blink, there's something in a corner of your eye — a shadow, a vision, a memory."
e9a71beb-9774-4e73-a340-de9a395c2270: {n}A strange glow appears in the gnome's eyes.{/n} "When you approached, for a moment I thought I saw Her again. The way you walk... this power you radiate… and a ghostly crown of a newborn kingdom upon your brow — it cannot be seen, but I see the weight your shoulders bear carrying it. Your connection with Her, with She who fell — it is stronger than you think."
1bef2f0b-e332-4ab1-b7b2-ac629610c60c: "Just like that? 'No'? Just 'no'?! Final and absolute 'no' without any nuances and explanations?!" {n}Jubilost's face is a mix of emotions that are difficult to read — he's either indignant, furious, or… very, very disappointed.{/n}
a1812218-189d-44a3-80bb-0601d3314037: "If you seek a snake, don't ask her slough for direction. But I'll tell you..." {n}The gnome goes silent, as if his ears caught something, then resumes.{/n} "Those... others... They never 'left'. They never 'went' anywhere. They just disappeared. Everyone disappeared." {n}The gnome averts his eyes.{/n} "I have nothing more to tell you."
920c1b82-18fa-4517-8bce-20722c5cdcba: {n}The gnome turns away and looks at his feet for a long time, mumbling under his breath. After several moments, he turns to you again.{/n} "It is possible to leave this place! Possible, yes... but to cross back, you'll need to bear the brunt of Her wrath. But it is not something you can find — it is something you must inspire."
e6d8e186-c0b4-42c7-8963-49e2c41ccbf2: "You have to follow Her. The Goddess who fell. You have to see the world through Her eyes, recognize Her voice among thousands of other voices. Go down Her path, awaken Her wrath — then you'll be able to return home."
9c6adff5-318a-406b-b8c1-c22da99efbb6: "So much meaning can be hidden in one 'maybe'… ask away!"
c56745fa-0c52-4bcb-80a7-ce6b312e34e8: {n}The gnome nods off, then raises his head abruptly.{/n} "It's you again! What do you wish to know, child?"
245e1e86-5637-4094-85a0-5d6eefa69e05: {n}The gnome's eyes glint slyly.{/n} "Would anyone listen to the stories, if they are told quick and simple? But fine. The one that sings dies of desperation in the night. The one that is dead poisons the clear waters. This poison born of death is what can awaken the wrath — and awaken the path."
ecc24d8e-6676-42d0-81ea-707374e2b173: "Wait! I'll tell you the story of the Goddess. It will help you, yes, it will…"
fb9d7070-629b-4eaf-b0f6-a3d9c06f920e: "You, children, are always so curious. Questions, more questions, then some more questions..." {n}The gnome shrugs.{/n} "Which should I answer first?"
d888183d-88b2-4d2a-b701-c5d46b452e23: "As you wish, child. As you wish."
93c8d9da-53b7-4087-8b82-e7c30414a0cb: {n}The gnome gives you a distracted nod.{/n}
9da674e4-2d5a-4f48-9ec1-e6f40d833154: "Indeed, you can meet my brethren in most unexpected places. Which makes the expression 'unexpected places' pointless where gnomes are concerned!"
2d74063e-13f4-4775-b8e4-fcb25e1c1478: "Poison... Wrath... This is... And that means..." {n}Linzi frowns, then cheerfully declares,{/n} "I can't understand it at all! But I'll write everything down, just in case."
8c752a53-a1d2-45d8-a811-a434b2b7ff25: "You are truly old beyond measure... What holds you here in this world?"
88427ae4-b728-44b1-89dc-05ed9368d081: "Nothing holds me but the world itself. You mortals love asking for reasons, as though the world were governed by laws of cause and effect. As if everything happened for a reason... Silly, stupid mortals. I am here simply because I am here..."
e4d1671c-4dc9-44c8-b2c0-3f6a9daa1442: "Oh, right, sure! The beasts aren't to blame — they were just hungry! But then, I'm not really to blame either, right? I just wanted to chop their heads off!"
15f4f2bc-0bd6-4d78-86a6-a49b421726fd: "Of course. No one is to blame for anything... You and they — you have much in common."
7415a085-0f59-4398-bccd-b05277a4c752: "Don't you understand you can never heal all the sick or console all the afflicted? Learn to enjoy life, not crawl through it like you have a boulder on your shoulders."
7731a89c-1a94-449d-9370-294cfbf03af6: "My vows are no boulder, but a precious load I carry through my entire life. Living is easy for you, but only because your existence is empty and pointless."
8da51e82-fd70-49e6-8bde-1bea90d663c7: "What do you want to tell me?"
3837bd32-b072-4292-914c-1c2293be0041: "Thank you for telling me your story. I guess we will be able to defeat Kargadd."
52465285-e9dc-4d95-b127-b86349d7ab38: "No. I can live without this knowledge."
3c9e6d15-6b14-4585-ad08-5baefc460b78: "I am ready now. No need to tell me anything."
c375bb43-11b9-44bb-bebb-41a4adcf4da2: "I prefer to know everything about those I travel with."
dad92bb3-8efc-4d38-9361-2cfc25d434ea: "So, let's sum up. What do we know about this Kargadd?"
155e8897-bba8-4d1c-9e89-c2515e4b58e0: "Why did the troll leave you alive?"
35bffa0f-130f-40d4-b763-408c367b1714: "It was Kargadd who killed your family?"
e2cff247-83e8-4e51-8801-3531022418cc: {n}Ekun nods.{/n} "You lead us to battle, thank you. This monster must not survive."
9730ee12-a8f2-4b32-9da7-78b97a939695: {n}Ekun exhales loudly, gathering his thoughts.{/n} "Rock trolls have more strength, brutality than the regular ones. Kargadd is the strongest. We fought. He crushed buildings with fists. He caught people up, tore them apart. During our fight, he just swept my body aside. Like he would sweep aside horse fly, annoyed but not harmed by bite. Do not be fooled by his clumsiness. He can be very fast."
6c85ed44-2b98-4cc2-a07f-793f123af758: {n}Ekun's face twists in a painful grimace.{/n} "Hmmm. Should you know the details?"
42e29a29-b0f7-4558-a69c-04231bb81e0d: {n}Though it is obviously hard for him to tell this story, you hear some relief in Ekun's voice.{/n} "I'm grateful you made me tell this. Needed that."
0ba9cff7-8505-48cf-9916-16036e908cb5: "He swept my defenses out of the way and crushed the wall of our house. He… seized my wife Amanda and.. bit off her head. Hurled her body aside. Clarissa screamed. He just stomped on her."
0d735953-47e9-4b03-8fd6-2ee3b01cfd15: "The trolls shouted it as a war cry. As anthem. Kargadd, Kargadd, Kargadd. They were yelling it when he crushed the walls of our house. When he... killed."
a5c4a652-e4f8-4d36-a13b-dd986de08513: "Wait, friend," {n}Ekun stops you.{/n} "Kargadd is near. Can feel it. On the ground. On the grass. On those rocks. Everything is soaked with his stench."
d9ef865c-2c8b-42f3-9f1b-7ee94d57752d: "At least they didn't suffer before they died." {n}Octavia puts her hand on Ekun's shoulder. The ranger flinches at her touch, then relaxes — with an obvious effort. {/n}
39daddca-b572-466a-bcb0-1c2d5c3b9257: {n}Ekun shrugs.{/n} "He was in a haste. The night was ending. In the light of dawn, rock trolls turn to rock they originated from. Sunlight is his worst enemy. Kargadd knows that."
8ace1819-0267-474b-8123-7605c8e5ad53: "Kargadd is a rock troll, thus he has greater size and strength than regular trolls. Fire and acid are not deadly to him, but still can hurt him. His weakness is sunlight, he has no desire to turn stone." {n}Ekun grunts.{/n} "The dungeon gives him strength, the rock itself heals his wounds. The battle will be held inside his home."
946e415b-b694-4ab3-b94b-e0d0d932231e: "Must tell you about him. You need be prepared. This fight will not be easy."
3639c586-25df-4ee0-b285-12e07aaac793: {n}Ekun nods in gratitude, but the pain in his eyes doesn't subside.{/n}
508407fb-b344-433b-bfc5-c1eb5c2f101c: "The atrocities committed by this monster are horrific indeed. We will deliver justice!"

d0ebab0a-4eb3-46f9-858e-225f470dd632: "And Elki fell in love right away, ha ha ha! Hey, what are you looking at? It's the truth! Well, she found us later. And bought our sweets, and started to keep an eye on us. She called us the Sweet Teeth ever since! Ah, our Elder... we'd be lost without her!"
1b11e7ee-3092-4cbe-8649-0be67ca3ec3a: "Such a shame! We only just got started! Oh, well, that's too bad."
725c234e-3d55-4672-a556-11bea1ce5904: "If you manage to come up with any more tasks for us — feel free to come visit! We're here all the time."
58066c37-3a0b-448a-918c-3110b3801aef: {n}Tevi lowers her eyes.{/n} "We promise to keep away from our friend. And I think I know why we're always being sent out on errands."
c95a12f0-f5fb-4a8b-8222-2881f8c1abae: "Regongar, what's that you're chewing? Eww, nasty! What is that, a rat? Raw? Aaaagh, how can I forget that I saw that?!"
8a183bd4-3d5f-4e9b-8891-30884629fd47: "Ha, you wuss! In Numeria we were glad when we had a rat for supper! Besides they're so fat and tender here in the Stolen Lands – yummy!"
4d796650-3533-42a0-861e-7af1c8933c38: "You smell like a warm bed, a cozy home, and food cooked by someone else. What the hell are you doing out here? Civilization has made you too weak."
1595e3e0-0184-4f04-8ca4-7e463e850931: "But smart – the smartest. I'm weaker than a bear but I'm smarter. Meanwhile you're about equal to a bear on both counts."
a5fe041b-407c-409d-a902-342e56fcc9b5: "Why? What is your purpose in this?"
06bd1e67-94c1-4a30-ac96-656d1543ae25: "I'd believe you. The fey are famous for their evil and pointless jokes."
6ab7a664-a840-4d2e-968d-b483d0dd7d32: "I don't believe you. All of this must be part of some larger plan – the details of which you've carefully hidden."
886c6ecf-761d-45db-9323-02b578e84356: "I don't know what to believe any more."
3834a6f8-7d1b-4105-aa33-e8cc1d90cb73: "So this tomb of the cyclops lord, and the gift of Charon – they never existed?"
95e82158-777d-4009-9a96-f0d12471cdc3: "What did you do to Varnhold? To my companions?"
438a4433-19c5-400e-9f6b-51d09b7f00ca: "You've told me about your game. So what do you want from me now?"
3ce459ec-65ab-4b7e-a0b2-0dec8e659ccd: [Step back to the portal] "Do not come near, monster!"
a6c49ecf-748e-48d5-b708-27e5f56f73ae: [Attack] "We have nothing to talk about, monster!"
846eaa1a-ccd6-4969-b70f-21dbbb681111: "I agree. Give me the power to protect Varnhold!"
a88fbdc5-26d7-4913-9398-bd69c54639ce: [Enter the portal] "I seek nothing from you. I am going home."
ff39a4f7-fe3c-4bd2-b185-38414ed5c481: "I agree. Make me the ruler of Varnhold!"
2f0c1793-1efc-4a44-bba2-8f71f150e21f: "I don't know and I don't want to know!"
9921e0c8-4af9-451a-88a3-38b0378c8517: {n}The monsters are dead, and the sounds of battle have faded. All you hear is the blood rushing in your ears, and the rustling leaves of the unfamiliar plants around you.{/n}
faae0bee-ee56-49f2-b4dc-b46d0b76e315: {n}The silence is broken by the measured clapping of a heavy pair of hands. Clapping slowly, a human-like creature enters the clearing, wearing a full helmet decorated with heavy horns. You can't see his eyes, but you feel the thick darkness under the helmet studying you with curiosity.{/n}
5c75a8ce-e56d-4546-8c86-c972a4f88afc: "Bravo. That was an exceptional victory. Not many mortals would have managed to get this far – not to mention killing two of my vassals. I am impressed. Such feats deserve a reward."
2173cdf7-cb65-4bb4-939a-12e6292a35fc: "Call me the Horned Hunter. I have other names, but today you'll have to make do with that one. I am the true creator and master of this dungeon."
8d1e4126-0f53-4674-8171-a14e73b5bd19: "Is there anything else you wish to ask me? You may do so. You have earned the right."
9fb3f00a-2077-4f14-b825-7c7e22749087: "We are on another plane, the world of fey. It is often called the First World. Or do you mean the dungeon through which you've just passed? This is Lostlarn Keep – my gate between the two worlds."
256850e2-7be3-453c-9cb5-5273bceb007f: "Once it was a castle of the proud Taldan Empire. Then it became the zoo of a sorceress who dreamed of other worlds. And finally it became my toy. I hid it under the ground, and quietly persuaded the locals that this is the resting place of their precious cyclops leader."
ac44658a-c01b-429d-957a-87bcfaf3fb89: "Would you believe me if I told you, I did it on a whim? As a joke? Would you believe that I've been playing this game for ages, just to see the expression on your face?"
c65aeacd-e8d6-499f-8dea-82bed2ac5f5a: "Oh, this is not at all pointless. You simply cannot appreciate the beauty of the irony. The lives of mortals like you are far too short to enjoy the depths of a truly epic joke!"
14f60e20-4f56-4d65-846d-bbff346ebaa5: "You are so discerning! Yes, there is a larger game, and you have played your part in it... Nevertheless, I do enjoy this delicious moment."
0e2e2d3e-3eb1-4008-abc5-c4949505f305: "Then choose insanity! If your mind has let you down, see what you can do without it. Maybe then you could catch a glimpse of the depths of my joke!"
c1ba76f5-ce64-4a1d-b6e0-135e2db040a9: "My long-term plans are not so distracting that I miss the beauty of fleeting events. I swear, I am enjoying this conversation like a glass of thousand-year-old wine!
057434d9-dc52-4daf-9568-bc864d06fe53: "Oh no! Both exist. They are not far from here – in the mountains to the south-west. I'll tell you more. The dusty lich has already awakened, and the hunt for his treasure begins... But alas, you will not be joining the others."
6a410135-95fb-4bb1-b6cc-bf9559f10f46: {n}The mocking voice of the Horned Hunter seems to come from nowhere.{/n} "I had hoped to reward you with a curse for good measure... But you've played quite a fine joke on yourself! Safe travels! We'll see if you can find your way home..."
63db127b-cbde-4907-8796-842daea4ef00: "Me? Nothing. That horrible vision your commander saw was merely that – a vision. When he returned home, he found Varnhold safe and sound. The wizard followed him. The two were about to muster a force to dig you up... But suddenly changed their minds and went... elsewhere. Indeed, they've only just set off. Many exciting adventures await them!"
311e1344-7dc7-4923-8a55-b0a97ec54b9e: {n}The mocking voice of the Horned Hunter seems to come from nowhere.{/n} "As long as there are monsters in the world, it will need a hero. As long as that hero stands guard, the torrent of monsters will be unrelenting. You shall defend Varnhold without rest or sleep, until the master of these lands allows you to leave your post!"
4dfe3803-1880-42cf-adf6-ac216986038a: {n}The last thing you hear is the mocking voice of the Horned Hunter.{/n} "Oh yes, you will be great. You will instill fear. I am generous! You will have title and dominions! I pronounce you {mf|Marquis|Marquise} Devouratio, the new master of Lostlarn Keep!"
60f34a7a-ea71-43e8-8a6a-aa75c21174d3: "You haven't found what you seek here, but you still deserve a reward. I know what it is you really want most in your heart. And I will make that wish come true."
ad056be1-8866-4830-8712-47629b97773a: "How rude! Farewell, then! But be careful as you go. These portals can be so unreliable. Who knows where you might end up?!"
584dd5d5-36f2-4803-b57a-675fb24b39f4: {n}Bursting into laughter, the Horned Hunter disappears. And with him – the portal behind your back!{/n}
410a7ee2-2907-4a7d-948d-f73eab92f898: "Deep down, you truly are a hero, aren't you? You don't like making deals with monsters and the followers of dark gods. You seek power – but not to impose your will onto others. No, you need it to destroy the monsters. Well, I can grant you this power! Take it from my hand, and become the defender that Varnhold deserves!"
5dd692e5-ef5e-4572-bfd9-4aff3093a78f: "You are not one to settle for less. You seek might, and to obtain it, you are ready to go anywhere, even to the god of death! I respect this. Come, take this might from my hands! Accept it, and achieve such greatness that would even make this land's former masters shudder!"
3f20c352-9e6e-4a0f-9616-8666690b8832: "You have served your leader long and faithfully, but you were not born to serve! No, your fate is to rule. That old fool Cephal refused to overthrow his pupil, but not I! I will help you get rid of Maegar Varn, and make you the sole ruler of Varnhold!"
1ff1fe3a-813c-4716-9e76-e3074303a365: {n}The Horned Hunter reaches out his hand, and you feel transported, far away...{/n}
9dab2e7f-9ac6-46c7-ba13-7c25266e10ae: {n}The Horned Hunter holds out his hand, and you're bathed in bright light...{/n}
f57749cd-3d1f-4ed5-9e7f-580c5984eebb: {n}The Horned Hunter holds out his hand, and the world goes dark before your eyes...{/n}
2dc4a6f9-04f9-4c3a-9f2f-a054862578b4: "Ah, if only you knew what a wonderful endgame I have planned... You know what? I guess there's no harm in telling you that secret as well. But first, try to guess, who was the key piece in the game of chess I played at Varnhold?"
b7196a36-000d-4e1f-b1ac-731f00ad0af2: "Ah, that's a pity. Well, this isn't the first secret I'll keep to myself.""
7b3cd9dc-a0a0-4dac-9140-f2a85db761aa: "That grey-haired queen who thinks himself a player? No. Though I do enjoy his type. Both far-sighted and near-sighted. A cunning fool, busying himself building houses of cards, which I do so like to blow down. Under different circumstances, I might play a most interesting game with him... But this time he stayed on the sidelines."
1e5fa584-ec62-42bb-8c85-c593eba7e5aa: "Don't flatter yourself. You are but a pawn, which got to the end of the board by some chance. Truth be told, you aren't supposed to be here at all!"
102347b2-b6dc-490a-a9ba-ab6c18095585: "No. On a chess board, of course, the king is more important than the other pieces, but only because without him there would be no game. But he rarely expresses the beauty of the game."
7d4cc620-6c18-4dad-aba7-db86ed4ab3ab: "The entire chain of events – everything that has happened and what will happen – was put in motion by Gunderson. That tireless knight, small but quick, keeps jumping onto squares where he's not expected!"
af843ca3-5155-4bff-b520-3dbe9ce8d16e: "It was I who pointed the way to the tomb of the cyclops ruler. Without me, he might have wandered through the mountains for the rest of his life. I summoned the darkness that opened the gates of the tomb. I led him to the treasury, from which he took but one bracelet – or rather a ring – from a sleeping finger. The sleeper immediately felt the thief, awoke from his deathlike slumber, roused his servants and sent them forth on a chase..."
43305437-e2a3-4f4c-8d58-2204ed88e7b0: "Such a knight's move would make any chess master jealous! Just don't ask me why I did it, or what's going to happen next. What kind of player would I be, if I revealed all my plans? But believe me, with each day, the stakes rise higher, and the game grows more and more interesting!"
0b73eae0-9b9f-42ac-8f89-9ad223cef7b1: {n}The mocking voice of the Horned Hunter seems to echo from nowhere,{/n} "Enjoy your reward, oh lord of nothing! My parting gift to you is solitude. Will he who has betrayed twice, draw his poison from the chalice? Will he find someone he can trust?"
9f9cba02-697f-4b1c-8331-467ff9510e76: "Sometimes I feel our arguments about religion are pointless..."
54d9c333-46c0-4f70-831d-ab98ae5554a1: "Of course they are, Tristian! Of course. Everything is vanity and fuss. Our conversations are nothing more than the rustling of leaves... And yet, admit it, you do enjoy our little talks!"
99d4b400-1d95-4788-b0c7-3c7af4ef5b4c: "Ekun, can you smile at all? Try it, it's easy!"
85ba7bc3-f9dc-4889-a074-b143f22a055c: "I can smile. I just don't see a reason."
f00010ff-3ff9-403d-97e1-0b4cb9cfd32b: "Your religion is insane. How could you pray to someone who wants to kill us all?"
eab73513-b8aa-4f21-aa0b-fc9c21b7151f: "Groetus does not want anything. This pathetic world will come to an end – one way or another. My god just patiently waits for that day. His path is patience, and humility in the face of the inevitable..."
728d586f-3545-4cbf-8ba2-181071547b1b: "You used to wear slave's shackles, didn't you? That's right. Your sort always benefits from lessons in obedience. With a few lashes to drive the point home."
56f976ac-6cac-4b73-b9a0-a604678b595e: "Oh, I learned my lessons well. You've no idea how much the one under a whip learns about the one who holds its handle! Make no mistake, I will pass my test."
c6663e5f-19cb-43fc-8bba-231faca10256: "Didn't you ever think about changing your ways, Nok-Nok? To be a bit less savage than your wild brethren?"
12a2bfeb-234d-4148-b9f5-ece9bd2e6cc0: "Nok-Nok is not like the others. Nok-Nok wants to be a Hero! Others don't. That's enough difference, why more?"
6592c964-64a8-4f84-83dd-272108aa3a6f: "Tell me, are your tattoos somehow related to the lightning you cast in battle? Or are they just pointless marring of your skin?"
c81fcb17-795b-4610-accd-e1f648f89454: "Why do you care? If you ask too many questions, I'll give you a brand to match!"
a1ff7853-a5d2-48fa-94ee-605a64ebfc37: "There wasn't even really a battle. The armies just stood staring at each other for a while, then the barbarians turned to head back to Numeria."

4d74eccd-e12d-4945-a669-8ef67abe6f03: "Rumor has it the barbarian chieftain left his men in the middle of a battle, so they turned their backs on him and returned to Numeria."
6eb7cb14-00b6-47eb-aa85-5fd94c18f42e: [Lie] "Sorry to disappoint, but I know nothing of the battle."
4c10371d-e774-41c6-9b64-7ea163aa35f8: [Attack] "We beat back the barbarians. Let me show you how!"
379513c9-74f3-4fdf-aeca-a2b9ce5140be: "Aren't you fed up with this Sister? I'd have finished her off long ago."
cbca77bd-8f8a-4e82-addb-0dadd21def88: [Attack] "I've learned all I needed. Now I'll deal with you once and for all."
e970da5d-8c9b-4c38-b81a-2b2d240d1ee7: "There was a riot in the Tiger Lords' camp. The barbarians deposed their chieftain and returned to Numeria."

15582ce2-5b98-47cb-bfd4-4968becdf9b9: "Good riddance, I say! It was long overdue! That man was crazy, anyone could see."

662fb5d6-0e70-4482-b59c-07e507a81579: "Maybe... but what if he isn't? The Sisters always claimed that once he exited the tomb, he'd be the mightiest fighter {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g} ever saw! f6332ce5-8f52-4572-88f4-2aa8e7beedd8: {n}The barbarians gather around the Sister's bloody body.{/n} "So, that's it... The witch is gone. There's no turning back now — Armag won't waste any time investigating, he'll just tear our heads off."
9c333050-b797-4477-9e45-40d5760affd8: "To the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g} with him! Are we supposed to wait here for him until we're old and gray? He's a traitor, not a chieftain! 478eaaf6-74ec-4dc2-ae29-d4b26741b5c5: "Right! Enough is enough! I say, whether he's alive or dead, we go back to {g|Numeria}Numeria{/g}! We'll tell the elders everything, and they can choose a new chieftain!"

e749f78e-dc5f-4df1-83da-3ca6a9120a3b: "That's fine. In a thousand years, someone will dig them up again, and then my jokes will come back to enslave all of {g|Golarion}Golarion{/g}!"

34d904cb-fd5a-44b8-9b74-5689e8dbc804: "Which outsider do you and your sister descend from?"
97e3d773-0087-4058-a554-97e12830a689: "Many think that evil literally runs in tiefling blood, owing to the heritage of their ancestors..."
49a5a5f7-0b4b-4039-8c2d-7d31e0301eea: "I never wish to see you or your sister in my dominions again."
00fe9365-9e93-42c2-969a-47233a4cae9c: "I want you to leave my lands."
ce84ed6d-21c3-4e7c-8380-a27622d45f80: "On second thought, no. You can stay."
9f5c4333-5ad7-40fd-a7e0-539218aad33e: "Who is this 'illusionist' who Kanerah called upon to change your appearance?"
bb2d4dd5-2107-4c8c-96cb-86d801649243: "Don't blame yourself! How could you sit at home, knowing that your friends would be captured and dragged to a torture chamber?"
6ad3dc55-c761-4cad-b358-5298c97c91e8: "How could you put the life and safety of your sister at risk? – For a bunch of trouble-makers, of all things."
5ef5b5f0-bbf8-4236-a2cf-c8210a3ae732: "You and your sister seem to have done everything you could to destroy each other's lives. All this could have been avoided, if only you were able to agree."
835dd99a-3e7e-44ef-822b-1e4600bf72c1: "It's hard to imagine a more foolish act. It's a sad outcome, but quite predictable."
dd6ca34c-08b9-4fbc-833f-f47f1c35a675: "You had me racking my brains! A girl shows up, acting like she wants to be my friend – and the next moment turns her nose up like she's seeing me for the first time..."
4ba2f355-0deb-4e8f-a1a6-ad0ab3557840: "It was clear from the very beginning that something was up with 'Kaessi'."
aa550aed-d102-47d1-8347-048773a44159: "A contract with a devil?! That cannot stand."
62de1b69-737c-40c4-b84c-706c9019d10d: "You tried to fix an injustice that came upon you as a curse from the cradle. That can be understood and forgiven."
be273ddc-c7c3-4592-ad9b-f952a48a3687: "No one is inherently good or evil. Only our intentions are."
a28ae5df-4145-41bd-a1b7-0cc651021a38: "I hope you made the most of that contract. That's what matters."
8bbd3531-8bab-47db-b169-bb8f0064fb8e: "I found out what I wanted, thank you!'
e852030b-3cf2-4d77-9de0-48fa567e299b: "How do you live with these switches?"
0878c92b-1aff-42de-8f27-155c9a2c4e54: "Do you like it in the Stolen Lands?"
e4cfec02-1b85-4267-8086-57449a8081c4: "I found a piece of paper with your poems..."
01cb82c1-b960-44c7-a05d-576702bab08e: "I think your poems beautiful. Do you mind if I read them from time to time?"
f9c6efda-b169-4c5e-89ae-188332a61bfc: "What was the agreement you made with the devil?"
153ed0b3-fa6f-4bc5-8f25-f6af4298f217: "What assignments did the devil give you?"
ade2dca6-49cb-48f8-99b8-54ef04f91ed5: "How does it work, your 'living in turns'?"
7b655793-c371-4c35-af3f-2ea3010697b0: "Do you like it in the Stolen Lands?"
e26871f4-cd3a-4400-82d2-bc96627101d0: "That road led you to me. And I must admit, I'm glad it did..."
6cc809fe-c145-44f5-8a1f-0f20bbdcf6a5: "May it be a road of joy from now on!"
8296aa58-e343-46a6-92a6-48ac27782291: "Enough sighing for the old days. There are more meaningful ways to spend your energy."
e90d4463-2acd-4885-bcab-c176e432acdc: "Why did you decide to remain in my lands? After you found and activated the relic, you could have left..."
0f993c8c-a0de-4537-a825-b158fa215588: "Tell me, what made you stay here after we found your relic?"
fad80a58-2a68-479d-9e62-26935fbd125e: "And why, I wonder, should I protect you?"
926aa10a-58df-4b0b-8c6e-5b8d804966f6: "You can rely on me. We'll find a way to deal with that devil."
cd69afc9-9c7e-4e03-8e89-e6f30604d3e6: "It's very arrogant to think I'm going to jump at a chance to protect you."
9eca02fd-86a8-4dec-8919-80590f0a601c: "The lives of my companions is more to me than can be expressed in words. I will try to help you."
3a3360fc-d55d-4f0a-8421-d8e28e51e91d: "I have important news for you – the devil known as the Forefather came to me..."
697f3736-5765-40d8-b5fb-b8bdb5694c59: "I didn't even listen to the wretch! Unfortunately, he escaped with his life."
f09851b8-605a-4b5b-8e75-468a59a4a526: "He wants you and I to go to the barrens to deal with the soul eater who killed Kanerah. He says he's ready to help."
f8dc8337-699c-4409-8d64-f4236623a2cd: "He offered his help against the soul eater who killed Kanerah. I'd rather not deal with such a creature, but I fear for your lives."
e72656f7-da00-459e-a450-33195c356108: "He offered his help against the soul eater that's hunting you."
578621d2-8153-4e09-9ef7-0af177b1b9c9: "He wants to help us get rid of the soul eater that's hunting you. We should take whatever advantage of the situation we can, no matter what methods we have to use."
8815c6a8-e002-47d3-b34a-da6104895098: "Don't you think the Disk of the Eclipse reacted strangely?"
db4c2d0c-745c-4ef9-aadd-fddc35acb51b: "It's strange what happened with the Disk of the Eclipse..."
321abd74-a046-4988-92f6-08f30c7df54b: "It doesn't matter what he wanted. Talking to devils is too dangerous."
84088b4b-2d12-4fa6-aaf1-04e64092d1a8: "It doesn't make sense to communicate with such dangerous creatures."
c9ae5d25-c8ae-4b70-8b05-41e90f396e27: "I wanted to talk about a personal matter regarding your sister..."
85fd9b3a-a766-4a69-a9ed-f1334f11db9e: "I told Kanerah that I like her. She reacted – strangely… – She broke off the conversation and ran away. Did I do something wrong?"
10073528-4340-4ec7-875f-c5dde0c8e986: "Forgive me if my words offend you, but I like you and your sister – both of you – and not just as my companions. I don't know how you will react, but she behaved... Rather strangely."
67d2a03b-49c7-44fc-8c92-290edc1fa2b5: "So what do you propose I do?"
29779d2d-d005-4993-9ec6-264419054830: "I think I scared you during the conversation in my chambers."
3605574b-a735-4a00-a0ff-259eb31ed651: "Would you like to spend some time together?"
bdbb00fc-c7dc-4387-be28-ec8627457403: "I want to tell you – we'll have no more intimate encounters from now on."
c4516875-a10d-4646-b576-114d4081d7fa: "I've missed you. I want to spend some time... alone with you."
46cacf13-61cf-43a5-a51d-35841b311adb: "I don't want to pressure you, but please know that everything I said is true."
c2aca062-0074-4f93-be81-f44545aabc9e: "This entire conversation was a mistake. Let's forget about it."
1b466e90-2387-47f9-9f24-86774167cf55: "With that stiff?" {n}Kanerah wrinkles her nose, but seems strangely saddened.{/n} "Very well, I'll get her. So long!"
ab9b0ff8-9fd3-4729-ae95-68701f270ded: "For Kanerah it seemed as easy as changing a dress. For me... it was unusual. So many smiles, so many admiring eyes. Still almost a child, at first I took this warmth for granted. Oh the heady wine of affection – how easy it is to overlook its poisonous nature!"
cfb7ef3e-0b90-4953-bbe7-9ec6d3ccff62: "I like your confidence. I have a penchant for the strong and confident..."
83131481-415d-4fb6-8f60-7d3e92afbad1: "Ask me anything. We owe you much, and being open with you is the least I can do to repay you."
e00ed20c-d79f-40c4-afaf-6d0c68c18ac4: "My sister and I were born in {g|Qadira}Qadira{/g} – the country of the radiant Sarenrae, where we tieflings are not very welcome. But for my sister this was more a challenge than a barrier. She wanted respect, power, and wealth – things we were unlikely to get, being who we are. But she found a way."
c7b270c4-deb3-4470-ab5e-e51eb5cf8743: "Trouble."{n} Kalikke says quietly.{/n} "My sister and I took different paths. Kanerah was able to earn the trust of a powerful patron, one of {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae's{/g} fanatics – a member of the Cult of the Dawnflower. His mercenaries hunted down secret cults and monsters day and night. Meanwhile, I found a group of castaways, who reminded me of my sister and I as children – tieflings and genie-spawn. We gathered in secret to share our sorrows and dream of finding our place in the sun."
371e36da-47c8-4056-9dd1-b73dadd93818: "Oh, I cannot answer that question in much detail. The 'Kaessi' you met at the reception in Restov was Kanerah. – At the time, I'd been sleeping in our demiplane for over a month. I didn't even know my sister wanted to join the expedition that Lady Jamandi was sending. And then suddenly I was thrown out into reality – in the middle of a burning mansion with assassins dashing about! And the swordlord fighting monsters in the grand hall."
4aa7a1df-c81a-48f6-80f4-91a2fa153136: "Oh, I could tell you a lot about it..."
fd6f9921-59c3-4a14-8124-414e97c32727: "That's reasonable. Who wouldn't want to know about their subjects and companions?"
a7beffb0-aae0-4718-b286-238da56e0b1f: "The beginning of this story is quite unexciting. My sister and I were born in {g|Qadira}Qadira{/g}, a place most unsuitable for tieflings. The people there honor the radiant Sarenrae, and think of themselves as guardians of the good. Of course, no one threw us in a dungeon right away or tried to kill us for no reason. But we could forget about social status. It's impossible to rise from rags in that country, where they value connections and reputation more than gold. Since birth, they looked on us as evil creatures, vicious and unpredictable."
accbfa9e-8cd6-46d5-8a79-153fc8b661b9: "We've lived for a few years under this disguise, gaining a certain status, affluence – and crowds of gullible suitors. In time I found a patron from among the followers of the Cult of the Dawnflower. A man of great wealth, with a personal army of mercenaries, who roamed the lands of Qadira night and day, seeking out monsters and those who worship them. I quickly became his confidant and joined that army – all as the Forefather desired. Perhaps this is why the devil agreed to give us the appearance of aasimars."
391694f2-2838-4f56-9524-0bb8c49d6ec9: "You know the fun part of our story? When Nethys returned me to life, the poor hungry soul eater started following my trail again. He cannot discover me, so long as I live disguised as Kaessi – but he keeps trying. That's one reason why my sister and I never stay in one place for long. We moved north, living here and there until we reached Restov."
ca59b724-e28f-411f-9ef9-3d1f44d4fb00: "What, already? How do you resist my charms?"
db4acb68-d4f4-4ab2-a43d-394306ca9300: "Admit it, you like my horns. Or is it the tail?"
b808c40e-d3ad-4c0d-8181-544c4cec6140: "{g|Nethys}Nethys{/g} is the god of magic. There are no limits to his power."{n} Kalikke speaks with awe.{/n} "He was born human, but achieved such unparalleled mastery of magic that he gained divine power. He is the embodiment of paradoxes, contradictions, and making the impossible come true. I called on him at the moment of my greatest need, and he — through his Herald — helped me when all the 'kind and merciful' gods fell silent. But I'm no naive worshipper. – The gods, especially him, are powerful and unpredictable. Besides, he's hardly interested in my gratitude. But I do honor those who help me."
4074c660-e3eb-452d-ad0c-acdee0071e19: "You'd better ask Kalikke about that. When she learned of my death, she pleaded to {g|Nethys}Nethys{/g}, the god of unparalleled powers. And his {g|Arcanotheign}Herald{/g} agreed to return me to life, but in the state we're in now: only one of us can be in the Material Plane at a time. Meanwhile, the other sleeps in a special demiplane."
cb8868be-aecd-413d-bd01-22fd48672bea: "We are what happens when mortals mix their blood with evil outsiders – mostly demons, daemons or, as with me and my sister, devils. This heritage can manifest through many generations, and can be a cruel blow for the parents of a tiefling." {n}Kalikke frowns.{/n} "As you probably know, there's hardly a corner in Golarion where the birth of someone like me is considered a welcome gift."
f56a4049-2e9f-4918-ab5d-cd3d61660c2f: "While one of us is in the Material Plane, the other sleeps in a demiplane created specially for us. There we sleep and sup upon elemental energy. When one of us enters the Material Plane, the other disappears. Until recently we couldn't even control the moment when we switched. – It seemed to happen randomly, usually while we slept, but sometimes in broad daylight. Now, thanks to you, we have a little more control over what's happening. It's been a great relief."
0c110880-db0a-4379-9922-53803c433e97: "After my sister almost got my friends killed, and I in my turn brought the wrath of her former patron down upon her. Kanerah died as she fled from him. In terror, I could only pray to the higher powers, and the {g|Arcanotheign}Arcanotheign{/g}, {g|Nethys}Nethys'{/g} Herald, answered this prayer."
378b0222-be6d-48cb-a7a4-fc9ae15d3154: "We are born if an ancestor laid with a powerful and evil outsider, be it a devil, a demon or some other dark creature. Many mortals do this, believe me – either for power or pleasure. This heritage can be hidden for many generations. And it can manifest in many ways. – It's difficult to find two similar tieflings."
22b18338-c29b-471d-a3c9-43078897afbf: {n}A smile, sincere but sad, appears on Kalikke's face.{/n} "My sister and I... we are twins, but we're as different as day and night. She was named Kanerah, which means 'Silent Flame' in our tribe's language, and I am named Kalikke, 'Silent Storm'."
ae76e8a1-6900-495c-b61c-e060d45dab5c: "From a devil. I can even guess which one. Of all the infernal beings worshiped in Qadira, the whore queen Mahathallah is the most venerated – secretly, of course. Servants of her court frequent these lands. And they leave... trails."
70e64516-6d87-4b7f-a390-bff636643a98: "Those who think so are both right and wrong. Your fate is not written by your blood alone. Surrendering to the temptation of evil is a choice every tiefling must make for themselves."
5648d884-404e-4125-a9b7-dfef6a807fee: "It's a beautiful land – but quite unlike the Stolen Lands. My sister and I grew up in a place dominated by the desert. I've often heard from travelers that such landscapes depresses them, but there's nowhere I feel more at home. Sand-drifts under the sun, life hiding where you'd never expect it... The lush green of a suddenly-revealed oasis... They are austere lands, but can be breathtaking."
6092af96-0940-4b19-90dc-c9403005e16c: "The cities of {g|Qadira}Qadira{/g} are an endless whirlwind of turmoil and bright colors. Some say the heart and essence of every Qadiran city is its temple to Sarenrae – ever since our country was blessed by the radiant goddess. But I'd put it differently. The heart of every city is a noisy market with its tents in every color you could imagine. Most of the city's life happens at the market. People go there not only to trade, but also to have fun, negotiate, and spin their intrigues. Take away the market – and what's left of Qadira?"
ad30ccbf-c1b5-4099-bd6a-7f439f07e596: "We were at our eighth summer when Kalikke, the spring of my solace, got angry at me and chucked a bunch of desert thistles into my hair. I had to cut them out afterwards! That's what you have to suffer if life 'rewards' you with a sibling. Though I should say – that very evening I burned her favorite dress. With great trouble comes great satisfaction."
40c2aa10-7c6a-4b3c-993a-2cdbc0e656ad: {n}Kanerah gives you a wry smile.{/n} "What a surprise... It's little wonder that he came to you instead of me. – He respects hierarchy, as devils should. So what did he want?"
2f75dcfb-4f21-4410-8d84-75f7567c66da: "Oh goodness, what fatherly commitment! You're right, he might be useful. But dangerous too, like any devil. But since it's my life that's at stake..."
75ce531b-29f7-4cef-a77f-9eaade040edf: "As you wish. Now, thanks to you, we can at least switch when we want to..." {n}Kalikke closes her eyes and focuses, calling to the other plane.{/n}
841084be-8006-4ffb-a489-6b733b2cf089: "And that's it?" {n}Kanerah slowly sways her tail.{/n} "I've been known to spark... curiosity."
8f73f635-1ec3-4651-aa77-41d8e8bf42a0: "{g|Qadira}Qadira{/g} is a part of the Padishah Empire of {g|Kelesh}Kelesh{/g}, a great, thriving state. Don't think me rude, but the northern states are but a pale shadow of my homeland. Only Taldor at its height could compete with us, though it's long since lost its power. My land is wealthy, powerful, and full of opportunities for anyone cunning enough to seize them. It's a pity they're all devoted to Sarenrae, and the whole array of superstitions that go along with it..."
2286b8ad-aa44-41dd-bad8-0adf2184dc8d: "Look at your golden-haired boy priest, and you'll see at once what exactly makes living in Qadira so unbearable, despite all its grandeur." {n}Kanerah wrinkles her little nose.{/n}
09387fe2-cf21-478a-b176-5ee37a017694: "I'm not one to judge you, but refusing him might not have been the most sensible thing to do... at least for me and Kanerah. Who knows why the Forefather came to you, and what awaits us, after... But now is not the time for regrets. What's done is done."
ed005ac8-f5d7-4907-82bc-de674bf665f5: "The soul eater has returned! I don't know what to do, {name}. I'm worried sick! A devil's guile knows no bounds, but if my sister is in danger... I beg you, at least try to find out what the Forefather is plotting, and whether the soul eater really is once more at our heels..."
ebe4935c-e4d1-4a2a-9e37-803ca0f23c85: "Dealing with devils, one must never drop one's guard, not even for a moment. But it's also true that it's best not to ignore them or their warnings. Especially when they involve mortal threats. And when it's your own life in the balance…"
20947c89-fcb5-485f-b65b-8fa5dc7116a7: "But you are listening to me." {n}Kanerah smiles innocently.{/n} "I wish I knew what he wanted... You can't just dismiss the words of such a powerful creature, even if you consider him your enemy. But what's done is done. It's not my habit to judge the actions of someone who has granted me their protection."
7b819346-cff5-4a6c-8084-dce52b45e4fb: {n}Kalikke smiles faintly but her eyes remain sad.{/n} "Ask what you will."
0d2ec191-dc74-444e-948d-4996bc443593: "I think we all have different experiences. What would you like to discuss?"
1d58e9b8-7a23-4654-9acc-9b962c3169c8: {n}Kalikke's eyes flare but she restrains herself, saying only:{/n} "Is this your final decision?"
8a0c21a3-ef4c-4fe7-a6d9-458844fc2040: "Well, it's not the first – and of course it won't be the last time we're driven away. Farewell!"
1792a4c0-caf4-4684-add7-82d1d37f26c1: "I can't imagine a reason that would make you wish to part with me. Are you sure?"
12a3a7ec-ae3a-43c3-8d5c-c78286716a36: "I never doubted that you would change your mind."
3cbdba00-4f55-4499-8eac-9547833c1916: "Very well, goodbye. I will entertain myself with thoughts of how quickly and bitterly you will regret this decision..."
53c3d49c-ffb9-48c5-a4fc-6dbfbb63f600: "But it was not enough to entirely hide our essence and pass as an emberkin. And Kanerah... asked for help. She asked a master of deception and illusion." {n}Kalikke frowns. She obviously wishes to get through this part of the story as quickly as possible.{/n} "We left our native desert, crossed half of the country to avoid accidentally crossing paths with anyone from our tribe, and set off for a new life, in a new 'skin'."
d930f55c-cb1c-48aa-8c92-72297b82fc82: "Kanerah was born a few minutes before me. I suppose she just elbowed me out of the way in our mother's womb, to become the firstborn. Being the first – that's what she always craved. I never felt offended by it, though. Whenever the storm clouds gathered above our heads, heralding danger and trouble, my sister walked forward one step ahead, tightly holding my hand."
9f4690c8-1bd3-4ff7-bf94-2e9ab2b543f1: "I remember the day when I and a company of my friends met three young tieflings trading simple delicacies. As I reached for a coin to buy some food, my friends took me by the arm and led me away, saying a flameborn shouldn't take anything from the hands of unclean beings."
d5fcecc1-e20b-48b6-9c1a-c8c27e32b91e: "A flameborn…"{n} — says Kalikke sullenly.{/n} "My 'friends' would have been surprised to learn what sort of flame burned in my blood. But enough of this... I deceived them, and they were glad to be deceived, and no one was to blame. There is only one thing I regret – the rage that replaced the joy in my heart. Rage is not the best advisor – as I learned later from a bitter, bitter experience."
d06545f7-65df-4497-890b-fd9259349faa: "A devil." {n}Kalikke answers shortly, and stops gloomily for a moment.{/n} "A powerful being, mighty and ancient. He made a contract with Kanerah, promising to weave an illusion for us. Luckily, my sister promised him only her service, not her soul. Ask Kanerah about details if you wish. Just remembering that creature's voice makes my skin crawl."
23f31883-03eb-46f1-9982-30151fb179cc: "Time passed, and these gatherings became more bitter. We yearned to prove that monster blood does not make us monsters. We spoke of how we should unite, and enter the great games of Qadiran aristocracy – supporting those who were ready to accept us as equals, and bringing down their opponents. We planned to use me as a cover – 'a beautiful emberkin', who would be the voice of the castaways."
1f8b152f-7257-49cd-83ea-3ceda1606797: {n}The girl lowers her head.{/n} "One evening, my sister came to me, full of careless grace. She told me that there was to be a raid on our secret meeting that very night. I had to stay home, and not even think of warning the others. It wasn't hard to guess how she found out. – The raid was to be led by followers of the Cult of the Dawnflower – fanatics who fancy themselves cleansing flames, saving the world from evil. Kanerah's patron, first among them."
9a167180-1ffd-4651-a80d-6f983d906824: "At that moment, I realized my sister loved me so much that she was ready to set aside her aspirations, and warn me of the danger. But I also realized something else – Kanerah was ready to sacrifice any number of innocent lives to get what she wanted. I ran away... after yelling in her face that she was a monster. I left her to warn my friends. – It's the last time I saw my sister alive."
18d41566-b09a-4ccd-bd2a-d69bd7cf8c1d: "I tried to save my friends from the raid, but came face-to-face with wizards from the Cult of the Dawnflower. They were able to dispel the illusion that protected me, and found out I was a tiefling. My secret was revealed – along with my sister's. What a shock it must have been for her patron, to find out that a clever tiefling was serving at his side, disguised as a righteous aasimar! There is no worse deed in Qadira than disgracing your patron. Kanerah knew this well, and tried to flee, terrified of his wrath. But she couldn't get away. Trouble came to her from a place she didn't expect. Ask her about the details if you want... I lack strength to talk about it. The truth is, I betrayed our secret, and my sister died because of it. I was able to bring her back to life, but bitterness has scorched my heart, and will be a part of me until my death."
79d88939-5935-44b2-8d2b-3a4d93449032: "Thank you. Your compassion gives me strength."
3630d339-1603-4348-92d2-395147b2ce75: "I don't know the answer, {name}. But I do see that my 'good heart' led my sister, jewel of my heart, to her death. I still cannot tell whether I was right or not, or how I would act if faced with a similar choice."
56273203-cd98-442a-873b-aaee78f34bdb: "I acted without thinking, I admit. But I wouldn't wish this choice on anyone – to choose between friends and a sister... I often ask myself – what would have I done, if I'd known how great the danger was for Kanerah? And I do not know the answer."
25f24402-b411-4cdc-aabd-df0a6e7cfb11: "Perhaps. But can water agree with fire? I do not know the answer."
dc32cffb-87e5-4f42-962f-8d573694e5a8: "You may be right. But how could I have stayed away, and not tried to warn those who trusted me?"
76b6b92c-160b-400b-83c3-0fafa92370c8: "I wish Kanerah and I were more alike... We nearly destroyed each other, after failing to accept each other's wishes, and the paths we chose. Sometimes I feel that the life we now live is the best we could hope for. We can never meet, can never share each other's sorrows. But at least I don't have to be upset about her cruelty towards others. And she – about my softness and recklessness."

02f3bb03-d7dd-4090-983a-e8a6f3771ec3: "Of course, a masquerade of that sophistication required a little outside help – and I found it. 18db2b3d-10cc-4cff-a44d-bfe6c62c730b: "Of course I did. I would have done so much more, but as always, nothing went according to plan."
ce6b237b-1ecf-48be-bb31-06f95a758655: "Anyway, it's all in the past now. The contract was annulled by my death. Now I'm free to live as I wish."
361b21e6-7656-41ac-8615-c15af831b4b6: "Everything was going perfectly. But then Kalikke, that silly child, got herself mixed up with a band of tiefling renegades, who were too cowardly and stupid to achieve anything in their lives by their own wits."
2307345d-334a-475a-9a1c-aac17a08317f: "By the power of {g|Nethys}Nethys{/g}, my sister and I cannot meet... for as soon as one of us appears in the Material Plane, the other one is immediately spirited away to our demiplane. a902319c-cddd-4a48-8fd7-b6a7f4d63e93:

73612664-76a6-4f11-98d9-a258a2e30abf: "But nothing works out as one plans. – She hurried off to warn her friends, and fell into the hands of the Cult of the Dawnflower. 3cfa9c8e-1a1b-49c7-afe0-3fff5514682e: "It's a pity this ability came after we'd paid such a heavy price. 6184e034-0129-4296-abbb-0d570e0a53a5: "Our home is always open to you... as am I!"
9ac55f93-3a9a-40da-855c-9e758a49558e: "The people of Qadira revere the blood of the skies with the same fanaticism with which they distrust that the blood of {g|Hell}Hell{/g}. 200e83f8-bba6-4e50-ac35-ee3ebc76b37d: "It's not easy. {g|Nethys}Nethys{/g} made us agree to keep our story secret.
