2285bb28-3f4d-49d4-a8c8-f26677df6394: "Hmm?" {n}It seems that Mim has again been carried away by the sight of the mountains.{/n} "Oh yes, of course... Uhh... about what?"
a77a08c4-bbe2-4c99-be61-5b92cd4825c1: "I... I don't completely understand it myself... I woke up that morning and thought – it's now or never." {n}Mim sighs and shrugs.{/n} "And it turns out I was right!"
f34f530d-816b-461d-8f5f-06e3407702ba: {n}Mim laughs.{/n} "I wish I knew the answer! But I never gave the decision a second thought. I just grabbed my backpack and stepped out. And it all turned out for the best!"
120009ab-2c9e-4fff-acb8-966eaae36368: "I have to admit, I have no idea what my third wish should be. I'll tell you as soon as I come up with something. Now if you'll excuse me – art can't wait!"
917cf997-373c-4bc9-8f34-8f830416b5c9: "Not yet. You can't rush the delicate movements of the soul. I can feel it growing within me, and that's all for now."
9e4a7e09-6dca-4886-8a77-8e58a297af99: "I don't mean the ordinary tavern booze. I need something delicate... rare... like... like berry wine from {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}! Or even... Oh lord! Elven absinth!" {n}She slaps her head, freezes for a second – and starts speaking faster and faster, and waving her hands in excitement.{/n} "Why, of course! Why didn't I think of that? Elves! They're so close to the nature. To be one with nature! That's the unity I'm looking for!"
4e520ce3-7027-420a-bc89-0960e6eb6c95: "Nok-Nok, why did you make that hissing sound — and why are your weapons out?"
baf54971-52a8-401e-b565-a4d9f029dc37: "Book. Linzee's book. I see it looking at me, like it about to attack – but not if I get it first."
968829d8-1b1b-4b77-9343-ccf31219e4c2: "Couldn't we find a better place to rest?"
da4a1055-a47d-4a05-b4ad-6cd223504a18: "Apparently, trying to get ourselves killed by monsters and bandits is no longer exciting enough. Now we're spending our nights in their lairs!"
b4ddee3a-f36d-4d68-afcf-c7e6775ce695: "Just try not to think about it. Tell us about your adventures instead!"
d848c810-0610-4a4c-b50d-cf0775f0e9dc: "Couldn't you keep your mouth shut just once? Stop your complaining and pretend you have some shred of dignity."
448b730c-b260-4a53-843b-b118d59cddc0: "This crappy place fits you better than anything else, gnome."
822c5a72-1975-4651-b1e2-069531bcf877: "Didn't get enough walking today already? Ready to gather your things, move the tents and make a fire someplace more to your liking? Go ahead then! Be my guest!"
5394d175-760b-49aa-9a2a-723263df261b: "Eestian, where does Sarenrae live? On the sun?"
a923dbdc-7619-4764-9752-ae1e122a939e: "No, Nok-Nok. But once I heard a story of a powerful wizard that made his home on the sun."
48587704-2e6d-4318-b0da-02120df5669c: "You know, Ekun, perhaps you should join those who venerate Sarenrae. She could heal the wounds on your heart."
17480861-b94f-4173-993c-c63f41bd9909: "Torag is a good god. He was with me when I was at my weakest. When I was dying. Why should I turn away from him now?"
7b4eb2c2-343b-4797-95d9-68d6a4e8623c: "Don't look at me, storyteller. I have no stories for your book."
13e92275-eed2-401c-b2d9-d0d54eee99e8: "Oh, how come? You can talk about every leaf and bug in the forest! You can't say anything about yourself?"
0cd54ee3-9e89-4c0c-b62d-31467196b227: "Are you serious? Just abandon everyone and leave?"
a6b9b548-8f13-4ca9-9ef2-2f480a74b0e3: "That's a great idea! Let's just run — get as far from here as we can! — Right now!"
6e85b736-5ea2-47f8-a17d-53e02698b59b: "What a silly idea! I can't abandon my {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom} and all my friends!"
3f4cceea-6df8-4df9-a795-c54f5443d97a: {n}Octavia holds you tight. Her soft lips touch your ear, and she whispers softly.{/n} "Listen... Aren't you tired of all this? Expeditions, battles, constant blood and dirt... And worse yet — ambassadors, advisors and giving orders!"
c3d843e8-2db5-4f27-85c1-c2063b203f50: "Let's just run away. Abandon all this. They aren't children — they'll figure it out without you! And we'll go... To {g|Absalom}Absalom{/g} — I've always wanted to see it! Or no, even farther! — Beyond the sea to {g|Osirion}Osirion{/g} or {g|Katapesh}Katapesh{/g}! Just you and I!"
2366cd49-6971-4f28-bc30-b06f3111c3b9: "We'll take him with us! We'll all run!"
26c8582d-1326-4b90-b45d-c260ff7f1f39: "Are you... Are you serious? Oh, {Name}, I love you so much!" {n}Octavia clings to you even tighter.{/n} "I was just joking, of course... What would they do without us? But you know what..."
d68133b6-d1f3-431a-8382-cd4db36969e0: "Maybe later, when all this is over... Maybe we really will run away. Think of it!" {n}The half-elf kisses your ear and pulls away.{/n}
9beaf847-a0e4-47bc-9bf5-6c485ebb546a: "Well, yes, duty calls... A girl can dream! But you know what..."
91dae0fe-2095-4abd-80e1-39e4de5a7d16: "I'm not sure. I guess I probably am. We can't let everyone down, can we? But you know what..."
c316d5f9-396e-4373-be78-58177a5bd89e: "Citizens of Pitax! Irovetti is dead — the tyrant is no more. If you think this is a time for riots, you are mistaken. Surrender the troublemaker to the guards and leave peacefully, or I will have to disperse you by force!"
74680d2c-d3d3-4eda-996b-ddf2a6b647bb: "Alondi, you dirtbag! You stand there pretending to be a hero — why don't you tell everyone why you were thrown out of the academy?"
272a8fb1-e876-4840-9508-88b99bdac972: "What are you doing? Shame on you! Look at yourselves — you're like animals! This is how you act after I freed you from that tyrant?"
3ecd2cf2-7adf-4024-99bc-0e2ca2139828: "Let's go, Linzi. Let them do what they want. It's their city."
faf34a17-b6f2-4f8d-b552-f43d69d9489e: "Burn it all! The tyrant's dead, to the Hells with his legacy!"
20e4146b-bbda-4089-859a-a7a8af154753: {n}A crowd of citizens, armed with whatever they could find — bludgeons, daggers, torches — murmurs indignantly. They're listening to{/n} {d|Alondi}Alondi{/d}{n}. A man in expensive clothes lies at his feet, writhing in a puddle of blood as he presses his hand over a wound. You gather from the screaming crowd that this must be Nunzio Arpaia, Irovetti's master of ceremonies.{/n}
e47afe02-1713-49bc-ae82-cfafd5953308: "Citizens of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}! For too long have we tolerated a tyrant as he trampled our city into the mud! Well, no longer must we fear telling the truth. You've all read the {d|Linzi Book Gloss}book{/d} by Eobald the Insightful — the only art taught at the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy of Grand Arts{/g} was that of licking Irovetti's boots! We students were trained not as bards, but as jesters, like this man here!" {n}Alondi kicks Nunzio in the ribs, but he seems to have stopped moving entirely.{/n} "Enough of this mockery! Our art is finally free! We'll build our own academy — once we've burned this old travesty to the ground!"
e0b77686-a743-4330-9fe6-a276bff07597: "Wait, what are you doing?! We... we didn't write the book for THIS! Alondi, have you no shame? Do I have to remind you why you were-"
6fb51842-f7b5-48c7-8e86-e59a41915587: {n}Alondi interrupts Linzi, raising elated screams from the crowd.{/n} "Look, it's Linzi! The hero who revealed the truth to all of {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}! Hurrah! Hurrah! Glory to the heroes of the resistance! Down with Irovetti! Burn the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy{/g}!"
9f6fd215-74b3-44d4-98e9-cdcac4170683: "Look! It's our new {mf|king|queen}! The one who liberated us from Irovetti's oppression! Glory to {mf|His|Her} Highness! Down with the tyrant! Hurrah!"
10d77a00-e32d-46fd-8a12-7d13b8bf5457: "Look at them! They killed Nunzio — a funny old man who'd never hurt a fly in his life. And now they want to burn down the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy{/g}! And it's... it's all because of our book..."
0e9dd984-fc47-44df-ad55-fb6cee405778: {n}Alondi pales, then flees. After some confused clatter, the crowd also wanders off.{/n}
eaae798d-2384-40a5-8fde-9dae630b0a2b: {n}Alondi goes pale and tries to escape, but he's swiftly captured and handed over to the guards. The remaining crowd quickly scatters.{/n}
956c34a2-5483-48fd-ac25-f84253b8ff08: {n}The crowd's enthusiasm dies out. After a bit of confused clattering, the rioters clear out.{/n}
bbb59e7a-ee3f-4141-88d7-44608d6c3e63: {n}Linzi stares at the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy{/g}, then nods and turns away.{/n}
0e51ece5-84b0-4503-b597-ac7256e9cf4d: {n}Linzi looks at you, surprised. Then she looks at the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy{/g}, and a scowl crosses her face.{/n} "Yes! Burn it! To the {g|Abyss}Abyss{/g} with the academy! To the Abyss with it all!"
e85f323e-6e76-4002-b4ac-f7eab148e21f: {n}The crowd roars, a mix of rallying cries, curses toward Irovetti, and praise for you. Stones, then torches begin flying toward the {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy's{/g} windows, and smoke begins to billow over the building.{/n}
83cba9bd-2506-4f01-9a58-70e11324c092: "That guy's slimier than a slug! Doesn't matter how many chances you give the likes of him — if they were shit, they'll stay shit. Hey, little one, can I kick him? Or you want to do it?"
a8cf5898-b507-4bb6-a55d-b7a9162a4812: "Sarenrae teaches that there are some people for whom sparing would be a waste of mercy. Much can be forgiven to a repentant sinner, but what can you do for one who does not want to reform?"
829c5a99-41d0-41d1-81eb-3a8455803058: "Cleric. You often look at me. But never speak."
40f54a6c-36b4-4653-8de5-76b6e38bf0bb: "You rarely speak yourself. I… feel your pain. Would that I could ease it. And I am saddened, my friend, that it's beyond my power to console you."
e7f3eba6-0357-46de-969f-6cae98548c7f: "Your sword is so heavy. Maybe you should carry a smaller weapon and wear more serious armor?"
eca29975-b766-4c93-a6e0-c17ccc0ed15c: "Yeah right! Why do I need armor? My enemies can barely raise their hands before they fall on the ground! That wouldn't be so easy if I was swinging a toothpick!"
16e57d11-6106-4b4f-bada-92ce3c2106de: {n}A huge stone slab blocks entrance to the tomb. The ancient stone surface is covered in worn inscriptions, barely visible beneath the moss.{/n}
8f1c2892-891a-4ec5-84b1-cc0411928784: {n}You examine the door closely, but you find no sign of any mechanism that would open the door.{/n}
dfb8429b-bf44-4833-9b6f-2ab595e12464: {n}The crumbling, ancient stone is densely covered with thick moss. Near the edge of the slab, some of the moss has been torn — some unknown force must have moved it aside and then replaced it.{/n}
456e3037-35e6-4b2b-ad23-99585c11141e: {n}Chunks of moss fall from the slab as you strike it. There doesn't seem to be any other effect.{/n}
d3c46c48-1447-4dd8-a415-6c0c7eaa6b81: {n}The slab slides aside, easily and noiselessly, making a crack wide enough for you to enter.{/n}
c6a547fc-b90c-4516-9d80-4dab5ad48161: {n}After ensuring the slab won't close itself behind you, you step into the damp, cold darkness of the tomb.{/n}
f0c1e0ab-c2ac-4a41-81e0-c501a460de83: {n}The door radiates a faint transmutation aura.{/n}
c112d3f2-b1f9-4a26-bcce-0c44541fdc2b: {n}You manage to read several phrases of the ancient cyclopean language.{/n}
9e86ab27-69b8-4c0a-b2b3-d862dd0077d7: {n}You stare at the symbols on the worn stone for a long, long time, but they just won't reveal their secrets.{/n}
4b2967d9-a036-4e9c-925d-babd5b985e32: {n}Before you have a chance to take a single step, a voice calls out from inside the tomb.{/n} "Wait! Do not enter! Prop the door, or it will close behind you!" {n}Unwilling to tempt fate, you move a large stone to the entrance and prop the door open.{/n}
744ae60b-1349-48c3-a9ff-acdb046be73a: {n}The huge stone slab that had been blocking the entrance now stands to the side. The darkness within seems to almost breathe with cold and dust.{/n}
6a78131a-f80a-4122-92f9-f4c27c3c6e11: {n}Swearing under her breath, Amiri continues hitting the door several more times. Once it's apparent that it isn't going to budge, she gives it an angry kick.{/n}
878df4ea-4592-4fb0-9b47-6207a8dac9d1: {n}Cruel and evil go into the blind darkness, while kind and merciful go into even deeper darkness... impenetrable blackness... darkness opens every door... wise and stupid, lewd and ascetic... there's not a single path in this world that won't lead into ultimate darkness.{/n}
9e2db9c0-b785-4be3-9149-6cb30b6af748: "Wait a moment... I think I can understand some of this. Let me see..."
59796ae9-a703-4fbe-8fcd-8193bf28ff96: "Ick, what a load of nonsense! I was hoping for a legend. Or maybe a poem. Or at least some sort of ancient recipe!"
23399137-9b4e-4ba9-945a-c83dc47c15ef: "If you had even rudimentary knowledge of ancient cyclops culture, you wouldn't be so eager to see their recipes. To wit: they were cannibals."
ff9873fa-2f62-4c17-80f2-5ff879ba7f93: "The cyclopes were fabulously rich. Why, instead of creating ageless beauty, would they waste it all building monumental ugliness like this?"
a28bfce7-020f-45bc-9b1c-3414d3cf3280: [Pry off the sarcophagus lid with a crowbar]
a4eaf39d-40ad-46c0-94f0-b9cf7106fa94: {n}A massive sarcophagus lies before you. In the dim light you can see the edges of gleaming carvings that wind their way along the sides and up and across the lid of the sepulcher.{/n}
0d10a9b1-51ac-4717-ad89-467c9db8f697: {n}The lid is made of a single slab of marble. It's covered with ancient runes and looks extremely heavy.{/n}
6481acd5-a248-4083-95a0-fc2bddbabc8e: {n}You step closer to take a better look at the sarcophagus lid — and suddenly see deep scratches on its smooth gleaming surface. Judging by the lid, it was slid aside, then slid back into place. Also, you notice rows of small round holes covering the lid. Were they made to let air flow into the coffin?{/n}
c2ee5066-297c-4216-aaec-e58197628b1a: {n}Putting all your strength into it, you slide the marble slab aside. The slab hits the ground with a great booming noise, echoing in the dark hall. {/n}
ed06032e-916a-4079-ae30-2c30f87cbcc6: {n}After several failed attempts to move it — and spending a good deal of time catching your breath — the marble slab finally slides aside. The slab hits the ground with a great booming noise, echoing in the dark hall. {/n}
3725f56b-8a30-4ae2-9ab7-a7ef55a9f13d: {n}The carvings on the coffin depict an ancient cyclopean empire. They speak of a rebellion, when human tribes rose against their cyclopean masters. Judging by the images, the riot was brutally suppressed, the leader of the rebels was caught, and the human armies slaughtered.{/n}
136c5d3f-900e-454e-b1b3-456cd5e28974: {n}To your horror, the sides of the coffin are raked with scratches and dried blood. Someone was buried here, and they were desperately trying to get out. But despite the scratch marks, there is nothing inside — the sarcophagus is empty.{/n}
aa944fcd-1ebb-41e6-a52b-4edab380f7d6: {n}In the darkness behind you, you hear a faint rustling sound. An involuntary shiver runs down your spine.{/n}
208065d9-60d7-42f5-b0d3-c87f0b4191ad: {n}All of a sudden, the grinding of stone erupts around you — the lids of the sarcophagi along the walls begin to slide open!{/n}
d6079f35-a7fc-4eed-86f7-37deef1f9abd: {n}You walk around the sarcophagus, studying where it meets the floor — as you do, you notice fresh tracks in the dust. Someone has been here recently.{/n}
0f3476f0-c0c5-4c31-92b4-8f11e323ea67: {n}The carvings on the coffin are an array of strange images — one-eyed giants, human (?) armies, collapsing houses… you can't make sense of it.{/n}
899635ae-26a5-4c56-a294-c5ceeed19e87: {n}You walk around the sarcophagus and see nothing out of the ordinary.{/n}
c0e8edd0-fab3-4ce5-95df-d4654de250e0: "I agree. Lamashtu shall take her place among the kingdom's patron gods."
b040d2e0-43e6-4b2b-8552-48852ae935a3: "I'd like to congratulate you, Your Highness. These lands were once a gloomy, godforsaken place. Its people were shackled by ignorance. But now the sky shines with the light of the gods! Now the temples are full of followers, and godly blessings protect the kingdom against calamity."
9e6cc5db-38be-457b-9332-bba43b790138: "Oh, what have you done, {name}... These lands were dying until you came. This was a dark, godless place. It's your fault that my god has turned away from this kingdom! It's your fault that it blossoms again! The people rejoice! They've forgotten what is coming for them! This makes me very sad. They were nearly prepared for the truth. Now they hide once more behind their delusive happiness."
cafb519d-97e9-44f2-8aa8-a8a30d1195e7: "You've surprised me, {name}. I always thought that not a single god, not even {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g}, ever cared about what was happening here, or who might rule the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g}. This place was quiet and mournful. But you filled the temples with followers, and the gods have turned their eyes upon you. I imagine they have big plans for you."
917050df-2f99-4682-96f1-b5a367cf974f: "You relentlessly pursued the small cults of dark and vile gods, and cleared the lands of blight and abomination. The priests appreciate your effort. A sacred guard gathers – priests of the gods we honor here, to protect law and order in these lands."
c0325437-46a8-410a-a075-c04e8e5b857e: "You have resolutely cleared these lands of minor cults, but the {g|Stolen Lands}Stolen Lands{/g} has served as a graveyard for the obsolete for too long. The old religions clung to life and didn't want to fade away. You gave them peace. Your subjects wish to continue what you've started. The priests of all the kingdom's recognized gods gather in a sacred guard, to protect your domain against crime and intrigue."
14323037-f044-4f34-be27-9b2a7d824384: "I approve of how you've treated the small cults that settled here. It was time for them to go, and now this place is cleared. The priests of your kingdom's faithful gods have no intention of retreat. They are setting up a sacred guard, to deal with any crimes against the gods and their followers. My pack is safe, in any case. A couple of my brothers occupy high positions in the guard. But the other cults will have to make themselves small, or be taken over by {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} in order to survive."
1eef8ddf-ac31-4bc0-9a6f-43b8925d797b: "{g|Cayden Cailean}Cayden{/g} had a wonderful influence on your kingdom. One fair goes on after another, and people treat each other with kindness and light in their hearts. They laugh more, and bear their misfortunes bravely. Bards love our lands. Once they arrive, many decide to stay. We have a good reputation, and you are known as a dear and understanding leader."
38476705-f886-443f-9b7b-364a0913cd15: "{g|Gorum}Gorum's{/g} priests are generous with their blessings for our warriors. Our fighters are strong, daring in battle, and confident in victory! Many of the kingdom's children dream of becoming your knights when they grow up. You are considered the ultimate power in the realm – a true leader!"
a96982e1-cafb-4e55-81a1-9b3e2743d8e4: "{g|Asmodeus}Asmodeus{/g}' followers have brought order to your domain. Laws are executed consistently, and punishments are now accepted as part of the normal course of life. {g|Cheliax}Cheliax{/g} sends its messengers to sign lucrative contracts with us. Alas, our immediate neighbors are worried and enraged. And yet the comprehensible of Asmodeus is far better than the incomprehensible chaos that plagues other lands. The {g|Hellknights}Hellknights{/g} arriving to our domain intend to bring order to the neighboring lands – with fire and sword. Meanwhile you maintain the image of a just and fair {mf|king|queen}."
e2e7afc4-2ac8-4465-8ff9-edda63d24cab: "Where {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g} might grant your subjects understanding, {g|Cayden Cailean}Cayden{/g} gives them solace and oblivion in a jar of wine. They drink and rave, just to escape their fate and the burdens of their lives. They go to fairs, give birth to children, and enjoy the simple things in life, certain that it shall forever be, just like this. They open their thoughts to adventure, as if they were immortal, and call you their beloved {mf|King|Queen}, in the merry land with no woe."
9237ad55-5c88-49a8-8768-7f1b7b3a6ed2: "{g|Gorum}Gorum{/g} ensures that your warriors are ruthless and devastating. They are lost to {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g}, for they do not stop to consider death – it's as if the end doesn't exist! The game of war is as child's play, with many children looking to join your army, to kill and maim at your command. People say you've taken your throne by right. After all, everyone who has challenged your right is dead!"
a928ff5f-52f8-47e5-ae1e-86f3c4f5ceab: "Faith in {g|Asmodeus}Asmodeus{/g} has led many to accept law as the only way of life. People obediently bow their heads, so obedient they've trained themselves to be, as if obedience and diligence could protect against the inevitable end. Your neighbors were outraged by the new church nearby, and seriously considered warring with you. But ambassadors from {g|Cheliax}Cheliax{/g} have expressed their appreciation for our loyalty to their patron. The {g|Hellknights}Hellknights{/g}, who arrive on our lands this very moment, regard our territory as the key to restoring order in the {g|River Kingdoms}River Kingdoms{/g}. It was a dangerous bargain, but it promises a substantial reward."
6737f9ed-979b-4822-a952-8e23fe7aab13: "{g|Cayden Cailean}Cayden's{/g} bliss pleases your pack. It sates and cheers them. They celebrate, sing songs and frolic at their fairs. And, of course, they multiply. {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} likes this – except for their free thinking. Their tongues are loosened by their cups, and they grow too daring. They cannot be easy to rule – I don't understand how you make them obey your commands, and even honor you with songs of praise, their merry and generous {mf|King|Queen}."
25d1cfa1-0ca0-40cf-b45e-61473acc5e97: "Your armies are blessed by {g|Gorum}Gorum{/g}. Our warriors are cold-blooded, mighty, and fearless. Children dream of shedding blood on your orders, when they grow up – for the glory of Gorum. This could come in handy sooner than you think. As the rumor spreads that you're the strongest {mf|king|queen} in the world, many will come to challenge you."
9a8b339d-cfc2-4db2-80c3-ddca6a03ff87: "{g|Asmodeus}Asmodeus{/g}' servants have taught your pack to obey the leader and submit to your will. Your neighbors are furious with you, while {g|Cheliax}Cheliax{/g} has sent its ambassadors to your capital. You've strengthened your position, taking the advantage of your alliance with the church of Asmodeus. This was clever – a bold decision with a great reward!"
1424cf52-dde2-450c-b5c4-50cca0b7f5d3: "Thanks to your tolerance of the small cults, rumors are spreading that every minor religion will be welcomed in your kingdom. And so every odd rag-tailed priest and congregant of the minor deities is flocking to your kingdom in search of shelter. Many of them are good but misled people. There's a bad element as well, but we're watching them day and night. The wide variety of worship may confuse some decent folks, but most of them are committed to the true faith."
f55f78a7-dbc0-431e-8cba-a88d6292749e: "I accept that you avoid imposing your faith on others, allow the worshipping of idols, and give shelter to the weak. But look where this has led you! Dozens of smaller cults, more worthy of oblivion, are flooding your lands, seeking protection! They survive in your kingdom rather than face the inevitable. Their teachings and obsolete magical knowledge, so welcomed by your wizards, were meant to be forgotten!"
d85fda58-e9db-4d27-9b2d-1d25c0ac64a4: "You were right not to stamp out the smaller cults hiding here. Whispers spread that minor religions are safe in your domain, and cults scurry to hide themselves {mf|behind your shield|under your skirts}. Some possess curious knowledge of ancient magics. All their priests are willing to share it with you!"

8815c5f8-3c73-43bc-9a27-a9123cd198c6: {n}The baron gives you no notice. He just remains sitting, looking down.{/n}
8b07f645-26e7-4224-96c8-27e2ed3f295a: {n}Baron Drelev submits meekly to death by your hand. He doesn't even lift his gaze.{/n}
394af933-4978-45b8-8bfa-7395b958513c: {n}The baron's lips begin to tremble, but he doesn't lift his eyes from his hands. Just when you begin to sense you won't be getting an answer, he speaks softly,{/n} "You are too late. Baron Hannis Drelev is dead. This is only a corpse."
a85e870f-42ee-4cf8-8ba1-c62b3f965fd6: {n}The baron shrugs ever so slightly.{/n} "I don't know."
2de3431c-ac7a-49d3-a718-6c086cc8417a: {n}After a long pause, Hannis speaks softly and simply.{/n} "Yes."
4ff0a2bf-7006-4386-990b-4edc4520a3eb: "Irovetti keeps a monster as a servant. A pet naga. It assumes different shapes for him... But that's not important. He gave her a weapon. A wooden sword. Probably magic. He told her to pierce Drelev with it. She did. And Drelev died."
313c2d8f-8909-43e6-90d7-6e8c27ad1361: {n}Drelev interlocks his fingers.{/n} "The baron left {g|Restov}Restov{/g} for {g|Glenebon}Glenebon{/g}. Stumbled into an ambush. Irovetti slaughtered his people, and captured him. No one paid a ransom for Baron Hannis Drelev. Then Irovetti killed him."
9e8c6c5f-c605-484b-acd0-c2b6abaa9215: "Look closer." {n}Drelev lifts his hand, and probes the skin on his cheek with his trembling fingers – it's pale, but quite healthy.{/n} "You see? 2179feab-89b5-4c32-bc48-887ac64ec8ce: {n}Drelev doesn't react to your words, and keeps looking down at his hands.{/n}
11626fb3-1775-4bb7-ab9f-73492ff7458d: "Drey Yarnes, a priest. A priest... Can resurrect Drelev?" {n}Hannis stands up with effort and leaves the cell, swaying unsteadily on his feet.{/n}

5d20baed-398c-4692-bbfe-1a81080f0c4e: {n}Hannis raises his face with difficulty and looks at you.{/n} "Thank you, {Name}. Perhaps Baron Drelev will live again."

8c627a32-be11-4889-b8aa-d1a7bcfc9d2f: "You hurt everyone. Why? Your tongue is like a snake."

c15fdb66-6cd3-4b32-9e55-c8e8c11691b8: {n}Tristian remains on his knees for a few moments, and then stands and straightens his clothes, as if nothing had happened.{/n}
ad4e400f-1e37-45bf-8060-a40d4cffc6d9: {n}Tristian lowers his head, and then turns to you.{/n} "I know that I shall always be with my true heart's love, even after death. How brave one must be to fall in love with someone you might lose — and eventually will lose?"
5c67b7fb-91bb-49d9-8938-86bcb1da4b52: {n}Tristian remains silent for a few moments, and then turns to you.{/n} "Probably not. I just never encountered it, and I'm not hurrying to judge something I don't understand." {n}The priest looks at you attentively.{/n} "Or think I don't..."

8fdfbcbd-f65d-4e45-ba4c-81199f69c7b7: "But others will follow. After all, we came here too. And we most certainly will not perish!"
6edd6b11-8d01-478c-9d05-9f9a0fedbd80: "Foolishness. A righteous cause is worth dying for. A thirst for adventures is not."
a3c6d1ee-0383-4b6b-95a4-6c45e5828d6d: "...and then there's those who are most tempted by the sounds of clinking glasses and moaning whores at the roadside inn. Speaking of which, when are we heading back to the capital?"
d3f94cc4-252f-4577-8361-ac86f2709bd2: "Finally some leisure time. We can celebrate our leader's birthday!"
c6d13b30-4972-4168-bcc2-cc86d02ed7eb: "You know I'm no good at speeches. All I can say is: be happy and inspire the people who follow you. May the light of Sarenrae guide your way!"
ecf19f08-bf23-4b81-ad32-9f0c9f9fc0e3: "Looks like it. Irovetti has played me."
80b6c8c9-6cf9-42d7-88ab-a31507c9e40a: "You're right about one thing. Only one monarch will hold their crown by day's end. But it won't be Irovetti!"
77b64bfa-c307-4ce4-86eb-c7687bd60e1a: [Attack] "I don't understand why you're still alive. It's time to fix that mistake!"
87b5a457-4346-4775-ae16-19211681b77a: "If you knew what I know, you wouldn't stay loyal to Irovetti for long. Let me tell you something..."
9fe99fa0-3fa3-473a-befb-bcbb3b5c129a: "So, we reach the climax of your tale at last. baaca7ce-740e-44c1-9b91-ead48066fe11: "You simply won't give up, even to the bitter end. How amusing. Well, we shall see who prevails!"
498901f3-b39d-4902-92f9-02965b299504: "There is nothing shameful about admitting defeat. On the contrary, it shows true wisdom!"
5200633b-a5a7-4363-85a3-39d7f95e7777: "Waste no more time talking to me. His Highness Irovetti is waiting!"

3d4ac1dc-c11e-4d94-bd49-8b8d001684eb: {n}Moskoni has lost some weight, and his suit looks rather less lavish than before. 3b9fe229-0588-4893-b39a-dd317e177dd2: "Surprisingly quiet. I managed to settle the property disputes between the old families and the thieves' guild. 9fcd3d06-9e2f-40ef-9a09-9b7801538d02: "A sharp mind and a steady hand will always profit in this city! Praise the goddess, in my work for Irovetti I gained not only enemies, but also friends... By the way, you fooled us all so brilliantly! Who else could have defeated Irovetti at his own game?"
0fc9f816-1702-4d5f-80c1-858198a6aab0: "You wish to duel? I'm happy to oblige!"
be5b1cfe-73f5-4dcf-a5bc-c8c574204d51: "Don't waste your breath. I already know everything that you know, and more besides. You can't convince me to join you, with flattery or threats, or any shocking scandal."
fef149b4-3af9-4643-9ca1-9c85b0567108: "Almost like in the old days, before Irovetti laid his hands upon the city — may he rest in peace. 2ac1a801-a2e1-41a3-8d4e-22fb7f409a86: "Kharne Vereel is a strange fellow, of course, but he's a fine businessman — especially when he takes a break from his poison for a day or two. 0bf69f58-7256-444d-8f95-b05bfacc46a5: "No distractions! If you haven't forgotten, they're trying to kill us!"
83d61080-6110-4093-b1ff-81068f5aaa5d: "Stealing from a swordlord in her own mansion? She'd have our heads."

444dd788-a69c-49b7-8739-40eddccc3600: "Don't drag me into this! You do what you want, but I'm not taking a single coin!"

9b0ea89e-1e6a-4ce4-9cc7-ed0b92187dd7: "Your Academy might not be the best institution of learning, but you are so greatly lacking in education. Trust me, a career in writing is impossible without it."
6da82fed-08f8-41d0-8202-193919fe6a3d: "So your books are not a reflection of your own merit, but your teachers'? How about that! I never expected such a confession from you!"

96362b0a-086e-4c43-aaac-b3fab638e7b7: "The rabble once more forgets its place, {name}! A madding crowd of concerned idiots has lodged a complaint against the inhabitants of the mages' quarter. The brainless vermin tremble in terror at the sight of anything that exceeds their narrow frame."
9c74d52c-6bb1-41f6-86b7-f25b3b493c41: "I understand just how… difficult it can be to live alongside mages and alchemists. e176e07c-26d2-4cdf-8f73-311001163b38: "The answer is clear. c8b8304a-9957-4b1f-b596-7b9b881a72ee: {n}The Storyteller nods.{/n} "I shall speak with the inhabitants of the mages' quarter."
2e544f6d-4b1e-4384-88a6-2df9acf8a014: "I knew you'd understand! Don't worry, I'll find a way to calm down the neighbors. We'll put on a fireworks show or something…"
54c35beb-2b72-4d96-ade5-fb9bfef8fc2e: "Wonderful! I shall tell everyone at the mages' quarter that they may carry on with their experiments."
5dd6994b-0f6f-4cf0-a530-2b64cc9e618e: "Splendid. I won't even bother replying to the whiners. It sickens me even to look at them."
f5deed33-e5cc-46af-b43c-ca7ad428e2c7: "Windows all along the street started shaking, and then some sticky purple substance rained down on the town. Children started playing with it immediately. 5aeba8e0-3b96-4684-841d-19bed1e4c6e3: "A young alchemist's experiments have lead to an explosion so powerful that his neighbors up and down the street felt their window panes tremble. Later that day, an unidentified purple substance fell from the sky – all over the city. 25c1e6e1-945b-417c-b3b1-93563e72567d: "As you can imagine, this list includes practically everything: lights, noises, and smells… The complaint was renewed today after an explosion at an alchemy lab which made the whole city 'reek of wet goblin hide'! Ha!"
e39aeb22-5406-4161-a52b-35022a066dff: "If you were better at protecting each other's backs, then you-know-who would still be alive."
4337f6ee-e2f6-4bf0-8004-ab4d25b4ec51: "I know I did everything I could to save the member of our company. But what did you do, hunh?"
9407147e-c546-4973-8960-1f258c048e7c: "How can such a feeble body contain so much scorn? Please, Jubilost... let's not get into this. Not now."
42b6e7ef-79a5-4030-83fb-743b6ccd61bf: "Have you no respect for the fallen?! Do everyone a favor — keep your mouth shut and let us mourn."
e00a38f8-bd5f-4e53-8d67-cdb831a4fbe7: "I don't deny my part in this. But please, next time think before saying things like that. Everyone feels sad and bitter enough already."
bf0c4785-b522-457b-84ed-b5f5b8ffb33c: "Shush, or I'll send you to join them."
dddd1cf3-9ad2-43c7-a15c-19be401dcdf3: "Maybe things would have turned out differently if you spent as much effort helping your friends as you do finding fault with them."
13cfb650-6b66-40c8-bc8a-e7c85a6ff701: "Maybe things would have turned out differently if you spent as much effort helping your friends as you do finding fault with them."
84b29768-a721-4b87-a32c-edbd749af936: "I'd like to know more about you."
957dc2c4-d6db-473f-b14b-2cebf1790f0f: "A half-orc among the Brevic aristocracy is a rare sight indeed."
90374c90-b94f-4d04-af42-d665344e4f29: "What's it like for you, living among humans?"
98083f42-cb7f-4680-a971-4051bbf01749: "I need to discuss politics and affairs of the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom} with you."
825c3acf-fcca-4946-b5af-0d4ad07ad6be: "You must know much of the history of Brevoy and the neighboring lands."
32ada20d-d852-465e-90bc-44c6be7f7611: "What's the situation between the Aldori and the Royal House Surtova?"
9b7dca86-f6eb-4ddf-848e-427c509c5617: "What can you tell me about the River Kingdoms?"
ebb741cc-64f4-4544-a7d4-b4d270439cb6: "I'd like to hear about the early history of Brevoy."
f86ccdee-09de-4627-ab04-061fb57d16c4: "Thank you. Let's discuss something less personal."
6c9b8458-4517-4282-ba76-206bc706ad7f: "Thank you. I've learned what I needed."
40d50088-3340-4b02-8c4a-68797f3b4423: "So the baron was the first Swordlord?"
2a6e4367-29f8-4633-82ca-e52376b43be9: "Wouldn't it be better to accept yourself completely as you are?"
21d29fbc-3524-4aa3-95c0-ca575f12850e: "People will never truly accept those like us as their own."
4fba7b0b-8a25-480f-a938-f1ea365d345b: "Can I rely on you in matters of state?"
37794506-86cb-4881-a27f-4e36cca0a733: {n}Kassil Aldori, elegantly dressed in formal clothes as always, welcomes you with a courteous half bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}!"
e11910cd-7832-43fd-aa6c-c0af11b52d4e: "I grew up alone on the streets of {g|Restov}Restov{/g} — I know nothing of my parents. It's more than likely that my mother just wanted to be rid of me — probably left me somewhere in an alley as a baby. And I don't feel I have the right to blame her."
6f7a68d6-ea85-45ab-9540-0ff0137385c5: "I don't remember how I survived. My first memory is of sneaking into someone's backyard — I must have been three or four — and trying to steal food from a cat." {n}Kassil smiles sadly.{/n}
69a3ba3b-f71c-45e4-a8c9-6b812d2a7727: "Lady Jamandi Aldori herself brought me into the family. She picked me up off the streets when I was about fourteen. I was fighting some lord's guardsmen — their master had expressed his wish, in a most inappropriate manner, to acquaint me with his female wolfhound in the hopes of producing offspring." {n}Kassil's lips turn up slightly at the corners, stopping just short of looking sinister. No other sign of emotion crosses his face.{/n}
aff889ce-a7e2-4ae7-ad44-f969707cc844: "I was at what would politely be called a disadvantage when I saw a flashing beam of light reflect off a lone sword. What happened next was too fast for me to follow, but all three of my torturers fell to the ground, a single woman standing above them. She turned to the lord and coldly asked him, 'And just what is it you're doing in here?'" {n}Kassil speaks almost reverently, genuine awe in his voice.{/n}
28381511-3b67-4b0f-b191-7c871f5ccf41: "It isn't easy, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. I was born and raised in {g|Restov}Restov{/g} — I don't know a single word of Orc. I devoted my entire life to proving myself worthy to bear the name Aldori. But to most people, I'm still a half-orc first and foremost — anything else is secondary."
f1f9a225-7f38-4325-ac86-f353e53bbd81: "How may I be of service, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}?"
0668d165-3ccc-4333-b0b8-ede8a5c82e3e: {n}Kassil's eyes light up.{/n} "In {g|Restov}Restov{/g}, I spent nearly as much time studying historical chronicles as I did training with the sword. What would you like to discuss, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}?"
b9f6a523-63e8-4ef3-8c0a-a44484ce7011: {n}Kassil's face remains impassive, but his speech becomes slower, more deliberate.{/n} "The {g|House Surtova}Surtovas{/g} and the Aldori are... different in nature and spirit. They are as water and stone — a snake and an eagle. When {g|Choral}Choral the Conqueror{/g} came to our lands, the Surtovas didn't even attempt to defend themselves — they gave up the crown in exchange for positions of power in the new court, along with the safety of their lands."
cb0fa79e-a8d8-4a93-83cb-41e1949c92fa: "For two centuries we've fought for survival, while the Surtovas have flourished and grown stronger at the side of the throne. Needless to say, now that {g|King Noleski Surtova}King Noleski Surtova{/g} and his sister Natala rule over {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g}, our relationship hasn't improved. The {g|House Surtova}Surtovas{/g} fear the Aldori, and the Aldori don't trust the Surtovas — that's the current situation between our houses."
a5fd337b-ac68-4ad7-9168-0731996b3575: "That's a story written in blood — Aldori blood, mostly. In the beginning, {g|Brevoy}Brevoy{/g} was two independent lands — {g|House Surtova}House Surtova{/g} reigned over {g|Issia}Issia{/g}, and the Aldori ruled {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g}. They were not peaceable neighbors. Issia's soil was too poor to sustain its population, and its people were too cruel and proud to simply stand by and watch as their neighbors prospered."
a97e828a-bcac-435b-b3c1-e34f219565fa: "I'd be willing to bet that {g|Restov}Restov's{/g} northern walls still hold a few marks left by {g|House Surtova}Surtova{/g} soldiers during their frequent raids from ages past. It was {g|Choral}Choral{/g} {g|House Rogarvia}Rogarvia{/g} — later known as Choral the Conqueror — who put an end to all that. He brought each realm to its knees. Only, one side knelt willingly — the other ended up first paying a devastating toll."
1c68e9de-343c-474e-ad91-6f5593b6559e: "I could speak for days about the {g|Swordlords}Swordlords{/g}, but I'll try to condense things so as not to bore Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! Our history goes back to ancient times, when {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g} was ruled by Baron Sirian First. He was a notorious squabbler and duelist, but at the time, he wasn't as skillful as he thought. After losing a fight against a local gang leader — the baron was the one who issued the challenge — he went into exile to hide his shame."
0c0e96d2-67f2-4c2f-9fc9-05208338a930: "In times past, they were little more than a nest of bandits. Frankly, that hasn't really changed." {n}Kassil frowns disapprovingly.{/n}
53413a79-cffb-4385-b6cc-f541519315de: "But that was just the beginning! No one knows where Sirian wandered, but a few years later, he returned to {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g} a changed man. He challenged that same gang leader to another duel and bested him handily. The baron then declared an open challenge: anyone who could defeat him would be rewarded handsomely."
9da02841-ecf0-4c59-8f1d-6a27efabc3c0: "After that, not a month would pass without Sirian seeing another challenger. Renowned fighters and experienced warriors came and went, but none — not a single one! — could best the baron. In those years, Sirian took on his new name — Aldori. But many people preferred to call him simply 'the Sword Baron.'"
8977c4cc-53ba-4e0e-9764-d7ad02abbd23: "The very same. His heirs inherited the secrets of his dueling style, along with the name 'Aldori'. Ever since, the name has been passed down from master to student along with the title {g|Swordlords}'Swordlord'{/g}. The Aldori are simultaneously a family and an alliance. Swordlords will usually teach their own children, but many of us were brought in from outside the family. Occasionally, you can even find a half-orc fosterling or two." {n}Kassil gives a slight bow.{/n}
3d74b652-7b16-4729-8408-0eb8e4d984f2: "I had never seen a {g|Restov}Restovic{/g} noble so afraid — but he was also almost reverent. And this lord was a close companion to the mayor, at that! At the time, I had no idea who this woman was, but I couldn't keep myself from rushing after her — well, hobbling, really — and pleading with her, 'Teach me! Please, teach me!'"
24baed85-8739-4735-9720-47e91b8379c3: "The Aldori went to war — and lost. I dare not even say 'valiantly lost.' The damage inflicted on {g|Rostland}Rostland{/g}'s armies by the red dragons of {g|Choral}Choral the Conqueror{/g}... Well, it was a slaughter. A crushing defeat." {n}A barely noticeable frown darkens Kassil's face.{/n} "Even with two centuries of effort, the Aldori and Rostland have yet to fully recover."
4917d8cb-4cfe-43a9-9457-a6847f96c028: "It infuriated me when I was younger, but with age, I've learned to accept my fate. To me, I'm simply Kassil, a street urchin from {g|Restov}Restov{/g} who became the student of Swordlord Jamandi Aldori. Nothing more, nothing less."
eeeff191-83ac-42b2-8c5e-975de2a2da46: {n}Kassil shows a reserved but heartfelt smile.{/n} "You're the ruler of this realm, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. Your example can change the way people see those like me."
769c8dea-8655-4191-8b88-93b916f61b69: "Perhaps. But everyone has to answer the question 'What are you?' on their own, and I have."
c09947a1-500d-4097-8a81-4c89ff2e64c3: "Be that as it may, there are a select few whose opinions matter to me. I don't concern myself with the opinions of anyone else."
7546c216-9236-4410-91cf-c799d9ea48e2: {n}You notice Kassil's eyes flash.{/n} "Certainly, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. To the best of my ability. I've learned from lady Aldori not only the art of the sword, but also the ability to inspire. I could apply myself in the role of military advisor."
06228c6c-92a3-4511-b1a8-d6c12ff186a0: {n}Kassil bows.{/n} "I thank you for the faith you place in me. I shall do my best to prove worthy of your trust."
8b8d5c5f-f418-49ab-968d-d3e90fc35e4a: {n}Kassil frowns for a moment.{/n} "It seems I am ill fit for state service. I suppose it would be better if I continued as an ambassador for Lady Aldori — and no more than that."
df1ebfa0-e9f4-4ad5-8e07-f13626bd006f: "Of all the kingdoms, {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} is probably of the greatest interest. King Irovetti rose to power too quickly and too easily — I would recommend Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness} take great caution with him."
67d40b6a-24cc-4b97-aa1b-011ab4d7e42d: Try to push against the lid of the tomb.

d8ca5aab-cc2e-481d-a0a7-a21f7c143825: "Those greater powers decided to punish the nymph for her boldness. They sent a horrible monster to poison the enchanted forest and kill the singing birds. b9bc8fd1-5712-446d-ae57-80880c667780: {n}The satyr plays the reed pipe, and the dryad, laughing, accompanies him by clapping her hands. As they see you, they wave. {/n}"Welcome back!"

8b07924e-d792-4d94-8ebe-f9c899e5e819: {n}The dryad narrows her eyes at Falchos and folds her arms.{/n} "Can't you do without the 'death' part?"

6cf4a14c-793f-47f2-a8e1-935cd483fc40: "These lands could be beautiful again, but not as long as this monster exists."{n} Falchos's hand curls into a fist.{/n} "We cannot leave, we must fight!"

38562c2f-a44c-4d6a-96d2-071159e5f9f7: {n}Fighting with all your will, you ignore the music, and focusing, you shake off the enchantment, feeling the emotions bleeding away — pity? A desire to help? 93d19827-64ad-40cc-b0ce-e7c22d3e0117: {n}The satyr, seemingly surprised at his own luck, nods quickly and hides the reed pipe.{/n}

27d70751-37bf-4bb7-90f2-555ba8b2f36c: "I wanted to know if the way back to {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g} is open for me. I spent endless hours in prayer, asking for but one thing — a sign, a vision, a portent... a single word... and all I got in return was silence."

f16c2026-9a74-45ac-9ca3-c63171147d7e: "I've said the same thing to myself. But now I realize it's just a pathetic excuse, to help me save face. It was for me to overcome my fear. It was for me to find strength and resolution. I failed. I have no excuse."
