da390992-e018-4448-8614-39eb5b6b3865: "I am proud of you, Amiri. Returning the sword to the sheath and avoiding bloodshed — that is a true feat that not many are capable of."
00344837-f659-4fb0-ad4f-dc8ba5b479f8: "Oh, get lost! This isn't the time for your lectures!"
b91a6941-5a52-46d8-9801-649d70aa3925: "Without the king, goblins need their own hero. Not longshank or halfshank. Their own. Like me."
e69c405e-1748-4001-a9d1-e12cb6ccd24c: "That's great, Nok-Nok, keep it up! Maybe someday you'll grow some spine... instead of warts, ha!"
1aabcdfc-7acb-4090-abda-ceed16a3a919: "After the fall of the king the whole tribe should have been gone, like the last breath of life leaving a corpse's lungs. Yet goblins tend to defy universal laws."
388ce9ae-ad14-41aa-b35e-7924e7fb175c: "Can you tell me what happened here?"
801167de-de8c-4694-92b4-a7cdd66e30a8: "Dorsy said you'd sold your daughter to the fey. Is it true?"
d7135b35-0cec-4541-8b2f-5e0886eb59d6: "Your daughter married one of the fey?"
f0e5ed2c-238a-4f6c-b26b-edff8fc892c8: "I've opened the well and scattered will-o'-wisps."
c928eb9f-fb93-4fa0-aac4-e460ff7cf89c: "I've found some coins in the well. Here, have a look!"
e2bc85ac-b4e9-406e-806c-818307777418: "What keeps you from your eternal rest?"
1035bf13-ed06-4bbf-9bc0-24cf06ec32c9: "Look at this letter. It is written by the same hand as your name on the coin."
70ba1288-23ab-4583-ad67-c9dfb26a0167: "That's enough about the curse, let's talk about something else."
50929c76-a530-492e-831b-c9cd3677d6b6: "I've given the coins to put Dorsy to rest."
561beaa0-5c40-40f9-9b90-6bc69e55b03c: "I've given the coins to lift the curse off Dorsy."
8cc7c89d-ce54-4f77-98b7-326d765ed4fb: "You want to know about me? Name's Wilber, Wilber Colton, I'm the headman of this place. You're not locals, are you? Welcome..." {n}The old man gestures around the ruins and his smile fades.{/n} "...I'm dead, right? And all the rest as well? I keep forgetting. That's old age for you..."
4288dcb7-ba5a-45cc-8665-9705afc13a53: {n}In front of the ruined temple you see a ghost — an old man, walking the grounds. Noticing you, he smiles and nods.{/n}
25c4fe4b-106a-4d0e-b4ad-e186f44bb1eb: "Happened? Where? {n}The old man looks around, puzzled.{/n} "Ah, the village... aye, something bad happened here... Problem is, I can't remember a thing! 2a464b2b-3882-4362-8f44-53c377b37a68:
"Which ghost?"{n} The old man raises his eyes, surprised, then looks at himself and sighs. {/n}"Ah, right... Something won't let me rest in peace... Did I anger {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}? No, that wasn't that..."
{n}The old man's eyes widen, and he snaps his fingers — it makes no sound.{/n} "Ah, I remember now! It's these... lights, they're the reason! They keep creeping out of the well, whispering, hissing, and ruining my sleep! Aye, it's all because of them!"
1373dd26-b69c-4fdd-b9de-17780d91a905: "Dorsy, huh? That's the one to listen to, hah! That rascal would have some tales to tell, no doubt... he was her fiancé, you see. c6ab0b4f-8e55-4a01-8025-8c7d4293cc0c: "You did? And still I can't rest… so it wasn't those lights after all... I must have done something wrong, then… or maybe I had to do something, but didn't? Damn it all, if only I could remember!"
b51ba72d-0357-4679-935f-48eb51583a18: "A fight?"{n} The ghost echoes.{/n} "What fight? We're peaceful folk, we are! We mean harm to no one."
96a946c1-f8ed-4ee9-a9af-f90815af846b: {n}The ghost studies the coins for several moments, then turns to you — his face grief-stricken.{/n} "That's what this all about. That's why I can't rest… Oh, dark things, dark sins..."
3515dad3-58a1-49b7-a069-1382c899f740: "Wilber — that's me. And I thought I had no enemies at all… and here were two who wanted me gone from this world! These coins, look at them — the inscription was done by different hands!"
d16ec1f9-cf39-4245-9405-1cd6043cd2f2: "And the second name, the second… Callitropsia, sounds familiar... Aye, right! That's the dryad, my daughter's new love! Someone must have hated her so much that he was willing to doom his own immortal soul to get rid of her and of me!"
a5dc126f-09f7-4c6e-adeb-799e4713f3a4: "They are a curse. b23a35e3-5289-45c9-b0b3-9b18c190350a: "Here they are, these coins just won't let me go… Those with my name on it — they are the symbols of a curse. I was hated not by one, but by two persons. Their hatred is the rope that ties me to this world and keeps me awake..."
733e09a1-d70a-471d-8ce8-d06a599859ae: {n}The ghost watches the coins evaporate to mist, almost in disbelief.{/n} "At last... you have my gratitude! 798e36a1-9cfd-4025-a187-9297f8a98d16: {n}…and with that, the ghost dissolves into thin air.{/n}
a31ab477-2f87-46e3-b3d3-68e5298e27f5: {n}The ghost raises his grief-stricken eyes at you. {/n}"While I was alive, I was a coward. A coward and a liar. If I gave her to Dorsy — the fey would seek revenge, if I gave her to the fey — Dorsy would seek revenge."
77ce5df0-44b8-4308-a3df-42b09003563e: "I used to give advice, but I couldn't heed it myself. I was a fool..." {n}The ghost speaks slower, as if hearing his own story for the first time.{/n} "I... lied to Dorsy, saying the fey threatened me. Then... db006313-81d7-4aa7-b163-1f4cbbcdeff5: "What — what are you talking about? Coins? Forgive an old man, my memory is not what it was… What were we talking about?"
0e516650-2f30-4e8c-bb97-3377133aeda3: "Which curse? Why are you saying these horrid things? We never had any curses here, {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} forbid!"
58e6b917-b0b5-448f-9b48-71cebaf469ad: "I don't know if a curse like that can be lifted... But do me a favor — put the coins on the altar of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} — it's nearby, in the temple ruins. Maybe my god will take mercy on me, let me rest at last."
584a2df7-01e0-4b13-a70c-72d4510db94d: {n}You place the coins on the altar. For a moment, nothing happens, then the coins evaporate silently, steaming away to mist.{/n}
7817b955-2b6d-432a-a6e4-3d8fd912bb8b: "To lose both your life and mind... Disgusting. Not that this man had a lot of wit to begin with..."
f0cc8e67-7856-4bba-83ad-4990113ab8e0: "Don't blame yourself. You've meant to do good."
446abb34-2629-41a7-8ba9-6fac8c10d1fd: "Thank you for your kind words. But who cares what I've meant if in the end it led to... this." {n}The ghost points at the ruins around him.{/n}
7bd9c4ac-7586-4bc4-8bc7-7f72e61223c6: "So he doesn't even remember us beating him? What a fool! Should we give him a reminder?"
2db31d8f-1c44-4cbc-bcf6-c7984b241a56: "It's not like he'll remember! Eh, whatever."
30c36493-3ad0-4eea-aa00-b773acfbb071: "A daughter, laying a death curse on her father merely for being afraid and confused? How hardhearted! I would like to feel sorry for her, but now I simply cannot."
e602bf3e-9cad-4646-87dd-09838a456a45: "I guess this yobbo Dorsy was the one who'd cursed us. Her — for stealing his bride, and me — for letting this happen. Nasty things, nasty sins... But who else could wish me dead? I've got no slightest idea about that!"
430f9083-a035-4f4a-9efb-8566a83cc4f4: "Maybe she did — by the time of wedding I had... passed. Still, a fey marriage wasn't unheard of here in the village. 8b36e4a3-868c-481b-9b79-ebff2b198d2a: {n}After reading the letter, the old man shakes his head, devastated.{/n} "Oh, Nyta, Nyta, what have you done… And what have I done, such an old fool..."
5da8de51-1302-460a-808b-545b884c78ad: "That sounds like a dark deed... Wouldn't your deity punish you for that?"
5eef4dac-0eb3-4435-a3ea-a9a2fce9dec7: "Idiot! While you're conducting this weird ritual, wounded people are bleeding to death at the camp! They need your help, not your heroic corpse!"
a91d777d-a35a-4715-84df-697d8a464ef5: "Are you really willing to be cursed by your goddess just to kill a few barbarians?"

That very night, the children snuck out of the house and... their bodies were found at the base of the cliff the next morning..."
ef8b5eed-47d1-4127-92c0-7be1dc43dfa9: "His poor wife's heart couldn't bear the loss. Lissa... she was gone soon after. So Ivar cursed himself. Cursed his own blabbering tongue and reckless mind. Standing near the graves of his family, he could only mutter to himself over and over, "I'm a monster... I'm a monster!" Then, he felt the self-inflicted curse begin to melt him from the inside — burning him, turning him into a beast. He became a werewolf, swore to protect the village to honor the memory of Lissa and his children. He wanted to serve people, to bring them good instead of evil, at least once."
2375cff2-894a-4696-8d28-d481bc17aaab: "Sorry, {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}, but no. I'm not interested in working for anyone else. Besides, the village would never accept me if they learned who I really am. So, please, just finish me off or let me go — the choice is yours."
1d4ac539-68d8-4249-b1b1-891ec4a22122: {n}Ivar's brow furrows.{/n} "I stopped looking to the future long ago. But... but I don't think I belong here anymore. Especially if people discovered the truth. Were you to spare my life, I'd... leave. Leave, and try to find a new reason to live."
68197d9b-ebb2-4b19-aa4f-c33bb482c4a3: "There's always someone trying to take from the villagers, be it their property or their lives. Many's the villain who's become food for worms in the nearby woods. The only danger I haven't gained much ground against is a gang holed up in a nearby cave. I started hunting them, but it seems I've run out of time to finish the job." {n}Ivar's tone is bitter as he looks away.{/n}
cde957ed-d4c8-4269-92a8-8e0c04f033bc: "Planning a visit?" {n}Ivar smirks.{/n} "The gang's not big, but they are well trained. They're very familiar with the woods around here — they've made a den in one of the caves to the west, near the lake. It isn't far."
f881e190-2780-4270-9883-243184dc8ad9: {n}Ivar stands, holding the wound on his side.{/n} "I was... not expecting mercy, but I'm certainly grateful for it."
01be653b-92b4-4c54-8235-2b2bddbdb8c1: "Head forward, then take to the right. And if you're looking for work, my advice would be to find a traveling circus — I'm sure you'd fit right in."
94e42559-b553-482e-a4d0-97f322d829a5: {n}Octavia is shaking slightly after all that's happened.{/n} "Thank you for giving him a chance. I... I hear there's a cure for lycanthropy. Good luck to you, Ivar!"
ac932d55-48c5-49a4-9d7b-eb4dd4a97705: {n}Ivar bows slightly, then winces in pain.{/n} "A word in parting, if I may, {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}. Consider it my werewolf instincts talking. I can tell you'll be the subject of stories and legends yourself, soon, and I'm sure they'll be told far and wide across the land. Now, whether they'll be tales of terror or of hope — well, that will be up to you."
9794f976-ceb9-4cc9-935a-742a32a54cb9: "I'll make sure of that!" {n}Linzi smiles.{/n} "And your story... it won't be forgotten! I promise!"
08e182fc-149a-40f4-8d92-ea077acbd061: "Shut your trap, animal!" {n}Regongar spits at the werewolf, then looks at you, grinning in triumph.{/n} "His mane'll make a good trophy."
a4290a50-47e1-48fc-8775-37c6768cc1d4: "And if you called yourself a pig, you'd have grown a snout! That's exactly why it's so important to always think of yourself in only the best light."
75a33a6b-7d2f-4074-b951-52da9c93d0cc: "Anger and pain invited a beast's soul into a human heart? Huh... When I was a kid, the old crones talked about something like this. I thought it was just a fairy tale, though."
3dd4aeb5-2231-47ea-8302-ebaf349477dd: "Oh, you would definitely know, being the local clown and all."
2f86a6c0-185f-4967-bbc6-125fa8941ba2: "It's about time! Not like we've got any business chatting with wolves, here!"
a177a256-1d89-480d-80ad-298ab280e5fe: "You defeated him — that is enough. Stay your hand. Do not let anger control you." {n}Tristian looks at the werewolf, sadness in his eyes.{/n} "Please. At least speak with him before passing your sentence."
b29f2790-8c57-4cc6-bf9f-f4b864ecbafb: {n}Tristian lowers his head.{/n} "I hope you can come to terms with your loss. May {g|Sarenrae}Sarenrae{/g}'s light guide you." {n}Tristian turns to you.{/n} "Thank you for showing mercy."
5c369929-7a11-44bd-b424-d76b5287abad: "Unlike your tongue, that speaks nothing but poisonous rot. How can you mock someone who is defeated and helpless?"
cf22dfbf-5c62-4e50-8963-5c4fb74ccd5f: "This story breaks my heart. How can one kill with kind stories, or make oneself into a monster out of sheer gloom and grief?"
4b9888d6-62b6-4b51-9430-35da29a7f2c0: "Almost a rebel, a high-minded rhymer, who doomed himself to the life of a shapeshifter. I'd gladly to pay to publish a book featuring his story. – Let the other rebel dreamers see where this road leads!"
d712cbbd-cdcb-4adf-aeea-7cd4a6ee1bb9: "And the foolish werewolf joined his family in death, and never again troubled the local people. At least it's a story with a happy ending!"
37425232-7996-43a2-9be9-fd1325cff34d: "You know what? Let's get married. Will you be my king?"
05a35de3-199c-4392-8638-a78567181e5f: "If we have a future — it's one it's one we share together."
58d446e3-5d60-49a4-ac97-4bc2850f098a: "You've done a lot for me too. I have no idea how I would live without you."
7c5dcb34-1548-4010-af86-81cfa79042e4: "I was very scared for you. Especially because you kept silence about your feelings."
25f28e4c-315c-4a24-8de2-e3bcbf611e83: {n}Tonight Regongar was especially passionate. He screamed in your arms, and when it was over, he lay still for a long time, staring at the ceiling and biting his lips.{/n}
27c120e6-1ab0-4fe8-91d2-39d79b114669: "You know... There was this chump in {g|Numeria}Numeria{/g} who went mad because of all the torture. He thought there was no one in the world but him. He said that when he closed his eyes, I disappeared. That's just about how I've felt during the last few months. Like if you're not looking at me, I don't exist. Like a ghost that's only real when you touch me. I cut my skin to make sure I still have red blood."
a41eb37c-9243-4ea7-829f-c902ea84cf25: "No one needs me. Especially myself. I'm not even alone, I'm simply nobody. But you... {Name}, my {Name}... You've kept me alive. If you let me go for even a moment, I'll probably fall right through the ground into {g|Pharasma}Pharasma{/g}'s palm. It's only thanks to you that I can even make myself move... And now I've started to feel alive again. For the first time I feel like I have some sort of future."
789bf6af-fc77-4af4-bc5d-c1474475d2cb: "Who, me? A king? Look at me, ha ha! I'm not husband material, let alone a king."
2f377813-ac08-42f7-8e09-3af9e8df7324: "Yes. Now there's only one thing left to do — face the powers of this world and another, and tear them all to pieces. People, monsters, fey, gods — doesn't matter. Everyone who wants to take away our future. And then..."
3d4c6eac-1e47-4016-906a-b3200f22966f: "Wait, are you serious? You really want to marry me?" {n}Regongar looks baffled for a moment, then smiles a broad smile quickly.{/n} "All right. Let's do it, of course. It's just... Let's postpone the wedding until the victory, all right? When we don't have swords hanging over our heads. I want it to feel like we really do have a future."
63c7e9db-396b-4adf-bd03-5fcffe28025a: {n}The half-orc smiles.{/n} "Then it will be just you and me."
0d5983c4-8e8f-49ec-871d-bda21ea291af: "So we really met for a reason. The gods aren't good for much, of course, but sometimes they send gifts... Like you and me to each other."
69df2ed5-4dfd-41fb-9645-95cbea531f3e: "Yes... I should have told you everything earlier instead of letting it gnaw me up. But I didn't quite understand myself. And then... I was such an idiot — I was afraid to tell you, afraid you'd laugh and push me away. I'm so sorry."
4ab092c6-701f-4042-8bc7-fd4502abe19f: {n}Your advisor has arrived to report about the recent Divine developments in your {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom}.{/n}
97c6fd51-faf7-4ada-9ddd-b24df07c9996: "Merciful doesn't mean spineless. In one hand, Sarenrae holds a healing light, in the other – a killing sword!"
24ba65c6-4a84-4ee8-b63b-c9a3a0a7ee17: "I know you are good with your little sword. And you don't run away in a fight. But after a battle you always have that face, like you just swallowed a hedgehog. What's the point of fighting if you don't enjoy it?"
04d73fe9-b0b5-4f8c-8b84-40a9f9bc5c51: "You might be surprised to hear this, boy-priest, but I was that sword, and I've cut down many. Perhaps even more than you."
de5cdab1-c10a-4804-832f-30ef64aced3f: "No! I'm not going to listen! I've heard enough preaching! Go bother someone else!"
303d14d7-b39d-4e15-b7d8-868da5a5cf13: {g|Divine9_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "Let them speak out, without fear for their lives or their freedom. Leave them be."
4b5159a3-f0ca-4fbb-86d8-f90c7a86d7d1: {g|Divine9_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "Declare their teachings prohibited, and drive them to the border."
c6593f4a-10f8-47b9-9f58-d80f1d62806f: "I will rely upon you in this matter."
d3f37a98-6c00-4331-98ef-53d50e69a7e5: "We have arrested some agitators from Touvette. They claim themselves harbingers of atheism, and doubt the high status and authority of the gods, whose servants cause only pain and suffering. We should do as Touvette's neighbors have done, and drive these agitators away, while still preventing bloodshed."
f2b9aa28-2a2d-422a-a842-580ce3233be4: "The guards have arrested some agitators from Touvette. They call themselves preachers of godlessness, also known as atheism. The gods should not be worshipped, they say, and I agree with them. Only {g|Groetus}Groetus{/g} is worthy of our prayers. He alone is honest with us. He doesn't promise any reward. On the contrary, he shows what awaits us, no matter how tempted we may be to reject him in horror. So I would leave these... atheists alone. Their frustration with the gods is justified in many ways. That's why the priests are after them!"
fc24460c-c317-4acd-8e8a-b347d6384b67: "We've captured some dangerous rebels. They're agitators from Touvette claiming to be atheists, or simply put, godless people. They may be fools, but they're dangerous nevertheless. Our divine patrons might turn away from the kingdom, depriving us of their protection, and all because of these fools! They must be banished. Or even better – publicly executed, to show the gods that we haven't let them poison our minds."
a8d9a4d6-ee54-4ed4-bba2-ddd3ef2e85a2: {n}Harrim's voice is hollow, as if echoing down a deep well.{/n} "Every voice may sound in the void, but not every voice can fill the void."
83b0f19d-0665-4df1-8f5e-749ae30e5178: "I will make sure that they are entirely driven from your lands."
ef286a7a-ecb1-4b15-a6ff-96b605b04c08: {n}Harrim shrugs.{/n} "Very well, but it's not going to change anything. Their teachings have already been shared. Fate cannot be changed."
7ea84f05-9ad3-459e-b824-708eb568ed58: {n}A predatory grin appears on Tsanna's face.{/n} "It will be done. I'll see that they suffocate properly – slowly and painfully. The gods won't blame us for showing mercy to their enemies."
a5f2c980-4af4-49d9-882a-ec79de57020a: {n}Jhod frowns and clenches his fists.{/n} "I'll make sure they're driven away quietly. Let them preach their false ideas in Touvette. We'll not welcome it here. The gods are gracious, and our ruler is not angling to take their place!"
71861c9d-a8f3-42ee-9aaf-8f531a4cb30c: {n}Harrim sighs.{/n} "Let them teach what they will, then. The end may come when we finally give up all religions but {g|Groetus}Groetus'{/g}! This makes their teaching harmless. It only promotes the inevitable."
ffe3fc73-0ee7-4a4a-bcf8-6be37ba345ed: {n}A predatory grin appears on Tsanna's face.{/n} "I'll ensure that no one ever hears their dangerous teachings. I'll put their heads on display."
8f351699-2159-4de6-92df-82aa7f97d5f2:
"It's a bad place! Wars between rival priests tore Touvette apart. The fighting almost destroyed the country. Neighbors annexed half the territory. The people were starving. – And the priests and the king didn't care at all.
So General Voran gathered the people's full support, overthrew the king, and seized power. Voran put an end to the war, restored order, and recovered the kingdom's lands. I even approve that he seized the priests' treasures to feed the people. It was the priests who led the people to starvation! But Voran isn't the sort of man you would freely give power to."
0ea6d4d4-a688-4771-9a59-8b2d688b3b77: "Touvette is a brilliant example for us all. Emptiness and death await everyone. The priests of Touvette fought each other too fiercely, and this brought their country to ruin. But just as Touvette was about to fall, General Voran appeared. He overthrew the king, expelled the priests, and restored order. He spent the temple's treasures to feed the people. You must wonder if this story had a happy ending? No, it didn't. As I said, the inevitable cannot be stopped."
da41f86b-8af1-4a0d-8329-35a0834c6cfb: "It's a bad place! The local priests of the "good" gods began to quarrel, and almost ruined the country. General Voran seized power, and became a strong leader. {g|Lamashtu}Lamashtu{/g} could have granted her blessing to him. But Voran attempted to become even more. I think he considers himself almost a deity. He killed or expelled all the priests to eliminate competition, and turned the temples into headquarters for his knights. They are soldiers, judges, and executioners all at the same time."
a1367842-efcd-436e-8fa3-ec96d98a331d:
"He expelled all the priests from Touvette. Dissenters were dragged behind horses through the streets, and stoned to death. He also turned the temples into 'refuges', a combination of schools, hospitals, and offices.
Voran instituted strict order and fully subdued Touvette. Its people sing praises to him every morning, as if he were a god – for saving them from religion and laziness. Everything is closely watched. Indeed, Voran himself announced that the country was full of spies. This is how he compels obedience. Like most crimes, speaking out against the general is punished by death at the hands of his Knights. They are warriors, judges, and executioners, all at the same time."
9c6b242f-adb3-400a-8006-3f1abde7effa: "The worst sin in Touvette is believing in anyone or anything other than Voran. The general has declared war on all gods. He combined the ways of {g|Razmiran}Razmiran{/g} and {g|Rahadoum}Rahadoum{/g}, the famous country in {g|Garund}Garund{/g} which denies all the gods. Take my word for it, Touvette will never flourish without the patronage of a mighty god. On the contrary, the country is now isolated, and it has no allies."
bd875727-4f03-45a4-a583-72b8e96ffb0c: "Now there is order in Touvette. Strict order. There's only one punishment for breaking the law. Death. Speaking against Voran or worshipping the gods are chief among crimes. Everyone is watched so closely that no one can hide. I don't have any brothers or sisters there. That country is destined to perish, either by the will of the gods, or by the simple act of its neighbors, who have broken off all ties with Touvette."
6187cffe-640b-47dd-a6d6-98edc2e17c2d:
"Voran went mad. He forced to people to worship him and utter prayers of gratitude to him every morning. He banned all other gods and killed the priests. His knights watch everyone, and kill all who dare worship a god. This is a country of strict laws, and everyone must submit to the cruel dictator.
He once crucified a defeated general and carried the cross above his army like a banner, can you imagine it? That's the sort of man he is, the savior of Touvette."
1ad642af-32ec-4751-889a-6c5193dd45ce: "But he's merely postponed the death of his country. Either it will be punished by the enraged and jealous gods, or starved to death by neighbors who've no interest in further dealings with Touvette."
390f75f4-5e49-41ba-b48c-2df6943e0a5c: "What were you and Dugath arguing about?"
a82d51b4-c623-404a-a5ce-f07fe275beed: "Do you have any idea where your Sisters might be?"
e6220616-8c52-4c5b-b18c-8b1fbdd1b193: "Do you know anything about what happened in Varnhold?"
402a8aac-1c08-4a28-b050-ce1dc5883c54: "What compensation can I expect for my help?"
d68f6baf-8515-4c94-952a-2d4585cf8919: "You don't need to know my name."
a23fee1f-79ac-41c3-a19b-deedee55f166: "I found your Sister in the Forsaken Mound."
b028d313-35d2-4f57-8ed1-668f044cf972: "I found your Sister in the City of Hollow Eyes."
04921c20-f3f2-4c36-b0af-fd4cc26581d0: "I found your Sister in the Sepulcher of Forgotten Heroes."
8101e886-97e4-4d2a-a4d6-6f687ec7d443: "She's alive and well, and she'll return soon. She asked me to give you this incense burner."
d6f5e7e2-32b2-4d55-9bd7-67a35c06903a: "You have a whole army here. How did you manage to get this far?"
e21520f0-e671-4708-b73f-9f88cc893858: {n}A slim figure stands eerily still, wrapped in a cloak and hiding her face in her hands. If you hadn't seen her moving before, you could easily mistake her for a statue. However, as you approach, she lowers her hands from her face, and golden-green eyes peer at you through the holes in the cloth covering her face.{/n} "You... Our guest. The {mf|baron|baroness} of {kingdomname}, am I right? I'm sorry you witnessed that unpleasant scene. If I may ask, what is your name?"
db3b496a-49d1-4679-be85-9797c43aefbb: {n}The Defaced Sister stands still, only her golden-green eyes follow you through the holes in the cloth that covers her face.{/n}
7f6f906c-e250-42f5-8107-19407f05ef17: "I'm one of those who call themselves the Defaced Sisters. We've rejected our names and our faces in service to benevolent spirits. I'm sorry that I can't reveal our true destiny to you yet — but believe me when I say our mission is extremely important. Not just for us, not just for the tribe, but for the entire world."
6c8555a6-3a7f-4974-b468-46396091ab40: {n}The woman lowers her head.{/n} "My Sisters... They each went out on their own quests and never returned — not one of the three. I can understand Dugath — he doesn't trust us. But by refusing to help my sisters and me, he puts himself, his people, and countless innocent souls in grave danger. If only I could soften his impenitent heart..."
628c70aa-7c5b-4788-b69c-2ba4f8be9557: "Do you have a map? I can provide you some direction. One of my Sisters went to the {g|Sepulcher of Forgotten Heroes}Sepulcher of Forgotten Heroes{/g}. Another went looking for the {g|Forsaken Mound}Forsaken Mound{/g}. And the third was going to visit the ruins of the {g|City of the Hollow Eyes}City of Hollow Eyes{/g}. I won't lie, these places are all very dangerous — but searching for lost truth always involves danger." {n}The woman marks the locations on your map.{/n}
50d1759b-89c0-465c-a736-5d4b19096fc4: "It is not yet time to answer this question. We're searching for ancient ruins, the remains of structures built by the previous holders of these strange lands — that's all I can tell you for now. I understand that you want to know more, but have no doubt — you will in time."
16546dcc-06cc-4996-85d8-4ae3bbd47255: "Don't be wary of riddles. Those wise enough to solve them eventually learn much more than those who always seek straight answers."
9dcd5edc-5e16-4449-a41b-921f69439eed: "Dark things tend to happen in that land. I can only guess to the fate of {g|Varnhold}Varnhold{/g}. My three Sisters know more. Help me find them, and you'll get your answers — if the spirits are kind, it will happen before it's too late."
55d92d51-696e-45b1-9d54-6121f3cf3d34: "With the most valuable treasure of all — truth."
ba83f3e2-948f-41ae-8e71-b1b027110e88: "May kind spirits guide you in your travels."
280757b2-ae06-499c-8b03-f5509772815f: "These are enigmatic lands — stars rain from the sky, soil bleeds fire and gives birth to metal instead of grass... These are lands of mysteries and nightmares — but they're destined to become the salvation of us all, for that's where great Armag lived, died, and rose again, and he will bring redemption for us all."
a2f2ddce-1331-481b-8195-a4c039743dae: "He's a man of great destiny. The gods themselves tried to lay him low, but he came back, defied death itself, as was foretold, for that was his fate. He's destined to save many, many lives, but at terrible cost to himself. I would never wish a fate like that on you, Baron{mf||ess}. I would never wish a fate like that on anyone."
07abada3-1635-4f9e-9a6d-ca82cc301693: "Nice to meet you, Baron{mf||ess}. I have no name. I've rejected it to serve benevolent powers — not the greatest sacrifice of those we're sometimes called to make. You may call me Defaced Sister."
a1be2508-85f0-463e-b3be-f964385afcf2: {n}The woman nods.{/n} "So be it. Everyone has their secrets, Baron{mf||ess}."
4af29f4a-69f0-43e3-861a-17f51fdafe79: {n}After you give your name, a large raven who'd been sitting on the fence nearby takes wing and flies away, cawing coarsely.{/n}
4166ce95-f304-435b-9ff2-97ff5aa182b1: "I thank you. How is she? Where is she?"
eee24e5e-9a95-4de7-9265-02885c62ff95: "Good spirits be praised! Where is she?"
0299ed3b-f435-4a3e-b7d0-e53fbbc6f3c4: "Thank you for your help. I hope she's all right?"
073d9771-0d16-4d6b-a015-d6f119490c64: "I'm so glad! I knew I shouldn't lose hope!"
fee0344e-da86-4fe1-ade6-a1c66300dd5d: "Grave news, indeed. May the kind spirits save her soul."
fe159639-9c2f-41d5-9ad3-6a1d819c2aa4: "You... You've committed a terrible crime — and made an even more terrible mistake."
669d9883-9538-4593-9dc7-f46925c6487f: "I can't wait to see her again. Oh, Sister, please hurry!"
21246ca5-4838-4e9a-8742-937c8126bc3b: "My poor Sister... I won't let her sacrifice be in vain."
c9f1a814-c7b6-48a6-9cda-61e22037204d: "How could you! You have no idea of the horrible dangers you've brought on your head — on the heads of us all!"
8c5ef7b2-0455-41a3-8bfe-eb5d13930b6a: "May the kind spirits guard her path."
a93601ed-ed8b-44c8-924a-72e394b21ddc: "Such a tragedy... Alas, sometimes serving the good demands the ultimate sacrifice of us."
a8f0efdc-4dfe-479c-b545-18987f767529: "Oh, spirits... You've no idea what you're doing!"
3940ecdd-6176-4ec6-b957-a6911b0f6982: "She's back already. I can't thank you enough."
4ac99863-d0e4-4beb-849a-d70671d2442d: "You have my thanks. I was so happy to see her alive and well!"
91227ae8-c2f4-49df-b19a-df0305bf8e96: "If in your travels you meet my Sisters, please help them. And I will help you in return. Remember this word: "kheb." That is what the previous inhabitants of these lands, the cyclopes, called darkness they so worshipped... If a door, shut and lockless, bars your path — this word might be your key."
7dd8bae9-6822-437a-81d0-0734e1a87163: "That's strange... What could keep her away for so long? I suppose it is no matter. I'm just happy to know she's all right. Thank you for taking care of her."
527a4645-a300-43f3-8adf-98a6bd6d95a9: "Wise ones know many routes that are closed to the uninitiated... Will you be able to detect them? Will you dare to walk along them? Who knows..."
a34aab6e-88a6-44b7-8b2a-b1f889836b87: "So honorable! Do these benevolent spirits have names?"
e4b95472-545c-4e58-8e42-dee215362ae2: "Do not burden yourself with idle questions, cleric. Know that all the truths you are seeking for will find you — but only when you are ready for them!"
a7832651-b8c3-4271-bd8c-b2e191d86a19: "How is this possible? Doesn't this army know any kind of order or discipline? How do they manage to even fight in such chaos?"
f3472ab1-a230-4e6d-8fed-cc345b715851: "There are many songs about Armag, not all of them {g|Numeria}Numerian{/g}. Some see his story as an inspiration, other as a warning against the dangers of hubris... But I've never heard about any prophecy!"

The centerpiece was made of hundreds, maybe even thousands of polished bones, all put together to form the head of an enormous dragon. If a single bone were to be removed from the foundation, this beautiful statue would crumble to dust. And I even spotted one such flimsy bone...
Regardless, we'd come face-to-face with irrefutable proof — the kobolds, for better or worse, were changing. This news had no impact on our search for the trolls, though — the land was clearly sacred to the kobolds, and it seemed unlikely they would bring their new friends here.

9e58d8c7-fc02-4a33-b0e7-c20577d42641: "Yes. It was my idea, after all."

6ffef165-ba85-4a53-86e9-51d3cb162c20: "You know Linzi. She has a creative mind."
f933b402-ddbf-41e5-a14c-a26071f1c867: "Sometimes our feelings scare us... but your grief and your anger are justified. One can't order one's heart to stop seeking revenge and justice."
95d4e994-2d17-4ca5-b179-83842b7ede4b: "Only you can decide what path is right for you. I believe you will make the correct choice."
ee5ad0cf-9eb5-4703-b937-74c37f641936: "And that's it? You have nothing else to tell me?"
9340e684-e9ac-4743-bf0a-065cd1de5cc0: {n}The ranger greets you with a curt nod.{/n}
e1c24cb3-6be4-4d2e-b316-51b77df1faa5: "Your Grace must want to talk to Ekun. I'll go make sure everyone has enough to drink."
96860e08-c934-4514-804a-40332a1f339f: {n}The ranger rubs the back of his head, then smirks.{/n} "Amanda. Said, 'A caravan is here — you'll go to the tavern again! Ntavi is a bad influence!' And then Ntavi started coming less and less..."
c8f4c416-ea2e-497d-9e23-cf6982e952dc: "Guarded caravans. She talked a lot. I thought: 'She must be in love with her own voice.'" {n}Ekun winces.{/n}
6cb9d96f-7f9e-454f-879a-78a3dac914fd: {n}Ekun chuckles and nods confidently.{/n} "It's good to be among friends and trees. And better still — not holding a bow."
4d31fc0f-69df-4f4b-aa29-465c0132a830: {n}Ekun looks at the grass beneath his feet.{/n} "As fire and wind."
44fc37fc-db79-4b05-876e-f3f42616b050: "We are friends. And friends leave — but stay anyway."
0d7b4857-6f38-475a-8f67-97dbc92bfb92: {n}Ekun looks uncertainly at the offered glass.{/n}
8a0907df-10e4-4c35-8cd1-f00acd015855: {n}Ekun resolutely shakes his head.{/n} "No. Thank you."
38deae43-1a4a-483d-b662-fc73ce128fd4: {n}Ekun is silent for a moment, then pours himself some wine and tastes it… then his face relaxes slightly.{/n} "Not bad."
8d239173-f585-4dbe-a64e-48e5dd1a2fc1: {n}Ekun nods and the tension leaves his shoulders.{/n}
f06fcc71-3e7b-4848-9e0a-ce9c957365ff: "Life is life. It goes on... whether we wish it or not."
b587b3d4-52e7-46ce-a80b-122c1b903fde: {n}Ekun tugs at the buttons of his jacket and lowers his head.{/n}
9b65b2b9-3cc9-43ec-b1d2-b5a225d3f658: {n}A faint smile spreads on Ekun's face.{/n} "There is very much of her. All at once. However... she is a good woman."
b425369d-5dfd-4caa-a931-8efad1ab397b: {n}Looking at Elina's back, Ekun turns to you, fixing one of his belt bags.{/n} "Cunning plan. To bring a hunter to a feast, call him to hunt."
35a11a22-0913-412d-84e1-c7daf6d206cb: {n}Ekun stares into the distance.{/n} "I wake up with the first rays of sun — I see the faces of my family. Fire turns to ashes, midday turns to midnight — and when the stars are shining I still think of them."
4fa13195-e965-4ba6-90db-0ce95c9595d3: "I find it interesting to look at faces, listen to what they say to each other. I... missed it."
84adb7bb-985a-4055-bb7b-4c4172e1652d: {n}Ekun nods.{/n} "It's good to be among friends and trees. And even better — not holding a bow."
52c480c0-6bd0-40b3-a407-9df47081309a: "She is the lady of the house. This is her responsibility."
f501384a-876c-4859-81e1-3fcf61ef9d45: "And you, according to Elina." {n}Ekun is silent for a while.{/n} "Thank you."
2a3b0d02-f780-4a53-8fca-aa612956cb89: {n}Ekun shrugs.{/n} "It's good to be among trees."
c287295e-903e-4ca2-9d4c-fa54658a2f7e: "I started living with Amanda. And Ntavi left with a caravan."
7fc36c03-6fe0-49a5-a012-a74146563d7a: "And then the desert taught her to close her mouth. Sand gets in." {n}Ekun smiles slightly, but his eyes are joyful.{/n}
8f189fc2-80e3-4518-88bb-57a5ced8d5d4: "I... thought about it. Time will tell."
5960fc1a-b92d-47e1-b3d3-e44677c26151: {n}Ekun's eyes flare.{/n} "What do you know of how I live?"
db34c375-470f-4415-9406-1d835a332975: {n}Ekun's face is still.{/n} "You will not put me out. No point trying."
ac317697-3389-4b3e-bc9f-d2086c1f7b3f: "Some days bitterness and rage fill me — I drive them away. Other days I feel a smile on my face and I appall myself. Only hunting numbs my feelings. But the farther I follow the trail, the darker the woods are... and the harder it is to find my way back."
902f7144-fd82-459e-938a-9a9ddc487364: {n}Ekun looks down. After a long silence he speaks, noticeably relieved.{/n} "Your eyes look deep. Sometimes too deep. Thank you, {name}."
08f6169d-40ee-4f57-ba89-a27ce84d664c: {n}Ekun's face is blank.{/n} "Your words can't hurt me."
308f9987-322f-4f82-8b1d-0790383005ae: {n}Listening to you, Ekun sighs heavily, but determination is written on his face.{/n} "I suppose you're right. One can't be scared and leave these woods behind."
98c723e7-eb2c-4da4-8645-70224f8abe91: {n}Ekun smiles slightly.{/n} "Easier said than done. But there is wisdom in your words."
406ba4b1-96c8-488d-884b-445c0b49184e: {g|Loyalty10_1}[Choice effects]{/g} "Our gallows cannot wait to meet them. Let everyone see what fate awaits traitors."
615d7079-0f11-40d1-853e-eaefe1edd77d: {g|Loyalty10_2}[Choice effects]{/g} "Let them go. We've taught them a lesson. It is sufficient."
2b9d4b72-bc8e-4cbf-a208-b4aa2f10c503: {g|Loyalty10_3}[Choice effects]{/g} [Gain 10000 gold and 200 BP] "Free them from their chains. Also free them of their wealth, their estates, their luxurious clothing and any other possessions. It will be seized for the good of the state and its people."
f7ee9084-418f-4a95-97c0-c113c38e6b30: "Các thương nhân trở nên giàu có vì họ biết đọc biết viết, và họ học lịch sử và địa lý. Hãy để dân chúng gửi con cái đến trường học, đền thờ, và các hiền nhân, để chúng học hỏi và trở nên khôn ngoan hơn."
4d2e1ac8-6350-4b6b-bf34-37dbab275027: "I want the people to become the kingdom's ears. Keep an eye on any suspicious foreigners. Never discount a strange rumor. Only united can we stand against our enemy's deceptions."
ef6c9a61-8aa6-4fb2-b238-0a675b46b98f: "Tell everyone you meet that I'm a just ruler. If our neighbors learn of my people's respect, my fame and power will grow."
8914c62c-d67d-4154-becd-0ecdf44f76ad: "But now for some less uplifting news. The guards have exposed a conspiracy of merchants. All the plotters have been arrested, and you must decide their fate. The people are concerned that the rich merchants will simply get away with it. I believe your justice will be served rightly and mercifully."
e9f2ef71-f28d-45a0-bfdd-5fc0d04ebc44: "Your citizens gathered in a council today to plan some more new slums. They're naming one of their squares after you. I love how they roll over for you. Not every ruler enjoys such a mixture of fear and love!"
db15bd8c-68e2-4c5a-92a6-4e068a1f614a: "I am sad for them. I wish someone had stopped them before their conspiracy went too far. Part of the blame for this is also mine."
edb1a6ea-815e-4cb3-8f65-18021891855f: "This will teach a harsh lesson to all who witness the punishment. The lesson of fear and respect, {name}. They are the two pillars of every true leader's power."
aa2e1745-6ce6-4020-8d46-0c1825903e92: "I hope they recognize how lucky they are, and use this chance to start a new life."
7abbc190-9ffc-46e0-b62f-24a9ecfa6d05: "Your softness is sickening. Very well, as you wish. Your pack may consider it a token of generosity."
21fc6376-9b54-498a-ae7f-bd0d729e9a43: "I heard it's only when a man has nothing that he recognizes true virtue. Perhaps they'll become better and purer souls without their riches..."
9397a9ed-56d4-4d2e-adec-1ed68ce127a0: "Hm... You might be doing the right thing. Anyway, they'll be helpless without their wealth."
ea6b45b4-6016-4f9b-b3de-f51c6ce44479: "We shall forgive them, but deprive them of their means of bribing people and plotting behind your back. Let their wealth be put into use for the ordinary poor people, and let the conspirators join their number."
6f3c4926-bd65-4a38-a54b-a2a783942746: "Dangerous and diseased pack members should be eliminated. I will take care of everything, beginning with these pathetic conspirators."
c189f915-4f0a-4521-91a3-f1736d090925: "Another visitor awaits an audience with you. He is the leader of the druids of {kingdomname}."
2f35d81f-f02b-4861-81e4-74fe3e6cfc5d: {n}Tsanna's face darkens. She seems nervous. Her rat has disappeared gone.{/n} "Now that the destiny of the conspirators has been decided, please accept another visitor. He is the leader of the druids of {kingdomname}. But beware – he is not as simple as he seems."
4ac22d0c-cbe9-4b42-9bcb-62367a112472: "{name}, the city council discussed the expansion of one of the districts today. The square in its center will be named in your honor, by unanimously consent. You deserve the love of your subjects! Not every ruler has a chance to enjoy it."
3034f9bf-0851-4110-a7e4-48c8e712966b: "The loyal hounds of your guard arrested the last members of the merchants' conspiracy today. It's time to decide their fates. I would not recommend mercy. 0def0a5b-f2c8-4973-aa5c-df1d697306a0: {n}A sturdy old man with a shaggy beard begins to clear his throat. His penetrating eyes scan you, his face benign and respectful.{/n} "Long live Your Highness! We didn't think of you as a friend at first, I admit. But we were wrong."
d4847373-a5ca-40f8-9a6e-ef081dfb040b: "Chúng ta sẽ làm được, {name}. Tất nhiên sẽ mất thời gian, nhưng rồi cuối cùng ta sẽ tốt đẹp hơn nhờ nó."
75489cb0-29ca-4521-8068-3d5d7aa7651f: "You're speaking dark words, but I don't want to argue. It is true, in times like these, all our neighbors envy us. Don't you worry. If any trouble stirs up, your guards will be the first to know!"
b3187d4c-44ec-4e20-9598-c45216cdb039: "Sẽ xong thôi. Mọi láng giềng của ngài sẽ nghe về việc dân chúng ủng hộ ngài thế nào. Điều đó sẽ khiến họ kính trọng ngài!"
dbb918f7-07b7-42ae-b722-ab16bf577677: "We've seen many things, but a ruler who stands up for the ordinary people against the rich – that's something new. The petty merchants that robbed the people are like the bandits now. They're singing a different tune, and engage in honest trade. For this I thank you on behalf of the druid circle. Tell us what your people can do for you, and your words will be ours. The people heed their druids."
a0afff0d-da3c-4c12-8fdc-1304bf8ac5ed: "Your people truly love you. However mighty or powerful a ruler may be, the druids never bear gifts to tyrants or villains."
01e9b5d1-cf0c-46bd-a748-6fe84a4af464: {n}Tsanna and the old man stare down one another as if discussing something silently. Then the Councilor nods reluctantly.{/n} "I'm glad to see you have come in good faith, old man. You have delivered the people's message, and we have heard you."
9240ba57-48b8-4701-a7ba-006de3049f8a: "Your Highness, the merchants who conspired against you have been arrested. You will have to determine their fate. Naturally, the crowd is out for blood. bfa46b96-badc-466e-88d8-32162c84ab29: "If they were mere peasants, I would agree. But these are people of great value to the kingdom. They've made a fortune on their own wits. We all might benefit from their wisdom. Their clever heads on spikes – that would truly be a sorry sight!"
aa3c2616-fc9a-4aa1-9e31-67456dbc5287: "Your Highness, it is time we graciously receive another visitor, if you please. He is a representative of the people, so to speak. Ahem."
cf043b51-5cc9-4558-adfd-2500464d3146: "They've learned their lesson. Arrest and imprisonment sent them a clear message. We can be sure that they'll think thrice before stirring up another rebellion. – And more importantly, if any make such a proposal, they'll all come running to report it to you!"
7b1a2605-06d2-4fa1-b7d8-03bd05e70ed2: "Your Highness, that's tantamount to murdering them. But it's not their individual lives that matter. It's their names and assets that are important. Strip them of their gold, and you'll destroy pillars that support your kingdom. Though your power to devastate will strike fear into the hearts of the other merchants..."
a7259f30-f4ec-4540-9ffc-5c16ac2e0cbb: {n}The Councilor smiles at the druid graciously, but her gaze is cold.{/n} "Your Highness, I am glad there's someone in the kingdom who we may rely on. 3ef36976-8424-4d4b-8562-065ac92e9450: "But I suggest they should be pardoned. They made a mistake, true. But they were caught. That will teach them to fear your wrath, and carefully consider their actions in the future. They have been among the most noble people in the capital. You have now their obedience. The same might not be true of whoever should replace them."
6a6a0e08-f104-4510-89d3-00ecc781236a: "You are so young, Tristian, but you've seen so much! It must be hard, carrying your faith to all the ends of the world!"
325902a4-72fb-4780-b845-92051c4b1a3e: "Yes, Octavia, it's a heavy burden. Sometimes I doubt I can handle it. But I close my eyes and appeal to the Healing Light, and I feel the presence of my goddess, and I know – if not me, then who?"
e4a685a9-e35e-45a2-a950-13458b3f485e: "I have no questions right now. Farewell."
edc572b3-bb64-4246-9166-8d157f2ca618: "You're doing a good thing. May Erastil never abandon you."
6b20d264-b258-42dd-9b1f-fefb999f3ba0: {n}You see a tall woman dressed in simple but rugged traveling clothes.{/n} "Greetings, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! I'm Ilga, leader of these pilgrims in honor of {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}. I meet with travelers and deal in the goods our small community creates. How can I be of service?"
47249c6b-fd36-49ea-9de7-6c2b0f21d9ba: "Not quickly, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}. Temples like this take dozens of years to build, and I fear a full restoration won't be much faster. But we're happy to be able to touch the holy shrine and do our part to ensure its future greatness."
da57b426-17e0-4f65-a952-540a9301c111: "Thank you, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! May he bless you as well!"
ae0e3fe1-092f-439b-9878-cbafd49b9d72: [Attack] "What a disgusting offer. You will be brought to justice."
847ddf47-15cc-4f29-beb1-14d3c4de05fd: {n}Morhalan looks at you apprehensively, but his voice sounds confident.{/n} "Greetings, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. 4bfea879-4635-4646-816d-a6bf54151f82: "The very same thing that I offer all the other over-meticulous hunters and prying guards. Gold. Gold, {mf|Your Grace|Your Grace|Your Highness|Your Highness}. 846d9dd4-fa49-4a62-9910-ac7ec3b8bad9: "I'm happy to hear that you have found my offer sensible. Please accept this purse of gold. Your people can collect the rest from my workshop. Now if you will excuse me, there is one more matter that I simply must address before I leave these lands."
db727c7a-6951-4a48-8023-b9de8503fade: "I would like to hear your story."
f53ef8f9-b043-4eaa-9bd2-c1281ffa12e3: "You and Tristian seem to not get along."
fbbac3d6-662f-412a-af70-ac39f0fce1a4: "I have decided I no longer need your assistance."
378d292a-b326-48c2-b992-df77192ad96a: "How did you die — and what happened after?"
4a9969b5-de5a-4745-ad67-8249a670136f: "Is exile your only punishment for murder?"
9c02167e-0c57-4925-a50d-ef6dffa19a40: "Did you kill innocent elves for entertainment and pleasure? That's abominable!"
5fb18cba-7321-494c-89b2-39f244f04c74: "I am not one to judge you for your past deeds."
4dfcd008-4729-49bb-8a6c-b4890dc8d206: "In the end we all live for ourselves. The lives of others shouldn't outweigh our own."
eabb5723-b7d5-452a-a0fe-924fb6a290cf: "How do healing spells, prayers and potions affect you?"
72517718-fc2f-4f8e-a10d-e7c1e5dd5bc8: "Do you regret not being alive anymore?"
fc4dbc20-ea9b-462c-aeec-49310ceb6798: "What does Urgathoa require of her followers?"
637bf744-28a4-4c94-a5ce-205bc65f72e8: "Why is the cult of Urgathoa forbidden in much of Golarion?"
0b79fbab-f22f-4f1e-8d47-3f780a45f029: "You've become powerful, that's all that matters. It's much better than the life of ordinary mortals — and even elves."
336a2518-63a0-4b7a-9cd6-9f0bd1a4b6f0: "A bright life, full of pleasures, is better than un-life, though eternal."
cb31c9ec-020f-47ac-8178-4bc335fe2fae: "There's no purpose in living only for yourself. It makes life and un-life equally senseless."
0e4d97a0-a601-4064-a916-a6af6e2cd3c4: "But why do these assassins follow you?"
8276dd0d-3ddf-457b-8c23-0eb696c37a84: "You are my companion, so you can count on my protection."
3b4aec86-22ff-4cef-be76-5247ccf173c5: "Do not engage me in your personal war."
6ca46664-bdd7-4497-ba5d-94d6601a16aa: "Thank you, I have no more questions about this."
bc837b56-6377-4e7d-844a-40aaa7ab2251: "What do you know of Urgathoa herself?"
4d33a679-6bf8-4112-8507-6cb1858b4248: "I hope you suffered fair punishment for your crimes!"
f85c39cf-0fdb-4dbb-ba10-5b46bc15ebb8: "An objective worth pursuing, but it would be better to refrain from secret murder. There are many ways to arrange a death, while keeping within the boundaries of law and decency."
b33855c5-1486-4382-a049-68a90799eede: "Does Urgathoa feud with the other gods?"
9765ba0f-24a9-4076-8cf4-918746c13890: "No. I just wanted to see how you'd react."
7e936005-11c3-4366-8c37-e41e5c25c226: "Do you have family in Kyonin? Anyone who is dear to you?"
c734d1b4-4d7b-42cb-9ece-e0cf9e06734b: "It seems to me the experience... changed you."
34d6b63f-7365-42c6-98e9-1c55dc99b598: "No. Undeath has nothing to do with life. It reeks of evil, and disgusts me."
383dcf63-246d-4816-92e0-aaea3072bdfd: "I don't know. But your power does intrigue me."
43a3c1df-13eb-42ae-88ab-10651d1d6ed7: "I understand you. There is a frightening beauty in un-life. The beauty of power. The beauty of being able to ignore the laws that rule over all living things."
8de50ce8-c83a-40ae-b387-198fbd5b6a52: "Regarding this story with Taneka and Enneo..."
229d363b-b191-4212-b7d3-78ab11ffaf05: "Did you study the scroll? What can you tell about the ritual?"
2ac2bd61-30ee-4c84-aea4-ace14d8cd12f: "Before raising that elf woman as undead, you said that she looked like 'Nortellara'. Who is that?"
d3223694-edda-4a9e-8943-14927100b1d7: "What can you tell me about Enneo?"
4d42c3b5-deac-469f-af2e-1588b247ecfe: "I want to speak with you about what happened at the elven camp."
cba59696-74e6-49cb-98a9-b034507726fc: "You are wrong to be inspired by Enneo's example. He was a fanatic and it led him to his death. Your desire for a carefree life of pleasure — that seems much more sensible."
bd87c5d4-e4e0-4876-b467-dc3997cdaa8a: "I do not like Enneo's fanaticism, nor the pointless indulgence of one's whims. There must be another way."
a0875d1e-4888-4754-908d-50763a2b81c1: "Enneo had a goal, and he moved towards it with fascinating tenacity. He deserves our respect. "
eeac611c-be6a-4b81-8bcb-d90dfa4eedd7: "What can you expect now that you have passed Urgathoa's test?"
6d8df2a9-a579-4c73-9873-56af70d390d3: "What does it mean to be an inquisitor of Urgathoa?"
950a24dd-a953-4c7c-aaed-33a7be8222f6: "Right. I was born in other lands but always wanted to know more about the homeland of elves."
be715952-610f-4db5-bb61-6eba68738106: "I'm from Kyonin too, but I'd like to hear how you see our common homeland."
8c84d2c2-384f-43d8-b59c-b634f66dcdb8: "I just haven't been there for a long time. I want to hear the latest news."
701f0ef3-bf3b-4a85-8ebb-5ee1efc02590: "Everything depends on us. If some elves become jaded and boring late in life, they probably didn't enjoy life before either."
8149bb40-3dec-4297-a72f-514ab2ed7da1: "It's impossible to keep the soul forever young. Not across the ages, with all the pain and commotion."
966e8789-cd53-40d7-b59d-a88ad58c5abf: "Maybe, but our longevity is still much better than the short and bright existence granted to the short-lived."
03883ae7-8aec-4aaa-9b73-9964ad51f22d: "I understand what you mean. I myself fear to lose mental clarity and open-mindedness over time."
52e8c0f9-506f-4446-ae61-9cb054a1b4d9: "Stories..." {n}Jaethal shrugs.{/n} "Stories are boring, and a waste of time. I have killed. I was exiled from {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}. I died. I was raised by {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa's{/g} gift. That is my 'story'."
41c1c266-a5d7-4de1-8203-59e7370d473c: "Family. Four." {n}Jaethal's voice is calm and ordinary, as if she's speaking of something trivial.{/n} "But 'why' is the more interesting question."
b7e8e283-696b-4026-8592-b85d87ab460a: "What is the worth of a thousand years, if you cannot enjoy it like your first ten dozen springs?" {n}The elf's voice sounds unusually vehement.{/n} "Everyone considers elves ever-young, but our 'youthfulness' is but a mask, a threadbare ritual gown.
