Unless you have another assignment for me, you'll have the elixir the next time we meet!"
8e69464d-a64b-4ef6-be68-e701f51eab01: "I do hope this helps." {n}Bokken smiles and bows to you.{/n}
27e35def-f0e4-49c4-a212-fb2b672a3c28: "Try the potion, won't you? It's the best I've ever brewed! My life's work, one could say." {n}Bokken smiles and bows to you.{/n}
604831e5-b00a-4b25-9ac2-a12b7bd2a570: "It's me, good old Bokken. And they say old men get poor memories, hah! I'm your humble alchemist. I brew potions and oils, and study ancient formulas for transmutation. I'm going to make a very special elixir once my studies are complete. One that'll refine your spirit, and mind, and body alike!"
bf4a21a2-07f8-4793-ad38-c73d5971e962: "I kind of... I wanted to ask you something about my tribe... It's — forget it, it doesn't matter anymore. They're gone now — so hell with them! We have enough to do without those scums, right?" {n}Amiri tries to force a grin, but fails. You can see that she's upset, but not inclined to talk about it.{/n}
3da01e32-f645-486d-b4f5-40ab44291edb: "I'm looking for a troublemaker, who has been stirring the people to riot. Have you seen her?"
35bd40c2-9aa8-47a4-b366-4d6a6642d954: {n}An old man in a threadbare robe squints at you, fiddling with his matted beard.{/n} "What do you seek, soldier? Oh, I'm sorry — General, of course! So, what'll it be? Spells, magic? Secrets? Old Ignash can do anything, knows everything... I have wands and potions. I can tell you your fortune... It won't cost you much..." {n}You detect the sour stench of stale alcohol, as the old man mumbles.{/n}
abe4dc01-c856-4f06-abf3-357d629cedb2: "What does your spirit want? Potions? Wands? Perhaps a reading?" {n}You detect the sour stench of stale alcohol, as the old man mumbles.{/n}
61c5ca6d-0eb5-49ab-8ff6-1d51a79a1d17: "Go, go, wherever you want. But you can't get away from your fate, no no..." {n}As you leave, the old man keeps mumbling something incoherent.{/n}
818c5c5d-46fd-4333-809b-797811db42da: {n}With a visible effort, the old man focuses his eyes on you.{/n} "Me? Ignash the sorcerer. I worked for years, in rain and snow, ne'er a beer, and ne'er any dough! Then one sad day I got myself wasted, and suddenly the gift of magic I tasted. Now I wander, with fortunes to tell and spells to sell!"
0f768013-d28e-4591-b41c-1cd51d317be5: {n}The old man hides the money away, and takes out a handful of bizarre dice with different numbers of sides, and squiggly marks instead of numbers. He shakes the dice in his wrinkled, trembling hands, casts them, and studies the results for a long time, moving his lips in silence and quietly counting on his fingers.{/n}
4178cc29-faa1-48ec-b156-b8479621761e: "You will have happiness, and health, and a long life! Now you are a General, but someday you'll be a Marshal! But beware the number eleven, carrot juice, and the song of the chaffinch."
f8701927-6b47-4843-b941-d74f4b77514c: "Empyrean love awaits you! Happiness is passing close by. – Be careful not to miss it!"
58391a89-1819-4b55-81d6-b8be200ca743: "Beware, General. Death walks close behind you. Be vigilant, and do not turn your back upon the dead! If you hope to evade it, you must throw it off your trail. Make yourself a charm of horse's mane and a lizard's tail, and wear it about your neck at all times. But – if instead you wish to meet it on the battlefield, and defeat in a fair fight, then wrap a dog's skin around the handle of your sword!"
7818c700-6c68-40f3-a9b7-8ec8732d7fc4: "Remember, victory belongs to those whose desire for success is stronger than their fear of defeat! Drink at least four cups of water a day! Break big tasks into smaller steps! And eat more vegetables!"
1cee7e74-bc37-4ce3-be82-99dd381cf210: "You walk by secret paths, and will come to a crossing without roads. If you step forward, you will lose your way, if you turn back, you will be lost. But either way, the liar's voice will find you. If you listen, he will deceive you!"
27f17155-130b-4d66-82b8-58aa6ded12cf: "I saw her, yes I did... She picked my pockets clean... But it's all right. A pocket is not a belly. If they cut it, you can stitch it up and fill it again! But the things she stole won't be good for her. No, they won't. She's invited trouble upon herself, silly girl..."
637622d2-40b8-4c05-9fcf-c76ae7379f9a: "Here, look. Everything is real. Plenty of magic, but no tricks!"
198bd6b9-5973-4b03-a294-271a3fee866a: "This fog... it's here for a reason. I've seen much subterfuge, hearing cases at Kyonin's courts. I don't know how these dimwit bandits managed to do it, but they use the fog to hide their trails."
14ce06ae-bcf6-4dbd-9a88-902eddcae65c: "Maybe the fog has nothing to do with the bandits, and has a completely different origin?"
621c14f5-6368-46d3-90b8-ebe264dd960f: "No matter where it came from, we won't be able to leave these lands until it clears away."
ffd18e59-982a-4315-9592-1d33794f0647: "Hah. I doubt they could afford to hire a wizard capable of such magic."
f0028c76-ab03-4ff1-8a95-31f122478207: "I defeated Tartuk because he wouldn't live by my laws, but I let him go after he repented. If you swear to stop attacking humans, I'll do the same for you."
2f165311-77ac-44dd-af2c-eb61f3bb0871: "What are you doing here? What do you want?"
351603d2-9a9f-4160-9272-768405422a17: "I've destroyed your home, and I can kill you just as easily. Get out of my barony, and never return!"
a4cfc81f-a000-4ad7-9c03-80ac4a1bf1ea: [Attack] "Ah, more kobolds! And here I was worred we'd all but run out."
10563dec-e897-4836-a7f3-0f6768c3e47c: "I killed Tartuk because he wouldn't live by my laws. If you want to live, stop attacking humans, or you'll meet the same fate he did."
f8d68673-8919-46dd-a626-3193ce289609: {n}The kobolds remain silent, but some of them stir as if understanding — but also in fear, as if afraid to answer.{/n}
11cea3cf-b27f-4f27-bfe5-c8e1626879ff: {n}The kobolds show no reaction to your words. It's unclear whether they understood a single word you said.{/n}
4788e402-b341-43b1-8b64-04e3abc86d15: {n}The kobolds make no sound. They simply stand and look at you, following you with their unblinking eyes as though waiting for something. The kobolds step away when you try to leave, making no move to block your way, but their silent attention is somewhat uncomfortable.{/n}
093eba4c-50e5-40a5-a138-3f600003eb6f: {n}Octavia touches your hand to get your attention.{/n} "They're frightened! Remember, how they used to repeat all unknown words?" {n}She shivers.{/n} "Let's leave them be. They've suffered enough."
a6266e94-a02e-4200-bea1-a74e3a721b9f: {n}The crowd of kobolds parts before you and closes silently behind you as you pass. After several steps, you turn around and see that the kobolds are drifting apart, going separate ways.{/n}
68077b74-3766-4f57-ac3e-74bca70e357c: {n}The kobolds keep looking at you silently. Just when you think they may not answer, one speaks.{/n} "Kobold. Hearsss. Underssstandsss." {n}He then falls silent.{/n}
ce42de21-7271-4a33-b369-c3e24befa21e: {n}The kobolds stay silent. Quivering somewhat, they keep their eyes on you as you pass by.{/n}
08c1cb70-7df4-48d9-b922-141b98c6edbb: {n}A small crowd of kobolds surrounds you. They look frail and thin, their skin covered with sores and claw marks. Even the tattered skins they wear are falling apart.{/n}
eb156ddb-162e-439b-974f-62855e4749b3: "I am ready to pass the trial."
bebe7661-eb3b-499e-8a52-eed6bb707c5c: "I'm sick of your trials. Get out of my kingdom at once!"
3a835440-9b31-4bcc-abba-efac42949059: "Erastil, Pharasma, Shelyn, Cayden Cailean, Desna, Sarenrae."
1c32ed66-27da-4634-8371-258a783f3c3a: "The Ways of the Phoenix, Unicorn, Wolf and Lion."
7be21296-c8de-4fec-a5e1-cd0e6d7ee5b5: "The Ways of the Phoenix, Unicorn, Wolf, Lion, and Chameleon."
e7183b89-33ab-4a57-9009-28acb1c79b64: "The Ways of the Phoenix, Unicorn, Wolf, Lion and Dragon."
0aee096e-4821-4fcb-8b9e-8e5e0fa2da1d: "Where can I learn more about your order?"
a1c3c354-ab94-480f-8c94-747346ba52e9: "Hello, Your Highness. I am Vidya the Lion. Are you ready for your final trial?"
b5c14ade-246d-44d3-855c-b0def354708f: "Hello, Your Highness. Are you ready for your final trial?"
e05abba0-0217-4754-ad82-8a5dd8325d13: "I haven't always had that name. The teacher gave it to me, it means 'knowing the truth'. I follow the Lion's Way – it is the way of preaching. I came to understand the teachings of the Wise Way, and learned to declare them loud and clear – like a lion's roar."
49b5936d-88ee-450d-b6f3-1fb2352ed48f: "You are making a mistake. But so be it." {n}Vidya casts a spell and boundless peace and tranquility descend upon you. You watch Vidya leave, unable to even reach for your weapon.{/n}
3abf04bf-9fb9-4d44-8a47-af6a6480b7e5: "May the trial commence. Happy are those who have learned the truth!"
f9d7f000-3489-46cf-813b-2f11b4219ae2: "My trial is the trial of truth. I will ask you three questions about the Suramgamin Order, to test how much you've learned of us. If you are unsure in your knowledge, do not hasten to commence this trial. First try to learn more about us!"
35730714-b197-4f0e-bfdc-3f771401844c: "What does the name of our order mean?"
510d16bf-d7ab-49e8-a479-7ae2f0a85475: "What paths to achieving a master's title are there in our order?"
ab15ddf5-68f6-4e22-9ccf-faa703dc7547: "Where did teacher Avalo meditate as he learned the truth?"
5483f790-77f9-41f7-b605-30c302c4bdce: "What did teacher Avalo do when he learned the truth?"
62accc70-79f0-4397-b025-b567fc6e9241: "Where is the main temple of our order?"
8033d6f6-126f-44f5-8be0-7e025ee65527: "What is the name of a martial art that members of our order are taught?"
156a8e49-9529-4eca-b0cf-462c16d81c12: "What does it mean to go the Way of the Hero?"
ea1db5bd-ae1f-467a-bb1d-269d935d98fd: "Well, Your Highness, you have answered all the questions."
7db51d72-0a5b-4950-8748-7ee8f141c336: "In the same place you would go looking for knowledge about anything – in books! What I will ask you is no secret. I'm sure you can easily find books about us."
46606775-e3e0-4968-bf4c-27a74c59b03b: "You learned so much about our order. I am glad: knowledge is the first step to understanding, and understanding opens the path to enlightenment.'
ef5e8ac8-b684-4c1b-b5a5-2406b45a9d29: "Unfortunately you have learned far less about us than we've learned about you... But do not despair: a single trial does not tip the balance."
3e38ea76-101e-49c4-95ba-ddc1323d8bfe: "Correct. We offer our prayers to gods of good and order."
176d5d5b-c04d-44d2-b6b4-c3404a166576: "Close, but not exactly. {g|Cayden Cailean}Cayden Cailean{/g} and {g|Desna}Desna{/g} are kind gods, but their deeds are marred with chaos. Pharasma is indifferent to good or evil, and takes a different path from us. And you forgot to mention {g|Abadar}Abadar{/g} and Irori."
3c9062cf-e2e5-4701-a21d-073a164bca75: "What? {g|Asmodeus}Asmodeus{/g}? {g|Rovagug}Rovagug{/g}? Your Highness, who do you take us for? No one in our order venerates evil!"
d283c1d0-f69b-4238-9009-452d8db58aae: "Correct. That is exactly where he came from to these lands."
f37d263f-a262-4bed-8732-6f2c225b8585: "No, he meditated in Arthfell Forest while searching for the truth. Initially he hailed from {g|Jalmeray}Jalmeray{/g}."
24880704-1724-4b8b-a4bb-214b310b6bdf: "No, his homeland is much farther. He came from {g|Jalmeray}Jalmeray{/g}."
53c0b7a8-5d59-4a2e-b84e-3e59eb6a4236: "No, the Wise Way is a philosophy our order teaches. The name of the order means 'the way of the hero'."
0f306770-270a-4468-8b93-931716c0103a: "The exact translation might actually be impossible. But it's usually translated as 'the Way of the Hero'."
0bf2bc8e-c6fd-49d2-99d9-9dcd6af180b1: "Very true, but you forgot to mention the Way of the Chameleon. It's an easy mistake: the chameleon's way lies in shadow and silence, away from watchful eyes."
c2be8042-0d66-4c6f-93ac-7b41eabf9c93: "I see you are knowledgeable... Yes, Chameleon masters are not as noticeable, but are no less important than the others."
c551cc98-5bff-4025-b989-681642bcea66: "There is no Way of the Dragon in our order. But there is one you forgot – or perhaps didn't know – the Way of the Chameleon."
d9562672-6700-47b9-ab5d-59066e7c1ac4: "No, though he was born there. But to seek out the truth, he went to Arthfell Forest – where he still lives to this day."
a5d4761c-bea3-4c1a-a4aa-aef43b48308c: "Correct. He still lives there, surrounded by his disciples."
710665cd-722d-4cc4-9b4b-6eef6f0a70e6: "The {g|Narlmarches}Narlmarches{/g}? Oh no. He meditated in Arthfell Forest."
0bce56f5-0d93-4a14-a468-73b645b7b004: "Of course not. Teacher Avalo preaches non-violence – how could he set forth to fight? He organized debates about faith."
3fac5323-2ffb-46aa-867c-d107a9802693: "Correct. Many traveled there to prove his words wrong... only to become his followers."
af640cae-c452-4933-8ef9-b28b59acbee6: "Oh no. The revelations of teacher Avalo are recorded in many books, but never by he himself. He organized debates about faith with major religious leaders."
3f59d4d9-004a-44ca-b684-507f0f165358: "No. The teacher lives there, with a community of disciples – but our order has no temples."
c8114311-583f-4a2c-b2bc-fa56648e39e4: "No. Our order does not build temples."
666367ad-7b5a-4509-910e-cbb75d63afa7: "Correct. We don't build temples, and each of us is free to venerate the gods as they see fit. What's important is to follow the Wise Way."
98068eb5-1e5b-4ed6-9e0b-f4b25d976fc0: "Incorrect. The Wise Way is not a fighting style, but a dedication to complete non-violence. We do not teach any martial arts."
5fe608d2-11b3-42b0-b1ec-ee7c0d6418c1: "A fist cannot pacify, just as a sword cannot heal, nor the executioner's axe revive. Our core principle is non-violence. We do not teach any martial arts."
7b7f014f-47d5-4a3a-ae6a-75ce3d6a13a4: "Indeed. Our main principle is non-violence. We teach no martial arts."
d62529fd-09ca-4864-8b09-b301fa2c88a3: "He who kills villains only increases their number. No, we call a hero not the one who sheds blood, but the one who makes the world a better place."
a8fc7a41-43c1-47ce-a37f-f4e7b0a4f252: "What is power worth, if it's not applied to a good cause? No, we call a hero one who makes the world a better place."
1443fe7b-8b7c-497b-98dd-c436c08e5a5d: "Indeed. We call a hero any one, no matter how weak or strong, who brings even a small measure of good and order to this world."
5303cb75-54e5-44db-ab22-67a6660d6700: "With your permission I shall withdraw. I must to confer with my brothers and sisters. We shall assemble not far from here. Find us to hear our verdict."
cb1772ea-0a16-4d7d-9ecf-28a82992f76c: "Ah, so it all ended with a boring theology exam. Not surprising."
2402c408-a4d8-4ad5-80fa-dce825fc49da: "I think it'll be exciting! Everything's so symbolic — lions, unicorns... and the {mf|king|queen} wisely giving one correct answer after another!"
cdb8fec6-bfca-4927-a2e0-0aa8bb501693: "Jaethal, stop! You cannot do this to your daughter."
0bc8c0bd-24c5-4a1c-91ae-b6fedd4097bb: "Life is full of feeling and pleasure, which cannot be tasted by the undead. Take the body of your daughter, Jaethal, and be reunited with your desires."
e27d0bda-bc7f-477c-94e0-534333a3fc8d: "Un-life has provided you with new powers, and placed you above the laws of nature. Sacrifice your daughter, as Urgathoa wishes, but remain what you are."
700a667c-8b11-4ce1-b9d6-4155179cd9d0: "Do whatever you wish. I care not what you choose."
7f0d7cbe-8201-43ec-92ff-1fb072294404: [Attack Jaethal] "My patience is at an end! I can no longer tolerate your evil ways!"
0ff921ea-517e-4b31-88d1-37570a196dc3: "She's your daughter. Don't you have at least an echo of love for her?"
50690ff2-cceb-4ebd-b86f-f467762d6934: "You surely put much effort into raising your daughter. Were you proud of what she became, or am I wrong? Do you really want to sacrifice all this now?"
4c546ae4-d2d9-4f97-84cf-d3c9ea2b57b2: "This is what turned Nortellara against you in the first place. Break this chain of senseless violence before it's too late."
7283f0f5-53e0-4ae6-9b16-0b6d13fc5fb9: "Can't you see what has your life has become? Blood is spilled again and again, and every time there's more."
1fce4caa-0621-4b75-beb4-637aa439fa78: "Remember the girl at the camp near the Thorn River? She would rather die than become undead. You bear destruction and grief. Those are the 'gifts' you offer. It's what Urgathoa gave to you."
383c781f-e2b1-4645-9530-dfe0e3d2373d: "Remember the story of Taneka? You can blame Enneo for what happened to her, but in truth it was her faith in Urgathoa that condemned her, and offered her no comfort in her time of need."
9afc53f7-427e-433e-b717-55eab21332bf: "Urgathoa awakened your worst side, Jaethal. But I have seen another side of you — purposeful, stubbornly seeking answers, respectfully speaking of Enneo's dedication, despite the fact that he was your enemy."
8ea594d7-ba99-4e15-b58a-1776f290f6cf: [Attack Jaethal] "If so, I have no other choice but to stop you by force."
f8c0b737-0f25-4e89-9b58-d7bbc84a6848: "Taneka's ritual? What will happen if you use it?"
4cbcb028-d694-4aaa-bbea-a848bf9bc0ba: {n}Jaethal approaches the fallen Nortellara and freezes like a statue. The scene from the elven camp at the {g|Thorn River}Thorn River{/g} repeats itself once again, but now instead of some unknown elven girl, her own daughter lies at the inquisitor's feet, and she seems still alive.{/n}
458324b0-4e5e-492c-b840-80eac159ac73: "I... hear you." {n}Jaethal speaks under her breath, and you realize that she is talking neither to her daughter, nor to you, nor anyone else. For a moment you are filled with the strange sensation of someone else's presence — someone evil but somehow jubilant — and then the feeling fades. Jaethal's eyes grow clear.{/n} "Yes, mistress. I am ready."
c8d63eee-e027-4585-be4b-1835f25518cc: {n}Jaethal turns to you. The dark eyes of the undead creature glow like a night sky pierced by lightning.{/n} "{g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa{/g} has declared her will. The goddess demands a sacrifice of me, and she is prepared to grant me her blessing in return. I will become Herald of her will, her perfect follower, the impeccable undead. But she requires blood. Blood — and the life of my daughter, taken here and now."
b0b6140a-bf98-4ca1-989c-ba58f01084c3: "Don't let her do it, {name}. Killing her own daughter or taking her body — this is true, genuine evil. There can be no way back. Neither for Jaethal nor for any of us."
ca276608-9cff-4556-ade0-da20af95f37d: "The girl's got herself into trouble, and she deserves a beating for it. Both of them, in fact — mother and daughter."
7eb7984a-491f-44ba-a2bb-09cd7846637b: "Here's my expert opinion: the situation looks quite bad, and you must decide carefully here. Interfering in the affairs of the gods might be a bad idea."
69e58f05-735e-420e-b1fb-28bf78abe414: {n}Nortellara struggles to open her mouth.{/n}"So, you wish to feed me to your ravenous goddess? It's just what I'd imagine she would want!"
7eb93cf3-4fd6-4e6f-9b9f-9ce8600a1989: {n}Jaethal turns to you. Her eyes are glowing with a cold flame.{/n} "{g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa{/g} wants me to choose one of the two paths of faith. I can use Taneka's ritual to regain a living body, with all the pleasures that it offers. The children I can then bear will be the source of my immortality. I will become an eternal spirit, changing temporary vessels, and even the ages-long lifespan of the elves will be to me as a season."
e23613e0-5f14-4ea7-96f6-47db15258af1: "There is another way. I will remain undead, eternal, unchanging and impeccable. In exchange for my final sacrifice, {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa{/g} will grant me new power. A perfect spirit, or perfect undead. Either way, I shall be her perfect follower. All that my goddess requires of me is the life of my daughter — here and now."
50191765-a0ce-4531-a8da-6f4edb1a8601: {n}Jaethal's eyes look stern and motionless.{/n} "Do you understand what you ask? I cannot resist {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa's{/g} will, even if I had good reason to do so. The gods do not forgive disobedience. I have served you well, but now I must have what I so desperately need."
0da5efa3-ca4f-44fe-bbea-4053698e93f3: "Have I ever given you any reason to believe that stupid sentimentality means something to me?"
03db623d-1972-4ee9-842f-3c7ed9e77029: {n}A barely-noticeable shadow of doubt runs through the depths of Jaethal's dark eyes.{/n} "I... I will regret it. Perhaps I will even feel sad — once or twice a year. But I will not turn back. I cannot turn back."
c26a10b3-a2d3-41d1-9578-68617668db88: "Do you suggest I sacrifice myself for the sake of what is 'good' and 'just'? I cast these sentiments from my mind, together with {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g} and my service to their court."
fdd0ae32-f90e-4c94-9144-07011f3a5246: "Again, my good-hearted patron, stepping in to denounce me! But I give you credit — at least you are consistent. I can respect that."
0b6bf7ea-90a1-4ac2-bf86-aa68e6fc0959: "I don't recall you condemning me earlier, and you knew all about the murders I committed in {g|Kyonin}Kyonin{/g}."
6caf6bf7-2dd5-4bae-8016-b50f14263c25: "I didn't want to torture her, only to {d|Jaethal Kill Elf}preserve{/d} her youth and beauty for eternity!" {n}Jaethal takes a long look at her daughter, as if comparing the two girls, and recalling the fate of the first.{/n}
a9376940-a21c-4cc6-bd5b-a238756c4a07: "But wasn't it you, {name}, who convinced me to {d|Jaethal Keep Elf}keep{/d} the girl as undead, against her will? It didn't seem at the time that my actions were so destructive."
f178dba3-8256-4be8-bbc9-4c34ee38c752: "She {d|Jaethal Taneka Dead}was{/d} foolish, weak — unworthy of {g|Urgathoa}Urgathoa's{/g} gifts. With me it will be different. I shall live as I wish. I won't run from my enemies like a rat." {n}Jaethal's face remains motionless, and yet it seems that the memory of Taneka's terrible fate stirs in her some unspoken feeling.{/n}

ef4c2ad0-799e-4076-8555-59dc6616e3ca: "You speak the truth. Sometimes I feel that senselessly drifting in a sea of pleasure would never be enough, even if I got everything I could possibly want. But refusing the goddess means suffering her wrath."

12ee2f6b-d355-47d2-886c-3f4fbab6f573: {n}The corners of Tristian's mouth turn up in what might be a smile.{/n} "I should have noticed it earlier. Is it not marvelous how love can flourish between anyone?"
474b2a34-2855-4de7-95e8-e19799698446: {n}Eimar grins eagerly.{/n} "Then it's settled! I'll write down the directions real quick, and when you're done, you meet me in {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g} so I can hear your account. 0b7062ae-0246-4189-95d0-96a6d464dd11: "Now that's more like it! Let's go crash those pirates! And we'd better not waste time here. I don't like {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, or its people — everyone's always trying to cheat you, or swindle you, or drag you into some other cunning scumbaggery."
920f9efd-3a22-4bc9-a4e1-07d33eb12e38: {n}Eimar sidles closer, lowering his voice.{/n} "And that's where Irovetti has failed. The {g|Pitax River}Pitax River{/g} is our lifeline, connecting us to the outside world. River pirates know it, and they prey upon incoming travelers. This tournament? It hides how we suffer from the king's inaction."
efc7c015-25b0-4f6f-958c-5ff295ad351a: "He barely opened his mouth before he made my teeth itch, with all his treacle and nonsense!"
588e8ec8-45e1-45f3-9c8d-3b218c9ee7ff: [Leave the hunters] "Ha, good luck up there! See you around. Maybe."
d7e0fe47-7fb4-424a-ad87-cce84340b50c: "How many of you are there? Is anyone wounded?"
c2b12a54-e6a1-4a62-bad6-8ee8cf92284b: [Throw a rope to the hunter] "Hold on! I'll help! You're going to be all right."
2e9f83d4-cf7f-4b19-baba-63d8123bcc17: [Try to catch the hunters using a stretched-out cloak] "Jump! We'll catch you!"
df84a903-dc81-4fb6-bc20-30f415182033: "Sure, we can help you down — if you pay in advance."
8e248fbb-2e96-43df-b6df-fec8666d2e26: "How much is my help worth to you?"
9af42c26-c65f-4f48-a1cd-11b370a367c5: [Try to catch the hunters using a stretched-out cloak] "We'll try to catch you, but please, be careful!"
4afebb5a-f7cd-4f49-9573-8aea0ecfe008: {n}Digging through his pockets, the hunter pulls out a small purse.{/n} "Take this too, as promised. I'd give you more, but it's all I have!"
c219f3aa-4285-419a-a931-10ee0246ed6d: {n}Digging through his pockets, the hunter pulls out a small purse.{/n} "Take this too. Linnel and me owe you our lives, after all."
35a30f9f-d0b8-4006-b889-0e5a75b8eadb: {n}The hunter hands you a gilded metal cog.{/n} "Here, as a reward for your efforts. I found it on the corpse up there. It looks valuable."
c7d4205e-70b3-4bec-a7e4-320ce523065b: {n}Jubilost looks back toward the camp you spent the night in. He opens his mouth as if to speak, but he instead bends over and bursts into wild, knee-slapping laughter. After eventually regaining control of himself, he wipes his eyes dry and gives you a silent thumbs-up.{/n}
7552c6e0-5b15-4e51-bd86-4e9e5e277f61: "We're just two. I'm mostly good, thank {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}. Linnel here, though, she came down pretty hard. She's got some broken ribs, can hardly breathe. As for Duldin... I think he's dead. I can only see his feet sticking out of the rock. There's some dwarf corpse up here, too — guess he got here the same way we did."
e8db24bd-7328-46e2-9df2-2adac92637f2: "No clue! We were heading off to sleep when a dream came over us — a bright one, too! All three of us were in a river, and the current was sweeping us away! The trees on shore were too high — up to the sky, I tell ya! And the clouds above were like mountains! We went over a waterfall and hurtled down... Next I knew, we were up here on this rock, wet like drowned rats. I've never seen anything like it! And I hope I never have to again."
827d44fa-50de-42d3-b6c1-a4b628db286f: "I found this funny thing on a corpse up here... It looks valuable. You save us, it's yours."
5f8de8a6-6dd1-481b-88c5-ab6b08534169: {n}The hunter digs in his pocket and pulls out an odd object — a gilded metal cog. He holds it up to give you a good view, then tosses it down to you.{/n} "There! Now, help us down, for gods' sake!"
4114d629-acc9-468e-9c42-f08e512f2fde: {n}The hunter reaches out, pleading.{/n} "All we have is yours! Just get us down from here!"
9aa9f411-d574-40e3-94a2-e64c37ed59d3: {n}You hear a voice from somewhere above you.{/n} "You there! Help us!" {n}A man wearing simple clothes waves to you from the top of the massive rock.{/n} "Hunters, we are! We were camping in the woods, then suddenly we were up here! Some weird magics or something, I guess. For gods' sake, help us!"
560c5f72-1ef2-4ecc-b80c-9bfab2f15c7d: {n}You throw the rope up. The hunter fixes it to the rock, then slowly lowers his wounded friend before climbing down himself.{/n}
cd78d917-3faf-4b27-880d-5f5884edc32e: {n}You manage to get a cloak stretched taut to try and catch the hunters. The man above pushes his wounded friend down first, then jumps himself. You catch them both without any trouble.{/n}
b546e74c-9bdc-4a8a-a61d-a05b2c9e16f5: {n}You manage to get a cloak stretched taut to try and catch the hunters. The man above pushes his wounded friend down first, but you fail to catch her. The impact kills her immediately. You manage to catch the man when he jumps down, and he looks at you reproachfully.{/n} "She... she's dead, isn't she? How could you let this happen? What... what am I to do now?"
59042584-9217-458b-b501-b7d4f9cb34a4: "Wait, you can't! We had a deal!" {n}Ignoring their frantic cries, you walk back into the woods. A moment later, you hear a scream behind you, followed by a wet thud. It sounds like the unlucky hunter grew desperate enough to try getting down on his own.{/n}
57b12ec1-e909-4ec3-80c4-d60ebca7c4b6: {n}Harrim closes his eyes as if trying to hold on to the hunter's death cry.{/n} "How did I miss it before...?" {n}he whispers.{/n} "Death cries are music, too... So beautiful..."
ebc663ff-5edb-4985-aae9-a20a6e950f0f: {n}Octavia glares at you.{/n} "That was mean and undignified... Your Grace!"
84a50263-0695-49f1-833a-e726ebd3ddbf: "Wait, don't leave! Save us!" {n}Ignoring their frantic cries, you walk back into the woods. A moment later, you hear a scream behind you, followed by a wet thud. It sounds like the unlucky hunter grew desperate enough to try getting down on his own.{/n}
38546661-2792-4b58-9f60-7315af17bb0c: "Thank you for saving my life. You were paid in advance, so all's proper and honest now."
4ccb3eb4-04ae-4ee4-9642-3b70c56e8446: {n}Harrim gives a deep sigh.{/n} "What a shame... He was just one step away from his death... Such a rare chance for a most beautiful end — wasted!" {n}He shakes his head in frustration.{/n}
d0574573-94b4-4602-ac71-76bc6cea5139: {n}The hunter hands you a gilded metal cog.{/n} "My word's good as gold — here's what I promised. Thank you for your help!"
a839bbec-722d-48c1-8d88-3a2e37c2a7b5: "What?! For the sake of {g|Desna}Desna{/g}, this sounds... No-no-no, no way that can be true. He must have drunken too much and seen a bad dream!"
a90abdc2-a577-40d6-b166-6fb325191f42: "Ha! Losers! And you're a sharp one! It's only fitting we rob the likes of them!" {n}The half-orc roars with laughter as he makes an obscene gesture toward the stone.{/n}
362c5f71-1496-4631-af8c-f9c172847629: [Utters a muffled cough and spits aside]
07681ace-6fd9-48a3-9469-337c08994bd6: [Wipes the sweat from his pale forehead]
fc7b0ec3-c125-4299-9066-474bad8b5c97: "Stop pretending you're fine! You need help!"
68f68d51-f39d-4705-b05b-9afba660866b: "You have proven you can endure pain without complaint. Now be kind enough to consider healing."
f53d376d-eee7-49f8-9bb9-0072b4d8ba6f: "You see now what serving Torag has brought you to? Forget him, he's not a god worthy of worship!"
b44da1ae-3d2a-44f9-b4d5-1ef85b8da833: "If you won't let yourself be healed, that's your choice, I suppose. But think about poor wolfy! He will worry about you — he'll whine and grow restless. This kind of trouble is definitely no good for him!"
8065be8e-7adb-4f1a-8062-fc5adbe221a9: "You are like an ancient rock: indestructible on the surface, but inside there are caves and chasms. Know this: there is no shame in opening your heart to friends."
916e67af-c6ad-4ce4-b73e-b400f5d46873: "It's so dark in here... This place gives me creeps! "
8da772dc-13d2-4b0e-aaec-521244e76f14: "I feel uncomfortable… I'm not sure we're safe here. "
bbe9b168-a548-42b6-9cb9-521954756f21: "It's beautiful, isn't it? It is in places like this that the frailty of faltering life grows clear!"
2fca5e33-2c32-422b-aaae-b7c7b1a74077: "Pull yourself together! Monsters can smell your fear. If you whine and moan, they'll eat you first!"
254d8d9a-dc24-4eef-91cc-2c8b0d4dca82: "I too feel disquieted. But together we're strong enough to stand against any danger."
14573a00-2b9d-4f6c-b477-3e86d98aeb4b: "Don't be a chicken. I'll be right here."
d1c841ad-f826-44ec-9d74-e598c8b1040f: "Who are all those people on the bridge?"
f7aa8aa0-1854-42b0-9167-9144e0be481e: "I found the berries you were talking about."
60739608-9803-43b2-9578-93f49c9dc4e7: "I found your berries. You lied. These aren't medicine — they're poison."
aebd2f8e-a5aa-4d37-a0e9-e0796f513209: [Give him the berries] "If that's really what you want..."
d69c5c15-b61e-48cd-af34-34f48be86479: "My goal was to help you, not kill you. You'll have to find some other way to end your life if that's what you want."
d3914d4e-3d10-4fd0-87ff-7b4a491be573: "Find Jhod Kavken in town. He can identify your illness and give you the help you need."
8b6b96b7-1c8b-4d02-af1d-6db36049344c: "Why are you so sure you have the same illness?"
8ced6179-2613-475a-8cd9-f15ff3530001: [Attack] "First you fool me, and now you dare beg me for yet more help? Perhaps you've found your death after all!"
8c955a1b-3db0-4667-a66e-6fcda6d5b13d: [Attack] "I am the {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}. And you're about to learn how I deal with any rabble who would dare vilify me!"
81e5e2df-dc0e-4e84-829b-f03222d29ed4: "You shouldn't speak of the {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen} that way."
f31cc41f-2363-4907-8037-19ca23cdb2ef: {n}The old man who called to you looks to be in bad shape: pale face, dark circles under his eyes, and his forehead glistening with sweat. There's no doubt this man is very sick.{/n}
b7bdad8a-cae1-4aee-bf51-735a2e6a8e57: "Hey... hey, {mf|lad|lass}! Would you-" {n}The old man breaks into a coughing fit.{/n} "Would you do an old man a favor in his hour of need? I've traveled far, but I somehow fell ill along the way. I know of a berry that grows along the coast in these parts, though — it's supposed to be a potent medicine. It will-" {n}The old man coughs again.{/n} "It'll put anyone back on their feet!"
0daf2d7f-0e2e-4928-8edc-6b3388eb129f: "They're black — hard to miss..." {n}The old man bursts into more coughing for a few moments.{/n} "Black with a hint of purple. The bush is short. You've strong legs and sharp eyes. Honor-" {n}The old man coughs again but quickly controls it.{/n} "Honor an old man's wish — bring me a handful of those berries."
de196bc8-8def-4124-939d-8f04ede6bc4a: {n}The old man looks at you, hope in his purblind eyes.{/n}
169b954f-e4ea-4109-9db4-5781d6f6b9c1: "The outskirts of the {g|Narlmarches}Narlmarches{/g}. Used to live there with my son and his wife. But when this scourge started to spread through the {mf|barony|barony|kingdom|kingdom} and a few people in our village started falling ill, we knew it was time to run. Hated to abandon the house, but what could we do? My son's little ones-" {n}The old man lets out a few wet coughs.{/n} "We couldn't just let the little ones perish in that cursed place..."
f2bcd6c1-109c-479b-98b5-fd447cafa8f7: "Refugees, running from an illness that causes horrible beasts to burst out of people's bodies. The rulers couldn't care less for the simple folk," {n}the old man says, cringing slightly,{/n} "so people run as far as they can. The {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen} can stay in {mf|his|her} cursed land all {mf|he|she} wants, but we want to be safe."
200bce03-1b8b-449b-a7a1-6d5303e16445: {n}The old man shifts his gaze down.{/n} "Please don't be angry... Look, I'm sick like all the others. I've seen the monsters come out of people — I'd rather take my own life than wait for such a terrible end!"
df28b31d-57a3-44e6-be3d-3beeb9bee684: {n}The old man carefully examines the berries, then nods fervently.{/n} "Yes... Yes, these are the right ones. Thank you, {mf|lad|lass}." {n}He crams the black berries into his mouth and chews vigorously.{/n}
09072f8c-c8c8-4bca-8304-35fec272d80a: {n}A weak smile flickers across the old man's timeworn face.{/n} "And so it begins..." {n}He turns his gaze to you, his eyes going glassy.{/n} "I'm sorry, my friend, but I tricked you. I don't-" {n}The old man coughs, but it's less powerful than before.{/n} "I don't want to die to this damn sickness, let some disgusting beast crawl from my body... It's... better this way..."
7d8f6a15-1353-476f-811c-b2a264c5d0df: "I'm... not sure. And who's to say? But waiting to see whether some horrible creature hatches out of me... I'd rather die by my own hand!"
e0b5f7bb-5e8b-4c94-bd5e-9ce84cafb3fb: {n}The old man carefully examines the berries, then nods fervently.{/n} "Yes... just what I needed..." {n}He raises his tearful eyes to you.{/n} "Thank you, my friend. You've saved my soul... {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} bless you." {n}He crams the black berries into his mouth and chews vigorously.{/n}
adf54ffc-8caf-4516-99e8-a5d9ce686e54: {n}The old man's eyes swell with tears.{/n} "I beg of you, give me the berries! Let me decide my own fate!"
17633895-b78f-40b1-9ac5-3162cc732fcd: {n}The old man's eyes light up.{/n} "Someone... someone could help me?" {n}A weak smile crosses his wrinkled face.{/n} "There's still hope? Oh, {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} protect this {mf|man|woman}! Thank you! Thank you! I'm leaving right now — I won't let this sickness stop me. As long as my legs will carry me, I'll make it there!"
b6838fca-98e5-4eb4-8f49-5c14c9129510: "I left too — they're my family, after all..." {n}The old man coughs a few times.{/n} "But I'm not as strong as I once was. I started lagging behind, holding them back. So I said, 'Listen, son, save your wife and kids. I'll make it there on my own.'" {n}He coughs again, then goes silent for a moment.{/n} "We agreed to meet up in Drember village..." {n}He trails off as his eyes grow watery.{/n}
3d6607d8-cac9-42ed-b3c5-b05601debe7f: {n}The old man tries to say something else, but his lips are sluggishl, his voice silent. Berry-tinted foam drips from his mouth as his eyes roll up and he slowly sags to the ground.{/n}
7ffa2c3f-b276-466e-bb74-992f639ecfe3: "I beg you, {mf|lad|lass} — give me the berries. This is no sin upon your soul. I'd have killed myself anyway — you only helped an old man ease his suffering!"
ac3cb394-a12e-4f6e-9169-1ddabe3b45a3: {n}The old man waves his hand dismissively.{/n} "I'm old. I've little concern for them high lords... I just hope I don't die and none of my kin get sick!"
8e674e9f-ad8d-4b10-8c3c-29d11510eba6: "Dawnflower, don't turn your gaze from me! I need your power to help those who suffer."
a9bc4d1e-1f96-417d-904a-d17bbd32bbd9: "The fire of my prayers has fallen to embers. I address my plea to you, Dawnflower — grant me the strength to serve you."
ece812e5-eba5-44e7-8f18-2cd0f22eb270: "I like to listen when you pray. A pure voice, and a pure soul."
97cb15a3-da34-43a6-b8d7-18cb05d40202: "You wasted all your prayers again? Good. Now you'll need to learn how to use weapons properly."
09144645-727c-43e8-a113-d395a17a8c35: "All your prayers are always about serving, and helping others. This… brings to my mind many things. I think upon those things that separate sincerity and vanity."
ed80ccac-a5f8-4499-b574-ed86a71b0980: "Oh goddess, give me your strength... Because I have none of my own, ha, ha, ha!"
da236df0-961c-4f08-962a-c02ed5e533b8: "And why couldn't you just sit in Absalom? You'd eat grouse from a silver platter, drink expensive wine and keep writing your little books. Why did you have to travel all the way to the Stolen Lands?"
80450d22-4c7d-4774-8137-a83cdf936437: "You see, to afford grouse and wine, a writer must be successful. And to achieve success, one needs to experience what one writes about!"
b93f4058-0d3a-4ae0-9ad2-6c7840f60d24: "I heard that in a far away tribe people entertain themselves by throwing huge logs. Whoever throws it the farthest is the strongest."
4ffba10e-306e-4e5b-ba39-42755ba1f0bf: "Throwing logs? Ha! What weaklings. The Mammoth Lords lift mammoths! I used to lift two at once!"
7e7e0331-6871-4ed0-89bf-a7fb88b7260b: "You smile rarely, Valerie. What troubles you?"
0ec69052-376a-480b-a9c2-04c48cdd2c11: "Nothing. I'll laugh when there is something to laugh about. Right now I'm busy thinking about how we're going to survive these wild lands."
a6f59688-962c-4c82-82be-caa15dcc9f82: {n}The ponies are soothed by your voice, but as soon as you try to touch them, they shy away.{/n}
ab0a9a30-c935-4824-935b-360b36fd22ed: {n}The ponies are soothed by your voice, but as soon as you try to touch them, they shy away.{/n}
0fd635fe-0554-4610-9745-a88f1d328d50: {n}Soothed by your voice, the ponies let you touch them and stroke their manes.{/n}
114f2b6c-dcd3-4b0e-80c6-6c169e6ec426: "Hey, these are my ponies! Stupid animals, why did you flee the camp?" {n}The gnome glares at the ponies, who seem unperturbed.{/n} "On the other hand, if you were smart, I suppose you'd want me to pay for your services. I guess it's in all our best interests that you stay stupid."
5698f26f-d613-42d4-9fa6-d39aa606d00b: {n}Soothed by your voice, the ponies let you touch them and stroke their manes. You decide to lead them to the river to help drag the gnome's cart out.{/n}
97887102-e67d-4f24-8c95-c251935473ce: {n}Soothed by your voice, the ponies let you touch them and stroke their manes. You decide to lead them to the river to help drag the gnome's cart out.{/n}
0472fe2e-06f4-40b8-b426-e97b70c0d05c: {n}A pair of scared ponies stands before you. They don't run away, but they snort loudly and neigh as you approach. These are most likely the spare pair of ponies the gnome expedition used to pull their cart. When the kobolds attacked, they weren't tied to the cart, so they just pulled themselves free and fled into the forest.{/n}
2555d4a3-59d1-4019-932e-1862783844cc: {n}Oleg is breathing heavily, but he shakes his fist in the air menacingly.{/n} "You rats got what you deserved! Now they'll know better than to treat honest people like cattle!"
41acf79c-db3d-4334-b6eb-09e0bdff0a70: "And our Bokken here taught them {d|c11 Bokken Fight}a thing or two{/d} as well!"
cd434692-1ff3-4d77-b823-6f1be086fff2: "{d|c11 Bokken Dead}Sorry{/d} about Bokken... He was a fierce old man, but I guess not fierce enough. How will I tell Svetlana? She'll probably cry. How tragic..."
ff15197b-84af-4756-9a2f-6ca26351e40c: "Now, my {mf|lord|lady}, head on up to the guest rooms on the second floor. You deserve some rest after such a battle. I need to... clean things up."
f0fc11f9-4a02-4b75-97c0-b0373cd3136c: "And this is for your efforts. Now, don't offend me by trying to turn it down — just take it. An honest fight deserves an honest reward. If that were more common practice in this world, I think life would be so much better..."
8878dd08-952c-4c3b-9e36-abf09179e1c8: "We should call Bokken out before he freezes in those bushes."
e85275f5-98c2-4ce6-aa7d-f8045e285c83: "Ekun, why is your wolf staring at me? I'm not a chunk of meat!"
1c54b067-ae69-4741-8670-b55fd15a2505: "He likes you. You have lot in common."
567d4d45-122e-4d80-bee4-47dba3dcb3ef: "I didn't expect to see you again. What brought you here?"
8c0100be-5213-486d-80bd-5fc8b008a640: "You're still a werewolf... How do you live with it?"
debc5afe-d074-4dab-b1c3-4e2889f05b7f: [Attack] "Sorry, but you're still a danger. You have to die."
c2fc7190-e8cd-4ca9-8fc6-0df8939e141e: "Thank you for your help. Farewell. Maybe we'll meet again sometime."
b7d3e264-64c7-4381-b14a-23843d0e5f1b: "Hello again, {name}!" {n}Ivar, human once more, catches his breath.{/n} "I can't say your appearance was unexpected, but it was certainly impressive."
9c090d6a-23f0-406c-9fb9-bf5476365b7a: "That's a long story. After we parted ways at {g|Silverstep}Lake Silverstep{/g}, I went seeking a way to control my curse — both my curses, really. My drivel could also be considered a curse of sorts, or maybe a just dangerous gift... Well, I failed to oust the beast from inside me, but I thought I could try to at least do something of use with my tales. So I enrolled in {g|Pitax}Pitax's{/g} {g|Academy of Grand Arts}Academy of Grand Arts{/g}. I thought it would be a suitable place to learn to control my words."
a1e29be8-a063-4f99-bb0e-ac48c4fb928c: "And it was, to an extent. But I also saw how words could be weapons. My family was killed due to my stupidity and a deadly accident," {n}Ivar says bitterly.{/n} "The bards in {g|Pitax}Pitax{/g}, and especially here in {g|Littletown}Littletown{/g}, are learning to direct those skills toward murder and manipulation. And I'm afraid they really seem to know what they're doing."
0205cc92-3edc-42e0-a69c-c8f8c9ce33b0: "All kinds of sordid things." {n}Ivar frowns.{/n} "At first, they wouldn't tell us where we were being sent. But once we were there, things began in earnest — there were lectures, general meetings, we wrote pamphlets and songs... Whether the topic was love or war didn't matter, so long as at least one of the lines was used to smear you, {name}. I quickly realized what was going on, but I decided to stay anyway. 0bd6c06a-993a-4d28-92dc-266fb400f49b: "The priests I consulted about lifting the curse couldn't help me. Maybe it was because I... because I'm not ready to forgive myself. Not yet. cfdfd6fa-a4f8-482f-b39a-3c9dc4296688: {n}You open the book and see... Octavia. Her eyes are glowing brightly with courage and compassion for those in trouble. Her smile is full of life and joy. Have you ever seen anything more beautiful?{/n}
a0a23248-ea46-44bf-be4b-a12f103073b2: "It's a pity you don't like to read... I have no one here to talk to!"
862e4cf3-d815-4eb1-9958-abded3451a19: "Although the mistress stopped reading books from the top shelves long ago, and many of them were scattered around the house. I barely saved my favorite book — about Beauty." {n}The mephit narrows his eyes with a serene look.{/n} "Vast waves roll under the blue sky! The waterfall is falling, deep into the rainbow! Would you like to read it?" {n}He carefully fishes out a little book from the pieces of the clock. It doesn't look harmed by water at all. The mephit opens it for you to see, but he's not letting go of it.{/n}
bf064043-48e5-4eef-aef3-66e9fbcf3050: "There is nothing written here! It's pure magic, causing the 'reader' to have this or that emotion. It's primitive. Tasteless! Pointless, devoid of even the shadow of the author's hand! It's the poorest representation of the idea of 'book' that I've ever seen!"
0f6d78e8-9cc1-46cc-9662-eb144f3a184c: {n}The goblin tries to peak in the book and winces, as if splashed with boiling water.{/n} "Books! Disgusting magic books! Why it shows me these pictures? Why we not burn this li-ba-ry? We kill water beastie and burn everything!"
20937f0b-c670-45da-b87c-579f25617633: "I like this. I see moonlit meadows, beautiful young boys and girls... I wonder if these books will work outside {g|First World}the First World{/g}? I'd take an edition or two of Beauty with me. And a thick volume of Patience. — Especially if there's one entitled 'Patience for Those Surrounded by Weaklings, Fools, and Wimps'."
fa570f8a-a1e5-441a-b61d-7837dfdd06e1: {n}You open the book and see... Regongar. Looking at him is like watching a living flame, one that is strong, fierce and rebellious.{/n}
97a99b62-4aa2-4d77-ae6e-ed152d1072ef: {n}You open the book and see... Valerie... Courage and loyalty, steadfast, and willing to face her fate — all of this reflected in her eyes.{/n}
85de5b02-0435-45c9-b154-5132e35ad3c1: {n}You open the book and see... Tristian. He seems woven of sunlight — the light of kindness and selflessness, coming from his soul.{/n}
50c30875-00bf-4eb7-af26-bb6fb4bcd03a: {n}You open the book and see... Nyrissa. Is that her? The nymph's beautiful face is not disfigured by cruelty and despair — instead joy and endless fascination glow upon it. All the madness of the blooming lands, and the changeability of {g|First World}the First World{/g} are embodied in the nymph's appearance. This is probably what she was like before the curse.{/n}
96384234-d6af-40d4-8781-745e403b53e2: {n}You open the book. A series of vague images flash before you: clouds flowing across the sky, the faces of those you care about or desire, incredible scenes from {g|First World}the First World{/g}, and others from your homeland, more familiar but no less charming.{/n}
e07d8a40-a9ce-4b4f-84fa-79933844fca4: {n}You open the book and see... Regongar and Octavia. Day and night, the gleaming whiteness of snow and the surface of boiling lava. There is incredible beauty in the contrast, the synergy of opposites.{/n}
634c63fa-c8f5-4297-b585-d31f8efca1ca: "Do you see? Beautiful, beautiful waves! And such a white waterfall!" {n}Says mephit in awe.{/n}
582d8890-13cb-45bb-9106-0cc160db6fb2: {n}You feel the presence of a powerful spell targeting the mephit. It's obvious that the spell's creator is not the creature itself, but someone much more powerful. It's hard to identify the spell's school of magic or its purpose. You can assume that right now it only provides passive effects, but it could be activated by some trigger or command.{/n}
37e8823d-4b13-4083-bb5f-26ab4a7e6985: "Now that's strange. I can't see a thing. Wait... There's the glitter of gems... And the bodies of lovers entwined in a passionate embrace... Ah, now it's gone again."
1e587424-f112-4c42-b9b3-8f7c0354ee85: "Still rings in my ears from Reg-Reg's zaps. Mighty stuff! Want some!"
047113bd-41f7-4330-be84-86668de73583: "Ugh no. You impose enough risk on all of us already. Would you have lightnings, I wouldn't be able to sleep at all!"
862c01b2-e5b0-4b62-9dbe-92f97b6185a8: "Clear the road and let these people pass!"
c761164b-db02-4dab-bc62-9545cb6322bb: "Not a bad set-up you got here. How about you work for me?"
e900e36d-fac2-4824-b8c0-3aa938094d55: [Attack] "You should have run while you could."
3cb6ca7e-2110-475e-a63b-5615d984481e: "I am the {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen} of this realm, and I didn't order anyone to guard this bridge."
0963018e-3dc6-44d6-9677-72b2e621f99b: "The Stag Lord? The Stag Lord is dead. What is this nonsense?"
e1db1c1e-242d-41f1-9ab7-35dcb2dfe216: "Who gave you the right to extort passers-by?"
adeb5ebc-79ed-4807-8ff6-7fc7ac08f8e2: "What are these monsters you're talking about?"
cfda97e4-ee77-4b32-a315-49c72e94f2f1: [Attack] "I've had enough of brigands in my lands!"
56dea9d8-6667-4709-9d9a-a589289cdea7: {n}The cutthroat in front of you is well-armed, as are the other warriors behind him. He turns to face you.{/n} "Hey, get in line! Watch where ye're goin'..." {n}The man trails off as he sees your face — he recognizes you.{/n}
4ad89787-1077-4556-a169-a0e1e39be3b1: "By the Gods! The {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}! What the... what brings you here?" {n}The man glances at his companions, who look equally uncertain what to do, and turns red.{/n} "Eh, well, err... of course you can pass, Yer {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}!'
e003a6cc-887a-4e76-95c3-0a686ae5616b: "Well, now, we... we're guarding the bridge, {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}! From monsters and others. On the Stag Lord's orders."
3718bc54-cb46-44a0-ae90-8ad8953690a4: {n}The bandit swallows.{/n} "It's ahhhh... like... an order's an order! We're the Stag Lord's people. He says — guard the bridge, we guard the bridge!"
c4b3a2a0-dbd6-45b2-b2ee-4559749d3fe7: "Gotta peel yer eyes, Yer {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! Alive, he is! See for yourself — there he is, keeping watch over us himself!"
9dc6fae7-e3dc-4483-ab1d-638ec54828e5: "We have to eat, as much as anyone else — hunger will take us if we've no coin."
7dfcec28-3485-41ac-8d88-40e531033773: "Why, eh... {mf|baron|baroness|king|queen}... all kinds, all kinds! Not long ago, a hydra popped up on the other side o' the river. Right, men?" {n}The warriors nod.{/n} "A fat, long-fanged bastard, too! Now, Your {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness} — what happens if that thing gets it into its head to feast on folk crossing the bridge? And that's not the worst of it — there's goblins sneaking all about as well, snatching everything that's not tied down!"
6868988a-b6d4-43ea-b85c-74bbbcd6a9d8: {n}The man falls silent. The men behind him all looking at their feet uncomfortably.{/n}
a6915105-cf12-4eee-81ae-9e7b5643f580: "But, but... see..." {n}The man takes a breath, and leans in.{/n} "{mf|Baron|Baroness|King|Queen}, I'm nothing, a pair of hands — I collect the money, see, and let through ones that pay. It'd be better if you took the matter up with the Stag Lord, have a chat with him."
8a1f972a-4941-405d-a0a8-396733fa1bef: {n}The man's eyes light up — then a worried expression crosses his face.{/n} "Yer {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}, me and the boys would like that, we would! But, see, we already answer to the Stag Lord... maybe you should have a word with him about it?"
95a6940f-f59a-4a83-9c12-f3de037893d0: "There, see, right there. Go up to him, he's the one to talk to."
0d6f1458-e4d5-41ac-ad48-6ba9876df92a: {n}The man gives a wide grin.{/n} "Easy pickings, Yer {mf|Grace|Grace|Highness|Highness}! Doing well as before, but now's it's easier getting them to part with their coin now we have your blessing!"
8bfff3ac-b488-4070-94e7-f284576f21e7: "Amiri, have you ever tried to count how many enemies you've killed?"
d5b8aee5-55f5-4f66-9bcb-e1564088a0d7: "A lot! There aren't even such high numbers! If someone wanted to count that high, they'd have to start making up new numbers a long time ago!"
f539f3dc-28e0-4bb5-8e50-5823f9270434: "Why did you leave your home? Do any traveling bards ever live happily ever after? Or did you hope to earn your glory, singing songs in taverns?"
b7d26251-b6d9-4d9a-80e6-073df98c49a8: "Heh, you don't appreciate your happiness! You've been surrounded by books, paintings, poets and singers since you were a child... In our village the only entertainments we had were tavern fights and harvest dance parties! I'd have died of boredom if I'd stayed there!"
5381c2ed-91b5-4148-9706-b84db4e5e445: "Yes, Jhod. We found the source of the infection and destroyed it once and for all. They won't be back."
9bb70535-fb5c-4b04-9806-9eb602d02143: "What difference does that make, you weakling? You're just going to die on me now? You're such a letdown, to me and the entire town!"
b4225656-2201-4013-95ff-78a1b3051174: "Hey, Jhod, what do you think you're doing? If you're thinking of hopping the twig, you'd best think again, old man! I need someone around who can cure the immense hangover I'll have after tomorrow's feast, you know?"
f74dee81-713c-4c03-ada0-46b66b98ac14: "We found where the fiends are coming from. Now we just need to pay them a visit and dispose of this threat."
41405c31-b1f2-4f50-a1b0-c17c3d15e2cc: "We found and destroyed the source of the infection. There won't be anymore seeds."
668a2e3f-7666-49ee-a576-27417c8c01c7: {n}Jhod Kavken lies on the ground, broken and bloody. When he sees you, he groans quietly. You can tell there's no saving the old priest.{/n} "The city..." {n}he whispers.{/n} "Is the city... safe?"
c76408d9-a4b4-4b88-9c1d-97a614050695: {n}The old priest winces. He's holding his side, and while bloodstains are slowly spreading on his clothes, it's clear that his life isn't in danger.{/n} "You came! I prayed to {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} that you would make it in time!"
dff2862e-55f0-4b79-afa0-3980b0116ac1: {n}The priest whispers a prayer and touches the wound on the warrior's hip, then the wound immediately begins to close. Jhod lifts his eyes and notices you.{/n} "Praised be {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, you made it!"
fa7dd524-5046-4b93-acb6-c849e8be3cdd: "You're the best thing... these lands have seen... in centuries... Take care of yourself... And take care of them..."
d2f06e11-12e7-4cc2-9937-fc20ee623068: "You're... an evil {mf|man|woman}..." {n}Jhod coughs wetly, and blood runs down his chin.{/n} "But these lands... have no other protector... It falls to you... There is... no one else..."
643b2de7-bb43-481b-9f01-e80ffaf1d9e0: {n}The priest's eyes roll back. He dies with a grimace on his face.{/n}
27c29ec8-65f6-486c-a2ea-27dabe8aec14: {n}Jhod laughs sharply, but it immediately becomes a wet cough, and blood runs down his chin.{/n} "Yes... you are mad after all... But I wouldn't want... anyone else... protecting these lands... Take care of them..."
b9799a4b-70f6-4dd7-9b4f-9fe3e5c34202: {n}The priest's eyes roll back. He dies with a smile on his broken lips.{/n}
89db562a-b126-412f-b6e1-4f3bb8480106: {n}Jhod's eyes roll back. His bloodied face looks almost serene.{/n}
28a034ca-3cb9-4ca1-a6ec-fa00b5b0ba7c: A trifle... Nothing a prayer to {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} couldn't cure. But my wound can wait — the townsfolk are in greater need of divine aid than I am."
ee587ff7-03d4-4d74-b923-1c3969123bc3: "I had just finished an operation and was preparing for the next one when all the remaining patients... bloomed. There were no survivors. I managed to fight my way to the street — and landed straight in this monster's claws! I was running out of spells and stamina... If it weren't for you, I'd have met my end."
25e123d3-41b8-4283-a392-56883b027a01: "There are still many wounded in the city streets. I aim to help everyone I can."
4e41abd8-bb87-430a-a67a-017ff02ab6c5: "Go, Your Grace. I must leave as well — the battle isn't over yet. Horrendous creatures prowl the streets, and there are wounded in need of aid. {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g} save us all!"
57c490ce-67c5-4491-8eb8-11b0913bca95: "Hardly a scratch, Your Grace. I'm afraid the same can't be said of many of the townsfolk..."
84d5e6bd-add8-4665-a032-8ae17ef5f7c6: {n}The priest clutches his holy symbol and whispers a prayer.{/n}
1fb44cf8-bd8a-46e3-8b38-0580f3f9db8f: "Right, all hail me... Thanks for knocking some sense back into me. Not sure I could live with myself if Jhod had been gobbled up while I was playing hero out there."
84e2db66-be0e-42bd-a6ab-dedeb2554c55: "Praise to {g|Erastil}Erastil{/g}, shield of these lands! Once the battle is over, you must make your way there and destroy the source of this plague! Burn everything in your sight, if need be!"
69ab35d5-0afc-4d4c-b568-3b08b4245003: "This is joyous news... or would be, in most any other situation... Still, praised be your name, our deliverer. You've saved your realm and rescued the people!"
2ef703d0-0a4e-453f-acb3-7e2c2cc8f87e: {n}Kesten gives a short bow and follows Jhod out.{/n}
